http://lmss.sali.org/R3Vk2eHOjTsqOyQaAHj.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, the creation, export or delivery of a document production set including: creation of production export, metadata redaction, creation of delivery media and image branding. Excludes cost of printed set (X101 or X102).
http://lmss.sali.org/R3Vk2eHOjTsqOyQaAHj.pref_label: A125 Document Production Creation and Preparation

http://lmss.sali.org/R3Xgl77xYQjGnw8EJTT.label: Client Organizational Unit
http://lmss.sali.org/R3Xgl77xYQjGnw8EJTT.definition: The particular company entity/division/unit (e.g., Sales, Human Resources) for which the legal work is being performed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3XhsEnunIrdi5MYNdL.label: Children's Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R3XhsEnunIrdi5MYNdL.definition: Children's rights are the legal and moral entitlements specifically aimed at the protection and welfare of minors. These rights may include, but are not limited to, the right to education, healthcare, protection from abuse and exploitation, and participation in family and cultural life, often upheld by international law such as the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3XuZ2VcNStGsIrlegq.label: WC180 Alternative Fee Arrangements
http://lmss.sali.org/R3XuZ2VcNStGsIrlegq.definition: This code includes all non-hourly or other alternative fee arrangements for tasks and activities in this phase.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3a93_SRkRRS5rksR9X.label: TR400 Domestic Trademark Prosecution and Renewal
http://lmss.sali.org/R3a93_SRkRRS5rksR9X.definition: All action associated with prosecuting and renewing a trademark application in the home country of an applicant, including initial review and any calendaring of any response deadline, report to client with any proposed response, review of applicant's instructions and comments, preparation of amendments and/or responsive arguments, examiner interviews, and report of actions to the client. Excludes any filings in response to Official Communications under TR430. Includes any affidavit, petition, extension, declaration and other requests for supervisory action that are not decided by a quasi-judicial or appellate tribunal within the Trademark Office. Note that governmental fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the US) are included under E100.
http://lmss.sali.org/R3a93_SRkRRS5rksR9X.pref_label: TR400 Domestic Trademark Prosecution and Renewal

http://lmss.sali.org/R3b7f27oh98hVpr5wWv.label: Liver or Gallbladder Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R3b7f27oh98hVpr5wWv.definition: Liver cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the liver cells, with the most common type being hepatocellular carcinoma. It often requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy, depending on the stage and extent of the disease.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3bU74bKrSAyu2rkZ4S.label: Negative Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R3bU74bKrSAyu2rkZ4S.definition: A Negative Covenant is a legal provision that prohibits a party from performing a certain action or engaging in a particular activity, as specified in a contract or agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3e2z0YyuTWB0E6NALi.label: Abandonment of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/R3e2z0YyuTWB0E6NALi.definition: Escheatment is the legal process by which unclaimed or abandoned property reverts to the state. This occurs when the rightful owner of the property cannot be located or has failed to claim ownership within a specified period, resulting in the transfer of the property to government custody.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3erD0I2JnRN8fVHGUf.label: Prehearing Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/R3erD0I2JnRN8fVHGUf.definition: A Prehearing Conference is a litigation event that occurs before a hearing, where the parties and the judge discuss the case and attempt to resolve any issues or streamline the hearing process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3gxP7qFBBfoVwuD03a.label: Judicial Discretion
http://lmss.sali.org/R3gxP7qFBBfoVwuD03a.definition: Judicial discretion refers to the power and authority granted to judges to make decisions or take actions within the bounds of the law based on their interpretation, judgment, and application of legal principles. This discretion is exercised to ensure justice and fairness but is generally subject to appellate review to prevent arbitrary or capricious rulings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3h3lX4YER9yUBrmYJN.label: PA599 Other Patent Application Preparation - International
http://lmss.sali.org/R3h3lX4YER9yUBrmYJN.definition: Use only for preparation activities in connection with patent applications that are to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, and that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.
http://lmss.sali.org/R3h3lX4YER9yUBrmYJN.pref_label: PA599 Other Patent Application Preparation - International

http://lmss.sali.org/R3hoFzzOMUpoN1ikUIW.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Executory Contracts and Unexpired Leases
http://lmss.sali.org/R3hoFzzOMUpoN1ikUIW.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Executory Contracts and Unexpired Leases, also known as Schedule G, requires the debtor to list all ongoing contracts and active leases that have not been fully performed or expired as of the bankruptcy filing date. This schedule provides details about each contract and lease, including the counterparty's name, the nature of the agreement, and any relevant terms.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3i3yf8DfaqtgbC4Qmp.label: New Jersey Court of Common Pleas
http://lmss.sali.org/R3i3yf8DfaqtgbC4Qmp.definition: The New Jersey Court of Common Pleas is a trial court within the New Jersey State Courts system that handles civil and criminal cases at the county level.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3lzB8rbUKBznJCewfI.label: Supplemental Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/R3lzB8rbUKBznJCewfI.definition: A Supplemental Appendix is an additional section of a document or report that provides further information or data beyond what is included in the main body of the Appendix.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3mSLYffVXqWZk2f3IX.label: New York Town Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R3mSLYffVXqWZk2f3IX.definition: New York Town Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the New York State Courts system that handles minor civil and criminal matters at the local level.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3pDZshEsgzcL5fOhCM.label: Leave Eligibility Miscalculation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R3pDZshEsgzcL5fOhCM.definition: A leave eligibility miscalculation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for improperly calculating their eligibility for protected leave under applicable laws. These laws may include the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the California Family Rights Act (CFRA), or other state and local laws that provide protected leave for certain reasons, such as for the employee's own serious health condition, to care for a seriously ill family member, or for the birth or adoption of a child. The claim typically arises when an employer miscalculates an employee's eligibility for protected leave, which can result in the employee being denied leave or having their leave prematurely terminated.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3uq0eVSfEpZbTNkX6M.label: Collaborative
http://lmss.sali.org/R3uq0eVSfEpZbTNkX6M.definition: Collaborative negotiation is a negotiation approach where parties work together cooperatively to find mutually beneficial solutions, emphasizing communication, trust, and problem-solving. This style focuses on creating value and fostering long-term relationships, often characterized by open dialogue and a willingness to understand and accommodate each party's interests.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3vPpsxzF77aXJwiOJ3.label: Nevada District Court - Clark County
http://lmss.sali.org/R3vPpsxzF77aXJwiOJ3.definition: The Nevada District Court - Clark County is a specific court within the Nevada District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clark County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R3wLqupQlOkBDRXPF6b.label: Wrongful Death Claim

http://lmss.sali.org/R6BuVjQc5Xltba4bK4j.label: Wood Product Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R6BuVjQc5Xltba4bK4j.definition: Establishments in the Wood Product Manufacturing subsector manufacture wood products, such as lumber, plywood, veneers, wood containers, wood flooring, wood trusses, manufactured homes (i.e., mobile homes), and prefabricated wood buildings.  The production processes of the Wood Product Manufacturing subsector include sawing, planing, shaping, laminating, and assembling wood products starting from logs that are cut into bolts, or lumber that then may be further cut, or shaped by lathes or other shaping tools.  The lumber or other transformed wood shapes may also be subsequently planed or smoothed, and assembled into finished products, such as wood containers.  The Wood Product Manufacturing subsector includes establishments that make wood products from logs and bolts that are sawed and shaped, and establishments that purchase sawed lumber and make wood products.  With the exception of sawmills and wood preservation establishments, the establishments are grouped into industries mainly based on the specific products manufactured.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73dveMt11oYotWVGR1.definition: Cherries are small, round stone fruits from the Prunus genus, characterized by their juicy flesh, smooth skin, and varying flavors from sweet to tart. They are widely consumed fresh, dried, or processed into products like jams, pies, and beverages, valued for their rich antioxidant content, vitamins, and dietary fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73e7MvslVKhXMpvW8l.label: Status - Approved
http://lmss.sali.org/R73e7MvslVKhXMpvW8l.definition: Status of "Approved" indicates that an application or request has been reviewed and granted approval by the relevant authority, confirming that the individual's request or application has met the necessary criteria and legal requirements, allowing them to proceed with the intended action, status change, or benefit. This tag is particularly relevant to regulatory agencies (e.g., immigration, patent, trademark).

http://lmss.sali.org/R73fgmpNbSrKeieM9ZP.label: Past Recollection Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R73fgmpNbSrKeieM9ZP.definition: Past recollection recorded is a document that is a hearsay exception, allowing a witness to use a written or recorded statement to testify about a matter that they once knew but cannot recall during testimony. The statement must have been made when the event was fresh in the witness's memory and must accurately reflect their knowledge at that time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73hoH1RXYjBTYiGfol.label: Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R73hoH1RXYjBTYiGfol.definition: A matter's events, as well as collections of those events (often noted as "phases").

http://lmss.sali.org/R73jCDNZO71858YRbQG.label: Freedom from Slavery
http://lmss.sali.org/R73jCDNZO71858YRbQG.definition: Freedom from slavery is a basic human right that prohibits all forms of slavery, servitude, and forced or compulsory labor. This right is enshrined in various international instruments, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the United Nations Slavery Convention, and is considered a non-derogable right, meaning it cannot be suspended for any reason.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73kyLODrqAqSL1LXWd.label: Mutual Waiver of Consequential Damages Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R73kyLODrqAqSL1LXWd.definition: A Mutual Waiver of Consequential Damages Clause is a provision in a contract where both parties agree to waive their right to seek damages for indirect or consequential losses resulting from a breach of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73l5ieLA2jBChIQidq.label: Cluttering
http://lmss.sali.org/R73l5ieLA2jBChIQidq.definition: Cluttering is a speech disorder characterized by a rapid or irregular speech rate, which often results in disorganized speech patterns, including omitting or collapsing syllables and words. This disorder affects the clarity and fluency of speech, making it difficult for listeners to understand.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73nCk9hdOpN2xWeIaJ.label: Germanic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R73nCk9hdOpN2xWeIaJ.definition: Germanic languages are a branch of the language family that includes English, German, Dutch, and Scandinavian languages.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73uN7kP1iXmj2AOvXW.definition: Time limitation of public benefit refers to a policy that restricts the duration for which an individual or family can receive financial assistance or services from a specific public benefit program. This is designed to encourage recipients to become self-sufficient and reduce long-term dependency on government aid.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73uTlrSoALybiLK0Ko.label: Pheasants
http://lmss.sali.org/R73uTlrSoALybiLK0Ko.definition: Pheasants are a group of large, colorful birds belonging to the family Phasianidae, often raised for their meat, ornamental value, and hunting purposes. Known for their striking plumage and game bird status, pheasants are commonly found in agricultural and wild settings, contributing to both culinary and recreational activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73wyWRNERaEWYgVxiG.label: Chamic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R73wyWRNERaEWYgVxiG.definition: Chamic languages are a group of languages that belong to the larger category of languages and are spoken in Southeast Asia, including Cambodia, Vietnam, and Thailand.

http://lmss.sali.org/R73y1XBWub6SsArvBiT.label: Conversion Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/R73y1XBWub6SsArvBiT.definition: Conversion Disorder involves the presence of one or more symptoms of altered motor or sensory function that are inconsistent with or cannot be fully explained by medical or neurological conditions. The symptoms cause significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other important areas of functioning.
examples: Functional Paralysis: An individual displays paralysis or motor dysfunction with no identifiable medical cause or neurological disorder.
Non-Epileptic Seizures: A person experiences seizures that do not have a neurological basis and cannot be explained by epilepsy or other medical conditions.
Sensory Loss: A person experiences loss of sensation, such as blindness or deafness, without any underlying medical or neurological condition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R74Ml4vxSPjSu45jw41.definition: A Biometric Claim refers to a legal assertion or action brought under laws regulating the collection, use, and storage of biometric data, such as fingerprints, facial recognition, and other unique biological attributes. examples: New York City Biometric Information Privacy Law
Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI)

http://lmss.sali.org/R74TUaDuXhtfgwnBtY3.definition: A Due Date Event refers to the specified deadline by which a particular task, action, or submission is required to be completed. http://lmss.sali.org/R74W8n1Is40wEpY9mVJ.label: Genderfluid
http://lmss.sali.org/R74W8n1Is40wEpY9mVJ.definition: Genderfluid refers to a gender identity or expression that may change over time or depending on circumstances, signifying a fluid or dynamic experience of gender rather than a fixed or static identity. http://lmss.sali.org/R74eoff0t9bkabhhZR2.definition: An Appellate Court Judicial Opinion is a written decision by a higher court that reviews and affirms, reverses, or modifies the decision of a lower court, and provides legal reasoning and analysis for the decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R74qtGrajLRLamHOPJf.label: Sexual Orientation
http://lmss.sali.org/R74qtGrajLRLamHOPJf.definition: Sexual orientation refers to an individual's enduring pattern of emotional, romantic, and/or sexual attractions to men, women, both genders, or neither. Sexual orientation is often a protected characteristic under anti-discrimination laws, which aim to ensure that individuals are treated fairly and equally regardless of their orientation. In many jurisdictions, these laws prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation in areas such as employment, housing, education, and public services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R75XNpcAhlxR5GFSURD.definition: An indefinite term clause is a provision in a contract that does not specify a specific duration or end date for the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R75bHdlOpZuNpI8BozM.definition: A nondelegable duty is a legal obligation that cannot be transferred or assigned to another party, even if that party is an agent or representative of the original party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R76SBh2sN45UoKUS5e9.label: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Purchaser for Intentional Nondisclosure of Material Facts
http://lmss.sali.org/R76SBh2sN45UoKUS5e9.definition: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Purchaser for Intentional Nondisclosure of Material Facts: The legal responsibility of a real estate broker to a purchaser for intentionally withholding important information about a property that would have affected the purchaser's decision to buy, and the resulting legal claims that may be brought against the broker for such actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R76UTCrg8DDzlFkZCPj.definition: A Specialty Occupation Visa is a type of visa that allows foreign nationals to work in a job that requires specialized knowledge or expertise, typically at a professional level that requires at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent. http://lmss.sali.org/R76WkcXfFt3glDpVhlV.definition: A Release of Liability Clause is a legal provision that relieves one party from responsibility for any harm or damage caused to another party, typically in the context of a contract or agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R76ZlnhoJvqxs7byZOM.label: Not in Destination Country
http://lmss.sali.org/R76ZlnhoJvqxs7byZOM.definition: In the context of immigration law, "Not in Destination Country" refers to an individual who is not in the United States but may be in the process of seeking admission or has intentions to travel there. http://lmss.sali.org/R77x3SkEZVElsBUssI5.definition: A Debenture is a type of long-term debt instrument that is not secured by physical assets or collateral but is backed only by the general creditworthiness and reputation of the issuer. http://lmss.sali.org/R77xnTlfaItCdEEx5Ej.label: Development Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R77xnTlfaItCdEEx5Ej.definition: A Development Agreement is a legally binding contract between parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the development of a specific property or project.

http://lmss.sali.org/R77zwCEC3rQgFNALnni.definition: A sales commission is a form of payment that individuals receive based on a percentage of the sales they generate or the business they bring in. http://lmss.sali.org/R783351768f732C2bad.label: U.S. Dept. of Housing and Urban Development
http://lmss.sali.org/R783351768f732C2bad.definition: The United States Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) is a Cabinet department in the Executive branch of the United States federal government. HUD's mission is to create strong, sustainable, inclusive communities and quality affordable homes for all. HUD is working to strengthen the housing market to bolster the economy and protect consumers; meet the need for quality affordable rental homes; utilize housing as a platform for improving quality of life; build inclusive and sustainable communities free from discrimination, and transform the way HUD does business.

http://lmss.sali.org/R784c4f2919de292371.label: State Department Office of the Inspector General

http://lmss.sali.org/R78P63bt8qx54WQ5xBd.label: Nordic Law System

http://lmss.sali.org/R78PKqeEIORKpYVwEfC.definition: A vote is the act or process of expressing a choice or preference in a decision-making procedure, often within a formal setting such as an election or a meeting. http://lmss.sali.org/R78bV0IQasgnKfZBYYe.label: Dormant Commerce Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R78bV0IQasgnKfZBYYe.definition: A Dormant Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation violates the United States Constitution by burdening or discriminating against interstate commerce. http://lmss.sali.org/R79RlwOz0IOIvKNxmXN.definition: A Writ of Certiorari is a legal document filed with an appellate court requesting that the court review a lower court's decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R79UCI3zYVOfFextRds.definition: The party or parties in a class action lawsuit who represents the interests of the entire class of similarly situated individuals or entities. http://lmss.sali.org/R79WNFd9w49QaDgGyJg.definition: Law governing the rights, interests, and legal status of indigenous peoples, including land rights, treaty obligations, self-determination, cultural heritage protection, resource rights, and the relationship between indigenous communities and the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/R79ZRcChNA1jEORJLsP.definition: Public benefits objectives refer to legal services related to the accurate and efficient distribution of public assistance to eligible recipients. For example, underpayment objectives focus on identifying and rectifying instances where beneficiaries receive less than they are entitled to, often due to administrative errors or oversight. Overpayment objectives aim to detect and recover funds that have been erroneously disbursed in excess of eligibility, to maintain the integrity and sustainability of the benefit program.

http://lmss.sali.org/R79ZnCKDSoLOn17LGjA.label: Patent Subject-Matter Classifications
http://lmss.sali.org/R79ZnCKDSoLOn17LGjA.definition: Patent Subject-Matter Classifications are a system of categorizing patents and patent applications based on the technical fields or subject matter they pertain to, such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, and life sciences. http://lmss.sali.org/R79aItNTJQwHgR002wu.label: Data Format
http://lmss.sali.org/R79aItNTJQwHgR002wu.definition: The data structure that gives the file its meaning; in the context of legal data, the format of the legal-data file (e.g., Microsoft Word Document, Adobe Acrobat PDF, Microsoft Excel file).

http://lmss.sali.org/R79avSlZ9WCGqpbXi4A.label: Motion for Summary Disposition
http://lmss.sali.org/R79avSlZ9WCGqpbXi4A.definition: A Motion for Summary Disposition is a request made to an appellate court to dispose of a case without a full trial, based on the evidence and arguments presented in the record.

http://lmss.sali.org/R79dS3BFjCbPpeHjyI3.label: Aplastic Anemia
http://lmss.sali.org/R79dS3BFjCbPpeHjyI3.definition: Aplastic anemia is a condition characterized by the failure of the bone marrow to produce sufficient quantities of blood cells, leading to pancytopenia (low levels of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets). http://lmss.sali.org/R79ooHwjGKqjqJTzhOx.definition: A Personal Day is a type of paid time off provided by employers that allows employees to take leave for personal reasons without specifying the nature of the absence. http://lmss.sali.org/R79uvw3nIwtdShCWTu6.label: Binge-Eating Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/R79uvw3nIwtdShCWTu6.definition: Binge-Eating Disorder is an eating disorder characterized by recurrent episodes of eating large quantities of food in a short period, accompanied by feelings of loss of control during the binge and significant distress or impairment. http://lmss.sali.org/R7IjZ1aqBNtooeIsm94.definition: To unlawfully obtain money, property, or any other thing of value, either tangible or intangible, through the use or threat of force, misuse of authority, threat of criminal prosecution, threat of destruction of reputation or social standing, or through other coercive means.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7InIIPkEsFj4mgSQmz.label: tax_on_tax
http://lmss.sali.org/R7InIIPkEsFj4mgSQmz.definition:
"""Tax-on-Tax"" is a situation where one or more taxes in a tax jurisdiction are based on the sum of the corresponding invoice line item totals AND any other tax amount previously applied to those line item totals. For example, formerly n both Quebec and Prince Edward Island Canada had specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Io9U9PqnfjRLxLhRB.label: Bankruptcy Plan Confirmation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Io9U9PqnfjRLxLhRB.definition: The Bankruptcy Plan Confirmation (Event) is the legal process of approving a debtor's proposed plan for reorganizing their finances and repaying their debts, which occurs within the context of a bankruptcy case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7IqV5quFMKN1NFsYqq.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Warren County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7IqV5quFMKN1NFsYqq.definition: A court located in Warren County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ItETKZAfykvNgICh5.label: Chronic Bronchitis
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ItETKZAfykvNgICh5.definition: Chronic bronchitis is a type of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) characterized by persistent inflammation of the bronchial tubes, leading to a chronic cough and production of mucus over a period of at least three months per year for two consecutive years. This condition results in narrowed airways and impaired airflow, causing difficulty in breathing and frequent respiratory infections.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ItJL7sTHMRx2i7WbP.label: Geese
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ItJL7sTHMRx2i7WbP.definition: Geese are domesticated waterfowl belonging to the genus Anser and Branta, commonly raised for their meat, eggs, feathers, and down. Known for their grazing habits and strong flocking instincts, geese are often utilized in agriculture for weeding and as guard animals, as well as for their high-quality meat and egg production.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7IurUy8ro7uBQ6cHRD.label: Supersedeas Bond Payment Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R7IurUy8ro7uBQ6cHRD.definition: A Supersedeas Bond Payment is the payment of a type of surety bond required by a court from an appellant who seeks to delay payment of a judgment until the appeal is resolved. This bond ensures that the appellee will be compensated if the appellant fails to meet the judgment after the appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7IyL6dp9k9JuIaKGhP.label: Fishing License
http://lmss.sali.org/R7IyL6dp9k9JuIaKGhP.definition: A fishing license is an official permit issued by a governing authority that allows individuals to legally catch fish in specific bodies of water during certain times. The purpose of such licenses is to regulate and conserve fish populations, ensuring sustainable practices. To acquire a fishing license, individuals usually pay a fee, and in some jurisdictions, they might also need to complete an educational course or adhere to certain regulations, such as bag and size limits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Iyau03VDMkjuzpdOX.label: Visa for Parent of Crime Victim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Iyau03VDMkjuzpdOX.definition: The Visa for Parent of Crime Victim is a derivative visa granted to the parent of a principal U Nonimmigrant Visa holder (U-1 Visa), specifically when the U-1 Visa holder is under 21 years old. It allows the parent to enter and remain in the U.S. as long as the principal U Visa holder maintains their status.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7J2SwejNGksmubIaDs.label: Texas District Court - Tarrant County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7J2SwejNGksmubIaDs.definition: A Texas District Court located in Tarrant County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Texas handling civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7J4lqNzHVYdV3Gz1aG.label: Deposition Transcripts Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/R7J4lqNzHVYdV3Gz1aG.definition: The Deposition Transcripts Expense refers to the cost incurred by a party in a legal matter for obtaining a written record of a witness's testimony given under oath outside of court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7J5tsgW4oZHjUWIol2.label: Out of Immigration Status
http://lmss.sali.org/R7J5tsgW4oZHjUWIol2.definition: "Out of Status" refers to the condition where an individual has violated the terms of their visa or other immigration authorization. This could involve overstaying the duration specified on their visa, working without proper authorization, or failing to maintain enrollment in a study program, among other infractions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7J7NYI0WlIIflyMEgn.label: Buyer Consent Requirement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7J7NYI0WlIIflyMEgn.definition: Buyer Consent Requirement is a legal concept that refers to the obligation of a party to obtain the consent of the buyer before taking certain actions, subject to certain conditions and limitations, as specified in a negative covenant.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7J9mdDwUbagFyDrtDm.label: Texas District Court - Kaufman County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7J9mdDwUbagFyDrtDm.definition: A Texas District Court located in Kaufman County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JH92eqeB3Aq5I1zYF.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Marion County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JH92eqeB3Aq5I1zYF.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Marion County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Marion County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JJFiu27ZoIAXcxG0O.definition: The Virgin Islands Supreme Court is the highest court in the Virgin Islands Territory Courts system, responsible for hearing appeals and making final decisions on legal disputes within the territory.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JKVOM2aFkvG1yiLzF.definition: Defamation is a civil claim and tort claim that involves the communication of a false statement that harms the reputation of an individual or entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JNvoooIaePAkBMY2R.definition: Qualified Immunity: A legal doctrine that shields government officials from liability for civil damages in cases where their actions did not violate clearly established statutory or constitutional rights of which a reasonable person would have known.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JVzHB6Maj6HKG0jTx.label: Motion for Hardship Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JVzHB6Maj6HKG0jTx.definition: A Motion for Hardship Discharge is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case, seeking to discharge the debtor from their remaining debts due to extreme financial hardship.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JWlrPoiFzoTpw51us.label: End User License Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JWlrPoiFzoTpw51us.definition: An End User License Agreement is a legal contract between a software application author or publisher and the user of that application. The EULA details how the software can be used and any restrictions on its use.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JXHwSxMx4w6TqRPF7.label: Indiana Superior Court - Clay County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JXHwSxMx4w6TqRPF7.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Clay County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JYtOWpJ7Ll2VatPjc.definition: Sorbian languages refer to a group of Slavic languages spoken in eastern Germany, and are a subcategory of the broader concept of Language.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JZv6z3TDA2deV497R.definition: An Alternative Dispute Resolution Clause is a provision in a contract that requires parties to resolve any disputes through methods other than litigation, such as mediation or arbitration.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jdt796FlfxJBeCqnk.definition: A Homeowner is an individual or entity that holds legal title to a residential property. This term is typically used in contexts such as property tax assessment, real estate transactions, and asset evaluation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JjaM6OYcXyCHcp1bQ.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Salem County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Salem County and serving as a trial court for civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JlaNDA5Ji5sdlFMTq.label: Appellate Briefing Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JlaNDA5Ji5sdlFMTq.definition: Appellate Briefing Practice refers to the specialized legal practice of preparing written arguments and submissions to a higher court for the purpose of appealing a lower court's decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jo1aujvVXJf6e9d3X.definition: A Periodical is a regularly published work that includes a collection of articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements, typically focusing on specific subjects or areas of interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jo3gp8LjhpdJNXYE9.label: Reorganization Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jo3gp8LjhpdJNXYE9.definition: This is a process where a company, individual, or any other entity rearranges its debts in order to remain viable. The debtor typically retains their assets and continues to operate the business, while working out a plan to repay creditors over time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jows5YP8imYL7zA2a.label: Instant Runoff Electoral System
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Jows5YP8imYL7zA2a.definition: The instant runoff electoral system, also known as ranked-choice voting, is a voting method where voters rank candidates by preference. If no candidate wins a majority of first-preference votes, the candidate with the fewest votes is eliminated, and their votes are redistributed according to the voters' next preferences, continuing until one candidate achieves a majority.
examples: Multi-Winner IRV: Minneapolis city council elections
Single-Winner IRV: San Francisco mayoral elections

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JpSKT0YIcvskga9qV.label: Infectious Disease Specialist Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JpSKT0YIcvskga9qV.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional who specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7JpuC51ZTyEzu5Wv0G.label: Massachusetts Trial Court - Housing Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7JpuC51ZTyEzu5Wv0G.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court - Housing Court is a specialized court within the Massachusetts Trial Court system that handles cases related to housing disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7K2qUhID6JtseZQoE6.label: Funds Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7K2qUhID6JtseZQoE6.definition: Funds Practice involves the legal aspects of forming, managing, and regulating investment funds, including private equity funds, hedge funds, and venture capital funds. This practice area covers fund structuring, compliance with financial regulations, investor relations, and transactional activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7K5c8d5SpTPn51L6Oy.label: Substance Abuse and Drug Testing Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7K5c8d5SpTPn51L6Oy.definition: Substance Abuse and Drug Testing Law refers to the legal framework governing the testing of individuals for the presence of drugs and the regulation of substance abuse. It includes policies, procedures, and regulations related to the detection, prevention, and treatment of drug use and addiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7K8uOM9AVSJfW9z6zQ.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Warren County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7K8uOM9AVSJfW9z6zQ.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Warren County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Warren County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KAqYfSya4NlgEIbP3.label: Informally Consulted Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KAqYfSya4NlgEIbP3.definition: An expert whom a party approaches informally for consultation, but the party never retains or engages the expert.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KDJyh80vhtCWC1jOu.label: Hittite
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KDJyh80vhtCWC1jOu.definition: A language used by the ancient Hittite civilization, which is now extinct.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KGGhirGUj2y81W5Kp.label: Warrant Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KGGhirGUj2y81W5Kp.definition: A warrant claim refers to a legal assertion involving the issuance, execution, or validity of a warrant, which is an official document issued by a judicial officer that authorizes law enforcement to perform certain acts, such as an arrest, a search, or a seizure. A warrant claim can take many forms, including claims that a warrant was improperly issued, executed, or lacked sufficient cause.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KHm1waJ0vHLMZ0i6u.label: Debtor's Statement Regarding Pending Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KHm1waJ0vHLMZ0i6u.definition: A Debtor's Statement Regarding Pending Proceeding is a written document submitted in a bankruptcy or restructuring case that provides information about any ongoing legal proceedings involving the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KJAcIi5UZdgjv5R4E.label: Georgia District Court - Carroll County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KJAcIi5UZdgjv5R4E.definition: Georgia District Court - Carroll County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Carroll County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KKPWuNeKZR4f78UNX.label: Surveillance Device Warrant
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KKPWuNeKZR4f78UNX.definition: A Surveillance Device Warrant is a legal document issued by a court that authorizes law enforcement agencies to install and use surveillance devices, such as wiretaps, cameras, or tracking devices, to monitor and gather evidence on suspected criminal activities. This type of warrant is typically subject to strict legal standards and oversight to protect individuals' privacy rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KLFf3gPDu1CcoHKnJ.label: L330 Depositions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KLFf3gPDu1CcoHKnJ.definition: A deposition (L330) is a legal proceeding where a witness gives sworn testimony outside of court, typically in a lawyer's office, as part of the discovery (L300) process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KRLFkDC6ycyN3FyXi.label: Consumer Credit and Unfair Debt Collection Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KRLFkDC6ycyN3FyXi.definition: Consumer Credit and Unfair Debt Collection Claims refer to legal claims made by individuals against creditors or debt collectors for unfair or deceptive practices in the collection of debts or the provision of credit.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KSeR2OcrUxcnB9JZY.label: Legal Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KSeR2OcrUxcnB9JZY.definition: Fraud committed by a legal service provider, which involves intentional deception or misrepresentation of facts to gain an unfair advantage or benefit in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KT28JDYyoIznmDdBf.label: General Release
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KT28JDYyoIznmDdBf.definition: A General Release is a legal document that releases a party from all known and unknown claims, demands, and liabilities arising from a particular matter, without specifying the particular claims or demands being released.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KYATnZcNxJsZ1MQBA.label: Water Resources and Wetlands Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KYATnZcNxJsZ1MQBA.definition: Law governing the management, use, and protection of water resources (including surface water and groundwater, oceans and seas) and wetland ecosystems. Includes water rights, allocation, flood control, and the conservation of wetlands as critical habitats for wildlife and natural water filtration.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KYfSpf0bnFF3LV3RL.label: National Labor Relations Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KYfSpf0bnFF3LV3RL.definition: A National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) claim is a legal action initiated by an employee or group of employees against an employer, alleging that the employer has violated their rights under the NLRA, which is a federal law enacted in 1935 to protect employees' rights to engage in collective bargaining, join or form labor unions, and participate in other concerted activities related to their employment conditions. The NLRA also prohibits employers from interfering with these rights or retaliating against employees for exercising them. An NLRA claim may be filed with the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB), which investigates the allegations and can impose legal remedies, such as reinstatement, back pay, or policy changes, to ensure compliance with the law and the protection of employees' rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KZwhAGHfOZiJ3JU4w.label: Railroad Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KZwhAGHfOZiJ3JU4w.definition: The concept of Railroad Negligence refers to the legal responsibility of a common carrier, such as a railroad company, to exercise reasonable care in the operation and maintenance of its equipment and facilities to prevent harm to passengers and others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KdA9imirXtH3TmNJA.label: Escrow Instructions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KdA9imirXtH3TmNJA.definition: An Escrow Instructions Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for the delivery of funds or property to a third-party escrow agent for safekeeping until certain conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KdQLWwrvkyzohDgf4.label: Intellectual Property Regulatory Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KdQLWwrvkyzohDgf4.definition: An Intellectual Property Regulatory Document, such as a Patent Application, Trademark Application, or Copyright Application, is a formal submission to a governmental body to secure legal protection for a specific piece of intellectual property. It outlines the details of the intellectual property, provides evidence of its originality or distinctiveness, and serves as the basis for granting or denying the intellectual property rights

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KfGheIupP0PG2C1rT.label: Common Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KfGheIupP0PG2C1rT.definition: Common Law is a legal system characterized by case law developed by judges through decisions in individual cases, rather than through legislative statutes or executive branch action. This system relies heavily on the doctrine of precedent, where past judicial decisions are authoritative in future cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KhOsYwbnspBGTPBjt.label: Motion for New Trial - Excessive Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KhOsYwbnspBGTPBjt.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Excessive Damages is a legal request made by a party to a lawsuit asking the court to set aside a previous verdict and order a new trial due to the excessive amount of damages awarded.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KiY8F9Txea9UFAm4j.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Testimony
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KiY8F9Txea9UFAm4j.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Testimony is a formal request made to a judge before a trial to prevent certain testimony or evidence from being presented to the jury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KnhbKXnWBeCBhayT7.label: Supply Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KnhbKXnWBeCBhayT7.definition: A supply agreement is a legally binding contract between two parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the supply and delivery of goods or services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KsFvVNE5x9Evtbgti.label: Multilateral Governmental Policy Representations
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KsFvVNE5x9Evtbgti.definition: Multilateral Governmental Policy Representations refer to the legal practice of representing a client's interests in multiple jurisdictions or before various international bodies simultaneously. This practice requires a comprehensive understanding of different legal systems, treaties, and international regulations to effectively advocate for the client across borders.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KwjAGH04YXSDBLO1O.label: Librarian
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KwjAGH04YXSDBLO1O.definition: A Librarian is a professional who manages, categorizes, and provides accessto  collections of legal resources, books, and documents, to ensure that legal practitioners can quickly and accurately access the information they need.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KxYUBMSAuzPHdBhWf.label: Demographic Market Segments
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KxYUBMSAuzPHdBhWf.definition: Demographic segments refer to divisions of the market that are categorized based on demographic characteristics such as age, gender, income, education level, and family status. These segments help marketers and businesses tailor their products and services to specific groups within the population, based on their unique needs and preferences.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7KxjL7VPa0Qrz5eSP9.label: AI Model
http://lmss.sali.org/R7KxjL7VPa0Qrz5eSP9.definition: An AI Model is a core component of an AI system used to make inferences from inputs to produce outputs. It characterizes an input-to-output transformation designed to perform a specific computational task of the AI system, such as classifying an image, predicting the next word in a sequence, or selecting a robot's next action based on its state and goals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7L5eLIzH0CpOUE74uJ.label: Legal Entity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7L5eLIzH0CpOUE74uJ.definition: A person, company, organization, or other entity that has legal rights and obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LAXCx30bNmUdSsBDf.label: Florida Court of Appeals - 4th District
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LAXCx30bNmUdSsBDf.definition: The Florida Court of Appeals - 4th District is a specific court within the Florida District Court of Appeals that hears appeals from trial courts in its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LDrNr3UKXymP1c9pj.label: Tax Tier Total Taxable Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LDrNr3UKXymP1c9pj.definition: The Tax Tier Total Taxable Amount is a subcategory of Tax Tier Detail and refers to the total amount of taxable income subject to a specific tax rate.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LEBX7I09x6PQNyx2J.label: Pay or Play Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LEBX7I09x6PQNyx2J.definition: A Pay or Play Clause is a contractual provision that requires one party to either pay a specified amount or perform a specific action, typically related to employment or entertainment, in order to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LI3BONqNkXbKHKa0t.label: Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LI3BONqNkXbKHKa0t.definition: Any process that involves the liquidation or restructuring a business. The process usually has several parties - debtors, creditors and buyers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LMjAi2eUg18j92Ouj.label: 441 Voting (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LMjAi2eUg18j92Ouj.definition: Action filed under Civil Rights Act, 52 U.S.C. § 10101, and Voting Rights Act, 52 U.S.C. § 10301

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LQAM6H8WDBexXwLl2.label: Independent Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LQAM6H8WDBexXwLl2.definition: An independent committee is a group of people assembled to conduct an activity independent of the management of a company, often in connection with an internal investigation or approval of an interested party transaction. Also known as a "special committee."

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LRKIXqx7XuNkfXue0.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Response
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LRKIXqx7XuNkfXue0.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Response is a formal request made to a court, either appellate or trial, to grant additional time beyond the original deadline for a party to submit a response to a motion or pleading.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LRqYwbWo4Vo6VZx69.label: Redaction Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LRqYwbWo4Vo6VZx69.definition: Redaction Management refers to the process of identifying and removing sensitive or confidential information from legal documents in order to protect the privacy of individuals or organizations involved in litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LZ9PILiO5J5eBv25b.label: Washington Superior Court - Island County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LZ9PILiO5J5eBv25b.definition: Washington Superior Court - Island County is a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Island County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LaDc7tLarcbkRoHGy.label: Invoice Reference
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LaDc7tLarcbkRoHGy.definition: A reference number or identifier used to track and identify a specific fee invoice within a legal engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LcabDb2Hv99SkV7xg.label: Pediatrics Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LcabDb2Hv99SkV7xg.definition: Pediatrics Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that involves the negligent or wrongful actions of healthcare providers in the treatment of children.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ld7qyFJbsJW4bUxqQ.label: Litigation Document Number
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ld7qyFJbsJW4bUxqQ.definition: A Litigation Document Number is a specific identifier assigned to a document related to a legal dispute, used to track and reference the document within the litigation process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LeNe404PtPq9jvTa0.label: Writ of Prohibition
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LeNe404PtPq9jvTa0.definition: A Writ of Prohibition is a legal order issued by a higher court to prevent a lower court or tribunal from exceeding its jurisdiction or acting outside the scope of its authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7LxQrJBJJS1106ICEV.label: Florida Circuit Court - Liberty County - 2nd Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7LxQrJBJJS1106ICEV.definition: A court located in Liberty County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7M0SnFzqvb2ZLS3kR9.label: L240 Dispositive Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7M0SnFzqvb2ZLS3kR9.definition: A dispositive motion is a legal request made by a party in a case, asking the court to make a final decision on a particular issue or the entire case, before a trial takes place.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7M11YumH7mCJwI7JQT.label: California Court of Appeal - 1st Dist.
http://lmss.sali.org/R7M11YumH7mCJwI7JQT.definition: The California Court of Appeal - 1st Dist. is a specific division of the California Court of Appeal, which is a higher court that hears appeals from lower courts in California.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7M2So7cSnn0yNcjECU.label: Breach of Covenant Not to Compete
http://lmss.sali.org/R7M2So7cSnn0yNcjECU.definition: The Breach of Covenant Not to Compete refers to a violation of an agreement between an employee and employer or principal, where the employee agrees not to engage in competitive activities with the employer or principal after leaving their employment or business relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7M8wW11LJaLtWjQS7D.label: Neurological Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/R7M8wW11LJaLtWjQS7D.definition: Neurological disorders encompass a broad range of conditions that affect the nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves. These disorders can result in a variety of symptoms, such as muscle weakness, coordination issues, seizures, and cognitive impairments, requiring tailored medical and therapeutic interventions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MAzHUZtwmTtToqN57.label: Neural Network
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MAzHUZtwmTtToqN57.definition: A neural network consists of one or more layers of neurons connected by weighted links with adjustable weights. Neural networks receive input data and produce an output by passing it through the network, with each neuron performing a simple computation. Although some neural networks aim to simulate the functioning of biological neurons in the nervous system, most neural networks in artificial intelligence are engineering tools that draw only loose inspiration from biology.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ME5bcP1ep2LpnUSiB.label: Pretrial Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ME5bcP1ep2LpnUSiB.definition: Pretrial Practice refers to the legal work and procedures that take place before a trial, including but not limited to motions, pleadings, and discovery.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MGQ9xUx0PxGLp5yxp.label: U.S. Constitutional Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MGQ9xUx0PxGLp5yxp.definition: U.S. Constitutional Claims are claims that a person's rights guaranteed by the Constitution have been infringed upon by a government entity or individual acting under the authority of the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MK1XmyjtYxZKg8Iw4.label: Personal Injury and Tort Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MK1XmyjtYxZKg8Iw4.definition: Law which allows an injured person to obtain compensation from the person who caused the injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MMdgWYyPcJ2ITrSpU.label: Washington Superior Court - Kitsap County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MMdgWYyPcJ2ITrSpU.definition: Washington Superior Court - Kitsap County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Kitsap County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MONvnw0kKoBZoLMC9.label: Probate due to Substance Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MONvnw0kKoBZoLMC9.definition: Probate due to Substance Abuse refers to the legal process of managing the estate of a deceased person who had substance abuse issues and ensuring that their assets are distributed according to their will or state law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MRIM3vshGlEUKpDuy.label: Financial Market Index
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MRIM3vshGlEUKpDuy.definition: A Financial Market Index is a statistical measure that reflects the composite value of a selected group of stocks, bonds, or other financial instruments, representing a specific market or sector. Examples include the S&P 500 Index, which tracks the performance of 500 large-cap U.S. companies, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA), which measures the stock performance of 30 prominent U.S. companies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MXUsspwVFhBmhwbAG.label: Notary Public Officer Liability for Negligent Acknowledgment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MXUsspwVFhBmhwbAG.definition: The liability of a notary public officer for negligent acknowledgment refers to the legal responsibility of such an officer for making a mistake or error while performing an acknowledgment, which can result in a malpractice claim or a judicial and procedural tort claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MYBHp8VQU1tMWBnsP.label: Underwriting Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MYBHp8VQU1tMWBnsP.definition: An Underwriting Agreement is a contract between a company issuing new securities and an underwriter, where the underwriter agrees to buy the securities and then resell them to the public or institutional investors. The agreement specifies the responsibilities, fees, and terms of the issuance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MYwAlvWYNhF8Ai1QG.label: Privilege Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MYwAlvWYNhF8Ai1QG.definition: A Privilege Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the evidence being sought or presented is protected by a legal privilege, such as attorney-client privilege or spousal privilege. This objection seeks to uphold the confidentiality and integrity of certain relationships, preventing the disclosure of privileged communications.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MbuFEaL6NyU9tM2AX.label: Crimes Against People
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MbuFEaL6NyU9tM2AX.definition: Crimes Against People (Individuals) refers to a category of criminal offenses that involve harm or injury to an individual, including but not limited to assault, battery, sexual offenses, kidnapping, and false imprisonment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mc60hKHT5gcEo5bUM.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Bates County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mc60hKHT5gcEo5bUM.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Bates County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Bates County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7McYrEjjkUvymAUxeP.label: Florida County Court - Pinellas County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7McYrEjjkUvymAUxeP.definition: A court located in Pinellas County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mjmxl2ZWEqL5o73rN.label: Indiana City. Court - Marion County, Beech Grove City
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mjmxl2ZWEqL5o73rN.definition: A court located in Marion County and serving the city of Beech Grove, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MjtuzLqoOJ7YjyzEp.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 15 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MjtuzLqoOJ7YjyzEp.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 15 Claim is a type of claim made in a bankruptcy case that involves international insolvency proceedings and seeks recognition of a foreign bankruptcy proceeding in the United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MkduvsDzel0qNQIbS.label: Quileute Tribe of the Quileute Reservation, Washington

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MkhgU1aFdJhkULnXp.label: Emergency / Temporary / Special Probate
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MkhgU1aFdJhkULnXp.definition: A type of probate filing for situations that require immediate action or attention, such as emergencies or temporary arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mlan20RuGoPGMl0sV.label: New York Supreme Court - Livingston County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mlan20RuGoPGMl0sV.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Livingston County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Livingston County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mm9Zf0HlgIvCoXnWb.label: Employer Withholding
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Mm9Zf0HlgIvCoXnWb.definition: Employer withholding refers to the process where employers deduct a portion of an employee's wages or salary to satisfy obligations (e.g., tax obligations, garnishment as a remedy from a prior judgment). In the case of tax obligations, this withheld amount is then remitted to the appropriate tax authorities on behalf of the employee, helping individuals meet their tax liabilities throughout the year.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MmeHfXj4xIERqXjFO.label: National Governmental Body
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MmeHfXj4xIERqXjFO.definition: A national governmental body refers to an organization or institution at the highest level of governance in a country, responsible for making, executing, or interpreting laws and regulations. These bodies often include the executive branch (headed by presidents or prime ministers), legislative branches (such as parliaments or congresses), and judicial branches (like supreme or constitutional courts). Their functions and structures vary depending on the specific form and constitution of each nation's government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MqwKt86WORif7fq9f.label: New York City Court - Batavia
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MqwKt86WORif7fq9f.definition: A court located in Batavia, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MsH9WtTPf14W1GB1m.label: Product Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MsH9WtTPf14W1GB1m.definition: Product Liability Claims refer to civil tort claims that arise when a consumer is injured or suffers damages due to a defective or dangerous product, and seeks compensation from the manufacturer or seller of the product.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MwByzT51ywFAucExi.label: Peremptory Challenge of Juror
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MwByzT51ywFAucExi.definition: The Peremptory Challenge of Juror is the right of a party in a trial to reject a potential juror without stating a reason, as long as the rejection is not based on race or gender.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7MxkTvcb7ueuW8WviD.label: Visa Priority Date
http://lmss.sali.org/R7MxkTvcb7ueuW8WviD.definition: The immigration priority date is a critical concept in immigration system, marking the date when an individual's application for a visa or permanent residency (such as filing Form I-485) is first received by the relevant authority. This date determines the applicant's place in the queue for visa availability, as visas are allocated based on the priority date in conjunction with the visa bulletin.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7N1KfcAjKj8Y3Qp9oU.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Livingston County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7N1KfcAjKj8Y3Qp9oU.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Livingston County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Livingston County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7N3mHbDxpMp8lgod0T.label: Diversity and Inclusion Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7N3mHbDxpMp8lgod0T.definition: Diversity and Inclusion Management refers to the practice of promoting and maintaining a workplace culture that values and respects differences among employees, including but not limited to race, gender, age, religion, and sexual orientation, with the goal of creating a more inclusive and equitable environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7N6j20nBHZEeLQlUvi.label: Exhibit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7N6j20nBHZEeLQlUvi.definition: An exhibit is a piece of evidence presented in a trial or appellate proceeding, which can include documents, objects, or other tangible items.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7N71UJvQpaL7vVEjmF.label: Civil Battery
http://lmss.sali.org/R7N71UJvQpaL7vVEjmF.definition: The intentional and harmful physical contact with another person without their consent, resulting in injury or harm, which can be the basis for a personal injury claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7N98qJISKRO5yiVuJE.label: Observing Deposition
http://lmss.sali.org/R7N98qJISKRO5yiVuJE.definition: Observing Deposition: The act of attending and watching a deposition, without actively participating, in a manner consistent with the posture of a deposition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NB9WJzAFK6tIIGmfI.label: Objections to Direct Examination
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NB9WJzAFK6tIIGmfI.definition: Objections to Direct Examination are formal challenges raised by a party in a legal proceeding, questioning the propriety, relevance, or admissibility of questions or evidence presented during the direct examination of a witness. These objections aim to ensure the integrity and fairness of the examination process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NDrp0Djwxfca3D3Vu.label: Credit Account
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NDrp0Djwxfca3D3Vu.definition: A credit account is a contractual arrangement where a lender extends a line of credit to a borrower. This can be in the form of a credit card account, retail account, or other types of loans. The borrower is obligated to repay the borrowed amount along with any applicable interest and fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NGHZ1AulAgptyZmUy.label: Destruction of Assets Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NGHZ1AulAgptyZmUy.definition: A Destruction of Assets Claim is a legal action taken during divorce proceedings when one spouse alleges that the other spouse has intentionally damaged or destroyed marital property to reduce its value or prevent the other spouse from receiving their fair share in the divorce settlement. This claim seeks to address the consequences of such actions and may involve the court ordering compensation or adjustments in the division of assets to account for the damage or destruction of property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NLDqAMWW0HeEjiPli.label: Negligent Failure to Warn of Dangerous Condition
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NLDqAMWW0HeEjiPli.definition: Negligent Failure to Warn of Dangerous Condition refers to a legal claim made by an individual who has suffered harm due to a failure to warn of a dangerous condition, where the failure to warn was due to negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NMdyMuLrZYEdmZV4g.label: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NMdyMuLrZYEdmZV4g.definition: Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CMBS) are a type of asset-backed security backed by a pool of commercial real estate loans, such as those for office buildings, hotels, shopping centers, and other income-generating properties. Investors in CMBS receive payments from the principal and interest collected on the underlying commercial mortgages, offering exposure to the commercial real estate market.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NPSSODp2sRYDRSQ2h.label: Breach of Warranty
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NPSSODp2sRYDRSQ2h.definition: Breach of Warranty refers to a legal claim made by a party against another party for failing to fulfill the terms of a warranty, either express or implied, related to a product or service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSOpfI2rIDYuhJrfu.label: Fair Labor Standards Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSOpfI2rIDYuhJrfu.definition: A Fair Labor Standards Claim is a legal claim made by an employee against an employer for violations of federal labor laws related to minimum wage, overtime pay, and other employment standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSY7xuiRPxwfxpijR.label: Tailgating Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSY7xuiRPxwfxpijR.definition: A Tailgating Claim involves allegations that a driver has followed another vehicle too closely, violating safe following distance regulations and potentially causing a safety hazard. This type of claim is typically addressed in traffic courts and can lead to penalties, including fines and driving record points, depending on the jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSnFDAuKIakuxCUbc.label: Escrow Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NSnFDAuKIakuxCUbc.definition: An Escrow Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a third party to hold funds or property until certain conditions are met, providing security and assurance to both parties involved in the transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NY3RN4HKneok9Io7x.label: Emergency Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NY3RN4HKneok9Io7x.definition: An Emergency Motion is a type of legal request made in an appellate court that seeks immediate relief due to an urgent situation or circumstance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NYW1tJHp3hK7vY0nI.label: Party-Appointed Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NYW1tJHp3hK7vY0nI.definition: An expert who is appointed by a party

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NZh8iVFREAUf5r47v.label: Motion to Expedite Discovery
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NZh8iVFREAUf5r47v.definition: A Motion to Expedite Discovery is a legal request to speed up the process of obtaining evidence in a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NbFVMmNBqSIc3izA5.label: Lead Underwriter
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NbFVMmNBqSIc3izA5.definition: A bookrunner, also known as a lead underwriter or lead manager, is a financial institution or investment bank responsible for managing the issuance of new securities, such as bonds or stocks, in a public offering. The bookrunner coordinates the syndicate of underwriters, sets the price of the securities, and allocates them to investors, playing a crucial role in the success of the offering.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NbRiaFKuXbP6fYk43.label: Asset Redemption Right
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NbRiaFKuXbP6fYk43.definition: Asset Redemption Right refers to the provisions and options available for the retirement or redemption of shares, allowing for the return of investment under specific conditions. These rights include various scenarios such as redeemable shares, extendible redemption dates, exchangeable shares, and perpetual shares with no fixed maturity date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nc5vbh0wZZ68BgwFg.label: Arkansas District Court - Pulaski Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nc5vbh0wZZ68BgwFg.definition: The Arkansas District Court - Pulaski Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pulaski County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nem8wZFI0MFQYNxH1.label: Non-Standard Contractual Terms
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nem8wZFI0MFQYNxH1.definition: Non-Standard Contractual Terms refer to contract specifications that are variable and customized, differing from the standard predefined terms. These contracts include options traded on exchanges with non-standard delivery or expiry terms, tailored to meet specific needs and preferences of the contracting parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NhrfIR7xbRa4UTFkT.label: Florida Court of Appeals - 1st District
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NhrfIR7xbRa4UTFkT.definition: The Florida Court of Appeals - 1st District is a specific court within the Florida District Court of Appeals that hears appeals from trial courts in its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nidnq88zIxptlouGM.label: Motion to File Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Nidnq88zIxptlouGM.definition: A Motion to File Complaint is a formal request made to a court to allow a plaintiff to submit a complaint or petition for legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NkMt6XJKd4fSolKqq.label: General Sales and Consumption Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NkMt6XJKd4fSolKqq.definition: General Sales and Consumption Tax Payment includes all taxes, other than import and export duties, levied on the production, leasing, transfer, delivery, or sale of a wide range of goods and the rendering of a wide range of services. These taxes apply to both domestically produced and imported goods, irrespective of the stage of production or distribution at which they are levied. This category covers value-added taxes, sales taxes, and multi-stage cumulative taxes, including adjustments for border transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NkdM8YhcmzfiWmRif.label: Director’s Liability to Shareholders
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NkdM8YhcmzfiWmRif.definition: The legal responsibility of a director to act in the best interests of the shareholders of a corporation, and the potential consequences if they fail to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Noco0WzoPRAfLQ1iJ.label: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Noco0WzoPRAfLQ1iJ.definition: An ITAR Claim arises when an individual or entity violates the International Traffic in Arms Regulations, which control the export and import of defense-related articles and services. This claim involves allegations of unauthorized export, re-export, or transfer of defense articles or technical data to foreign nationals or countries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NramUMccSNnkd1qOV.label: Certified Integration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NramUMccSNnkd1qOV.definition: A Certified Integration Clause is a specific type of Integration Clause in a legal contract that confirms the completeness of the agreement and prevents any prior or contemporaneous agreements from being considered part of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NuHbXZluNRzq9D1bL.label: Agreement Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NuHbXZluNRzq9D1bL.definition: Agreement Attributes refer to the characteristics and forms in which agreements can exist, defining how they are communicated and understood between parties (e.g., whether the is agreement is oral or written). These attributes determine the enforceability and clarity of the agreements within legal contexts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7NwY5UT07qF3VkI8MY.label: Spoliation of Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7NwY5UT07qF3VkI8MY.definition: The intentional or negligent destruction or alteration of evidence by a party in a legal matter, which may result in sanctions or adverse inferences against that party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7O2ClQ73HLZZLgFgtN.label: Blood Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/R7O2ClQ73HLZZLgFgtN.definition: Hematological Disorders encompass a range of conditions affecting the blood and its components, including red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, and plasma. These disorders can impact blood production, function, and composition, leading to symptoms such as anemia, bleeding, or increased risk of infection.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7O4HXKi7dDm0Q2urKs.label: Radio Broadcast
http://lmss.sali.org/R7O4HXKi7dDm0Q2urKs.definition: A Radio Broadcast is the transmission of audio content via radio waves to reach a wide audience, typically through AM or FM frequencies. This medium delivers a variety of programming such as news, music, talk shows, and advertisements, and can be received on radios, car stereos, and internet streaming platforms.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7O7as1yRGQddK7A38H.label: Lease Abstract
http://lmss.sali.org/R7O7as1yRGQddK7A38H.definition: A Lease Abstract is a summary document that highlights the key terms, conditions, and provisions of a lease agreement. It serves as a quick reference guide for both landlords and tenants, often utilized for portfolio management or due diligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7O8JOzD2AiH9GOb3VZ.label: Trustee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7O8JOzD2AiH9GOb3VZ.definition: A trustee is an individual person or member of a board given control or powers of administration of property in trust with a legal obligation to administer it solely for the purposes specified.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OA1fGV1VIu5tK8bsC.label: Mining Industry (except Oil and Gas)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OA1fGV1VIu5tK8bsC.definition: Industries in this group primarily engage in mining, mine site development, and beneficiating (i.e., preparing) metallic minerals and nonmetallic minerals, including coal. The term 'mining' is used in the broad sense to include ore extraction, quarrying, and beneficiating (e.g., crushing, screening, washing, sizing, concentrating, and flotation), customarily done at the mine site.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OF55qIq9P3iOXGnNf.label: Counterpart Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OF55qIq9P3iOXGnNf.definition: A Counterpart Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for multiple identical copies of the contract to be signed by different parties, each copy being considered an original.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OGr396bNkl4sseQ1b.label: Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OGr396bNkl4sseQ1b.definition: A lien is a legal claim or right that a creditor has over a debtor's property as security for a debt or obligation, which can be enforced through court action or other legal means.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OJQHant3Dx172WXuP.label: Garnishment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OJQHant3Dx172WXuP.definition: A garnishment is a legal process where a creditor can collect a debt owed by a debtor by seizing a portion of their wages or assets, as authorized by a court order.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OJgVOoKOeIJVrRB9K.label: Cher-Ae Heights Indian Community of the Trinidad Rancheria

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OJrnkSsmSxdaPzTo9.label: 345 Marine Product Liability (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OJrnkSsmSxdaPzTo9.definition: Action (Admiralty and Maritime) alleging personal injury or wrongful death from an accident involving a water vessel or harbor/dock facilities and caused by a defective product.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OM23yAFBywKVmUN7p.label: Ovarian Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OM23yAFBywKVmUN7p.definition: Ovarian cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the ovaries, the female reproductive glands responsible for producing eggs. It is often diagnosed at an advanced stage and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, and targeted therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OQ65vKuOBSSGgSVYn.label: Electoral System
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OQ65vKuOBSSGgSVYn.definition: An electoral system is a set of rules and procedures used to conduct elections and determine the outcome of votes. Different systems can influence the election's outcome, voter behavior, and the overall representation in the elected body, ranging from single-member plurality systems to proportional representation systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OQGIV07yTmUJLm6I1.label: Blue Sky Filing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OQGIV07yTmUJLm6I1.definition: A Blue Sky Filing is a state-level or province-level regulatory filing required for the sale of securities to ensure compliance with securities laws, commonly referred to as "Blue Sky Laws." These filings are necessary to protect investors from fraudulent sales practices and ensure that securities offered or sold within a state meet specific disclosure and registration requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OUu5ODCeFQNlXBmuC.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Amendment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OUu5ODCeFQNlXBmuC.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Amendment is a request made to a trial court to allow additional time beyond the original deadline to file an amendment to a legal document.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ObFXssh9mBYuezsOz.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Clark County Circuit 1
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ObFXssh9mBYuezsOz.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Clark County Circuit 1 is a court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Oi8U82iOSGoo7aV3l.label: Amended Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Oi8U82iOSGoo7aV3l.definition: An amended document is a revised version of an original document that incorporates changes, corrections, or additions. The purpose of amending a document is to update or clarify its content, often to reflect new information or agreements between parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OmVvDEkIqcYQBoUjC.label: Fee Pre or Post Split
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OmVvDEkIqcYQBoUjC.definition: A fee that is either paid before or after a split between parties, and is categorized under discounts and credits in legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7On4VWw10rNMziVMsy.label: Narrative Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7On4VWw10rNMziVMsy.definition: An objection to a narrative is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a witness's response or a question posed by the opposing counsel is too lengthy, lacks focus, or provides information beyond what was requested. This objection aims to prevent the introduction of irrelevant or prejudicial details into the record.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Oohbb58KPtSYRioVT.label: "Entitled to" Specific Performance Language
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Oohbb58KPtSYRioVT.definition: The "Entitled to" Specific Performance Language refers to a clause in a legal contract that grants a party the right to demand specific performance of the terms of the contract, rather than seeking monetary damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OsK77qJzadZwNwV39.label: Faithfully Executed Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OsK77qJzadZwNwV39.definition: A Faithfully Executed Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a government official, typically the President, has failed to faithfully execute the laws as required by the Faithfully Executed Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the official's actions or omissions in implementing or enforcing the laws are in violation of the constitutional duty to faithfully execute the laws, potentially rendering their actions unconstitutional or invalid.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7OtUosForl1Zon7KU3.label: Real Estate Operator
http://lmss.sali.org/R7OtUosForl1Zon7KU3.definition: A Real Estate Operator is a professional or entity responsible for the day-to-day management, maintenance, and operations of real estate properties. This role includes overseeing property functions, ensuring tenant satisfaction, handling leasing activities, and maintaining the physical condition of the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ovn011buRjUrj091T.label: By Calendar Time Period
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ovn011buRjUrj091T.definition: A fixed fee for a calendar time range (e.g., each month, for six months, each calendar year) is also known as a "Subscription Fee".

http://lmss.sali.org/R7P734VIOsQm2wkRGVK.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Shannon County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7P734VIOsQm2wkRGVK.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Shannon County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Shannon County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7P7kd5lf60cWlSHHwG.label: Report
http://lmss.sali.org/R7P7kd5lf60cWlSHHwG.definition: A formal record of factual findings, legal conclusions, or proceedings (e.g., meeting, session).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7P9B6jiNyVyISiXycL.label: Georgia Superior Court - Effingham County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7P9B6jiNyVyISiXycL.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Effingham County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Effingham County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PHFZzZmVmczzNQl6i.label: Creditor
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PHFZzZmVmczzNQl6i.definition: A creditor is a person or company to whom money is owed. Also, a party to which a bankruptcy debtor owes money.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PLGEKPyX32hNUi7SK.label: Another Planned Permanent Living Arrangement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PLGEKPyX32hNUi7SK.definition: A planned permanent living arrangement (APPLA) is an alternative option for a child in the foster care system who cannot be reunited with their birth family or adopted, and involves placing the child in a long-term, stable living situation with a caregiver who is not their legal guardian.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PPywVywQYcT4Gloer.label: Trial Testimony Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PPywVywQYcT4Gloer.definition: Trial Testimony Event refers to the phase of a trial where witnesses are questioned and provide evidence under oath, including both direct-examination and cross-examination.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PX1rDXmNgCrkuDqtG.label: Bus
