http://lmss.sali.org/R7PX1rDXmNgCrkuDqtG.definition: A bus is a large, motorized vehicle designed to transport multiple passengers. It is commonly used for public transportation and can vary in size and configuration, including city buses, school buses, and long-distance coaches.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PcwRJiICix5bHHDJ6.label: Indiana Superior Court - Daviess County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PcwRJiICix5bHHDJ6.definition: A court located in Daviess County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PdNH9CyPCZwagGc0N.label: Hemoglobin Deficiency
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PdNH9CyPCZwagGc0N.definition: Thalassemia is a genetic blood disorder characterized by the reduced production of hemoglobin, leading to anemia and other related health issues. It is caused by mutations in the genes responsible for hemoglobin production, resulting in abnormal hemoglobin and red blood cells.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PjSMSqDsr4pw5CY13.label: Application for National Interest Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PjSMSqDsr4pw5CY13.definition: In the United States, an application for National Interest Waiver (NIW) is a request submitted by foreign nationals seeking an exemption from the labor certification requirement as part of the employment-based green card process in the United States. By applying for an NIW, applicants are essentially requesting that the requirement for a job offer and labor certification be waived due to their work being deemed in the national interest of the United States. The NIW is typically filed as part of the I-140 petition (Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker) and requires demonstrating how the applicant's work benefits the U.S. in a significant and unique manner

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PoPGfISTLi8JD8AMy.label: X126 Witness Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PoPGfISTLi8JD8AMy.definition: Any sheriff or service fees and other costs associated with the testimony of a witness at court or in a similar legal proceeding

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PxEci57eXCLx3AlRl.label: Cushitic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PxEci57eXCLx3AlRl.definition: Cushitic languages are a group of languages within the broader category of Language, which are spoken primarily in the Horn of Africa and are characterized by shared grammatical features and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7PyR6ZeFKwHLi0gh4W.label: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/R7PyR6ZeFKwHLi0gh4W.definition: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) is a chronic mental health condition characterized by uncontrollable, recurring thoughts (obsessions) and behaviors (compulsions) that the individual feels driven to perform. These obsessions and compulsions can significantly interfere with daily activities and cause distress.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q3iT3Zmj2aKMmv6vd.label: Washo
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q3iT3Zmj2aKMmv6vd.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Washo people in California and Nevada.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q8Ra8XyYj14cKvu35.label: Payment Terms Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q8Ra8XyYj14cKvu35.definition: A Payment Terms Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the specific conditions and requirements for payment between parties involved in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q8hvwDtsW9FYHMK3r.label: Georgia Superior Court - Lee County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Q8hvwDtsW9FYHMK3r.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Lee County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Lee County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QFp4uyS7ePAzZI3mj.label: Restrictive Legend Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QFp4uyS7ePAzZI3mj.definition: A restrictive legend clause is a provision in a contract that limits the transferability of securities by requiring the purchaser to hold the securities for a certain period of time or to obtain the issuer's consent before selling them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QNGRlEB8h2Rpruaa2.label: Waiver of Confidentiality Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QNGRlEB8h2Rpruaa2.definition: A Waiver of Confidentiality Clause is a provision in a legal agreement where a party agrees to release or give up their right to keep certain information confidential.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QS7ehjfWdMVZItPqj.label: Ute Indian Tribe of the Uintah and Ouray Reservation, Utah

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QSvNbqtp6RnaSReIk.label: Avaric
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QSvNbqtp6RnaSReIk.definition: Avaric is a language that belongs to the Northeast Caucasian language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QWiAxrz8JDUrQnMjS.label: Reptiles
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QWiAxrz8JDUrQnMjS.definition: Reptiles are a class of vertebrate animals characterized by their dry, scaly skin, laying of amniotic eggs, and ectothermic metabolism. This diverse group includes lizards, snakes, turtles, and crocodiles, and they are primarily found in terrestrial habitats, although some species are adapted to aquatic environments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QXlJ9s0u5JTB6fZHW.label: New York Supreme Court - Schenectady County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QXlJ9s0u5JTB6fZHW.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Schenectady County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Schenectady County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Qd4rF5lYVTkqpZAZu.label: Finance and Capital Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Qd4rF5lYVTkqpZAZu.definition: Finance and Capital Tax Payment refers to the settlement of taxes levied as a result of financial and capital transactions. This includes taxes on the sale or transfer of securities, bonds, and other financial instruments, as well as taxes on capital gains, dividends, and interest income.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QfJi1Gh1gRy67VVzI.label: Short Form Lease Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QfJi1Gh1gRy67VVzI.definition: A short form lease clause is a provision within a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a lease agreement in a concise manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QiKeEkci1FYlRMv6n.label: Bankruptcy First Day Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QiKeEkci1FYlRMv6n.definition: Bankruptcy First Day Motions are motions filed by a debtor on the first day of a bankruptcy case, seeking relief from certain requirements or restrictions, such as the automatic stay, to allow for the continued operation of the debtor's business.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Qj5gZIdKfp8urYwCz.label: Food Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Qj5gZIdKfp8urYwCz.definition: Food public benefit refers to government programs specifically designed to provide food or food-purchasing assistance to individuals and families facing financial hardship. Programs like the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in the United States or similar initiatives in other countries offer vouchers, electronic benefit transfer cards, or direct food provisions to help ensure access to adequate nutrition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QqT8OYSjPMxWY3Tj1.label: Proceeding Closed / Disposed
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QqT8OYSjPMxWY3Tj1.definition: The concept of "Case Closed / Disposed" refers to the state or condition of a legal matter where all proceedings have been completed and the case has been resolved or dismissed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QrYwyYBDXJn7LaGPW.label: Iban
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QrYwyYBDXJn7LaGPW.definition: A language spoken by the Iban people of Borneo, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QtA1XEvYBttW8LUvB.label: Release Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QtA1XEvYBttW8LUvB.definition: A Release Clause is a contractual provision that relieves one party from liability or obligation, typically in exchange for a payment or other consideration, and may take various forms such as Release of All Claims Clause, Release of Liability Clause, Release of Security Interest Clause, Release of Obligations Clause, Release and Indemnity Clause, or Release Agreement Clause.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7QvqzxjRDyypPBQQqn.label: Kabardian
http://lmss.sali.org/R7QvqzxjRDyypPBQQqn.definition: Kabardian (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, belonging to the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7R0xowZoDCBNbFt6VG.label: JM20 Points of dispute, Replies and Negotiations (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7R0xowZoDCBNbFt6VG.definition: Work on the formal procedural steps under CPR 47 following service of a bill of costs together with Part 36 and other offers to settle costs and consequent negotiations

http://lmss.sali.org/R7R1YAozFcvfvIX32ms.label: Witness Examination Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7R1YAozFcvfvIX32ms.definition: The Witness Examination Practice is a legal practice that involves questioning a witness in a legal proceeding, either through cross-examination or direct-examination, and is a subset of Trial Practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7R4AXHIioZlOCG64AG.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Cibola County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7R4AXHIioZlOCG64AG.definition: A court located in Cibola County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7R79cl5ydPUGDehAUc.label: inv_desc
http://lmss.sali.org/R7R79cl5ydPUGDehAUc.definition:
"A descriptive summary of work performed.  

It is expected that this field will be picked up by receiving system and displayed to bill reviewers.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R7R8n2TTGZFKhS7wWtk.label: Negligent Supervision
http://lmss.sali.org/R7R8n2TTGZFKhS7wWtk.definition: Negligent Supervision refers to a legal claim that arises when a person or entity fails to properly supervise another person, resulting in harm or injury to a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7REQZyOuTRSG5KrUBf.label: 195 Contract Product Liability (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7REQZyOuTRSG5KrUBf.definition: Action concerning damages caused by a defective product, not primarily involving personal injury or property damage, and based primarily on breach of contract, breach of warranty, misrepresentation, and/or violation of consumer protection laws.  Actions primarily alleging personal injury or property damage caused by a defective product should be classified under the appropriate nature of suit code under “TORTS.”

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RIiGEhbNy3YC5PH9o.label: Religious Belief Evidence Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RIiGEhbNy3YC5PH9o.definition: A Religious Belief Evidence Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that evidence regarding a person's religious beliefs or practices is being used unfairly to suggest credibility, believability, or character. This objection aims to prevent prejudice or bias based on religious affiliation and to ensure that the focus remains on relevant and admissible evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RJBmbUXQimbiHsYbM.label: Matter Discount or Credit Total
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RJBmbUXQimbiHsYbM.definition: A Matter Discount or Credit Total is a type of discount or credit applied to a specific legal matter, reducing the overall cost of legal services provided.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RNX8iqkaqNH2ZqLZw.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Bedford County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RNX8iqkaqNH2ZqLZw.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Bedford County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ROqnkjkzSNTuRIsd5.label: Catastrophe Bonds
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ROqnkjkzSNTuRIsd5.definition: Catastrophe bonds, commonly known as cat bonds, are high-yield debt instruments designed to raise money for insurance companies in the event of a natural disaster. These bonds provide insurers with an alternative source of capital to cover significant losses from catastrophes, transferring some of the financial risk to investors who receive regular coupon payments unless a specified catastrophe event occurs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RS1hG7BxbLQktXIrO.label: Applicant/Petitioner
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RS1hG7BxbLQktXIrO.definition: An applicant or petitioner is a person who files a petition or makes an application or the person who is applying for a legal remedy to a problem.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RTOi3HJBujhrMQbvq.label: Speech Disability
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RTOi3HJBujhrMQbvq.definition: Speech Disability refers to impairments that affect an individual's ability to produce sounds that create words, impacting verbal communication. These disabilities can result from various causes, such as neurological disorders, physical impairments, or developmental conditions, and may affect articulation, fluency, voice, or resonance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RX4TNmaqqwO8btjXE.label: Liability for Injury to Pets
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RX4TNmaqqwO8btjXE.definition: Liability for Injury to Pets refers to the legal responsibility for harm caused to a domesticated animal, such as a dog or cat, and the resulting damages that may be awarded to the pet owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RYnZ1GpjlQaMwVkwC.label: Appellate Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RYnZ1GpjlQaMwVkwC.definition: A brief or memorandum of law filed in an appellate proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rdvjz7Q76QLZXnSJ6.label: M&A Transactional Method
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rdvjz7Q76QLZXnSJ6.definition: A M&A Deal Structure is the specific plan or arrangement for the merger or acquisition of companies, including the methods used to acquire the target company, such as tender offers or mergers, and the legal framework supporting the execution of the plan.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ReDY2v13rer1U8AyO.label: Matter Narrative
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ReDY2v13rer1U8AyO.definition: A textual narrative of a matter's factual and legal details.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RhGZFubZjZLpW0OXB.label: JB10 Budgeting - own side's costs (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RhGZFubZjZLpW0OXB.definition: Preparing budgets solely for the client and monitoring costs incurred for the purposes of any required variations. Performing budgetary work related to obtaining third party funding/ATE insurance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RhXjTqymRaRNfV80C.label: Landscaping Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RhXjTqymRaRNfV80C.definition: A Landscaping Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the responsibilities and obligations of the parties involved with regards to the design, installation, and maintenance of the landscaping on a property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rjozxnhp53D0o2VP8.label: Privacy of School Records Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rjozxnhp53D0o2VP8.definition: The concept of "Privacy of School Records Claims" refers to legal claims made by parents regarding the protection of their children's educational records from unauthorized access or disclosure, which may result in liability for educational institutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rkqx0l45T8KATEjfp.label: Deferred Sentence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rkqx0l45T8KATEjfp.definition: A Deferred Sentence is a form of sentencing in which the court postpones the imposition of a final judgment and punishment, typically allowing the offender to complete certain conditions or requirements. This approach gives the defendant an opportunity to demonstrate good behavior and compliance, potentially resulting in a reduced sentence or dismissal of charges upon successful completion.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RmklJajQfttoW1GZr.label: Non-binary
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RmklJajQfttoW1GZr.definition: Non-binary refers to a gender identity that is not exclusively male or female, and falls outside of the traditional binary gender system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RmrcQmzFAxOoyazzw.label: Zande languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RmrcQmzFAxOoyazzw.definition: The Zande languages refer to a group of structured systems of communication that are spoken by the Zande people in Central Africa and are part of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rs3fovRoMt2c9xs7L.label: Strategic Alliance Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Rs3fovRoMt2c9xs7L.definition: A Strategic Alliance Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of a partnership between two or more companies for a specific purpose or project.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7RsCBFvE6jaG2xSsg2.label: Arkansas District Court - Arkansas Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R7RsCBFvE6jaG2xSsg2.definition: A court located in Arkansas County that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7S4uqggwk4TapPrj5N.label: D.C. Office of the Attorney General
http://lmss.sali.org/R7S4uqggwk4TapPrj5N.definition: The D.C. Office of the Attorney General is a government entity within the District of Columbia Courts that is responsible for administering legal proceedings and providing legal advice to the District of Columbia government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SEjiYzkEBKWLmzH6W.label: Electric Power Generation, Transmission and Distribution Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SEjiYzkEBKWLmzH6W.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in generating, transmitting, and/or distributing electric power.  Establishments in this industry group may perform one or more of the following activities: (1) operate generation facilities that produce electric energy; (2) operate transmission systems that convey the electricity from the generation facility to the distribution system; and (3) operate distribution systems that convey electric power received from the generation facility or the transmission system to the final consumer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SIwCoL6kJ2TvbetkU.label: Native Village of Kluti Kaah (Copper Center)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SLrnHnhCS6Ena6ZNn.label: Indic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SLrnHnhCS6Ena6ZNn.definition: Indic languages are a group of languages spoken in the Indian subcontinent, including Hindi, Bengali, Punjabi, and Gujarati, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SNUlE96MsWXjBYB9M.label: Motion to Assign Case to Prior Panel
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SNUlE96MsWXjBYB9M.definition: A Motion to Assign Case to Prior Panel is a formal request made in appellate courts to assign a case to a previously assigned panel of judges.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SNliTqUL4QJjkYLF6.label: Baltic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SNliTqUL4QJjkYLF6.definition: Baltic languages refer to a group of languages spoken in the Baltic region, including Lithuanian and Latvian.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SZK3Qu9tVZxLLbKiq.label: Type 2 Diabetes
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SZK3Qu9tVZxLLbKiq.definition: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic condition characterized by insulin resistance and impaired insulin production, leading to elevated blood glucose levels. It is commonly associated with obesity and a sedentary lifestyle and requires management through lifestyle changes, oral medications, and sometimes insulin therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SaXrn5D1aJju69qYJ.label: Immigration Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SaXrn5D1aJju69qYJ.definition: The concept of "Immigration Violation" refers to a breach of immigration laws or regulations, which may result in penalties or legal consequences.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SdenAJ4aI0wyuxBsP.label: Trial Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SdenAJ4aI0wyuxBsP.definition: Trial Motions are requests made by parties during a trial to the judge for a specific action or ruling, such as a Motion for Judgment Notwithstanding the Verdict (JNOV) or a Motion for Mistrial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SfjNZajT3w8quumBN.label: Net Revenue
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SfjNZajT3w8quumBN.definition: Net revenue is gross revenue minus returns, allowances, and discounts. Net revenue provides a more accurate picture of the actual income a business has available for operating expenses, since it accounts for deductions that reduce the total income.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SjRNz21PxEqj0JVBf.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Crawford County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SjRNz21PxEqj0JVBf.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Crawford County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Crawford County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SrMh68UnjXSxbiHcS.label: Civil Sexual Battery
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SrMh68UnjXSxbiHcS.definition: Civil Sexual Battery: A type of civil battery that involves the intentional and unwanted sexual touching of another person, without their consent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7SrsKfZnufxClg3K1z.label: Mandatory Mediation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7SrsKfZnufxClg3K1z.definition: A mandatory mediation clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to attempt to resolve any disputes through mediation before pursuing legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Sz5mppPwSssjF31xH.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Cumberland County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Sz5mppPwSssjF31xH.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Cumberland County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Sziktu5A0P0N95qLV.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Luzerne County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Sziktu5A0P0N95qLV.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Luzerne County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7T7fvPoZLDaqNHW4oa.label: Notice to Appear
http://lmss.sali.org/R7T7fvPoZLDaqNHW4oa.definition: A charging document in the context of immigration is a formal document issued by the country's agency (e.g., U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS)) that initiates removal proceedings against a noncitizen. It outlines the specific grounds for removal, such as violations of immigration laws or criminal convictions, and serves as the basis for the government's case in immigration court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TB5AJsngthjmL6KsE.label: Legal Research
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TB5AJsngthjmL6KsE.definition: Legal Research: The process of gathering and analyzing information related to legal issues, cases, and regulations in order to provide guidance and support for legal decision-making.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TDLEydth241fdSxQB.label: LINE_ITEM_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TDLEydth241fdSxQB.definition: The LINE_ITEM_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT is a specific element within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard that represents the amount of adjustment made to a line item.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TDmkWo6F51IzefrMI.label: Child Support Enforcement Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TDmkWo6F51IzefrMI.definition: A Child Support Enforcement Claim is a legal action taken by a party to enforce a child support claim against a non-paying parent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TEfV8HM651CRCjbk4.label: Guardianship of Adult
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TEfV8HM651CRCjbk4.definition: The concept of Guardianship of Adult refers to the legal arrangement where a court appoints a guardian to make decisions for an adult who is unable to make decisions for themselves due to mental or physical incapacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TEqpfz1F8QrV3B5fw.label: Signature Page Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TEqpfz1F8QrV3B5fw.definition: A Signature Page Clause is a specific type of clause found within a contractual agreement that outlines the location and manner in which the parties involved will sign the document.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7THdgb6vPCuvEA0fCD.label: Hypoglycemia
http://lmss.sali.org/R7THdgb6vPCuvEA0fCD.definition: Hypoglycemia is an abnormally low level of blood glucose, which can result from diabetes management or other conditions. Symptoms can be recognized and reversed by consuming glucose-containing substances, though some individuals may not recognize the symptoms due to hypoglycemia unawareness. Severe cases can lead to complications like seizures or loss of consciousness.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TLlJ71b9UaOSriKDs.label: Military Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TLlJ71b9UaOSriKDs.definition: A Military Court is a specialized court within the jurisdiction of the military that has the authority to hear and decide cases involving military personnel and offenses related to military service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TMX2dw9IzNIC3bpUZ.label: Legislative Drafting Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TMX2dw9IzNIC3bpUZ.definition: Legislative drafting practice involves the creation of legal texts that are intended to become laws, typically performed by specialized legal experts or legislative counsel. This practice requires a deep understanding of legal principles, legislative processes, and the ability to write clearly and unambiguously, with the goal of producing enforceable and effective laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TMXUE0nBJ2a4RL8Lb.label: Devisee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TMXUE0nBJ2a4RL8Lb.definition: A devisee is an individual or entity designated in a will to receive real property from the estate of the deceased. The term specifically refers to beneficiaries of real estate, distinguishing them from legatees who inherit personal property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TPuxw7aZk4v8DXqhL.label: Pregnancy and Maternal Healthcare Coverage
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TPuxw7aZk4v8DXqhL.definition: This specialized form of healthcare coverage provides medical services related to pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum care. Many standard health insurance plans offer this coverage as a part of their package, and specialized plans may offer more comprehensive benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TPwe5Zy8PKEBYlvCD.label: Motion to Reschedule Oral Argument
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TPwe5Zy8PKEBYlvCD.definition: A Motion to Reschedule Oral Argument is a formal request made to a court to change the date or time of a hearing that was previously scheduled for oral argument.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TQ6tG5LVrcNwvwrdW.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Wayne County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TQ6tG5LVrcNwvwrdW.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Wayne County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Wayne County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TUl56ig2yKtcpa1sa.label: Design Defect
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TUl56ig2yKtcpa1sa.definition: A design defect is a legal concept within strict product liability that refers to a flaw in the design of a product that makes it unreasonably dangerous for its intended use.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TWc8tQpBqTWnxuyuD.label: Quality Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TWc8tQpBqTWnxuyuD.definition: A Quality Agreement is a document that defines the quality-related roles and responsibilities of parties involved in contract manufacturing or a similar arrangement. It ensures both parties understand quality standards, specifications, and processes required for the product or service in question.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TXw8bvDtHjprmpiUN.label: Alternative Legal Services Provider
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TXw8bvDtHjprmpiUN.definition: An Alternative Legal Services Provider (ALSP) is an entity that delivers legal or legal-related services outside the conventional law firm model.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tai3J1oqCCrjTMdXi.label: Tigre
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tai3J1oqCCrjTMdXi.definition: Tigre is a language that belongs to the Afro-Asiatic family and is spoken in Eritrea and Sudan.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TdGXulr78B7PU1F0P.label: Wildlife Trafficking
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TdGXulr78B7PU1F0P.definition: Wildlife Trafficking is the illegal trade, smuggling, or movement of wildlife and wildlife products across borders. This activity contributes to the decline of species and biodiversity, violating national and international laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TgV9FkR8Q4DMivxT5.label: Labor Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TgV9FkR8Q4DMivxT5.definition: Law governing the rights and obligations of workers, employers, and trade unions in the workplace, including employment contracts, wages, working hours, collective bargaining, workplace safety, discrimination, and the resolution of employment disputes, aimed at ensuring fair and equitable treatment of workers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ThXbAhhJvDfLZDgWW.label: Constitutions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ThXbAhhJvDfLZDgWW.definition: A written instrument embodying the (usually foundational) rules of a political or social organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ti8xGiWI5NzMSs5up.label: Administrative and Support Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ti8xGiWI5NzMSs5up.definition:
Industries in the Administrative and Support Services subsector group establishments engaged in activities that support the day-to-day operations of other organizations.  The processes employed in this sector (e.g., general management, personnel administration, clerical activities, cleaning activities) are often integral parts of the activities of establishments found in all sectors of the economy.  The establishments classified in this subsector have specialization in one or more of these activities and can, therefore, provide services to clients in a variety of industries and, in some cases, to households.  The individual industries of this subsector are defined on the basis of the particular process that they are engaged in and the particular services they provide.

Many of the activities in this subsector are ongoing routine support functions that businesses and organizations perform in-house.  However, it is common to contract or purchase services from businesses that specialize in such activities and can, therefore, provide the services more efficiently.

The industries in this subsector cannot be viewed as strictly "support."  The Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services industry group includes travel agents, tour operators, and providers of other travel arrangement services, such as hotel and restaurant reservations and arranging the purchase of tickets, serving many types of clients, including individual consumers.  This group was placed in this subsector because the services are often of the "support" nature (e.g., travel arrangement) to businesses and other organizations that purchase such services.

The administrative and management activities performed by establishments in this sector are typically on a contract or fee basis.  These activities may also be performed by establishments that are part of the company or enterprise.  However, establishments involved in administering, overseeing, and managing other establishments of the company or enterprise are classified in Sector 55, Management of Companies and Enterprises.  Establishments in Sector 55, Management of Companies and Enterprises, normally undertake the strategic and organizational planning and decision-making role of the company or enterprise.  Government establishments engaged in administering, overseeing, and managing governmental programs are classified in Sector 92, Public Administration.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TinY6ZZFe8OBYvc2z.label: Chuukese
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TinY6ZZFe8OBYvc2z.definition: Chuukese (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Chuukese people and culture.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TkNvAkzIJZNnz45hv.label: Motion to Avoid Lien on Household Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TkNvAkzIJZNnz45hv.definition: A Motion to Avoid Lien on Household Goods is a legal request to remove a lien on personal property that is essential for daily living, such as furniture and appliances.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TlHyVfZlcWLLtCXkv.label: Matter Final Bill
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TlHyVfZlcWLLtCXkv.definition: A "Matter Final Bill" is a detailed record of the final charges for legal services provided in a specific matter, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of "Engagement Fee Detail".

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tlb5jr0s5vTCukFLE.label: Asset Sale
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tlb5jr0s5vTCukFLE.definition: The concept of Asset Sale refers to the transfer of ownership of assets for a regulatory purpose (e.g., selling bankrupt or financially distressed company's assets to another party in order to raise funds and pay off creditors; e.g., to increase public benefits).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TmA0IapaoAjuWfDF1.label: Leukemia
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TmA0IapaoAjuWfDF1.definition: Leukemia is a type of cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow, characterized by the overproduction of abnormal white blood cells. This disease can be acute or chronic and often requires treatments such as chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or stem cell transplantation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tp95bROozvk51gEU0.label: Indiana Circuit Court - LaPorte County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tp95bROozvk51gEU0.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within LaPorte County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TqhCJiUfRyt5zfeLs.label: Freedom of Thought and Conscience
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TqhCJiUfRyt5zfeLs.definition: Freedom of thought, conscience, and religion refers to the basic human right that protects an individual's ability to hold and change beliefs, practice a religion, or exercise non-religious ethical views without coercion or penalty. This right is often enshrined in international human rights law, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and is considered fundamental to the dignity and freedom of individuals

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tt57F4NFC3GTNrXx5.label: Charitable Organization Liable for Wrongdoing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Tt57F4NFC3GTNrXx5.definition: A Charitable Organization Liable for Wrongdoing is a legal concept that holds a charitable organization responsible for any wrongful actions or misconduct committed by its agents or representatives.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TtaWVHWeAChN6aCA2.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Shelby County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TtaWVHWeAChN6aCA2.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Shelby County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Shelby County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ttdyo4FsvaupPKT35.label: Murder
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ttdyo4FsvaupPKT35.definition: The intentional killing of another person, with malice aforethought, which is a criminal offense and can be classified as second-degree murder, first-degree murder, or felony murder.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TxvYxSg4f2BzLUmL1.label: Redemption Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TxvYxSg4f2BzLUmL1.definition: A redemption clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to buy back or reclaim something, such as property or shares of stock, from the other party under certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7TzyLcZq0lELm4qq9p.label: Third-Party Defendant
http://lmss.sali.org/R7TzyLcZq0lELm4qq9p.definition: A party who was not initially sued but is brought into a civil action by another defendant.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7U0Y6j3u18HyTLnqyo.label: Breach of Loan Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/R7U0Y6j3u18HyTLnqyo.definition: A Loan Default occurs when a borrower fails to meet the legal obligations or conditions of a loan agreement, typically involving missed payments or breach of other terms. This default triggers legal consequences and can lead to actions such as foreclosure, repossession, or litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7U11pwkJfQSG7FGXqy.label: Medical Treatment Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7U11pwkJfQSG7FGXqy.definition: A Medical Treatment Statement is a hearsay exception that allows the admission of statements made for purposes of medical diagnosis or treatment. This exception is based on the belief that statements made to medical professionals are likely to be truthful because the declarant has a strong motivation to provide accurate information to receive proper care.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7U1M4K5pt4eRGECPez.label: Poverty Line
http://lmss.sali.org/R7U1M4K5pt4eRGECPez.definition: The Poverty Line is a predetermined income threshold used to define the minimum level of income required for an individual or family to meet their basic living expenses. It serves as a reference point to identify individuals or households living in poverty and often influences social welfare policies and programs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UEGpJgE0tmrVMUuHG.label: LAW_FIRM_COUNTRY
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UEGpJgE0tmrVMUuHG.definition: A country where a law firm is located, as defined by the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UFW7IONSy0FtRqWsm.label: Fundamental Representations and Warranties
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UFW7IONSy0FtRqWsm.definition: A Fundamental Representation and Warranty is a legally binding statement made by one party to another in a contract, which guarantees the accuracy and completeness of certain information or facts that are fundamental to the agreement, and which cannot be waived or modified without the consent of both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UIhjENFeJ7oUvQf3b.label: Au Pair Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UIhjENFeJ7oUvQf3b.definition: An Au Pair visa permits a foreign national to temporarily live with a host family in the host country, providing child care services in exchange for a cultural exchange experience. This visa is typically part of larger exchange visitor programs aimed at promoting mutual understanding through educational and cultural exchanges.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UJAiYtYDWKVCr6nag.label: Stocks - Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UJAiYtYDWKVCr6nag.definition: A stock (also known as "shares" or "equity") is a type of security that signifies proportionate ownership in the issuing corporation. This entitles the stockholder to that proportion of the corporation's assets and earnings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UL77ApThOeQHgvfPU.label: Brand Value
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UL77ApThOeQHgvfPU.definition: Brand Value in accounting refers to the intangible asset that represents the additional value a business gains due to the favorable reputation or recognition associated with its brand name. It is often calculated as the present value of the estimated future cash flows attributable to the brand and is considered during mergers, acquisitions, or company valuation

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UNCe4IDSASK4SnZRH.label: Millet
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UNCe4IDSASK4SnZRH.definition: Millet is a group of small-seeded cereal crops belonging to the Poaceae family, known for their resilience to harsh growing conditions and nutritional benefits. These grains are staple foods in many parts of Asia and Africa, providing essential nutrients such as carbohydrates, proteins, and minerals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UOK5KBV4sX9iEfCVt.label: Rheumatology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UOK5KBV4sX9iEfCVt.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a healthcare provider in the field of rheumatology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UYJUZ3D37DD8nEuNU.label: Refugee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UYJUZ3D37DD8nEuNU.definition: In the context of immigration law, a "Refugee" is someone who has been forced to flee their home country due to a well-founded fear of persecution. That fear is often based on race, religion, nationality, political opinion, or membership in a particular social group.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UeOz3WmAQEVCsh3ka.label: Notice of Continued Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UeOz3WmAQEVCsh3ka.definition: A Notice of Continued Hearing is a written communication that informs parties involved in a legal proceeding that a previously scheduled hearing has been postponed to a later date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UhpyqBT6mY118k4BH.label: Florida Circuit Court - Gilchrist County - 8th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UhpyqBT6mY118k4BH.definition: A court located in Gilchrist County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UiQA8gafbU8G6XKu2.label: Amendment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UiQA8gafbU8G6XKu2.definition: An Amendment Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for changes or modifications to be made to the original agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UlsbfVKjhOfux7PAQ.label: Rollover Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UlsbfVKjhOfux7PAQ.definition: A Rollover Agreement refers to an arrangement where an investor transfers the proceeds from a mature security into a new issue of the same or a similar security. It can also pertain to the transfer of assets from one retirement plan to another without incurring tax penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7UorltDTpUJ773L1eK.label: Estimate of Exposure Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/R7UorltDTpUJ773L1eK.definition: Estimate by the client and/or provider as to the amount of potential exposure.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ur5AilEpfkfmgpJhS.label: National Lower House Legislator
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Ur5AilEpfkfmgpJhS.definition: A National Lower House Legislator is an elected official who serves as a member of the lower chamber in a bicameral national legislature. This individual is typically responsible for initiating legislation, representing local constituencies, and providing democratic accountability through more frequent elections compared to the upper house.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7V6UTOTAina6Er8vli.label: Failure to Return Tenant's Security Deposit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7V6UTOTAina6Er8vli.definition: The failure of a landlord to return a tenant's security deposit, which is a type of claim that falls under the broader category of disputes between landlords and tenants.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7V9R3w28BDjOd4lLUU.label: Crimes Against the Government
http://lmss.sali.org/R7V9R3w28BDjOd4lLUU.definition: Crimes Against the Government refer to illegal acts committed against the state or its institutions, including but not limited to terrorism, perjury, counterfeiting, sabotage, tax evasion, insurrection, obstruction of justice, campaign finance violation, bribery, illegal re-entry, rescue of prisoner, treason, sedition, escape from correctional facility, subornation of perjury, and espionage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VHEoDUFVEwkyvRY96.label: Bankruptcy - Initial Case Filings
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VHEoDUFVEwkyvRY96.definition: Bankruptcy - Initial Case Filings: The legal documents and forms required to initiate a bankruptcy case, including the Statement of Financial Affairs, Bankruptcy First Day Motions, Bankruptcy Initial Routine Motions, Bankruptcy Second Day Motions, Bankruptcy Schedules, and Bankruptcy Petition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VRaoAh9ayMTR0GEuS.label: Regulatory Filing Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VRaoAh9ayMTR0GEuS.definition: Regulatory Filing Management refers to the process of managing and submitting required documents and information to regulatory authorities in order to comply with legal and regulatory requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VSowgjEr2WlrwUxkb.label: Settlement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VSowgjEr2WlrwUxkb.definition: A settlement clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for resolving disputes between parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VSt6Td4pEcRCInrHy.label: Condominium Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VSt6Td4pEcRCInrHy.definition: Condominium Law refers to the legal rules and regulations that govern the ownership, management, and use of condominium properties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VT1DI09A8acXjpciv.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Bond County (3rd Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VVK8tV2Tn6iw4H6tH.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Warren County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VVK8tV2Tn6iw4H6tH.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Warren County is a specific court within the New Jersey Superior Court Appellate Division, which is responsible for hearing appeals from lower courts in Warren County, New Jersey.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VZ8tZeEfuh6WM1GME.label: E106 Online research
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VZ8tZeEfuh6WM1GME.definition: Online research expenses incurred by a party in a legal matter, including costs associated with accessing and utilizing electronic legal research databases and resources.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VdYfnuQ2y5IZiVy6a.label: Material Change Report
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VdYfnuQ2y5IZiVy6a.definition: A Material Change Report, also known as a Current Report, is a document filed with securities regulators that discloses significant events or changes affecting a company. This could include changes in management, mergers, or other events that could impact the stock price.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VeU2EdrmGbNb0K7Zr.label: AAA International Dispute Resolution Procedures
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VeU2EdrmGbNb0K7Zr.definition: AAA International Dispute Resolution Procedures refer to the specific rules and procedures established by the American Arbitration Association for resolving international disputes through arbitration.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VlwpQyoUHn87pbY0N.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Buchanan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VlwpQyoUHn87pbY0N.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Buchanan County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Buchanan County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VmaaMtK5Ycimrw7r0.label: Nanny Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VmaaMtK5Ycimrw7r0.definition: A Nanny Visa authorizes a foreign national to enter and work in a host country as a live-in or live-out caregiver, primarily for children of certain non-immigrant workers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VndJ6w4w2Y0TR0pz5.label: Mosaic Down Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VndJ6w4w2Y0TR0pz5.definition: Mosaic Down syndrome is a genetic condition in which an individual has a mixture of cells, some with the usual two copies of chromosome 21 and others with three copies (trisomy 21). This results in a mosaic pattern of normal and abnormal cells.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Vo4lupZdSYNhCwK7F.label: Analysis of Employee Retention
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Vo4lupZdSYNhCwK7F.definition: Analysis of Employee Retention refers to the examination and evaluation of the factors that influence an organization's ability to retain its employees, including but not limited to compensation and benefits packages.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7VoSz3jjFWkRBy2z7C.label: Georgia District Court - Charlton County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7VoSz3jjFWkRBy2z7C.definition: Georgia District Court - Charlton County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Charlton County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Vs0DoddY29OqKW1QR.label: Motion for Relief due to Newly Discovered Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Vs0DoddY29OqKW1QR.definition: A Motion for Relief due to Newly Discovered Evidence is a legal request made to the court to reconsider a previous decision or judgment based on new evidence that was not available at the time of the original decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7W499nGCY59KMgPnfq.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 13 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7W499nGCY59KMgPnfq.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 13 Claim is a type of claim made in a bankruptcy case that allows individuals with regular income to develop a plan to repay all or part of their debts over a period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WDKuYlS2RESK9u2Ik.label: Strongarm powers
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WDKuYlS2RESK9u2Ik.definition: Trustee as lien creditor and as successor to certain creditors and purchasers

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WFfYMH1TScAYGE7FE.label: Matter Net Expenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WFfYMH1TScAYGE7FE.definition: Matter Net Expenses refers to the costs incurred by a law firm in providing legal services to a client, which are then passed on to the client as part of the engagement fee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WGDhX7l3Ewlv4bpL3.label: Edisto Natchez-Kusso Tribe of South Carolina (Natchez Indian Tribe)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WGnh1rtHb83LCujSQ.label: Balloon Payment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WGnh1rtHb83LCujSQ.definition: A balloon payment clause is a provision in a contract that requires the borrower to make a large payment at the end of the loan term, often used in mortgage agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WJanpmZE8YVO58tbl.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Peoria County (10th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WK8h5gXv13brisEQF.label: Contact State or Province
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WK8h5gXv13brisEQF.definition: Contact State or Province refers to the geographic location of a person or entity's contact information, such as their address, within a specific state or province.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WOZlSaagIDfXbaMnM.label: Texas District Court - Collin County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WOZlSaagIDfXbaMnM.definition: A Texas District Court located in Collin County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WUWbLlupo51XOIT68.label: Material Contracts Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WUWbLlupo51XOIT68.definition: Material Contracts Representation refers to a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party provides assurance about the status, validity, and enforceability of significant contracts to which the target entity is a party. It seeks to ensure that these critical contracts are in good standing and there are no hidden liabilities or issues that might adversely affect their value or enforceability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WdnFMPg1EhKvngDx5.label: Indiana Superior Court - Vigo County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WdnFMPg1EhKvngDx5.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Vigo County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WezfxjTeUdAQlkD7y.label: Indiana Superior Court - Boone County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WezfxjTeUdAQlkD7y.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Boone County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Boone County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WpnfyVtusqXzU7Awd.label: Amount in Controversy - expressed as "exceeding"
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WpnfyVtusqXzU7Awd.definition: The minimum amount in controversy, where the actual amount in dispute exceeds that minimum. Example: U.S. federal courts deciding a state-law matter (e.g., breach of contract) require an amount of controversy exceeding a certain amount (in 2022, that amount was $75,000).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Wr4hG8vwC8fkSaCK9.label: Public Housing Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Wr4hG8vwC8fkSaCK9.definition: Housing public benefit programs refer to government initiatives that provide assistance to individuals or families in obtaining affordable and safe housing. These programs often include subsidies, vouchers, or direct assistance to help low-income or vulnerable populations access housing that meets their needs. The specific eligibility criteria, types of assistance, and regulations governing such programs can vary widely by jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WsHBcxEk830usDLuC.label: inv_end_date
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WsHBcxEk830usDLuC.definition:
"The ending date for the billing period.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WsZP035ytgj9lOtIM.label: M&A Deal Size
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WsZP035ytgj9lOtIM.definition: The M&A Deal Size refers to the monetary value of a merger or acquisition transaction, which is a specific objective within the broader category of Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7WtvtriAUAudcIJMth.label: Notice of Voluntary Conversion - Chapter 13 to 7
http://lmss.sali.org/R7WtvtriAUAudcIJMth.definition: A Notice of Voluntary Conversion - Chapter 13 to 7 is a written statement informing the court and creditors of a debtor's decision to convert their bankruptcy case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Wv7wmPd5CWWsR7PHX.label: Maithili
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Wv7wmPd5CWWsR7PHX.definition: Maithili is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7X4vuBVsbGf69DAu7X.label: Personal Jurisdiction Bases
http://lmss.sali.org/R7X4vuBVsbGf69DAu7X.definition: Personal Jurisdiction Bases refer to the various legal grounds or criteria that a court may use to establish its authority over a person or entity in a legal matter, such as through property ownership, physical presence, or consent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7X62xlciGs5tCYd8bU.label: UTBMS MD00 Ancillary Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/R7X62xlciGs5tCYd8bU.definition: UTBMS MD00 Ancillary Documents: Documents that are not considered part of the main agreement in a merger or acquisition, but are related and necessary for the transaction, as classified under the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions code set.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XByfiMyRNQjAjdDQs.label: New York City Court - Lackawanna
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XByfiMyRNQjAjdDQs.definition: A court located in Lackawanna, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XCZzjQeBOLsFNtnrO.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Elkhart County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XCZzjQeBOLsFNtnrO.definition: A court located in Elkhart County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XEUVrFS72CU6LCzw9.label: Construction Defect Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XEUVrFS72CU6LCzw9.definition: A construction defect claim is a legal action brought against a party for damages resulting from faulty construction work.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XEtBP7LZhFvD8KRI1.label: Cahto Indian Tribe of the Laytonville Rancheria

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XItu3tE7QqpQuiRvk.label: Patent-Agent Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XItu3tE7QqpQuiRvk.definition: The Patent-Agent Privilege is a legal protection that allows communications between a patent agent and their client to remain confidential and not be disclosed in court, similar to attorney-client privilege.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XZu7ZMWoUsxX5UYm4.label: New York Supreme Court - Niagara County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XZu7ZMWoUsxX5UYm4.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Niagara County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Niagara County, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XcGXa2rEcUSGCu7cc.label: Inside
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XcGXa2rEcUSGCu7cc.definition: Actor attribute designating an internal role (e.g., Inside Counsel, In-house Counsel, Internal Expert).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XgHu1mRjYD5pPdi12.label: Lack of Contractual Capacity Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XgHu1mRjYD5pPdi12.definition: A Lack of Contractual Capacity Claim asserts that a party to a contract did not have the legal ability or competence to enter into the agreement, rendering the contract voidable. This claim typically arises due to factors such as minority, mental incapacity, or intoxication.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XggsCHhZxlgmBoni4.label: Right of Publicity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XggsCHhZxlgmBoni4.definition: The Right of Publicity is a legal concept that protects an individual's right to control the commercial use of their name, image, likeness, or other identifiable aspects of their persona, and prohibits others from using them without permission.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XjMoxjqIUftkOYtnz.label: Disinheritance
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XjMoxjqIUftkOYtnz.definition: Disinheritance is the legal act of deliberately excluding an heir from receiving property or assets from a deceased person's estate, typically through the terms specified in a will or trust. This action can be taken for various personal, financial, or relational reasons, and must comply with legal statutes to be effective.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XjkX2t9nn1HNqmQ1C.label: South Carolina Bar - Ethics Advisory Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XjkX2t9nn1HNqmQ1C.definition: A committee established by the South Carolina Bar to provide guidance on ethical issues related to the practice of law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Xjkk7EkIgiSA3LmsP.label: Illegal Gambling
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Xjkk7EkIgiSA3LmsP.definition: To unlawfully bet or wager money or something else of value; assist, promote, or operate a game of chance for money or some other stake; possess or transmit wagering information; manufacture, sell, purchase, possess, or transport gambling equipment, devices or goods; or tamper with the outcome of a sporting event or contest to gain a gambling advantage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XkvVSRKmrHqQOASeK.label: Material Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XkvVSRKmrHqQOASeK.definition: A person who prosecutors believe has evidence of a material fact in a criminal investigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XlRtk6WMnbMZULXcg.label: Family Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XlRtk6WMnbMZULXcg.definition: Family Liability refers to the legal responsibility of family members for the actions or debts of other family members, including spousal and parent-child liability, as well as agency and vicarious liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Xnvf9ThDb99RM1dpQ.label: Reasonable Act or Omission to Correct
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Xnvf9ThDb99RM1dpQ.definition: A "Reasonable Act or Omission to Correct" refers to a legal concept within the larger framework of "Governmental Immunity for Condition of Public Property," which allows a government entity to avoid liability for injuries caused by a dangerous condition on public property if they can show that they acted reasonably in attempting to correct the condition or that their decision not to correct the condition was also reasonable.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XpYe4Rz8RjUeP6NgD.label: Corporal Punishment Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XpYe4Rz8RjUeP6NgD.definition: A claim made against an educational institution or its staff for the use of physical discipline on a student, falling under the category of Education Liability and specifically related to Corporal Punishment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7XyscaXi5Cnm09a2Eu.label: Existing Mental, Emotional, Physical Condition
http://lmss.sali.org/R7XyscaXi5Cnm09a2Eu.definition: Existing Mental, Emotional, or Physical Condition is a hearsay exception that allows the admission of statements that describe the declarant's then-existing state of mind, feeling, sensation, or bodily health. This exception is based on the belief that such statements are reliable because they are made in the moment and are unlikely to be fabricated.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Y2YIqmaVxoK50QYYZ.label: U.S. Tax Court Rules of Practice and Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Y2YIqmaVxoK50QYYZ.definition: Procedural rules promulgated by the U.S. Tax Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Y2wUAbW64pENZVQnI.label: E119 Experts
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Y2wUAbW64pENZVQnI.definition: E119 Experts refer to the expenses incurred for hiring professionals with specialized knowledge or skills to provide expert testimony or advice in legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YHIpFbch8nzNShIta.label: Legal Work Location - Locality
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YHIpFbch8nzNShIta.definition: Locality where the legal services work is being performed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YLYsG4BIFuIwKRx4z.label: Immigrant Visa for Employer Sponsored Priority Workers
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YLYsG4BIFuIwKRx4z.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Employer Sponsored Priority Workers" grants permanent residency to highly skilled individuals who demonstrate exceptional abilities in fields such as science, arts, business, or academia. This visa prioritizes workers with extraordinary qualifications, including outstanding professors, researchers, and executives or managers of multinational companies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YQTW5fOZ5GXceSvFa.label: Special Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YQTW5fOZ5GXceSvFa.definition: A Special Appendix is a specific type of appendix that contains unique or exceptional information and is distinct from other types of appendices.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YShSuPBbr8Gd8UZEm.label: Economic Loss Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YShSuPBbr8Gd8UZEm.definition: The Economic Loss Doctrine is a legal principle that limits recovery in negligence claims to only economic losses, such as lost profits or property damage, and excludes recovery for personal injury or other non-economic losses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YToQxzuXojCNWk2g0.label: Second-Degree Murder
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YToQxzuXojCNWk2g0.definition: The concept of Second-Degree Murder, also known as Depraved Heart Murder, refers to the intentional killing of another person with malice aforethought, but without premeditation or deliberation, and with a reckless disregard for human life.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YVt2Lq9xcrk6RYtqL.label: Non Waiver Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YVt2Lq9xcrk6RYtqL.definition: A non-waiver clause is a contractual provision that states that the failure to enforce a right or remedy under the contract does not constitute a waiver of that right or remedy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YXMd6n1Pa9dmpBWmb.label: Manufacturing Defect
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YXMd6n1Pa9dmpBWmb.definition: A manufacturing defect is a type of product defect that occurs when a product is not made according to its intended design, resulting in a dangerous or defective product.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YZiYE6y1mjgMaElmt.label: Single Asset Real Estate Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YZiYE6y1mjgMaElmt.definition: A Single Asset Real Estate Debtor (SARE Debtor) refers to a specific classification in bankruptcy proceedings for debtors whose primary business involves a single real estate property. This classification impacts how bankruptcy cases are handled, particularly by expediting the process and applying unique rules concerning automatic stays and reorganization plans.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YZtYSCWULuIY1kc2N.label: Contact Name Suffix - J.D. (Juris Doctor)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YZtYSCWULuIY1kc2N.definition: The suffix "J.D." stands for "Juris Doctor" and is used after a person's name to signify that they have earned the professional graduate degree in law. This designation indicates the individual's qualifications to practice law in a particular jurisdiction, provided they have passed the bar exam, and is commonly used in legal settings, academic environments, and formal documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YcudBFwMUS1r7BcWj.label: "Intervening Event" Thresholds
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YcudBFwMUS1r7BcWj.definition: Intervening Event Thresholds refer to specific criteria or conditions that must be met in order for an event to be considered an intervening event, which is an event that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement and may affect its performance or outcome.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YfzXuf8O3MZ9abOL3.label: Indiana Superior Court - Marion County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YfzXuf8O3MZ9abOL3.definition: A court located in Marion County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YqwBGZ2zCoqGykJ8k.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Floyd County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YqwBGZ2zCoqGykJ8k.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Floyd County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Floyd County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7YrUEeY57nXqKlmxKC.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Franklin Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/R7YrUEeY57nXqKlmxKC.definition: A court located in Marion County, Franklin Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Z3OOdNgCP7699V17s.label: Per Diem Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Z3OOdNgCP7699V17s.definition: A per diem clause is a provision in a contract that specifies a daily allowance or rate of payment for expenses incurred by one party while performing duties for the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZILG1WNANuv2AwDSs.label: Kikuyu; Gikuyu
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZILG1WNANuv2AwDSs.definition: A Bantu language spoken primarily in Kenya by the Kikuyu people, characterized by its use of prefixes and suffixes to indicate tense, mood, and subject.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZRH4lO4MWjM2intGA.label: JI20 Pre Trial Review (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZRH4lO4MWjM2intGA.definition: Work in preparing for and attending any Pre Trial Review (excluding Costs Management).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZT5KiHPBk7MwCIt3V.label: Immigrant Visa for Spouse of a Citizen of Host Country
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZT5KiHPBk7MwCIt3V.definition: A "Visa for Spouse of a Citizen of Host Country" is an immigration authorization granted to the spouse of a country's citizen, allowing lawful entry, residence, or stay. This visa type typically facilitates family reunification under immigration law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZUD4AC5YHqLtlGhBq.label: Fiduciary Relationship
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZUD4AC5YHqLtlGhBq.definition: A fiduciary relationship is a legal relationship in which one party is entrusted with the care and management of another party's assets or interests, and is obligated to act in the best interests of the other party, with loyalty, honesty, and good faith.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZXlNb1fYV5MAmgwbu.label: payable_by_cl_name
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZXlNb1fYV5MAmgwbu.definition:
"The name of the party paying the invoice.  May not be the same party that is paying VAT on the invoice.  

The legal name of the party paying the invoice may also be different from the CLIENT.cl_name, the INVOICE tax_invoice_cl_name and the INVOICE.bill_to_cl_name.  In some jurisdictions it may be required by law to provide this information.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZaU5VfaJgXoZ6mCMO.label: Information Management Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZaU5VfaJgXoZ6mCMO.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's capacity and sustainability of information management procedures and practices — including the potential for negative outcomes resulting from an organization's inability to effectively collect, store, process, and protect its data and information assets. This can stem from poor data quality, outdated systems, inadequate data security measures, or noncompliance with data protection regulations, potentially leading to data breaches, or legal liabilities, ultimately affecting the organization's performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZbV4IDYgaCLaamhpV.label: Expungement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZbV4IDYgaCLaamhpV.definition: Expungement is the legal process through which an arrest or conviction is removed from an individual's criminal record, effectively sealing or erasing it from public view. Once expunged, the individual typically does not need to disclose the arrest or conviction in most situations, such as during employment background checks, and it is as though the event never occurred in the eyes of the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zbqfhemxs6PR7r2Fk.label: Medical Negligence Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zbqfhemxs6PR7r2Fk.definition: Medical Negligence Claims refer to legal claims made by individuals who have suffered harm or injury due to the failure of medical professionals to provide an appropriate standard of care.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZfDTW9ZZuAvpJxvh7.label: Motion to Introduce Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZfDTW9ZZuAvpJxvh7.definition: A Motion to Introduce Evidence is a formal request made to a court to allow the presentation of evidence during a trial or hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zfa5zKmebxoYJBZqi.label: Full-Time Employee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zfa5zKmebxoYJBZqi.definition: A Full-Time Employee is an individual who works a minimum number of hours specified by their employer or by labor laws, often at least 35 to 40 hours per week. This classification usually comes with benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, and retirement plans, which may not be available to part-time or contract workers

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZirUAl92QNUmY1box.label: Notice of Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZirUAl92QNUmY1box.definition: A Notice of Bankruptcy is a formal written communication that informs creditors and other interested parties that an individual or entity has filed for bankruptcy protection.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZkEwFlNJhzaSONYM8.label: Crohn's Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZkEwFlNJhzaSONYM8.definition: Crohn's disease is a chronic inflammatory condition of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, which can affect any part from the mouth to the anus, though it most commonly impacts the small intestine and colon. The disease is characterized by transmural inflammation, which can lead to complications such as strictures, fistulas, and abscesses, and typically requires ongoing medical management and sometimes surgical intervention.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZlaQW5BEvAiAweNG6.label: Nature of Work Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZlaQW5BEvAiAweNG6.definition: A Nature of Work Clause is a provision in a contract that defines the type of work that will be performed by one or both parties involved in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZqFHFPIl26xzldTIE.label: Note-Related Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZqFHFPIl26xzldTIE.definition: A "Note-Related Agreement" is a supplementary or associated contract that clarifies, modifies, or elaborates upon the terms of a primary promissory note or similar debt instrument. This document may cover issues such as security interests, covenants, or guaranties that are not detailed in the main note but are critical to the lending arrangement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZrWzdAOf6mXVtcQ49.label: Judicial Finding of Fact
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ZrWzdAOf6mXVtcQ49.definition: Finding of fact as adopted by a decisionmaker (e.g., judge, magistrate, arbitrator).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zwd84vqcynsz8PsQJ.label: Entertainment Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zwd84vqcynsz8PsQJ.definition: The Entertainment Visa (in the U.S., P-1B Visa), is designed for members of internationally recognized entertainment groups that wish to perform in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). In the United States, this non-immigrant visa allows the entertainers to stay for the duration of the event, competition, or performance, with an initial period of up to one year, which can be extended in increments of up to one year for continued performances or events

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zx0Z5V6kJy0JWEnLV.label: Motions for Bail
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zx0Z5V6kJy0JWEnLV.definition: A Motion for Bail is a formal request made to a court by a defendant or their attorney, asking for the release of the defendant from custody pending trial or appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zymc3xp7oUcp7PF4A.label: credit_note
http://lmss.sali.org/R7Zymc3xp7oUcp7PF4A.definition:
"In the European Union (and possibly in other areas of the world) it is required to indicate whether an instrument is a Credit Note if it corrects a Tax Invoice.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R7a564vmQrNahaDKe1F.label: 450 Commerce (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7a564vmQrNahaDKe1F.definition: Action filed under the Interstate Commerce Acts 49:1 et seq., 49:301

http://lmss.sali.org/R7a6EyWsqfhBLYPLP3e.label: Transcript Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/R7a6EyWsqfhBLYPLP3e.definition: A transcript appendix is a supplementary section of a document that includes a written or recorded record of spoken words, typically used in legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aBbOhIQLuwrLOympu.label: New York District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aBbOhIQLuwrLOympu.definition: The New York District Court is a trial court within the New York State Courts system, with jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in a specific geographic area within the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aFBns3Z2d9MuNI5sD.label: Deportation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aFBns3Z2d9MuNI5sD.definition: The forced removal of a person from a country by the government as a consequence of violating immigration laws or committing a crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aHk2AkuO60xkjZ0nG.label: Disinterested
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aHk2AkuO60xkjZ0nG.definition: The attribute "disinterested" refers to parties, often trustees or professionals, who have no personal interest in the outcome of the proceedings and no prior relationship with the debtor or creditors. Disinterested parties ensure unbiased administration and decision-making, fostering fairness and integrity in the process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aOV3ldC5GVaSOcGua.label: Expired Parking Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aOV3ldC5GVaSOcGua.definition: This occurs when a vehicle is parked in a regulated space beyond the time limit indicated on a parking meter or permit. The violation is typically enforced through a citation and fine issued by parking enforcement officers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aPdNazR2TDAE03Nhe.label: Meal Break
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aPdNazR2TDAE03Nhe.definition: A "Meal Break" is a period of time during the workday, typically lasting 30 minutes to an hour, in which employees are allowed to stop working and have a meal. This break is often unpaid and is intended to provide employees with the opportunity to eat and recharge.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aSm1AVSKBVx8el1HZ.label: Conflict of Interest Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aSm1AVSKBVx8el1HZ.definition: A Conflict of Interest Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties involved to disclose any potential conflicts of interest that may arise during the course of their relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aTogftBWxHCdIJBM3.label: School Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aTogftBWxHCdIJBM3.definition: School Liability Claims: Legal claims brought against educational institutions for damages or injuries caused by the institution's negligence or failure to provide a safe environment for students.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7aZgPyFypRCPoD3uON.label: Claim Construction Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/R7aZgPyFypRCPoD3uON.definition: A Claim Construction (Markman) Brief is a written document submitted to a court that provides an interpretation of the language used in patent claims, specifically for the purpose of determining the scope of the patent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ad12pe2psHapASxpX.label: Bronchiectasis
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ad12pe2psHapASxpX.definition: Bronchiectasis is a chronic respiratory condition characterized by abnormal and permanent dilation of the bronchial tubes, leading to impaired mucus clearance, chronic cough, and frequent respiratory infections. This condition results from damage to the airway walls, which can be caused by a variety of factors, including infections, genetic disorders, and autoimmune diseases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7afrfWXgffBUFBsbsa.label: Negative Commerce Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7afrfWXgffBUFBsbsa.definition: A Negative Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation violates the United States Constitution by unduly burdening or discriminating against interstate commerce, even in the absence of federal legislation. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Negative Commerce Clause prohibits states from imposing unreasonable barriers on interstate trade and commerce, thereby ensuring a free and fair flow of goods and services between states.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ahfB1BbtNvve47RAq.label: Blacklisting Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ahfB1BbtNvve47RAq.definition: A blacklisting claim refers to a legal action taken by an individual or entity who alleges they have been unfairly prevented from obtaining employment, services, or opportunities due to being placed on a "blacklist." A blacklist is an unofficial list of persons or entities that are deemed undesirable or untrustworthy, resulting in exclusion from certain opportunities or associations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7alL3ThuE851s7NQLQ.label: Forfeiture Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7alL3ThuE851s7NQLQ.definition: A forfeiture clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to forfeit or lose their right to something, such as a deposit, if they fail to meet certain obligations outlined in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7at71dGnBZ8kRawoY8.label: Jury Selection / Voire Dire Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7at71dGnBZ8kRawoY8.definition: Jury Selection / Voire Dire Practice refers to the process of selecting a jury for a trial, which involves questioning potential jurors to determine their suitability for serving on the jury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7athlXhsUuRtg7LvK0.label: Medical Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7athlXhsUuRtg7LvK0.definition: Medical Malpractice: Negligence or breach of duty by a healthcare professional that results in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7awxTX5kqxlsN3N0qT.label: Motion for Leave to Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/R7awxTX5kqxlsN3N0qT.definition: A Motion for Leave to Appeal is a formal request made by a non-party filer in a bankruptcy case to seek permission from the court to appeal a decision made by a lower court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7azvKC8RwopK0ecoTM.label: Presumption of Innocence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7azvKC8RwopK0ecoTM.definition: The presumption of innocence is a fundamental principle of criminal law that assumes an accused person is innocent until proven guilty. This cornerstone of the justice system places the burden of proof on the prosecution, requiring them to present sufficient evidence to convince a judge or jury of the defendant's guilt, and helps ensure that individuals are not unfairly convicted without proper evidence or due process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bP5vwpnavvW5pPJut.label: Criminal Claim Degree
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bP5vwpnavvW5pPJut.definition: The Criminal Claim Degree (Severity) refers to the level of seriousness of a criminal offense, such as a felony, misdemeanor, or infraction, within the context of a legal claim or litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bR4JuUnFZwFzMrQbR.label: Georgia District Court - Bryan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bR4JuUnFZwFzMrQbR.definition: Georgia District Court - Bryan County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Bryan County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bUyjnSIcSI4bvVW21.label: Hair Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bUyjnSIcSI4bvVW21.definition: Hair evidence includes strands or fragments of hair found at crime scenes or on objects. Through microscopic examination and DNA analysis, hair can reveal information about its origin, potentially linking individuals to a particular location or event.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bZqwOPufVYSnVkmLz.label: Entrapment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bZqwOPufVYSnVkmLz.definition: Entrapment is a defense in criminal law where the defendant argues that law enforcement induced them to commit a crime they would not have otherwise committed. This defense is used to prevent the conviction of individuals who were coerced into illegal activities by police or government agents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bddbBa7EIzMF8MI0E.label: Exclusive Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bddbBa7EIzMF8MI0E.definition: An exclusive agreement clause is a provision in a contract that restricts one or both parties from entering into similar agreements with other parties during the term of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bgNaAADYGryTZSNn3.label: Lovelock Paiute Tribe of the Lovelock Indian Colony, Nevada

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bioZVoICxYfaUkkVt.label: INVOICE_CURRENCY
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bioZVoICxYfaUkkVt.definition: The concept of INVOICE_CURRENCY refers to the specific currency used in a legal invoice, as defined by the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bndABfdeRug7rH6iT.label: Employee Re-Hire Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bndABfdeRug7rH6iT.definition: An Employee Re-Hire Event refers to the occasion when a former employee is formally rehired and rejoins the same organization. This event often involves the signing of a new employment contract and may necessitate another round of onboarding, while also potentially impacting seniority, benefits, and other employment conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7bnear7qteTICuLSkS.label: Collateral Estoppel
http://lmss.sali.org/R7bnear7qteTICuLSkS.definition: Collateral Estoppel is a legal doctrine that prevents a party from relitigating an issue that has already been decided in a previous case, even if the parties and legal theories are different.
