http://lmss.sali.org/R7lCj2dvGu7618ONPPE.label: Systemic Sclerosis
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lCj2dvGu7618ONPPE.definition: Systemic sclerosis (also known as scleroderma) constitutes a spectrum of disease in which thickening of the skin is the clinical hallmark. Raynaud's phenomenon, often medically severe and progressive, is present frequently and may be the peripheral manifestation of a vasospastic abnormality in the heart, lungs, and kidneys. The CREST syndrome (calcinosis, Raynaud's phenomenon, esophageal dysmotility, sclerodactyly, and telangiectasia) is a variant that may slowly progress over years to the generalized process, systemic sclerosis.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lGKuy9aoKEAAMDN48.label: Failure of Consideration
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lGKuy9aoKEAAMDN48.definition: Failure of Consideration is a legal defense that asserts that one party did not receive the agreed-upon consideration or value in exchange for their performance or promise, which renders the contract or agreement unenforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lHdg31xpYxItf0jgC.label: Tai languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lHdg31xpYxItf0jgC.definition: The Tai languages are a group of related languages spoken in Southeast Asia, including Thai, Lao, and Shan.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lM86QKcvnde0R3MxY.label: Maximum Exposure Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lM86QKcvnde0R3MxY.definition: The Maximum Exposure Amount is the highest possible monetary value that is at stake in a legal dispute, which is determined by the amount in controversy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lRwoMNdnWvEJefKNh.label: New York Children's Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lRwoMNdnWvEJefKNh.definition: A specialized court within the New York State Courts system that handles cases involving children, such as abuse and neglect, delinquency, and adoption.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lTxlzGtyW6qmFY5c2.label: tx_id
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lTxlzGtyW6qmFY5c2.definition: A unique identifier associated with the tax/rate/jurisdiction, assigned by the law firm.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lV0e95WaSyanL4yoU.label: Statistical Summary of Certain Liabilities
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lV0e95WaSyanL4yoU.definition: A Statistical Summary of Certain Liabilities is a type of information presented in a Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document that provides a numerical representation of certain debts or obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lZNBkmK6PzOpYUGGE.label: Fact Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lZNBkmK6PzOpYUGGE.definition: A nonparty who testifies to things that person has perceived.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lafmn1MTN8tqTrOnC.label: Proceeding Transferred to Problem-Solving Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lafmn1MTN8tqTrOnC.definition: The concept "Case Transferred to Problem-Solving Court" refers to the act of moving a legal case from a traditional court to a specialized court that focuses on addressing underlying issues that may have contributed to the legal matter, such as substance abuse or mental health problems.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lbn5V8jFfExuAk7Ou.label: Automobile Damaged at Parking Facility
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lbn5V8jFfExuAk7Ou.definition: An Automobile Damaged at Parking Facility refers to a legal claim related to property damage caused to a vehicle while parked in a designated parking area, and falls under the broader categories of Property and Premises Liability Claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lbqYoeuZitiUJsrh5.label: Testifying Expert Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lbqYoeuZitiUJsrh5.definition: An expert whom a party retains for consultation, where that expert provides oral testimony and/or a written report.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lf0A1jIEuJv35dVQw.label: Simple Agreement for Future Equity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lf0A1jIEuJv35dVQw.definition: A Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) is a contractual agreement between an investor and a company wherein the investor provides capital to the company in exchange for the rights to receive equity at a later date. The equity is usually issued during a subsequent financing round, at which point the SAFE converts based on the terms set forth in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ljmto05qFOOjMDFYJ.label: Scènes à Faire
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ljmto05qFOOjMDFYJ.definition: Scènes à Faire in copyright law refers to scenes, elements, or themes that are standard, necessary, or customary to a particular genre and are therefore not protectable due to their lack of originality. This doctrine acknowledges that certain expressions are indispensable or typical for certain topics or settings and are therefore free for use by all.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lnHJ7QtcApqKgnLNV.label: Equal Pay Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lnHJ7QtcApqKgnLNV.definition: An Gender Pay Equality Claim is a legal action alleging violation of a law requiring that men and women in the same workplace be given equal pay for equal work. The claim typically involves issues of gender-based wage discrimination.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ltqLFbA95B5Hwmwgf.label: AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ltqLFbA95B5Hwmwgf.definition: The AAA Commercial Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures are a set of guidelines and procedures established by the American Arbitration Association for resolving commercial disputes through arbitration and mediation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lw1kvfDrIqvdTv04Q.label: Change of Recommendation Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lw1kvfDrIqvdTv04Q.definition: A Change of Recommendation Covenant is a provision in a deal protection agreement that requires a target company's board to recommend a new offer to its shareholders, even if it is less favorable than a previous offer, in exchange for certain protections for the acquirer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7lxeVIOck43eKAMJhZ.label: ENT Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7lxeVIOck43eKAMJhZ.definition: Failure of a healthcare provider to exercise reasonable care, skill, or diligence in the treatment of a patient resulting in harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7m1UQGl07ZddtpzqQt.label: Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7m1UQGl07ZddtpzqQt.definition: A WARN Act claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification (WARN) Act. The WARN Act is a federal law that requires certain employers to provide advance notice of significant layoffs or plant closings to affected employees, as well as to state and local government officials. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with the WARN Act's notice requirements, which can result in employees losing their jobs without sufficient notice or time to find alternative employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7m3V9EVDL2R68BV2Hv.label: Reinsurance Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7m3V9EVDL2R68BV2Hv.definition: A Reinsurance Agreement is a contract where an insurer transfers a portion of its risks to another insurer, known as the reinsurer. This helps the primary insurer manage its risk exposure and maintain solvency by spreading potential large losses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7m3iIocgmkCmBLcoyg.label: Genderqueer
http://lmss.sali.org/R7m3iIocgmkCmBLcoyg.definition: Genderqueer is a gender identity that falls outside the conventional binary of male or female and may encompass a range of identities that are not exclusively masculine or feminine. Legally, genderqueer individuals may seek recognition and protection under laws pertaining to gender discrimination, harassment, and equality, similar to other non-binary or gender non-conforming identities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7m7hUozBtx7JODLD9V.label: Motorcyclist
http://lmss.sali.org/R7m7hUozBtx7JODLD9V.definition: A motorcycle driver is an individual who operates a motorcycle, controlling its mechanisms to navigate roads and other environments. This role entails a distinct set of skills and adherence to specific traffic laws to ensure the safety of the driver and other road users.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mBPPNZa5Dk7a8ft3v.label: CLIENT_NAME
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mBPPNZa5Dk7a8ft3v.definition: The term CLIENT_NAME refers to a specific data element within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard, which is used to identify the name of a client in legal billing and invoicing processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mL8NoasPohW19RcS9.label: Senior Subordinated Credit Ranking
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mL8NoasPohW19RcS9.definition: Senior Subordinated Credit Ranking refers to the priority status of senior subordinated debts, which are ranked above junior and junior subordinated debts but below senior debts in the event of liquidation. This ranking ensures that senior subordinated creditors are paid before junior creditors from the proceeds of the liquidated assets, providing them with a moderate level of security and reduced risk compared to junior debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mLi0c5rJV5GYGGuEi.label: Judgment Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mLi0c5rJV5GYGGuEi.definition: A judgment lien is a type of lien that is created when a court grants a judgment in favor of a creditor, giving them the right to place a lien on the debtor's property in order to secure payment of the debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mMPoEuA9Ja4rODr1L.label: Copyright Work Types
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mMPoEuA9Ja4rODr1L.definition: Copyright Work Types encompass various forms of creative works such as Derivative Work, Collective Work, and Joint Work, each with unique characteristics and legal implications. Derivative Works are based on pre-existing works, Collective Works involve the assembly of independent works into a single publication, and Joint Works are created by collaboration with merged contributions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mPsut1F9ySs0TTroC.label: Key Performance Indicator
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mPsut1F9ySs0TTroC.definition: A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a quantifiable measure used to evaluate the success of an organization, employee, or process in achieving specific objectives. KPIs are essential for assessing performance, guiding strategic decisions, and improving efficiency across various sectors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mRrzk4AYWd6T2Q9b0.label: New York Supreme Court - Nassau County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mRrzk4AYWd6T2Q9b0.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Nassau County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Nassau County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mSGVYgqs4JBAyPv4J.label: Motion to Admit Involuntarily
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mSGVYgqs4JBAyPv4J.definition: A Motion to Admit Involuntarily is a request made in a trial court to allow evidence that was obtained without the consent of the person from whom it was taken.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mT3oM7UJnGCUIq15F.label: Force Majeure Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mT3oM7UJnGCUIq15F.definition: A Force Majeure Clause is a contractual provision that can modify (e.g., terminate, excuse, extend) the party's performance of its obligations under the contract  when unforeseeable events beyond the control of the parties, such as natural disasters or acts of war, make performance impracticable or impossible.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mV7HE7QyVvKdoNumY.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Pike County (8th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mVtx371wZ4xXfqQEt.label: Insurance Adjuster
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mVtx371wZ4xXfqQEt.definition: An insurance adjuster is a professional who works for an insurance company and investigates and evaluates insurance claims made by policyholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mWBDOBHpRNqVFQKat.label: Nilo-Saharan languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mWBDOBHpRNqVFQKat.definition: Nilo-Saharan languages are a group of languages spoken in parts of Africa, including Sudan, Chad, and Ethiopia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mZ0hPBKZ924ElwuXp.label: U.S. Personnel Appeals Board
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mZ0hPBKZ924ElwuXp.definition: The U.S. Personnel Appeals Board (PAB) is a specific administrative proceeding venue within the U.S. Government Accountability Office that handles appeals related to personnel actions taken by federal agencies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ma9Q5FiHDcIYgKoxK.label: Inchoate Criminal Offenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ma9Q5FiHDcIYgKoxK.definition: Inchoate Criminal Offenses are incomplete or anticipatory criminal acts that have not yet been fully carried out, but are still punishable by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mdFwKA6SgDr4v5jLl.label: Uncontested Adoption
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mdFwKA6SgDr4v5jLl.definition: An Uncontested Adoption is when all relevant parties agree on the adoption of a child without any opposition. Typically, the biological parents have either voluntarily relinquished their parental rights or have had them legally terminated, allowing the adoption process to proceed smoothly and without legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7meQhKYGkcA57UZ7v4.label: Banking Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7meQhKYGkcA57UZ7v4.definition: Law that governs how banks and other financial institutions conduct business.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mgNPd4FGctFwPjYqR.label: Motion to File Oversized Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mgNPd4FGctFwPjYqR.definition: A Motion to File Oversized Brief is a legal request to submit a brief that exceeds the standard page limit set by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mghrIauk4oJaakhl0.label: Property Rights and Transactions Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mghrIauk4oJaakhl0.definition: Law relating to the acquisition and transfer of real property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mhIW2MLv6G8EokmXg.label: Ewondo
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mhIW2MLv6G8EokmXg.definition: A language spoken in Cameroon, primarily in the central and southern regions, belonging to the Bantu language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mi3UrSTsIyhoH1zkl.label: Outstanding Fees Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mi3UrSTsIyhoH1zkl.definition: An Outstanding Fees Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to pay any unpaid fees or charges to the other party before the contract can be terminated or enforced.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mjxSC5MBmLhpORyFr.label: Promise to Pay Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mjxSC5MBmLhpORyFr.definition: A Promise to Pay Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that obligates one party to pay a specified amount of money to another party at a designated time or upon the occurrence of a certain event.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mquexwFQwlWQLbRUZ.label: UK National Health Service
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mquexwFQwlWQLbRUZ.definition: The UK National Health Service (NHS) is a publicly funded healthcare system in the United Kingdom, providing comprehensive medical services to residents. Established to offer free at the point of use healthcare, the NHS administers services including hospitals, general practitioners, dental care, and specialized treatments, ensuring accessible health care across the country.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mshiJbRkzS94zhlvn.label: Argumentative Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mshiJbRkzS94zhlvn.definition: An Argumentative Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question posed by the opposing counsel is designed to provoke an argument rather than elicit factual information. This objection seeks to maintain the proceeding's decorum, ensuring that questions are neutral and focused on obtaining relevant evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7mu9UwgyzXG3u0tptu.label: Commander in Chief Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7mu9UwgyzXG3u0tptu.definition: A Commander in Chief Clause claim refers to a legal argument challenging the constitutionality of an action taken by the President or executive branch of government based on the powers and limitations outlined in the Commander in Chief Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim asserts that a particular action exceeds the President's authority as the Commander in Chief of the armed forces, potentially rendering it unconstitutional. The Commander in Chief Clause grants the President the power to command and control the military forces of the nation but is subject to checks and balances established by other constitutional provisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7n44E1SO9VDJ9Kp9G6.label: Lessor’s Breach of Express Warranty on Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/R7n44E1SO9VDJ9Kp9G6.definition: The Lessor's Breach of Express Warranty on Goods refers to the failure of the party leasing goods to fulfill a specific promise or guarantee made about the quality or condition of the goods, resulting in legal claims by the lessee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7n6xn6CbnvekygNrB5.label: Consumer Contract Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7n6xn6CbnvekygNrB5.definition: Consumer Contract Claims are legal claims made by a party in a contract with a consumer, including claims related to billing errors, unlawful provisions, unconscionable circumstances, and improper actions by loan brokers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7n9rAWIq1fi7qGb3xR.label: Blasphemous Material
http://lmss.sali.org/R7n9rAWIq1fi7qGb3xR.definition: Blasphemous Material refers to content that shows disrespect or irreverence toward religious beliefs, figures, deities, or sacred symbols. This type of material often leads to significant controversy and legal actions in jurisdictions where blasphemy laws are enforced.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nCzcmx7E2irmj7iF0.label: Political Party
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nCzcmx7E2irmj7iF0.definition: A political party is an organized group of individuals who share similar political beliefs and goals, seeking to influence public policy and gain control of government through the electoral process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nEmCl4lSrGiGW6mOu.label: Securities Purchase Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nEmCl4lSrGiGW6mOu.definition: Securities Purchase Agreement is a legal contract detailing the sale and purchase of securities, either equity or debt. It includes terms such as the purchase price, representations, warranties, and covenants of the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nF662MDXmfCV8oTfz.label: Bankruptcy Plan Consummation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nF662MDXmfCV8oTfz.definition: Bankruptcy Plan Consummation refers to the completion of the necessary actions outlined in a bankruptcy plan, leading to its implementation. It marks the point at which the bankruptcy proceedings are consummated, and the plan's terms are effectuated.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nIE5X1yCdSbN8Uihl.label: Minnesota District Court - Kandiyohi County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nIE5X1yCdSbN8Uihl.definition: Minnesota District Court - Kandiyohi County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Kandiyohi County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nIUZHs8FEmvVOZ76P.label: Intranet Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nIUZHs8FEmvVOZ76P.definition: Intranet Management refers to the process of organizing and controlling the internal network of an organization, including the management of content, access, and security.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nJP4dSsrkKNSDVNhv.label: Chemical Patent
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nJP4dSsrkKNSDVNhv.definition: A chemical patent is a legal protection granted to inventors of new and useful chemical compounds, compositions, processes, or improvements thereof.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nLS8ry1FEJUBSrWrR.label: Closing Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nLS8ry1FEJUBSrWrR.definition: The Closing Event is a specific type of event that occurs during a merger and acquisition or transaction, marking the completion of the deal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nRpAuHPTYLWKWrxp5.label: Motion to Disqualify Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nRpAuHPTYLWKWrxp5.definition: A Motion to Disqualify Counsel is a legal request to remove an attorney from a case due to a conflict of interest or other ethical violation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nS49EDFV5ikI46xI7.label: Motion to File Supplemental Briefing for Petition for Rehearing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nS49EDFV5ikI46xI7.definition: A Motion to File Supplemental Briefing for Petition for Rehearing is a formal request to submit additional written arguments or evidence to support a request for a new hearing, after a decision has already been made, in order to address new or relevant information that was not available at the time of the original hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nYjWxGQdHVUZcYq7n.label: Hit and Run
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nYjWxGQdHVUZcYq7n.definition: The concept of Hit and Run refers to a criminal offense where a person involved in an accident fails to stop and provide information, such as their name and contact details, to the other party involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ncIl72DDP9vuJh1lY.label: Fixed Rate Interest Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ncIl72DDP9vuJh1lY.definition: A Fixed Rate Interest Payment is a type of interest payment structure where the interest rate remains constant throughout the life of the debt instrument. Under this arrangement, the borrower pays a predetermined interest rate at regular intervals, typically annually or semi-annually, which is established at the time of issuance and does not change regardless of market fluctuations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ngAC5KMKiOazWcp35.label: Immigration Arrival in Country
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ngAC5KMKiOazWcp35.definition: Arrival In Country refers to the act of entering a nation, commonly documented and regulated through immigration control points like airports, seaports, and land borders. The process usually involves inspection and verification of travel documents, visas, and other entry requirements, after which the individual is granted or denied permission to enter the country.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7niFkRJVZFV9SgeGEW.label: Primary Care Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7niFkRJVZFV9SgeGEW.definition: Primary Care Malpractice: Negligence or wrongdoing by a healthcare provider who is responsible for the initial diagnosis and treatment of a patient, resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nn3Ecr1ZswWh3I6hw.label: Oil and Gas Extraction Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nn3Ecr1ZswWh3I6hw.definition: Industries in this group operate and/or develop oil and gas field properties. Such activities may include exploration for crude petroleum and natural gas; drilling, completing, and equipping wells; operating separators, emulsion breakers, desilting equipment, and field gathering lines for crude petroleum and natural gas; and all other activities in the preparation of oil and gas up to the point of shipment from the producing property. This subsector includes the production of crude petroleum, the mining and extraction of oil from oil shale and oil sands, and the production of natural gas, sulfur recovery from natural gas, and recovery of hydrocarbon liquids.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7nqxxlAfhYqqSA2UQ5.label: Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7nqxxlAfhYqqSA2UQ5.definition: Negligence is a legal concept that refers to the failure to exercise reasonable care, resulting in harm or injury to another person or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ns6CvegRSTYBYdduo.label: Pumpkins
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ns6CvegRSTYBYdduo.definition: Pumpkins are a type of winter squash from the Cucurbita genus, characterized by their round shape, ribbed skin, and vibrant orange color. They are widely cultivated for their edible flesh and seeds and are valued for their nutritional content, including vitamins A and C, fiber, and antioxidants, as well as their use in decorative and cultural traditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7o4TiXsYQ6vV6MrJMT.label: Construction and Development Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7o4TiXsYQ6vV6MrJMT.definition: Law dealing with matters relating to building construction, engineering, and related fields.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7o6JzvLOQ3IpjNUscF.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Bureau County (13th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7o7soNetY9MJNcGnoq.label: Welsh
http://lmss.sali.org/R7o7soNetY9MJNcGnoq.definition: Welsh (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken in Wales and some parts of the United Kingdom.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7o9hDYdsWzr49mfYSm.label: Indiana Superior Court - Greene County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7o9hDYdsWzr49mfYSm.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Greene County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Greene County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oAOOGrsnzhH7VlWXp.label: Legislative Immunity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oAOOGrsnzhH7VlWXp.definition: Legislative Immunity refers to the legal protection granted to legislators from being held liable for their actions or statements made in the course of their legislative duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oBWHStfmqTLn2Mypk.label: Entity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oBWHStfmqTLn2Mypk.definition: A legal entity is a legal construct through which the law allows a group of natural persons to act as if they were a single person for certain purposes. The most common purposes are lawsuits, property ownership, and contracts. Some examples of legal entities include companies, cooperatives (co-ops), corporations, municipalities, political parties, sovereigns, states, temples, trade unions, and ships or vessels.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oDJy77EA0Pi8O1aVP.label: work_location_locality
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oDJy77EA0Pi8O1aVP.definition: The location where the work associated with the fee item was performed, to support the taxes appearing in the for example, in canada appropriate values would be the province; if city or other local tax is charged would be city or locality.  use accepted abbreviations for state or province mandated by the country's postal service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oIpRW8ruWV68pwMEj.label: Dyscalculia
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oIpRW8ruWV68pwMEj.definition: Dyscalculia is a specific learning disability that affects an individual's ability to understand, remember, and manipulate numbers and mathematical concepts. This condition leads to difficulties in performing arithmetic operations, understanding numerical relationships, and grasping abstract math concepts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJAhnRY9sc5jyWHuJ.label: Non-fundamental Representations and Warranties
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJAhnRY9sc5jyWHuJ.definition: Non-fundamental representations and warranties are the less essential or non-core statements made by a party in a contract, typically pertaining to the condition of a business, assets, or the accuracy of certain information. While important, these representations and warranties are generally considered less critical to the overall transaction than fundamental representations and warranties, which relate to crucial aspects such as the seller's ownership, authority, and the validity of the contract itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJoG2FXMDxj3klcFZ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Cobb County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJoG2FXMDxj3klcFZ.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Cobb County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Cobb County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJtSIkuDOqLueUjlM.label: Sponsorship Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oJtSIkuDOqLueUjlM.definition: A Sponsorship Agreement is a legally binding contract between two parties that outlines the terms and conditions of a sponsorship arrangement, typically involving the exchange of goods, services, or financial support in exchange for advertising or promotional opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oMfkhjloy4XV9dITY.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Dearborn County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oMfkhjloy4XV9dITY.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Dearborn County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oNzeoztbuRwAAvrHz.label: Common Benefit Fee Methodology
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oNzeoztbuRwAAvrHz.definition: A Common Benefit Fee Methodology is a method of calculating attorney fees in a legal matter where the outcome of the case provides a benefit to a group of individuals, and the fees are divided among the group based on their proportionate share of the benefit received.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oOBypnPAAA47zUxyQ.label: Privileges & Immunities Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oOBypnPAAA47zUxyQ.definition: A Privileges & Immunities Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on the Privileges and Immunities Clause of the United States Constitution, asserting that states cannot discriminate against citizens of other states by denying them fundamental rights and privileges. It aims to protect the rights and equal treatment of individuals traveling or residing in different states within the United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oPtqGQSFLbuj4sBCA.label: Customs and Import Controls Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oPtqGQSFLbuj4sBCA.definition: Customs and Import Controls Practice encompasses the legal frameworks and regulations governing the importation of goods into a country. This practice area includes compliance with customs laws, import duties, tariffs, import restrictions, and procedures for resolving disputes related to customs and import controls.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oWyxtB6MtD5SutNOJ.label: Private Right of Action
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oWyxtB6MtD5SutNOJ.definition: A private right of action refers to the legal authority granted to an individual or private party to file a lawsuit for violations of law that have affected them. Essentially, it enables citizens to enforce statutes or regulations by taking alleged violators to court, rather than relying solely on government agencies for enforcement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oZYoHPjrvOgl09T5W.label: Dependent
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oZYoHPjrvOgl09T5W.definition: A dependent is an individual who relies on another person, typically a family member, for financial support and is often eligible for specific tax benefits. In legal and insurance contexts, dependents may include spouses, children, and sometimes other relatives or individuals who live in the same household and rely on the primary earner for essential financial support.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oaAQI6I2tIaCnl7vd.label: Member Liability in Joint Enterprise
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oaAQI6I2tIaCnl7vd.definition: Member Liability in Joint Enterprise refers to the legal responsibility of individuals who are part of a joint enterprise, such as a partnership or corporation, for any liabilities incurred by the enterprise.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7obUkCMjl1ukHhagGF.label: Extranet Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7obUkCMjl1ukHhagGF.definition: Extranet Management refers to the management of a secure network that allows external parties to access and share information with an organization, and is a subset of Collaboration Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7obzFRN58WoEDO4rf1.label: Educational Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/R7obzFRN58WoEDO4rf1.definition: Educational benefits are perks provided to employees to support their educational goals and aspirations, including offerings such as courses, seminars, tuition reimbursement, and professional development opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ogKhtdFzkrnGBbBfb.label: DEPRECATED: Bankruptcy Plan Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ogKhtdFzkrnGBbBfb.definition: DEPRECATED: Bankruptcy Plan Hearing - A hearing held in a bankruptcy case to consider the confirmation of a plan of reorganization or liquidation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ohBhG30mAhFCPtHV0.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Massac County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ohUdiqiABUnXnkxmn.label: Domestic Relations Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ohUdiqiABUnXnkxmn.definition: A Domestic Relations Claim is a legal action brought by a party in a family law or matrimonial matter, seeking relief related to issues such as divorce, child custody, child support, alimony, or property division.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oiIlyfdtRYQUVuBKh.label: Strategic Buyer
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oiIlyfdtRYQUVuBKh.definition: A strategic buyer is a type of M&A buyer who acquires a company with the intention of achieving long-term goals, such as expanding their market share or diversifying their product offerings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7oop8Do8ZoVb99BBKZ.label: Turkeys
http://lmss.sali.org/R7oop8Do8ZoVb99BBKZ.definition: Turkeys are large domesticated birds belonging to the species Meleagris gallopavo, commonly raised for their meat. Known for their distinctive fan-shaped tail and wattled neck, turkeys are an important source of poultry, particularly in North America, where they play a central role in traditional meals like Thanksgiving.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ov944p22Oy99uqJIz.label: Debarment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ov944p22Oy99uqJIz.definition: Debarment refers to the exclusion of an individual or entity from participating in certain activities, particularly government contracting and subcontracting, due to violations of regulations, misconduct, or failure to comply with contractual obligations. This measure aims to protect public interest by preventing unreliable or unethical parties from engaging in government-related activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ow8F5Gk8GH6KriHGb.label: Indiana Superior Court - Decatur County

http://lmss.sali.org/R7pahpml2WPENJk6Hj3.definition: A Regulatory Denial Event refers to the situation where an application, request, or submission made to a regulatory authority is declined or denied, often due to not meeting the specified criteria or requirements. In immigration, this could entail the rejection of an immigration application, visa request, or other related matters based on assessment by the relevant authorities

http://lmss.sali.org/R7pdxPTaX6vba9mZzRN.label: Failure to Satisfy Conditions Precedent
http://lmss.sali.org/R7pdxPTaX6vba9mZzRN.definition: The Failure to Satisfy Conditions Precedent is a legal defense in civil litigation where the defendant argues that the plaintiff did not fulfill the necessary requirements before bringing the lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7penaMGwxbgCHaVN2a.definition: The Montana Workers Compensation Court is a specialized court within the Montana State Courts system that handles cases related to workers' compensation disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7pgWczDcp7em4Tl5BC.label: Non-Responsive Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7pgWczDcp7em4Tl5BC.definition: A Non-Responsive Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a witness's response does not directly address the question asked. This objection seeks to ensure that the testimony remains relevant and focused on the issues at hand.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7pjdyhdGIGiBKuLCGT.label: By Reverse Contingency
http://lmss.sali.org/R7pjdyhdGIGiBKuLCGT.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a fee represented by the percentage of the amount of money that a client saved in litigation — often expressed as the difference between a third party's originally demanded amount (from the client) and the client's ultimate payment amount.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7pmemTPiA07Ig74u5U.label: Tonga
http://lmss.sali.org/R7pmemTPiA07Ig74u5U.definition: A language spoken in the Tonga Islands, characterized by its own grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ppLbcG1r1qmn9k8nk.label: Improper Lay Opinion Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ppLbcG1r1qmn9k8nk.definition: An Improper Lay Opinion Objection is raised when a party believes that a non-expert witness is offering an opinion without sufficient basis, exceeding the bounds of their direct perception or not aiding in understanding or determining a fact in issue (e.g., Federal Rule of Evidence 701). Lay witnesses can offer opinions if they have personal knowledge and a rational basis for their conclusions, such as describing someone's appearance without speculating on their thoughts. However, they may not testify to someone else's thoughts, specific medical conditions, or other technical matters beyond their knowledge.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7q2TONAogRMuCETWEq.label: Pilot Ruleset
http://lmss.sali.org/R7q2TONAogRMuCETWEq.definition: A Pilot Ruleset is a specific type of legal rule that is used for testing or experimental purposes before being fully implemented.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7q3vIB6kCMaSnQt4XP.definition: A Future Consideration Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines an obligation to perform an action or provide compensation at a later date, based on certain conditions being met.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7q5BdWG3lyvHbHIZj9.definition: A Schedule of Post-Petition Debts is a list of debts incurred by a debtor after filing for bankruptcy, which must be disclosed to the court and creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qD861Sfx35d9VnPcZ.definition: Physical Examination Practice refers to the specialized knowledge and skills used by experts in conducting physical examinations as part of their legal work.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qEZ5Y9qpwrPabAFeV.definition: An ISDA Agreement is a standardized contract established by the International Swaps and Derivatives Association to regulate over-the-counter derivatives transactions. http://lmss.sali.org/R7qFX8LI9LOwqdCbxrh.definition: Knowledge Representation is the method of encoding information about the world in a format that an AI system can use to solve complex tasks, including reasoning and inference. This involves using various symbolic or sub-symbolic techniques to model entities, relationships, and rules within a specific domain.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qLFW8vS0YBGkyL5Bu.definition:
The visa for dependents of vocational students (in the U.S., the M-2 visa) is a non-immigrant visa that allows spouses and minor children of vocational students

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qOIe1R5RuWJy0aoak.definition: The Vermont Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Vermont, responsible for hearing appeals from lower state courts and interpreting state law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qQcDwFVcSsYPeHEJc.definition: A fee credit amount is a type of discount or credit applied to legal services fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qVuIk7an16npW6AGq.definition: Voluntary Bankruptcy occurs when a debtor initiates bankruptcy proceedings by filing a petition with the bankruptcy court. It contrasts with Involuntary Bankruptcy, where creditors initiate the process against a debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qYdzDpOwDU4Z5oYtm.definition: The Negligent Provision of Required Safeguards or Precautions refers to a failure to provide necessary safety measures or precautions, resulting in harm or injury, in the context of industrial injury claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qfDUdV0uQYPGsrjTf.definition: Involuntary employment termination event refers to the act of an employer initiating the separation of an employee from their job. Reasons can range from downsizing and organizational restructuring to performance issues or misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qfTexSR4G3oOhgwnF.label: Project Communication Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qfTexSR4G3oOhgwnF.definition: A plan for communicating status, progress, change management, and other considerations to a project's stakeholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qgJwhdyqvE8u175RN.label: Reprieve
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qgJwhdyqvE8u175RN.definition: A reprieve is a temporary delay or suspension of a punishment or sentence, especially in the context of the death penalty. It serves as a postponement of the execution of a sentence, often to allow the defendant more time to seek a new trial, appeal, or another form of relief. However, a reprieve does not change the underlying conviction or sentence; it only delays its enforcement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qhPJtO8qtuoWinPbe.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Colfax County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qhPJtO8qtuoWinPbe.definition: A court located in Colfax County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qicnAOVCTYIaiJHt9.label: Medical Test
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qicnAOVCTYIaiJHt9.definition: A Medical Test is a clinical procedure performed to detect, diagnose, or monitor diseases, disease processes, susceptibility, or to determine a course of treatment. Examples include blood tests, DNA tests, drug tests, and paternity tests.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qjvUfvWoLEUPk8i4r.label: Collective Work
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qjvUfvWoLEUPk8i4r.definition: Collective Work in copyright law refers to a work consisting of individual contributions assembled into a collective whole, where each contribution retains its individual copyright but the collection as a whole is also protected. This concept is common in anthologies, encyclopedias, and periodicals, where the collective arrangement is subject to copyright, separate from the individual works.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qkNyMp2YJBTV6wKB5.label: Washington Superior Court - Yakima County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qkNyMp2YJBTV6wKB5.definition: Washington Superior Court - Yakima County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Yakima County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qrXXQ5A5fENvEmT0M.definition: ODR - Machine Facilitation refers to the use of technology to assist in resolving disputes through an online platform, within the context of an Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Forum.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qsTGPudSzjxbZQyxD.label: Payroll Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qsTGPudSzjxbZQyxD.definition: A Payroll Tax Payment, also known as Taxes on Payroll and Workforce, refers to the taxes an employer withholds from employees' wages and pays on their behalf, as well as the employer's own contribution to social security and other employee benefits. These payments include income tax withholdings, social security contributions, Medicare taxes, and unemployment insurance taxes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qsus2EDS3QX2jMpmA.label: Future Earning Capacity
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qsus2EDS3QX2jMpmA.definition: The concept of "Future Earning Capacity" refers to the potential income that an individual could have earned in the future, had they not been injured or suffered damages, and is used to calculate economic damages in legal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qtGVrRkHrukFbMI54.label: Additional Insured Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qtGVrRkHrukFbMI54.definition: An Additional Insured Clause is a provision in a contract that extends insurance coverage to a party who is not originally named as an insured under the policy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7quKu2uOiDPbRllssT.label: Motion for Access to Tax Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/R7quKu2uOiDPbRllssT.definition: A Motion for Access to Tax Documents is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case seeking permission to obtain and review tax-related records or documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qwFGG4GQtcyJtzRIz.label: Novation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qwFGG4GQtcyJtzRIz.definition: A novation clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the substitution of a new party for one of the original parties, thereby releasing the original party from their obligations and transferring them to the new party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7qxVfcFITBa22T7miU.label: Cattle
http://lmss.sali.org/R7qxVfcFITBa22T7miU.definition: Cattle are domesticated bovine animals that belong to the species Bos taurus, commonly raised for their meat, milk, and hides, as well as for labor. This group includes both cows (females) and bulls (males), and they play a significant role in agriculture and human economies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r0TvVRRmeI8IQTxKX.label: Bail Bondsman
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r0TvVRRmeI8IQTxKX.definition: A Bail Bondsman is a licensed professional who provides bail money for a fee, typically a percentage of the bail amount, to defendants who cannot afford to make bail themselves. The bondsman ensures the court of the defendant's appearance and may be liable for the full bail amount if the defendant fails to appear for their court date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r2pu2R5lD1vnROf21.label: Leave Law Notice Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r2pu2R5lD1vnROf21.definition: A leave law notice violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing required notice of an employee's rights under applicable leave laws. These laws may include the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the California Family Rights Act (CFRA), or other state and local laws that provide protected leave for certain reasons, such as for the employee's own serious health condition, to care for a seriously ill family member, or for the birth or adoption of a child. The claim typically arises when an employer fails to provide required notice of an employee's leave rights, which can result in the employee not being aware of their rights or not being able to take leave to which they are entitled.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r3Fh9SuTv56MbLm90.label: Petition for Visa for Nurses and Medical Professionals
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r3Fh9SuTv56MbLm90.definition: In the United States, this was a petition for the H-1A visa category, which was previously available for foreign nurses coming to the United States to work in healthcare positions that required the skills of a registered nurse. The H-1A program was discontinued in 1995. The Nursing Relief for Disadvantaged Areas (NRDAA) program was created to replace the H-1A program, and foreign nurses are now typically eligible for H-1B visas if they meet the necessary requirements for specialty occupation positions. It's important to note that the information provided here might not be up-to-date, so it's recommended to check with official U.S. government sources or legal experts for the most current information regarding visa categories for nurses and healthcare professionals

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r4E6CScXkLjln7BLq.label: D.O. (Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r4n9m41DwdLMB8pMQ.label: Cruelty to Animals
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r4n9m41DwdLMB8pMQ.definition: The intentional infliction of harm or suffering on animals, including neglect, abuse, and torture, which is prohibited by law and may result in criminal charges and penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r8FeqnphadygvNP0X.label: Motorcycle
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r8FeqnphadygvNP0X.definition: A motorcycle is a two-wheeled motorized vehicle typically powered by an internal combustion engine. Motorcycles are designed for personal transportation and come in various styles, including sport bikes, cruisers, touring bikes, and off-road motorcycles.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7r9vjnfkpI0wCKJXlx.label: Time and Materials Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7r9vjnfkpI0wCKJXlx.definition: A Time and Materials Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that the client will pay for the actual time and materials used by the contractor to complete the project, rather than a fixed price.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rEmc9PaAz1JI1YpYZ.label: Fee and Employment Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7rEmc9PaAz1JI1YpYZ.definition: Fee and Employment Practice (Bankruptcy) refers to the legal work related to the compensation of professionals and employment issues in the context of bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rGAr4SqkaXUrTvSBK.label: New York Supreme Court - Allegany County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7rGAr4SqkaXUrTvSBK.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Allegany County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Allegany County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rMU6Js4awTWJdyPKT.label: Alford Plea
http://lmss.sali.org/R7rMU6Js4awTWJdyPKT.definition: An Alford plea (aka best-interests plea) is a type of guilty plea in which a defendant maintains their innocence but acknowledges that the prosecution has enough evidence to likely secure a conviction. This plea allows the defendant to accept punishment without admitting guilt.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rOX0OkBHLnTJ0wxo4.label: Tax Disclaimer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7rOX0OkBHLnTJ0wxo4.definition: A Tax Disclaimer Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that disclaims any liability or responsibility for tax-related matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rQPa68hcj34ouzYvp.label: Sickle Cell Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/R7rQPa68hcj34ouzYvp.definition: Sickle Cell Disease is a genetic disorder characterized by the production of abnormally shaped red blood cells that resemble a crescent or sickle. These malformed cells can obstruct blood flow, causing pain, anemia, and a range of complications affecting various organs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rxnxceY2juwT8bYVU.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Marshall County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Marshall County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7rzyUQtbNY0XEee7Z1.definition: Relief from Stay is a legal concept that refers to a court order allowing a creditor to take action against a debtor or their property despite the automatic stay that is put in place when a bankruptcy case is filed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sBKqCcmlK1Dw9HBvK.definition: Operative Dates include various time points that are significant in legal and regulatory contexts. http://lmss.sali.org/R7sF6CuYYcS7vaHaY36.label: Time-Off Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sF6CuYYcS7vaHaY36.definition: Time-off benefits encompass policies or perks that allow employees to take time away from work for various reasons, such as vacation, illness, or personal needs, often with pay.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sHH7RvjZ6aZS7ZExD.label: Individual Person Characteristics
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sHH7RvjZ6aZS7ZExD.definition: Individual person characteristics refer to the distinct attributes or qualities that define a person's identity and differentiate them from others. These characteristics can include things like age, gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, and disability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sKCtSzamzXRER0AW4.definition: A Matter Percentage Shared Fee is a type of Engagement Fee Detail in which the legal fees are shared between the client and the law firm based on a percentage of the total amount recovered or saved in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sMdOVdcVJ90TomMNz.label: Land Contract Foreclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sMdOVdcVJ90TomMNz.definition: Land Contract Foreclosure is the legal process initiated by a seller to reclaim property when a buyer defaults on payments under a land contract, also known as an "installment sale agreement." Unlike mortgage foreclosures, the process and rights of the parties involved may differ significantly, depending on state laws and the terms of the land contract itself. In states that recognize land contracts as a form of property ownership, failure to meet the terms of the land contract can result in foreclosure.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sTV7GNyTqSpNK3YNx.label: Engineering Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sTV7GNyTqSpNK3YNx.definition: An expert in an area of engineering (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, civil engineering).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sWbMNP8rs38BvNKNT.label: Temporary Maintenance
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sWbMNP8rs38BvNKNT.definition: Temporary Maintenance: A type of financial support requested by a party in a matrimonial emergency application, which provides for the payment of expenses and support during the pendency of the legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7satC832hl6f73qj2q.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Stoddard County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7satC832hl6f73qj2q.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court - Stoddard County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Stoddard County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sb56xli7a6ZSmGoBP.label: Potatoes
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sb56xli7a6ZSmGoBP.definition: Potatoes are starchy tubers derived from the Solanum tuberosum plant, widely cultivated for their edible underground stems. http://lmss.sali.org/R7siEJR3U6RQHWmWuSk.label: General Indemnity Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7siEJR3U6RQHWmWuSk.definition: A General Indemnity Clause is a provision in a contract where one party agrees to protect and compensate the other party for any losses, damages, or liabilities that may arise from the contract, regardless of fault or cause.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7smhlh2jRwfrXXBMcH.label: Fraud by Nondisclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/R7smhlh2jRwfrXXBMcH.definition: The concept of Fraud by Nondisclosure refers to a type of fraud claim where one party intentionally fails to disclose important information to another party, which causes harm or damages to the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7so1V1R3bpN7TsaSN1.label: Breach of Employment Contract with No Specified Term
http://lmss.sali.org/R7so1V1R3bpN7TsaSN1.definition: The Breach of Employment Contract with No Specified Term refers to a violation of an employment agreement that does not have a specific end date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7sr57cVoc1vLsO7jeI.label: Clerk's Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7sr57cVoc1vLsO7jeI.definition: A Clerk's Notice is a written communication issued by a court clerk, informing parties of a court action or decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7srq5nkC3xCo34ztMF.label: Intellectual Property Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7srq5nkC3xCo34ztMF.definition: A provision in a contract that outlines the ownership and rights of intangible creations, such as inventions, literary and artistic works, and symbols.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ssf9135kwzOV2U0zn.label: Animal Attack Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ssf9135kwzOV2U0zn.definition: A claim for damages resulting from an animal's attack on a person, which falls under the broader categories of animal claims and personal injury claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7stFpIsNEKo2eVK5MS.label: Program Design and Delivery Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R7stFpIsNEKo2eVK5MS.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's design and delivery of specific programs, which may impact the organization's overall objectives — including the potential for negative outcomes arising from the inadequate planning, development, or execution of an organization's projects or initiatives. This can result from poor project management, ineffective stakeholder engagement, unrealistic expectations, or insufficient resources, potentially leading to delays, cost overruns, unmet objectives, or reputational damage, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and success

http://lmss.sali.org/R7stuyBOVoKONmbxJyf.label: Komi
http://lmss.sali.org/R7stuyBOVoKONmbxJyf.definition: A language spoken by the Komi people, primarily in the Komi Republic of Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7szt8biY3dbRGBbwUF.definition: Work performed related to applications for an injunction or committal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7t2Hg7cfHArl1MVLOo.definition: Timber rights provide the holder with the authority to harvest trees from a designated area of land. These rights can be sold or leased independently of the land itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7t6kRXe15nhWQpnC4T.label: Municipal Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7t6kRXe15nhWQpnC4T.definition: Municipal Law refers to the body of law that governs the administration of local government and the relationship between municipalities and their residents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7t97ENeV9nJZyZ9GLd.definition: A Motion to Remove Debtor as Debtor in Possession is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to remove the current debtor from their role as the debtor in possession, typically due to a conflict of interest or other issue that may hinder the administration of the bankruptcy estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tEWk8Yy2BKBJgug5Y.definition: Florida County Court - Hamilton County refers to the specific court located in Hamilton County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within that county.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tFU0P1atJqNKz2BW7.definition: An industry classification for matters where the primary client is a natural person rather than an incorporated entity, partnership, or other formal business structure. Used for personal legal matters including estate planning, high-net-worth advisory, family law, and work involving influencers, athletes, or other individuals whose economic activity does not fit a single corporate sector code.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tKtki2tvT0I1cpSLJ.label: Legal Services Provider - Person
http://lmss.sali.org/R7tKtki2tvT0I1cpSLJ.definition: A Legal Services Provider - Person is an individual who provides legal services and is associated with specific invoice data, including their provider level, timekeeper ID, first name, and last name.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tNBM5FHn1YRrRfL0b.definition: A Licensed Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that grants permission to use or distribute a specific product or service, subject to certain conditions and limitations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tihKK0L440nkLIrRc.definition: Provider Level refers to the classification of a person who provides legal services, which can be further categorized as either a timekeeper or non-timekeeper level.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tmFaJ5bsx906wMXGp.definition: A provision in a contract that grants a non-possessory interest in another's land, allowing the holder to use the land for a specific purpose.
