http://lmss.sali.org/R7tntD0FNWW6fwrlsFi.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Erie County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7trXnufWqSoZJnuOxD.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Sevier Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R7trXnufWqSoZJnuOxD.definition: A court located in Sevier County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7twvfq1X5Lw4BMHuKg.label: Brief Analysis Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7twvfq1X5Lw4BMHuKg.definition: Brief Analysis Management is the process of organizing and managing legal research and litigation information in a concise and efficient manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7txERXQ85pCIryX6tF.label: Broadcasting Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7txERXQ85pCIryX6tF.definition: Broadcasting Law governs the transmission of television and radio programs, including the regulation of content, licensing, and the management of broadcasting rights. It ensures that broadcasters comply with standards for public interest, decency, and fairness.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7tyTDBG6hxQCa8xDkW.label: Insects
http://lmss.sali.org/R7tyTDBG6hxQCa8xDkW.definition: Insects are a class of invertebrate animals within the phylum Arthropoda, characterized by a three-part body (head, thorax, and abdomen), three pairs of jointed legs, compound eyes, and one pair of antennae. Insects are the most diverse group of animals on Earth, inhabiting nearly all environments and playing crucial roles in ecosystems as pollinators, decomposers, and prey for other animals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7u0JelUtJfjM4BJThq.label: Waiver of Right to Sue Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7u0JelUtJfjM4BJThq.definition: A Waiver of Right to Sue Clause is a provision in a legal agreement where one party agrees to give up their right to bring a lawsuit against the other party in the event of a dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7u1GstOpfAmZ3mI7yF.label: Criminal Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7u1GstOpfAmZ3mI7yF.definition: Criminal Claims refer to legal claims made in a court of law against an individual or entity for committing a crime, including offenses against people, property, the government, and the public.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7u2oTEkyPQN6Ut84t3.label: Non-Contributory Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7u2oTEkyPQN6Ut84t3.definition: A type of social security benefit funded by general tax revenues rather than individual contributions, typically provided to eligible individuals based on criteria such as age, disability, or income level. Non-contributory benefits aim to provide a basic level of social protection and poverty alleviation for those who may not have contributed sufficiently to qualify for contributory benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uBjRUZtTAofQCFoWv.label: Good Faith Negotiation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uBjRUZtTAofQCFoWv.definition: A Good Faith Negotiation Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to negotiate in good faith when attempting to resolve disputes or reach an agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uFVN5bBTvnyBwRjMB.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Mississippi County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uFVN5bBTvnyBwRjMB.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Mississippi County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Mississippi County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uJtne5WmOaSqeSiGe.label: Defined Terms Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uJtne5WmOaSqeSiGe.definition: Defined Terms Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining a collection of specific terms and their definitions within legal documents, distinct from general document management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uVC81MaZEePkYh4Lf.label: Religious Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uVC81MaZEePkYh4Lf.definition: Discrimination based on a person's religion or religious beliefs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ubIXv0FiVjd2mOqmj.label: Georgia District Court - Tattnall County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ubIXv0FiVjd2mOqmj.definition: A court located in Tattnall County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ueaoXfaJI7dcYi5MF.label: Financial Elder Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ueaoXfaJI7dcYi5MF.definition: The unlawful or unethical exploitation of an elderly person's financial resources, assets, or property by a perpetrator who has a relationship of trust or authority with the victim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ug7DRQMLVAGgzfc2p.label: NATO-1 Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ug7DRQMLVAGgzfc2p.definition: A International Military Personnel Visa (aka NATO-1 visa) is issued to members of the armed forces of NATO countries stationed in the U.S. for official duties and their immediate family members. This visa category is for individuals who are part of the NATO alliance and are deployed under the provisions of the NATO agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uigsz85fFCSPszS6B.label: Appellant
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uigsz85fFCSPszS6B.definition: An appellant is a person, company or entity that applies to a higher court for a reversal of the decision of a lower court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ulfMGe8SDZj4tMiar.label: Internal Use Only Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ulfMGe8SDZj4tMiar.definition: An Internal Use Only Clause is a provision in a contract that restricts the use of certain information or materials to only those within the organization or entity that is a party to the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7umcxBP0kYYmHad2pz.label: Minnesota District Court - Wilkin County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7umcxBP0kYYmHad2pz.definition: Minnesota District Court - Wilkin County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wilkin County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uq2Mq8qLUybQoDhVc.label: Indiana Superior Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uq2Mq8qLUybQoDhVc.definition: The Indiana Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uyIxTLHDGeNG0m3ZW.label: Domain Name Registration Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uyIxTLHDGeNG0m3ZW.definition: The domain name registration process is a series of steps that an individual or entity must follow to acquire a unique internet domain name. This process typically involves choosing a domain name, checking its availability, and registering it with a domain name registrar.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7uzfpLbCGc2taU7nsJ.label: ALL American Arbitration Association Rules
http://lmss.sali.org/R7uzfpLbCGc2taU7nsJ.definition: Procedural rules governing arbitrations in the American Arbitration Association.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7v3ruFwyUrl1FqZJ0S.label: Motion to Release Funds
http://lmss.sali.org/R7v3ruFwyUrl1FqZJ0S.definition: A Motion to Release Funds is a request made in a bankruptcy case to allow the debtor to access certain funds that are currently being held by the court or a trustee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7v4SYVp1aOWK3RAXWm.label: Consumer Credit Billing Error
http://lmss.sali.org/R7v4SYVp1aOWK3RAXWm.definition: A consumer credit billing error is a mistake made by a creditor in the billing statement of a consumer, which can include incorrect charges, interest rates, or fees, and can be the basis for a legal claim under consumer credit and contract laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7v7VCPabxKizFrNUCd.label: Application to Waive Requirement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7v7VCPabxKizFrNUCd.definition: An Application to Waive Requirement is a request made in a bankruptcy proceeding to be excused from fulfilling a particular obligation or condition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vBjMmDitSBmBKZvNu.label: Bankruptcy Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vBjMmDitSBmBKZvNu.definition: Bankruptcy Claims refer to the legal claims made by creditors against a debtor who has filed for bankruptcy, seeking to recover the debts owed to them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vCIdFgeJCiGZmKDY8.label: Change of Immigration Status
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vCIdFgeJCiGZmKDY8.definition: "Change of Immigration Status" (COS) refers to the process of applying to alter an individual's existing immigration category or status while already within the destination country, typically requiring submission of relevant documents and approval from immigration authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vIk4lggL45eU2kthy.label: Ordinary Mandate
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vIk4lggL45eU2kthy.definition: An Ordinary Mandate is a type of writ of mandamus that is issued by a court to compel a public official or entity to perform a duty that is required by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vJPxcT40MjEfNZkBK.label: Litigation Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vJPxcT40MjEfNZkBK.definition: Legal argument or theory seeking to defeat a legal action, based on either legal or factual grounds.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vPOgqlI0pfXdkb8pH.label: Taxing Jurisdiction Locality
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vPOgqlI0pfXdkb8pH.definition: A Taxing Jurisdiction Locality is a specific geographic area that has the authority to impose and collect taxes, and is a subcategory of Tax Detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vRDuKcPhDlQTNz9zW.label: Emolument Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vRDuKcPhDlQTNz9zW.definition: An Emolument Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a government official, typically the President, has violated the Emoluments Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the official has received improper financial benefits, such as gifts, payments, or other advantages, from foreign governments or entities, which is prohibited by the Emoluments Clause to prevent conflicts of interest and foreign influence on public officials.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vY8WK0oISJWX8cd6F.label: Superior Offer - Minimum Necessary Amount of Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vY8WK0oISJWX8cd6F.definition: A "Superior Offer - Minimum Necessary Amount of Assets" is a specific threshold within the broader concept of "Superior Offer" that requires a minimum amount of assets to be included in an offer in order for it to be considered superior to other offers in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vePHCMm1h6C4X9QLx.label: New York Supreme Court - Oswego County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vePHCMm1h6C4X9QLx.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Oswego County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York, with authority over civil and criminal cases within Oswego County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7vfM0J4fZ9NCcg884u.label: M&A A Preliminary Matters Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7vfM0J4fZ9NCcg884u.definition: M&A A Preliminary Matters Practice refers to the legal work involved in the initial stages of a merger or acquisition, such as conducting due diligence and negotiating preliminary agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7w2oSbX8iq73SPYWpp.label: tax_total_detail_fees
http://lmss.sali.org/R7w2oSbX8iq73SPYWpp.definition:
"Total taxable amount of fees attributable to this tx_id, including amounts associated with MATTER_DISC_CRED where disc_cred_category = ""Fee"".  

Using the Math Statement on the next tab:  
   The total for pre-split fee items for this tx_id
+ The total for post-split fee items for this tx_id  
   tax_total_detail_fees  

If tx_id is a Tiered Tax, the value in this field should be 0.

Certain taxes are calculated not only on line items, but also include another tax for these line items -- a ""tax on tax"" situation.  For example, in Canada both Quebec and Prince Edward Island have specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items.  In situations like this, the tax_total_detail_fees figure should include the other tax attributable to the line items so that the math statement for total_tax_on_fees is correct. 
 "

http://lmss.sali.org/R7w4ReqKUSBV9uWNFkH.label: Minnesota District Court - Winona County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7w4ReqKUSBV9uWNFkH.definition: A court located in Winona County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7w57uhHy8mqTtVXNfU.label: Enterprise Legal Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R7w57uhHy8mqTtVXNfU.definition: Enterprise Legal Management refers to the process of managing legal operations within a business or organization, including tasks such as legal project management, budgeting, and vendor management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wAI24LOsaWoWC4JFz.label: Meals Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wAI24LOsaWoWC4JFz.definition: Meals Expense refers to the cost incurred for food and beverages consumed during a business trip or entertainment event, which is considered as a type of expense in financial accounting and tax law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wFa2OWTbJrSusNQEt.label: Hearsay Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wFa2OWTbJrSusNQEt.definition: A Hearsay Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a statement being offered as evidence was made outside of the current trial or hearing and is being used to prove the truth of the matter asserted. This objection aims to exclude secondhand information that has not been subjected to cross-examination and may not be reliable.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wJH5ybR7TZzVpLpsd.label: First-Degree Murder
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wJH5ybR7TZzVpLpsd.definition: The intentional killing of another person with malice aforethought, which is planned and premeditated, and is considered the most serious form of murder.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wLLoc6H1zcuVpchb4.label: Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wLLoc6H1zcuVpchb4.definition: Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms are written or electronic documents submitted to a higher court for review, including letters, requests, certificates, statements, and updates related to a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wMOe9r9YCfk6SBb5n.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lane County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wMOe9r9YCfk6SBb5n.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lane County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lane County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wN0DsBuwkWYRu5Mev.label: Georgia Superior Court - Morgan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wN0DsBuwkWYRu5Mev.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Morgan County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Morgan County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wOwXNJVXg4zhX7JkH.label: Non-Household Motor Vehicle Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wOwXNJVXg4zhX7JkH.definition: Non-Household Motor Vehicle Tax Payment refers to user taxes levied on motor vehicles owned by entities other than households, such as businesses, organizations, and government agencies. These taxes are typically paid at regular intervals and may include vehicle registration fees, road use taxes, and other related charges required for the legal operation of motor vehicles by non-household entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wQ6uN1h4BP4YPC7h9.label: Loss of Consortium
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wQ6uN1h4BP4YPC7h9.definition: The concept of Loss of Consortium refers to the damages suffered by a spouse or parent due to the injury or death of their loved one, which includes the loss of companionship, affection, and support.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wZePVWBKLVfAUwDtb.label: Agent Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wZePVWBKLVfAUwDtb.definition: Agent Liability refers to the legal responsibility of an individual or entity acting as an agent for another party, for any harm caused to a third party due to their negligence or breach of fiduciary duty.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wdbxCDCSve7_7MwOZ.label: L611 Preservation order
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wdbxCDCSve7_7MwOZ.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that data is preserved in accordance with requirements and assist with any efforts to seek relief from preservation order that may be issued by the court. Includes notice letters to other parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7weWtBHO2jaJ1TqfeS.label: Oats
http://lmss.sali.org/R7weWtBHO2jaJ1TqfeS.definition: Oats are a cereal crop belonging to the species Avena sativa, known for their edible seeds that are highly nutritious and commonly used in food products such as oatmeal, granola, and oat milk. They are valued for their high fiber content, particularly beta-glucan, and are grown primarily in temperate regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wiZFY7X1mvwdTAODD.label: Split Dollar Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wiZFY7X1mvwdTAODD.definition: A Split Dollar Agreement is a contract that details how the premiums, death benefits, and cash values of a life insurance policy are split between two parties. Typically, one party owns the policy, while the other has a vested interest in the death benefit or cash value.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7widavYhXmyfw9WvR9.label: Divorce Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R7widavYhXmyfw9WvR9.definition: Divorce Claims refer to legal actions taken by a party to end a marriage and obtain a legal dissolution of the marital relationship, including issues related to property division, spousal support, and child custody.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wjSxFeGSnGHBA4sop.label: Jail
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wjSxFeGSnGHBA4sop.definition: A Jail is a local government-run facility designed to detain individuals who are awaiting trial, sentencing, or serving short-term sentences typically for minor offenses. It serves as a temporary holding place for pretrial detainees and inmates convicted of misdemeanors, emphasizing security, custody, and limited rehabilitation services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wpO1Qu9qmPRI8VFoL.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Clearfield County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wpO1Qu9qmPRI8VFoL.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clearfield County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Clearfield County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wrI57WaogjWdkpoza.label: Oral Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wrI57WaogjWdkpoza.definition: An Oral Agreement is a contract or agreement that is spoken and not written, where the parties express their mutual intentions and promises through verbal communication. While enforceable in many legal contexts, proving the terms and existence of an oral agreement can be more challenging than a written one.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wsLtBraH6Dx1GyHgB.label: Tender Offer
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wsLtBraH6Dx1GyHgB.definition: A tender offer is a type of M&A deal structure where the acquiring company offers to purchase a significant portion or all of the target company's shares at a premium price, usually with the goal of gaining control of the target company.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ww9HussHVxgA1tC5l.label: Assiniboine and Sioux Tribes of The Fort Peck Indian Reservation, Montana

http://lmss.sali.org/R7wwWiluROeltnO9D3E.label: Waiver of Exemptions
http://lmss.sali.org/R7wwWiluROeltnO9D3E.definition: A waiver of exemptions is a legal document that relinquishes a debtor's right to claim certain property as exempt from seizure or sale in bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7x6L4xcx0rH3s3ZaK3.label: Mutual Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/R7x6L4xcx0rH3s3ZaK3.definition: A mutual waiver is an agreement between two or more parties where each party voluntarily relinquishes specific rights or claims, often as part of a broader contractual arrangement. It typically aims to resolve disputes or avoid future legal liabilities between the parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7x6g9iAXmUiJlXphvL.label: Additur
http://lmss.sali.org/R7x6g9iAXmUiJlXphvL.definition: Additur refers to a court's power to increase the amount of damages awarded by a jury if the judge finds the award insufficient. This practice is primarily used in the United States and is not recognized in federal courts due to constitutional concerns regarding the Seventh Amendment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7x9oK0YduqWR8uViL5.label: Chippewa Cree Indians of the Rocky Boy’s Reservation, Montana

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xBgB4PfVczsw05VoU.label: Efforts Standards
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xBgB4PfVczsw05VoU.definition: Efforts Standards are a set of obligations that require a party to use a certain level of effort or diligence in fulfilling their obligations under a contract, with variations including Flat Covenant, Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard, and Reasonable Best Efforts Standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xH8j1ovKq0dTkDyI1.label: Coyote Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xJvteC0OEnUuVAvst.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Johnson County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xJvteC0OEnUuVAvst.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Johnson County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Johnson County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xMz5cMTEkH1HxCy93.label: Intentional Spoliation of Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xMz5cMTEkH1HxCy93.definition: The intentional destruction or alteration of evidence by a party in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xOnSD7ckOYgvhgmXr.label: Minnesota District Court - Stearns County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xOnSD7ckOYgvhgmXr.definition: A Minnesota District Court located in Stearns County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Minnesota, handling civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xXHdEoLx3SWagIQRt.label: First Day Declaration
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xXHdEoLx3SWagIQRt.definition: A First Day Declaration in bankruptcy is a legal document filed by a debtor that provides information about the debtor's financial situation and the reasons for filing for bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xXtNuWfHbvZCMmCvK.label: Legal Services Related Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xXtNuWfHbvZCMmCvK.definition: Legal Services Related Attributes refer to the characteristics and classifications of tasks performed by a legal service provider that determine whether the activities are billable or non-billable to the client. These attributes help identify the financial impact and efficiency of the services provided, influencing billing practices and revenue generation for the firm.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xYDTzzTo7YiXeLN7z.label: Privacy Principles
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xYDTzzTo7YiXeLN7z.definition: These privacy principles, developed by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), provide the most commonly used privacy framework, they are reflected in existing and emerging privacy and data protection laws, and serve as the basis for the creation of leading practice privacy programs and additional principles. These principles are part of the OECD Guidelines on the Protection of Privacy and Transborder Flows of Personal Data, which was developed in the late 1970s and adopted in 1980.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xetKG7UJNRSImGDq3.label: Accumulation Fund
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xetKG7UJNRSImGDq3.definition: An Accumulation Fund is an investment fund that typically reinvests its investment profits back into the fund, rather than distributing them to shareholders. This reinvestment strategy aims to enhance the fund's value over time, providing potential for capital growth.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xiZlU9FV7hpv5tDKr.label: Export Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xiZlU9FV7hpv5tDKr.definition: An Export Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Export Clause of the United States Constitution, which prohibits states from imposing excessive burdens or discriminatory measures on interstate or international trade and commerce, thereby interfering with the free flow of goods and services across borders

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xjtdjCK8LoDNrx5Ew.label: Data Security Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xjtdjCK8LoDNrx5Ew.definition: A Data Security Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the measures and responsibilities for protecting sensitive information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xjyYlLUGcj13HDSJF.label: ADR Mini-Trial Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xjyYlLUGcj13HDSJF.definition: An ADR Mini-Trial Forum is a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum where parties present their case to a panel of experts who then provide a non-binding evaluation of the dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xkC6Bs7ZPn190uzRk.label: Turnover of property by a custodian
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xkC6Bs7ZPn190uzRk.definition: The turnover of property by a custodian refers to the legal action taken to recover assets that were wrongfully transferred or held by a custodian, as part of an avoidance action claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xla5mpMCkDl1t6YAR.label: Information Technology Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xla5mpMCkDl1t6YAR.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's capacity and sustainability of information technology, both the infrastructure and utilization of technological applications — including the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's reliance on technology systems, infrastructure, and processes. This can result from technology failures, cyber attacks, data breaches, or inadequate IT management practices, potentially leading to operational disruptions, financial losses, reputational damage, or legal liabilities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and competitiveness.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xmPX9pj9KdiRWgSiw.label: Effective Tangible Net Worth Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xmPX9pj9KdiRWgSiw.definition: An Effective Tangible Net Worth Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to maintain a certain level of tangible assets in relation to their liabilities, in order to ensure their financial stability and ability to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xpf80TbUte15aQuYy.label: Poultry
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xpf80TbUte15aQuYy.definition: Poultry refers to domesticated birds raised primarily for their meat, eggs, and feathers. This category includes chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese, and these birds are integral to agriculture, providing a significant source of protein and other products for human consumption.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xqVevh0JKSwX977TR.label: Loan
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xqVevh0JKSwX977TR.definition: A transaction whereby property is lent or given to another on condition of return or, where the loan is of money, repayment. In a loan of money, the money lent becomes the property of the borrower during the period of the loan against an undertaking to return a sum of an equivalent amount either on demand or on a specified date or in accordance with an agreed schedule of repayments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xqzcm2A0qK3UaLVIg.label: Passport Issuing Country
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xqzcm2A0qK3UaLVIg.definition: Passport Issuing Country refers to the nation that issued an individual's passport. This information is a key element of the passport and is used to establish the individual's nationality and citizenship. It is important for identification, travel, and various legal and administrative purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xrNuVBQ2B3sD1Pzbw.label: Written Asynchronous Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xrNuVBQ2B3sD1Pzbw.definition: A communication that occurs in writing and does not require that the users be synchronous (communicating at the same time).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7xvhTRvZsOK7xYmQh6.label: Timing of Acquisition Proposal Closing
http://lmss.sali.org/R7xvhTRvZsOK7xYmQh6.definition: The Timing of Acquisition Proposal Closing refers to the specific period during which a proposal for acquisition must be closed, as determined by the Tail Period Fee Triggers, and includes the conditions of being signed, closed, not opposed, or approved during that period.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7y4MfRVjPqdQsxJpyG.label: Fee Simple Absolute
http://lmss.sali.org/R7y4MfRVjPqdQsxJpyG.definition: Fee Simple Absolute is the highest form of ownership interest one can acquire in real estate, granting the holder complete and unrestricted rights to the property. This ownership is inheritable and free of any conditions or limitations beyond standard government-imposed restrictions like zoning and taxes

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yFvjE3c7XNyrKkiFP.label: Negligence of Notary Public & Sureties
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yFvjE3c7XNyrKkiFP.definition: The failure of a notary public and their guarantors to exercise reasonable care and diligence in performing their duties, resulting in harm or loss to a party involved in a real estate transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yGKmHfKLvmiQ41Hwp.label: Delaware Industrial Accident Board
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yGKmHfKLvmiQ41Hwp.definition: The Delaware Industrial Accident Board is a specialized court within the Delaware State Courts system that handles cases related to workplace injuries and accidents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yIjNsOTcwKyqxQ7el.label: DEPRECATED: Litigation Engagement Scope
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yIjNsOTcwKyqxQ7el.definition: DEPRECATED: Litigation Engagement Scope refers to the scope of work and services provided by a law firm to a client in a litigation matter, including the tasks and responsibilities of the law firm and the expected outcomes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yKB3SkQ5bQZsUOV5R.label: Stolen Property Offenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yKB3SkQ5bQZsUOV5R.definition: Receiving, buying, selling, possessing, concealing, or transporting any property with the knowledge that it has been unlawfully taken, as by Burglary, Embezzlement, Fraud, Larceny, Robbery, etc.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yQYf6cDb3K2dwaEPo.label: Tlingit
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yQYf6cDb3K2dwaEPo.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Tlingit people of Alaska and Canada, characterized by its complex grammar and extensive use of consonant clusters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yQfCOV7FKR5X31pCj.label: Simple Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yQfCOV7FKR5X31pCj.definition: Defendant is not required to tell the plaintiff of dangers of a simple procedure where it is commonly understood the dangers are not likely to occur.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ySw3Q2ZOiM5J4f8o0.label: Service Sales Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ySw3Q2ZOiM5J4f8o0.definition: Services sales practice is the area of law focused on the legal aspects and agreements related to the sale and provision of services, rather than assets. This practice encompasses contract formation, regulatory compliance, liability issues, and the protection of intellectual property related to service transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yULiuUW6FwlVvfIPt.label: Receivership Creation
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yULiuUW6FwlVvfIPt.definition: Receivership creation refers to the judicial appointment of a receiver to take control of and manage a company's assets during financial distress or litigation. This process aims to protect and preserve the assets while a resolution is sought, often leading to restructuring, liquidation, or sale.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yYrJ0JY2Mn3NH89SK.label: Assamese
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yYrJ0JY2Mn3NH89SK.definition: Assamese (Language) refers to a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Assam region of India.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yZIgA7OiFZCN0zGIs.label: Probate Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yZIgA7OiFZCN0zGIs.definition: A Probate Court is a specialized court that deals with the administration of estates and the distribution of assets after a person's death.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ycfANA4jCRs6bemGx.label: Court-Approved Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ycfANA4jCRs6bemGx.definition: Used where the fees of the participant (e.g., Bankruptcy Trustee, Special Master) must be approved by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ycrZHHD5JqaYqf3qO.label: Monitoring
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ycrZHHD5JqaYqf3qO.definition: The process of monitoring developments in the law, including judicial decisions, agency opinions, and statutory and regulatory enactments usually for the purpose of establishing up-to-date policies and protocols.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ydNRwk7rseIE6ater.label: Notice of Assignment
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ydNRwk7rseIE6ater.definition: A Notice of Assignment is a written notification that informs a debtor that their debt has been assigned to a third party for collection or other purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ydR1WLhJGDq03xhmd.label: New York City Court - Hudson
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ydR1WLhJGDq03xhmd.definition: New York City Court - Hudson is a specific court located in New York City that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yiK6hR6BkuiTgbsV5.label: Governing Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yiK6hR6BkuiTgbsV5.definition: The law that applies to a given legal matter, which may differ from the location of (1) the client and (2) the legal work being performed. This may be contractual (e.g., "governing law is Delaware") or it may be a function of law (e.g., "negligence claim is governed by Arkansas law").

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yjLHdBoidKvZitbOx.label: European Council
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yjLHdBoidKvZitbOx.definition: The European Council is a key institution of the European Union that comprises the heads of state or government of the member states, the President of the European Council, and the President of the European Commission. It plays a crucial role in setting the EU's overall political direction and priorities, but does not have legislative power.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7ykjjcQy2ZtgjEYF8B.label: Appellate Final Form Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/R7ykjjcQy2ZtgjEYF8B.definition: A written legal argument submitted to an appellate court as a final attempt to persuade the court to rule in favor of the submitting party, following the submission of previous briefs and oral arguments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yrQjhxTeSoEQWSBUh.label: Workplace Violence
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yrQjhxTeSoEQWSBUh.definition: Workplace Violence: Any physical or verbal abuse, harassment, intimidation, or threatening behavior that occurs in a work setting, which may result in harm or injury to employees or damage to property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yue2mtjzJWKBkXpq5.label: Negligently Providing Alcohol
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yue2mtjzJWKBkXpq5.definition: The concept of Negligently Providing Alcohol refers to the legal claim that holds a person responsible for providing alcohol to someone who is not legally allowed to consume it or who is already intoxicated, resulting in harm or injury to that person or others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yx6mEAF1KVUrcYbb6.label: National Business Identification Number
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yx6mEAF1KVUrcYbb6.definition: National Business Identifiers are a unique identification numbers that governments assign to a business entity for regulatory, tax, and reporting purposes. In the United States, this is commonly known as the Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN), which is used to identify businesses for government purposes (e.g., tax, immigration).

http://lmss.sali.org/R7yyIAUvkgjyuhLF0sp.label: Formation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R7yyIAUvkgjyuhLF0sp.definition: A Formation Agreement is a type of legal agreement that outlines the terms and conditions of a business arrangement between parties, specifically related to the creation or formation of a new entity or venture.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7z0ey8ZMeOT1q01VNP.label: Geographic Market Segments
http://lmss.sali.org/R7z0ey8ZMeOT1q01VNP.definition: Geographic market attributes refer to the characteristics of a market that are defined by the geographical scope and location of consumers and businesses. These attributes can include the national, international, and local reach of a market, and they play a crucial role in shaping marketing strategies and product offerings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7z0wkcHx9WmE4Embu9.label: Xhosa
http://lmss.sali.org/R7z0wkcHx9WmE4Embu9.definition: A Bantu language spoken in South Africa, characterized by its use of click consonants.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7z8IPBHMwVOHP53OFY.label: Urinary and Reproductive System Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/R7z8IPBHMwVOHP53OFY.definition: Genitourinary disorders encompass a range of conditions affecting the organs of the reproductive and urinary systems, including the kidneys, bladder, ureters, urethra, and reproductive organs. These disorders can be congenital or acquired and may involve functional impairment, structural abnormalities, or systemic diseases impacting the genitourinary system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7z9q6EKXwifsayj0YR.label: Motions Regarding Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/R7z9q6EKXwifsayj0YR.definition: A Motion Regarding Counsel is a formal request made to an appellate court by a party in a legal case to change or remove their legal representation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zCjs76iK43kBLxTXU.label: International Organization Meeting Visa For Non-Member Governments
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zCjs76iK43kBLxTXU.definition: A International Organization Meeting Visa For Non-Member Governments (in the U.S., a G-3 visa) is issued to representatives of non-recognized or non-member foreign governments traveling to the U.S. to attend meetings of designated international organizations. This visa category also includes their immediate family members.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zFDSz9BjpVwMtwSqs.label: Contingent Convertible Share
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zFDSz9BjpVwMtwSqs.definition: A Contingent Convertible Share, often referred to as a CoCo bond, is a type of debt security that automatically converts into equity when a predefined trigger event occurs, typically related to the issuer's financial health or regulatory capital thresholds. These instruments are designed to provide additional capital to the issuer during periods of financial stress, thereby enhancing financial stability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zHyrVy8Z3m15uOpjf.label: Naturalization Application
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zHyrVy8Z3m15uOpjf.definition: The Naturalization Application is a legal claim related to immigration that seeks to obtain citizenship for a non-citizen by fulfilling the requirements set forth by the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zJmYJGxGh6BPGA8rW.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Scott County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zJmYJGxGh6BPGA8rW.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Scott County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Scott County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zOJlSftSahbSm5hUy.label: Right of Antichresis
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zOJlSftSahbSm5hUy.definition: The Right of Antichresis in civil law refers to a security arrangement where a debtor provides a creditor with the right to the fruits or income generated by a real property, usually land or a building, as a means to service or secure a debt. This right allows the creditor to apply the income generated from the property toward repayment of the debt, without transferring ownership of the property itself

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zRqqs2v5nPBMMJDVv.label: Waste
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zRqqs2v5nPBMMJDVv.definition: Waste refers to the destruction, damage, or misuse of property by a person who is not the owner, resulting in harm or loss to the owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zSyMmXCYynrBPGDUs.label: Nonconsolidation Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zSyMmXCYynrBPGDUs.definition: An opinion letter stating that a property will not be subject to “substantive consolidation” in situations where a restructuring or liquidation may involve the property’s owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zVAb2kzP6ZyfHRn7W.label: Forward-looking MAE Application - "Adverse impact on target's business" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zVAb2kzP6ZyfHRn7W.definition: A Forward-looking MAE Application - "Adverse impact on target's business" Language is a specific application of the Forward-looking Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Standard that focuses on the potential negative effects on the target company's business in the future.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zWBvIqiJSsycwsIWy.label: Transgender
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zWBvIqiJSsycwsIWy.definition: Transgender: A person whose gender identity differs from the sex they were assigned at birth.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zWrP7kURfXqUyMuSf.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Ford County (11th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zYtQfJ3ala72EZ2qD.label: Cross Indemnity Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zYtQfJ3ala72EZ2qD.definition: A Cross Indemnity Clause is a provision in a contract where each party agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the other party from any claims or damages arising from the other party's actions or omissions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zaqkwrDcRNxtd2fq8.label: Social Host Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zaqkwrDcRNxtd2fq8.definition: The legal concept of Social Host Liability refers to the responsibility of a person who provides alcohol to others, particularly minors, and can be held liable for any harm or damages caused by the intoxicated individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zdaw1kj13alQxc4P9.label: JE10 Issue and Serve Proceedings and Preparation of Statement of Case (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zdaw1kj13alQxc4P9.definition: Work related to effecting service, including dealing with process servers or the foreign process office. Work in preparation of claims, petitions and any other originating process, Statements of Case, Part 20 proceedings, including reviewing those of other parties whether or not a responsive document is served. Includes all work with counsel thereon and all dealings with client and others in connection therewith.  In appeals includes Appellants’ and Respondents’ Notices and supporting skeleton arguments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zeIIm4x0pd88nhZz9.label: M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts)
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zeIIm4x0pd88nhZz9.definition: An M.F.A. (Master of Fine Arts) is an advanced degree typically earned in creative or performing arts disciplines, such as visual arts, writing, or theater. It signifies a high level of proficiency and specialization in artistic endeavors

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zeIvDfPCP2MF0Dv7I.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Mora County
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zeIvDfPCP2MF0Dv7I.definition: A court located in Mora County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zm5gZHD2sMJlUNd5m.label: Legal Assistance Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zm5gZHD2sMJlUNd5m.definition: A legal assistance document refers to informational materials designed to guide individuals through legal processes, often without the need for direct representation by a lawyer. Examples include legal self-help guides, online court legal information portals, and standardized forms that provide step-by-step instructions for common legal procedures.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zmzVgoKNctwopFd7Q.label: Household Size
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zmzVgoKNctwopFd7Q.definition: Household size refers to the number of individuals who reside together as a single economic unit. This number is relevant for determining eligibility for certain benefits, exemptions, or deductions, and it impacts calculations related to taxes, bankruptcy means tests, and other legal considerations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zqQn3T6kJzQIHOII6.label: Affirmative Action Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zqQn3T6kJzQIHOII6.definition: An affirmative action claim is a legal assertion or case related to the enforcement of policies that promote opportunities for historically excluded groups in employment, education, and other areas, often involving allegations of discrimination or non-compliance with governmental regulations on diversity and equal opportunity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zuVvp0uvtcuv3nWWC.label: Motion to Redact
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zuVvp0uvtcuv3nWWC.definition: A Motion to Redact is a formal request made in a trial court or bankruptcy court to remove or conceal certain information from a document or record.

http://lmss.sali.org/R7zvYKadqTXgMZV8ghL.label: Trial Court Practice Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/R7zvYKadqTXgMZV8ghL.definition: Trial Court Practice Documents are written or presented materials used in the litigation process, including exhibits, reports, affidavits, motions, stipulations, and other procedural documents created or used in trial courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R802950F8Bbc9D9332c.label: Mozirje
http://lmss.sali.org/R802950F8Bbc9D9332c.definition: Mozirje is a town located in Slovenia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R805t9lASgHhn25grer.label: Georgia Superior Court - Pulaski County
http://lmss.sali.org/R805t9lASgHhn25grer.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Pulaski County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pulaski County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R80694c25Ba33226089.definition: Atacora is a region in Benin.

The minimum redemption value is equal to the nominal value, provided a specified barrier has not been breached; if the barrier is breached, the product converts into a tracker certificate. With greater risk, multiple underlying assets (worst-of) allow for a higher bonus level or lower barrier, offering reduced risk compared to a direct investment in the underlying assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81SEQDLhhVCoslHg2h.definition: The Lessor's Breach of Implied Warranty on Goods refers to the failure of a party who leases goods to provide goods that are fit for their intended purpose, which was not explicitly stated in the lease agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81SeVD4T2SxJDsbPSI.label: Indemnification for Third Party Claims Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R81SeVD4T2SxJDsbPSI.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and defend the other party against any claims made by a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81TNXmSOpIQdFCN6cf.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Washington County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, located in Washington County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81U2hYMdTqNKegcCFH.label: Withdrawal of Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R81U2hYMdTqNKegcCFH.definition: A Withdrawal of Objection is a formal action taken by a party in legal proceedings to rescind or retract a previously filed objection, effectively signaling agreement or no further contest to the matter at issue. This action can occur in various legal contexts, including litigation, administrative proceedings, and bankruptcy cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81UJniGisJBdDFipJl.label: Public Offering
http://lmss.sali.org/R81UJniGisJBdDFipJl.definition: Public Debt Offering, also known as Retail Distributions, refer to the sale of non-convertible debt securities directly to individual investors or through channels that cater to non-institutional buyers. This method of distribution makes debt securities accessible to the general public, often in smaller denominations than those typically offered to institutional investors. This process allows governments or corporations to raise capital from a broad base of retail investors, often involving simplified issuance procedures.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81UTFam3zqrbp9MfWC.label: Physical Accessibility Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R81UTFam3zqrbp9MfWC.definition: A physical accessibility claim is made when a physical space or infrastructure, like a building, public space, or facility, is not accessible or usable by individuals with disabilities. This might involve a lack of ramps, inappropriately designed restrooms, or inaccessible public areas.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81UVfoWtSHwxVmVVi2.label: Visa for Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement
http://lmss.sali.org/R81UVfoWtSHwxVmVVi2.definition: Visas for individuals with extraordinary ability or achievement in fields such as sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics (in the U.S., an O-1 visa), is a non-immigrant visa allows recipients to work temporarily in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). In the United States, that duration is typically for up to three years, with the possibility of extensions in one-year increments as long as they continue to maintain their "extraordinary" status.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81VVZdOeEvD1EbkHfB.label: Grand Jury Proceedings Unlawfully Disclosed
http://lmss.sali.org/R81VVZdOeEvD1EbkHfB.definition: The concept of "Grand Jury Proceedings Unlawfully Disclosed" refers to the illegal act of revealing information about a grand jury investigation, which is supposed to be kept confidential, without proper authorization or legal justification.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81apEDmAH26iJtESwI.label: Copying Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/R81apEDmAH26iJtESwI.definition: The Copying Expense concept refers to the costs incurred for reproducing documents or materials, which are necessary for a legal matter and are considered as an expense.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81c1psAgogF7fBsY65.label: Prison Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R81c1psAgogF7fBsY65.definition: Prison Law refers to the body of laws and regulations that govern the rights and responsibilities of prisoners, including their treatment and conditions of incarceration. It also encompasses the rules and policies that regulate the management and organization of prison facilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81ea6Rg9Cd8vEEma9E.label: Terrorism
http://lmss.sali.org/R81ea6Rg9Cd8vEEma9E.definition: The concept of Terrorism refers to the use of violence and intimidation in pursuit of political aims, often targeting civilians and carried out by individuals or groups against a government or society.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81gIxZEycEyh9ymjYj.label: Exchange Debt for Equity
http://lmss.sali.org/R81gIxZEycEyh9ymjYj.definition: An asset exchange where a party replaces debt with equity — or equity with debt — in a company. Replacing debt with equity often occurs during restructuring to improve financial stability. Replacing equity with debt can help raise capital while avoiding dilution of ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81j4VBZk0ZJyM8Z4bf.label: Work Order Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R81j4VBZk0ZJyM8Z4bf.definition: A Work Order Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the specific tasks or services to be performed by one party for another, often including details such as timelines, deliverables, and compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81kMOLHVVbe2vyCOS8.label: Emancipation of a Minor (Remedy)
http://lmss.sali.org/R81kMOLHVVbe2vyCOS8.definition: Emancipation of a minor refers to a legal process through which a minor becomes legally independent from their parents or guardians, thereby assuming most adult responsibilities. Once emancipated, the minor is no longer under the care or control of their parents or guardians, and they can make legal decisions on their own behalf.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81n0uoiTFQMwwdzAsk.label: Business Development Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R81n0uoiTFQMwwdzAsk.definition: Business Development Management refers to the strategic planning and implementation of initiatives aimed at expanding and improving the business operations of a law firm or legal organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81opfsWnlEQvW2jFPW.label: Judgment of Arbitration
http://lmss.sali.org/R81opfsWnlEQvW2jFPW.definition: A Judgment of Arbitration is a decision made by an arbitrator or panel of arbitrators in a dispute resolution process, which is binding on the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81q0MYebZZv26XtzcI.label: Disability Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/R81q0MYebZZv26XtzcI.definition: Disability public benefit refers to government-provided financial assistance specifically aimed at individuals who are unable to work due to a disability. These benefits are designed to provide a safety net by replacing lost income or covering additional costs associated with the disability. In the United States, this can include Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI), Social Security disability insurance, and Supplemental Security Income (SSI).

http://lmss.sali.org/R81sYeX6XlFzhYawUGF.label: Central American Indian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R81sYeX6XlFzhYawUGF.definition: Central American Indian languages are a group of languages spoken by indigenous peoples in Central America, including languages such as K'iche', Mam, and Nahuatl.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81vvUfjtIynvagUMuG.label: Intended Spouse
http://lmss.sali.org/R81vvUfjtIynvagUMuG.definition: An Intended Spouse is a person who is engaged to be married and has a clear intention to enter into a legally recognized marriage. This status often involves legal considerations, such as immigration benefits, where the intended spouse may apply for a visa to join their partner in another country for the purpose of marriage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81wHQGRIbpj4t46jFI.label: Responses to Requests for Production
http://lmss.sali.org/R81wHQGRIbpj4t46jFI.definition: Responses to Requests for Production are documents produced in response to a formal request for information during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/R81yd87w2FAjvdGX2u9.label: Collaboration Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R81yd87w2FAjvdGX2u9.definition: A Collaboration Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of a partnership between two or more parties for the purpose of working together towards a common goal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82421ArEUfpkzc44Yg.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Pike County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pike County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R824a894D8fc1ECC3d9.definition: Saint Ann is a geographic location in Jamaica.

http://lmss.sali.org/R826inlltaxQ8KIpU8F.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Berkshire County is a specific court within the Massachusetts Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Berkshire County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82Bfd8D9316c4FEbae.definition: Vila Real is a city in Portugal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82DCY9wpy8RlxYrwn0.label: Non-Hearsay Evidentiary Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/R82DCY9wpy8RlxYrwn0.definition: A Non-Hearsay Evidentiary Objective refers to a purpose for admitting an out-of-court statement that is specifically exempted from the hearsay rule due to its inherent reliability or fairness in the context of the adversarial process. These objectives include party admissions, prior statements by witnesses under oath, and prior identifications made by witnesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82F6e3AADf0d123048.label: Palladium
http://lmss.sali.org/R82F6e3AADf0d123048.definition: A one troy ounce unit of the precious metal palladium, which is used as a standard of exchange.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82IWJ1gNpkd1OgHK8j.label: Affidavit of Prejudice
http://lmss.sali.org/R82IWJ1gNpkd1OgHK8j.definition: An Affidavit of Prejudice is a legal document filed by a party in a case, alleging that the decision maker assigned to the case is biased or prejudiced against them, and requesting that the decision maker be disqualified from the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82UgEWzxaFk4xLk3Hx.label: Joint Will
http://lmss.sali.org/R82UgEWzxaFk4xLk3Hx.definition: A Joint Will is a single testamentary document executed by two or more individuals, typically spouses, which combines their respective wills into one instrument. This document outlines how the collective assets of the testators will be distributed upon the death of both or all parties, often including provisions that the surviving party cannot alter the will after the first person's death.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82Yb8u8L6F9E8vrZFO.label: Funds, Trusts, and Other Financial Vehicles Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R82Yb8u8L6F9E8vrZFO.definition:
Industries in the Funds, Trusts, and Other Financial Vehicles subsector group legal entities (i.e., funds, plans, and/or programs) organized to pool securities or other assets on behalf of shareholders or beneficiaries of employee benefit or other trust funds.  The portfolios are customized to achieve specific investment characteristics, such as diversification, risk, rate of return, and price volatility.  These entities earn interest, dividends, and other investment income, but have little or no employment and no revenue from the sale of services.  Establishments with employees devoted to the management of funds are classified in Industry Group 5239, Other Financial Investment Activities.

Establishments primarily engaged in holding the securities of (or other equity interests in) other firms are classified in Sector 55, Management of Companies and Enterprises.  Equity real estate investment trusts (REITs) that are primarily engaged in leasing buildings, dwellings, or other real estate property to others are classified in Subsector 531, Real Estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82YwnDd4g8kOAQ7Ekb.label: Nursing Home Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/R82YwnDd4g8kOAQ7Ekb.definition: Nursing Home Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a nursing home for any harm caused to its residents due to negligence or misconduct, specifically in cases where the nursing home is managed by a third-party entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82iOqJMuYOjOGxNmuj.label: Administrative Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/R82iOqJMuYOjOGxNmuj.definition: An administrative judgment is a decision made by a government agency or administrative body, typically in regards to a specific case or issue.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82ikX2gSG3Kyc0OXqO.label: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception Triggering Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R82ikX2gSG3Kyc0OXqO.definition: A No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception Triggering Event is an exception to a no-shop covenant in a merger or acquisition agreement that allows a target company's board of directors to consider alternative acquisition proposals from third parties if they are deemed to be in the best interest of the company's shareholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82kPq1u51rWEx0EVL7.label: Cost or Fee Awarded - Amount Reduced
http://lmss.sali.org/R82kPq1u51rWEx0EVL7.definition: A reduction in the amount of costs or fees awarded, which is a part of the broader concepts of cost shifting and fee shifting in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82lHq2oPnrskZ1aM9N.definition: A court located in White Plains, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R82mGnEayAviMiF6MSe.definition: A Publicity Clause is a provision in a contract that governs the use of a party's name, image, or likeness for promotional purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R83VhHEeaRnvGWxfksx.definition: Industries in the Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing subsector manufacture products that generate, distribute, and use electrical power.  Electric Lighting Equipment Manufacturing establishments produce lighting fixtures, electric light bulbs, and parts (except glass parts and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), and other lighting equipment.  Household Appliance Manufacturing establishments make both small and major electrical appliances and parts.  Electrical Equipment Manufacturing establishments make goods, such as electric motors, generators, transformers, and switchgear apparatus.  Other Electrical Equipment and Component Manufacturing establishments make devices for storing electrical power (e.g., batteries), for transmitting electricity (e.g., insulated wire), and wiring devices (e.g., electrical outlets, fuse boxes, and light switches).

http://lmss.sali.org/R83cWaRd5UP59KOlvvF.definition: Schizophrenia is a chronic and severe mental health disorder characterized by disturbances in thought processes, perceptions, emotional responsiveness, and social interactions. http://lmss.sali.org/R83sNnwSvTMsV9jowtv.label: Large Trader Identification Form

http://lmss.sali.org/R83u2PaBNXclAGLdTJG.label: Limited Voting System
http://lmss.sali.org/R83u2PaBNXclAGLdTJG.definition: The limited voting system is an electoral method where voters have fewer votes than the number of available seats, allowing for the possibility of minority representation. examples: Alabama State Board of Education Elections: Limited voting used to ensure minority representation
Gibraltar's Parliamentary Elections: Voters have ten votes for seventeen seats
Spain's Senate Elections: Voters have two or three votes for four seats in each province

http://lmss.sali.org/R856uwdSyc5Lfpm3Hgh.label: Printing and Related Support Activities Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R856uwdSyc5Lfpm3Hgh.definition:
Industries in the Printing and Related Support Activities subsector print products, such as newspapers, books, labels, business cards, stationery, business forms, and other materials, and perform support activities, such as data imaging, platemaking services, and bookbinding.  The support activities included here are an integral part of the printing industry, and a product (a printing plate, a bound book, or a computer disk or file) that is an integral part of the printing industry is almost always provided by these operations.

Processes used in printing include a variety of methods used to transfer an image from a plate, screen, film, or computer file to some medium, such as paper, plastics, metal, textile articles, or wood.  The printing processes employed include, but are not limited to, lithographic, gravure, screen, flexographic, digital, and letterpress.

In contrast to many other classification systems that locate publishing of printed materials in manufacturing, NAICS classifies the publishing of printed products in Subsector 513, Publishing Industries.  Though printing and publishing are often carried out by the same enterprise, it is less and less the case that these distinct activities are carried out in the same establishment.  When publishing and printing are done in the same establishment, the establishment is classified in Subsector 513, Publishing Industries, in the appropriate NAICS industry even if the receipts for printing exceed those for publishing.

This subsector includes printing on clothing because the production process for that activity is printing, not clothing manufacturing.  For instance, the printing of T-shirts is included in this subsector.  In contrast, printing on fabric (or grey goods) is not included.  This activity is part of the process of finishing the fabric and is included in Industry 31331, Textile and Fabric Finishing Mills.

Excluded from this subsector are establishment primarily engaged in manufacturing bare printed circuit boards.  These establishments print, perforate, plate, screen, etch, or photoprint interconnecting pathways for electric current on laminates and are classified in Industry 33441, Semiconductor and Other Electronic Component Manufacturing.  Establishments primarily providing printing brokerage services are classified in Industry 56199, All Other Support Services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Hs98hbvGXbyLnjZcT.definition: Duty of care is a legal obligation requiring individuals and organizations to adhere to a standard of reasonable care while performing acts that could foreseeably harm others. This duty ensures that actions or omissions do not result in injury or damage to other parties.
examples: Corporate Director’s Duty To Company: A director must make decisions with the same care an ordinarily prudent person in a similar position would use, focusing on the company's best interests.
Landowner’s Duty To Visitors: A property owner must ensure that their property is safe for visitors and take reasonable steps to prevent injuries.
Manufacturer’s Duty Of Care: A manufacturer must ensure that products are safe for consumer use and provide adequate warnings of potential hazards.
Medical Professional’s Duty To Patients: A doctor must provide treatment that meets the standard of care expected in the medical community to avoid harm to patients.
Teacher’s Duty To Students: A teacher must provide a safe learning environment and act with reasonable care to prevent harm to students.
