http://lmss.sali.org/R8ND6YNfW3G28ruL8Q4.label: Tax ID - Client
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ND6YNfW3G28ruL8Q4.definition: A Tax ID - Client is a specific type of Tax Detail that refers to the unique identification number assigned to a client for tax purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NLKPDCyexTiBJCz8m.label: Indenture
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NLKPDCyexTiBJCz8m.definition: An Indenture is a formal legal document that sets forth the terms and conditions governing a relationship, usually involving debt securities such as bonds. It specifies the obligations of the issuer, the rights of the bondholders, and the responsibilities of the trustee, who acts as an intermediary between the two parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NOhFstiXFl3rquUpF.label: Officer's Certificate
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NOhFstiXFl3rquUpF.definition: An Officer's Certificate is a formal document executed by a company officer attesting to the accuracy of certain facts or figures, often in relation to the company's financials or compliance status. It is commonly used to validate representations made in contracts or agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NS2clrdzMdZxaKZRr.label: Forest Resources Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NS2clrdzMdZxaKZRr.definition: Laws governing activities in designated forest lands, most commonly with respect to forest management and timber harvesting.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NSvW60V29sGAOjRQt.label: Business Intelligence Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NSvW60V29sGAOjRQt.definition: Business Intelligence Management refers to the systematic process of collecting, analyzing, and managing data to support strategic decision-making for a particular business. It involves the use of tools and techniques to transform raw data into meaningful insights that can inform business strategies and operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NUIwfAJqCZ01KNqq2.label: Mandatory Arbitration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NUIwfAJqCZ01KNqq2.definition: A mandatory arbitration clause is a provision in a contract that requires any disputes arising from the contract to be resolved through arbitration rather than through the court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NXBaBIdqkUFrXWxuQ.label: Goodwill
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NXBaBIdqkUFrXWxuQ.definition: Goodwill is an intangible asset that represents the value of a business beyond its tangible assets and liabilities. It arises when one company acquires another for a price higher than the fair market value of its net identifiable assets. It also represents elements like excellence of management, customer loyalty, brand recognition, favorable location, or quality of employees and overall business going concern value that are not separately identifiable but contribute to generating future economic benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NXqK1uTl4KVVtXDo2.label: Monetary Inflow
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NXqK1uTl4KVVtXDo2.definition: External Actor pays Legal Services Buyer. Money flowing into the Legal Services Buyer. E.g., Litigation proceeds from plaintiff-side litigation. E.g., Legal Services Buyer hires Legal Services Provider to negotiate with a contractual counterparty, resulting in increased funds flowing to Legal Services Buyer. In Accounts Payable systems (e.g., Oracle), this is labeled "Profit Center."

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NaWaVnkBqgo4SQa0i.label: Apparent Authority
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NaWaVnkBqgo4SQa0i.definition: The concept of Apparent Authority refers to the legal principle that holds a principal liable for the actions of an agent who appears to have the authority to act on their behalf, even if the agent does not actually have such authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NbbZM7ESWmrKMGuKG.label: Disbursement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NbbZM7ESWmrKMGuKG.definition: The concept of Disbursement (Distribution) refers to the act of distributing funds or assets to the intended recipients, often as part of a larger event or phase.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NcEcKGyel5bjJtbeS.label: Tsimshian
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NcEcKGyel5bjJtbeS.definition: A language spoken by the Tsimshian people, primarily in British Columbia and Alaska.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NeHqlm4gpDHd2jIQm.label: Patent Infringement - Utility Patents
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NeHqlm4gpDHd2jIQm.definition: The unauthorized use, manufacture, sale, or importation of a product or process that is protected by a utility patent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NfA8M4UkdbVvVH1Ur.label: Work Product Ownership Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NfA8M4UkdbVvVH1Ur.definition: A Work Product Ownership Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the ownership rights of the work product created under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NgQgBrQtQicNGf4Ia.label: Common Law Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NgQgBrQtQicNGf4Ia.definition: A Common Law Lien is a type of lien that arises from the common law rather than from a statute, and allows a creditor to retain possession of a debtor's property until the debt is paid.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NhmHvt8LqUHj6HTQw.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Clarion County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NhmHvt8LqUHj6HTQw.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Clarion County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NkyPiBO4cDYNheqxF.label: Freedom of Association
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NkyPiBO4cDYNheqxF.definition: A freedom of association claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to freedom of association, as protected by the First Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment guarantees the right to associate with others for the expression of ideas, beliefs, and collective action, including the right to form and join groups and organizations. A freedom of association claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts the right to associate or form organizations, when a government actor interferes with the right to join or participate in a group or organization, or when an individual or group is discriminated against or punished based on their association with a particular group or organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Nlu1VORhFmeFKM5x3.label: Georgia Superior Court - Worth County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Nlu1VORhFmeFKM5x3.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Worth County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Worth County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NvVLe26lWZXxjXVtX.label: False Arrest and Imprisonment
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NvVLe26lWZXxjXVtX.definition: The concept of False Arrest and Imprisonment refers to the unlawful detention or confinement of an individual without legal justification or consent, resulting in a violation of their personal liberty and freedom of movement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NvsufkQHORQ3VcXpa.label: Lost Profits Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NvsufkQHORQ3VcXpa.definition: Lost Profits Damages refer to the financial harm suffered by a party as a result of a breach of contract or other wrongful act, where the damages are calculated based on the profits that the party would have earned if the breach or wrongful act had not occurred.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8NwI4yCwegzAreujm0.label: Transfer of Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8NwI4yCwegzAreujm0.definition: The Transfer of Claim is a legal document that allows a creditor to transfer their right to receive payment from a debtor to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8O16bYOWvNPglI4VNR.label: Subtenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R8O16bYOWvNPglI4VNR.definition: A person or entity who subleases property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8O1VWhQ1xk3ac5wJbU.label: Spinach
http://lmss.sali.org/R8O1VWhQ1xk3ac5wJbU.definition: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable from the Spinacia oleracea species, known for its tender leaves and mild, slightly earthy flavor. It is consumed raw or cooked and is valued for its high nutritional content, including vitamins A, C, and K, iron, calcium, and antioxidants.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8O1uQRrzRaJZpBZ6wL.label: Army
http://lmss.sali.org/R8O1uQRrzRaJZpBZ6wL.definition: An Army is the land-based military branch of a nation's armed forces, primarily responsible for ground warfare and territorial defense. This organization consists of trained soldiers, support personnel, and various types of land-based military equipment, structured to conduct large-scale ground operations and maintain national security.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8O3PoolmgHAy2hrZsg.label: Copyright Concept Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/R8O3PoolmgHAy2hrZsg.definition: Copyright Concept Objectives refer to the criteria that a work must meet to be eligible for copyright protection. These objectives can include originality, expression in a tangible medium, and creativity, ensuring the work is a unique creation of the author.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8O7ZXDsTGKT17x6b5I.label: tax_point_date
http://lmss.sali.org/R8O7ZXDsTGKT17x6b5I.definition:
"The tax point is generally the invoice date.  In instances where the tax point date is different from the invoice date, the tax point date indicates the financial period in which the tax applies.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OG1CzgBjIlVUwKfnc.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Tioga County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OG1CzgBjIlVUwKfnc.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Tioga County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OHUPwUB6sK3OOjq0W.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 15 Case
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OHUPwUB6sK3OOjq0W.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 15 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed Chapter 15 bankruptcy case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OKiUVlu5kYKBztT11.label: 140 Negotiable Instrument (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OKiUVlu5kYKBztT11.definition: Action relating to an agreement to pay a specific amount of money, including promissory notes, loan agreements and checks.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OMleboXVCPErVs3Bp.label: Non-Billable
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OMleboXVCPErVs3Bp.definition: The term "Non-Billable" refers to time spent or tasks performed by a legal service provider that cannot be charged to the client. These activities are typically considered necessary for practice operations but do not directly contribute to client work.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ON9C39HUAjJYhP2BP.label: Failure to Mitigate Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ON9C39HUAjJYhP2BP.definition: The failure of a plaintiff to take reasonable steps to minimize their losses or damages after an injury or breach of contract has occurred, which may limit the amount of damages they can recover in a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ONVC8pLVJC5dD4eKq.label: Matter Narrative Format
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ONVC8pLVJC5dD4eKq.definition: The file format containing the narrative description of a matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ONtQynsBvLAfqn6ni.label: Mechanical Patent
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ONtQynsBvLAfqn6ni.definition: A mechanical patent is a legal protection granted to inventors of new and useful machines, mechanical devices, or improvements thereof.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OSzNgB4LUHHubChvz.label: New York City Court - Glen Cove
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OSzNgB4LUHHubChvz.definition: A court located in Glen Cove, New York, which is a subdivision of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OXAl4XER5P7DRJEzq.label: Settlement Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OXAl4XER5P7DRJEzq.definition: Settlement Motions are motions filed in trial courts related to the settlement of a legal dispute, including motions to stay proceedings pending settlement, approve settlement, enforce settlement, postpone settlement conference, adjourn settlement conference, settle, and enforce agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OYDhDoTNCMNQHheM1.label: Contract Reformation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OYDhDoTNCMNQHheM1.definition: The concept of Contract Reformation refers to the legal remedy of modifying or changing the terms of a contract in order to correct a mistake or address an unfair situation, and is a type of equitable relief.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OYtUgrSy0s0J4hyXJ.label: Kansas District Court - Crawford County, Girard
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OYtUgrSy0s0J4hyXJ.definition: The Kansas District Court - Crawford County, Girard is a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Crawford County and is located in the city of Girard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OaEGleirRyxkYz6d2.label: Marine Corps
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OaEGleirRyxkYz6d2.definition: A Marine Corps is an amphibious warfare branch of a nation's armed forces, specializing in projecting military power from the sea onto hostile or potentially hostile shores. This force is trained to operate in maritime, littoral, and land environments, often serving as a rapid response force for expeditionary operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OcL6bnGz3VCUHybQi.label: Tax on Tax ID
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OcL6bnGz3VCUHybQi.definition: A tax imposed on a unique identification number assigned to an individual or entity for tax purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Oek9P5OcDc0RoLp6Z.label: Local Governmental Leader
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Oek9P5OcDc0RoLp6Z.definition: A Local Governmental Leader is an elected or appointed official who holds a position of authority in a municipal or regional government body. This individual is responsible for making decisions, implementing policies, and representing the interests of their constituents within a specific geographic area smaller than a state or province.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OhdVjX930P6m8083G.label: Motion for Mistrial
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OhdVjX930P6m8083G.definition: A Motion for Mistrial is a request made by a party during a trial asking the judge to declare the trial invalid and start over due to a significant error or misconduct that has occurred during the proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OkaBimrQsIPRJQjXv.label: Laboratories - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OkaBimrQsIPRJQjXv.definition: A laboratory is a type of real estate asset, which is a property that is owned or controlled by a person, business, or economic entity and is specifically designed and equipped for scientific research and experimentation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Ol92hxELxA00tCrZW.label: Work Allocation Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Ol92hxELxA00tCrZW.definition: Work Allocation Management refers to the process of assigning and distributing tasks and responsibilities among legal professionals within a law firm or legal department, as part of the overall management of legal operations and business activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OmVstIMR7qzYcAWgA.label: Natural Language Processing
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OmVstIMR7qzYcAWgA.definition: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is the field of artificial intelligence focused on enabling machines to process, analyze, and generate human language in its spoken, written, or signed forms. NLP involves a range of techniques to understand, interpret, and produce human language in a way that is both meaningful and useful.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OnUCufrh95zFJBYQV.label: Unauthorized Practice of Medicine
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OnUCufrh95zFJBYQV.definition: The Unauthorized Practice of Medicine occurs when an individual or entity engages in medical activities, such as diagnosis, treatment, or offering medical advice, without the necessary medical qualifications, licensure, or authorization in a particular jurisdiction. This practice poses significant risks to public health and safety, as it involves providing medical care without the required expertise and credentials.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OotZk1bnNPg3b30FQ.label: Theft Locations
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OotZk1bnNPg3b30FQ.definition: Theft Locations refer to specific places or settings where theft occurs, such as buildings, motor vehicles, or coin-operated machines, and are a subcategory of Criminal Theft.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OqYvJ3jvCXYGpiBDJ.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Montour County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OqYvJ3jvCXYGpiBDJ.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Montour County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Montour County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8OsGCPOsihiJLtbFkI.label: Res Judicata
http://lmss.sali.org/R8OsGCPOsihiJLtbFkI.definition: Res Judicata refers to the legal principle that a matter that has been adjudicated by a competent court and a final judgment has been rendered, cannot be litigated again between the same parties or their privies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Ov4MbOJULZY0aLe1K.label: Personal Information
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Ov4MbOJULZY0aLe1K.definition: Personal Information refers to any data that relates to an identified or identifiable individual. This includes both sensitive personal information, which requires greater protection due to its potential to cause harm if disclosed, and personally identifiable information (PII), which can be used to identify, contact, or locate a specific individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Owlw8lExgVrP33uVe.label: Norwegian
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Owlw8lExgVrP33uVe.definition: Norwegian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Norway and other Norwegian-speaking regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P1ofmH8rlGJmCYCSY.label: Bill and Hold Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P1ofmH8rlGJmCYCSY.definition: A Bill and Hold Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a seller to bill a buyer for goods that have not yet been delivered, but are being held by the seller for the buyer's future delivery instructions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P36P1R5mabdOkGBYM.label: Corporate Issuer
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P36P1R5mabdOkGBYM.definition: A Corporate Issuer refers to a corporation that issues debt or equity securities to raise capital for various purposes, such as expanding operations, financing acquisitions, or refinancing existing debt. These securities can include corporate bonds, stocks, and commercial paper, and are sold to investors in the capital markets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P4TfMxPJDoohmXd80.label: Nauru
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P4TfMxPJDoohmXd80.definition: Nauru (Language) refers to the structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in the Pacific island nation of Nauru.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P6ORUIVam6jbpvOXu.label: Asset Appreciation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P6ORUIVam6jbpvOXu.definition: Asset Appreciation is the increase in the value of an asset over time. This growth in worth can occur due to various factors such as market demand, scarcity, improvements, or economic conditions, and represents a gain in the asset's potential sale price or intrinsic value.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P7ySQTk9HGk6opadx.label: Application to Extend or Change Nonimmigrant Status
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P7ySQTk9HGk6opadx.definition: The "Application to Extend or Change Nonimmigrant Status" refers to Form I-539 in the United States, which is used by individuals in certain non-immigrant visa categories to request an extension of their stay or a change to a different non-immigrant status. This form is commonly used by individuals who want to prolong their stay or switch to a different visa category while remaining in the U.S.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8P8o9JZGG11Tcu8bJ1.label: Possession of a Controlled Substance
http://lmss.sali.org/R8P8o9JZGG11Tcu8bJ1.definition: The unlawful cultivation, manufacture, distribution, sale, purchase, use, possession, transportation, or importation of any controlled drug or narcotic substance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PCFARyZiL1JkOYsz4.label: Dollar-Based Antitrust Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PCFARyZiL1JkOYsz4.definition: A Dollar-Based Antitrust Standard is a legal concept that sets a monetary threshold for determining whether a business practice violates antitrust laws, with the aim of preventing anticompetitive behavior while also allowing for efficient business operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PM7MAJvY1XMZszOKt.label: INVOICE_NET_TOTAL
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PM7MAJvY1XMZszOKt.definition: The INVOICE_NET_TOTAL concept refers to the total amount of money owed on an invoice, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PRNJLPTB6chhMV6J6.label: Response to Show Cause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PRNJLPTB6chhMV6J6.definition: A response to show cause is a legal document filed in response to a court order requiring a party to explain why a certain action should not be taken against them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PRh8TOVmFK4yO7zFG.label: Wrongful Incarceration
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PRh8TOVmFK4yO7zFG.definition: The concept of Wrongful Incarceration refers to the unlawful detention of an individual by the government, which results in the deprivation of their liberty and freedom.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PS7NPVfrpmQhdb9uV.label: New York City Court - Corning
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PS7NPVfrpmQhdb9uV.definition: A court located in Corning, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PTXy9BnB1jKpNSVz7.label: New York Village Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PTXy9BnB1jKpNSVz7.definition: New York Village Court is a local court in New York State that has jurisdiction over minor criminal and civil matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PXw7e9ivTqcR50MvT.label: regulation_heading
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PXw7e9ivTqcR50MvT.definition:
"The citation of the statute or regulation associated with the information provided in the next field.  E-Billing vendors and clients are requested to provide instruction on how data is to be recorded in this field.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PYbh617hyhRaXTMwT.label: Down Payment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PYbh617hyhRaXTMwT.definition: A Down Payment Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a specified amount of money to be paid upfront by one party to the other as a condition for entering into the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PkM7HX25gKcknv2Iw.label: Minnesota District Court - Houston County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PkM7HX25gKcknv2Iw.definition: Minnesota District Court - Houston County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Houston County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PlPcdLJhdp1AR6Zt1.label: Texas District Court - Dallas County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PlPcdLJhdp1AR6Zt1.definition: A Texas District Court located in Dallas County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Pr3Om4eSaH0cIW4B3.label: Common Share
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Pr3Om4eSaH0cIW4B3.definition: Common Shares, also known as Ordinary Shares, represent a basic unit of equity ownership in a company, granting shareholders voting rights and a share in the company's profits through dividends. These shares typically entitle the holder to one vote per share and are the most prevalent type of stock issued by companies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PtSWt5IQ5kyBmQX8c.label: Trademark Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PtSWt5IQ5kyBmQX8c.definition: Trademark Management refers to the process of overseeing and protecting a company's registered trademarks, including monitoring for infringement and taking legal action when necessary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8PvYibP2eJP2dynJCZ.label: Due Diligence Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8PvYibP2eJP2dynJCZ.definition: Due Diligence Management refers to the process of conducting a thorough investigation and analysis of a legal transaction to ensure that all relevant information is disclosed and risks are identified and mitigated.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q31MHgiF9qpQ2nPT5.label: Investment Services Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q31MHgiF9qpQ2nPT5.definition: An Investment Services Agreement is a contract between an investor and a service provider detailing the scope of investment-related services to be offered. It outlines fees, responsibilities, and terms of the relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q81X6IbMcyQaHoJP2.label: Motion to Strike Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q81X6IbMcyQaHoJP2.definition: A Motion to Strike Complaint is a legal document filed by a party in a lawsuit requesting the court to remove or strike certain allegations or claims made by the opposing party in their complaint.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q9yB6dZBNqz25bJG8.label: Fees of Court Clerk or Marshal
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Q9yB6dZBNqz25bJG8.definition: The Fees of Court Clerk or Marshal refer to the charges imposed by the court clerk or marshal for their services rendered in a legal matter, which are included in the overall Court Costs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QA8463ZVLrPCfw6Jj.label: Physical Asset Delivery
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QA8463ZVLrPCfw6Jj.definition: Physical Asset Delivery refers to the settlement of a contract, financial instruments, or assets through the receipt or delivery of the actual underlying instruments instead of cash. This method is common in derivative contracts, where fulfilling the settlement obligation involves the transfer of the physical underlying asset.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QAy2M9XDOWZjh3ISK.label: Mediation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QAy2M9XDOWZjh3ISK.definition: A Mediation Agreement is a contract that parties enter into, agreeing to resolve their disputes through mediation: a process where a neutral third-party mediator assists the parties in reaching a voluntary settlement. The agreement outlines the terms of the mediation process and any resultant decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QBuMoK1uPFeLW0sg4.label: Contact Information
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QBuMoK1uPFeLW0sg4.definition: Contact Information refers to the details of an individual or entity that can be used to communicate with them, including their name, address, phone number, email, and other relevant information.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QGR6XrWipZpr96KLw.label: Minnesota District Court - Clay County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QGR6XrWipZpr96KLw.definition: Minnesota District Court - Clay County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QIbdYmychm9yabx8K.label: Motion for Temporary Restraining Order
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QIbdYmychm9yabx8K.definition: A Motion for Temporary Restraining Order (TRO) is a legal request for a court order that would prevent a party from taking a certain action until a hearing can be held to determine whether a preliminary injunction should be issued.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QJDc8SCwsfsJARkye.label: UTBMS Litigation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QJDc8SCwsfsJARkye.definition: UTBMS Litigation refers to the standardized codes used to categorize legal activities and expenses related to the litigation process, including discovery, pre-trial pleadings and motions, trial preparation and trial, and appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QK5HHpHaMbIsluZWC.label: Listed Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QK5HHpHaMbIsluZWC.definition: Listed Assets refer to debt securities and other financial instruments that are registered and traded on a recognized stock exchange or regulated market. These assets include corporate bonds, government bonds, and other debt instruments, providing liquidity and transparency to investors.
examples: A corporate bond listed on the New York Stock Exchange is considered a listed asset, providing ease of trading for investors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QNoHPGUoFXi3PeVUb.label: Waste Management and Remediation Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QNoHPGUoFXi3PeVUb.definition: Industries in this group are engaged in the collection, treatment, and disposal of waste materials. This includes establishments engaged in local hauling of waste materials; operating materials recovery facilities (i.e., those that sort recyclable materials from the trash stream); providing remediation services (i.e., those that provide for the cleanup of contaminated buildings, mine sites, soil, or ground water); and providing septic pumping and other miscellaneous waste management services. There are three industry groups within the subsector that separate these activities into waste collection, waste treatment and disposal, and remediation and other waste management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QOUoIZ2UaFdo92yx8.label: E105 Telephone
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QOUoIZ2UaFdo92yx8.definition: A telephone expense incurred in the course of business operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QQECCOA6NV5fPjKk8.label: Motion for Injunction Pending Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QQECCOA6NV5fPjKk8.definition: A Motion for Injunction Pending Appeal is a legal request made to a higher court to temporarily stop a lower court's decision from being enforced until the appeal process is completed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QRLB1gnbhfJrE1S4m.label: Antitrust - Market Allocation Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QRLB1gnbhfJrE1S4m.definition: Antitrust - Market Allocation Claims: A legal claim alleging that competitors in a market have colluded to divide the market among themselves, thereby reducing competition and harming consumers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QTEDugP1P22lLQaJa.label: Preamble Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QTEDugP1P22lLQaJa.definition: A preamble clause is a type of contractual clause that serves as an introductory statement to a legal document, outlining the purpose and context of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QUhchXCdtxl5mRDMA.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Cameron County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QUhchXCdtxl5mRDMA.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Cameron County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Cameron County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QWcchNijv5Tf8mVrp.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 7 Case
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QWcchNijv5Tf8mVrp.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 7 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 7 of the Bankruptcy Code.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QXnLxK56gYst8NZ7P.label: Blin; Bilin
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QXnLxK56gYst8NZ7P.definition: A language spoken by the Blin and Bilin people, primarily in Eritrea and Ethiopia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qa1qofajFPWBwy4F0.label: Magahi
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qa1qofajFPWBwy4F0.definition: Magahi is a language that belongs to the Indo-Aryan language family and is primarily spoken in the Bihar state of India.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QdULAkvnPR1GddKH1.label: Intervening Event - Reasonable Foreseeable at Signing
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QdULAkvnPR1GddKH1.definition: An "Intervening Event - Reasonable Foreseeable at Signing" refers to a circumstance that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement, which was reasonably foreseeable at the time of signing and may affect the terms of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qj3vVE60T2ayHgCD8.label: Blood Test
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qj3vVE60T2ayHgCD8.definition: A Blood Test is a medical procedure where a sample of blood is taken from an individual's body, typically from a vein in the arm, to be analyzed for various purposes. These purposes can range from assessing general health, detecting diseases and infections, to evaluating organ function or checking for specific conditions like anemia or diabetes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qlu8j6378wRwqtVUx.label: Public Information
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Qlu8j6378wRwqtVUx.definition: Public Information refers to information that is openly available to anyone and does not require any form of authorization or clearance for access. This type of information is intended for widespread dissemination and does not necessarily pose a risk of harm to the organization (e.g., company, nonprofit, nation) if disclosed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QpNAiaNNvHJkLDYV0.label: Gifts Causa Mortis
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QpNAiaNNvHJkLDYV0.definition: A gift causa mortis is a transfer of property made by a person who is anticipating their imminent death, and is made with the expectation that the gift will only take effect if the donor dies from the illness or peril that they are facing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8QtE84BGxDxytWklaf.label: Lack of Competency Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R8QtE84BGxDxytWklaf.definition: A Lack of Competency Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a witness does not possess the necessary qualifications, knowledge, or mental capacity to provide reliable testimony. This objection aims to ensure that testimony is provided only by individuals who are deemed competent to testify under the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8R1yLVmTPfF0G3vYNk.label: Design Immunity
http://lmss.sali.org/R8R1yLVmTPfF0G3vYNk.definition: Design Immunity is an affirmative defense to a claim of dangerous condition of public property and should be considered where the design of the subject area is at issue.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8R2AoaEDICGsFmF97d.label: Child’s Right to Rescind Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/R8R2AoaEDICGsFmF97d.definition: The Child's Right to Rescind Contract refers to the legal right of a minor to cancel or void a contract they entered into before reaching the age of majority. This concept falls under the broader category of Contract & Quasi-Contract Claims within the legal framework.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8R7UAZpzIQTdqNtctK.label: Unfair Prejudice Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R8R7UAZpzIQTdqNtctK.definition: An Unfair Prejudice Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that evidence being presented is more likely to cause bias or unfair harm to one side than to contribute meaningfully to the resolution of the case. In other words, the evidence's probative value doesn't outweigh its unfairly prejudicial impact. This objection seeks to prevent evidence that might unfairly influence the decision-maker's judgment, ensuring that the trial remains fair and impartial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8R9Nh01rABqHHrtndW.label: Firm Knowledge Manager
http://lmss.sali.org/R8R9Nh01rABqHHrtndW.definition: A Firm Knowledge Manager is a non-timekeeper level provider who manages the knowledge and information within a law firm.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RAiCSA22RcLvEbpQS.label: Notice of Settlement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RAiCSA22RcLvEbpQS.definition: A Notice of Settlement is a written communication that informs parties involved in a legal dispute that an agreement has been reached and the case will not proceed to trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8REFEtDy732ovlT7nI.label: Gasoline Stations and Fuel Dealers Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8REFEtDy732ovlT7nI.definition: Industries in the Gasoline Stations and Fuel Dealers subsector retail automotive fuels (e.g., gasoline, diesel fuel, gasohol, alternative fuels) and automotive oils, without or in combination with convenience store items; or retail heating oil, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, and other fuels via direct selling (i.e., home delivery).  Gasoline stations have specialized equipment for storing and dispensing automotive fuels.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RGcWVmCxoTR6JBMKm.label: Pre-petition Payroll Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RGcWVmCxoTR6JBMKm.definition: A Pre-petition Payroll Motion is a request made in a bankruptcy case by the debtor to pay its employees for work done prior to the bankruptcy filing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RGi6eeBrnhmcGtWCg.label: Consideration - Intellectual Property Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RGi6eeBrnhmcGtWCg.definition: Intellectual property (IP) consideration refers to the valuation and transfer of intangible assets, such as patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets, from the seller to the buyer as part of the deal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RH0L3Ly427nlRy8H0.label: Prospectus
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RH0L3Ly427nlRy8H0.definition: A Prospectus is a formal document filed with securities regulators that provides details about an investment offering for sale to the public. It usually includes the terms of the offering, risks, and financial statements among other critical information.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RHDWYB8AvApZyPoBs.label: Mohawk
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RHDWYB8AvApZyPoBs.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Mohawk people, characterized by its complex grammar and unique phonetics.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RHS60Cj8fDtECBoRL.label: Siksika
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RHS60Cj8fDtECBoRL.definition: Siksika (Language) refers to the structured system of communication used by the Siksika people, which consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to their culture and traditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RJIpODageO9V5kZNQ.label: Food Services and Drinking Places Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RJIpODageO9V5kZNQ.definition: Industries in this froup prepare meals, snacks, and beverages to customer order for immediate on-premises and off-premises consumption. There is a wide range of establishments in these industries. Some provide food and drink only; while others provide various combinations of seating space, waiter/waitress services and incidental amenities, such as limited entertainment. The group includes special food services, such as food service contractors, caterers, and mobile food services; drinking places; and restaurants and other eating places.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RLoj1VDuLRAtv0kYB.label: Esophagus Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RLoj1VDuLRAtv0kYB.definition: Esophagus cancer is a malignant tumor that originates in the esophagus, the muscular tube that connects the throat to the stomach. This cancer can significantly impact swallowing and digestion and often requires a combination of treatments, including surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RLxiE9kF0pyDfj0Cv.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Scott Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RLxiE9kF0pyDfj0Cv.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Scott County is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Scott County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ROO6ZbtyydIFTasNZ.label: Invoice Due Date
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ROO6ZbtyydIFTasNZ.definition: The "Invoice Due Date" is a specific detail within the broader concept of "Fee Invoice Detail" and refers to the date by which payment for legal services must be made.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RWtvqzcTuy24nU1nW.label: TR110 Fact Investigation and Development
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RWtvqzcTuy24nU1nW.definition: All actions to investigate and understand the facts of a matter that are not included under another trademark task code below. Covers initial meeting to discuss new matter, interview of client personnel and potential witnesses, review of documents to learn the facts of a potential case, work with an investigator, and all related communications and correspondence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RZqUEjM4B0PS0FbnL.label: Directive
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RZqUEjM4B0PS0FbnL.definition: A Directive is an official or authoritative instruction or guideline issued by a governing body or regulatory authority, often aiming to manage or direct specific actions within its jurisdiction. It typically outlines procedures, sets standards, or provides guidance for compliance with laws and regulations

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RaxtAg8qZWpNrONQu.label: Invalidity Analysis Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RaxtAg8qZWpNrONQu.definition: Invalidity Analysis Practice is a legal service that involves investigating and developing facts related to the invalidity of a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RbtZExft9n6SUAnvr.label: Statutory Immunity
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RbtZExft9n6SUAnvr.definition: Statutory Immunity is a legal concept that provides protection from legal action to government officials or entities who are acting within the scope of their duties as defined by a specific statute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RfDzMtuMPdmNTonmh.label: Lease
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RfDzMtuMPdmNTonmh.definition: A Lease Agreement is a binding contract between a lessor (the owner) and a lessee (the renter) that stipulates the terms and conditions for renting out an asset, such as real estate property or an automobile. The agreement outlines details like the rental amount, lease duration, responsibilities of each party, and other specific provisions related to the rented asset.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RgzFhDdl1pdx5e5pd.label: Pancreatic Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RgzFhDdl1pdx5e5pd.definition: Pancreatic cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the tissues of the pancreas, an organ responsible for aiding digestion and regulating blood sugar. It is often diagnosed at an advanced stage and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RjNYOqUElQ9CiHuLp.label: Joint Work
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RjNYOqUElQ9CiHuLp.definition: Joint Work in copyright law refers to a work produced by the collaboration of two or more authors where their contributions are not separate from each other. This concept is characterized by the intent of the authors to merge their contributions into inseparable or interdependent parts of a unitary whole.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RnHOTDaEMDMEljV8F.label: Insurance Deductible Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RnHOTDaEMDMEljV8F.definition: An insurance deductible amount, in the context of legal matters, is the portion of a covered loss that the insured party is responsible for paying before the insurance company's coverage begins.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RojRAoe6WRsBzZCIY.label: Motion for Judgment on Partial Findings
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RojRAoe6WRsBzZCIY.definition: A Motion for Judgment on Partial Findings is a legal request made by a party in a case asking the court to rule in their favor on specific issues that have already been decided during the trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RpTOwiNs5o1omuvFr.label: tax_authority_ref
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RpTOwiNs5o1omuvFr.definition: In some countries tax invoices must be routed, approved and in some cases even delivered to the customers by a platform controlled and/or imposed by the tax authority.  This platform normally returns an approval code/identifier to the invoice issuer for audit trail purposes.  Such code/identifier may need to be communicated to the customer as a reference depending on the jurisdiction. Use this field to specify the approval code/identifier if required in your country.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RuerKbbGEIA5xqRC8.label: Aymara
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RuerKbbGEIA5xqRC8.definition: Aymara is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in the Andes region of South America, particularly in Bolivia, Peru, and Chile.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8RzOhOfkA2gKQoBAsx.label: Voluntary Employment Termination Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R8RzOhOfkA2gKQoBAsx.definition: Voluntary employment termination event refers to the act of an employee willingly leaving their job, either through resignation or retirement. This is distinct from involuntary termination, where the employer initiates the separation due to reasons like downsizing, performance issues, or misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S1IGzUlNcKTEKpP4J.label: Incorporation of Recitals Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S1IGzUlNcKTEKpP4J.definition: The Incorporation of Recitals Clause is a specific clause within a contract that references and includes the introductory statements or background information (recitals) of the agreement into the body of the contract itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S5ejyAKrhwEonXKcs.label: Diversity Immigrant Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S5ejyAKrhwEonXKcs.definition: The "Diversity Immigrant Visa" grants permanent residency to individuals from countries with historically low immigration rates to the host country, aiming to increase demographic diversity. This visa type is awarded through a lottery system, offering winners a direct pathway to immigration and eventual citizenship.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S6XHMUuU5cg5gdDri.label: Deal Protection and Related Provisions
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S6XHMUuU5cg5gdDri.definition: Deal Protection and Related Provisions refer to a set of contractual clauses and agreements that are designed to safeguard a merger or acquisition deal from external threats and ensure its successful completion, including provisions such as no-shop covenants, breakup fee triggers, and fiduciary termination rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S6z85FPWxd4AVrVeD.label: Breach of Express Warranty
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S6z85FPWxd4AVrVeD.definition: The Breach of Express Warranty is a legal concept that occurs when a seller fails to fulfill a specific promise or guarantee made to a buyer regarding the quality or performance of a product, resulting in harm or damages to the buyer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S7jw4M04j86O7ALCO.label: IP Rights Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S7jw4M04j86O7ALCO.definition: IP Rights Management refers to the process of managing and protecting the legal rights associated with intellectual property assets, such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S9ASKtG0EZZj3a4ou.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Franklin County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S9ASKtG0EZZj3a4ou.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Franklin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8S9Op9EiFQvTngpJ5n.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Decatur Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8S9Op9EiFQvTngpJ5n.definition: A court located in Marion County, Decatur Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SBI3x3TFVnxpSe2TL.label: Salary Deferral Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SBI3x3TFVnxpSe2TL.definition: A Salary Deferral Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that allows an employee to defer a portion of their salary to a later date, typically for retirement savings purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SCEafhkCA6MFM4zfj.label: Increase of Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SCEafhkCA6MFM4zfj.definition: Increase of public benefit refers to the action of raising the amount or level of financial assistance or services granted to an individual or family under a specific public benefit program. This can occur due to changes in a recipient's circumstances, such as increased financial hardship, or modifications to eligibility criteria, and usually involves an administrative process for reevaluation and approval.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SK2JSEusj02qBISiZ.label: Lac Vieux Desert Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SLYHvXhM4OuMhZqaT.label: Legal Operations Consulting Services
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SLYHvXhM4OuMhZqaT.definition: Legal Operations Consulting Services refers to professional advice and guidance provided by experts in the field of legal operations management, including strategic planning, process improvement, and technology implementation, to help law firms and legal departments optimize their operations and achieve their business objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SLaqeL3IoFDECzZtR.label: European Parliament
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SLaqeL3IoFDECzZtR.definition: The European Parliament is one of the legislative bodies of the European Union, composed of members elected by citizens of the member states. It shares the power to legislate, supervise, and budget with the Council of the European Union, representing the interests of EU citizens.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SQ1qC9DBq8ApbGEWH.label: Outstanding Professor or Researcher Immigrant Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SQ1qC9DBq8ApbGEWH.definition: An Outstanding Professor or Researcher Immigrant Petition (in the U.S., I-140 EB-1) allows universities or private employers to sponsor foreign nationals who are internationally recognized as outstanding in their academic field. Applicants must demonstrate at least three years of experience in teaching or research and show evidence of significant achievements. Applicants must demonstrate international recognition for your outstanding achievements in a particular academic field, have at least three years of experience in teaching or research in that academic area, and be entering the United States to pursue tenure or a tenure-track teaching position or a comparable research position at a university, institution of higher education, or private employer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SU49WTqAr53LfDfXN.label: L430 Written Motions and Submissions
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SU49WTqAr53LfDfXN.definition: A written request or argument submitted to a court or other legal authority during the trial preparation and trial phases of a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SWmzPcrmcS8LDGj2c.label: DUPLICATIVE: Attempt
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SWmzPcrmcS8LDGj2c.definition: An attempt to duplicate something that is no longer in use.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SXsuhOb76PDAHy1Sk.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plans Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SXsuhOb76PDAHy1Sk.definition: Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs) Law refers to the legal framework governing the establishment, management, and regulation of ESOPs, which allow employees to acquire ownership interests in their employer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Scl6Rq9sPzgThnTlk.label: Likelihood of Adverse Result
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Scl6Rq9sPzgThnTlk.definition: Likelihood of an adverse result (e.g., client liability, client convicted) — sometimes expressed as a percentage, and sometimes expressed as a classification (e.g., Very High, High, Medium, Low)

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SmjtKjXa7BlkZuLWR.label: 440 Other Civil Rights (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SmjtKjXa7BlkZuLWR.definition: Action alleging a civil rights violation other than the specific civil rights categories listed below or a violation related to prison. Example: Action alleging excessive force by police incident to an arrest. (Excludes claims against corrections officials)

http://lmss.sali.org/R8SvWG0grgB1s3Oc8q4.label: Statutory Claim of Venue
http://lmss.sali.org/R8SvWG0grgB1s3Oc8q4.definition: A Statutory Claim of Venue is a legal argument made by a party in a case that asserts a specific location where the case should be heard, based on a specific statute or law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Sz0s9t0f50ZJbxuJy.label: Careless Contractual Work
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Sz0s9t0f50ZJbxuJy.definition: Careless Contractual Work refers to a breach of contract claim that arises when a party fails to exercise reasonable care in the performance of their contractual obligations, resulting in harm or damages to the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8T3eoIe1jDNksj1nug.label: UTBMS MK00 Deal Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8T3eoIe1jDNksj1nug.definition: UTBMS MK00 Deal Management refers to the specific code used in the Uniform Task-Based Management System to categorize legal tasks related to managing deals, such as mergers and acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8T3nkxnHHyC9QS9zdl.label: New York County Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8T3nkxnHHyC9QS9zdl.definition: New York County Court is a court of general jurisdiction located in New York County, New York, which hears both civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8T5pbCMvSogrWlJq4X.label: Indemnification of Employee Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8T5pbCMvSogrWlJq4X.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and protect an employee of the other party from any legal claims or losses arising from their work or actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8T6tbHMWYiBEtN98Dn.label: Immigration Extension
http://lmss.sali.org/R8T6tbHMWYiBEtN98Dn.definition: "Immigration Extension" is the process of applying to prolong the duration of an individual's current immigration status, such as a visa or permit, allowing them to stay in the destination country beyond the original expiration date, typically requiring documentation and approval from immigration authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TDryFVDoO7ZkD1zSq.label: Washington Superior Court - Kittitas County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TDryFVDoO7ZkD1zSq.definition: Washington Superior Court - Kittitas County: A specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Kittitas County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TEDsQW7oF8wnUVzGO.label: Trust Formation Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TEDsQW7oF8wnUVzGO.definition: A Trust Formation Document is a legal instrument used to establish a trust, specifying the terms under which assets are held by a trustee for the benefit of beneficiaries. This document outlines the purpose of the trust, the parties involved, and the legal framework governing the trust's operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TGm0eCxQrrdPecCDU.label: New Jersey District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TGm0eCxQrrdPecCDU.definition: The New Jersey District Court is a court within the New Jersey State Courts system that has jurisdiction over certain types of cases within a specific geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8THIhCQDpX9BgtDhsf.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/R8THIhCQDpX9BgtDhsf.definition: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) refers to a group of chronic conditions characterized by inflammation of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract. The primary forms of IBD are Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, both of which can cause symptoms such as abdominal pain, diarrhea, and weight loss, and may require ongoing medical management and, in severe cases, surgical intervention.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TMNc88LXU1QGrGGYq.label: Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me-Wuk Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TWoEHp9esCcIv9wCN.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Knox County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TWoEHp9esCcIv9wCN.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Knox County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Knox County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TYw0RFyM1FRjyfb6A.label: Georgia Superior Court - McIntosh County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TYw0RFyM1FRjyfb6A.definition: Georgia Superior Court - McIntosh County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within McIntosh County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TcoZums6Bey9dc1v7.label: Right of Sepulcher
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TcoZums6Bey9dc1v7.definition: The Right of Sepulcher is a legal claim that grants a person the right to control the burial and funeral arrangements of a deceased loved one.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TdEzcPmKmlt57CbOA.label: Not Guilty
http://lmss.sali.org/R8TdEzcPmKmlt57CbOA.definition: "Not guilty" is a legal determination made by a court in a criminal case when the defendant has been acquitted or found not responsible for the charges brought against them. It indicates that the prosecution failed to prove the defendant's guilt, and as a result, the defendant is not subject to criminal penalties or convictions for the alleged crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8TdveqJvhMYAkn6khV.label: Stipulated Judgment

These rights are often protected by international law and may include access to cultural and educational resources, protection of cultural heritage, and freedom to engage in cultural practices

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XMs89zuZc9chn6WQ9.label: Animal Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XMs89zuZc9chn6WQ9.definition: Animal Claims refer to legal claims related to harm caused by or to animals, including liability for injury to pets, cruelty to animals, animal attacks, trespassing livestock causing harm, dangerous domesticated animals, injury caused by wild animals, and negligent handling of animals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XQGAi1N0JWYJ3YT4y.label: New York Community Justice Center - Redhook
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XQGAi1N0JWYJ3YT4y.definition: A specialized court in New York City that aims to reduce crime and improve public trust in the justice system, located in the Redhook neighborhood.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XSHg9bgncgnUB5Xda.label: Geothermal Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XSHg9bgncgnUB5Xda.definition: Geothermal rights grant ownership or control over the heat energy stored beneath the earth's surface in a specific area. The holder of these rights can harness this energy for power generation or other purposes and may lease, sell, or transfer these rights to another entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XUf1TqJ74SPRoBiop.label: Motion to Stay the Mandate
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XUf1TqJ74SPRoBiop.definition: A Motion to Stay the Mandate is a request made to a higher court to temporarily suspend the enforcement of a decision made by a lower court until the appeal process is completed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XYr38AveQ9CS79lnO.label: Payor
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XYr38AveQ9CS79lnO.definition: A person legally obligated to pay.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XbDT15o2VgPwJQmeN.label: Financial Reporting Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XbDT15o2VgPwJQmeN.definition: Financial Reporting Law encompasses the regulations and standards governing the disclosure of financial information by entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xh6kVAQjF7V8TKbrD.label: Motion to Hear
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xh6kVAQjF7V8TKbrD.definition: A Motion to Hear is a formal request made by a party in a trial court to have a specific matter or issue heard by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XiN2fWrOwJ5UIfnG2.label: Ship
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XiN2fWrOwJ5UIfnG2.definition: A Ship is a large watercraft designed for deep-water navigation, typically used for transporting goods, passengers, or military personnel over long distances. Ships are equipped with various facilities and systems for navigation, safety, and cargo handling.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xog8HfRqeibD6dtbU.label: Motion to File Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xog8HfRqeibD6dtbU.definition: A Motion to File Appendix is a formal request made to a court to include additional documents or evidence in the record of a case, beyond what has already been submitted.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XqrkTtzwDo9hrSPrD.label: Arkansas District Court - Carroll Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XqrkTtzwDo9hrSPrD.definition: A court located in Carroll County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xrium2aVaYqlV8F4U.label: Intellectual Property Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Xrium2aVaYqlV8F4U.definition: Intellectual Property Management refers to the process of managing and protecting intangible assets such as patents, trademarks, copyrights, and domain names.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XwFrJuWIwLcyBNEkI.label: Extendible Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XwFrJuWIwLcyBNEkI.definition: An Extendible Asset is a financial instrument that allows the redemption date to be extended at the option of the issuer or the holder. This feature provides additional flexibility, enabling the extension of the asset's maturity under predefined conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8XxCPX0obhOk013uLp.label: Default Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8XxCPX0obhOk013uLp.definition: A default clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the consequences if one party fails to fulfill their obligations under the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Y9sDLe5XeFbzoBt8d.label: Efik
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Y9sDLe5XeFbzoBt8d.definition: Efik is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YA4v37gGvqOV4PG5i.label: Household Appliances and Electrical and Electronic Goods Merchant Wholesalers Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YA4v37gGvqOV4PG5i.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of electrical apparatus and equipment, wiring supplies, and related equipment; household appliances, electric housewares, and consumer electronics; and other electronic parts and equipment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YBf8Plir549jdl8lk.label: Treaty Skilled Worker Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YBf8Plir549jdl8lk.definition: This visa category (in the U.S., TN-2 Visa) applies to skilled professionals in treaty-signatory countries. In the United States, this non-immigrant visa allows the individual to work in the U.S. under the provisions of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), which was replaced by the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA). The initial period of stay is up to three years, but extensions can be granted in three-year increments

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YBhfiALaEYcnZJ9DM.label: Notify Consulate Abroad
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YBhfiALaEYcnZJ9DM.definition: "Notifying Consulate Abroad" involves informing a consulate or embassy in a foreign country about an individual's intent to apply for a visa or immigration benefit, initiating the process of obtaining the necessary documentation and approval for entry or residency in the destination country.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YEKFiYkowitD7dlvV.label: Adult
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YEKFiYkowitD7dlvV.definition: An adult is an individual who has reached the age of maturity as defined by law, typically marking the transition from childhood to full legal autonomy and responsibility. The specific age at which this transition occurs varies by jurisdiction, but it is commonly 18 or 21 years old.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YHVip80BTyOcnFNfD.label: State of Emergency
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YHVip80BTyOcnFNfD.definition: A State of Emergency is a governmental declaration that suspends normal constitutional procedures to address a crisis, disaster, or other extraordinary situation. This status grants special powers to authorities to implement measures necessary to manage the emergency, often involving restrictions on normal civil liberties and government operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YJTRhHvp1SM1F3try.label: Real Estate Broker's Constructive Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YJTRhHvp1SM1F3try.definition: Real Estate Broker's Constructive Fraud: A type of constructive fraud that occurs when a real estate broker misrepresents or conceals material facts with the intent to deceive, causing harm to the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YKevEQMvnDljIgewW.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lackawanna County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YKevEQMvnDljIgewW.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lackawanna County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YMVMAr8OFlouOGxvn.label: Recruitment Commission
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YMVMAr8OFlouOGxvn.definition: A commission for recruitment refers to a fee or payment that recruiters or staffing agencies receive for successfully finding and placing candidates in job positions for employers. This compensation is typically a percentage of the candidate's first-year salary and serves as an incentive for recruiters to match suitable candidates with job opportunities

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YOS0RtLYgPopBKbZQ.label: tax_tier_total_taxable_amount

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YPLTfN7GcfLUe561a.label: Recreational Vehicle
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YPLTfN7GcfLUe561a.definition: A recreational vehicle (RV) is a motorized or towable vehicle equipped with living accommodations, typically including sleeping, cooking, and bathroom facilities. RVs are used for travel, camping, and recreation, providing a mobile home away from home for individuals and families.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8YQkBevCduWpKda55v.label: Actions Taken with Consent or Approval of Buyer Language
http://lmss.sali.org/R8YQkBevCduWpKda55v.definition: Actions Taken with Consent or Approval of Buyer Language refers to the specific language in a legal agreement that outlines the actions that can be taken by one party with the consent or approval of the other party, typically in the context of a Material Adverse Effect (MAE) carveout.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8Yb5K15AqsVB29ypxH.label: Motion to File Addendum
http://lmss.sali.org/R8Yb5K15AqsVB29ypxH.definition: A Motion to File Addendum is a formal request made to an appellate court to allow the submission of additional information or evidence to be included in the record on appeal.
