http://lmss.sali.org/R8kjLrbGIJHik38V31B.definition: A Termination of Employment Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which an employer may end the employment relationship with an employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kklvRS0txCX6vk7mU.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Allegheny County, Civil Division
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kklvRS0txCX6vk7mU.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Allegheny County, Civil Division is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that handles civil cases in Allegheny County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kmQMgCr7HN4i77QrZ.label: Mortgage Contingency Loan Exacting Illegal Commission
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kmQMgCr7HN4i77QrZ.definition: A Mortgage Contingency Loan Exacting Illegal Commission is a type of loan in which the lender charges an illegal commission to the borrower, and the loan is contingent upon the borrower obtaining a mortgage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kmkbl5tqKfNDvX5GK.label: Signing Bonus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kmkbl5tqKfNDvX5GK.definition: A signing bonus clause is a provision in a contract that provides for an additional payment to be made to an individual upon signing the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ks4EFK3G3kUjRP4Fu.label: Death
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ks4EFK3G3kUjRP4Fu.definition: Death, in a legal context, marks the end of a person's life, as well as the termination of an individual's legal rights and duties. It initiates the probate process, where a deceased's estate is settled, debts are paid, and assets are distributed to heirs or beneficiaries according to a will or intestate laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ktJqdQifgzEaV2DJk.label: expense segment
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ktJqdQifgzEaV2DJk.definition: Expense segment refers to a specific component within the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard, which includes information such as charge date, units, work location, expense code, and total amount for billing purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kuuSDAoKCp6Qf5r0r.label: Georgia Superior Court - Long County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kuuSDAoKCp6Qf5r0r.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Long County: A specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Long County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kx7Pf1pAd4rPpvFex.label: Travel Document Issued Date
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kx7Pf1pAd4rPpvFex.definition: The Travel Document Issued Date is the specific date on which a travel document like a passport or visa was officially issued by the relevant authority. This date is important for determining the document's validity period and is often required when applying for visas or entering foreign countries

http://lmss.sali.org/R8kzhwTd7KeEPjyAyHR.label: Defending Deposition
http://lmss.sali.org/R8kzhwTd7KeEPjyAyHR.definition: Defending Deposition refers to the legal process of representing a party in a deposition and protecting their interests, typically in response to a legal dispute or claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8l6PNZlEOv8nFmdeHb.label: Credit Issuer Dishonoring or Repudiating
http://lmss.sali.org/R8l6PNZlEOv8nFmdeHb.definition: The concept of "Credit Issuer Dishonoring or Repudiating" refers to the act of a bank or other entity failing to honor or refusing to acknowledge a debt or obligation owed to a creditor, typically involving commercial paper or other financial instruments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lGEk1h42ZjiKM5FK2.label: Regulatory Exemption
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lGEk1h42ZjiKM5FK2.definition: Regulatory exemption refers to a provision that allows an individual, business, or activity to be excused from complying with certain rules or requirements typically imposed by a regulatory authority. Exemptions are usually granted to promote specific policy objectives or because the standard regulations are deemed unnecessary or overly burdensome in particular cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lHFxyABf5pHFBmo1g.label: Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lJBYa0F2dwqHWpGpL.label: Breach of No-Shop Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lJBYa0F2dwqHWpGpL.definition: The Breach of No-Shop Covenant refers to the violation of a contractual agreement between parties involved in a business transaction, where one party agrees not to solicit or entertain offers from other potential buyers for a specified period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lLBrXn05NcbvWN7xA.label: Retroactive Effectiveness Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lLBrXn05NcbvWN7xA.definition: A Retroactive Effectiveness Clause is a provision in a contract that makes it effective from a date before it was actually signed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lSNI0PHUoSSYL7VtP.label: Lease Assumption Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lSNI0PHUoSSYL7VtP.definition: A Lease Assumption Agreement is a legal contract that allows a new tenant to take over the lease of a property from the original tenant, with the consent of the landlord, and outlines the terms and conditions of the transfer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lUhXZL4bmYUDGjCyK.label: Motion for Misjoinder of Parties
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lUhXZL4bmYUDGjCyK.definition: A Motion for Misjoinder of Parties is a legal document filed by a party in response to a complaint, requesting the court to dismiss the case due to improper joinder of parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lZOWTlcK5fZVxv30q.label: Louisiana Department of Labor - Office of Workers' Compensation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lZOWTlcK5fZVxv30q.definition: The Louisiana Department of Labor - Office of Workers' Compensation is a government agency responsible for administering workers' compensation proceedings in Louisiana State Courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8laa4RmOrW4EmaV7FX.label: Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8laa4RmOrW4EmaV7FX.definition: An Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive (AIFMD) Claim refers to a legal action or regulatory complaint arising from the alleged breach or non-compliance with the AIFMD, which regulates managers of alternative investment funds (AIFs) in the European Union. These claims often involve issues related to investor protection, transparency, and the marketing and management of AIFs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lbOgBIHIIDXw31RR7.label: Supremacy Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lbOgBIHIIDXw31RR7.definition: A Supremacy Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on the Supremacy Clause of the United States Constitution, asserting that federal law prevails over conflicting state or local laws when they are in direct conflict. It establishes the principle that the Constitution, federal laws, and treaties take precedence over inconsistent state laws, ensuring a consistent and unified legal framework throughout the United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ld5fuznk2KgKLafAE.label: Trade Dress Dilution
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ld5fuznk2KgKLafAE.definition: The concept of Trade Dress Dilution refers to a legal claim that protects the distinctiveness and uniqueness of a company's product or service design from being weakened or diluted by similar designs used by competitors, which may cause confusion among consumers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ldDGTh6RHzt0IDL7p.label: Crimes Against Property
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ldDGTh6RHzt0IDL7p.definition: To willfully or maliciously destroy, damage, deface, or otherwise injure real or personal property without the consent of the owner or the person having custody or control of it.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lgJl0ey9KySLmQdw1.label: New York City Court - Lockport
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lgJl0ey9KySLmQdw1.definition: A court located in Lockport, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lhhP1c4Hm9RruhEpW.label: Trusts and Estate Planning Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lhhP1c4Hm9RruhEpW.definition: Trusts and Estate Planning Events refer to significant occurrences, like death, funeral, or incapacity, that trigger the provisions and directives outlined in estate planning documents. Such events necessitate actions like asset distribution, trust activation, or execution of end-of-life directives to ensure the deceased or incapacitated individual's wishes are honored.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ljLQwD2ZfUw6DFiBD.label: Cow Creek Band of Umpqua Tribe of Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ljsyofqbjPd8V1LNV.label: Sole Shareholder Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ljsyofqbjPd8V1LNV.definition: A Sole Shareholder Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the rights and obligations of a shareholder who owns all of the outstanding shares of a corporation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lkSfOpjFlx0hkkOvC.label: Lease Termination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lkSfOpjFlx0hkkOvC.definition: A lease termination clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which a lease agreement can be ended before its natural expiration date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lmBq0wKyXYXR8m7en.label: Collective Bargaining Event
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lmBq0wKyXYXR8m7en.definition: A formal negotiation process between an employer (or group of employers) and a group of employees (or their representatives, usually a union) aimed at reaching agreements on employment conditions. This event typically involves discussions on wages, working hours, benefits, and other terms of employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lmmL3rdkaA4qJ31x3.label: Multi-District Litigation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lmmL3rdkaA4qJ31x3.definition: Multi-District Litigation (MDL) refers to a legal procedure where multiple related cases from different jurisdictions are consolidated and transferred to a single court for pretrial proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lnpnx0d18K5lUlsPc.label: By Time with Standard Rates
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lnpnx0d18K5lUlsPc.definition: A method of billing for legal services based on the amount of time spent on a task using standard rates.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lpuELvxz47gLtnJQs.label: Health and Personal Care Retailers Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lpuELvxz47gLtnJQs.definition: Industries in the Health and Personal Care Retailers subsector retail health and personal care merchandise.  Establishments in this subsector are characterized principally by the products they retail, and some health and personal care retailers have specialized staff including pharmacists, opticians, and other professionals engaged in retailing, advising customers, and/or fitting the product sold to the customer's needs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lqYUyAceKZxTgybrD.label: Hassanamisco Band of the Nipmuc Nation

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lqqKPmifNK2vDWzRQ.label: Personal Property Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lqqKPmifNK2vDWzRQ.definition: Law relating to personal property — not real property — such as damage to vehicles, ownership of valuables (e.g., jewelry), trespass to chattels, etc.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ltWSvJgHxq0FIdULj.label: Japanese
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ltWSvJgHxq0FIdULj.definition: Japanese (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a means of document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect, and is a subcategory of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ludoWmVMfon7jd8o6.label: Motion to File Noncomforming Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ludoWmVMfon7jd8o6.definition: A Motion to File Nonconforming Brief is a request made to the court to allow a party to file a brief that does not comply with the court's rules or standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ly82UzT3qEXtZR0pc.label: Depressive, Bipolar and Related Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ly82UzT3qEXtZR0pc.definition: Depressive, Bipolar, and Related Disorders encompass a range of mental health conditions characterized by significant mood disturbances. These disorders are characterized by an irritable, depressed, elevated, or expansive mood, or by a loss of interest or pleasure in all or almost all activities, causing a clinically significant decline in functioning. Symptoms and signs may include, but are not limited to, feelings of hopelessness or guilt, suicidal ideation, a clinically significant change in body weight or appetite, sleep disturbances, an increase or decrease in energy, psychomotor abnormalities, disturbed concentration, pressured speech, grandiosity, reduced impulse control, sadness, euphoria, and social withdrawal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8lzdOOZaSGSmPB3aaE.label: Holdover Eviction Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8lzdOOZaSGSmPB3aaE.definition: A holdover eviction claim is a legal action initiated by a landlord against a tenant who remains in a rented property after the lease or rental agreement has expired. In such cases, the tenant is often referred to as a "holdover tenant." The claim seeks the tenant's removal from the property due to their continued occupancy without a valid lease or rental agreement. The eviction process typically involves court proceedings to resolve the dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8m3St8sv9Xxcy5K83d.label: Waiver of Presentment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8m3St8sv9Xxcy5K83d.definition: A Waiver of Presentment Clause is a provision in a legal document that waives the requirement for a party to present a document or instrument for payment or acceptance before taking legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8m7PyvhxHbcEbu9ItY.label: Mandamus
http://lmss.sali.org/R8m7PyvhxHbcEbu9ItY.definition: A writ of mandamus is a civil remedy sought to compel a public official or entity to perform a duty that they are legally obligated to perform.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mBLAvdwmc4l41eWBK.label: Warden
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mBLAvdwmc4l41eWBK.definition: A Warden is the chief administrative officer of a correctional facility, responsible for overseeing all aspects of the facility's operations, including security, inmate management, staff supervision, and compliance with regulations. The Warden ensures the effective and humane treatment of inmates while maintaining order and safety within the institution.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mCB7w7tqtq6yOWvTx.label: Broadcast
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mCB7w7tqtq6yOWvTx.definition: A Broadcast is the transmission of audio and/or video content to a dispersed audience via electronic mass communication mediums such as radio, television, or internet streaming. Broadcasts can include news, entertainment, educational programs, and advertisements, reaching audiences in real-time or through scheduled programming.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mCsSoGFAK3ZNBZ7xF.label: Interest Payment in Kind
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mCsSoGFAK3ZNBZ7xF.definition: Interest Payment in Kind (PIK) is a method of paying interest on debt obligations using additional securities or other non-cash assets instead of cash. This payment structure allows the issuer to defer cash outlays by increasing the principal amount of the debt or by issuing additional securities, typically used in situations where the issuer wants to conserve cash or lacks immediate liquidity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mFCqGeQBsy1vCeX92.label: Manzanita Band of Diegueno Mission Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mHvt7b97NBDaHEiSp.label: Early Termination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mHvt7b97NBDaHEiSp.definition: An Early Termination Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one or both parties to end the agreement before its natural expiration date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mIcAbTKuWzc5wwsNG.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Santa Fe County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mIcAbTKuWzc5wwsNG.definition: A court located in Santa Fe County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mKNKRoG3JBThsGgXE.label: Utilities Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mKNKRoG3JBThsGgXE.definition: A Utilities Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and obligations of the parties with respect to the provision and use of utilities, such as electricity, gas, water, and telecommunications services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mPqV8s5cgSKpmdWBx.label: Minnesota District Court - Rice County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mPqV8s5cgSKpmdWBx.definition: Minnesota District Court - Rice County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Rice County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mREFTbCVNHGAdqneL.label: Litigation Criminal Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mREFTbCVNHGAdqneL.definition: A criminal defense used in a legal proceeding to protect an individual accused of a crime from prosecution or punishment, specifically in the context of litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mRVhfZeh0jCUAFtlL.label: Indiana Superior Court - Jennings County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mRVhfZeh0jCUAFtlL.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Jennings County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mUCJdapej2NbVNEhV.label: Texas District Court - Gillespie County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mUCJdapej2NbVNEhV.definition: A Texas District Court in Gillespie County is a specific court within the Texas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Gillespie County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mVQPOiTPBSdYKLHfB.label: Slovenian
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mVQPOiTPBSdYKLHfB.definition: Slovenian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Slovenian language, which is used in legal matters such as documents, artifacts, evidence, testimony, proceedings, or any other legal aspect.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ma9cZh7KtvVXrmXmS.label: Institutional Investment Manager Holdings Report
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ma9cZh7KtvVXrmXmS.definition: Institutional Investment Manager Holdings Report is a report filed by institutional investment managers with the financial regulator (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) to disclose the investment manager's holdings in "in country" traded equities (e.g., within U.S.), options, and other securities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mcful9ybHs1jjHXvX.label: Occitan
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mcful9ybHs1jjHXvX.definition: Occitan (post 1500) is a language that developed after the year 1500 and is part of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mchuGv5Xvl9V7trgY.label: Software as a Service Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mchuGv5Xvl9V7trgY.definition: A SaaS Agreement governs the provision and use of cloud-based software services. It typically covers aspects like subscription terms, data handling, service levels, and terms of use.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mclXwzDGKYkjxaWVb.label: South American Indian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mclXwzDGKYkjxaWVb.definition: South American Indian languages are a group of structured systems of communication spoken by indigenous peoples in South America.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mdtiEByhNM1c8AfvQ.label: Spin-off
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mdtiEByhNM1c8AfvQ.definition: A spin-off divestiture is a corporate action in which a company separates a business unit, division, or subsidiary into a standalone, independent entity. In this process, shares of the new company are often distributed to existing shareholders of the parent company on a pro-rata basis. Spin-off divestitures are often undertaken to allow the separated entity to focus on its core competencies, unlock shareholder value, or comply with regulatory requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mgROREzBH1Pdp5yug.label: Georgia Superior Court - Dougherty County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mgROREzBH1Pdp5yug.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Dougherty County, Georgia, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mhr9YGlyTNig0Qdru.label: Synchronous Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mhr9YGlyTNig0Qdru.definition: A communication that occurs synchronously (at the same time), such as an in-person meeting, telephone call, or videoconference.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mhyaytzU3aWKoT5W7.label: Constructive Eviction of Tenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mhyaytzU3aWKoT5W7.definition: The Constructive Eviction of Tenant is a legal concept that occurs when a landlord's actions or omissions make a rental property uninhabitable, forcing the tenant to move out, and is considered a form of Unlawful Eviction of Tenant.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8miiXZzcMCmlChCuhl.label: AIDS
http://lmss.sali.org/R8miiXZzcMCmlChCuhl.definition: AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) is the advanced stage of HIV infection, characterized by a severely weakened immune system due to the significant loss of CD4 cells. This condition makes the body highly susceptible to opportunistic infections and certain cancers, requiring intensive medical treatment and supportive care.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mmaJHaK9fyr6FuVUq.label: Physical Elder Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mmaJHaK9fyr6FuVUq.definition: Physical Elder Abuse: The intentional use of force against an elderly person that results in physical pain, injury, or impairment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8moeCg3i0lZQ5CEjoo.label: Product Liability Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8moeCg3i0lZQ5CEjoo.definition: Product Liability Representation is a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party attests to the absence of product defects or claims arising from sold or distributed products of the target company. It serves to protect the buyer from potential undisclosed liabilities or claims related to product malfunctions, damages, or injuries that may arise after the acquisition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mv7WPb7PlAl2oknWr.label: Employee Benefits Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mv7WPb7PlAl2oknWr.definition: A request made by a debtor in a bankruptcy case seeking authorization to continue providing employee benefits, such as health insurance and retirement plans, to its employees.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mw82M2JL2CAKqkzh6.label: Freedom from Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mw82M2JL2CAKqkzh6.definition: Freedom from discrimination is a fundamental human right that entails the equal treatment of all individuals, regardless of race, gender, religion, nationality, disability, or other characteristics. This right is upheld by various international treaties and national laws, aiming to prevent unjust or prejudicial treatment based on a person's inherent traits or beliefs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mxTY8cKuN8Sy7FdDh.label: Notice of Status Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mxTY8cKuN8Sy7FdDh.definition: A Notice of Status Conference is a written communication that informs parties involved in a legal case of a scheduled meeting with the judge to discuss the current status of the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8mz8xGkeTyOUun1Ua0.label: Subsidized Healthcare Coverage Policy for Low-Income Groups
http://lmss.sali.org/R8mz8xGkeTyOUun1Ua0.definition: Subsidized healthcare programs like Medicaid in the U.S. provide medical coverage to low-income individuals and families. These programs are often funded by both state and federal governments, and eligibility criteria can vary by jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8n48IxRrEtKzQbaRVb.label: Non-Testifying Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/R8n48IxRrEtKzQbaRVb.definition: An expert whom a party retains for consultation, but the expert does not provide oral testimony or a written report.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8n7DXVA7hMX2rLuzQI.label: Motion to Cancel Meeting of Creditors
http://lmss.sali.org/R8n7DXVA7hMX2rLuzQI.definition: A Motion to Cancel Meeting of Creditors is a request made in a bankruptcy case to cancel the scheduled meeting of creditors, which is a meeting where the debtor is required to appear and answer questions under oath about their financial affairs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nAwoW16KIuykQfuJK.label: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court2
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nAwoW16KIuykQfuJK.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nD5zAAEzWQhizqQM7.label: Signed During Tail Period
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nD5zAAEzWQhizqQM7.definition: A contract or agreement that is executed during the final stage of an acquisition proposal, typically after the main terms have been agreed upon and before the deal is closed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nICrbcKzoElNkwEGS.label: Judicial Chambers Meeting
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nICrbcKzoElNkwEGS.definition: "Judicial chambers meeting" pertains to private discussions and exchanges of information among judges and their clerks or staff members within a court's administrative office or chambers. These communications can involve case-related matters, administrative issues, or legal research and are typically not part of the public record of court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nJTQh68R9-r_Z9-7-.label: WC130 Experts/Consultants
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nJTQh68R9-r_Z9-7-.definition: Identify medical experts and vocational experts, developing/reviewing Expert/Consultant Reports, communication with expert /consultants adjuster/employer/ nurse case manager regarding expert opinions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nKj8jCoF7tXLyAvph.label: AI Accuracy
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nKj8jCoF7tXLyAvph.definition: AI Accuracy is a metric within AI measurement that quantifies an AI system's proportion of correct (intended) predictions, compared to the total number of predictions. It serves as an indicator of how well an AI system performs in making accurate predictions, based on Ground Truth, encompassing both precision and recall, providing a comprehensive assessment of model performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nLFTTr3uGHv15w62f.label: Post-Judgment Interest
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nLFTTr3uGHv15w62f.definition: Post-Judgment Interest refers to the interest that accrues on a monetary award after a judgment has been entered by a court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nNqRKHdgIKZbyfzAg.label: Married
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nNqRKHdgIKZbyfzAg.definition: The concept of "Married (Marital Status)" refers to the legal status of being married, indicating that an individual has entered into a legally recognized union with another person.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nPMRM8xK1s7egzCI4.label: Air Quality Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nPMRM8xK1s7egzCI4.definition: Law governing the regulation and control of air pollution, including emission standards, monitoring requirements, and enforcement measures aimed at protecting public health and the environment from harmful airborne pollutants.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nR5H55okqmY6MA8IJ.label: Misappropriation of Name
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nR5H55okqmY6MA8IJ.definition: The Misappropriation of Name is a legal claim that arises when someone uses another person's name or likeness for commercial gain without their consent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nREeU6lB0zs0dt9N3.label: Actor Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nREeU6lB0zs0dt9N3.definition: Actor Attributes: Characteristics or qualities that define the role or position of a person involved in a legal matter, including their level of involvement (inside, outside, lead, local, supporting).

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nvlmwJzNQu4OM3Zwp.definition: "Immigration Process Modifications" encompass actions such as amendments, renewals, and extensions within the immigration process, where changes are made to existing immigration applications or statuses, allowing individuals to update, extend, or renew their legal presence or rights within the destination country. http://lmss.sali.org/R8nw59IHgnkM4RijICl.definition: A requirements contract clause is a provision in a contract that obligates one party to purchase goods or services exclusively from the other party for a specified period of time, based on the buyer's needs.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nycgMSnQGSzh9Lvnq.definition: Debt financing occurs when a firm raises money for working capital or capital expenditures by selling debt instruments to individuals and/or institutional investors. In return for lending the money, the individuals or institutions become creditors and receive a promise that the principal and interest on the debt will be repaid.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8nzGmaooF9VdUO5jEL.label: Evasion Attack
http://lmss.sali.org/R8nzGmaooF9VdUO5jEL.definition: An evasion attack is one of the most common attacks on machine learning models performed during production. It involves designing an input that appears normal to a human but is misclassified by ML models, affecting their behavior; a typical example includes altering pixels in an image to cause an image recognition system to fail in classification.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8o0lzPUMDOV8nWAfYH.label: Agency Service Provider
http://lmss.sali.org/R8o0lzPUMDOV8nWAfYH.definition: An Agency Service Provider in project finance transactions acts as an intermediary between the various parties involved, ensuring smooth communication and coordination. examples: Bank Acting As An Administrative Agent For A Syndicated Loan
Financial Institution Managing Communication Between Lenders And Borrowers
Service Provider Overseeing Compliance In A Project Finance Deal

http://lmss.sali.org/R8o3msiN3MfLDSiYFsz.label: Application for Copyright Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/R8o3msiN3MfLDSiYFsz.definition: An Application for Copyright Registration is a formal submission to a copyright office to secure legal protection for an original work of authorship. http://lmss.sali.org/R8o5aT4858rVxNv8e4c.definition: The Active Inducement of Patent Infringement refers to the intentional and knowing encouragement or assistance provided by one party to another in the act of infringing a patent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8o666peng6V5762Clx.label: Operational Efficiency
http://lmss.sali.org/R8o666peng6V5762Clx.definition: Operational Efficiency is the measure of how effectively a business converts inputs into outputs. It gauges the optimal utilization of resources to maximize revenue. Commonly calculated as the ratio of output to input within a specific time period, operational efficiency is often expressed as a percentage. If that percentage is higher, then the business is more operationally efficient.

This type of support is typically awarded when there is a significant income disparity between the spouses and the recipient spouse is unable to achieve financial self-sufficiency. The duration and amount of long-term spousal support are determined by court decisions or agreements between the parties and may consider factors such as the length of the marriage and the recipient spouse's needs.

It provides an opinion on the fairness and accuracy of an organization's compliance with applicable laws, standards, and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8qrNz3f9tQrFNxbNoW.label: D.C. Bar Legal Ethics Opinions
http://lmss.sali.org/R8qrNz3f9tQrFNxbNoW.definition: D.C. Bar Legal Ethics Opinions are official statements issued by the District of Columbia Courts regarding the ethical responsibilities of lawyers practicing in the District of Columbia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8qwdsgAn7Q1AOzytfy.definition: A Shareholding Structure Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the ownership and distribution of shares in a company among its shareholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8r0fE60KG2VwRq1Owb.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings
http://lmss.sali.org/R8r0fE60KG2VwRq1Owb.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings is a formal request made to a court or tribunal to temporarily halt or pause legal proceedings, typically until a certain condition is met or a specific event occurs.

"

http://lmss.sali.org/R8r3hX4cDNhyDTmzgm9.label: Compliance with Law Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8r3hX4cDNhyDTmzgm9.definition: A Compliance with Law Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8r4VVr8FSVNZsWEuQV.label: Florida Circuit Court - Highlands County - 10th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8r4VVr8FSVNZsWEuQV.definition: A court located in Highlands County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8r67x9DvibBWybkIqx.label: Uterus Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R8r67x9DvibBWybkIqx.definition: Uterus cancer refers to malignant tumors originating in the tissues of the uterus, including the endometrium (lining of the uterus) and the myometrium (muscular layer of the uterus). It encompasses various subtypes, with endometrial carcinoma being the most common, and can cause symptoms such as abnormal vaginal bleeding, pelvic pain, and weight loss.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8r7xew01V3RGWsfGtb.label: Romance languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R8r7xew01V3RGWsfGtb.definition: Romance languages are a group of languages that evolved from Latin and are primarily spoken in Western Europe and Latin America.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rFrUWj5Lyx75Z9MuX.label: 893 Environmental Matters (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rFrUWj5Lyx75Z9MuX.definition: Action filed under Air Pollution Control Act 42:1857-57L, Clean Air Act 42:1857:57L, Federal Environment Pesticide Control Act, Federal Insecticide, Fungicide & Rodenticide Act 7:135, Federal Water Pollution Control Act 33:1151 et seq., Land & Water Conservation Fund Act 16:4602,460 1-4, Motor Vehicle Air Pollution Control Act 42:1857F-1-8, National Environmental Policy Act 42:4321, 4331-35G, 4341-47, River &  Harbor Act penalty 3:401-437, 1251.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rHQa0gtDXGl7hzMKn.label: Analysis of Financial Reports
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rHQa0gtDXGl7hzMKn.definition: Analysis of Financial Reports refers to the process of examining and evaluating financial statements and other financial information to assess the financial health and performance of an individual or organization, as part of the broader legal obligation analysis.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rIjfy8ZkiLZ0gcCDw.label: Private Fund Reporting Form
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rIjfy8ZkiLZ0gcCDw.definition: Private Fund Reporting Form (in the U.S., Form PF) is a regulatory filing required by the regulatory authority (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) for private fund advisers managing hedge funds and other private funds, providing detailed information about their activities and assets under management. In the U.S., this form aims to assist the Financial Stability Oversight Council (FSOC) in monitoring systemic risk in the financial markets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rKmN0Xq06SOFecJFM.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Baxter Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rKmN0Xq06SOFecJFM.definition: A court located in Baxter County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rNA0tMngePxr57JgG.label: 751 Family and Medical Leave Act (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rNA0tMngePxr57JgG.definition: Action filed under the Family Medical Leave Act, 29 U.S.C. § 2601

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rNpWBb4BfCEdoREGP.label: Contract Review Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rNpWBb4BfCEdoREGP.definition: Contract Review Management refers to the process of systematically examining and analyzing contracts to ensure compliance with legal requirements and organizational policies, as well as identifying and mitigating potential risks and liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rRlOKgRaKi5Zubt18.label: Motion for Summary Reversal
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rRlOKgRaKi5Zubt18.definition: A Motion for Summary Reversal is a legal request made to a higher court to overturn a lower court's decision without a full appeal, based on the argument that the lower court made a legal error.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rVZpE5cTR7pJiDKxU.label: JM30 Hearings (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rVZpE5cTR7pJiDKxU.definition: Includes preparation for and attendance at hearings for directions and interim certificate applications as well as the detailed assessment itself

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rXyHyHKWqqlml4e0t.label: Tajik
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rXyHyHKWqqlml4e0t.definition: Tajik (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken or written in Tajikistan and parts of Uzbekistan, Afghanistan, and China.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rd3ksoSQ6HG1znf9z.label: Derivatives and Futures Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rd3ksoSQ6HG1znf9z.definition: Law governing the regulation, trading, and enforcement of derivative financial instruments and futures contracts, including options, swaps, and forward contracts, aimed at ensuring market integrity, transparency, and the management of financial risk in derivatives markets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rdUWolGkCREY6mxkI.label: Visa for Victim of Human Trafficking
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rdUWolGkCREY6mxkI.definition: The Visa for Victim of Human Trafficking is a nonimmigrant visa granted to victims of severe forms of human trafficking, who are physically present in the U.S. due to trafficking and are cooperating with law enforcement in the investigation or prosecution of the trafficking crimes. The visa provides temporary legal status in the U.S. and can lead to a Green Card after a specified period and conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rgsxWmEx8qQqXMEtu.label: Fiduciary Exemption to Change of Recommendation Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rgsxWmEx8qQqXMEtu.definition: A fiduciary exemption to change of recommendation covenant is a legal concept that allows a fiduciary to deviate from a previously agreed-upon recommendation in certain circumstances, without breaching their fiduciary duty.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rmINPJcI5dRjZrlQZ.label: Trusts and Estate Planning Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rmINPJcI5dRjZrlQZ.definition: Trusts and Estate Planning Law involves the legal planning and management of a person's assets and property during their lifetime and after their death, including the creation and administration of trusts, wills, and other estate planning documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rp4pVVEUdC5SuV0nq.label: 555 Prison Condition (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rp4pVVEUdC5SuV0nq.definition: Action by current prisoner, or former prisoner or their families alleging a civil rights, Federal Tort Claims Act, or state law claim with respect to a condition of prison life, whether general circumstances or particular episodes. Examples: inadequate medical care or excessive force by prison guards. Includes non-habeas actions by alien detainees alleging unlawful prison conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rprHiAMCXQXEOJd2l.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Lafayette County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rprHiAMCXQXEOJd2l.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Lafayette County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lafayette County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8ru0vJNHyGHLWcLe9X.label: Primary Election
http://lmss.sali.org/R8ru0vJNHyGHLWcLe9X.definition: A primary election is a preliminary election in which voters of a political party select candidates for a subsequent general election. Primary elections can also determine party delegates for nominating conventions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rv9qLRykKHJzBVV2X.label: Remote Trial Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rv9qLRykKHJzBVV2X.definition: Remote Trial Management refers to the process of managing a legal case remotely, including tasks such as scheduling, document management, and communication, typically conducted through virtual means.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8rxAf8YIYXBeQ8W8vJ.label: Loss of Parental Consortium
http://lmss.sali.org/R8rxAf8YIYXBeQ8W8vJ.definition: The loss of a parent's ability to provide love, affection, guidance, and support to their child due to injury or death caused by the negligence of another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8s0yR70Hwjc78Nrk2G.label: Assisting and Participating
http://lmss.sali.org/R8s0yR70Hwjc78Nrk2G.definition: Assisting and Participating refers to the act of aiding or supporting someone in the commission of a crime or other wrongful act, without necessarily being directly involved in the act itself.
