http://lmss.sali.org/R8s2P5JRpeYL9T6wkTW.definition:
"The name of the client as required by the client in the electronic submission.  Used as a key by the receiving system.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sBMSbqzdgUgBpLAYf.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 2
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sBMSbqzdgUgBpLAYf.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 2 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sE5cUzstzT3PI03RK.label: O-2 Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sE5cUzstzT3PI03RK.definition: An O-2 visa is issued to individuals who provide essential support services to O-1 visa holders, allowing them to enter the U.S. to assist in the performance of the O-1 visa holder’s work. This visa category includes personnel whose skills are integral to the successful performance of the O-1 visa holder.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sE5cUzstzT3PI03RK.pref_label: Support Staff Visa For Extraordinary Talent

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sHYur0w2BE0hztLtM.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Indiana County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sHYur0w2BE0hztLtM.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Indiana County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases within Indiana County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sIRvD8VHcXHmMNAc5.label: Leguminous Vegetables
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sIRvD8VHcXHmMNAc5.definition: Leguminous vegetables, also known as legumes or pulses, are a category of vegetables from the legume family (Fabaceae), known for their pod-bearing growth habit and nutrient-rich seeds. They are consumed as a protein source in diets worldwide and are valued for their high protein, fiber, vitamin, and mineral content, as well as their role in improving soil fertility through nitrogen fixation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sIipxJfqJ8ILg1TS3.label: Grass Roots Organization and Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sIipxJfqJ8ILg1TS3.definition: Grass Roots Organization and Management involves providing legal advice and support for the creation, development, and governance of community-based, often volunteer-driven, organizations. This practice includes structuring the organization, ensuring regulatory compliance, and facilitating effective grassroots campaigns and advocacy efforts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sLSP3fcYlpo2TNHby.label: Secondary Offering Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sLSP3fcYlpo2TNHby.definition: Secondary Offering Practice involves the sale of shares by existing shareholders, typically through a public offering, after the company's initial public offering (IPO). It includes the legal and regulatory processes to ensure compliance with securities laws and protect investors' interests.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sMcpQMoO3EOWAx73l.label: Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sMcpQMoO3EOWAx73l.definition: Religion refers to a set of beliefs, practices, and values centered around the worship of one or more deities, a higher power, or a guiding moral or ethical principle. In many jurisdictions, including the United States, it is unlawful to discriminate against individuals based on their religion or religious beliefs in various contexts, such as employment, housing, and public services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sP07TrV8J1AcB5noa.label: Medical Transport Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sP07TrV8J1AcB5noa.definition: Medical transport negligence refers to a claim of medical malpractice that arises from the negligent transportation of a patient, such as by ambulance or air transport.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sTJi1WLjNXSLoxic2.label: Florida Circuit Court - Union County - 8th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sTJi1WLjNXSLoxic2.definition: A court located in Union County, Florida that is part of the 8th Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sXq1TT3Bft1020Iks.label: Cremation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sXq1TT3Bft1020Iks.definition: Cremation is the process of reducing a deceased person's body to ashes through high-temperature burning. This practice serves as an alternative to traditional burial and is often chosen for cultural, religious, or practical reasons.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sZGaW5MSOXrBtsqN1.label: New York Appellate Division - 4th Dept.
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sZGaW5MSOXrBtsqN1.definition: The New York Appellate Division - 4th Dept. is a specific court within the New York Supreme Court - Appellate Division that hears appeals from lower courts in the western part of the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sZqYAFz71fYyeNtRD.label: Minnesota District Court - Red Lake County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sZqYAFz71fYyeNtRD.definition: A court located in Red Lake County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sd4v04cEXnzbttN2g.label: Vertebrate Animal
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sd4v04cEXnzbttN2g.definition: A Vertebrate Animal is a member of the subphylum Vertebrata within the phylum Chordata, characterized by having a backbone or spinal column. Vertebrates include a diverse group of animals such as mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish, all of which possess a well-defined internal skeleton and complex organ systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sf2WxI32nduJxQLmr.label: Lead Plaintiff
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sf2WxI32nduJxQLmr.definition: A plaintiff, usually among a group of plaintiffs (e.g., class action), who leads the plaintiff group.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sg6ZiCdJPHi2EUyh7.label: Social Assistance Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sg6ZiCdJPHi2EUyh7.definition: Industries in this group provide a wide variety of social assistance services directly to their clients. These services do not include residential or accommodation services, except on a short stay basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8sskZUTqRM7drGfBsK.label: Asset Depreciation
http://lmss.sali.org/R8sskZUTqRM7drGfBsK.definition: Asset Depreciation is the systematic decrease in the recorded value of an asset over time, typically due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or the passage of time. This accounting method allocates the cost of tangible assets over their useful life, reflecting the reduction in the asset's economic value.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t29mcCgDnprofEh5V.label: Tail Period Fee Triggers
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t29mcCgDnprofEh5V.definition: Tail Period Fee Triggers: A provision in a deal protection agreement that entitles the target company to receive a fee if a potential acquirer makes a bid within a certain period after the termination of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t3vR9aRVG8h1UgWT0.label: Real Property Defect Concealed by Seller
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t3vR9aRVG8h1UgWT0.definition: The concept of "Real Property Defect Concealed by Seller" refers to a situation in which a seller of real estate fails to disclose a known defect in the property to the buyer, which can result in legal claims related to the property and potential liability for the seller.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t5CSqYvG6L6Cl86vQ.label: Sale of Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t5CSqYvG6L6Cl86vQ.definition: The Sale of Goods is a legal concept that refers to the transfer of ownership of tangible personal property in exchange for money or other consideration, and is a type of contract or quasi-contract claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t5ZgAelF7GIF22HOq.label: Ohio Municipal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t5ZgAelF7GIF22HOq.definition: Ohio Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction in Ohio that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases within a specific geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t6ml1A9wI4Nz7X4rH.label: Language Access Right
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t6ml1A9wI4Nz7X4rH.definition: Language Access Right refers to the legal entitlement of individuals to receive assistance in understanding and communicating in the jurisdiction's dominant language (e.g., English) when interacting with government agencies or accessing public services. This right aims to eliminate language barriers that may prevent individuals, particularly those who are not proficient in the dominant language, from fully participating in civic activities or obtaining necessary services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8t7u58Bmu2hmFFto8S.label: Expert Fields
http://lmss.sali.org/R8t7u58Bmu2hmFFto8S.definition: The fields in which a person is an expert.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tEo7eLTGlfjDnmVgY.label: Motion for Injunction
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tEo7eLTGlfjDnmVgY.definition: A Motion for Injunction is a legal request made to a court to order a person or entity to stop doing a certain action or behavior, typically to prevent harm or damage to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tHU2UcmJzAEBDUdM5.label: Term Life Insurance
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tHU2UcmJzAEBDUdM5.definition: Term life insurance is a policy that provides coverage for a specified period, or "term," usually ranging from 10 to 30 years. If the insured individual dies within this term, the death benefit is paid out to the beneficiaries; however, if the term expires and the policyholder is still alive, there is generally no payout.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tHwZFllPzNEUgzUV3.label: Tax Tier Tax Percent
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tHwZFllPzNEUgzUV3.definition: Tax Tier Tax Percent refers to the percentage of tax applied to a specific tier of income or value, as a part of the Tax Tier Detail concept in legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tPYphBPF4fzyL7swX.label: Rincon Band of Luiseno Mission Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tRtkmUhSPhgqbY5D5.label: Zaza; Dimili; Dimli; Kirdki; Kirmanjki; Zazaki
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tRtkmUhSPhgqbY5D5.definition: A language spoken in parts of Turkey and Iran, including dialects such as Zaza, Dimili, Dimli, Kirdki, Kirmanjki, and Zazaki.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tSK2ASM9NyzsNs5wT.label: Bill of Attainder Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tSK2ASM9NyzsNs5wT.definition: A Bill of Attainder claim is a legal argument that a government has passed a bill of attainder: a law that legislatively determines guilt and inflicts punishment upon an individual without a judicial trial. This claim may arise when a law or action is perceived to inflict punishment without a trial, thus violating this provision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8te32edjcSUX4tMurh.label: Basque
http://lmss.sali.org/R8te32edjcSUX4tMurh.definition: Basque is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tnT9l9MwOJnd3la39.label: Provider Identifier
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tnT9l9MwOJnd3la39.definition: Identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) of the Provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) within the systems of stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts).

http://lmss.sali.org/R8triyPwuIUFKf6bDD6.label: Motion to Exclude Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R8triyPwuIUFKf6bDD6.definition: A Motion to Exclude Evidence is a formal request made to a court to prevent certain evidence from being presented at trial, typically on the grounds that it was obtained illegally or is otherwise inadmissible.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8tugkQDuOtwhIZjD4h.label: Tips
http://lmss.sali.org/R8tugkQDuOtwhIZjD4h.definition: Tips refer to additional payments received by service industry workers, such as waitstaff, bartenders, or delivery drivers, as a gratuity from customers for the provided service. They are considered a form of income and are often shared among staff or reported to tax authorities as part of an individual's earnings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8twGCWKPRCytRtmNOE.label: Noncontravention Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8twGCWKPRCytRtmNOE.definition: A Noncontravention Clause is a provision in a contract that ensures that the actions of one party will not violate any laws or agreements with third parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8u1phvZSRhhQRxC3m9.label: Environmental Report
http://lmss.sali.org/R8u1phvZSRhhQRxC3m9.definition: An Environmental Report is a structured document that provides an assessment of the environmental impact of a company's operations, projects, or activities. It often includes data on emissions, waste management, and compliance with environmental regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8u4eipKZkVmT9acNJC.label: Parkinson's Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/R8u4eipKZkVmT9acNJC.definition: Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the brain, leading to motor symptoms such as tremors, rigidity, bradykinesia (slowness of movement), and postural instability. It also includes non-motor symptoms like cognitive impairment, mood disorders, and autonomic dysfunction, requiring comprehensive medical and supportive care.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8u6odelVrsyEW3NFxO.label: A110 Manage data/files
http://lmss.sali.org/R8u6odelVrsyEW3NFxO.definition: The concept of A110 Manage data/files refers to the activity of organizing and controlling electronic or physical information and documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8u7CAB2KmMvx0wpzJ7.label: Audit
http://lmss.sali.org/R8u7CAB2KmMvx0wpzJ7.definition: An audit is a systematic examination and verification of an organization's financial and non-financial records, operational procedures, or a system's compliance with regulatory standards, usually carried out by an independent body.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8u8ZnC5K9DNlRCcMov.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Lancaster County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8u8ZnC5K9DNlRCcMov.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lancaster County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uBWMWwqnnRqkH4Bib.label: Fee Simple Determinable Interest
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uBWMWwqnnRqkH4Bib.definition: A fee simple determinable interest is a type of freehold estate in real property that automatically ends and reverts to the grantor upon the occurrence or non-occurrence of a specified event or condition. This estate is characterized by a possibility of reverter, where the original owner (or their heirs) has the right to reclaim ownership if the condition is breached.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uCJkVrnbXkz39DmzR.label: ZIP
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uCJkVrnbXkz39DmzR.definition: A file type that usually contains other files or directories that have been compressed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uMT43qzzp1HYiNimv.label: Speculative Grade
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uMT43qzzp1HYiNimv.definition: Speculative Grade refers to a category of credit rating that indicates a higher risk of default, making the debt securities less suitable for conservative investors. These ratings are assigned by credit rating agencies and generally include ratings below BBB on the Standard & Poor's and Fitch scales, and below Baa3 on the Moody's scale.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uMgFwwOTwfOpkGF73.label: Florida Circuit Court - Osceola County - 9th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uMgFwwOTwfOpkGF73.definition: A Florida Circuit Court located in Osceola County that operates within the 9th Circuit Court jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uPIk7OdU6TA8qkpov.label: Suit on Sworn Account
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uPIk7OdU6TA8qkpov.definition: A Suit on Sworn Account is a legal claim that arises from a written statement made under oath by a party who seeks to recover a debt or demand payment for goods or services provided, and is based on a contractual or quasi-contractual relationship between the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uPzCETLEs7fjbuzJP.label: Antitrust - Refusal to Deal Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uPzCETLEs7fjbuzJP.definition: The concept of "Antitrust - Refusal to Deal Claims" refers to legal claims made against a company for refusing to do business with another company, in violation of antitrust laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uUwQ5jjK4J6dt0P4H.label: Tax Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uUwQ5jjK4J6dt0P4H.definition: A Tax Related Agreement is a contract outlining the terms, conditions, and responsibilities of parties concerning taxation matters. This agreement can address issues like the allocation of tax liabilities, indemnifications, and procedures for handling tax-related disputes or inquiries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uVWChGsC92Bmw3gMJ.label: Creativity
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uVWChGsC92Bmw3gMJ.definition: Creativity in copyright law refers to the requirement that a work must display some level of original thought or artistic expression. It distinguishes copyrightable works from mere mechanical reproductions, ensuring protection is afforded only to creations that embody the author's intellectual effort.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW4lNe8RZr0qftjrI.label: Solvency Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW4lNe8RZr0qftjrI.definition: The risk that the company will not have sufficient assets to meet its liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW6qS9Y0zZglFODk0.label: Bonus Opportunity Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW6qS9Y0zZglFODk0.definition: A Bonus Opportunity Clause is a provision in a contract that provides an additional chance for a party to receive a bonus or reward based on certain conditions being met.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW7tSElnScC1uC2Cn.label: Termination of Contract Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uW7tSElnScC1uC2Cn.definition: A Termination of Contract Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the circumstances under which the agreement may be ended by one or both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uY9MW34wyc3LEsvEN.label: JE40 Amendment of Statements of Case (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uY9MW34wyc3LEsvEN.definition: Preparing and considering amendments to originating process, Statements of Case, Part 20 proceedings.  In appeals refers to amendments to Appellants’ and Respondents’ Notices and supporting skeleton arguments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uZfHJlzT6NtVlFGA8.label: Matter Narrative Description
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uZfHJlzT6NtVlFGA8.definition: A textual narrative description, detailing a matter's factual and legal details.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uaHVA5sLFEVE1yOEi.label: Trucking Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uaHVA5sLFEVE1yOEi.definition: Trucking Negligence refers to the failure of a common carrier engaged in the transportation of goods by truck to exercise reasonable care, resulting in harm or injury to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uaOTdTaAuNmWKOgiG.label: Lost Capacity in Living Resulting from Tort
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uaOTdTaAuNmWKOgiG.definition: The concept of Lost Capacity in Living Resulting from Tort refers to the reduction in a person's ability to enjoy life due to injuries caused by someone else's wrongful act, for which compensation may be sought in a personal injury claim under the category of non-economic damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uoc2fGReblZYERcaE.label: Work Environment Harassment
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uoc2fGReblZYERcaE.definition: Work Environment Harassment refers to a type of employment harassment claim that involves creating a hostile work environment through unwelcome and discriminatory behavior or conduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8utefjaPVm1ooWgvWH.label: Social Anxiety Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/R8utefjaPVm1ooWgvWH.definition: Social Anxiety Disorder, also known as social phobia, is a mental health condition characterized by an intense, persistent fear of social or performance situations where one may be scrutinized or judged by others. This fear often leads to significant distress and avoidance of social interactions, affecting daily functioning and quality of life.
examples: Public Speaking Anxiety: An individual experiences severe anxiety and avoidance when required to speak in front of a group.
Social Interaction Anxiety: An individual fears and avoids social gatherings or interactions due to fear of being negatively evaluated or embarrassed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8uuvxRrK0Eet2bpHbB.label: Lettuce
http://lmss.sali.org/R8uuvxRrK0Eet2bpHbB.definition: Lettuce is a leafy vegetable from the Lactuca sativa species, known for its crisp texture and mild, refreshing flavor. It is commonly consumed raw in salads and sandwiches and is valued for its low-calorie content and nutritional benefits, including vitamins A, C, and K, as well as fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8v0eP8PnMAaTYALLgh.label: Child Support Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8v0eP8PnMAaTYALLgh.definition: A Child Support Court is a specialized court or division within the legal system that handles cases related to child support obligations. These courts oversee matters such as the establishment, modification, enforcement, and collection of child support payments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8v6tFfln3S9d5Ob6qM.label: Florida Circuit Court - Flagler County - 7th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8v6tFfln3S9d5Ob6qM.definition: A court located in Flagler County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings within the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8v75O5vRYnYeS0trBp.label: Assessment of Eligibility for Public Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/R8v75O5vRYnYeS0trBp.definition: Assessment of eligibility for public benefits by a lawyer or other legal service provider involves a comprehensive review and analysis of an individual's or family's financial, social, and legal circumstances to determine their qualification for specific government assistance programs. This pre-application assessment typically includes gathering documentation, evaluating against program criteria, and providing legal advice on how best to present the case to maximize chances of approval

http://lmss.sali.org/R8v8NL73OspceQ5ouLm.label: Asset Ownership, Transfer, or Sales Restrictions
http://lmss.sali.org/R8v8NL73OspceQ5ouLm.definition: Asset Ownership, Transfer, or Sales Restrictions refer to the special conditions and regulatory constraints that limit the ownership, transfer, or sale of securities. These restrictions often include country-specific regulations, legal requirements, and contractual limitations designed to control the distribution and ownership of financial assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vAEBB4vqpklciwq0M.label: Political Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vAEBB4vqpklciwq0M.definition: Political rights are the rights that enable individuals to freely participate in the civic and political life of a society, including voting, running for public office, and engaging in public discourse. These rights are typically guaranteed by a country's constitution or laws and are essential for the functioning of a democratic system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vCImjU4kpMk3JflXO.label: Profit Margin
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vCImjU4kpMk3JflXO.definition: Profit Margin is a financial metric that measures the profitability of a business or a product. It is calculated by dividing net profit by total revenue and is usually expressed as a percentage, serving as a universal measure of business profitability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vDH4AcRvIpWxsivxJ.label: Acquiree
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vDH4AcRvIpWxsivxJ.definition: An acquiree is a company or entity that is being acquired or purchased in a merger or acquisition transaction. The acquiree is also known as the target firm during a takeover scenario.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vExmVldw6caYjBVNl.label: Motion/Brief Exhibit
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vExmVldw6caYjBVNl.definition: A Motion/Brief Exhibit is a type of Exhibit that is presented to a court or other legal authority in support of a motion or brief, typically containing evidence or arguments in favor of a particular position.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vFZmDq3YytR7qotGi.label: Classical Newari; Old Newari; Classical Nepal Bhasa
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vFZmDq3YytR7qotGi.definition: A language spoken in Nepal, including Classical Newari, Old Newari, and Classical Nepal Bhasa.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vJ8acn9LWAq1ZELF5.label: Machine Authorship
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vJ8acn9LWAq1ZELF5.definition: Machine Authorship in copyright law pertains to works created by machines or computer algorithms, typically without direct human creative input. This concept raises significant questions about the applicability of copyright laws to works generated by artificial intelligence or other automated processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vMLmVfhRJzdHOSa9M.label: Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vMLmVfhRJzdHOSa9M.definition: The suffix "Ph.D." stands for "Doctor of Philosophy" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned the highest academic degree awarded by universities in most fields of study. The use of this suffix signifies the individual's expertise and authority in a specific subject area and is often used in academic, research, and professional settings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vMvqNbleygUph9uql.label: Partnership Representative Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vMvqNbleygUph9uql.definition: A Partnership Representative Clause is a provision in a contract that designates a representative to act on behalf of a partnership in tax matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vSZ41a2OJv2cBFFNL.label: Analysis of Benefits Plans
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vSZ41a2OJv2cBFFNL.definition: The concept of "Analysis of Benefits Plans" refers to the examination and evaluation of employee benefits plans, such as health insurance and retirement plans, to determine their effectiveness and compliance with legal requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8viNe7dpcLA9kGH5gl.label: Unfair Competition Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R8viNe7dpcLA9kGH5gl.definition: Unfair Competition Claims refer to legal actions taken by businesses against competitors who engage in deceptive or unfair practices that harm their business, such as trademark infringement, trade secret misappropriation, or deceptive trade practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vj2bjxO4znRO9ZDWX.label: Security Deposit Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vj2bjxO4znRO9ZDWX.definition: A Security Deposit Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to provide a sum of money to the other party as a guarantee of performance or payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8voMwZ00WaA8Z9QZbJ.label: Joint Defense Group
http://lmss.sali.org/R8voMwZ00WaA8Z9QZbJ.definition: A group of parties who participate in a Joint Defense Agreement, usually separate parties (though in a similar position) who are defendants in a civil lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vomNaX2Wv8mWmUp4W.label: Variable Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vomNaX2Wv8mWmUp4W.definition: Variable costs are expenses that change in direct proportion to the level of goods or services that a business produces. Examples include raw materials, direct labor, subcontractor fees, and shipping costs, which increase or decrease as production volumes change. This metric is important for scalability analysis.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vqEh4rOF2zikhi94v.label: Motion for Damages for Creditor Misconduct
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vqEh4rOF2zikhi94v.definition: A Motion for Damages for Creditor Misconduct is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case by the debtor to seek compensation for any harm caused by the creditor's wrongful actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vrLOm6RKTfx8fw40C.label: Right of First Refusal Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R8vrLOm6RKTfx8fw40C.definition: A Right of First Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that grants a party the opportunity to purchase or lease property before it is offered to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8vxlbeyAj8xVakwh3g.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Woodford County (11th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w2FMS2FoF8rt7Tl3C.label: Misleading Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w2FMS2FoF8rt7Tl3C.definition: A Misleading Objection (aka Confusion Objection) is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question or statement is designed to deceive or confuse the witness or the court. This objection is often related to Federal Rule of Evidence 403, which allows the exclusion of evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by the risk of causing confusion, misleading the jury, or wasting time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3Bpo3vMIGJUOq3qc.label: Georgia Superior Court - Catoosa County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3Bpo3vMIGJUOq3qc.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Catoosa County and presided over by a judge.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3GX28sJ3Cr8KL33y.label: Disparate Impact Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3GX28sJ3Cr8KL33y.definition: Disparate Impact refers to a situation where a seemingly neutral employment or legal policy, rule, or practice has a disproportionately adverse effect on a specific group defined by race, gender, age, or other protected characteristic. While the policy may not be intentionally discriminatory, the end result creates inequality, often prompting legal scrutiny.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3J1xLv0r8q0dkXdI.label: Liability For Unlicensed Subcontractors
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3J1xLv0r8q0dkXdI.definition: Liability for Unlicensed Subcontractors refers to the legal responsibility of a company or individual for any harm caused by a subcontractor who does not possess the required license or permit to perform the work they were hired for.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3kl1tpEaQ2woPVs9.label: Bench Trial
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w3kl1tpEaQ2woPVs9.definition: A bench trial is a trial by judge or panel of judges, as opposed to a trial by jury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w5P07AUmVBNbU2ou1.label: Document Management Add-On
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w5P07AUmVBNbU2ou1.definition: A Document Management Add-On is a specialized tool or feature that enhances the functionality of a Document Management system. It is a software component that can be added to an existing Document Management system to provide additional capabilities or improve existing ones.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w6bfVXll4twICpXeE.label: Death Penalty
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w6bfVXll4twICpXeE.definition: The Death Penalty (Capital Punishment) is a form of criminal penalty that involves the execution of a person who has been convicted of a capital crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8w9K6q1zRPSzNpj1H8.label: X118 Eviction Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/R8w9K6q1zRPSzNpj1H8.definition: Any other costs specifically associated with an eviction action not already provided for within the expense codes

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wA0A8nszg5VoIH0n4.label: Machine Learning
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wA0A8nszg5VoIH0n4.definition: Machine Learning (ML) is a branch of Artificial Intelligence (AI) that focuses on developing systems capable of learning from data to perform tasks without being explicitly programmed. Learning involves optimizing model parameters through computational techniques to enhance the model's performance for specific training tasks

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wA3T9pdhvD5aLaVlH.label: 423 Withdrawal of Reference 28 USC § 157 (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wA3T9pdhvD5aLaVlH.definition: Action held in bankruptcy court requesting withdrawal under the provisions of 28 U.S.C. § 157

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wCAMhqoNRh4U7amC8.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 3
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wCAMhqoNRh4U7amC8.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 3 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wEzsnWA30YRmdfZKR.label: Brief / Memorandum of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wEzsnWA30YRmdfZKR.definition: A Brief/Memorandum of Law is a written document submitted to a court that summarizes the legal arguments and relevant facts of a case, typically prepared by an attorney for a client.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wJ23hSjeLDVX8ZP9h.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Morgan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wJ23hSjeLDVX8ZP9h.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Morgan County: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wOITiPftK5xTRvzn9.label: Entity Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wOITiPftK5xTRvzn9.definition: An entity registration document is a formal document issued by a governmental or authorized body, confirming that an individual, organization, or product meets specific standards or regulations. This certificate serves as legal evidence of compliance and may be required for certain professional practices, business operations, or product distributions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wXGWJTzR57bI6XTE3.label: Indivisible Harm Caused by Separate Tortfeasors
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wXGWJTzR57bI6XTE3.definition: Indivisible Harm Caused by Separate Tortfeasors: A legal concept where multiple parties are responsible for causing harm to an individual, and the harm cannot be divided or attributed to any one party individually.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wb6BTY1L08UgqWd1J.label: Health Maintenance Organization Act Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wb6BTY1L08UgqWd1J.definition: Claims brought under the Health Maintenance Organization Act, which regulates the operation and structure of health maintenance organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8we77lAWoqoNTTuaOb.label: Florida Circuit Court - Miami-Dade County - 11th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8we77lAWoqoNTTuaOb.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Miami-Dade County (11th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Miami-Dade County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wgkSjQJHL0NrF8OId.label: Indiana Superior Court - Sullivan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wgkSjQJHL0NrF8OId.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Sullivan County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sullivan County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wi2smGXfyidmuHXdf.label: Northern Sami
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wi2smGXfyidmuHXdf.definition: A language spoken by the indigenous Sami people in northern Scandinavia, Finland, and Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wisznMX44NzobECeW.label: Criminal Matter Identifiers
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wisznMX44NzobECeW.definition: Criminal Matter Identifiers are unique codes or numbers used to track and identify criminal cases, including information such as law enforcement arrest tracking numbers, fatality indicators, commercial motor vehicle indicators, law enforcement incident tracking numbers, and traffic accident indicators.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wln21w2Ro3XIXYz53.label: Values and Ethics Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wln21w2Ro3XIXYz53.definition: Values and Ethics Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's failure to adhere to its stated values, principles, or ethical standards in its operations, decision-making, or behaviors. This can result from unethical practices, inadequate oversight, or cultural issues, potentially leading to reputational damage, legal liabilities, or loss of stakeholder trust, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, credibility, and sustainability

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wnUawk0J2E9P9nN3n.label: Georgia Superior Court - Habersham County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wnUawk0J2E9P9nN3n.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Habersham County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wosSYqYiY7yPUaCnx.label: Aggravation of a Pre-Existing Ailment or Condition
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wosSYqYiY7yPUaCnx.definition: The aggravation of a pre-existing ailment or condition refers to the worsening or exacerbation of a medical condition that existed prior to an incident or accident, resulting in non-economic damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8wt2n3AFdskQGAtG1S.label: Litigation Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/R8wt2n3AFdskQGAtG1S.definition: Litigation Related Agreements are contracts associated with disputes, their resolution, and related legal processes. These agreements can dictate the terms, conditions, and procedures to avoid or end litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8x0u39yCNHqlqk08vu.label: Promissory Note
http://lmss.sali.org/R8x0u39yCNHqlqk08vu.definition: A promissory note is a written agreement in which one party promises to pay a specific amount of money to another party at a future date or on demand.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8x4cjS7BbUJ9Vg6l94.label: Property Disparagement
http://lmss.sali.org/R8x4cjS7BbUJ9Vg6l94.definition: The act of making false or misleading statements about someone's property, which causes harm to their reputation or financial interests, and can result in legal action under the categories of defamation, property, and premises liability claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8x520MB0xME0o4Wrg2.label: International Trade Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R8x520MB0xME0o4Wrg2.definition: International Trade Practice involves the legal frameworks and regulations governing the exchange of goods, services, and capital across international borders. This area includes trade agreements, customs regulations, export and import controls, trade compliance, and dispute resolution in global commerce.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8x6LJFoln3OhMhoiVy.label: MD
http://lmss.sali.org/R8x6LJFoln3OhMhoiVy.definition: Markdown is a lightweight markup language with plain text formatting syntax. It is commonly used to format readme files, for writing messages in online discussion forums, and to create rich text using a plain text editor.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8x7xLzlrWIFUf0jUHr.label: "'Violation' of fiduciary duties" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/R8x7xLzlrWIFUf0jUHr.definition: The "Violation" of fiduciary duties refers to a breach of the legal obligation of loyalty and care that a fiduciary owes to their client or beneficiary, often resulting in harm or loss to the latter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xB67rtMDMgJgiTMAX.label: Law of Obligations
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xB67rtMDMgJgiTMAX.definition: The Law of Obligations in civil law systems refers to a set of rules governing the duties, responsibilities, and rights of parties engaged in contractual or quasi-contractual relationships. It provides the legal framework for various types of obligations, such as contractual obligations, torts, and unjust enrichment, specifying how these obligations arise, are performed, or can be extinguished.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xIIJGedrUnNDQeOch.label: Modern Rape
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xIIJGedrUnNDQeOch.definition: Non-consensual sexual intercourse that involves physical force, coercion, or the inability to give consent, and which is prosecuted under contemporary legal definitions and standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xSzwRnuQy4kqrATCJ.label: Drug Test
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xSzwRnuQy4kqrATCJ.definition: A drug test is a technical analysis of a biological specimen, such as urine, hair, blood, breath, sweat, or oral fluid/saliva, to determine the presence or absence of specified drugs or their metabolites. These tests are often used by employers, sports organizations, legal and law enforcement agencies, and in healthcare settings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xVomTmvKTNPlk7iEQ.label: New York Recorder's Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xVomTmvKTNPlk7iEQ.definition: A court in New York State that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and traffic violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xafuL4jC4isD0BT3m.label: Citizen
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xafuL4jC4isD0BT3m.definition: A citizen is a member of a political community or nation, endowed with certain rights and responsibilities under the governing laws of that jurisdiction. Citizenship status is typically conferred by birth within a certain territory, descent from citizens, or naturalization

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xbRSLkmAz0QmnzbLM.label: Anti-Virus Certificate
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xbRSLkmAz0QmnzbLM.definition: A certificate issued by an anti-virus software company verifying that a computer system is free of viruses or malware, typically used as evidence in legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xcw9mHJrwyp7RfwsN.label: Urogynecology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xcw9mHJrwyp7RfwsN.definition: Urogynecology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that involves injuries or harm caused by the negligence or misconduct of a urogynecologist, who specializes in the treatment of pelvic floor disorders in women.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xekNn7K6SxToo5Arj.label: Motion to File
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xekNn7K6SxToo5Arj.definition: A Motion to File is a request made to a court to allow a party to submit a document or pleading that is not currently part of the official record in a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xg0kpsdZphvyE6bNX.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Reynolds County
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xg0kpsdZphvyE6bNX.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Reynolds County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Reynolds County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xgHlBKmHBkhCKyytJ.label: Successor Probate
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xgHlBKmHBkhCKyytJ.definition: Successor Probate is a type of probate filing where a new executor is appointed to administer the estate of a deceased person when the original executor is unable or unwilling to fulfill their duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xgHnZw9VbPFOSxm4z.label: Contact ID
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xgHnZw9VbPFOSxm4z.definition: Contact ID refers to a unique identifier assigned to a specific contact within a system or database, typically used for tracking and organizing contact information.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xhTgEOLxauZ6mN68J.label: Perjury
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xhTgEOLxauZ6mN68J.definition: The intentional act of lying or giving false testimony under oath in a legal proceeding, which is considered a crime against the government and can result in judicial and procedural tort claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8xhtpCx6BhKVUQaYq0.label: Settlement Offer Evidentiary Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R8xhtpCx6BhKVUQaYq0.definition: A Settlement Offer Evidentiary Objection, also known as an Offers of Compromise Objection, is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that evidence of a settlement offer or negotiation is being used to prove liability or the validity of a claim. This objection aims to protect the confidentiality of settlement discussions and encourage parties to negotiate without fear of their offers being used against them in court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R8yBi7eGC3bVzVUorDn.label: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works) Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R8yBi7eGC3bVzVUorDn.definition:
Industries in the Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works) subsector include establishments primarily engaged in assigning rights to assets, such as patents, trademarks, brand names, and/or franchise agreements, for which a royalty payment or licensing fee is paid to the asset holder.  Establishments in this subsector own the patents, trademarks, and/or franchise agreements that they allow others to use or reproduce for a fee and may or may not have created those assets.

Establishments that allow franchisees the use of the franchise name, contingent on the franchisee buying products or services from the franchisor, are classified elsewhere.

Excluded from this subsector are establishments primarily engaged in leasing real property and establishments primarily engaged in leasing tangible assets, such as automobiles, computers, consumer goods, and industrial machinery and equipment.  These establishments are classified in Subsector 531, Real Estate, and Subsector 532, Rental and Leasing Services, respectively.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Cj1A31dy70CbB8b6U.definition: An entrepreneurial buyer is an individual or entity that engages in mergers and acquisitions with the primary goal of acquiring a business to actively manage and grow. http://lmss.sali.org/R9Cw8CmXhnaMRuej3PN.label: Presentment Clause Claim

http://lmss.sali.org/R9GqgpAu9J8iXUREZ3M.label: Primary Metal Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/R9GqgpAu9J8iXUREZ3M.definition:
Industries in the Primary Metal Manufacturing subsector smelt and/or refine ferrous and nonferrous metals from ore, pig, or scrap, using electrometallurgical and other process metallurgical techniques.  Establishments in this subsector also manufacture metal alloys and superalloys by introducing other chemical elements to pure metals.  The output of smelting and refining, usually in ingot form, is used in rolling, drawing, and extruding operations to make sheet, strip, bar, rod, or wire, and in molten form to make castings and other basic metal products.

Primary manufacturing of ferrous and nonferrous metals begins with ore or concentrate as the primary input.  Establishments manufacturing primary metals from ore and/or concentrate remain classified in the primary smelting, primary refining, or iron and steel mill industries regardless of the form of their output.  Establishments primarily engaged in secondary smelting and/or secondary refining recover ferrous and nonferrous metals from scrap and/or dross.  The output of the secondary smelting and/or secondary refining industries is limited to shapes such as ingot or billet that will be further processed.  Recovery of metals from scrap often occurs in establishments that are primarily engaged in activities, such as rolling, drawing, extruding, or similar processes.

Excluded from the Primary Metal Manufacturing subsector are establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing ferrous and nonferrous forgings (except ferrous forgings made in steel mills) and stampings.  Although forging, stamping, and casting are all methods used to make metal shapes, forging and stamping do not use molten metals and are included in Subsector 332, Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing.  Establishments primarily engaged in operating coke ovens are classified in Industry 32419, Other Petroleum and Coal Products Manufacturing.

These attributes categorize broadcasts into synchronous (live) and asynchronous (pre-recorded) transmissions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9H9OMSGtJ376F4xzlq.label: Separated
http://lmss.sali.org/R9H9OMSGtJ376F4xzlq.definition: Separated (Marital Status) refers to the legal status of a married couple who are no longer living together but have not yet obtained a divorce.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9H9PP0j1qzvD6sNKqK.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Clay County (4th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HBQQorBzLchJWIZlb.label: Failure to Mediate
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HBQQorBzLchJWIZlb.definition: The concept of Failure to Mediate refers to a civil defense in litigation where one party fails to participate in mediation, which is a process of resolving disputes outside of court with the help of a neutral third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HE5GFA1XOadp4IeFH.label: Twi
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HE5GFA1XOadp4IeFH.definition: Twi is a language spoken in Ghana and is a subcategory of the Language class in the ontology.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HKgi7LSbdz9zvbOyk.label: Certificate of Deposit
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HKgi7LSbdz9zvbOyk.definition: A Certificate of Deposit (CD) is a time-bound deposit made with a bank or financial institution that offers a fixed interest rate over a specified period. Unlike a regular savings account, funds in a CD are usually locked in for the term of the CD and early withdrawal may result in penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HLUMVIgthompejqWq.label: Pathology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HLUMVIgthompejqWq.definition: Pathology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from errors or negligence in the examination and diagnosis of tissue samples and bodily fluids by pathologists.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HNdgwRrqNB4YxqQeK.label: Interference with Leave Rights Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HNdgwRrqNB4YxqQeK.definition: An interference with leave rights claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for interfering with their right to take protected leave under applicable laws. These laws may include the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), the California Family Rights Act (CFRA), or other state and local laws that provide protected leave for certain reasons, such as for the employee's own serious health condition, to care for a seriously ill family member, or for the birth or adoption of a child. The claim typically arises when an employer denies or discourages an employee from taking leave or retaliates against an employee for taking protected leave.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPWCZUhOAniaeM37h.label: Securitization Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPWCZUhOAniaeM37h.definition: The financial practice of pooling various types of contractual debt such as residential mortgages, commercial mortgages, auto loans or credit card debt obligations (or other non-debt assets which generate receivables) and selling their related cash flows to third party investors as securities, which may be described as bonds, pass-through securities, or collateralized debt obligations (CDOs).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPXBgZpsNyy2AbQLv.label: Out-of-Court Restructuring
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPXBgZpsNyy2AbQLv.definition: An out-of-court restructuring or workout is a nonjudicial process through which a financially troubled company and its significant creditors reach an agreement for adjusting the company's obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPub0PMW2GODvjQ2P.label: Leasehold Estate
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HPub0PMW2GODvjQ2P.definition: A Leasehold is an estate in real property where a lessee is granted the exclusive right to occupy and use a property for a predetermined period, typically in exchange for rent or other consideration. Unlike fee simple ownership, leasehold interests are temporary and revert back to the lessor at the end of the lease term

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HRq0jDT4IJcj5e27x.label: Railway Labor Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HRq0jDT4IJcj5e27x.definition: A Railway Labor Act Claim involves legal proceedings or disputes arising under the Railway Labor Act (RLA), which governs labor relations in the railway and airline industries in the United States. These claims typically address issues such as collective bargaining, union representation, and the resolution of labor disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HSXSwprTDq85YteDQ.label: Errata
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HSXSwprTDq85YteDQ.definition: Errata refers to a document filed with a court that corrects errors or omissions in a previously filed document, and is categorized under Trial Court Practice Documents and Appellate Practice Documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HTLbEXSzD7fXO9Hu6.label: Aircraft
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HTLbEXSzD7fXO9Hu6.definition: An Aircraft is a vehicle capable of atmospheric flight due to its interaction with the air, primarily through the generation of lift. This category includes various types of flying machines such as airplanes, helicopters, gliders, and drones.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HVZcHfpIbYNnALLEZ.label: Arbitrator
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HVZcHfpIbYNnALLEZ.definition: An arbitrator is an independent person or body appointed to hear a dispute in arbitration.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HVyZN6AOaDLzX48zw.label: Tax Matters Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HVyZN6AOaDLzX48zw.definition: A Tax Matters Agreement delineates the rights, responsibilities, and obligations of parties in relation to tax matters, particularly when companies undergo a separation or spin-off. It specifies how the entities will address shared tax liabilities, benefits, and the management of tax-related procedures post-separation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HYiwtnrCegkpzpKHb.label: Estate, Inheritance, and Gift Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HYiwtnrCegkpzpKHb.definition: Estate, Inheritance, and Gift Taxes are levies imposed on the transfer of wealth through various means, either during a person's life or upon their death. Estate taxes are applied to the total value of a deceased person's estate before distribution to heirs, inheritance taxes are imposed on beneficiaries receiving assets, and gift taxes are applied to transfers of wealth during an individual's lifetime that exceed certain thresholds.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HZN3K6Th3Tafu6Ygh.label: Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Culturally Unique Program

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HaCRM3Cyt9tuUqLoa.label: Paiute-Shoshone Tribe of the Fallon Reservation and Colony, Nevada

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Hh6KeMR56ynN9kPCN.label: Writ of Mandamus
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Hh6KeMR56ynN9kPCN.definition: A Writ of Mandamus is a legal order issued by a court that commands a government official or agency to perform a specific duty or act that they are legally obligated to do.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HhXTHi0mTgRGnYja0.label: Cherokee Bear Clan of South Carolina

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Hi3UmOlYwfQbxmgeK.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Ste. Genevieve County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Hi3UmOlYwfQbxmgeK.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Ste. Genevieve County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Ste. Genevieve County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HlxYOQb4WGC3goxZE.label: Diplomat
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HlxYOQb4WGC3goxZE.definition: A diplomat is an individual appointed by a state to conduct negotiations, represent interests, and maintain diplomatic relations with other states or international organizations. Diplomats often enjoy certain privileges and immunities under international law, which allow them to perform their duties more effectively while residing in a foreign country

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HoOEFkLqTzYCpeYoL.label: Annulment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HoOEFkLqTzYCpeYoL.definition: The legal process of declaring a marriage null and void, as if it never existed, typically due to some defect or impediment that existed at the time of the marriage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HtVIZJS79BdPOUYSR.label: Assignment Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HtVIZJS79BdPOUYSR.definition: An Assignment Agreement is a legal contract that transfers rights, benefits, or obligations from one party to another. This agreement outlines the conditions under which the assignment takes place, including the responsibilities of each party and any limitations or requirements that must be met for the assignment to be effective.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HuNkpWm24qMFuntuu.label: Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HuNkpWm24qMFuntuu.definition: Evidence refers to information, data, or physical items presented in a legal proceeding to support or refute a claim or charge. Its purpose is to prove or disprove the existence of an alleged fact. Evidence can take many forms, including witness testimony, documents, photographs, and forensic findings, and its admissibility in court is governed by a set of legal standards and rules.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HvF7FfEi0bAHAm2QC.label: Sick Leave
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HvF7FfEi0bAHAm2QC.definition: Sick leave is a form of paid time off that allows employees to take time away from work when they are ill or need medical care. It is designed to ensure that employees can recover from illness without losing income.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HvPWWjPpu4MmrQybm.label: Definition of Material Damage Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HvPWWjPpu4MmrQybm.definition: A Material Damage Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the responsibilities and liabilities of the parties involved in the event of physical harm or destruction to the subject matter of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9HwOtYn3EIoiEsllF0.label: JA00 Funding (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9HwOtYn3EIoiEsllF0.definition: All work relating to reviewing funding options, securing funding and reports to funders during the life of the case

http://lmss.sali.org/R9I0nYrXSCGRN5gaGJR.label: Hunting License
http://lmss.sali.org/R9I0nYrXSCGRN5gaGJR.definition: A hunting license is an official permit issued by a governing authority that grants individuals the legal right to hunt specific species of wildlife within designated areas and during specified seasons. To obtain a hunting license, applicants often must complete a hunter education course and adhere to established regulations, bag limits, and conservation measures. The license may have stipulations based on species, weapon type, and region.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9I1vkniee5QgVTnu8v.label: Motion to Expedite Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/R9I1vkniee5QgVTnu8v.definition: A Motion to Expedite Appeal is a legal request made to a higher court to speed up the process of reviewing a lower court's decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9I2QOa7u8LwCRqKo4F.label: Timberland Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R9I2QOa7u8LwCRqKo4F.definition: In the context of legal services, Timberland refers to a parcel of land with specific legal considerations surrounding the growth, management, and harvesting of timber. Legal issues may include property rights, environmental regulations, and contractual obligations between parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9I5NnI41F5zvaAiT1A.label: Asset Distribution Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9I5NnI41F5zvaAiT1A.definition: Asset Distribution Policy refers to the strategy a fund employs to manage and allocate its investment profits. This policy includes income funds, which regularly distribute profits to investors; accumulation funds, which reinvest profits back into the fund; and mixed funds, which combine both strategies by partially distributing and partially reinvesting profits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9I7IUYUmnVRQo4aTRW.label: Military Enrollment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9I7IUYUmnVRQo4aTRW.definition: Military Enrollment refers to the process by which individuals join the armed forces, either voluntarily or through conscription. This initial phase includes a series of steps such as application, background checks, and basic training to prepare the individual for service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IBK1C50E7u2akjOiY.label: Negligent Spoliation of Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IBK1C50E7u2akjOiY.definition: The intentional or reckless destruction or alteration of evidence by a party who had a duty to preserve it, resulting in the inability to use the evidence in a legal proceeding, due to their negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ICeOg6A95qwBlvRoe.label: Moral Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ICeOg6A95qwBlvRoe.definition: Moral Rights in copyright law refer to the rights of creators to protect the personal and reputational value of their works. These rights typically include the right to claim authorship, the right to prevent distortion or mutilation, and the right to withdraw or alter the work.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9INwIwwIifomch7DOe.label: Civil Arrest
http://lmss.sali.org/R9INwIwwIifomch7DOe.definition: The concept of Civil Arrest refers to the act of detaining a person by legal authority in order to enforce a civil judgment against them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IOi6YnPlSPWuCJD1p.label: Disclaimer for Lack of Cooperation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IOi6YnPlSPWuCJD1p.definition: A disclaimer for lack of cooperation is a statement made by an insurance company indicating that they are not liable for a claim due to the policyholder's failure to cooperate with the investigation or provide necessary information.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IQTEVH1zSGQgYcTbC.label: Illinois Circuit Court - McLean County (11th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ISJkkYKgzGJwJZ0YG.label: Trademark Regulatory Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ISJkkYKgzGJwJZ0YG.definition: Trademark Regulatory Objectives: The specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions related to the regulation of trademarks, including the legal frameworks and policies that support their execution.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IUa9jW3BLd4WrNowX.label: Tax Tier Maximum
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IUa9jW3BLd4WrNowX.definition: The Tax Tier Maximum is a specific detail within the broader concept of Tax Tier Detail, which sets the maximum amount of tax that can be charged for legal services provided under a particular engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ictcp1iwOnYdrf1bx.label: Application
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ictcp1iwOnYdrf1bx.definition: In the context of litigation, an Application refers to a formal request or motion submitted to a court or judicial body, seeking a specific order, relief, or direction as part of legal proceedings. This procedural instrument is fundamental in advocating for a party's interests, setting the stage for judicial review and decision-making.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Idcfy3k3uRwC4Xohb.label: Evidentiary Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Idcfy3k3uRwC4Xohb.definition: An evidentiary objection is a formal protest raised by a party in a legal proceeding, challenging the admissibility of specific evidence. Common grounds for such objections include lack of foundation, hearsay, irrelevance, and prejudicial nature.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IfEJ1qwXzk6iw5gd9.label: Trade Association
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IfEJ1qwXzk6iw5gd9.definition: A trade association is an organization founded and funded by businesses that operate in a specific industry. These associations advocate for the interests of their members, provide industry standards, and offer networking opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ih5zyGAU2AsCpVmsB.label: Credit Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ih5zyGAU2AsCpVmsB.definition: The risk that a borrower will not repay a loan or that a counterparty will not meet its financial obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ii4OzSADsjS0VegX1.label: Bankruptcy Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ii4OzSADsjS0VegX1.definition: Bankruptcy Motions are written requests made by parties in a bankruptcy case to the court for various purposes, such as to approve a plan, extend time, pay debts, or dismiss a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ij6BH1GeEahrPLtiT.label: Florida County Court - Hardee County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ij6BH1GeEahrPLtiT.definition: A court located in Hardee County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IkFUwMggGV4EMZUJM.label: Novelty
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IkFUwMggGV4EMZUJM.definition: Novelty in legal terms signifies that an invention must be new or original, not previously known or used, to be patentable. It ensures that patents are granted only for genuinely new advancements, not for modifications of existing ones.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IldpgAfUyz3upHKvX.label: Infliction of Emotional Distress
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IldpgAfUyz3upHKvX.definition: Infliction of Emotional Distress refers to the intentional or negligent act of causing severe emotional distress to another person, resulting in mental anguish, suffering, or trauma. It is a type of personal injury claim that can arise from intentional or unintentional actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IoAlyOWrsbtjuz7qo.label: Export Controls Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IoAlyOWrsbtjuz7qo.definition: Export Controls Practice involves the legal frameworks and regulations governing the export of goods, services, and technology from a country. This practice area includes compliance with export control laws, export licensing, restrictions on certain goods and technologies, and enforcement of export regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IqSEQ0yMKpXqkbScr.label: 463 Alien Detainee (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IqSEQ0yMKpXqkbScr.definition: Immigration habeas petition under 28 U.S.C. § 2241. All cases filed with this nature of suit code are restricted to case participants and public terminals. Petition is filed by an alien detainee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ir7JDITtSSGK1M2Ap.label: Breach of Confidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ir7JDITtSSGK1M2Ap.definition: A breach of confidence has occurred if the defendant discloses or uses a novel idea that the plaintiff previously disclosed to the defendant in confidence and that the defendant voluntarily received.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Itaf1ApZ0Oiq2OHw4.label: Georgia Superior Court - Webster County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Itaf1ApZ0Oiq2OHw4.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Webster County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Webster County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9IzhAblo458C3Kocqv.label: vendor
http://lmss.sali.org/R9IzhAblo458C3Kocqv.definition:
"Used to name a vendor the data is associated with, e.g. ""E-Billing Vendor"" or ""Realestate.com""  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R9J3IMReTiSXbXF9NGs.label: Survival Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9J3IMReTiSXbXF9NGs.definition: A Survival Claim is a legal claim made on behalf of a deceased person's estate for damages or losses that the person suffered before their death and that survived them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9J5Z30cBGCGWc6EmoO.label: Equity Compensation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9J5Z30cBGCGWc6EmoO.definition: An Equity Compensation Clause is a provision in a contract that grants ownership in a company to an individual as a form of payment or incentive, typically in the form of stock options or restricted stock units.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JBjakDIsSF91IjI8v.label: Libel
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JBjakDIsSF91IjI8v.definition: A false and malicious statement that is published or communicated to a third party, which harms the reputation of an individual or entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JDOjlrvV3jFpUOQu9.label: matter_disc_cred segment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JDOjlrvV3jFpUOQu9.definition: The "matter_disc_cred segment" is a component of the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard that includes information related to discounts or credits applied to a matter, such as the type, amount, and category of the discount or credit.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JHdxc5JeJIZii5dRB.label: Mari
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JHdxc5JeJIZii5dRB.definition: Mari is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JHul9FKmkFasxXopM.label: Affidavit / Declaration Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JHul9FKmkFasxXopM.definition: Affidavit/Declaration Practice refers to the legal work involved in preparing and submitting written statements made under oath or affirmation, typically used as evidence in a legal proceeding, and is a subcategory of Litigation Practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JIe7aURW35qmdzdEa.label: Representations and Warranties Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JIe7aURW35qmdzdEa.definition: A Representations and Warranties Clause is a contractual provision in which one party makes certain statements about the subject matter of the contract, and warrants that those statements are true and accurate, thereby providing assurance to the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JJWlci2GwDGSMqF9e.label: Vehicle Equipment Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JJWlci2GwDGSMqF9e.definition: A Vehicle Equipment Violation Claim involves allegations that a vehicle's equipment does not meet the regulatory standards required by law, which may include issues with lighting, brakes, tires, or emissions controls. These claims are crucial for ensuring road safety and environmental compliance, and they can result in mandatory repairs, fines, or other enforcement actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JMX7niGHsR9tG8mfI.label: Severability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JMX7niGHsR9tG8mfI.definition: A severability clause is a provision in a contract that states that if any part of the contract is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the rest of the contract will remain in effect.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JP1ZcUhPxVoXQqmTr.label: Common-Law Sodomy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JP1ZcUhPxVoXQqmTr.definition: The act of engaging in non-procreative sexual intercourse between persons of the same sex, which is prohibited by common law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JRUuArZPBgVxN3icU.label: tax_invoice_cl_name
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JRUuArZPBgVxN3icU.definition:
"The name of the party paying VAT on the invoice.  

The legal name of the party paying VAT on the invoice may be different from the value required by the receiving system in the CLIENT.cl_name field.  In some jurisdictions it may be required by law to provide this information.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JS9fTi5zofkUuIQJo.label: Stipulation to Reject
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JS9fTi5zofkUuIQJo.definition: A Stipulation to Reject is a legal agreement between parties in which they agree to reject or disallow certain evidence or arguments in a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JYaUvmj8h3XejfnzR.label: Motion to Proceed in Forma Pauperis
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JYaUvmj8h3XejfnzR.definition: A Motion to Proceed in Forma Pauperis is a legal request made by an individual who is unable to afford the fees associated with a court case, asking the court to waive or defer those fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JZE1Cazcu0al05drM.label: Maritime Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JZE1Cazcu0al05drM.definition: A maritime lien is a type of lien that gives a creditor the right to seize a vessel as collateral for unpaid debts related to the vessel's operation or maintenance.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ja1m4FrybHKTH0BWb.label: Income Tax Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ja1m4FrybHKTH0BWb.definition: Income tax practice refers to the area of law where lawyers assist clients in matters related to personal or corporate income tax, including compliance, filing, and dispute resolution with tax authorities. Lawyers in this field often advise on effective tax planning strategies to minimize liability while adhering to applicable laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JcsdtYN2CUc5CfCTU.label: Child Support
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JcsdtYN2CUc5CfCTU.definition: Child support is a legal obligation for a parent to provide financial assistance to their child, typically paid by the non-custodial parent to the custodial parent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhFu3gdrpsakpnlIV.label: 835 Patent – Abbreviated New Drug Application (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhFu3gdrpsakpnlIV.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a patent claim involving an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA). These cases are also known as “Hatch-Waxman” cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhmqmBeWWxLxZeHIk.label: Georgia Superior Court - Quitman County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhmqmBeWWxLxZeHIk.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Quitman County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhvLtNkH5oHMJorZy.label: Georgia Superior Court - Upson County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JhvLtNkH5oHMJorZy.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Upson County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Upson County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JjYncl4LPCfl86a4L.label: Accountability Principle
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JjYncl4LPCfl86a4L.definition: Accountability is the privacy principle that a data controller should be accountable for complying with measures which give effect to the principles stated above.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JkfZIjkVSa5ud1tJ1.label: Corporate and Partnership Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JkfZIjkVSa5ud1tJ1.definition: Corporate and Partnership Liability Claims refer to legal claims made against corporations or partnerships for their actions or inactions that result in harm or injury to others, including claims related to breach of fiduciary duty, wrongful interference, debt liability, freeze-out of minority shareholders, and piercing the corporate veil.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JkqKed1jktjgwaeiL.label: Liquidation Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JkqKed1jktjgwaeiL.definition: This is a type of bankruptcy where an individual's or company's assets are sold to pay off creditors. The debtor is typically absolved of further responsibility for the debts once the assets are liquidated, and the proceeds are distributed amongst the creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JrUYY8dlxxNVV1hBK.label: Invoice End Date
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JrUYY8dlxxNVV1hBK.definition: The "Invoice End Date" is a specific detail within the broader category of "Fee Invoice Detail" and refers to the date on which an invoice for legal services is due to be paid.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JsHceQc9dUPHsj05q.label: City Council
http://lmss.sali.org/R9JsHceQc9dUPHsj05q.definition: A City Council is the legislative body of a municipal government, typically composed of elected officials representing various districts or the city at large. This governing body is responsible for enacting local ordinances, approving budgets, and setting policies that directly affect the day-to-day operations and long-term development of a city or town.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9JtaQbKgVrXM5Msd7m.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Los Alamos County

Picketing typically involves organized protests by workers outside a workplace to express grievances, support labor disputes, or raise awareness about certain issues. While picketing is generally protected under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) and the First Amendment, it may be deemed unlawful if it involves activities such as violence, threats, intimidation, mass picketing that obstructs access to a business, or secondary picketing targeting neutral parties not involved in the labor dispute. An unlawful picketing claim may be filed with the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) or pursued through the court system.
