http://lmss.sali.org/R9NAqx3ulc9dcdzFyip.definition: A forum selection clause is a contractual provision that designates a specific jurisdiction or court where any disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NBtKsKyxEWOCrSt4p.label: Celtic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NBtKsKyxEWOCrSt4p.definition: A group of languages spoken in parts of Europe, including Ireland, Scotland, and Wales, that share a common linguistic and cultural heritage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NIOuuJ0SaNPWjNPtV.label: Montenegrin
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NIOuuJ0SaNPWjNPtV.definition: Montenegrin is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NQE4RYF9sPnV5oLHH.label: Immigration Sponsor
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NQE4RYF9sPnV5oLHH.definition: An immigration sponsor is a citizen or lawful permanent resident of a destination country (e.g., United States) who takes legal responsibility for supporting a foreign national seeking to enter or remain in the destination country (e.g., U.S.). The sponsor usually submits an affidavit of support, which is a legally enforceable contract stating that they will financially support the immigrant to ensure they do not become a public charge.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NT1JJYC1mlObK7d5d.label: Transit Visa to the United Nations
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NT1JJYC1mlObK7d5d.definition: A Transit Visa to the United Nations is a specialized type of transit visa issued to individuals who need to pass through the United States en route to the United Nations headquarters in New York City for official UN business. This visa allows the holder to enter and transit through the U.S. solely for the purpose of conducting activities related to the United Nations and is generally valid for a limited period.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NTMgGmXdV4PIRAjMN.label: L110 Fact Investigation/Development
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NTMgGmXdV4PIRAjMN.definition: The concept of L110 Fact Investigation/Development refers to the process of gathering and developing factual information relevant to a legal case, which is a part of the broader process of assessing, developing, and administering a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NiDYm2H8rNNzeKBkf.label: Karachay-Balkar
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NiDYm2H8rNNzeKBkf.definition: Karachay-Balkar is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken by the Karachay-Balkar people in the North Caucasus region of Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NiI0Gvzg2pByWBg0A.label: Assisting or Encouraging
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NiI0Gvzg2pByWBg0A.definition: Assisting or Encouraging refers to the act of aiding or abetting someone in the commission of a crime or wrongdoing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NoLB96WprNktZsw57.label: Merger Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NoLB96WprNktZsw57.definition: A Merger Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of the merger between two or more companies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Nwns5ybGXg2hQXtbf.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Caldwell County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Nwns5ybGXg2hQXtbf.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Caldwell County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Caldwell County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NxbulWPKUGRvKOU9H.label: Kazakh
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NxbulWPKUGRvKOU9H.definition: A language spoken in Kazakhstan and some neighboring countries, belonging to the Turkic language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NyaxwzSUYJfLEQfls.label: Adverse Possession of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NyaxwzSUYJfLEQfls.definition: The concept of Adverse Possession of Property refers to a legal defense used in civil litigation cases involving property disputes, where a person claims ownership of a property by occupying it continuously and openly for a certain period of time, without the permission of the legal owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9NzeSNhxrQwvcbiE1B.label: Breach of Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9NzeSNhxrQwvcbiE1B.definition: A Breach of Agreement Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that outlines the consequences and remedies in the event that one party fails to fulfill their obligations as outlined in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9O1AWe0Uu6Rx1tufxn.label: Segregation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9O1AWe0Uu6Rx1tufxn.definition: A segregation claim is a legal assertion that a person or group has been subjected to discrimination or unequal treatment based on race, ethnicity, or other protected characteristics, leading to their separation or isolation from others. Such claims are often made in the context of civil rights litigation to challenge practices or policies that perpetuate segregation and unequal access to opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9O1gpLCLK3QiJseYfg.label: Quality Assurance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9O1gpLCLK3QiJseYfg.definition: A Quality Assurance Clause is a provision in a contract that ensures that the goods or services provided meet certain standards and specifications.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9O364wqgRRa8Wu60r8.label: Zhuang; Chuang
http://lmss.sali.org/R9O364wqgRRa8Wu60r8.definition: A language spoken by the Zhuang people, primarily in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of southern China.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9O42UXt5foFZsqPnx5.label: Government Market
http://lmss.sali.org/R9O42UXt5foFZsqPnx5.definition: A "Government Market" refers to the sphere of trade and transactions involving goods and services sold to federal, state, or local government entities. This market is characterized by public procurement processes, compliance with specific regulatory frameworks, and contracts aimed at fulfilling governmental functions or public services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9O8DfnQ5nFlMiycGkJ.label: Litigation Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R9O8DfnQ5nFlMiycGkJ.definition: Litigation Management involves the management of various aspects of a legal case, including but not limited to, retention and litigation hold management, redaction management, expert witness management, brief analysis management, jury selection management, citation check management, remote trial management, eDiscovery services, exhibit management, and costs and settlement management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OCyhME6Rs0AVVSDKH.label: Georgia District Court - Richmond County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OCyhME6Rs0AVVSDKH.definition: Georgia District Court - Richmond County is a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Richmond County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ODLnhxFt38FQNV4BU.label: Immigration Regulatory Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ODLnhxFt38FQNV4BU.definition: Immigration Regulatory Objectives: The specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions related to the regulation of immigration, including the legal frameworks and policies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OFUYwG5cG4togMeKo.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OFUYwG5cG4togMeKo.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Witness is a pretrial motion requesting the court to prohibit a specific witness from testifying or presenting evidence at trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OIzJtfFVfhJJFuIHL.label: Outside Counsel Guidelines
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OIzJtfFVfhJJFuIHL.definition: Outside Counsel Guidelines are a set of expectations set by a company or organization for the external law firms or attorneys it hires, detailing billing, communication, conflicts of interest, confidentiality, and other work-related parameters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OJlM7qnQBsP6xcryJ.label: Adult Entertainer
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OJlM7qnQBsP6xcryJ.definition: An adult entertainer is an individual who performs in sexually-oriented shows or activities, often for an audience at specialized venues like strip clubs. The legal regulations governing adult entertainers vary by jurisdiction but commonly include age restrictions, licensing requirements, and zoning laws for the venues where they perform.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OPLmJsjNEC1np84qW.label: Swati
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OPLmJsjNEC1np84qW.definition: Swati is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OQDlkVuZ7bzfYSzAy.label: 560 Civil Detainee - Conditions of Confinement (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OQDlkVuZ7bzfYSzAy.definition: Action by former prisoner who was involuntarily committed to a non criminal facility after expiration of his or her prison term alleging unlawful conditions of confinement while in the non-criminal facility. This category includes, for example, an action by a former prisoner classified as a Sexually Dangerous Person or Sexually Violent Predator alleging civil rights violations during his detention in a medical facility. (Excludes actions by alien detainees)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OQgWwumb1SAaSfzau.label: Friendly Co-Party
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OQgWwumb1SAaSfzau.definition: A co-party in a legal or transactional matter whose interests and actions align with those of a specific client, even though they may be formally independent. Friendly co-parties generally cooperate and collaborate to achieve shared or mutually supportive outcomes within the matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVY5GWczMSrxKsf8c.label: Real Estate Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVY5GWczMSrxKsf8c.definition: Real Estate Documents are written or recorded representations of property ownership, transfer, or use, including but not limited to deeds, mortgages, and leases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVaeQiwFO2v0rOQ7F.label: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVaeQiwFO2v0rOQ7F.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Practice is a request made by a party to a lawsuit asking the court to set aside the verdict due to misconduct or improper behavior by the jury during the trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVtNYUqPXyvuaZmEg.label: Security Deposit
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVtNYUqPXyvuaZmEg.definition: A security deposit is a sum of money held by a landlord or lessor as collateral to cover potential damages or unpaid rent by a tenant or lessee. It is typically refundable if the terms of the lease are met and no damages occur.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVvZrP50aExKprI0e.label: Jewish Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OVvZrP50aExKprI0e.definition: Jewish Law, often referred to as Halakha, is the collective body of Jewish religious laws derived from the Torah and developed through centuries of rabbinical interpretation and tradition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OYNKT7pIr4gnoZODD.label: Voting Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OYNKT7pIr4gnoZODD.definition: Voting rights refer to the legal entitlement that enables eligible citizens to participate in the electoral process to choose their representatives in government. These rights are commonly protected by national constitutions and international treaties like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and may include provisions to prevent discrimination based on race, gender, or other factors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OfZsgy3e7BzLDC7ws.label: Endocrinology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OfZsgy3e7BzLDC7ws.definition: Endocrinology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the failure of an endocrinologist to provide appropriate care or treatment to a patient, resulting in harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ohxkkc2hNZKQtt1B3.label: Dismissal Without Prejudice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Ohxkkc2hNZKQtt1B3.definition: Dismissal Without Prejudice: A court order dismissing a case that does not prevent the plaintiff from bringing the same case again in the future.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OtqOSasjLPjNu5QS5.label: Unit per Hour
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OtqOSasjLPjNu5QS5.definition: A "Unit per Hour" is a type of unit used to measure the cost of legal services, where the fee is based on the amount of time spent providing the service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OvfJInosxBvH3L46H.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - McKean County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OvfJInosxBvH3L46H.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in McKean County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9OzLGaxH8FUa0QvIz1.label: Lender
http://lmss.sali.org/R9OzLGaxH8FUa0QvIz1.definition: A person or institution who lends money.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9P1L7grHrcTuv1suLZ.definition: Risk of Regulatory Change refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from changes in laws, regulations, or industry standards that may affect an organization's operations, products, or services. These risks can stem from various sources, such as shifts in political or economic priorities, emerging technologies, or public pressure for increased transparency and accountability, potentially leading to compliance challenges, increased costs, or reduced market opportunities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9P6haogRyeNPepJFEk.label: Insider
http://lmss.sali.org/R9P6haogRyeNPepJFEk.definition: A statutorily created role, where that Insider (e.g., C-suite executive, activist shareholder) can influence the Debtor. Relevant Statute: 11 USC 101(31).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9P9HWX0wTFws92tNkC.definition: A court located in Glades County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PChcVCDqDnnozvSz8.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Montour County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PFGT7QJlJ0ok1aBbx.definition: A specialized area within the M&A Practice Components that focuses on the management of K (knowledge) deals.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PHzS14PBA6CbZ0Zpw.definition: Communications at an initial stage in compliance with pre-action protocol including letters before action and responses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PLqqxNIpwbQxLWPoL.definition: CRM Management refers to the process of managing customer relationships and interactions with a law firm, including the use of technology and data analysis to improve client satisfaction and retention.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PNXksGLpp41yDOL7V.label: L220 Preliminary Injunctions/Provisional Remedies
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PNXksGLpp41yDOL7V.definition: A preliminary injunction is a temporary court order that prohibits a party from taking certain actions until a final decision is made in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PQzGkaFkFgcMvZOKr.label: Time
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PQzGkaFkFgcMvZOKr.definition: Time refers to the measurement of duration or the sequence of events in a particular order.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PTSzG1blsjX3xn1PT.label: Boat
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PTSzG1blsjX3xn1PT.definition: A Boat is a small to medium-sized watercraft designed for travel on water, commonly used for personal recreation, fishing, or short-distance transportation. Boats vary in size and type, including motorboats, sailboats, and rowboats, each serving specific purposes and environments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PYNVVb9kMDcRtGNPA.label: Legal Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PYNVVb9kMDcRtGNPA.definition: Legal rights are entitlements or privileges conferred by law that provide an individual or entity with certain freedoms, protections, or benefits. These rights can be civil, political, or social in nature and are enforceable by the judiciary, serving as the basis for legal claims or actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PdcdE8HbgI3sqZloS.definition: Antitrust - Vertical Market Allocation Claims refer to legal claims that allege an agreement between competitors to divide a market based on vertical lines, such as by customer type or geographic area, in violation of antitrust laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PfY9lASO3JAZnFZiW.definition: A LegalRuleMLDocument is a type of metadata that identifies an actor in the legal domain, specifically related to the OASIS LegalRuleML standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PjwWtzZhrMGTl19o9.definition: An Oversight Board is a governing body within an organization specifically tasked with monitoring and ensuring compliance with standards, policies, and legal requirements. This board maintains accountability, reviews organizational practices, and provides independent assessments of organizational performance and adherence to rules and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PssWyF8YOT1jGis6O.label: Minnesota District Court - Yellow Medicine County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PssWyF8YOT1jGis6O.definition: A Minnesota District Court located in Yellow Medicine County, which is responsible for hearing and deciding civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PuBFQqCIJcjnUuBJi.definition: Negligent Misrepresentation is a legal claim that arises when a party makes a false statement or omits important information, which they should have known was false or misleading, and that causes harm to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PvVz72B1f9fXxuK5W.definition: A legal reason for filing a subsequent probate, which includes the death, incapacity, or unwillingness of the original probate filer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PvfnPfjiIwXwWoldE.label: Felony Murder
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PvfnPfjiIwXwWoldE.definition: Felony Murder is a type of murder where a death occurs during the commission of a felony, regardless of whether the death was intentional or not.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Pwbr9KwJkAswReoHi.label: Exhibit Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Pwbr9KwJkAswReoHi.definition: Exhibit Management refers to the process of organizing and presenting evidence in a legal case, including the collection, tracking, and presentation of physical and digital exhibits.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PxiCptV9cYtmVkS4f.definition: Anesthesiology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the administration of anesthesia during a medical procedure.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9PyPzEUehPGahqJymg.label: Christian Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/R9PyPzEUehPGahqJymg.definition: The Christian Religion is a monotheistic faith centered around the teachings, life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, as documented in the Bible. In legal contexts, it often relates to the protection of religious freedoms, the recognition of Christian holidays and symbols, and the accommodation of Christian practices in diverse societal settings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q0CDspQRVH8CNYIeL.label: Food and Drug Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q0CDspQRVH8CNYIeL.definition: Law governing the safety, quality, labelling, and regulation of food, drugs, medical devices, and cosmetics, aimed at protecting public health by ensuring that products are safe, effective, and accurately represented to consumers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q4SBjm0FVgiXtIZxM.definition: A Motion to File Nonstandard Brief is a formal request to submit a legal document that does not conform to the standard formatting requirements set forth by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q4kB7yGIbUD9aMTcd.definition: Fund Formation (Service) refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the process of creating a new investment fund, including the drafting of necessary documents and compliance with regulatory requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q7Ut5uDnSIFiVL9nm.definition: A Quiet Enjoyment Clause is a provision in a contract that guarantees a tenant's right to use and enjoy the leased property without interference from the landlord or any third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q9CszYRTjTgwQ8JRq.label: Broker
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Q9CszYRTjTgwQ8JRq.definition: A broker is an individual or firm employed by others to plan and organize sales or negotiate contracts for a commission.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QCVwkeCigeLgC2pXY.definition: OASISThing refers to a type of data structure used in LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA, which can have specific functions and roles within the schema.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QDC1chH8o0jmTMsmr.definition: A specialized court program in New York State that aims to reduce crime and improve public trust in the justice system, by providing community-based services and alternative sentencing options.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QE2EdC7J6rNnMUaMT.label: New York City Court - Hornell
http://lmss.sali.org/R9QE2EdC7J6rNnMUaMT.definition: A court located in Hornell, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QN0xnYI5Hase8OfxF.label: Earned Income
http://lmss.sali.org/R9QN0xnYI5Hase8OfxF.definition: Earned income refers to the money an individual receives from working, including wages, salaries, bonuses, and commissions. http://lmss.sali.org/R9QQLAddYiYrVZR5Ung.definition: A Competitor Clause is a provision in a contract that restricts one party from engaging in business activities that compete with the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QTWcwXG9FLUtwMaAv.definition: An overpayment occurs when a payer disburses more money than is owed to a recipient, which can happen in various contexts such as payroll, social benefits, or vendor payments. http://lmss.sali.org/R9QUQK65GB15xLVfXkp.label: Asset Exchange Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/R9QUQK65GB15xLVfXkp.definition: Asset Exchange Attributes encompass various methods by which financial assets are traded or converted to achieve specific strategic objectives. These attributes involve transactions where assets like debt and equity are exchanged to improve financial structure, raise capital, or consolidate ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QVPObEikXAXDwK0bN.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Lycoming County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9QVPObEikXAXDwK0bN.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lycoming County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Lycoming County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QcJpEJ19eAN8glCzx.label: Legal Operations
http://lmss.sali.org/R9QcJpEJ19eAN8glCzx.definition: Legal Operations refers to the management of legal processes and resources within a legal department or organization, including matter management, project management, spend management, and other related activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9Qf9X22qnr7DDy7sBF.label: Littering
http://lmss.sali.org/R9Qf9X22qnr7DDy7sBF.definition: Littering is the act of improperly disposing of waste materials in public or private spaces, rather than in designated trash receptacles. This behavior results in environmental pollution, health hazards, and can lead to significant fines and penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9QkbfBhORCO4PzTokh.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Lack of Personal Jurisdiction is a legal request made by a defendant to dismiss a case on the grounds that the court does not have the authority to hear the case due to the defendant not having sufficient contacts with the jurisdiction.
