http://lmss.sali.org/R9b5fs8QJuliSZYeaJL.definition: Agency & Vicarious Liability refers to the legal responsibility of one party for the actions of another party who is acting on their behalf or under their control, such as an employer being held liable for the actions of their employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9b7R5qhOf9euXs4sfQ.label: Lezghian
http://lmss.sali.org/R9b7R5qhOf9euXs4sfQ.definition: Lezghian is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9b9cucv5zG3I8ujQm3.label: Pending Acquisition Proposal
http://lmss.sali.org/R9b9cucv5zG3I8ujQm3.definition: A pending acquisition proposal is a legal concept that refers to an offer made by one party to acquire another party's assets or business, which has not yet been accepted or rejected, and is subject to certain conditions and triggers, such as tail period fee triggers.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9bCaZjWhV1f2PgQiwz.label: Estate Management Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9bCaZjWhV1f2PgQiwz.definition: Estate Management Practice refers to the administration and oversight of a person's estate, including assets, liabilities, and financial affairs, both during their lifetime and after their death. http://lmss.sali.org/R9brxBQlQ4WkVgK7XOO.definition: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare and aggressive type of skin cancer that originates in the Merkel cells, which are found at the base of the epidermis and are associated with the sense of touch. http://lmss.sali.org/R9bu7L3xOUfbWLaHRhi.definition: A reinsurer is a company that provides financial protection to insurance companies by accepting portions of their insurance liabilities. http://lmss.sali.org/R9drVXQevOU9n2VpiFG.label: Freedom to Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/R9drVXQevOU9n2VpiFG.definition: A freedom to petition claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to petition the government for a redress of grievances, as protected by the First Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment guarantees that the government shall not abridge the freedom to petition, which includes the right to make requests or complaints to the government, access courts, and participate in other forms of advocacy without fear of retaliation or punishment. A freedom to petition claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts the right to petition, when an individual or group is retaliated against for filing a complaint or lawsuit, or when access to legal processes or governmental decision-making is improperly denied.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9e1bYJPmM4lWEdGvWI.definition: A military serviceperson is an individual who serves or has served in the armed forces of a country, which can include the army, navy, air force, or other branches of service. http://lmss.sali.org/R9eemrOBN0uTpbeMGN9.label: California Superior Court - San Francisco Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R9eemrOBN0uTpbeMGN9.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in San Francisco County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ejVFO48SQK7NinELT.label: Credit Union
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ejVFO48SQK7NinELT.definition: A credit union is a member-owned financial cooperative that provides traditional banking services, including accepting deposits, making loans, and offering other financial products to its members. Unlike banks, credit unions operate on a not-for-profit basis, returning profits to members in the form of lower loan rates, higher savings yields, and lower fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ek5RZIuIDj7sf24An.label: Regulatory Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ek5RZIuIDj7sf24An.definition: A Regulatory Notice is an official communication issued by a governmental or regulatory body to inform organizations or the public about new laws, updates to existing regulations, or other important compliance-related matters. It serves as a mechanism to ensure that affected parties are aware of their legal obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9em7T0Di8mYGAQVo5q.label: Preemptive Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9em7T0Di8mYGAQVo5q.definition: A preemptive rights clause is a provision in a contract that grants a party the right to purchase additional shares of stock in a company before they are offered to the public, thereby maintaining their percentage of ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9eupYRukr0f2ikwD6j.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Sullivan County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9eupYRukr0f2ikwD6j.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Sullivan County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Sullivan County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ewSPN5kBuDugrkLuW.label: Washington Pollution Control Hearings Board
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ewSPN5kBuDugrkLuW.definition: The Washington Pollution Control Hearings Board is a specialized court within the Washington State Courts system that hears cases related to environmental pollution and enforces regulations to protect the environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9f5VhF3BpnnedEE7De.label: Invoice Date Sent
http://lmss.sali.org/R9f5VhF3BpnnedEE7De.definition: The "Invoice Date Sent" concept refers to the specific date on which an invoice for legal services was sent to the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fEnvE04V1G9iFExOL.label: Educational Accountability and Standards Regulation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fEnvE04V1G9iFExOL.definition: Educational Accountability and Standards Regulation refers to the set of legal standards and requirements imposed on educational institutions to ensure consistent quality of education, student performance, and transparency in reporting outcomes. This encompasses mandates related to standardized testing, proficiency benchmarks, obligations of schools to disclose student progress metrics, and mechanisms to hold schools responsible for delivering high-quality education, as seen in acts like the No Child Left Behind and the Every Student Succeeds Act.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fKvjVlII2PEtadGED.label: Artistic Work
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fKvjVlII2PEtadGED.definition: An Artistic Work is a creation that expresses artistic or aesthetic value through visual or audio mediums, protected under copyright law. This includes paintings, sculptures, photographs, and other visual arts, granting the creator exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and display their work.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fPcbJiH51AXrnw5Aw.label: Minnesota District Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fPcbJiH51AXrnw5Aw.definition: Minnesota District Court - Washington County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fU2mdkwvBDJ2e94AC.label: Motion for Voluntary Dismissal by Stipulation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fU2mdkwvBDJ2e94AC.definition: A Motion for Voluntary Dismissal by Stipulation is a legal document filed by parties in a lawsuit that requests the court to dismiss the case by agreement of all parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fU3LWOxgJp4CwRmoU.label: Carve-out
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fU3LWOxgJp4CwRmoU.definition: A carve-out divestiture is a corporate action in which a company partially divests a business unit, division, or subsidiary by selling a minority stake, often through an initial public offering (IPO). The parent company retains majority ownership and control of the carved-out entity, while the new shareholders hold a minority stake. Carve-out divestitures are typically executed to raise capital, unlock value, or allow the separated entity to focus on its core competencies while maintaining a strategic relationship with the parent company.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fXAPsE95fXqAoJLCa.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Agreement/Conspiracy Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fXAPsE95fXqAoJLCa.definition: A claim made under antitrust law alleging an agreement or conspiracy between competitors operating at the same level of the market to restrain trade, limit competition, or fix prices.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fdA2JvJLnSC5KvriP.label: Florida County Court - Marion County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fdA2JvJLnSC5KvriP.definition: Florida County Court - Marion County is a specific court located in Marion County, Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fecXpSbt9vRFdgCC0.label: Minnesota District Court - Kittson County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fecXpSbt9vRFdgCC0.definition: Minnesota District Court - Kittson County: A court of law in the state of Minnesota that has jurisdiction over legal cases and disputes specifically within Kittson County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fiBuN68xjrliEydpa.label: Consideration - Mixed Cash and Stock - Election
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fiBuN68xjrliEydpa.definition: A mixed cash and stock election consideration is a type of consideration in a legal matter where the party receiving payment has the option to choose between receiving cash or stock as part of the payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9frdFAfyZSHqgY1wPZ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Wilcox County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9frdFAfyZSHqgY1wPZ.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Wilcox County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wilcox County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fslqJlcJW7E5ey4lz.label: Partnership Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fslqJlcJW7E5ey4lz.definition: A Partnership Claim is a legal action brought by one or more partners against the partnership or other partners for breach of partnership agreement or other wrongdoing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ftV8MHfUYUGEX3aY5.label: Analysis of DIP Financing
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ftV8MHfUYUGEX3aY5.definition: Analysis of DIP Financing refers to the examination and evaluation of the debtor-in-possession financing obtained by a company during bankruptcy proceedings, as a means of determining the best use of available cash.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fxfUhT4J5OgPl0jSg.label: Danish
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fxfUhT4J5OgPl0jSg.definition: Danish (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Denmark and parts of Greenland and the Faroe Islands.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fyD3lTs6lHrVdVmxb.label: Fiber Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fyD3lTs6lHrVdVmxb.definition: Fiber evidence comprises tiny threads or fragments from textiles found at crime scenes or on objects. Forensic analysis can determine the type, source, and sometimes specific origin of the fiber, potentially connecting a suspect to a location or another piece of evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9fzqoKTpwXpqadubIm.label: Failure to Identify to a Police Officer
http://lmss.sali.org/R9fzqoKTpwXpqadubIm.definition: The failure of an individual to disclose their identity to a police officer, which is categorized as a criminal misdemeanor offense.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9g0W8aJlZGxI0YFXt3.label: Aragonese
http://lmss.sali.org/R9g0W8aJlZGxI0YFXt3.definition: Aragonese (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Aragonese region of Spain.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9g0tsF68ZfL1dvdj4j.label: Contractual Standardization
http://lmss.sali.org/R9g0tsF68ZfL1dvdj4j.definition: Contractual Standardization refers to the extent to which the terms of a contract are standardized or custom-tailored. Standardized contracts have predefined terms and conditions that are universally applied, facilitating easier trading and regulatory compliance, while non-standardized contracts are customized to meet specific needs of the contracting parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9g6A1HOmIeGzVfSxil.label: Patent Infringement - Design Patents
http://lmss.sali.org/R9g6A1HOmIeGzVfSxil.definition: The unauthorized use or imitation of a unique ornamental design protected by a patent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9g6zihBZJgMMb0ZeY8.label: Spinocerebellar Degeneration
http://lmss.sali.org/R9g6zihBZJgMMb0ZeY8.definition: Spinocerebellar degeneration is a group of progressive neurological disorders characterized by the degeneration of the spinal cord and cerebellum, leading to impaired motor coordination, balance, and sensory functions. This condition often manifests with symptoms such as ataxia, gait disturbances, and loss of coordination.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gC89TmnmsW59eGc3M.label: Indiana Superior Court - Tippecanoe County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gC89TmnmsW59eGc3M.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Tippecanoe County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within Tippecanoe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gDhUx8OTeR2aOldVR.definition: Properties containing more than one Real Estate Asset (as listed in this category).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gFKiuU6KjBjgFL8aG.label: Motion to Remove Professional
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gFKiuU6KjBjgFL8aG.definition: A Motion to Remove Professional is a request made in a bankruptcy case to remove a professional, such as an attorney or accountant, from their role in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gFKqBJPzof1cSCSAN.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Pope Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gFKqBJPzof1cSCSAN.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Pope Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pope County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gOty6N5zIf7b5EMVH.label: Service Waiting
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gOty6N5zIf7b5EMVH.definition: Service Waiting refers to the period during which a task is on hold, pending completion of work by an external party. This could include waiting for a court ruling, receiving documents from opposing counsel, or other necessary actions by third parties that are required to proceed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gVbCYmeRMGmrOAJNj.label: Criminal Lineup
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gVbCYmeRMGmrOAJNj.definition: A criminal lineup is a procedure used by law enforcement in which a witness or victim of a crime is presented with a series of individuals, one of whom is the suspect, to determine if the witness can identify the perpetrator. The lineup can be live, with individuals standing in person, or photo-based, using pictures of potential suspects. Proper protocols are essential to ensure fairness and avoid unintentional suggestion or bias.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gWgkuIAtfyB9zjZJj.label: South Carolina Administrative Law Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gWgkuIAtfyB9zjZJj.definition: The South Carolina Administrative Law Court is a specialized court within the South Carolina State Courts system that hears cases related to administrative law disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gZnl9L7XB030vBLpJ.label: Tennessee Supreme Court - Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gZnl9L7XB030vBLpJ.definition: The Tennessee Supreme Court - Special Workers' Compensation Appeals Panel is a specialized division of the Tennessee Supreme Court that handles appeals related to workers' compensation cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gcJW5zpEIb8x5yJrf.label: Suicide and "Right to Die" Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gcJW5zpEIb8x5yJrf.definition: The concept of "Suicide and 'Right to Die' Claims" refers to legal claims and arguments related to intentional self-harm or assisted suicide, including cases involving prisoners and allegations of negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gdr8XujJKKno7hAJ0.label: New York Supreme Court - Genesee County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gdr8XujJKKno7hAJ0.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Genesee County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Genesee County, New York, which hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gfE6kHyuByZQuBx64.label: Relief from Stay Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gfE6kHyuByZQuBx64.definition: Relief from Stay Practice (Adequate Protection) refers to the legal practice of ensuring that a creditor's interest in property is protected during a bankruptcy proceeding, by providing adequate protection to the creditor's collateral.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ghw5JyR77pO8wtuIA.label: Redemption Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ghw5JyR77pO8wtuIA.definition: A Redemption Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that grants the holder the right to redeem or repurchase the subject of the contract, typically property or securities, under certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gqoOxERTZEdH5pVC9.label: U.S. Trademark Trial and Appeal Board
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gqoOxERTZEdH5pVC9.definition: The U.S. Trademark Trial and Appeal Board (TTAB) is a specialized administrative tribunal within the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) that hears and decides disputes related to trademark registration and infringement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gqzNBOvSSiVGWHH7Z.label: Child Dependency Permanency
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gqzNBOvSSiVGWHH7Z.definition: Dependency Permanency refers to the legal remedies, relief, and penalties related to the options available for a child's living arrangements when they cannot remain with their biological parents, including APPLA, return to parent, TPR, and adoption.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gyKB9FX0qPHRV1F7G.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Steuben County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gyKB9FX0qPHRV1F7G.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Steuben County, Indiana, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9gzWY22VTfLC9VNega.label: Intellectual Property Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9gzWY22VTfLC9VNega.definition: Intellectual Property Representation is a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party confirms the ownership, validity, and enforceability of the intellectual property assets held by the target company. It serves to assure the buyer that the target's intellectual property, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets, is free from encumbrances, infringements, or disputes, and that they hold significant value for the acquisition.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9h07LYCxtsrHwuvV4Q.label: Motion to Redeem
http://lmss.sali.org/R9h07LYCxtsrHwuvV4Q.definition: A Motion to Redeem is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case by a debtor to retain ownership of a property by paying off the creditor's claim in full.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9h5aaQVsZ4v7eZ45w3.label: Payment Document
http://lmss.sali.org/R9h5aaQVsZ4v7eZ45w3.definition: A Payment Document is a record that substantiates a financial transaction between parties, such as payments made or received. Examples include invoices, receipts, and payment confirmations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9h9foo6ERXxlBjJgNm.label: Freedom of Movement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9h9foo6ERXxlBjJgNm.definition: Freedom of movement is a fundamental human right that allows individuals to travel, reside, and work within their own country or internationally without unjustified restrictions. Protected by various international human rights instruments, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (Article 13) and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (Article 12), this right encompasses both the liberty to move within a country's borders and the freedom to leave and return to one's own country or to enter and reside in another country, subject to certain limitations for reasons of national security, public order, or public health.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hJl05qaJd1lFTBSdS.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Huntingdon County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hM7U9ZoNuM62WzfOd.definition: News Aggregator Management refers to the process of organizing and managing the collection and distribution of news articles from various sources, within the context of legal research.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hR0S1zExtgPQTzV0L.definition: Discovery Practice refers to the process of obtaining evidence and information from the opposing party in a legal matter, including document collection and production, written discovery, depositions, and discovery motion practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hTXkmBgyClbJrFIev.label: Milestone Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hTXkmBgyClbJrFIev.definition: Milestone Objectives are specific goals or targets that must be achieved within a project, serving as markers of progress towards the overall project management objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hVkAJB9JxWzSXk1Q3.definition: The unauthorized release of private information by an insurance company.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hXEcxyaclpnGHS3y0.definition: A court located in Whitley County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hXZgpQNb6TuIMA6K4.label: Usurpation of Corporate Opportunity
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hXZgpQNb6TuIMA6K4.definition: The Usurpation of Corporate Opportunity is a claim made against a corporation or partnership for taking advantage of a business opportunity that rightfully belongs to the company, thereby depriving the company of the opportunity to pursue it.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hYBvo8lGUd8g1NzBz.label: Sailboat
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hYBvo8lGUd8g1NzBz.definition: A Sailboat is a watercraft propelled primarily by sails, using wind power to navigate and maneuver. Sailboats are commonly used for recreation, sport, and racing, and vary in size from small dinghies to large cruising yachts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hZ42J1Ff5LTkGqhql.label: Minnesota District Court - McLeod County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hZ42J1Ff5LTkGqhql.definition: Minnesota District Court - McLeod County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within McLeod County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ha5Zbl8m0uLHHAJOb.label: Treaty Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ha5Zbl8m0uLHHAJOb.definition: A Treaty Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular action or law violates the Treaty Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the action or law undermines or contradicts the authority granted to the President and the Senate in making and implementing treaties, which requires Senate approval and compliance with the constitutional procedures outlined in the Treaty Clause.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hablBI4AVKVg4AEiI.label: Vendor ID of Legal Services Provider
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hablBI4AVKVg4AEiI.definition: The ID of the provider used by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hhrrXatORR9EqD2Ud.label: Avoidance of Statutory liens
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hhrrXatORR9EqD2Ud.definition: The concept of "Avoidance of Statutory Liens" refers to the legal action taken to prevent the enforcement of liens that are created by statute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hiZkJdEEmVQCWrwvp.label: Pregnancy Status
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hiZkJdEEmVQCWrwvp.definition: Pregnancy status refers to the condition of a woman being pregnant, which is the period during which she carries a developing fetus within her uterus. In many jurisdictions, including the United States, discrimination based on pregnancy status is unlawful in various contexts, such as employment, housing, and public services.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hifDazPvowv0fWwqa.label: President
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hifDazPvowv0fWwqa.definition: A president is the elected head of state and, in many systems, also the head of government, responsible for executing laws, directing foreign and domestic policy, and representing the nation both domestically and internationally. The specific powers and duties of a president vary by country and are usually defined by a constitution or similar foundational legal document.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hrBuJlNrcENMSAGmT.label: Near Par
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hrBuJlNrcENMSAGmT.definition: Near Par refers to the trading price of a financial instrument, such as a bond or loan, that is close to its face value or nominal value. This indicates that the market price is approximately equal to the par value, typically within a narrow range above or below par.
examples: A bond trading near par is priced slightly above or below its face value.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9hrwkCteBcFva1vyZI.label: Academic Transcript
http://lmss.sali.org/R9hrwkCteBcFva1vyZI.definition: An Academic Transcript is an official record provided by an educational institution that details a student's academic performance and history. It typically lists courses taken, grades received, credits earned, and any honors or awards conferred, serving as a comprehensive account of a student's academic achievements throughout their time at that institution.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9i2baqMppDj8enxXZk.label: Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Conditioned
http://lmss.sali.org/R9i2baqMppDj8enxXZk.definition: Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Conditioned: A legal concept that requires a buyer's consent to be freely given without any unreasonable conditions imposed by the seller.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9i2zxWzdRux99NVnxt.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Wayne County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Wayne County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9i3hWr3NOAzkRTAKHi.definition: An expert in the field of accounting.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9i4sJHoS3lEE31DjJb.definition: Minnesota District Court - Wabasha County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Wabasha County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iCcypHReRP54sT9aw.label: South Carolina Office of the Attorney General
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iCcypHReRP54sT9aw.definition: The South Carolina Office of the Attorney General is a government entity responsible for providing legal advice and representation to the state of South Carolina, operating under the jurisdiction of the South Carolina State Courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iGqX5xbiOWpsuFDpB.label: Go-Shop Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iGqX5xbiOWpsuFDpB.definition: A Go-Shop Covenant is a provision in a deal protection agreement that allows the target company to seek out alternative offers from other potential buyers during a specified period of time, while still honoring the original offer.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iHPKfEWde46GaHTUp.label: Limited Probate
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iHPKfEWde46GaHTUp.definition: Limited Probate is a type of filing in the probate process that is restricted in scope and typically involves a specific aspect of an estate, such as the distribution of a particular asset or the appointment of a temporary administrator.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iIfKh8looAmJ0pEG5.label: Blissymbols; Blissymbolics; Bliss
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iIfKh8looAmJ0pEG5.definition: A system of symbols used for communication, originally developed for individuals with communication disabilities, now used more broadly for international communication.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iNDKVGzNLRjMfDsSH.label: Exchange Equity for Equity
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iNDKVGzNLRjMfDsSH.definition: An asset exchange where a party swaps one type of equity for another. This can occur during mergers or acquisitions to consolidate ownership interests.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iQlRknNs4DeBQ9yfW.label: Peripheral Vision Loss
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iQlRknNs4DeBQ9yfW.definition: Contraction of the visual field in the better eye refers to a significant reduction in the area of vision around the point of fixation. This condition is characterized by one or more specific measurements indicating severe restriction in the visual field.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iRnRKt4gpWCVseCWJ.label: Family & Parenting Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iRnRKt4gpWCVseCWJ.definition: The family & parenting market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are parents or caregivers, focusing on products and services that cater to the needs of families and children. This segment encompasses a wide range of offerings, from child-rearing essentials to family-oriented activities, all designed to support the well-being, development, and enjoyment of family life.
examples: Family Entertainment Market (e.g., family movies, amusement parks)
Parenting Resources Market (e.g., parenting books, online forums)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iT6lOJFRf3RRgQvWc.label: Tutoring
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iT6lOJFRf3RRgQvWc.definition: Tutoring refers to the provision of educational assistance or instruction by a tutor to a student, as a condition of a criminal disposition imposed on the student's parents.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iUJ1YX0zK3V9D0RbQ.label: Equitable Relief
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iUJ1YX0zK3V9D0RbQ.definition: Equitable Relief refers to a type of legal remedy sought in civil cases that aims to provide fairness and justice to the parties involved, often through actions such as injunctions, specific performance, or rescission.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iX0KAluRjh1SUSjFz.label: Workers' Compensation Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iX0KAluRjh1SUSjFz.definition: A Workers' Compensation Court is a specific type of administrative proceeding forum that handles disputes related to workers' compensation claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9iX9jIngIBBPMjNmKB.label: Whole Life Insurance
http://lmss.sali.org/R9iX9jIngIBBPMjNmKB.definition: Whole life insurance is a type of permanent life insurance that provides coverage for the insured's entire lifetime. The policy includes a death benefit and typically a cash value component that grows over time, and the premiums are generally fixed and paid for the life of the policy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9igUrMQ39uK36v8pli.label: Entertainment Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9igUrMQ39uK36v8pli.definition: Entertainment Law encompasses the legal services and regulations that govern the entertainment industry, including film, television, music, theater, and digital media. It deals with matters such as intellectual property, contracts, labor relations, and litigation related to entertainment activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ihoRPcnCIxjpGoNYz.label: Public Health Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ihoRPcnCIxjpGoNYz.definition: Public health insurance is a government-sponsored program designed to provide healthcare coverage to eligible individuals or populations. Examples in the United States include Medicare, for older adults, and Medicaid, for low-income individuals. Coverage and eligibility criteria are determined by the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ikrznaQwm4RUsMzP9.label: Authority
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ikrznaQwm4RUsMzP9.definition: Authority is the legal power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9im5qokc06nTAz2xYe.label: Florida County Court - Calhoun County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9im5qokc06nTAz2xYe.definition: A court located in Calhoun County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9imivGwAZr4FFIvjT1.label: Luo
http://lmss.sali.org/R9imivGwAZr4FFIvjT1.definition: A language spoken in Kenya and Tanzania, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ipFN3Gn38ZzYsDrEM.label: Hardship Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ipFN3Gn38ZzYsDrEM.definition: A Military Hardship Discharge is granted when a service member faces extreme and unforeseeable personal or financial hardships that significantly affect their ability to continue serving. The hardships could include serious illness of a family member or severe financial strain, and they must be conditions that have developed or dramatically worsened after enlisting.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9irAG86NjCSqLqVShU.label: Stipulation to Convert Case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7
http://lmss.sali.org/R9irAG86NjCSqLqVShU.definition: A Stipulation to Convert Case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7 is a legal agreement between a debtor and creditor that allows the debtor to change their bankruptcy case from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9j28CnGJGZZNyI3B7F.label: Waiver of Right of First Refusal Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9j28CnGJGZZNyI3B7F.definition: A Waiver of Right of First Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to give up their right to be the first to purchase or lease a property or asset before it is offered to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jGsr6LEcgGQxDRMlc.label: Mineral Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jGsr6LEcgGQxDRMlc.definition: Mineral rights pertain to the ownership and control of the minerals (like coal, oil, and gas) beneath a plot of land. The owner of mineral rights can lease, sell, or transfer these rights to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jJy1g7qqFbLykg0Ip.label: Independent Creation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jJy1g7qqFbLykg0Ip.definition: Independent Creation in copyright law refers to the creation of a work without copying from other sources, relying solely on the author's own skill, judgment, and creativity. It emphasizes the requirement that a work must originate from the author and not be replicated from existing materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jLBBEicl6JwMj2Jf8.label: Terroristic Threats
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jLBBEicl6JwMj2Jf8.definition: The concept of "Terroristic Threats" refers to the act of making threats to cause serious harm or death to individuals or groups of people, with the intention of creating fear and panic in society.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jNLx5iR4vOfU2Gp8b.label: Negligent Interference with Good Samaritan
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jNLx5iR4vOfU2Gp8b.definition: Negligent Interference with Good Samaritan: A claim of negligence that arises when a person who is rendering aid to another is prevented from doing so by the negligent actions of a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jOImNGSk9GMOW7qtP.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - DeBaca County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jOImNGSk9GMOW7qtP.definition: A court in DeBaca County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jPXsbbRBBMSpgv98a.label: Stipulation for Adequate Protection
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jPXsbbRBBMSpgv98a.definition: A Stipulation for Adequate Protection is a legal agreement between parties that ensures a creditor's interest in property is protected during bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jQJqTpfsNpvV2UXQr.label: Sovereign Issuer
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jQJqTpfsNpvV2UXQr.definition: A Sovereign Issuer refers to a national government or its agencies that issue debt securities to raise capital for public expenditures, such as infrastructure projects or budget deficits. These securities, often called government bonds, are backed by the full faith and credit of the issuing government.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jRx7isWVizbJSNmFN.label: O-1 Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jRx7isWVizbJSNmFN.definition: An O-1 visa is issued to individuals with extraordinary ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, recognized at a national or international level. This visa allows them to enter the U.S. to continue work in their field of expertise.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jXpy77NJabGpVw7yk.label: Local Counsel Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jXpy77NJabGpVw7yk.definition: The term "Local Counsel Expense" refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for hiring an attorney who is licensed to practice in a specific jurisdiction where the legal matter is pending.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jjm7twT3DCFuOof0s.label: Motion to Stay Deportation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jjm7twT3DCFuOof0s.definition: A Motion to Stay Deportation is a legal request to temporarily halt the process of removing an individual from a country, typically filed by an individual facing deportation.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jlsYDJ1GAh88WpZLN.label: Georgia District Court - Henry County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jlsYDJ1GAh88WpZLN.definition: Georgia District Court - Henry County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Henry County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jpIjzc10qdgl78jXO.label: Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jpIjzc10qdgl78jXO.definition: A Judgment is a written decision by a court or other tribunal determining the rights and obligations of the parties involved in a legal dispute, often following a trial or other legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jx1uLGTrB6S8hwGcW.label: Criminal Claim Modifiers
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jx1uLGTrB6S8hwGcW.definition: Criminal Claim Modifiers are specific types of claims made in a legal matter related to criminal activity, including threatened, attempted, and aggravated claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9jy9gOvR5Sxb963dWa.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Barry County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9jy9gOvR5Sxb963dWa.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Barry County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Barry County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k5uXJHslZr1s3HROo.label: Hupa
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k5uXJHslZr1s3HROo.definition: Hupa is a Native American language spoken by the Hupa people in California, characterized by its unique phonology and grammar.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6H8crnKSeBgc9dn5.label: Multinational Manager or Executive Immigrant Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6H8crnKSeBgc9dn5.definition: A Multinational Manager or Executive Immigrant Petition (in the U.S., the I-140 EB-1) allows multinational companies to sponsor foreign nationals who have been employed abroad in a managerial or executive capacity to apply for permanent residency in the United States. Applicants must have been employed outside the United States for at least one year in the three years preceding the petition or the most recent lawful nonimmigrant admission if already working for the U.S. petitioning employer. The U.S. petitioner must have been doing business for at least one year, have a qualifying relationship to the entity the applicant worked for outside the U.S., and intend to employ the applicant in a managerial or executive capacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6Oqa7Wrrr5GmbDkA.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Cleburne Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6Oqa7Wrrr5GmbDkA.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Cleburne Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cleburne County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6fCcFUIbJ8aE6Tk6.label: Union Certification Election
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k6fCcFUIbJ8aE6Tk6.definition: A formal process by which the regulator (e.g., National Labor Relations Board (NLRB)) certifies a union or other employee organization as the official representative of a group of employees, typically after an election. Certification occurs when the union wins the majority of votes cast in a secret-ballot election overseen by the regulator (e.g., NLRB).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k89476blw1AVbyYt7.label: Data Privacy Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k89476blw1AVbyYt7.definition: Data Privacy Management refers to the process of ensuring that personal information is collected, used, and shared in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as industry best practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9k9eQXeUK3I54Rjw67.label: Motion for Sale of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/R9k9eQXeUK3I54Rjw67.definition: A Motion for Sale of Property is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case seeking court approval to sell assets or property, often to pay off creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kBMgFiDWZAo2HfU17.label: Gallbladder Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kBMgFiDWZAo2HfU17.definition: Gallbladder cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the gallbladder, a small organ beneath the liver that stores bile. It is often diagnosed at an advanced stage due to its asymptomatic nature in early stages, and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kKWOMvSKHRSPmBL5E.label: American Arbitration Association
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kKWOMvSKHRSPmBL5E.definition: The American Arbitration Association (AAA) is an alternative dispute resolution venue that provides administration and management of arbitration proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kPeaR5Knf1SM893ZO.label: Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians of North Dakota

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kPyvayvN6BdAv2L3D.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Dauphin County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kPyvayvN6BdAv2L3D.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Dauphin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kRX9zgxhy9wJ2cjSL.label: Fiscal Monopoly Profit Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kRX9zgxhy9wJ2cjSL.definition: Fiscal Monopoly Profit Payment refers to the portion of profits generated by government-controlled monopolies that is transferred to the general government or used to finance government expenditures. These profits are considered part of government revenue and are recorded when they are either transferred to the government or used to cover government expenditures.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kRdeC3m6NEz0zOxot.label: Lack of Capacity
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kRdeC3m6NEz0zOxot.definition: In criminal law, a "lack of capacity" refers to a defendant's inability, due to mental illness, cognitive impairment, or other factors, to understand the nature and consequences of their actions or to conform their behavior to the requirements of the law. If proven, this lack of capacity can be a defense in some cases, as it may negate the defendant's criminal responsibility for the alleged actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kWq43BdxAFNgSpfcT.label: Kannada
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kWq43BdxAFNgSpfcT.definition: Kannada (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in the Indian state of Karnataka and by Kannada-speaking communities around the world.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kXNc5SC2yZdt763eP.label: Matter Funds Applied
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kXNc5SC2yZdt763eP.definition: The concept of "Matter Funds Applied" refers to the portion of an engagement fee that is specifically allocated to cover expenses related to a particular legal matter, as opposed to the fee being applied generally to the overall engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kYnSD5e2yIyfslBXH.label: Control of Property Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kYnSD5e2yIyfslBXH.definition: A Control of Property Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the authority to manage or regulate a specific property or asset, typically for the duration of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kj3rbJwO4aZsqQhuk.label: Medical Expenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kj3rbJwO4aZsqQhuk.definition: Medical Expenses refer to the costs incurred for medical treatment and care, including both past and future expenses, as a result of an injury or illness, and are considered a type of economic damage in legal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kkMkiEYQKWjuu5Nmp.label: Rent Coverage Ratio Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kkMkiEYQKWjuu5Nmp.definition: A Rent Coverage Ratio Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a tenant to maintain a certain level of income in order to ensure they can afford to pay rent.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kmBUL0hXAuj5bhh6W.label: 365 Personal Injury - Product Liability (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kmBUL0hXAuj5bhh6W.definition: Action alleging personal injury or death resulting from a defective product.  (Excludes a marine or airplane product)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kmGZf5FSmFdouXWQ1.label: Engagement Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kmGZf5FSmFdouXWQ1.definition: Engagement Attributes are specific aspects that define the scope, nature, and terms of a legal service engagement, including both internally facing provisions for the legal services provider and externally facing terms for the legal services buyer. These attributes encompass the specifics of the legal services to be provided, the responsibilities of each party, and the financial arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kpSRoHo0Bk35jox4C.label: Central Vision Loss
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kpSRoHo0Bk35jox4C.definition: Central vision loss refers to the significant impairment or complete loss of vision in the central part of the visual field, while peripheral vision remains intact. This condition often results from diseases affecting the macula or the central retina, leading to difficulties with tasks that require detailed vision, such as reading or recognizing faces, despite maintaining peripheral awareness.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9krgtRhP32o3OodP1J.label: Document Provenance
http://lmss.sali.org/R9krgtRhP32o3OodP1J.definition: Source of a particular document, which could include Forums (e.g., courts, government agencies), Actors (e.g., Plaintiff, Lender), vendors (e.g., Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis, vLex, Fastcase, Docket Alarm), or many others.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ksYmaNhrwE6VL9r0q.label: General Fiduciary Exemption Language
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ksYmaNhrwE6VL9r0q.definition: General Fiduciary Exemption Language refers to a legal provision that exempts fiduciaries from liability for certain actions or decisions that may be inconsistent with their fiduciary duties, as long as they were made in good faith and with reasonable care.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kuXMvqzY34vaeAdTS.label: Taxes Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kuXMvqzY34vaeAdTS.definition: Taxes Representation is a provision in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party attests to the accuracy and completeness of the target entity's tax returns, payments, and compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations. It serves to assure the buyer that the target company has no undisclosed tax liabilities or issues, and that all tax obligations up to the date of the agreement have been appropriately addressed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kvj3qr4PlwHySafh0.label: Blackberries
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kvj3qr4PlwHySafh0.definition: Blackberries are aggregate fruits composed of small drupelets, characterized by their dark purple to black color and sweet-tart flavor. Widely cultivated and foraged in temperate regions, blackberries are consumed fresh, processed into jams and desserts, and valued for their high antioxidant content.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9kyXmzdpLGATkgzTpl.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Union County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9kyXmzdpLGATkgzTpl.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Union County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Union County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lFaqxVAcEIKXsy7lT.label: Robbery
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lFaqxVAcEIKXsy7lT.definition: The taking, or attempting to take, anything of value under confrontational circumstances from the control, custody, or care of another person by force or threat of force or violence and/or by putting the victim in fear of immediate harm.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lGDb8R7BEFaHDwz4Q.label: Deposition Transcript
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lGDb8R7BEFaHDwz4Q.definition: A deposition transcript is a written record of the spoken testimony given by a witness under oath during a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lIayMMbGtBfT0O6Gm.label: Sales Tax Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lIayMMbGtBfT0O6Gm.definition: Sales tax practice refers to the specialized legal service in which lawyers advise businesses on the collection, remittance, and reporting of sales tax, as well as represent them in disputes with tax authorities. The practice covers understanding jurisdictional differences, ensuring compliance with state and local regulations, and managing audits or assessments.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lL6FAaXWCq2v8t7r1.label: Polish
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lL6FAaXWCq2v8t7r1.definition: Polish (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Poland and by Polish speakers worldwide.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lW5EuQyblVmbXZ0dc.label: Voluntary Dismissal
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lW5EuQyblVmbXZ0dc.definition: A voluntary dismissal is a legal action taken by a plaintiff to end a case without prejudice, meaning they can refile the case at a later time.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lZ8qkZVz6gS9GTQv8.label: Bills of Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lZ8qkZVz6gS9GTQv8.definition: A bill of costs is a detailed statement of expenses incurred during a legal case, including court fees, witness fees, and other costs, which is submitted to the court for reimbursement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9leXQCbF3uoIF8Vb7t.label: Jute
http://lmss.sali.org/R9leXQCbF3uoIF8Vb7t.definition: Jute is a long, soft, and shiny vegetable fiber that can be spun into coarse, strong threads, widely used for making burlap, hessian, and other packaging materials. Known for its eco-friendly properties, jute is one of the most affordable natural fibers and is predominantly grown in regions with warm and humid climates.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9lfWgW9DPgpDATbgtS.label: Market Intelligence Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R9lfWgW9DPgpDATbgtS.definition: Market Intelligence Management is the process of gathering and analyzing information about a specific market or industry, with the goal of making informed business decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9likcSrlEIZAcqs2QQ.label: Project Schedule
http://lmss.sali.org/R9likcSrlEIZAcqs2QQ.definition: The timing of activities necessary to complete the deliverables.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9liyY3I2mm2fKclnOk.label: Motion to Continue Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/R9liyY3I2mm2fKclnOk.definition: A Motion to Continue Hearing is a formal request made to a court to postpone a scheduled hearing or trial to a later date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9llfkxbQWSbUNptbHv.label: Texas District Court - Grayson County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9llfkxbQWSbUNptbHv.definition: A Texas District Court located in Grayson County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Texas, handling civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9luHEuui2taMrChZ8b.label: Child Neglect Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9luHEuui2taMrChZ8b.definition: A Child Neglect Claim is a legal action brought against a parent or guardian for failing to provide adequate care and support for a child, falling under the broader category of Dependency Claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9m5l9KaXwssIIFeRjn.label: 720 Labor/Management Relations (Union) (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9m5l9KaXwssIIFeRjn.definition: Action relating to disputes between labor unions and employers as well as all petitions regarding actions of the Nation Labor Relations Board (NLRB)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9m7fEEboCdA3CLA3nd.label: Action to Quiet Title
http://lmss.sali.org/R9m7fEEboCdA3CLA3nd.definition: An Action to Quiet Title is a legal claim brought to establish clear and undisputed ownership of a property, and to remove any clouds or challenges to the title.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9m8Wz6rX8oJIJfhFFn.label: Discovery and Evidentiary Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/R9m8Wz6rX8oJIJfhFFn.definition: Discovery and Evidentiary Defenses: Legal arguments and strategies used by a party in a civil litigation case to challenge the admissibility or relevance of evidence obtained through the discovery process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mAcao22ayeGuvXlq5.label: Federal Trade Commission Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mAcao22ayeGuvXlq5.definition: A Federal Trade Commission Act Claim is a legal claim that alleges a violation of the laws and regulations enforced by the Federal Trade Commission, which is responsible for protecting consumers from unfair or deceptive business practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mBgc5eSrp7CbRP9Wc.label: Charges Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mBgc5eSrp7CbRP9Wc.definition: A charges clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the fees or costs that one party may charge the other party for specific services or actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mCCoYEusPcLMTiElg.label: Custodial Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mCCoYEusPcLMTiElg.definition: A Custodial Agreement is a contract where a financial institution, often a bank, agrees to hold and safeguard an individual's or entity's financial assets. The custodian may also provide additional services like account administration, transaction settlements, and tax support.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mE09H2zlfuEgZ7CVM.label: Client Passport Number
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mE09H2zlfuEgZ7CVM.definition: Client Passport Number refers to the unique identification number assigned to an individual's passport by the issuing government. This number is used to verify the passport's authenticity and can be required for various legal, travel, or identification purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mQAlCJdrjybzDoGaC.label: Mapudungun; Mapuche
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mQAlCJdrjybzDoGaC.definition: A language spoken by the Mapuche people in Chile and Argentina, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mRp7F4ecO0i1QqMGZ.label: Sami languages
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mRp7F4ecO0i1QqMGZ.definition: Sami languages are a group of languages that are spoken by the Sami people in northern Europe, including Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mSfKgf9j4vIGxmQrn.label: Pornography and Obscene Material
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mSfKgf9j4vIGxmQrn.definition: The violation of laws or ordinances prohibiting the manufacture, publishing, sale, purchase, or possession of sexually explicit material, e.g., literature, photographs, etc.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mVlGYXYz9djrvF1Di.label: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mVlGYXYz9djrvF1Di.definition: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) is a military alliance established in 1949, consisting of North American and European countries, formed to ensure mutual defense and security against external threats. NATO operates under a system of collective defense, whereby an attack against one member is considered an attack against all members, as outlined in Article 5 of the NATO treaty.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mZJ1oqZq9kKUlRdNB.label: Motion to Extend Exclusivity Period
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mZJ1oqZq9kKUlRdNB.definition: A Motion to Extend Exclusivity Period is a request made in a bankruptcy case to prolong the time during which a debtor has the exclusive right to propose a reorganization plan, thereby preventing competing plans from being proposed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mdedEs06VHEXTtNhv.label: Interested Party
http://lmss.sali.org/R9mdedEs06VHEXTtNhv.definition: A person or entity who is interested in a legal proceeding - without necessarily being a party to that legal proceeding. https://www.ca11.uscourts.gov/e-filing/notices-cases-interest

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mf4jHGk1EcEkyTBhf.label: Bail Payment Event

The mortgagee holds a lien on the property as security for the loan repayment and can foreclose on the property if the borrower fails to meet the terms of the mortgage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mmoUsDKGTyjfuOcuv.definition: The term "Billable" refers to whether a legal service provider can charge a client for time spent or tasks completed on the client's behalf. This concept encompasses activities that are directly related to delivering legal services and are eligible for invoicing.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9mz48xbSZ0Hwbl0Uk1.definition: The failure of an individual to obtain automobile insurance as required by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9n8FRvEhNiVY8ziiHc.definition: Kumyk is a language that belongs to the Turkic language family and is spoken primarily in the Dagestan Republic of Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9n8ukOX6QZ7e4bydqr.definition: Commutation is the reduction of a punishment or sentence for a crime, usually from a more severe form to a lesser one, without negating the underlying conviction. Unlike a pardon, which absolves the individual of the crime, a commutation typically pertains to reducing the length of a prison sentence or changing the type of punishment, but the conviction remains on the individual's record.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nB8qcUs6VLcyZcPsi.label: Anorexia Nervosa
http://lmss.sali.org/R9nB8qcUs6VLcyZcPsi.definition: Anorexia Nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by an intense fear of gaining weight and a distorted body image leading to severe food restriction and extreme weight loss. Individuals with this disorder may also engage in excessive exercise, purging, or other behaviors to prevent weight gain.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nJZe8rDXgfMrl5tUd.label: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court1
http://lmss.sali.org/R9nJZe8rDXgfMrl5tUd.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes and cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nKffsUrlMdYIg9r9K.label: Judgment As a Matter of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9nKffsUrlMdYIg9r9K.definition: Judgment As a Matter of Law (JAML) is a legal decision made by a judge based on the evidence presented in a case, rather than being left to the jury to decide.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nMt6HkjdNxIGBpR7E.label: Analysis of Dischargeability Issues
http://lmss.sali.org/R9nMt6HkjdNxIGBpR7E.definition: The Analysis of Dischargeability Issues is the examination and evaluation of whether a particular debt can be eliminated through bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nNdnfHEKPt7BncR0G.definition: A Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) is a legally binding contract negotiated between a labor union or employee association and an employer or group of employers. It outlines the terms and conditions of employment for the represented workers, covering aspects such as wages, working hours, benefits, workplace conditions, and dispute resolution procedures.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nO5Pzo6dJu02Wdg6w.definition: A constructed language created for the Star Trek franchise, spoken by the fictional Klingon species and used in various media and fan communities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nOavyaQyATTpL7lU6.definition: An Option to Extend Lease Term Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one or both parties the right to extend the lease agreement for a specified period of time beyond the original lease term.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nOzJ7UqJOqbircm8l.definition: Legal Management Consulting Services refers to the provision of expert advice and guidance to legal organizations and professionals on matters related to business management and strategy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nScyslqPFi8SLLbzF.definition: An Effective Date of Resignation Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the date on which a resignation will become effective.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9nbdHJRTyWZsckR9zV.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing one or more of the following: venetian blinds, other window blinds, and shades; curtain and drapery rods and poles; and/or curtain and drapery fixtures. http://lmss.sali.org/R9njctagdfLCVar0XrW.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Taney County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Taney County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9o2vztaSaUUlhhynoA.label: Personal Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/R9o2vztaSaUUlhhynoA.definition: Often considered in Bankruptcy Proceedings, Personal Goods are movable, tangible objects owned by an individual and primarily used for personal, household, or everyday living purposes. They are distinct from real property (real estate) and intellectual property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9o4Zp6QhHzwOPMUT2j.label: New York Supreme Court - Orleans County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9o4Zp6QhHzwOPMUT2j.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Orleans County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Orleans County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9o64xWUYP0wnO9r7Jj.label: Release from Active Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/R9o64xWUYP0wnO9r7Jj.definition: The concept of "Release from Active Duty" refers to the legal objective of obtaining a discharge from military service, and the associated legal and professional frameworks that support this goal within the context of bankruptcy and restructuring.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9o6t4TNaYw4lNTdJvE.label: Motion to Sever
http://lmss.sali.org/R9o6t4TNaYw4lNTdJvE.definition: Seeks to sever claims and/or parties into separate proceedings

http://lmss.sali.org/R9o8jrKodht6jciWlSx.definition: An Active Investor Disclosure is a document filed by investors who hold a significant stake in a company and intend to actively influence or control its management or operations. This disclosure is required by regulatory authorities to ensure transparency about the intentions of major shareholders and to monitor their potential impact on the company's governance and strategic direction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oK0KvFQFw9mmggZ2d.label: Cooperation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oK0KvFQFw9mmggZ2d.definition: A Cooperation Agreement is a legally binding document that outlines the terms and conditions of a collaborative effort between two or more parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oT1uDgFl2wSjoa358.label: Partner
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oT1uDgFl2wSjoa358.definition: A partner is an individual who is a member of a partnership - an entity formed when at least two or more individuals agree to go into business with one another.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oTWHAoyyW9ztb5KA2.label: Housing Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oTWHAoyyW9ztb5KA2.definition: A Housing Court is a specialized court forum that has jurisdiction over cases related to housing disputes and issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oTnyi9FomDmIeLK16.label: Agreement in Principle Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oTnyi9FomDmIeLK16.definition: An Agreement in Principle Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the basic terms and conditions of an agreement that has not yet been finalized.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oa5Hw9eJQOc1E7mtb.label: Fingerprint Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oa5Hw9eJQOc1E7mtb.definition: Fingerprint evidence involves the collection, analysis, and comparison of the unique patterns found on human fingers. Because every individual has a unique set of fingerprints, they can serve as a reliable means of identification. When fingerprints are recovered from a crime scene, they can be compared to known prints in a database or from suspects to establish a match. The accuracy and reliability of fingerprint evidence have made it a fundamental tool in criminal investigations and forensic science for over a century.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9on8tiquMTsKR6vhoo.label: Utility Patent Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/R9on8tiquMTsKR6vhoo.definition: Utility Patent Assets are a specific type of patent asset that refers to the exclusive rights granted to an inventor or assignee for a specific period of time to make, use, and sell an invention.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oqmNw5hRo7CnMIAeh.label: Vacation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oqmNw5hRo7CnMIAeh.definition: A Vacation, or Holiday, is a period of time taken off from work or regular activities for rest, relaxation, or travel. This planned absence from routine duties is typically paid time off for employees, allowing for leisure activities, personal pursuits, or extended breaks from professional responsibilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9oz08cWJcI23x0nYU1.label: Indemnification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9oz08cWJcI23x0nYU1.definition: An Indemnification Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the contract or a related transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9p16ExXgZzn7Kx478N.label: Prompt Engineering
http://lmss.sali.org/R9p16ExXgZzn7Kx478N.definition: Prompt Engineering is the process of designing and crafting prompts for AI models to elicit desired outputs. It involves understanding the capabilities of the model and tailoring the prompt to guide the model effectively toward generating relevant, informative, and creative responses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9p2vBxKILvrSZ0pjct.label: Vexatious Litigant
http://lmss.sali.org/R9p2vBxKILvrSZ0pjct.definition: A party who has abused the court system by filing too many frivolous lawsuits may be prohibited from filing another suit or matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9p2y1nt52ThtYwlyLA.definition: The "Adverse impact on ability to consummate" Language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that outlines the potential negative effects on the ability to complete a transaction, and is part of the Forward-looking Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9p98NogvwJk1MnJgYz.definition: Any process that provides advice to a single party without adversarial event.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pC5rYhFMiLaQiSZET.definition: The killing of another person through negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pDifEQPZakjZCBdUY.definition: Mergers and Acquisitions Documents are written or recorded representations of agreements and disclosures related to the purchase or merger of companies.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pJlgZDelUlrPrZ9dZ.definition: Industries in the Repair and Maintenance industry group restore machinery, equipment, and other products to working order. http://lmss.sali.org/R9pQxz2fUIrk1LjvVP8.label: Enforcement of Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pQxz2fUIrk1LjvVP8.definition: The enforcement of judgment refers to the legal process of ensuring that a court's decision is carried out, often through methods such as seizing assets or placing liens on property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pVM1ap8tvlM3l5FYd.label: Codicil
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pVM1ap8tvlM3l5FYd.definition: A Codicil is a legal document that amends, rather than replaces, a previously executed will. It allows an individual to make changes or additions to their existing will without drafting an entirely new one, ensuring that certain provisions are updated or altered while the remainder of the will stays intact.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pWPPfpEDTgIvTXaMF.label: Term of Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pWPPfpEDTgIvTXaMF.definition: A Term of Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the duration of the agreement and the conditions under which it can be terminated.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pWxROKSh2Pmvgjn2q.label: Washington Superior Court - King County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pWxROKSh2Pmvgjn2q.definition: Washington Superior Court - King County is a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within King County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pdzW3m7BhNJzoxFi5.label: Callable Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pdzW3m7BhNJzoxFi5.definition: A Callable Asset is a financial instrument that can be redeemed or repaid by the issuer before its specified maturity date, at the issuer's discretion. This feature allows the issuer to take advantage of favorable interest rate movements or other financial conditions, often resulting in the repayment of the principal and cessation of interest payments prior to the original maturity date.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pjDPV7ETWS05AjZIO.label: Right to Indemnification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pjDPV7ETWS05AjZIO.definition: A Right to Indemnification Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and defend the other party against any losses or damages incurred as a result of the contract, even if the losses or damages were caused by the indemnified party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pmjLDKAMzm147xIPP.label: Energy Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pmjLDKAMzm147xIPP.definition: Law governing the production, distribution, consumption, and regulation of energy resources — including oil, gas, electricity, and renewable energy — as well as the rights and obligations of energy producers, consumers, and regulators.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9prz4QxwZVTmvmo4Qt.definition: A PO_NUMBER is a unique identifier assigned to a purchase order within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pssJwbQ89wfcLFqq9.label: Commercial Paper
http://lmss.sali.org/R9pssJwbQ89wfcLFqq9.definition: Commercial paper is an unsecured, short-term debt instrument issued by a corporation, typically for the financing of accounts payable and inventories and meeting short-term liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ptzjWj29f9jaS2bIu.label: Buyout Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ptzjWj29f9jaS2bIu.definition: A buyout clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to purchase the rights or assets of another party under certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9puPEXqTuEYvrqkz2p.definition: Negligent or improper conduct by a medical professional specializing in orthopedic surgery, resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pvvZbNCigFkR0zlEI.definition: The INVOICE_DATE concept refers to the specific date on which an invoice was issued, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pwejG33H0Y9mi74Wz.definition: A body of persons (jurors) temporarily selected from a jurisdiction's citizenry that is invested with power to present or indict a person for a public offense or to try a question of fact.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9pzaBtzLrRZ0s9E41A.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Amended Complaint is a request made to the court to allow a party to have more time to submit a revised version of their initial complaint.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q0hyYnNxQC475BKXO.label: Insurance Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q0hyYnNxQC475BKXO.definition: Insurance Claims: A legal demand made by an insured party to an insurance company for compensation or coverage for a loss or damage that is covered by the insurance policy.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q2Y9Ds3fbGrRa0SxP.label: 376 Qui Tam  (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q2Y9Ds3fbGrRa0SxP.definition: Action brought under the False Claims Act by private persons (also known as "whistleblowers") on their own behalf and on behalf of the United States to recover damages against another person or entity that acted fraudulently in receiving payments or property from, or avoiding debts owed to, the United States Government, 31 U.S.C. § 3730

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q3ww86gR2YzIpw6Pi.label: Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q3ww86gR2YzIpw6Pi.definition: OSCE (Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe): The world's largest security-oriented intergovernmental organization, whose mandate includes issues such as arms control and the promotion of human rights, freedom of the press, and fair elections.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q4epP5NYLatJZ0eFt.label: Operating Report
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q4epP5NYLatJZ0eFt.definition: An Operating Report is a type of Report that is specifically related to Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document, providing information on the financial and operational status of a company during the bankruptcy process.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q6K9SQAWS0tjXvWLt.label: Par
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q6K9SQAWS0tjXvWLt.definition: Par refers to the face value of a financial instrument, such as a bond or loan, at the time of issuance or redemption. It is the nominal value that does not account for interest rates or market fluctuations

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q6Of9vCpTLTYAKbSr.label: Indiana Superior Court - Lawrence County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q6Of9vCpTLTYAKbSr.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Lawrence County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Lawrence County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9q7GJc1zsYT0P4Xdp6.label: Litigation Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/R9q7GJc1zsYT0P4Xdp6.definition: Demand or assertion seeking money, property, or enforcement of another right as provided by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qKXWNYSIemqokJFFu.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Cortland County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qNwyOrzjiccsqggU9.label: Inactive Employment Status
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qNwyOrzjiccsqggU9.definition: Inactive Employment refers to a temporary or prolonged period during which an employee remains on the payroll but is not actively performing job duties. This can occur for various reasons such as medical leave, furlough, or sabbatical, and usually entails a change in benefits or compensation during the inactive period.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qPz8wiiMNjtoH6mWA.label: Petitioning Creditor
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qPz8wiiMNjtoH6mWA.definition: A creditor who initiates an involuntary bankruptcy by filing an involuntary petition, which can be filed against an individual or business. 11 US Code § 303

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qSb7vRy506Q5Qr2GQ.label: Data Protection Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qSb7vRy506Q5Qr2GQ.definition: A Data Protection Agreement is a contract that outlines the terms and conditions under which personal data will be processed, stored, and protected. It's especially relevant in jurisdictions with strict data protection laws, ensuring that both parties are aware of and comply with their obligations to protect personal data from breaches and unauthorized access.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWEOU7UqQ1aii6GTa.label: Gifts Inter Vivos
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWEOU7UqQ1aii6GTa.definition: Gifts Inter Vivos: A legal term referring to gifts made during the lifetime of the donor, which are irrevocable and are not subject to probate upon the donor's death, and are often used as a means of reducing estate taxes.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWL0MSEb3SlvHokGo.label: Mutual Indemnification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWL0MSEb3SlvHokGo.definition: A Mutual Indemnification Clause is a provision in a contract where both parties agree to protect and compensate each other against any losses, damages, or liabilities that may arise from the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWOyiOCY9v0cF2P0c.label: Asset-Based Lending Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qWOyiOCY9v0cF2P0c.definition: Asset-Based Lending Practice involves legal work related to providing loans secured by a borrower's assets, such as inventory, accounts receivable, or equipment. This practice includes drafting and negotiating loan agreements, conducting due diligence on collateral, and ensuring compliance with relevant laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qYLpjYHVmsbAR3Gr5.label: Right to Nationality
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qYLpjYHVmsbAR3Gr5.definition: The right to nationality is a fundamental human right that ensures individuals have a legal membership in a sovereign state, often signified by citizenship. This right is protected by international treaties like the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and aims to prevent statelessness, which can result in the loss of basic rights and protections.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qZg3GlwEzB1fOm4As.label: Project Management Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qZg3GlwEzB1fOm4As.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's process and practice of developing and managing major projects in support of its overall mandate, as well as risks associated with specific projects that may require ongoing management. This includes negative outcomes stemming from an organization's inability to effectively plan, execute, and control its projects or initiatives. Causes can include poor project planning, inadequate resource allocation, scope creep, or ineffective communication. And this risk can potentially lead to delays, cost overruns, unmet objectives, or diminished quality, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, reputation, and success.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9qc3aBn8yLjeP2zODD.label: Coptic
http://lmss.sali.org/R9qc3aBn8yLjeP2zODD.definition: A language that was spoken in Egypt from the 2nd to the 17th century AD, characterized by its use of the Coptic alphabet derived from the Greek alphabet.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9sokcA9oHRbgtRmCOs.definition: In the context of a balance sheet, "balance" refers to the value assigned to an asset, liability, or equity account at a specific point in time. This is related to several legal areas (e.g., Tax Law, Bankruptcy Law).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9swAdlWbrsRBKc4DFF.definition: The concept of "Wasting Another's Property or Inheritance" refers to the intentional or negligent destruction, depletion, or misuse of assets or inheritance that belong to someone else, which can result in legal claims within the context of trusts and estates.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9sxVMDOgOIRK17x5PG.label: Property Right of Habitation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9sxVMDOgOIRK17x5PG.definition: In civil law jurisdictions, the Right of Property Habitation refers to a real right that allows an individual to reside in a dwelling for life or a specified period, without owning the property outright. http://lmss.sali.org/R9szLiADV9YpQbQthSA.definition: Litigation Costs: The expenses incurred by parties in a legal dispute, including attorney fees, court fees, and other related expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9t3AYQvReMSxehDqSa.definition: A claim made under the Longshore and Harbor Workers’ Compensation Act (LHWCA), which provides benefits to certain maritime workers who are injured or become ill while working on navigable waters or in adjoining areas used for loading, unloading, repairing, or building a vessel.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9t8WXRLn7pookX0bFc.label: Petition for Skilled Worker and Specialty Occupation Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/R9t8WXRLn7pookX0bFc.definition: The "Petition for Specialty Occupation Visa" generally refers to the H-1B visa petition in the United States. The H-1B visa is a non-immigrant visa category that allows U.S. employers to hire foreign workers in specialty occupations that require specialized knowledge and skills. The employer must file a Form I-129 petition with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), demonstrating that the position meets the criteria of a specialty occupation and that the beneficiary (the foreign worker) has the necessary qualifications. If approved, the beneficiary can work in the U.S. for the sponsoring employer for a specified period, typically up to three years with the possibility of extension

http://lmss.sali.org/R9t9CxrTa4mDaTCNU0T.label: Motion to Waive Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/R9t9CxrTa4mDaTCNU0T.definition: A Motion to Waive Fee is a request made in a bankruptcy case to waive the filing fee due to the petitioner's inability to pay.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9tXROSMkxjNIQjP9yc.definition: The APAC Market Region encompasses the geographical area of Asia and the Pacific, including East Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania, known for its economic dynamism, technological innovation, and diverse consumer bases. Bias can lead to unfair or discriminatory outcomes, impacting the effectiveness and ethical alignment of AI systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9tkTSSwP8aYisvfOD6.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Miami County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Miami County.
