http://lmss.sali.org/R9tuIhKlUCKz2ueksbu.definition: Firm Accounting Personnel refers to non-timekeeping staff members of a legal service provider who are responsible for financial management and accounting tasks.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9tw3RFfTLsJDMqB2iK.label: Endorsement Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9tw3RFfTLsJDMqB2iK.definition: An Endorsement Agreement is a legally binding contract between parties that outlines the terms and conditions of an endorsement deal, typically involving a celebrity or public figure promoting a product or service.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9twyHb3yZtdEWn4hwB.label: Treatise
http://lmss.sali.org/R9twyHb3yZtdEWn4hwB.definition: A treatise is a comprehensive and systematic written work that provides an in-depth analysis of a particular legal subject or area of law. It is often used as a reference by legal professionals and scholars to gain a deeper understanding of legal principles, case law, and statutory interpretations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9txSKDhPowifpnPFhQ.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Spencer County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9txSKDhPowifpnPFhQ.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Spencer County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Spencer County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9tyJmIM3Lx7OItGji5.label: Plaintiff
http://lmss.sali.org/R9tyJmIM3Lx7OItGji5.definition: A plaintiff, complainant, or claimant is a person who brings a civil or criminal action against another person or entity in a dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9tylKJIT1WXHqet4wZ.label: Seasonal Worker
http://lmss.sali.org/R9tylKJIT1WXHqet4wZ.definition: A Seasonal Employee is hired for a specific period that coincides with a season, event, or holiday, often in industries like retail, tourism, and agriculture. Unlike full-time or part-time employees, seasonal employees are usually not eligible for long-term company benefits and are laid off at the end of the season.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9u1OWNtqYmlcZCdyVR.label: Motion to Transfer Appeal to Other Circuit
http://lmss.sali.org/R9u1OWNtqYmlcZCdyVR.definition: A Motion to Transfer Appeal to Other Circuit is a formal request made in an appellate court to move a case to a different circuit for review.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9u4hHZJYFWdtdGcgko.label: Restrictive Covenant Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/R9u4hHZJYFWdtdGcgko.definition: A "Restrictive Covenant Agreement" is a contractual document that imposes certain limitations or obligations on one or more parties, commonly in the context of employment, real estate, or business transactions. The agreement specifies the scope, duration, and geographic extent of restrictions such as non-compete, non-solicitation, or land use limitations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9uTFHGFCMBjtYw5MOm.label: Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9uTFHGFCMBjtYw5MOm.definition: An insurance policy is a contract between an insurance provider and a policyholder that outlines the terms and conditions under which the insurer will provide coverage and financial compensation for specific risks, events, or damages. The policy specifies the premiums to be paid by the policyholder, the coverage limits, and the obligations of each party in the event of a claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9uZzHCid5e7wxUzNej.label: Application for Entry of Final Decree
http://lmss.sali.org/R9uZzHCid5e7wxUzNej.definition: An Application for Entry of Final Decree is a formal request submitted to a court by a debtor in a bankruptcy case, asking for the court's approval of the final order that will close the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9uiDByr48mJfLgUdiI.label: Sodomy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9uiDByr48mJfLgUdiI.definition: Oral or anal sexual intercourse with another person, forcibly and/or against that person’s will or not forcibly or against the person’s will in instances where the victim is incapable of giving consent because of his/her youth or because of his/her temporary or permanent mental or physical incapacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ulnAxGn9Q8G36Avin.label: Dower
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ulnAxGn9Q8G36Avin.definition: A dower is a claim made by a widow to a portion of her deceased husband's estate, typically one-third, as a form of support and security.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9uoItz60Ut8I4l3jEH.label: Civil Court
http://lmss.sali.org/R9uoItz60Ut8I4l3jEH.definition: A Civil Court is a type of court forum that has jurisdiction over non-criminal cases involving private disputes between individuals or organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9urXqVYLqwUXpAConC.label: Conservatorship of Juvenile
http://lmss.sali.org/R9urXqVYLqwUXpAConC.definition: A conservatorship of juvenile is a legal arrangement where a court appoints a responsible adult to care for a minor's personal and financial needs when the minor's parents are unable to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9urbfNUt3xFfiCqJ1x.label: Georgia District Court - Fulton County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9urbfNUt3xFfiCqJ1x.definition: Georgia District Court - Fulton County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Fulton County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9uzjRTP8QeY8QG9zT9.label: Special Purpose Acquisition Company
http://lmss.sali.org/R9uzjRTP8QeY8QG9zT9.definition: A Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) is a shell corporation specifically created to raise capital through an initial public offering (IPO) for the purpose of acquiring an existing company. Once the funds are raised, the SPAC identifies a target company to acquire, and if the acquisition is successful, the SPAC effectively takes the acquired company public.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v17ZYsnDkNSEZkvD3.label: Dispute Venue
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v17ZYsnDkNSEZkvD3.definition: A Dispute Venue is a specific type of Forum or Venue that is responsible for administering legal proceedings related to disputes, including Courts, Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Venues, Legislative Proceedings, and Administrative Proceeding Venues.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v1L6NTONpYHPqhwfG.label: Liquidity Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v1L6NTONpYHPqhwfG.definition: The risk that a party will be unable to buy or sell an asset quickly enough to prevent or minimize a loss.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v2UUDvT1VZX1aTmVu.label: Failure to Prevent Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v2UUDvT1VZX1aTmVu.definition: Failure to prevent discrimination refers to a situation in which an employer, organization, or entity neglects to take appropriate steps to address and deter discriminatory actions or practices within their environment. This may include not establishing and enforcing clear policies, failing to provide training or education on discrimination and harassment, or neglecting to investigate and remedy complaints of discrimination.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v3KOtcasrJrWD0dr9.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Lincoln County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v3KOtcasrJrWD0dr9.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Lincoln County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Lincoln County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v49XBtDD1H7m9vlSs.label: Escrow Provisions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v49XBtDD1H7m9vlSs.definition: An Escrow Provisions Clause is a legal provision within an Escrow Clause that outlines the specific terms and conditions for holding funds or property in a neutral third-party account until certain conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v4stLt6GphwMCo3CE.label: Florida Court of Appeals - 3d District
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v4stLt6GphwMCo3CE.definition: The Florida Court of Appeals - 3d District is a specific court within the Florida District Court of Appeals that hears appeals from lower courts in the third district of Florida.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v8rZaf1tIB7O0km8n.label: Motion to File Claim After Claims Bar Date
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v8rZaf1tIB7O0km8n.definition: A Motion to File Claim After Claims Bar Date is a request made in a bankruptcy case to allow a creditor to file a claim after the deadline for filing claims has passed.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9v922zEDjLTzShv6ZT.label: Custody Law
http://lmss.sali.org/R9v922zEDjLTzShv6ZT.definition: Custody Law refers to the legal rules and regulations that govern the care, control, and maintenance of children in cases of separation or divorce.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vDInu2daYCowH2dxM.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Howard County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vDInu2daYCowH2dxM.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Howard County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Howard County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vGEtlg073ckSVYaQN.label: Right to Use Common Areas
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vGEtlg073ckSVYaQN.definition: The Right to Use Common Areas refers to the legal entitlement of property owners or tenants within a multi-unit building or complex to access and utilize shared spaces, such as hallways, lobbies, parking lots, and recreational facilities. This right is usually governed by rules set forth in property agreements or by a homeowners' association, and may be subject to certain limitations and responsibilities

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vHzoqLH5KeerPLf5P.label: Equitable Tolling
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vHzoqLH5KeerPLf5P.definition: Equitable Tolling is a legal doctrine that allows for the extension of a statute of limitations in certain circumstances to prevent unfair forfeitures of rights, provided that the defendant is not prejudiced by the delay.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vJchiEBHNEBTJemS4.label: Putable Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vJchiEBHNEBTJemS4.definition: A Putable Asset is a financial instrument that grants the holder the right to sell the asset back to the issuer at a specified price before its maturity date. This feature provides investors with the flexibility to exit the investment under certain conditions, often mitigating potential losses and reducing risk.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vNTn6V5QqK2GsYuaX.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Adair County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vNTn6V5QqK2GsYuaX.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Adair County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Adair County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vXd0Re3VjMag8V2N5.label: Litigation Case - Long Name
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vXd0Re3VjMag8V2N5.definition: A litigation case with a longer name, which is a subcategory of a litigation case name.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vaSQKqYGzvWB6jGlL.label: Disclaimer of Damages Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vaSQKqYGzvWB6jGlL.definition: A disclaimer of damages clause is a provision in a contract that limits or eliminates the liability of one party for any damages incurred by the other party, even if the first party is at fault.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vhaGcxC6U5jgAzONH.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Exempt Property
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vhaGcxC6U5jgAzONH.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Exempt Property requires the debtor to list property they claim as exempt from the bankruptcy estate, protecting it from liquidation to satisfy creditor claims. This schedule identifies assets the debtor is allowed to retain under federal or state exemption laws, such as certain amounts of equity in a home, vehicle, or personal items.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vlLEQGyNxBPJqvNjd.label: Rescue Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vlLEQGyNxBPJqvNjd.definition: The Rescue Doctrine is a legal concept that allows a person who voluntarily attempts to rescue another person in danger to potentially recover damages if they are injured due to the negligence of another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vpB76lhr0zURJ6S0x.label: Academic Paper
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vpB76lhr0zURJ6S0x.definition: An academic paper is a scholarly piece of writing that is based on original research or analysis and contributes to the existing body of knowledge on a particular subject. In legal academia, these papers are often published in law reviews or journals, and they adhere to a stringent set of formatting and citation standards, providing a rigorous examination of legal theories, case law, or legislative issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vsqZnOJvcOcxaLMgF.label: 740 Railway Labor Act (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vsqZnOJvcOcxaLMgF.definition: Action relating to disputes filed under the Railway Labor Act, 45 U.S.C. § 151 including labor disputes, individual claims, and response to sanctions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vwYGCNwzGK4NDEiUH.label: Videoconference
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vwYGCNwzGK4NDEiUH.definition: A communication that occurs via videoconference (e.g., Zoom, Teams, Meet).

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vz5LkIP9uYv3qO6aS.label: Admission Pro Hac Vice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vz5LkIP9uYv3qO6aS.definition: Admission Pro Hac Vice is a legal term that refers to the permission granted to an out-of-state lawyer to practice law in a particular jurisdiction for a specific case.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9vzE33TyrWCJovQdYn.label: Insider Trading
http://lmss.sali.org/R9vzE33TyrWCJovQdYn.definition: The act of buying or selling securities based on material, non-public information obtained from a company or its insiders, in violation of a duty to keep such information confidential.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9w62eM16EjSgGYLj5T.label: Bite Mark Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/R9w62eM16EjSgGYLj5T.definition: Bite mark evidence involves the study of patterns left by teeth on various materials, often skin. Forensic odontologists analyze these marks to identify unique dental characteristics, potentially linking a suspect to an injury or crime scene.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9w8IqbzIqtshaEs4zN.label: Georgia Superior Court - Wilkinson County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9w8IqbzIqtshaEs4zN.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Wilkinson County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over legal matters within Wilkinson County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wJxE9zsfVpdyT8c4T.label: Statutory Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wJxE9zsfVpdyT8c4T.definition: A statutory appeal is a type of appeal that is specifically authorized by a statute or law, and allows a party to challenge a decision made by a lower court or administrative agency.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wMn80MhrS9iqfKdQd.label: Unlawful Detainer
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wMn80MhrS9iqfKdQd.definition: An unlawful detainer is a summary proceeding for a landlord to recover possession of a leased premises from a tenant wrongfully withholding or "detaining" the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wO0KkQsV21vmDQgWA.label: Cancer of Unknown Primary Site
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wO0KkQsV21vmDQgWA.definition: Cancer where the primary site is unknown after appropriate search refers to a malignant neoplasm for which the origin remains unidentified despite comprehensive diagnostic testing. This condition, also known as carcinoma of unknown primary (CUP), requires tailored treatment approaches due to the uncertainty of its origin and may involve symptoms affecting various organs or systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wOozhrGHQP0kgC7Ka.label: Hematology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wOozhrGHQP0kgC7Ka.definition: Medical negligence related to the diagnosis, treatment, or management of blood disorders or diseases.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTfv5R2USD2F700vI.label: New York City Court - Poughkeepsie
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTfv5R2USD2F700vI.definition: A court located in Poughkeepsie, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTjG87inLToLVFOsw.label: Kurukh
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTjG87inLToLVFOsw.definition: Kurukh (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTpJLzB8Yx3j8cHlT.label: Motion for Summary Adjudication
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wTpJLzB8Yx3j8cHlT.definition: A Motion for Summary Adjudication is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy or civil case, asking the court to rule in their favor without a trial, based on the evidence presented in the motion.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wUQCNfdSnHyqxrNwD.label: Binding Precedent
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wUQCNfdSnHyqxrNwD.definition: Binding Precedent is a legal principle established in a previous case that must be followed by all lower courts in the same jurisdiction when deciding subsequent cases with similar facts or legal issues. It is a fundamental aspect of common law legal systems and ensures consistency and predictability in the application of law.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wUVOoS6llpD5xghRl.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Saline Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wUVOoS6llpD5xghRl.definition: A court located in Saline County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated area.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wWe8tvB9q0PutQGf4.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Mi'kmaq people in Eastern Canada and Northeastern United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wXEpicPBDF420JUfm.label: Drug Testing Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wXEpicPBDF420JUfm.definition: A drug testing policy is a formal document established by an organization that outlines the procedures, guidelines, and consequences related to the testing of employees for the presence of drugs and/or alcohol. It generally seeks to ensure a safe and productive work environment by preventing substance abuse and its associated risks.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wfJNl4JrssnrTiDxP.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Boone County (17th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wiJc7Sk83LXxiu3a8.definition: A provision in a contract that specifies the inclusion of physical or digital items as evidence or proof of the agreement, which are attached to the contract itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wj1VE5eyNlYc9HVzs.label: Wrongful Seduction
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wj1VE5eyNlYc9HVzs.definition: The act of seducing someone through deceit or manipulation, resulting in harm or damages, which can be legally pursued as a tort claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wl00Cx0YzzMrf2sOv.label: Motion to Intervene
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wl00Cx0YzzMrf2sOv.definition: A Motion to Intervene is a legal request made by a non-party to join an ongoing case in order to protect their interests or rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9wmRF0K1qXafhcBaTm.label: Motion to Refer Case to Mediation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9wmRF0K1qXafhcBaTm.definition: A Motion to Refer Case to Mediation is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to have the case referred to a mediator for resolution, rather than proceeding to trial or appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9x02eEp8VVDan2OUz2.label: Previous Testimony
http://lmss.sali.org/R9x02eEp8VVDan2OUz2.definition: Prior Under-Oath Statements are statements made by a witness under oath in a previous legal proceeding or deposition that are admissible as non-hearsay evidence in a current trial or hearing. These statements are considered reliable because they were made under the penalty of perjury and subject to cross-examination at the time they were originally given.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9x5QwRGiVmdj639Zj4.label: Wild Animal
http://lmss.sali.org/R9x5QwRGiVmdj639Zj4.definition: A Wild Animal is a species that lives and thrives in its natural habitat without direct dependence on or control by humans. These animals have not been domesticated and typically rely on their instincts and the environment to find food, shelter, and survive.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9x6yqzHQfo3MF4rxIc.label: Legal Services Provider
http://lmss.sali.org/R9x6yqzHQfo3MF4rxIc.definition: A person or entity that is providing legal services to another person or entity

http://lmss.sali.org/R9x9hjbwp9vqD2UEtUV.label: Ainu
http://lmss.sali.org/R9x9hjbwp9vqD2UEtUV.definition: Ainu (Language) refers to the language spoken by the Ainu people, an indigenous group from Japan and Russia, and is a subcategory of the Language class in the ontology.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xB5Lty5VVIW6I47IA.label: JM10 Preparing costs claim (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xB5Lty5VVIW6I47IA.definition: Includes the reconciliation of the costs claimed to any approved budget in and the preparation of the bill of costs for detailed assessment

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xCPEuSGFNdgOy6l65.label: eDiscovery Technology Management
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xCPEuSGFNdgOy6l65.definition: eDiscovery Technology Management refers to the process of managing electronic discovery tools and technologies in the context of litigation management.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xEjWwUjs8etARsP6l.label: Prison Guard
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xEjWwUjs8etARsP6l.definition: A Prison Guard is a security officer responsible for maintaining order, enforcing rules, and ensuring the safety of inmates and staff within a correctional facility. They perform duties such as monitoring inmate activities, conducting searches, and responding to emergencies to prevent disturbances and uphold security protocols.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xIDmSWEmx5mz3AZrV.label: Order Denying Request
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xIDmSWEmx5mz3AZrV.definition: An Order Denying Request is a legal document issued by a court that denies a request made by one party to the court by providing a decision against the request.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xInCkOFkusezameAC.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Allegheny County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xInCkOFkusezameAC.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Allegheny County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Allegheny County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xOJtxvjFzaouQnUgc.definition: A Personal Injury Ruleset is a set of legal rules and guidelines that specifically pertain to cases involving physical or emotional harm caused by another party's negligence or intentional actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xPUqlbWdP9WloyHj3.label: Certificate of Service of Tax Information to Requestor
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xPUqlbWdP9WloyHj3.definition: A Certificate of Service of Tax Information to Requestor is a written document that confirms the delivery of tax information to the person who requested it.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xQp8xAqO9ia2VlUwP.label: Public Matter Narrative
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xQp8xAqO9ia2VlUwP.definition: A public version of a matter narrative.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xTnWMUohsyvLzHb6f.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 12th
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xTnWMUohsyvLzHb6f.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 12th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xXAi8F91sxNsSZRti.label: Insolvent Lessor Having Leased Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xXAi8F91sxNsSZRti.definition: An Insolvent Lessor Having Leased Goods refers to a legal claim arising from a contract or quasi-contract where the lessor of goods is unable to pay their debts and has leased the goods to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xcilcYTdYs5jsLtOt.label: Homestead Exemption
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xcilcYTdYs5jsLtOt.definition: In a homestead exemption, a property is protected from being sold to pay off debts in a bankruptcy case, as it is considered essential for the debtor's basic needs and livelihood.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xemfiWMWadeJrqQDm.label: Minnesota District Court - Marshall County
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xemfiWMWadeJrqQDm.definition: Minnesota District Court - Marshall County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Marshall County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xgvrUWmxGlvR7ooOg.label: Buyer Consent Requirement Application
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xgvrUWmxGlvR7ooOg.definition: A Buyer Consent Requirement Application is a specific instance where a buyer's consent is necessary for the execution of a negative covenant, either for all negative covenants or only for specified ones.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xjzPzl7ldTIpxYr4d.label: Motion to Amend Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xjzPzl7ldTIpxYr4d.definition: A Motion to Amend Judgment is a legal request to modify or correct a court's decision or order, typically made after a judgment has been entered.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xmtQ6KmUrpnuuE70m.label: Yakut
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xmtQ6KmUrpnuuE70m.definition: Yakut (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, and is a subcategory of the Language class.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xozXwwzmZ3msdwItV.label: Termination of Parental Rights Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9xozXwwzmZ3msdwItV.definition: Termination of Parental Rights (TPR) Claim is a legal action taken to permanently end a parent's legal rights and responsibilities towards their child, typically due to abuse, neglect, or abandonment.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9xrJpkUfwWXkTHxpfp.definition: A Complete Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that states that the written agreement represents the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes any prior negotiations or agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ya2bhBlRQfwOwM8T7.label: Social Security Number
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ya2bhBlRQfwOwM8T7.definition: A Social Security Number (SSN) is a nine-digit identification number issued by the U.S. Social Security Administration. http://lmss.sali.org/R9yi9EljTLvrh7N74L4.label: Hearsay Avoidance Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/R9yi9EljTLvrh7N74L4.definition: Hearsay Avoidance Objectives refer to the various purposes or exceptions that allow out-of-court statements to be admitted into evidence during a legal proceeding, thereby avoiding the exclusion of such statements under the hearsay rule. These objectives include direct testimony, present sense impression, excited utterance, and situations where the declarant is unavailable to testify in person.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9yjTfeSdVjijvdiMkt.label: Reasonable Suspicion
http://lmss.sali.org/R9yjTfeSdVjijvdiMkt.definition: Reasonable Suspicion is a legal standard that requires an officer to have a belief, based on specific and articulable facts, that a person is involved in criminal activity or is about to be involved in criminal activity.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9yjVzN8I8D3wt6c0Wg.label: Subrogation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9yjVzN8I8D3wt6c0Wg.definition: A subrogation clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to step into the shoes of another party and assume their legal rights and remedies in the event of a loss or damage.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ykFDK4FWIDYcF9bPL.label: Tamil
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ykFDK4FWIDYcF9bPL.definition: Tamil (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Tamil language, used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9yqnXWcGhtBOudF4Gu.definition: Estate Planning Practice involves the preparation and arrangement of an individual's estate to manage and distribute assets during their lifetime and after death. It includes creating legal documents such as wills, trusts, and powers of attorney to ensure that an individual's wishes are followed and to minimize taxes and legal complications.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9ytmPdgahEqzmq3LfI.label: Processing of Documents Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9ytmPdgahEqzmq3LfI.definition: The Processing of Documents Practice refers to the specific legal work involved in collecting and producing documents in the course of a legal matter, and is a subcategory of the Document Collection and Production Practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9yxbDuVoy3DTGPFCjw.label: Virtual Reality
http://lmss.sali.org/R9yxbDuVoy3DTGPFCjw.definition: A Virtual Reality Experience is an immersive, interactive environment created using computer technology that simulates a real or imagined world, allowing users to engage with the environment through specialized hardware such as VR headsets.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9yzeK9HOihAOIF0x8n.label: Notice of Appearance and Request for Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/R9yzeK9HOihAOIF0x8n.definition: A Notice of Appearance and Request for Notice is a legal document filed by an attorney to inform the court and opposing counsel that they are representing a party in a case and to request that all future notices and documents related to the case be sent to them.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9z1u2Wr9I7qaJiANll.label: Warranty of Title Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/R9z1u2Wr9I7qaJiANll.definition: A Warranty of Title Clause is a provision in a contract that guarantees the seller's legal ownership of the property being sold and promises to defend the buyer against any claims made by third parties regarding the title.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9z5VX9m1ukVvqp5ltd.label: Judicial Recommendation
http://lmss.sali.org/R9z5VX9m1ukVvqp5ltd.definition: A judicial recommendation is a document created by a trial court that provides guidance or advice to a higher court or decision-making body.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9z7SN3H66BpMdMDsPL.label: Intervening Event - Unknown at Signing
http://lmss.sali.org/R9z7SN3H66BpMdMDsPL.definition: An "Intervening Event - Unknown at Signing" is a circumstance or occurrence that happens after the signing of a legal agreement, which was not anticipated or known at the time of signing and may affect the performance or outcome of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9z8gDGK2jOKNXnrWAE.label: Motion for New Trial - Clerical Error
http://lmss.sali.org/R9z8gDGK2jOKNXnrWAE.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Clerical Error is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to reconsider its decision due to a mistake made in the court's records or paperwork, rather than an error in the trial proceedings themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9z9MTEwhmYDc2N1Fra.definition: A Pennsylvania District and County Court is a court within the Pennsylvania State Courts system that has jurisdiction over cases within a specific district or county.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9zHtGhiACIwYWhVohR.label: Consumer Credit Protection Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/R9zHtGhiACIwYWhVohR.definition: A Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) claim is a legal action initiated by a consumer, alleging that a creditor, employer, or other covered entity has violated their rights under the CCPA. The CCPA is a federal law enacted in 1968 to safeguard consumers' credit rights by regulating various credit practices and providing protections in areas such as wage garnishment, truthful lending disclosures, and debt collection practices. The CCPA encompasses several statutes, including the Truth in Lending Act (TILA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), and the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA). A CCPA claim may involve issues such as improper wage garnishment, inaccurate credit reporting, discrimination in credit decisions, or abusive debt collection tactics.

http://lmss.sali.org/R9zN7SGPrsshAytaOSt.label: Condominium Association
http://lmss.sali.org/R9zN7SGPrsshAytaOSt.definition: A condominium association is a governing body or organization established within a condominium complex or community. It is typically composed of unit owners within the condominium development. The association's primary responsibilities include managing and maintaining common areas and facilities, enforcing rules and regulations outlined in the condominium's governing documents, and collecting fees or assessments from unit owners to cover shared expenses. It plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and upkeep of the condominium community.

http://lmss.sali.org/RB54thk6pdEaSDe954H.definition: Mental incapacity refers to a condition in which an individual's mental state affects their ability to understand, reason, or make decisions about their own affairs. Mental incapacity can be temporary or permanent and can result from various factors, including age, injury, illness, or developmental disability. In a legal context, mental incapacity can have important implications for an individual's ability to enter into contracts, make decisions about medical treatment, or manage their own affairs. In such cases, a court may appoint a guardian or conservator to act on behalf of the individual with mental incapacity, in order to protect their interests and ensure that their affairs are managed appropriately. Legal proceedings involving mental incapacity can be complex and may require medical evaluations, assessments of decision-making capacity, and other expert testimony.

Form 11-K is a specialized financial disclosure document filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), detailing the financial status of a company's employee benefit plans, such as 401(k) plans. http://lmss.sali.org/RBAnXC8aCYwyK5n53Eq.label: Obstructed License Plate Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAnXC8aCYwyK5n53Eq.definition: An Obstructed License Plate Claim involves allegations that a vehicle's license plate was not clearly visible or was intentionally obscured, violating traffic regulations that require license plates to be unobstructed and legible. Such claims are essential for ensuring that vehicles can be properly identified by law enforcement and traffic cameras, and they often result in fines or corrective orders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAnnuEDUcj1Y0jVCsD.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 12 Case
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAnnuEDUcj1Y0jVCsD.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 12 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 12 of the Bankruptcy Code.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAoFbSK8WP6xJyVrgQ.label: Affirmative Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAoFbSK8WP6xJyVrgQ.definition: Affirmative Defenses are legal arguments raised by a defendant in response to a plaintiff's claim, which if proven, can defeat or mitigate the plaintiff's claim, and must be asserted by the defendant in their answer or other responsive pleading.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBArQMGGQsqMjU7hWmL.label: Contact Prior Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RBArQMGGQsqMjU7hWmL.definition: Contact Prior Name refers to any previous full name used by an individual before it was legally changed. This could be due to reasons like marriage, divorce, or a personal decision to change one's name. When applicable, the prior name may be included in formal documentation or databases for complete identification or historical tracking.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBArUb825Hom37vW5th.label: Patent Opposition Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBArUb825Hom37vW5th.definition: The patent opposition process is a legal procedure that allows third parties to challenge the validity of a patent or patent application. This process is intended to ensure that patents are only granted for inventions that meet the criteria of novelty, inventiveness, and industrial applicability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAslwjHggAEqEvEC7C.label: Government Relations
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAslwjHggAEqEvEC7C.definition: Government relations refers to the management of interactions and communication between an organization and government entities, including legislative bodies, regulatory agencies, and policymakers. It involves advocating for policies, regulations, or actions that benefit the organization or its stakeholders, and may include lobbying, monitoring legislative developments, and engaging in public affairs activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAv3u5Z3iCJEvASeA7.label: No-Knock Warrant
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAv3u5Z3iCJEvASeA7.definition: A No-Knock Warrant is a legal authorization that allows law enforcement officers to enter a property without prior notification to the occupants, typically in the context of a raid or search. This type of warrant is issued when announcing their presence is believed to pose a threat to officer safety or could lead to the destruction of evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAxfpbmWO6iXLjcldJ.label: Background Check Discrimination Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAxfpbmWO6iXLjcldJ.definition: A background check claim is a legal action initiated by an individual who alleges they have been unfairly treated or denied employment, housing, or other opportunities based on the results of a background check. Background checks typically involve the examination of an individual's criminal record, credit history, employment history, or other personal information. These claims often arise when an employer, landlord, or other decision-maker violates the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) or other applicable laws by not providing proper notice, failing to obtain consent, or using the background check information in a discriminatory manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBAz5we0vAOno0uhYu2.label: General Political or Social Conditions Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBAz5we0vAOno0uhYu2.definition: General Political or Social Conditions Language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that allows a party to terminate or modify the agreement if there are significant changes in the political or social conditions of a particular region or country, which may affect the performance of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBB5cexM3974afJhhR2.definition: Indiana Town Court is a local court in Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases within a specific town or township.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBB642PiefieVcp1WIL.label: Distributed Denial-of-Service Attack
http://lmss.sali.org/RBB642PiefieVcp1WIL.definition: A DDoS attack involves multiple compromised computer systems working together to flood a target, such as a website or online service, with a massive amount of traffic. The coordinated assault overwhelms the target's infrastructure, causing interruptions or complete shutdown of the service, making it inaccessible to legitimate users.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBB7n4u5fPhEx6bWG8n.definition: A Motion to File Late Petition for Rehearing (To File Motion and Petition for Rehearing Together) is a request made to an appellate court to allow a party to submit a petition for rehearing after the deadline has passed, while also submitting the motion and petition together.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBFsM2KcGW5CHQl9kA.definition: A Post-Argument Letter Brief is a written document submitted to an appellate court after oral arguments have been made, providing additional information or arguments in support of a party's position.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBIPvZ1CgmAsyYGBEK.definition: A Motion to Enforce Stay is a legal request made in bankruptcy proceedings to ensure that creditors do not take any action to collect debts from the debtor, as required by the automatic stay provision of the bankruptcy code.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBNGfCRL0x4GSTGGrY.label: Tribes
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBNGfCRL0x4GSTGGrY.definition: In the legal and societal context, tribes refer to groups of people sharing a common culture, language, or ancestry, often organized around familial or kinship structures and governed by customary laws or tribal chiefs. Tribal governance and jurisdiction may operate within, alongside, or outside the legal framework of a surrounding nation, with varying degrees of recognized sovereignty and legal authority

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBPUm7CnQzgT9OtoXs.label: Right to Compulsory Process
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBPUm7CnQzgT9OtoXs.definition: The right to compulsory process is a legal principle that grants individuals involved in a criminal trial the ability to obtain witnesses or evidence in their favor through the power of the court. This right, protected by the Sixth Amendment of the United States Constitution, ensures that defendants have a fair opportunity to present their case and gather supporting testimony or materials, even if it requires compelling unwilling witnesses to appear in court or obtaining documents that may be difficult to acquire voluntarily.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBQ6CW3nNMxLhWKILa.label: Surveyor Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBQ6CW3nNMxLhWKILa.definition: Surveyor Negligence is a legal claim of negligence against a surveyor who fails to exercise reasonable care and skill in the performance of their duties, resulting in harm or loss to their client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBZq2pnKF4F034vAf1.label: Skin Color
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBZq2pnKF4F034vAf1.definition: Skin color is the particular shade of a person's skin. In legal contexts, skin color might relate to allegations that an individual has experienced unequal treatment or discrimination based on the color of their skin, rather than their broader racial or ethnic background. These claims can arise in various contexts, such as employment, housing, or public services, and are prohibited under anti-discrimination laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBfInsYEtsGJvAm3qn.label: Berries
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBfInsYEtsGJvAm3qn.definition: Berries are small, pulpy, and often edible fruits, typically produced by perennial plants and shrubs, known for their rich colors and sweet to tart flavors. http://lmss.sali.org/RBBifG8DRVUc0IVqvXZ.label: Corporate Representative Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/RBBifG8DRVUc0IVqvXZ.definition: A Corporate Representative Witness is a witness who testifies on behalf of a corporation in a legal matter, providing information about the corporation's policies, practices, or actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBBo7LrufcJPANNOwnb.definition: An Ex Post Facto Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or action violates the Ex Post Facto Clause of the United States Constitution. http://lmss.sali.org/RBCUY507n1FqryTGMbD.definition: A Declaratory Judgment is a written or recorded statement issued by a court that declares the rights, duties, or obligations of parties involved in a legal dispute, without ordering any specific action or awarding damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBCV26gN63NNAmGIxsK.label: Asylee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBCV26gN63NNAmGIxsK.definition: An asylee is an individual who has been granted asylum, a form of international protection, after proving a well-founded fear of persecution in their home country due to race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion. http://lmss.sali.org/RBDGSreDT4BNz6N4z5O.label: Structured Settlement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDGSreDT4BNz6N4z5O.definition: A structured settlement is a type of settlement agreement that provides for periodic payments over time, rather than a lump sum payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDHqzVlg6n38MdBTYl.label: Motion to Vacate Sentence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDHqzVlg6n38MdBTYl.definition: A Motion to Vacate Sentence is a legal request to set aside or nullify a previously imposed sentence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDNHtmUIGTUKAXvzRP.label: Lawful AI
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDNHtmUIGTUKAXvzRP.definition: Lawful AI refers to AI systems designed and operated in full compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. This ensures that AI systems adhere to legal standards across jurisdictions, including privacy laws, anti-discrimination statutes, data protection regulations, and industry-specific legal requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDPzIFUWJsqqM1kkNf.label: Professional Limited Liability Company
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDPzIFUWJsqqM1kkNf.definition: A professional limited liability company ('PLLC') is a U.S. business entity designed for licensed professionals, such as lawyers, doctors, architects, engineers, accountants, and chiropractors. While many businesses choose to form a limited liability company ('LLC') because of the tax, limited liability, and other benefits, some states don't allow LLCs to be owned by professionals whose occupation requires a license. In these states, licensed professionals who want the benefits of an LLC must form a PLLC instead.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDRtzbiNquelJuhuvp.label: Ratification
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDRtzbiNquelJuhuvp.definition: Plaintiff approved the acts of the defendant and cannot now complain.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDTPeYwNkU855npTtn.label: Spendthrift Trust
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDTPeYwNkU855npTtn.definition: A Spendthrift Trust is a trust established to provide financial support to a beneficiary while protecting the trust assets from the beneficiary's creditors or reckless spending. The trustee has control over the distribution of funds to ensure they are used for the beneficiary's welfare in accordance with the trust's terms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDU1zRCWrr3tJVgsMA.label: Partial Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDU1zRCWrr3tJVgsMA.definition: Partial Payment refers to a financial transaction where only a portion of the total amount due has been paid. This status indicates that the obligation is not yet fully satisfied and includes arrangements such as installment payments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDbODDKtqnYurCrpo7.label: Commitment Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDbODDKtqnYurCrpo7.definition: A Commitment Letter is a formal, written document from a lender that outlines the terms under which the lender agrees to provide a loan to a borrower. The letter specifies important details like the loan amount, interest rate, and repayment terms, and it often requires the borrower's acceptance to become binding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDfRm4fG5sFgdk95zL.label: Social Security Funding Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDfRm4fG5sFgdk95zL.definition: The social security funding objective aims to ensure the financial sustainability of a social security system, which provides benefits such as retirement income, disability payments, and healthcare coverage. This objective involves strategies for collecting sufficient revenues through taxes or contributions and managing expenditures to maintain long-term solvency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDggRpYzbIC7NOvN4K.label: Visa for Dependents of Treaty Skilled Workers
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDggRpYzbIC7NOvN4K.definition: This visa classification (in the U.S., TD visa) is designed for the dependents of Treaty Skilled Worker Visa (in the U.S., TN) holders, including spouses and unmarried children under the age of 21. In the United States, this visa allows these dependents to accompany or join the principal TN visa holder during their period of stay in the U.S. While TD visa holders are not authorized to work, they are permitted to attend school.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDhSx7fl9qS0ezDVJu.label: Litigation Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDhSx7fl9qS0ezDVJu.definition: Legal elements to be proven or disproven (e.g., claims, defenses, remedies, burdens, standards of review).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDjAM773PfjvwDFIBw.label: Driving with a Suspended License
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDjAM773PfjvwDFIBw.definition: Driving on a Suspended or Revoked License: Operating a motor vehicle while one's driver's license has been temporarily or permanently revoked or suspended by the state due to a prior traffic offense or violation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDoWPZqIyQ9czAdSsP.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 3rd District
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDoWPZqIyQ9czAdSsP.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York that is part of the larger New York District Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDqQOVKFp6bdUgyj8m.label: Slander
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDqQOVKFp6bdUgyj8m.definition: The spoken or oral communication of false statements that harm the reputation of another person, which can result in legal action against the speaker.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDqcAr3d1kTppeIjAv.label: Ethnicity
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDqcAr3d1kTppeIjAv.definition: Ethnicity refers to the identification or affiliation with a particular group based on shared cultural traits, ancestry, or historical background. Unlike race, which is often seen as an externally imposed classification, ethnicity is generally considered a self-identified construct linked to a sense of shared community and heritage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDu2ulMPR4euCCHct7.label: Regulatory Petitioner
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDu2ulMPR4euCCHct7.definition: A Regulatory Petitioner refers to an individual or entity formally requesting legal or official approval from a regulatory body, often through a structured application process. This encompasses a wide array of requests, from immigration status changes to the issuance of permits for business operations or environmental actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDv7Fz1HVfJBucZRZG.label: Taken Into Custody
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDv7Fz1HVfJBucZRZG.definition: Taken Into Custody: The act of a law enforcement officer taking a person into custody, typically for the purpose of charging them with a crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDvvMcl4VbqDv1BGaZ.label: Agent
http://lmss.sali.org/RBDvvMcl4VbqDv1BGaZ.definition: A person authorized to act on behalf of another person or a government, including employees and representatives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBDwF6tdGUCMqhjPN00.definition: The textual description of the work performed in the billing period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEVPEYu9kdAbdHIdsH.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by a rehabilitation center or its staff, resulting in harm or injury to a patient, and giving rise to a legal claim for damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEfQXg8uUIsk2iZbk8.definition: A professional adviser offering financial counsel, sometimes charging fees and/or earning commissions. Rockhill  v.  William  M.  Jeude  &  Univest,  Inc. (W.D. Wash. 2012)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEhDoiBEDPhk2x8xwQ.definition: A Choice of Venue Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the location or jurisdiction where any disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEhnztyBTDVuAPjkFA.label: UK Serious Fraud Office
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEhnztyBTDVuAPjkFA.definition: The UK Serious Fraud Office is a governmental department responsible for investigating and prosecuting serious or complex fraud, bribery, and corruption. Operating independently, the SFO combines the functions of police and prosecutor to tackle high-level economic crimes affecting the United Kingdom.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEigCQdiTQxEXHnVOb.label: Management, Scientific, and Technical Consulting Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEigCQdiTQxEXHnVOb.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on management, environmental, scientific, and technical issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEl2j7VESmhE9eN8pS.label: Co-Authoring Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEl2j7VESmhE9eN8pS.definition: Co-Authoring Management refers to the process of managing the collaboration and contribution of multiple authors to a document, within the context of Document Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEnDvjP0Wekrb9m53B.label: Georgia Superior Court - Cook County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEnDvjP0Wekrb9m53B.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Cook County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEpq7cBrdIpiz5en0J.label: Visa for Staff of Diplomats and Government Officials
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEpq7cBrdIpiz5en0J.definition: A visa for staff of diplomats and government officials is a specialized visa category that allows personal employees, domestic workers, aides, attendants, or personal staff to accompany and work for diplomats or government officials while they are stationed in a foreign country. These visas are usually subject to specific conditions and may require the sponsoring diplomat or official to assume certain responsibilities for the employee's welfare and legal status in the host country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEs8X4DFr9E6Axfsdd.label: Residual Hearsay Exception
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEs8X4DFr9E6Axfsdd.definition: The residual hearsay exception is a legal provision that allows hearsay evidence to be admitted in court if it meets certain criteria, even if it does not fall under any other specific hearsay exception. These criteria include the statement being offered as evidence of a material fact, no other more probative evidence exists, its admission serves the interests of justice, and the offering party provides prior notice to the opposing counsel.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEtSbHUfDI2kqG46oM.label: Good Faith Deposit Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEtSbHUfDI2kqG46oM.definition: A Good Faith Deposit Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to provide a deposit as a demonstration of good faith in fulfilling their obligations under the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBEyYAL7xdGe6A1M4aV.label: Georgia Superior Court - Jefferson County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBEyYAL7xdGe6A1M4aV.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Jefferson County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Jefferson County.

examples: Threatened Use of a Deadly Weapon

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF5KuECPEHv8VWSLwe.label: Consumer Goods Leased Under Unconscionable Circumstances
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF5KuECPEHv8VWSLwe.definition: Consumer Goods Leased Under Unconscionable Circumstances refers to the situation where a consumer leases goods from a party who has taken advantage of the consumer's vulnerability, lack of bargaining power, or inability to understand the terms of the lease agreement, resulting in an unfair and unreasonable contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF5X8raWnXA5okY0zW.label: Florida County Court - Union County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF5X8raWnXA5okY0zW.definition: Florida County Court - Union County: A court of limited jurisdiction in Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Union County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF5ksLjDkjpXbqBh2O.definition: An L420 Expert Witness is a professional who possesses specialized knowledge or skills in a particular field and is called upon to provide testimony in a legal proceeding related to that field.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF81DlwefdmcbVKZmZ.label: Limited Ruleset
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF81DlwefdmcbVKZmZ.definition: A Limited Ruleset is a specific type of rule that has a restricted scope or application.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8BKitDKJzjKplRTz.label: Motion to File Answer
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8BKitDKJzjKplRTz.definition: A Motion to File Answer is a formal request made to a court by a defendant in a legal case, seeking permission to submit their response to the plaintiff's complaint.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8ICnA84eneZ25V48.label: Cervical Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8ICnA84eneZ25V48.definition: Cervical cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the cells of the cervix, the lower part of the uterus that connects to the vagina. It is often caused by persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) and requires treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8uUZ4p08orUeuKLX.label: No Liens Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF8uUZ4p08orUeuKLX.definition: A No Liens Clause is a provision in a contract that states that the property or assets involved in the agreement are free from any claims or encumbrances by third parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF956c8A8f888925b9.label: Acquaviva
http://lmss.sali.org/RBF956c8A8f888925b9.definition: Acquaviva is a location in San Marino.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBF9d4a4F540e1C4d71.definition: Kachin refers to an ethnic group and their language in Myanmar.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFAcd1AACbbfC7Bc94.label: Bale
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFAcd1AACbbfC7Bc94.definition: A bale is a unit of measurement used to quantify goods such as cotton or hay, typically weighing between 100 and 500 pounds.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFAn1xyfuXmMiWDnpS.label: Utilities Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFAn1xyfuXmMiWDnpS.definition: This group comprises establishments engaged in the provision of the following utility services: electric power, natural gas, steam supply, and water supply. Within this sector, the specific activities associated with the utility services provided vary by utility: electric power includes generation, transmission, and distribution; natural gas includes distribution; steam supply includes provision and/or distribution; water supply includes treatment and distribution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFBa1462D9db2C6c82.definition: Hung Yen is a province in Vietnam.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFBw7fG6mULNtDPzoD.definition: U.S. federal courts' body of procedural rules governing criminal actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFFc5c67FcaaC81514.definition: The IRS Tax Exempt and Governments Entities Division of the IRS provides administrative guidance to their examiners to ensure consistent tax administration and on matters relating to internal operations. http://lmss.sali.org/RBFFfSWsg811UlPoeFk.label: Visa for Nurses and Medical Professionals
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFFfSWsg811UlPoeFk.definition: A visa for nurses and medical professionals is a specialized visa category that may be offered by certain countries to healthcare workers who wish to enter for the purpose of employment in the medical field. These visas often have specific requirements, including proof of qualifications, job offers from recognized healthcare institutions, and sometimes a need to address shortages of medical professionals in the host country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFH5v175MuTKvLEcBL.label: Appellate Filings - Nonparty Filing
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFH5v175MuTKvLEcBL.definition: A non-party filing made in an appellate court, such as a motion to appear pro hac vice, motion for leave to appeal, motion to intervene, motion for leave to file as amicus, or notice of appearance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFLAZ8OTUxzMOdHkrX.label: Objection to Application for Professional Employment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFLAZ8OTUxzMOdHkrX.definition: An objection made specifically in response to an application for professional employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFLYkta0F7DwegW1Fn.label: Professional Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFLYkta0F7DwegW1Fn.definition: The Professional Services industry group comprises establishments that specialize in performing professional, scientific, and technical activities for others. These activities require a high degree of expertise and training.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFOZ6k0p0FnZyMzuij.label: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFOZ6k0p0FnZyMzuij.definition: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) is a diverse group of blood cancers that originate in the lymphatic system, which is part of the body's immune system. It includes various subtypes that differ in their aggressiveness and treatment protocols, commonly requiring chemotherapy, radiation therapy, immunotherapy, or stem cell transplantation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFQCPcpMnfZ25UzTt5.label: Non-Profit Formation Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFQCPcpMnfZ25UzTt5.definition: Nonprofit formation practice refers to the legal service where lawyers assist in establishing nonprofit organizations, guiding clients through aspects like drafting bylaws, filing for tax-exempt status, and ensuring compliance with state and federal laws. This specialized legal service aims to create a compliant and effective organizational structure that meets the client's charitable, educational, or social objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFSAt4xs2BlU2AYCt5.label: Color Blindness
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFSAt4xs2BlU2AYCt5.definition: Color Blindness is a visual impairment that affects an individual's ability to perceive colors accurately, typically due to a deficiency or absence of certain color-sensitive photoreceptors in the retina. This condition can range from difficulty distinguishing between specific colors to complete inability to see any colors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFSyAy4VY1rETaHMaR.label: Chattels
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFSyAy4VY1rETaHMaR.definition: Chattels are personal property items that are movable and do not include land or interests in land. This legal term encompasses tangible and intangible assets that a person owns, which can be physically relocated or transferred from one place to another, as opposed to real property or immovable assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFV1dXu2aXDzaGfasJ.label: Involuntary Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFV1dXu2aXDzaGfasJ.definition: An involuntary debtor is an individual or entity against whom creditors initiate bankruptcy proceedings, often because the debtor has failed to meet financial obligations. The involuntary bankruptcy process is initiated by the filing of a petition by the creditors, rather than the debtor themselves

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFZYGIRpeJOqUKpUaO.label: Additional Provisions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFZYGIRpeJOqUKpUaO.definition: An Additional Provisions Clause is a specific clause within a contract that outlines additional terms and conditions beyond those already stated in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFgL4Dth9VONjmIdH0.label: Personal and Family Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFgL4Dth9VONjmIdH0.definition: Law that deals with family matters and domestic relations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFlAGR9RuWPfkJ7wkh.label: Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFp8SArLjiXMX81Jna.label: Georgia District Court - Miller County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFp8SArLjiXMX81Jna.definition: Georgia District Court - Miller County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Miller County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFuGRXSksUz7DZ9ryC.label: Traffic Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFuGRXSksUz7DZ9ryC.definition: Traffic Court is a specialized court that deals with traffic violations and related offenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFudk1lZUkDxX0ibLX.label: Intrusion
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFudk1lZUkDxX0ibLX.definition: The concept of Intrusion refers to a type of privacy claim that involves intentional and offensive interference with an individual's solitude or private affairs, which would be highly offensive to a reasonable person.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFvWlZEViQihmHUpd1.label: Court Administrator
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFvWlZEViQihmHUpd1.definition: A person who serves a clerical, administrative function for a court. In some jurisdictions, this can include the Clerk of Court, and in other jurisdictions these roles are distinct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFvZ20fJFgntwJlfxg.label: Right of First Refusal to Lease Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFvZ20fJFgntwJlfxg.definition: A Right of First Refusal to Lease Clause is a provision in a contract that gives a party the opportunity to lease a property before it is offered to others, if the owner decides to lease it.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBFzESM7xYtW5oe3oeX.label: Amendment Fee Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBFzESM7xYtW5oe3oeX.definition: An Amendment Fee Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the fees associated with making changes or modifications to the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBG13LME30Uhc4hHe9J.label: Immigrant Visa for Professionals and Other Workers
http://lmss.sali.org/RBG13LME30Uhc4hHe9J.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Professionals and Other Workers" provides permanent residency to skilled workers, professionals with a bachelor’s degree, and certain unskilled workers for positions that require less training. This visa category serves individuals who fulfill labor demands in the host country and do not qualify under higher employment-based categories.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBG3vcHQul0R2GOZYUF.label: Appellate Page Proof Reply Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RBG3vcHQul0R2GOZYUF.definition: An Appellate Page Proof Reply Brief is a written document submitted to a higher court in response to an opposing party's arguments, which includes evidence and legal reasoning to support the appellant's position.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBG9uiYhwntrBh3nO4n.label: Condominium Right
http://lmss.sali.org/RBG9uiYhwntrBh3nO4n.definition: Condominium Right, also known as Horizontal Property Right, refers to the legal structure that allows individual ownership of a unit within a multi-unit building, along with a shared ownership interest in common areas like hallways, elevators, and amenities. This right enables the individual unit owner to sell, lease, or mortgage their unit independently, while being subject to the rules and governance of a homeowners' association or similar entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGCujfJShcjecj0Nz3.label: Billing and Payment Terms Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGCujfJShcjecj0Nz3.definition: A Billing and Payment Terms Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for payment and billing between parties involved in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGOABo2EAUBd1tDziS.label: Inupiaq
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGOABo2EAUBd1tDziS.definition: A language spoken by the Inupiaq people, primarily in Alaska and Canada.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGPkZ1oRgcP05LWQBG.label: Admiralty Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGPkZ1oRgcP05LWQBG.definition: Admiralty Court refers to a specialized court that has jurisdiction over maritime disputes and offenses, including those related to shipping, navigation, and marine commerce.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGX9go8arXeeiONRwu.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Wabash County (2nd Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGYyJXd0ZqnwU8AfJb.label: Texas District Court - Hays County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGYyJXd0ZqnwU8AfJb.definition: A Texas District Court located in Hays County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGaYz0rr5Dh0Sjxu0Z.label: Corporate Insolvency Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGaYz0rr5Dh0Sjxu0Z.definition: Law relating to insolvency or reorganization of corporations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGazseZqCbAWmgxQIN.label: Preservation of Documents Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGazseZqCbAWmgxQIN.definition: Preservation of Documents Practice refers to the legal practice of ensuring that relevant documents are protected and maintained in their original form during a legal matter, in order to prevent their destruction or alteration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGb8bbbUYkJSDIov4w.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Northampton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGb8bbbUYkJSDIov4w.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Northampton County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Northampton County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGd796pNg5ltGWhkyk.label: Asset-Backed Securities
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGd796pNg5ltGWhkyk.definition: Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) are financial instruments backed by a pool of assets, typically loans or receivables, that generate cash flows to pay interest and principal to investors. ABS allow lenders to transfer the risk of the underlying assets to investors and are commonly used to improve liquidity and raise capital.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGglw8HCEWLRsBTjST.label: New York City - Municipal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGglw8HCEWLRsBTjST.definition: New York City Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction that hears cases involving minor criminal offenses, civil cases involving amounts up to $25,000, and small claims cases involving amounts up to $5,000 in New York City.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGj6uu7MSyvtS4pgWJ.label: Lease Renewal and Extension Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGj6uu7MSyvtS4pgWJ.definition: A Lease Renewal & Extension Agreement allows a tenant to renew or extend their lease for an additional period, often under the same terms and conditions as the original lease.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGk40UuyHzWkmemx6I.label: Injunctive Relief Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGk40UuyHzWkmemx6I.definition: An Injunctive Relief Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to seek a court order to prevent the other party from taking certain actions or to compel them to perform certain obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGmw0JXsA0c36ZVr7q.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGmw0JXsA0c36ZVr7q.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Document is a legal request made by a party to prevent the opposing party from introducing a specific piece of evidence, such as a written or recorded representation, during a trial or hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGnzdlRTDfBWfXIysy.label: Book of Authorities Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGnzdlRTDfBWfXIysy.definition: Book of Authorities Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining a collection of legal authorities cited in a litigation case, including cases, statutes, and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGqLpPKM6XVHLg02Cl.label: Consumer Price Index Escalation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGqLpPKM6XVHLg02Cl.definition: A Consumer Price Index (CPI) Escalation Clause, also known as CPI, is a clause in a contract that allows for adjustments to be made to payments or prices based on changes in the CPI, which measures the average change in prices over time for goods and services consumed by households.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGqQPUiOxGOA7UwNKr.label: Artificial languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGqQPUiOxGOA7UwNKr.definition: Artificial languages are a subset of language that are created by humans for specific purposes, such as programming languages or constructed languages like Esperanto.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBGwrXLh0uuXtUN70lv.label: Investment Companies Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBGwrXLh0uuXtUN70lv.definition: Regulations on companies that engage primarily in investing, reinvesting, and trading in securities, and whose own securities are offered to the investing public.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH1NIeHTs7myQf1RgQ.label: Insurance Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH1NIeHTs7myQf1RgQ.definition: The concept of Insurance Fraud refers to the intentional deception or misrepresentation made by an individual or entity to an insurance company for the purpose of obtaining benefits or compensation to which they are not entitled, including the fraudulent acquisition of life or health insurance policies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH54tIgUv3NHcHH7pg.label: Assignee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH54tIgUv3NHcHH7pg.definition: An assignee is a person, company or entity who receives the transfer of property, title or rights from a contract. The assignee receives the transfer from the assignor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH5HK6PvLN70uKIZRr.label: Minnesota District Court - Martin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH5HK6PvLN70uKIZRr.definition: Minnesota District Court - Martin County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Martin County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH6tT6qvsg9Wc14Stv.label: Elements of Civil Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH6tT6qvsg9Wc14Stv.definition: The Elements of Civil Claim are the specific components that must be present in a legal claim brought in civil court, including facts, legal theories, and damages sought.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH9ifhEfXuEZFqeRqO.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Bergen County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH9ifhEfXuEZFqeRqO.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Bergen County is a specific court within the New Jersey Superior Court Appellate Division that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Bergen County, New Jersey.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBH9oWflI3j7t4auO0B.label: Acceleration of Rent Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBH9oWflI3j7t4auO0B.definition: An acceleration of rent clause is a provision in a contract that allows the landlord to demand the full amount of rent owed for the remainder of the lease term if the tenant breaches the lease agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHBZGsIXarbhsUEYz6.label: Witness Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHBZGsIXarbhsUEYz6.definition: A witness statement is a written or recorded account of an individual's observations or knowledge of an event, provided as evidence in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHCa8qkpoAnLunroEq.label: Peer Reviewed
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHCa8qkpoAnLunroEq.definition: Peer Reviewed indicates that a document has undergone a formal evaluation by experts in the same field to assess its validity, significance, and originality. This characteristic is often considered a marker of academic rigor and credibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHHeTBzqbfYwRhylbz.label: Motion to Recall Mandate
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHHeTBzqbfYwRhylbz.definition: A Motion to Recall Mandate is a legal request made in an appellate court to withdraw or cancel a previously issued mandate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHI06ZAbtF2eveFVFa.label: Valuation Metrics
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHI06ZAbtF2eveFVFa.definition: Valuation Metrics are quantifiable measures and methodologies used to assess the economic worth of an asset, business, or investment. These metrics serve as the basis for informed decision-making in activities such as acquisitions, investments, and financial reporting

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHIdTtufTstGd1ij1I.label: Visa for Dependents of Exchange Visitors
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHIdTtufTstGd1ij1I.definition: This non-immigrant visa for dependents of exchange visitors (in the U.S., a J-2 Visa) allows spouses and minor children of exchange visitors (in the U.S., J-1 Visa holders) to accompany them during their stay in the destination country (e.g., U.S.).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMad8oNmYXkYHOHZL.label: AI Lifecycle Systems
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMad8oNmYXkYHOHZL.definition: AI Lifecycle Systems encompass the processes and methodologies involved in the development, deployment, and maintenance of artificial intelligence systems. These systems include various stages such as data collection, model training, evaluation, and continuous improvement to ensure effective and ethical AI performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMbF88nRKlw4sA9PS.label: Negligent Advice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMbF88nRKlw4sA9PS.definition: Negligent Advice refers to a claim of professional negligence where a legal professional fails to provide competent advice or guidance to a client, resulting in harm or damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMgwmtjROHhYECWGF.label: Project Statement of Work
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHMgwmtjROHhYECWGF.definition: An agreement between the customer and the project team on success criteria, requirements, budget, and timeline.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHP1IDvzEGAyQ545DE.label: Private Offering
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHP1IDvzEGAyQ545DE.definition: Private Debt Offering refers to the sale of debt securities directly to a small group of private investors, typically without the need for public registration or regulatory approval. This method is often used by companies seeking to raise capital more quickly and with greater confidentiality than through public offerings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHWUtQZOtxmjDCio0r.label: Voter Intimidation and Coercion Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHWUtQZOtxmjDCio0r.definition: Voter Intimidation and Coercion Claims refer to allegations that individuals were threatened, harassed, or pressured to influence their vote or deter them from voting. These claims can include physical threats, verbal harassment, misleading information, or coercive tactics designed to interfere with the free exercise of voting rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHcgWfomutlulDfZaP.label: Bearer Securities
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHcgWfomutlulDfZaP.definition: Bearer Securities are financial instruments where the owner's identity is not recorded on the books of the issuer or the registrar. These securities can be transferred by mere possession, making them highly negotiable and anonymous.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHhRG514AmnN0tEERi.label: Lemon Law Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHhRG514AmnN0tEERi.definition: A Lemon Law Claim is a legal action taken by a consumer against a motor vehicle dealership or manufacturer for selling a defective vehicle that fails to meet the standards of quality and performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHhZhZQrKsG3gRbM78.label: tax_tier_tax_percent
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHhZhZQrKsG3gRbM78.definition:
