http://lmss.sali.org/RBHiE8PhIPNBDeGgvmt.label: New Jersey Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHiE8PhIPNBDeGgvmt.definition: The New Jersey Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of New Jersey, with the authority to hear appeals from lower courts and to make final decisions on legal disputes within the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHivDNKUN8aGNSBQlK.label: Position Posting
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHivDNKUN8aGNSBQlK.definition: A Position Posting is a public or internal announcement made by an organization to advertise a job vacancy. It typically outlines the job description, qualifications required, and instructions for application.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHlMH0i6Vc5ZGEkgKo.label: Words Negligently Spoken
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHlMH0i6Vc5ZGEkgKo.definition: Words Negligently Spoken refers to a legal concept under Defamation where a statement is made without proper care and caution, resulting in harm to the reputation of the subject.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHsNn71tsIOwuLG0Gh.label: Guaranty Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHsNn71tsIOwuLG0Gh.definition: A guaranty claim is a cause of action over a legal promise made by one party to be responsible for the debt or obligation of another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHsUy15guQC3jWrIYr.label: Regulatory Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHsUy15guQC3jWrIYr.definition: Regulatory Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's noncompliance with laws, regulations, or industry standards that govern its operations, products, or services. These risks can stem from various sources, such as changes in regulatory requirements, lack of clarity on compliance obligations, or failure to implement adequate controls, potentially leading to legal penalties, reputational damage, or operational disruptions, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHxBQRUlBK0J0bY3TF.label: Progressive Bulbar Palsy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHxBQRUlBK0J0bY3TF.definition: Progressive bulbar palsy (PBP) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive degeneration of motor neurons in the brainstem, leading to progressive weakness and atrophy of the muscles involved in speech, swallowing, and breathing. This condition often overlaps with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) but primarily affects the bulbar muscles.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHxaoG50eKk8vBlted.label: Fair Debt Collection Practices Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHxaoG50eKk8vBlted.definition: A Fair Debt Collection Act Claim is a legal claim made by a consumer against a debt collector for violating the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, which sets standards for debt collection activities and prohibits certain abusive and deceptive practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBHzq2yqYL8JEktmzbP.label: Trade Safeguards Dispute
http://lmss.sali.org/RBHzq2yqYL8JEktmzbP.definition: Trade Safeguards Disputes involve legal proceedings related to the application of safeguard measures, which are temporary restrictions on imports to protect domestic industries from serious injury caused by increased imports. This practice includes representing clients in disputes before international trade bodies and ensuring compliance with international trade agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBI1GgQFGHi8jZxymdj.label: Statutory Rape
http://lmss.sali.org/RBI1GgQFGHi8jZxymdj.definition: Nonforcible sexual intercourse with a person who is under the statutory age of consent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBI4hGnxdB0Ct4ffwBQ.label: Tort Claimants Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBI4hGnxdB0Ct4ffwBQ.definition: A Tort Claimants Committee is typically established within bankruptcy proceedings or large-scale litigation contexts to represent the interests of individuals who have tort claims against the debtor or defendant. This committee works to ensure that the rights and recovery opportunities of tort claimants are protected and maximized during the legal process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBI5p2rdv7JzHTtGyOb.label: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RBI5p2rdv7JzHTtGyOb.definition: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Events: The various legal proceedings and actions that occur during the process of bankruptcy and restructuring, including confirmation of a bankruptcy plan, asset sales, installment payments, joinder, auctions, creditor voting, initial meetings, disbursements, automatic stays, and financial management courses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIArpOds7Q2NJALC0v.label: Federated Learning
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIArpOds7Q2NJALC0v.definition: Federated learning is an approach to machine learning that addresses data governance and privacy concerns by enabling the collaborative training of algorithms without transferring data to a central location. In this model, each device trains on data locally and shares its local model parameters instead of sharing the training data, and different federated learning systems have various topologies for parameter sharing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBID3kqYjK1OiK5q4sk.label: Consumer Market
http://lmss.sali.org/RBID3kqYjK1OiK5q4sk.definition: A "Consumer Market" refers to the sphere of trade and transactions involving goods and services sold directly to individual consumers for personal or household use. This market emphasizes retail sales, product variety, and meeting individual consumer preferences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIFXKDu8dbhar4s1v9.label: L440 Other Trial Preparation and Support
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIFXKDu8dbhar4s1v9.definition: The concept of L440 Other Trial Preparation and Support refers to activities and tasks related to trial preparation and support that do not fall under any other specific category within the broader concept of trial preparation and trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIMYRtoYl1X28gAWrB.label: Harmful Bias
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIMYRtoYl1X28gAWrB.definition: Harmful bias in an AI system refers to biases that create negative impacts, such as unfair or discriminatory outcomes. These biases can emerge from various factors, including human or system decisions across the AI lifecycle, pre-existing cultural and social biases in training data, technical limitations like non-representative data, or the use of AI systems in unanticipated contexts

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIQkwaEgPZe315Vy3R.label: Fijian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIQkwaEgPZe315Vy3R.definition: A language spoken in Fiji, which is a member of the Austronesian language family and is the official language of the country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIUrP4gOU3nBTfDPKh.label: Objection to Professional Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIUrP4gOU3nBTfDPKh.definition: An objection raised by a party to challenge the amount or reasonableness of fees charged by a professional for services rendered.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIVr7LJ5wZmSxEONjW.label: Watercraft
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIVr7LJ5wZmSxEONjW.definition: A Watercraft is a vehicle designed for travel on or in water, including boats, ships, submarines, and personal watercraft. These vessels are used for various purposes such as transportation, recreation, military operations, and commercial activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIXc4MqHYUkxA0MXlx.label: Foreign Private Issuer Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIXc4MqHYUkxA0MXlx.definition: A Foreign Private Issuer Report is a document filed by foreign companies listed on U.S. exchanges, summarizing financial and operational data. It is a U.S.-specific requirement aimed at standardizing information for U.S. investors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIcGATp1pU0bJAxjyH.label: Florida County Court - Duval County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIcGATp1pU0bJAxjyH.definition: A court located in Duval County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBId9f3jW4zEqooPvSh.label: Product Liability Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBId9f3jW4zEqooPvSh.definition: Law relating to liability for injuries caused by defective or unsafe products.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIdngOFiYNrQ6DqcH8.label: Negligent Entrustment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIdngOFiYNrQ6DqcH8.definition: Negligent Entrustment is a legal claim that arises when a person allows someone else to use their property, such as a vehicle, knowing that the person is likely to cause harm due to their incompetence or recklessness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIgSt9tTBIIgOibr6v.label: Goods and Services Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIgSt9tTBIIgOibr6v.definition: Goods and Services Tax Payment encompasses all taxes and duties levied on the production, extraction, sale, transfer, leasing, or delivery of goods, as well as the rendering of services. This also includes taxes on the use of goods or permissions to use goods or perform activities, ensuring comprehensive taxation of economic activities related to goods and services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIjupGmQLqpwi89uEk.label: Expiration Date
http://lmss.sali.org/RBIjupGmQLqpwi89uEk.definition: For a legal proceeding or regulatory filing (e.g., patent registration, trademark registration) that filing's expiration date refers to the expiration date of a specific status, benefit, or action, as indicated in official documents such as visas, permits, or contracts. This date marks the end of the authorized period for a particular activity, residency, or employment, as determined by the relevant regulatory authority

http://lmss.sali.org/RBImYZdaopiwx272hSC.label: Motion to Convert
http://lmss.sali.org/RBImYZdaopiwx272hSC.definition: A Motion to Convert is a request made in a bankruptcy case to change the type of bankruptcy being filed, typically from Chapter 13 to Chapter 7.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBInEBiBM9AXI15yzeZ.label: Separation Agreement  Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBInEBiBM9AXI15yzeZ.definition: Separation or dissolution of a legal entity or legal relationship (such as employment).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBIplaNSJEfQ4ldBOjx.label: Standing Rock Sioux Tribe of North & South Dakota

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ0dgV4Z2Xk7aGfJt2.label: Immune System Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ0dgV4Z2Xk7aGfJt2.definition: Immune system disorders are conditions that result from abnormalities in the immune system, leading to improper immune responses. These disorders include a wide range of diseases, such as autoimmune diseases, immune deficiency disorders, and hypersensitivity reactions, which can cause significant impairment in the body's ability to fight infections and maintain homeostasis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ4HPUl2DrL4G30lmo.label: Transactional Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ4HPUl2DrL4G30lmo.definition: A Transactional Document is a written or recorded representation of a legal agreement or transaction, such as a contract or deed, that memorializes the terms and conditions of the agreement between parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ539i2zjZ7GGvJz0x.label: Origination Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ539i2zjZ7GGvJz0x.definition: An Origination Clause claim refers to a legal argument challenging the constitutionality of a bill or law based on the requirement in the United States Constitution that revenue-raising bills must originate in the House of Representatives. This claim asserts that a particular law violates the Origination Clause by originating in the wrong legislative chamber, potentially rendering it invalid or unconstitutional.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ8EngDwntEBRaXr7x.label: New York City Court - Jamestown
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ8EngDwntEBRaXr7x.definition: A court located in Jamestown, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ9rfob4mvVArjZbsE.label: Non-metallic Mineral Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJ9rfob4mvVArjZbsE.definition: These pertain to the ownership and extraction of non-metallic minerals, such as coal, limestone, and gravel, from specific plots of land. As with metallic minerals, these rights can be leased, sold, or transferred.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJHEe1jRjysGW7Lv6t.label: Georgia Superior Court - Telfair County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJHEe1jRjysGW7Lv6t.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Telfair County, Georgia, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJHLOZetGcv6GWkosB.label: Excited Utterance
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJHLOZetGcv6GWkosB.definition: An Excited Utterance is a statement relating to a startling event or condition made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement caused by the event or condition. This hearsay exception is based on the idea that statements made under the influence of excitement or shock are unlikely to be fabricated due to the lack of time for reflection or deliberation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJKfGRN6PPuMeHLwrD.label: Avoidance Action Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJKfGRN6PPuMeHLwrD.definition: Avoidance Action Claims refer to legal claims made in bankruptcy and restructuring cases that seek to recover property or assets that were transferred or paid out in a way that is considered fraudulent or preferential, and may include actions such as turnover of property, setoff, and avoidance of statutory liens.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJNvhPmodYtKUv6xWz.label: Assignment of Case
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJNvhPmodYtKUv6xWz.definition: The concept of "Assignment of Case" refers to the act of designating a specific case to a particular individual or group for handling.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJVPkhBi7K5BLh6864.label: oasis:Prohibition
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJVPkhBi7K5BLh6864.definition: A prohibition is a type of deontic specification in the OASIS ontology, indicating that an action or behavior is not allowed or prohibited.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJWgTkaOcLU7qdyszs.label: Data Tampering
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJWgTkaOcLU7qdyszs.definition: Data tampering involves the unauthorized alteration of data, often to mislead or commit fraud. It can compromise the integrity of the data and lead to incorrect or false conclusions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJX0FzWzDirAGzjMvO.label: Cargo
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJX0FzWzDirAGzjMvO.definition: Cargo refers to goods or merchandise conveyed in a vessel, airplane, or vehicle. It encompasses all types of freight, excluding passengers' baggage, transported for commercial gain or military purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJYdhH76MiHrKCxH8O.label: Order Granting in Part, Denying in Part
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJYdhH76MiHrKCxH8O.definition: An "Order Granting in Part, Denying in Part" is a legal decision issued by a court that approves some requests made by a party and denies others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJdGVtuPGY1SfatwiS.label: JF10 Preparation of the disclosure report and the disclosure proposal (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJdGVtuPGY1SfatwiS.definition: Preparation of the disclosure report and the disclosure proposal to comply with obligations that came in on 1-April-2013 (applicable to both manual and e-disclosure). All Disclosure related work required for the CMC. Additionally, this task encompasses work such as determining the location of documents, letters to client re disclosure obligations and setting up client based disclosure teams.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJlYzE4ZY14dTEghzb.label: Civil Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJlYzE4ZY14dTEghzb.definition: Civil rights are the rights of individuals to receive equal treatment and protection under the law, typically focusing on issues such as discrimination, freedom of speech, and the right to vote. These rights are enshrined in national laws and constitutions and are designed to protect individuals from unfair treatment or discrimination by the government or private organizations

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJpkCDCQzYJmN1Gkue.label: Flat Antitrust Efforts Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJpkCDCQzYJmN1Gkue.definition: A Flat Antitrust Efforts Standard is a provision within antitrust efforts that requires a company to make a consistent effort to comply with antitrust laws, without any specific benchmarks or goals to meet.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJufYZeEdrxyDZJftT.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Elk County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJufYZeEdrxyDZJftT.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Elk County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Elk County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJy3KoNBYSWUf4xdAR.label: Practice Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBJy3KoNBYSWUf4xdAR.definition: Practice Management refers to the administration and organization of a law firm's operations, including financial management, client relations, and human resources, within the context of the broader legal industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBJyKcxwDcKzly1zxNw.label: Miccosukee Tribe of Indians of Florida

http://lmss.sali.org/RBK3iLQxs59fBGIMb7a.label: Examiner Investigation Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBK3iLQxs59fBGIMb7a.definition: Examiner Investigation Practice refers to the process of analyzing and evaluating assets by an examiner in order to investigate and gather information related to a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBK4hsMsoDSleQta3pT.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hillsborough County - 13th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBK4hsMsoDSleQta3pT.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Hillsborough County (13th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Hillsborough County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBK5utQVzoZvBPojqtU.label: oasis:Associable
http://lmss.sali.org/RBK5utQVzoZvBPojqtU.definition: A legal concept within the LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA that pertains to the ability to associate or link information with other data based on a temporal characteristic.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBK60WFmXaKPDEXd5H5.label: Central Bank
http://lmss.sali.org/RBK60WFmXaKPDEXd5H5.definition: A central bank is a national financial institution responsible for managing a country's monetary policy, issuing currency, and regulating the banking sector to ensure financial stability. Central banks play a crucial role in controlling inflation, setting interest rates, and serving as a lender of last resort to commercial banks during financial crises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBK6ELF1SSFS9lIjKFc.label: DEPRECATED SANDBOX VERSION: Contractual Clause Types
http://lmss.sali.org/RBK6ELF1SSFS9lIjKFc.definition: This concept refers to types of clauses that are commonly found in contracts, but this version is no longer in use and has been replaced by newer versions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKAS83jA4f4XBIS5lA.label: Incitement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKAS83jA4f4XBIS5lA.definition: Incitement is the act of encouraging or persuading another person to commit a crime or unlawful act. It involves speech or conduct that is intended to provoke imminent illegal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKAwwAzIOYxNJwmaMS.label: Stand Your Ground Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKAwwAzIOYxNJwmaMS.definition: Stand Your Ground Law is a type of legislation that permits individuals to use force, including deadly force, to defend themselves without any obligation to retreat or flee if they believe they are in imminent danger of serious harm or death.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKBnWyBmr5Hmg5T3Vd.label: Lacks Personal Knowledge Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKBnWyBmr5Hmg5T3Vd.definition: A Lacks Personal Knowledge Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a witness is testifying about matters beyond their direct experience or observation. This objection aims to ensure that testimony is based on firsthand knowledge and is reliable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKD16ZdQ2RN4ZRBgCk.label: Texas District Court - Wood County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKD16ZdQ2RN4ZRBgCk.definition: Texas District Court - Wood County: A court of law in Texas that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Wood County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKDKlGW3vdxaMYLo53.label: Ewe
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKDKlGW3vdxaMYLo53.definition: A language spoken by the Ewe people, primarily in Ghana and Togo.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKLlIuJOjn8KZjbnON.label: Employee Misconduct Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKLlIuJOjn8KZjbnON.definition: Employee misconduct event refers to an action or behavior by an employee that violates a company's policies, codes of conduct, or legal statutes. Such events can result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination, and may also have legal repercussions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKQtIaKy5mC3T6KAAx.label: Sac and Fox Tribe of the Mississippi in Iowa

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKS05lS2Rg3gsFnEkF.label: Chapter 15 Service List
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKS05lS2Rg3gsFnEkF.definition: A Chapter 15 Service List is a specific type of document related to bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings that contains a list of parties who have been served with notice of the proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKT1I6J8ce2Gs6xwwF.label: Appellate Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKT1I6J8ce2Gs6xwwF.definition: Any service before a court oflaw that is empowered to hear an appeal of a trial court or other lower tribunal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKT7TSvBSVEvxJuaKh.label: Workers' Compensation Discrimination Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKT7TSvBSVEvxJuaKh.definition: A workers' compensation discrimination claim is a legal action brought by an employee who alleges that they have been subjected to unfair treatment, retaliation, or adverse actions by their employer due to filing a workers' compensation claim or exercising their rights under workers' compensation laws. Workers' compensation is a system designed to provide medical benefits and wage replacement for employees who suffer work-related injuries or illnesses. Employers are generally prohibited from discriminating or retaliating against employees who seek workers' compensation benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKTWRbwGg6abugwd5w.label: Mother and Child Health Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKTWRbwGg6abugwd5w.definition: Mother and Child Health Public Benefit refers to specialized government programs aimed at providing healthcare services or financial assistance specifically for mothers and their children. These may cover prenatal care, childbirth, postnatal care, and pediatric services to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and child. In the United States, one such program is the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKXEdlGEMzeuinxEdR.label: Consideration
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKXEdlGEMzeuinxEdR.definition: Consideration refers to the value given in exchange for a promise or performance in a legal contract, often involving the transfer of money, property, or services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKXJmqEI9hteWLD4bv.label: Material Contracts
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKXJmqEI9hteWLD4bv.definition: Material Contracts are key contracts that a company is obligated to disclose because they significantly affect the company's operations, financial condition, or liquidity. These are typically included as exhibits in regulatory filings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKZUeLk4DYGH1FBGT8.label: Georgia District Court - Jackson County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKZUeLk4DYGH1FBGT8.definition: Georgia District Court - Jackson County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Jackson County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKbEeuzsFZhkDLYjaS.label: Eastern Shoshone Tribe of the Wind River Reservation, Wyoming

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKdkT6bMp8b6YpEo5M.label: Insolvency Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKdkT6bMp8b6YpEo5M.definition: Insolvency Practice encompasses the legal processes and procedures involved in handling the financial distress and liquidation of individuals and businesses unable to meet their debt obligations. It includes bankruptcy filings, debt restructuring, and the administration of insolvent estates. In the United Kingdom, insolvency is distinct from the U.S. concept of Bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKhb3AMMOBaiFMfEwh.label: Contribution Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKhb3AMMOBaiFMfEwh.definition: A Contribution Claim is a legal claim made by a defendant seeking to recover a portion of damages paid to a plaintiff from another party who is also responsible for the same harm.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKmKwd28VABlMmnvo5.label: Tax Invoice Client Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKmKwd28VABlMmnvo5.definition: A tax invoice client name is a specific detail included in a fee invoice that identifies the client for whom legal services were provided and for which taxes are being invoiced.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKn2flG2OolpspDqIo.label: Arizona Superior Court - Mohave Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKn2flG2OolpspDqIo.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Mohave Cty. is a specific court located in Mohave County, Arizona that operates under the jurisdiction of the Arizona Superior Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKpy2Nyht27CqaMOee.label: Banking, Commercial Paper, and Creditor Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKpy2Nyht27CqaMOee.definition: Banking, Commercial Paper, and Creditor Claims refer to legal claims and disputes related to banking transactions, commercial paper, and creditor rights, including issues such as dishonored checks, wrongful foreclosures, and fraudulent transfers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBKsKSLjVdAm86mHUg8.label: Regulator
http://lmss.sali.org/RBKsKSLjVdAm86mHUg8.definition: A regulator is an entity, typically a government agency or authority, responsible for overseeing and enforcing specific regulations within a particular industry or sector. Regulators ensure compliance with laws, standards, and guidelines to protect public interests, such as consumer safety, environmental protection, and market fairness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBL1fZOfBcTqmNbeBIc.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Menard County (8th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBL2dkoVYGusm7xhxvH.label: Detainer Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RBL2dkoVYGusm7xhxvH.definition: A Detainer Proceeding is a legal process used to hold a person in custody until they can be transferred to another jurisdiction to face criminal charges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBL4qAVim7iCR3wAuwf.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Pope County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBL4zPemNCEq2piqyBM.label: Interference with the Custody of Children
http://lmss.sali.org/RBL4zPemNCEq2piqyBM.definition: The concept of "Interference with the Custody of Children" refers to the act of intentionally taking, withholding, or concealing a child from their legal guardian or custodian without permission, which is considered a crime against individuals under the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBL7MeOShW852LxpIWO.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 1st District
http://lmss.sali.org/RBL7MeOShW852LxpIWO.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York that is part of the larger New York District Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLAHsgfwEzyP8N8VTM.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLAHsgfwEzyP8N8VTM.definition: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by persistent difficulties in social communication and interaction, along with restricted, repetitive patterns of behavior, interests, or activities. The severity and manifestations of symptoms vary widely among individuals, making it a spectrum disorder.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLIg4nX2PtBvw0hZEx.label: "Confidential Information" Definition - Exceptions - Known Prior to Agreement

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLOT3utnNtA6pYPhY1.label: Governance Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLOT3utnNtA6pYPhY1.definition: Governance Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's ineffective or inadequate leadership, decision-making processes, and oversight structures. This can result from poor corporate governance practices, lack of transparency, or weak accountability mechanisms, ultimately leading to reputational damage, legal liabilities, and decreased stakeholder trust, which can impact the organization's performance and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLOV6ybP3eHqbQaahT.label: Visa for Dependent or Family Member of Human Trafficking Victim in Danger of Retaliation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLOV6ybP3eHqbQaahT.definition: The Visa for Dependent of Human Trafficking Victim in Danger of Retaliation is a derivative visa granted to qualifying adult or minor children, nieces, nephews, grandchildren, siblings of derivative T Visa holders (such as those holding T-2, T-3, T-4, or T-5 Visas) who face a present danger of retaliation as a result of the principal T-1 Visa holder's escape from trafficking or cooperation with law enforcement. The visa provides protection for these dependents, allowing them to enter and remain in the U.S. as long as the principal and derivative T Visa holders maintain their status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLPMwzuV84x8PFhF6j.label: Georgia Superior Court - Jasper County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLPMwzuV84x8PFhF6j.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Jasper County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Jasper County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLTVGCX2MXs6r6lNqr.label: Adultery
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLTVGCX2MXs6r6lNqr.definition: Voluntary sexual intercourse between a married person and someone who is not their spouse, which is considered as a ground for divorce.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLVFHgBAS4JQ5REt2Z.label: Generalized Anxiety Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLVFHgBAS4JQ5REt2Z.definition: Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) is a mental health condition characterized by persistent and excessive worry about various aspects of life, such as work, health, and social interactions, that is difficult to control. This anxiety is often accompanied by physical symptoms such as restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, muscle tension, and sleep disturbances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLVY0zljWHvn7aUS7B.label: Setoff
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLVY0zljWHvn7aUS7B.definition: A setoff in bankruptcy refers to the right of a creditor to offset a debt owed to them by the debtor against a debt owed by the creditor to the debtor, thereby reducing the amount owed by the creditor to the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLW2BanodMnM0GMfcn.label: Data Architecture Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLW2BanodMnM0GMfcn.definition: Data Architecture Management involves organizing the data extraction, planning, design, and implementation of policies, structures, and processes that govern the organization, storage, and accessibility of data within an enterprise, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and efficient use across various applications and systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLYLKMD32yWd9Wva6r.label: Regulatory Applicant
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLYLKMD32yWd9Wva6r.definition: A Regulatory Applicant is an individual or entity that applies for authorization, licensing, or compliance approval from a regulatory authority. This role relates to sectors where operations are subject to legal and regulatory standards, ensuring adherence to established laws, guidelines, and norms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLZGpqZWNsC7t5snIP.label: Clause Bank Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLZGpqZWNsC7t5snIP.definition: Clause Bank Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining a repository of standardized legal clauses for efficient retrieval and use in legal documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLodGElBPA4tNq7xpj.label: Commission
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLodGElBPA4tNq7xpj.definition: A commission is an authoritative body formed by a government or other organization to oversee, manage, and regulate specific activities or issues. Commissions can vary widely in scope, such as city commissions for local governance, the European Commission for regional policy and law, or commissions on human rights to oversee and promote human rights protections.
examples: City Commission: City of Los Angeles Planning Commission
Commission on Human Rights: United Nations Human Rights Commission

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLsm4yCq8zn36DUl8P.label: Motion for Relief due to Fraud, Misrepresentation, or Other Misconduct
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLsm4yCq8zn36DUl8P.definition: A Motion for Relief due to Fraud, Misrepresentation, or Other Misconduct is a legal request made to a court to set aside a previous order or judgment based on the opposing party's fraudulent, misleading, or wrongful actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLtTa9apXmqCQW13JY.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Lawrence County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLtTa9apXmqCQW13JY.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lawrence County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Lawrence County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBLzDQdY5M3AjVUpILn.label: Disability
http://lmss.sali.org/RBLzDQdY5M3AjVUpILn.definition: Disability refers to a physical, mental, or sensory impairment that significantly limits one or more major life activities, such as walking, speaking, learning, or working. Disabilities can be congenital or acquired, temporary or permanent, and vary in severity. Various laws, such as the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in the United States, protect individuals with disabilities from discrimination and ensure they have equal access to opportunities, services, and accommodations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBM2snOfHOGu50QMiZ0.label: Advice & Consent Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBM2snOfHOGu50QMiZ0.definition: An Advice & Consent Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular appointment or nomination made by a government official violates the Advice and Consent Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the appointment or nomination was made without obtaining the necessary advice and consent of a legislative body, typically the Senate, as required by the constitutional provision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBM3IlVpCVJe1AEljn6.label: Intercreditor Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBM3IlVpCVJe1AEljn6.definition: An "Intercreditor Agreement" is a contract between two or more creditors that establishes the hierarchy and relationship of their claims against a common debtor. The agreement sets forth the rules and procedures for the distribution of assets and proceeds in the event of the debtor's default, bankruptcy, or insolvency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMJL0qtFcCATu5EC8f.label: Data Management and Strategy Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMJL0qtFcCATu5EC8f.definition: Data Management and Strategy Services refers to the provision of expert advice and support in the planning, implementation, and maintenance of effective data management practices, including the development of strategies and policies, data governance, and data quality management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBML32OU09Dl72mx9f3.label: Car Renter Liable for Injury
http://lmss.sali.org/RBML32OU09Dl72mx9f3.definition: A legal principle that holds a person who rents a car responsible for any injuries or damages caused by the car while it is in their possession.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMMxJxCYv0BGt8jtwW.label: Web Search Portals, Libraries, Archives, and Other Information Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMMxJxCYv0BGt8jtwW.definition: Industries in the Web Search Portals, Libraries, Archives, and Other Information Services subsector group establishments supplying information, storing and providing access to information, searching and retrieving information, and operating Web sites that use search engines to allow for searching information on the Internet. The main components of the subsector are libraries, archives, and Web search portals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMNTqpAJhnP2NSq9YL.label: Motion Picture and Sound Recording Industries
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMNTqpAJhnP2NSq9YL.definition:
Industries in the Motion Picture and Sound Recording Industries subsector group establishments involved in the production and distribution of motion pictures and sound recordings.  While producers and distributors of motion pictures and sound recordings issue works for sale as traditional publishers do, the processes are sufficiently different to warrant placing establishments engaged in these activities in a separate subsector.  Production is typically a complex process that involves several distinct types of establishments that are engaged in activities, such as contracting with performers, creating the film or sound content, and providing technical postproduction services.  Film distribution is often to exhibitors, such as theaters and broadcasters, rather than through the wholesale and retail distribution chain.  When the product is in a mass-produced form, NAICS treats production and distribution as the major economic activity as it does in the Publishing Industries subsector, rather than as a subsidiary activity to the manufacture of such products.

This subsector does not include establishments primarily engaged in the wholesale distribution of video and sound recordings, such as compact discs and audio tapes; these establishments are included in the Wholesale Trade sector.  Reproduction of video and sound recordings that is carried out separately from establishments engaged in production and distribution is treated in NAICS as a manufacturing activity.  Establishments that primarily acquire the rights to distribute video and sound recordings to the public via television or radio broadcast or streaming distribution services are classified in Subsector 516, Broadcasting and Content Providers.  Establishments using facilities and infrastructure that they operate to distribute cable and satellite television subscription programming are included in Subsector 517, Telecommunications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMNhu3BspmADgr8f0D.label: Innocence Commission
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMNhu3BspmADgr8f0D.definition: An Innocence Commission, often inspired by or affiliated with initiatives like the Innocence Project, is an organized body that investigates claims of wrongful convictions with the aim of exonerating individuals who have been unjustly imprisoned. These commissions often utilize new evidence, such as DNA testing, to re-examine cases where there might have been miscarriages of justice, and they advocate for legal reforms to prevent future wrongful convictions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMOJGUEJ6ziXEMKmGL.label: Sukuma
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMOJGUEJ6ziXEMKmGL.definition: Sukuma is a language spoken in Tanzania, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMP3a3Y68abx6FeTqm.label: Waiver of Jury Trial Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMP3a3Y68abx6FeTqm.definition: A Waiver of Jury Trial Clause is a provision in a contract where parties agree to give up their right to a trial by jury in the event of a dispute, and instead have the dispute resolved by a judge or arbitrator.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMSWpFhhgwG0vRZUwS.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Wells County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMSWpFhhgwG0vRZUwS.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Wells County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wells County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMUi90pQsSmw0TEvza.label: Nursing Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMUi90pQsSmw0TEvza.definition: Nursing Malpractice refers to a legal claim against a nurse for failing to provide the appropriate standard of care, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMaj7l7i5c32ED9ErR.label: Tenancy by the Entirety
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMaj7l7i5c32ED9ErR.definition: Tenancy by the Entirety is a form of concurrent property ownership available only to married couples, where both spouses hold equal and undivided interest in the property with the right of survivorship. This type of ownership ensures that upon the death of one spouse, the surviving spouse automatically inherits the entire property, and the property cannot be sold or encumbered without the consent of both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBMcwJmi1qbptRmfbZD.label: Disaster Relief
http://lmss.sali.org/RBMcwJmi1qbptRmfbZD.definition: Disaster relief refers to the provision of immediate and coordinated assistance, including legal resources and services, to individuals and communities affected by natural or human-made catastrophes. The aim is to alleviate suffering, minimize further damage, and provide legal support for recovery and rebuilding efforts. Particular services might include helping obtain benefits and assistance, clearing title to property, and dealing with insurance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBPehVKHmGilQbPA55V.label: Guilty

http://lmss.sali.org/RBPpt2TgiFM9JSOSkJw.label: Fiscal Year
http://lmss.sali.org/RBPpt2TgiFM9JSOSkJw.definition: A fiscal year is a 12-month period used by governments, businesses, and organizations for accounting and financial reporting purposes. http://lmss.sali.org/RBPwovGZw8ygaPhghSc.label: tax_tier_detail segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBPwovGZw8ygaPhghSc.definition:
"There will be 0 or more TAX_TIER_DETAIL segments per file.  If no TAX.tax_tiers is defined, no TAX_TIER_DETAIL section would be included in the file. This segment must fully define each of the tiers involved in the tax calculation, even if the invoice total is less than the tax tier. 

This segment defines the tax tiers specified in TAX.tax_tiers and tallies the amount of tax at each tier for this invoice.  Unlike regular taxes, Tiered Taxes roll up to the invoice level whereas regular taxes roll up to the matter/invoice level.

A Tiered Tax is one where the tax rate can vary depending on the total of the file.   As compared to other kinds of taxes where a flat tax rate applies to the taxable item total, multiple tax rates apply.  

All tiers associated with the Tiered Tax as set forth by the tax authority must be represented in this segment, even if the tier exceeds the total of taxable items in the file.  

Illustration:

Let's say there is a Tiered Tax where the tax rate is 10% for $0 to $25,000, 12.5% for $25,000 to $50,000, 15% for $50,000 to $100,000, 17.5% for $100,000 to $200,000, and 20% for amounts above that amount.

Let's also say that an invoice includes $125,000 in taxable items subject to the Tiered Tax.

For $125,000 in taxable detail, the TAX_TIER_DETAIL segment would include 5 lines for each of the 5 defined tiers as follows:
tier 1 ($0 >= $25,000) = $25,000.00 * 10% = $2,500.00 tax due
tier 2 ($25,000.01 >= $50,000) = $25,000.00 * 12.5% = $3,125.00 tax 
tier 3 ($50,000.01 >= $100,000) = $50,000.00 * 15% = $7,500.00 tax due
tier 4 ($100,000.01 >= $200,000) = $25,000.00 * 17.5% = $4,375,00 tax due
tier 5 ($200,000.01 and above) = $0 * 20% = $0.00 tax due
Every tier must be defined in the file regardless of whether it exceeds the amount of taxable items.  Using the example above, the TAX_TIER_DETAIL segment must include a representation for tier 5.   

The total tax due on this tiered tx_id  then is $17,500.00 (the sum of the amounts above in blue).
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RBSyLDx8p1LtTo82YnX.definition: The Business Judgment Rule is a legal principle that shields corporate directors and officers from liability for decisions made in good faith and with reasonable care in the best interests of the company, even if those decisions ultimately result in negative consequences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBSyY8hOhTJFVVp812Y.label: Ethics Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBSyY8hOhTJFVVp812Y.definition: An ethics claim is a formal allegation that an individual or organization has violated ethical standards or principles within a specific profession or field. These claims can arise in various contexts, such as legal ethics, medical ethics, or government ethics, and often lead to investigations and disciplinary actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBT0WyT3K42Y3D2IU7m.label: Direct Patent Infringement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBT0WyT3K42Y3D2IU7m.definition: The unauthorized making, using, selling, or importing of a patented invention by a party without the permission of the patent owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBT0b5i4mnOONVVAKgQ.label: No Subletting Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBT0b5i4mnOONVVAKgQ.definition: A "No Subletting Clause" is a provision in a contract that prohibits the tenant from subleasing the property to another party without the landlord's prior written consent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTDbHlWwsQX0BPA5R0.label: Motion for New Trial - Format and Tactics
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTDbHlWwsQX0BPA5R0.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Format and Tactics is a specific type of legal document filed by a party after a trial, requesting the court to set aside the verdict and order a new trial based on specific grounds and strategies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTF6cCyE3OsMy8YPpL.label: Chickens
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTF6cCyE3OsMy8YPpL.definition: Chickens are domesticated birds belonging to the species Gallus gallus domesticus, commonly raised for their meat, eggs, and feathers. They are one of the most widespread and important sources of protein in agriculture, with numerous breeds adapted for specific purposes such as egg-laying or meat production.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTGZhd0HEVyJY9l5ym.label: Digital Transformation Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTGZhd0HEVyJY9l5ym.definition: Digital Transformation Services refer to consulting and management services that help organizations adopt and integrate digital technologies and processes to improve their business operations and customer experiences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTHHNY7rlRxTEG0OoZ.label: O-3 Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTHHNY7rlRxTEG0OoZ.definition: An O-3 visa is issued to the immediate family members of O-1 and O-2 visa holders, allowing them to accompany or join the primary visa holder in the U.S. This visa category includes spouses and unmarried children under the age of 21.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTLd8JvrBUbYcywr5K.label: New York Appellate Division - 3d Dept.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTLd8JvrBUbYcywr5K.definition: The New York Appellate Division - 3d Dept. is a specific court within the New York Supreme Court - Appellate Division that hears appeals from lower courts in the third department of New York State.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTMKp8VFIVjga6e7jG.label: Changes in Target's Industry Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTMKp8VFIVjga6e7jG.definition: Changes in Target's Industry Language refers to modifications in the terminology and language used in the industry of the target company, which may have an impact on the Material Adverse Effect (MAE) definition and carveouts in a legal agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTRFpp0FjlLGnwG1Wx.label: Break Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTRFpp0FjlLGnwG1Wx.definition: A break clause is a provision in a contract that allows one or both parties to terminate the agreement before the end of its term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTROJttsijvMTcx7uq.label: Assumption Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTROJttsijvMTcx7uq.definition: An Assumption Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to take on the obligations and liabilities of another party in a specific situation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTSlPzC3O4AAiaGzBg.label: Sycuan Band of the Kumeyaay Nation

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTd8CvRmE1h8jV1jU0.label: Visa for Unmarried Minor Sibling of Victim of Human Trafficking
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTd8CvRmE1h8jV1jU0.definition: The Visa for Unmarried Minor Sibling of Victim of Human Trafficking is a derivative visa granted to the unmarried minor sibling of a principal T-1 Visa holder, provided the T-1 Visa holder is under 21 years old. The visa allows the sibling to enter and remain in the U.S. as long as the principal T-1 Visa holder maintains their status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTf3gToke5LaxSNQfO.label: Anticipatory Breach of Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTf3gToke5LaxSNQfO.definition: Anticipatory Breach of Contract refers to a situation where one party to a contract indicates, before the time for performance, that they will not perform their obligations under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBThW0KGLGPqQw2V4T5.label: Prakrit languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBThW0KGLGPqQw2V4T5.definition: Prakrit languages are a group of ancient Indian languages that were spoken in the Indian subcontinent before the emergence of Sanskrit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTnKyetea0PXI9vvAM.label: Indiana Superior Court - Ripley County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTnKyetea0PXI9vvAM.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Ripley County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBTvzt8uobb19tFbNSY.label: Debt Investment Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RBTvzt8uobb19tFbNSY.definition: Debt investment assets are financial instruments where an investor lends money to an entity with the expectation of receiving periodic interest payments and the return of the principal amount at a specified maturity date. Examples include bonds, certificates of deposit, and promissory notes

http://lmss.sali.org/RBU0kvxOLj2mKs8stWa.label: Limburgan; Limburger; Limburgish
http://lmss.sali.org/RBU0kvxOLj2mKs8stWa.definition: A regional language spoken in the Limburg province of the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany, characterized by its distinct grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1Gc9qX3aN9NO6DsQ.label: European Court of Justice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1Gc9qX3aN9NO6DsQ.definition: The European Court of Justice (ECJ) is the highest court in the European Union, tasked with interpreting EU law and ensuring its uniform application across all member states. It has the authority to settle legal disputes between EU institutions, member states, businesses, and individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1MPZclWmAITpDAoW.label: Confidential
http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1MPZclWmAITpDAoW.definition: Confidential is a security classification level used for information that requires protection because its unauthorized disclosure could cause damage to the organization (e.g., company, nation). Access to confidential information is restricted to individuals with the appropriate security clearance and a demonstrated need to know.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1z7AUARMHEr7RMR6.label: Undeveloped - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RBU1z7AUARMHEr7RMR6.definition: An "Undeveloped Real Estate Asset" refers to parcels of land that have not yet been altered or improved for specific use. The associated legal matters typically involve zoning laws, land use rights, environmental assessments, and property taxation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBU9zZzHpiivyY3EFmu.label: Neurodevelopmental Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RBU9zZzHpiivyY3EFmu.definition: Neurodevelopmental Disorders are characterized by onset during the developmental period, that is, during childhood or adolescence, although sometimes they are not diagnosed until adulthood. Symptoms and signs may include, but are not limited to, underlying abnormalities in cognitive processing (for example, deficits in learning and applying verbal or nonverbal information, visual perception, memory, or a combination of these); deficits in attention or impulse control; low frustration tolerance; excessive or poorly planned motor activity; difficulty with organizing (time, space, materials, or tasks); repeated accidental injury; and deficits in social skills. Symptoms and signs specific to tic disorders include sudden, rapid, recurrent, non-rhythmic, motor movement or vocalization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUBqjNCYBI4CtLUcdA.label: Intellectual Property Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUBqjNCYBI4CtLUcdA.definition: Intellectual property is a broad categorical description for the set of intangibles owned and legally protected by a company from outside use or implementation without consent. Intellectual property can consist of patents, trade secrets, copyrights, franchises, and trademarks or simply ideas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUIl9w9F1OVEwbY7I8.label: Minnesota District Court - Morrison County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUIl9w9F1OVEwbY7I8.definition: Minnesota District Court - Morrison County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Morrison County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBULGg2FFyRHBhJSE0G.label: Old Age Public Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/RBULGg2FFyRHBhJSE0G.definition: Old Age Public Benefits refer to government programs designed to provide financial assistance, healthcare, and other forms of support to individuals who have reached retirement age. These programs aim to ensure a reasonable standard of living and access to necessary services for elderly citizens.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBULKQI6L28MSLKVkiN.label: Foul Ball Liability Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBULKQI6L28MSLKVkiN.definition: A foul ball liability claim is a legal claim for damages resulting from a personal injury caused by a foul ball at a sporting event.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBULSQ5kkKWLAGpgMIh.label: Redeeming Shares in Company Merger or Sale
http://lmss.sali.org/RBULSQ5kkKWLAGpgMIh.definition: The concept of "Redeeming Shares in Company Merger or Sale" refers to the legal process of exchanging shares in a company for cash or other assets during a merger or sale, which may result in liability claims against the corporation or partnership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBULYMym4JpJmgkW3Q4.label: Residence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBULYMym4JpJmgkW3Q4.definition: Residence refers to a specific place where an individual or entity lives or operates. It can include a personal residence where someone lives, or a business residence where a company operates its activities. This aspect is important for several legal analyses (e.g., personal jurisdiction, bankruptcy law, tax law). Residence refers to a person's fixed, permanent, and principal home, often with legal implications and the intention to remain for an extended period, in contrast to "occupancy," which refers to the physical act of living in or using a property, which can be temporary or intermittent,

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUPYY4wgW05EfNJ6kD.label: Currently Operative Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUPYY4wgW05EfNJ6kD.definition: The law appears to have legal efficacy, operating effectively.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUS0L6evAK1r6HGe8b.label: Sabotage
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUS0L6evAK1r6HGe8b.definition: The intentional destruction or damage of property or equipment belonging to the government or its citizens, with the aim of hindering or disrupting government operations or activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUWDvxFje4KIetKd00.label: Georgia Superior Court - Jenkins County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUWDvxFje4KIetKd00.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Jenkins County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Jenkins County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUcOdcuXzQ4gA4ginq.label: Operating Supplies Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUcOdcuXzQ4gA4ginq.definition: An Operating Supplies Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions related to the provision and use of supplies necessary for the operation of a business or organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUe0cQF64tyOYgN6tq.label: Disability and Medical Condition Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUe0cQF64tyOYgN6tq.definition: Discrimination based on a person's disability or medical condition, which is prohibited by law and can be the basis for a legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUicePpeAC3hZIVjUm.label: Disavowed Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUicePpeAC3hZIVjUm.definition: The previously effective law has been disavowed by some authority (e.g., appellate court, judge).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUnNw8sfeBEjhgetMI.label: Waiver of Subrogation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUnNw8sfeBEjhgetMI.definition: A Waiver of Subrogation Clause is a provision in a contract where one party agrees to waive their right to seek reimbursement from another party's insurance company for damages covered by the insurance policy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUo8nSV4wEEjMST5pS.label: Emphysema
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUo8nSV4wEEjMST5pS.definition: Emphysema is a chronic respiratory condition characterized by the progressive destruction of the alveoli (air sacs) in the lungs, leading to reduced gas exchange and difficulty in breathing. This destruction results in the enlargement of the air spaces and loss of elastic tissue, causing symptoms such as shortness of breath, chronic cough, and wheezing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUrLeB41YB8Kf0vx0n.label: Statement of Current Monthly Income
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUrLeB41YB8Kf0vx0n.definition: A Statement of Current Monthly Income is a document required in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings that provides a detailed account of an individual's income and expenses for the current month.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUtAfKXfMN4dku9Msq.label: Purchase Price Adjustment Mechanism
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUtAfKXfMN4dku9Msq.definition: A Purchase Price Adjustment Mechanism is a contractual provision in M&A transactions that allows for changes to the initial purchase price based on the target company's financial performance or position as of the closing date. It ensures that the final price reflects the actual value of the target, protecting the interests of both buyer and seller.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUuMlya908dAt6EHF7.label: Release of Obligations Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUuMlya908dAt6EHF7.definition: A Release of Obligations Clause is a provision in a contract that relieves one party from fulfilling certain obligations or liabilities specified in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUw79XqSBucysprkNI.label: House
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUw79XqSBucysprkNI.definition: A House is a residential building designed to provide living space for individuals or families, typically featuring multiple rooms, including bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, and common living areas. Houses vary in size, style, and structure, ranging from single-story bungalows to multi-story mansions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUwf37XdlDzrlbbYsj.label: Manchester Band of Pomo Indians of the Manchester Rancheria, California

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUx3pGXBPzy7tungkk.label: Awadhi
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUx3pGXBPzy7tungkk.definition: Awadhi is a language that belongs to the Hindi branch of the Indo-Aryan language family and is primarily spoken in the Awadh region of Uttar Pradesh and other parts of India.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBUzLmSRAQOBjAYBCO5.label: No Tax Advice Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBUzLmSRAQOBjAYBCO5.definition: A "No Tax Advice Clause" is a provision in a contract that states that no tax advice has been given by one party to the other, and that each party is responsible for obtaining their own tax advice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBV1YvIPuhHpckCheKw.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Moniteau County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBV1YvIPuhHpckCheKw.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Moniteau County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Moniteau County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBV3MQlbGLIUVo5fSiB.label: Criminal Proceedings
http://lmss.sali.org/RBV3MQlbGLIUVo5fSiB.definition: Criminal Proceedings refer to the legal process of prosecuting and punishing individuals who have been accused of committing a crime, including all related proceedings such as indictment, grand jury, sentencing, and parole.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBV6bQclArCSYXy5O9p.label: Illness Anxiety Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBV6bQclArCSYXy5O9p.definition: Illness Anxiety Disorder involves an excessive preoccupation with having or acquiring a serious medical condition, despite having no or only mild symptoms. The preoccupation leads to significant distress or impairment in daily functioning, and is not better explained by another mental disorder.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBV7sRG5Rn12K0LqLOh.label: 19th Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBV7sRG5Rn12K0LqLOh.definition: A 19th Amendment claim is a legal assertion related to the Nineteenth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which grants citizens the right to vote regardless of sex, effectively giving women the right to vote.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBV7zJLILiRtepIdHi1.label: Kansas District Court - Linn County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBV7zJLILiRtepIdHi1.definition: Kansas District Court - Linn County is a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Linn County, Kansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVCwr551O94R7T2y8a.label: Property Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVCwr551O94R7T2y8a.definition: A Property Tax Payment refers to the payment made by property owners to local government authorities, based on the assessed value of their property. This payment is used to fund various public services such as education, infrastructure, and emergency services within the community.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVGGEdVgHfVPEPq5dL.label: Settlement Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVGGEdVgHfVPEPq5dL.definition: A Settlement Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions agreed upon by parties to resolve a dispute or legal matter outside of court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVI1Asykw6zBCTkXQD.label: Florida County Court - Lafayette County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVI1Asykw6zBCTkXQD.definition: Florida County Court - Lafayette County: A court of limited jurisdiction in Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Lafayette County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVQj7fYsBw67yNXs4W.label: Investment Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVQj7fYsBw67yNXs4W.definition: Investment assets are financial instruments or physical assets acquired with the expectation that they will generate returns or appreciate in value over time. These can include stocks, bonds, real estate, mutual funds, and other forms of financial or tangible properties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVUwnN6RwAYW8uSLQ9.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bacon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVUwnN6RwAYW8uSLQ9.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Bacon County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Bacon County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVUyb38XelMKIl06TX.label: Tuition Reimbursement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVUyb38XelMKIl06TX.definition: A tuition reimbursement clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to pay for the educational expenses of another party, typically an employee, in exchange for certain conditions being met.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVXMCXoBW3Ef1c3VUu.label: Visas for Dependents and Families
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVXMCXoBW3Ef1c3VUu.definition: Visas for dependents and families typically allow the spouses, minor children, and sometimes other family members to accompany or join the principal visa holder in the host country. In the United States, for example, these visas often take the form of derivative visas such as F-2, J-2, H-4, and L-2, which correspond to the principal visa categories like F-1, J-1, H-1B, and L-1, respectively

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVhZSsJP3ga5WqA0gB.label: Contact Name Suffix - Sr. (Senior)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVhZSsJP3ga5WqA0gB.definition: The suffix "Sr." stands for "Senior" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish a father from his son when they share the same name. The usage is particularly helpful in legal, formal, or financial documents to clearly identify which individual is being referred to.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVjbydIKkqjIFP0kPy.label: US Chapter 15 Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVjbydIKkqjIFP0kPy.definition: Chapter 15 bankruptcy provides a way of dealing with cases that involve more than one country. The main goal of chapter 15 is to provide cooperation between a foreign debtor, foreign courts and the U.S. bankruptcy courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVpHQ7fb2I2B69LOWs.label: Justifiable Homicide
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVpHQ7fb2I2B69LOWs.definition: The killing of a perpetrator of a serious criminal offense by a peace officer in the line of duty, or the killing, during the commission of a serious criminal offense, of the perpetrator by a private individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVqeuh5Yby92R8jLO7.label: Putative Parent
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVqeuh5Yby92R8jLO7.definition: An alleged parent whose legal status as a parent has not yet been resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVs9U0uIoO1J8ui4sH.label: Arizona Superior Court - Yavapai Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVs9U0uIoO1J8ui4sH.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Yavapai Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Yavapai County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVuyIlK4O92ljgboAD.label: General Practitioner Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVuyIlK4O92ljgboAD.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a general practitioner in the medical field, resulting in harm or injury to a patient, which may lead to a legal claim for compensation or damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVv9pV8tJURHmMumHK.label: Arkansas District Court - Desha Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVv9pV8tJURHmMumHK.definition: A court located in Desha County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBVzrDP3Rdsmk085IMZ.label: Delaware Court of General Sessions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBVzrDP3Rdsmk085IMZ.definition: The Delaware Court of General Sessions is a court within the Delaware State Courts system that has jurisdiction over criminal and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBW2PKb6dohgDy8xEBX.label: Television Series
http://lmss.sali.org/RBW2PKb6dohgDy8xEBX.definition: A Television Series is a set of episodic content produced for television broadcast, typically following a consistent narrative or theme across multiple episodes and seasons. Television series can range from dramas and comedies to documentaries and reality shows, engaging viewers with recurring characters and storylines.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBW7QMNsjTXbouCQpRF.label: Industrial and Logistics - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RBW7QMNsjTXbouCQpRF.definition: Real estate industrial property including factories, logistic centers, and warehouses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBW9ULiPXv36gPl0prb.label: Securities Lending Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBW9ULiPXv36gPl0prb.definition: A Securities Lending Agreement allows the temporary transfer of securities, typically stocks or bonds, from an initial holder to another party in return for collateral, which could be cash or other securities. The agreement also outlines terms for the return of the lent securities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBW9y6esXubLJl4QMtm.label: Treaties
http://lmss.sali.org/RBW9y6esXubLJl4QMtm.definition: A signed agreement or arrangement made by negotiation between by two political authorities (usually states or sovereign governments), and usually ratified by the states' lawmaking authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWAzeRQRyYL4WHciIG.label: Florida County Court - Nassau County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWAzeRQRyYL4WHciIG.definition: A court located in Nassau County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWEcEhY9UhMFCPiyb7.label: Joint Guarantee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWEcEhY9UhMFCPiyb7.definition: A Joint Guarantee is a financial arrangement where an entity other than the issuer, typically a corporation, provides an assurance to fulfill the obligations of a debt instrument if the primary obligor defaults. This type of guarantee creates a shared responsibility for the debt, with both the issuer and the guarantor being jointly liable for the repayment, thus enhancing the creditworthiness of the instrument.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWFtmZ0jcqE6J00rlK.label: L340 Expert Discovery
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWFtmZ0jcqE6J00rlK.definition: The concept of L340 Expert Discovery refers to the process of eliciting evidence from individuals with specialized knowledge or skills to provide testimony or consultation in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWJ0sl9N65u3lsDkH9.label: Holdover Tenant
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWJ0sl9N65u3lsDkH9.definition: A holdover tenant is an individual who remains in a rented property after the expiration of their lease or rental agreement. In such cases, the tenant continues to occupy the property without formal authorization or a renewed agreement with the landlord. Holdover tenancy situations often lead to legal actions, such as eviction proceedings, as the landlord seeks to regain possession of the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWKzasBo3LNqauMGsx.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Crook County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWKzasBo3LNqauMGsx.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Crook County: A court of law in Oregon that has jurisdiction over cases within Crook County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWMzkmHHzpgtd8g272.label: International Organization Visa - Unrecognized or Non-Member Governments
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWMzkmHHzpgtd8g272.definition: An International Organization Visa for representatives of unrecognized or non-member governments is a specialized visa category that allows individuals from entities not officially recognized as states, or from governments not currently members of specific international organizations, to attend meetings or engage in activities at those organizations. The issuance of this visa is often a sensitive diplomatic matter and may be subject to specific conditions and limitations set by the host country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWPUbkNplXXhqH4NNu.label: Release and Indemnity Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWPUbkNplXXhqH4NNu.definition: A Release and Indemnity Clause is a legal provision that absolves one party from liability for damages or injuries suffered by another party, and requires the other party to indemnify and hold harmless the first party from any claims or losses arising from the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWTNMvqynzbuBEvo2w.label: Securities Law Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWTNMvqynzbuBEvo2w.definition: Securities Law Claims refer to legal claims arising from violations of laws and regulations related to securities, such as buying securities improperly during a corporate takeover or committing securities fraud.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWWm7M917awGxBEiWI.label: Letter of Credit
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWWm7M917awGxBEiWI.definition: A Letter of Credit is a written agreement between a buyer and a seller, typically used in international trade, in which a bank guarantees payment to the seller upon receipt of certain documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWYY2uAZnK8OjExo8X.label: Public Comment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWYY2uAZnK8OjExo8X.definition: A Public Comment Document is a written submission made by an individual, organization, or other stakeholder to express views, provide data, or raise concerns about a proposed rule or regulation during the public comment period. These documents become part of the administrative record and are considered by the regulating agency before finalizing the new rule, serving to inform and potentially influence the final regulation

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWYYH8EVxFlamkT7Z7.label: Commercially Reasonable Efforts Antitrust Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWYYH8EVxFlamkT7Z7.definition: The Commercially Reasonable Efforts Antitrust Standard is a provision within antitrust efforts that requires parties to make a good faith effort to achieve a particular goal or outcome, while taking into account the costs and benefits of such efforts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWaTXvy8c9N7LSNwql.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 11th
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWaTXvy8c9N7LSNwql.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 11th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWecgOpeAzPlvHZRQx.label: Some Credible Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWecgOpeAzPlvHZRQx.definition: Some Credible Evidence: Evidence that is trustworthy and reliable, and has the potential to persuade a fact-finder of the truth of a proposition, which is required to be presented by a party in a legal dispute in order to meet their burden of proof.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWh3agzjerSpR73Wyq.label: Renter's Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWh3agzjerSpR73Wyq.definition: Renter's insurance provides coverage for a tenant's personal belongings within a rented property and may offer liability coverage for injuries that occur within the rental unit. This type of insurance does not cover the structure of the building itself, which is the responsibility of the landlord.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWkw4DNYTnj7GzL9yO.label: Pulmonology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWkw4DNYTnj7GzL9yO.definition: Negligence or wrongdoing by a medical professional in the field of pulmonology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWm3ZY3Z4wGXQzJZ2b.label: Lahnda
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWm3ZY3Z4wGXQzJZ2b.definition: A language spoken in Pakistan and India, primarily in the Punjab region.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWo88jsbY4qHzhlTFr.label: Regulatory Services (Non-Dispute)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWo88jsbY4qHzhlTFr.definition: Any process that results in filing something with governmental entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWpkjHwVr6MdCAiCT9.label: Georgia Superior Court - DeKalb County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWpkjHwVr6MdCAiCT9.definition: The Georgia Superior Court - DeKalb County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in DeKalb County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWtD92XVrPI50Mmh2N.label: Document Collection Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWtD92XVrPI50Mmh2N.definition: A Document Collection Event is an occurrence related to the gathering and production of documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWuFpc7NoedtJMsSQV.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Madison County 1
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWuFpc7NoedtJMsSQV.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Madison County, Indiana, with the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWv52kXbExe8S8fvRh.label: Contact Name Suffix - Jr. (Junior)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWv52kXbExe8S8fvRh.definition: The suffix "Jr." stands for "Junior" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish a son from his father when they share the same name. The usage helps to identify which individual is being referred to in documents and correspondence, especially in formal or legal settings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBWvH2Gor6O5g4wb34T.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Westmoreland County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBWvH2Gor6O5g4wb34T.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Westmoreland County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBX1KA0BJR7y27zZSva.label: Credit Intermediation and Related Activities Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBX1KA0BJR7y27zZSva.definition: Industries in the Credit Intermediation and Related Activities subsector group establishments that (1) lend funds raised from depositors; (2) lend funds raised from credit market borrowing; or (3) facilitate the lending of funds or issuance of credit by engaging in such activities as mortgage and loan brokerage, clearinghouse and reserve services, and check cashing services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBX29Llbm21ZLXvlZoF.label: regulatory_statement segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBX29Llbm21ZLXvlZoF.definition:
"As e-billing expands around the world, it is likely that local, regional or national regulations require specific information to be included on electronic invoices.  This section is designed to accommodate those requirements, to the extent that they apply to the matter/invoice level, without needing to adjust the format.

In that this information is required by statute or regulation to be provided, all information provided in this segment should be captured by the receiving system and displayed during bill review.

There will be 0 or more REGULATORY_STATEMENT segments per INVOICE segment.

The EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RBX71jV28VppdF1KMZV.label: Breach of Implied Warranty of Suitability
http://lmss.sali.org/RBX71jV28VppdF1KMZV.definition: The Breach of Implied Warranty of Suitability refers to a violation of an unspoken guarantee that a product or service is appropriate for its intended use, resulting in harm or damage to the user.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBX75rpb8maqfgj95cw.label: Belarusian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBX75rpb8maqfgj95cw.definition: Belarusian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Belarusian language, which is a member of the Slavic language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXA5LJTYid9F7E9Nd4.label: Subcontractor
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXA5LJTYid9F7E9Nd4.definition: A "Subcontractor" is a company or individual hired by a primary contractor to perform specific tasks or provide services as part of a larger project. Subcontractors are typically responsible for a specialized aspect of the project, and they are not directly employed by the client but rather by the primary contractor. This arrangement is common in construction, manufacturing, and various other industries where a project involves multiple specialized tasks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXB69INnEvGHPf5qS9.label: Provider Office Location
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXB69INnEvGHPf5qS9.definition: Office location for the particular engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXHQl8XE3Va1jIhoYP.label: Performance Warranty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXHQl8XE3Va1jIhoYP.definition: A Performance Warranty Clause is a type of Warranty Clause that guarantees the quality and functionality of a product or service for a specific period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXIwuCHiebiYnRNELo.label: By Portfolio
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXIwuCHiebiYnRNELo.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee for legal services that cover two or more matters (i.e., a portfolio of matters).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXL5NHWRqvuvmX1Qtl.label: Subordination Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXL5NHWRqvuvmX1Qtl.definition: A "Subordination Agreement" is a contractual arrangement where a creditor agrees to rank its claim on a debtor's assets below the claims of one or more other creditors. This legal document outlines the conditions and circumstances under which the subordinated creditor will be repaid, typically in the event of a liquidation, default, or insolvency of the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXL6jE97xf2iDoGwng.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Mercer County (14th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXLxktY5N0q3aCYxxk.label: Request
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXLxktY5N0q3aCYxxk.definition: A request is a type of trial court practice document that is filed with the court to ask for a specific action or relief.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXMxIaY6np2I0j3Uqt.label: Ballistics Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXMxIaY6np2I0j3Uqt.definition: Ballistics evidence refers to the study and analysis of firearms, bullets, and the patterns of damage they cause, particularly when a weapon is discharged. It is used in criminal investigations to link projectiles and casings found at a crime scene to a specific weapon or to determine other details of a shooting incident, such as the trajectory or distance from which a shot was fired. Expert ballisticians can match unique markings on a bullet or casing to the specific firearm that fired it, providing critical evidence in firearm-related cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXOUUDPfzuxRdZOd1k.label: Occupational Safety and Health Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXOUUDPfzuxRdZOd1k.definition: An Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA) claim is a legal action initiated by an employee or group of employees against an employer, alleging that the employer has violated safety and health regulations, failed to maintain a safe work environment, or retaliated against employees for reporting safety concerns or exercising their rights under the OSHA.
