The OSHA is a federal law enacted in 1970 to ensure safe and healthy working conditions for employees in the United States by setting and enforcing safety standards and regulations. Employers have a general duty under the OSH Act to provide their employees with work and a workplace free from recognized, serious hazards.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXOgy9uSGpY2aX5Ot8.label: Noise Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXOgy9uSGpY2aX5Ot8.definition: A Noise Violation Claim involves allegations that an individual or entity has exceeded legally established noise levels, leading to disruptions or disturbances in residential, commercial, or public areas. These claims are handled through administrative or legal proceedings and can result in fines, orders to cease the noise, or other corrective actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXSNwXQHNppuziZkXf.label: New Hampshire Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXSNwXQHNppuziZkXf.definition: The New Hampshire Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of New Hampshire and serves as the final court of appeal for all legal cases within the state's jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXUO9viUhUieZENrWo.label: New York Supreme Court - Oneida County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXUO9viUhUieZENrWo.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Oneida County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Oneida County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXUc6YCuUilVK4rdtF.label: Spend Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXUc6YCuUilVK4rdtF.definition: Spend Management refers to the process of controlling and optimizing the expenses incurred by an organization, typically through the use of technology and data analysis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXVQ8cnzCJi3hsyglf.label: Conflict of Interest Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXVQ8cnzCJi3hsyglf.definition: Conflict of Interest Risk refers to the potential for ethical, legal, or reputational issues arising when an individual's personal interests, relationships, or obligations compromise their ability to make impartial decisions on behalf of their organization or role. These conflicts can lead to biased decision-making, decreased trust, or even regulatory penalties, ultimately impacting the organization's integrity and performance

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXVU4vw8lOn8Q1MVwy.label: Runaway
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXVU4vw8lOn8Q1MVwy.definition: A person under 18 years of age who has left home without permission of his/her parent(s) or legal guardian

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXYIdMeIpqr2E0zR4T.label: Change in Law Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXYIdMeIpqr2E0zR4T.definition: A change in law language refers to a provision in a legal agreement that outlines the impact of any modifications or alterations made to existing laws on the agreement, specifically within the context of carveouts related to material adverse effect (MAE) definitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXYWRRfVqe7EHO86Ie.label: Stipulation to Appoint Resolution Advocate
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXYWRRfVqe7EHO86Ie.definition: A Stipulation to Appoint Resolution Advocate is a legal agreement between parties in a dispute, where they agree to appoint a neutral third party to help resolve the dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXa7Zas4KaZjtUpwq0.label: Natural Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXa7Zas4KaZjtUpwq0.definition: The Natural Law System is a legal philosophy asserting that laws are derived from a set of inherent moral principles and universal truths that govern human behavior, existing independently of human-made laws. It posits that these principles are discoverable through reason and are inherent to human nature, providing a basis for evaluating and guiding positive law.
examples: Human Rights Charters often draw on principles from the Natural Law System, asserting rights that transcend national legal systems.
The abolition of apartheid in South Africa was partly justified by appeals to the universal moral principles of the Natural Law System.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXe7jvdOMHWIvT93GS.label: European Commission
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXe7jvdOMHWIvT93GS.definition: The European Commission is the executive branch of the European Union, responsible for proposing legislation, implementing decisions, and managing the day-to-day operations of the EU. It represents the interests of the EU as a whole, rather than individual member states.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXeFnOtcGD1SnlKcTD.label: Special Purpose Entity
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXeFnOtcGD1SnlKcTD.definition: A Special Purpose Entity (SPE) is a legal entity created for a specific, limited purpose, particularly in financial transactions. This entity is often used to isolate financial risk by legally segregating certain activities, assets, or investments from the main organization, thereby facilitating transaction security and credit enhancement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlENNMqPqLLWMb9ub.label: Pandemic or Other Public Health Event Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlENNMqPqLLWMb9ub.definition: Language included in a contract that defines the impact of a pandemic or other public health event on the material adverse effect (MAE) clause, which outlines exceptions to the clause in the event of certain circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlobBYNwoSXUUh9hy.label: Individual Contributor
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlobBYNwoSXUUh9hy.definition: An Individual Contributor is an employee who specializes in performing specific tasks or roles within an organization but does not have managerial responsibilities over a team. Individual Contributors focus on executing their specialized skill sets and are evaluated based on their own performance rather than the performance of a group.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlyRlyC23XqOQQkuf.label: 864 SSID Title XVI (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXlyRlyC23XqOQQkuf.definition: Action filed with regard to social security benefits provided to Supplemental Security Income Disability under Title XVI

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXoCwCeY64Ow60nWKS.label: Health-Conscious Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXoCwCeY64Ow60nWKS.definition: The health-conscious segment refers to a portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who prioritize health and wellness in their purchasing decisions. This segment includes products and services that are designed to promote physical, mental, and emotional well-being, catering to individuals who seek a healthy lifestyle.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXozjgPVMyJbstz1Yt.label: Small Intestine Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXozjgPVMyJbstz1Yt.definition: Small intestine cancer is a malignant neoplasm originating in the small intestine, which includes the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum. This type of cancer can cause symptoms such as abdominal pain, weight loss, and bowel obstruction and may include various subtypes such as adenocarcinoma, carcinoid tumors, and gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXpZKEtUb90P79zVvn.label: Death on High Seas Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXpZKEtUb90P79zVvn.definition: The Death on High Seas Act (DOHSA) is a legal concept that falls under the categories of Statutory and Regulatory Claims, as well as Admiralty and Maritime Claims. It provides a framework for compensation in cases of death that occur on the high seas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXrokRoNHSUbxowFTk.label: Schizoid Personality Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXrokRoNHSUbxowFTk.definition: Schizoid Personality Disorder is characterized by a pervasive pattern of detachment from social relationships and a restricted range of emotional expression. Individuals with this disorder often appear aloof, indifferent, and emotionally cold, and they typically have a limited desire for social interactions or engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXuNdDDsjEhgwsBBej.label: In-home Supportive Service Disability Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXuNdDDsjEhgwsBBej.definition: In-home supportive service disability benefit is a specific type of public assistance program designed to help individuals with disabilities receive essential care and services within their own homes rather than in institutional settings. These benefits can cover a range of services including personal care, meal preparation, and medical monitoring, and aim to enhance the quality of life for disabled individuals by enabling them to live more independently.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBXvJDVALlJ0Uzr6Yqy.label: Timne
http://lmss.sali.org/RBXvJDVALlJ0Uzr6Yqy.definition: Timne is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class, which is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBY1Ussr6yfSVer0uxk.label: Amicus
http://lmss.sali.org/RBY1Ussr6yfSVer0uxk.definition: An entity that is not involved in litigation but provides the court with input, testimony, and/or briefing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBY4j5UKZ7L8gp0q9Wr.label: Employment Classification
http://lmss.sali.org/RBY4j5UKZ7L8gp0q9Wr.definition: Worker Classification refers to the categorization of an employee's work status within an organization, often defined as full-time, part-time, or contractor. These classifications dictate the terms of employment, including benefits eligibility, tax implications, and legal obligations between the employer and employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBY8a3mEUgWortvVuS3.label: Expert Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RBY8a3mEUgWortvVuS3.definition: Expert Fees refer to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for the services of a professional with specialized knowledge or skills, such as a medical expert or a forensic accountant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYA8dqUZRnJEs8ZH32.label: R.N. (Registered Nurse)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYA8dqUZRnJEs8ZH32.definition: The suffix "R.N." stands for "Registered Nurse" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they are licensed to practice nursing. This designation confirms that the individual has met the educational and licensing requirements set forth by a nursing board or authority and is commonly used in healthcare settings, academic environments, and formal documents

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYAmc0olsXiCH0K1kW.label: By Portfolio - By Work Type
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYAmc0olsXiCH0K1kW.definition: A method of categorizing legal work based on the type of work being done within a specific portfolio or area of practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYD4vc5zjOUtzD4r6D.label: Kansas District Court - Clay County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYD4vc5zjOUtzD4r6D.definition: A court located in Clay County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYHV1W9hb3AUW4uxKw.label: Legal Design Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYHV1W9hb3AUW4uxKw.definition: Legal Design Services: A type of consulting and management service that focuses on the application of design thinking and user-centered design principles to legal processes and systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYHspF2cClL6YzpLgQ.label: Corporate Governance Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYHspF2cClL6YzpLgQ.definition: Corporate Governance Analysis refers to the examination and evaluation of the internal policies, procedures, and practices of a corporation to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, and to promote transparency and accountability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYQP3row1Mgm4AtOfx.label: Motion for Exemption from Means Test
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYQP3row1Mgm4AtOfx.definition: A Motion for Exemption from Means Test is a request made in a bankruptcy case to be excused from taking the means test, which is a calculation used to determine eligibility for Chapter 7 bankruptcy based on income.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYU9SExUHiFFo18lFs.label: Fund Formation Management Products and Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYU9SExUHiFFo18lFs.definition: Fund Formation Management (Products and Services) refers to the legal services and products related to the creation and management of investment funds.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYchLq1xe0CjTxxzJm.label: New York City Court - Watervliet
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYchLq1xe0CjTxxzJm.definition: New York City Court - Watervliet is a specific court located in Watervliet, New York, which operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhRNuXhZViZ7pJ1ut.label: Billing Attorney
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhRNuXhZViZ7pJ1ut.definition: A billing attorney is the lawyer responsible for keeping track of billable hours and expenses associated with a legal matter, and for preparing and issuing invoices to clients. This attorney ensures that the client is accurately billed for legal services provided, and may also address any billing inquiries or disputes that may arise.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYha7GrMtIUH1fPecZ.label: 470 Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYha7GrMtIUH1fPecZ.definition: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization Act, RICO 18:1961-1968

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhgoEtQ98SfEs8EnI.label: Manobo languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhgoEtQ98SfEs8EnI.definition: Manobo languages are a group of languages spoken by the Manobo people in the Philippines.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhoK7Teu3G0rAoKLI.label: Georgia Superior Court - Dade County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYhoK7Teu3G0rAoKLI.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Dade County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYjEVQYN2eWNPHqVk6.label: Fitness & Exercise Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYjEVQYN2eWNPHqVk6.definition: The fitness & exercise market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in physical fitness and exercise. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek to maintain or improve their physical health, fitness level, and overall well-being through various forms of exercise.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYljozfgM7STIDRjMB.label: Regulatory Taking Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYljozfgM7STIDRjMB.definition: The concept of Regulatory Taking refers to a situation where a government regulation or law results in the taking of private property or its use, without providing just compensation to the owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYll4ZdHxkCKuT3xKu.label: Motion to Dismiss the Case Voluntarily
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYll4ZdHxkCKuT3xKu.definition: A Motion to Dismiss the Case Voluntarily is a formal request made by the plaintiff or petitioner to end the case without prejudice, meaning that the plaintiff or petitioner can refile the case at a later time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYrAKMIuQfNeeUHxhg.label: Niger-Kordofanian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYrAKMIuQfNeeUHxhg.definition: Niger-Kordofanian languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language top-level class and are spoken in West Africa.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYrgPRNlmoj5i9Ga40.label: Expert Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYrgPRNlmoj5i9Ga40.definition: Expert Practice refers to the specialized legal work performed by an individual with advanced knowledge and experience in a particular field, typically involving the preparation and presentation of expert testimony in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYu7mrAChLYwfT9Szd.label: JF00 Disclosure (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYu7mrAChLYwfT9Szd.definition: Work relating to gathering and reviewing documents for potential disclosure, preparing disclosure lists and practical steps of disclosure.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYuUxEJgsIc0nAOhOC.label: Motion to Compel Written Discovery
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYuUxEJgsIc0nAOhOC.definition: A Motion to Compel Written Discovery is a legal request made by one party to another party in a lawsuit, asking the recipient to provide written responses to specific questions or produce certain documents that are relevant to the case, when the recipient has failed to do so voluntarily.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYurx8VXvP7jEj4kNu.label: Beja; Bedawiyet
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYurx8VXvP7jEj4kNu.definition: A language spoken by the Beja people, primarily in Sudan and Eritrea.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYvQCVAu3EbHY3xqt0.label: Promotion Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYvQCVAu3EbHY3xqt0.definition: A Promotion Agreement is a type of legal agreement that outlines the terms and conditions of a promotional campaign or event, typically between a company and a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBYyzOlJwVfpDApUYI4.label: Appellate Reply Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RBYyzOlJwVfpDApUYI4.definition: An appellate reply brief is a written legal document submitted by the appellant in response to the appellee's brief, presenting arguments and evidence in support of their appeal to a higher court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ2Ev1PTDeWx4FpdPR.label: Legal Marketplace Solutions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ2Ev1PTDeWx4FpdPR.definition: Legal Marketplace Solutions refers to a specific type of Legal Platform Solutions that provide a platform for legal professionals and clients to connect and exchange legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ5IuV0gTh73KJm144.label: Jurisdiction Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ5IuV0gTh73KJm144.definition: A jurisdiction clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the court or legal system that will have jurisdiction over any disputes arising from the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ64KRJIK7YDPikYT7.label: Unemployment Public Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ64KRJIK7YDPikYT7.definition: Unemployment public benefits refer to government programs that provide financial assistance to individuals who have lost their jobs and are actively seeking new employment. These benefits are typically time-limited and contingent on meeting certain eligibility criteria like work history and reason for unemployment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ6CHcf1max80FyXZH.label: LINE_ITEM_NUMBER
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ6CHcf1max80FyXZH.definition: A LINE_ITEM_NUMBER is a specific identifier assigned to each individual item listed in a legal invoice, according to the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ6lzCFbD2wuY0VCjW.label: Exchanges Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ6lzCFbD2wuY0VCjW.definition: Rules regarding market places or facilities for bringing together purchasers and sellers of securities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ9yZcHqV6d68U1Fue.label: Amicable Settlement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZ9yZcHqV6d68U1Fue.definition: An amicable settlement clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to attempt to resolve any disputes through negotiation or mediation before pursuing legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZEenLuT0zaK9omzPf.label: Artificial Intelligence Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZEenLuT0zaK9omzPf.definition: Artifical Intelligence (AI) Law encompasses legal issues arising from the development, deployment, and use of AI such as ethical use, transparency, and data protection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZL31YCqZA1E1vlIkz.label: tax segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZL31YCqZA1E1vlIkz.definition:
"A lookup segment for the taxes charged in the file.  There will be 0 or more TAX segments per file.  If items are not taxed, no TAX section would be included in the file.  

The EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZNh3aE4RTaPfgJEpb.label: Ukrainian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZNh3aE4RTaPfgJEpb.definition: The Ukrainian language is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Slavic language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZPOSDNBMmYllinnr5.label: Tumbuka
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZPOSDNBMmYllinnr5.definition: Tumbuka is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a language of a document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZXbv75cyMrROEWybf.label: State Governmental Leader
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZXbv75cyMrROEWybf.definition: A State Governmental Leader is the highest-ranking official in a state, province, or similar sub-national administrative division. This individual is typically responsible for executing state laws, overseeing state agencies, proposing legislation, and representing the state's interests at both national and international levels.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZazvtzwU8jwKWm68L.label: Licensee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZazvtzwU8jwKWm68L.definition: A licensee is a person or entity to whom a license is granted. A licensee has the license to use someone else's specified property such as a building, a land or intellectual property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZdShYeyerlOOUlB0f.label: Islamic Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZdShYeyerlOOUlB0f.definition: Sharia Law is a legal system based on Islamic principles derived from the Quran, Hadith (sayings of Prophet Muhammad), and other Islamic texts. This system governs both personal and communal aspects of life, integrating moral and legal guidelines.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZfjNF8HgF5bR2XQBF.label: Lump Sum Payment of Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZfjNF8HgF5bR2XQBF.definition: Lump sum payment of public benefit refers to the disbursement of financial assistance in a single, large payment rather than through ongoing, smaller payments. This approach is often used as part of a diversion objective to encourage recipients to use the funds for specific purposes like securing housing or job training, with the goal of reducing long-term dependency on public benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZfnioqo6TROkTyGa1.label: Denial-of-Service Attack
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZfnioqo6TROkTyGa1.definition: A denial-of-service attack, also known as a DoS attack, aims to disrupt a computer system or network by flooding it with an overwhelming amount of traffic, rendering the service unavailable to legitimate users.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZgWmGzcTraSAkw6fM.label: Immigration Removal Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZgWmGzcTraSAkw6fM.definition: Immigration Removal Proceeding is a legal process in which an individual is brought before an immigration court to determine their eligibility to remain in a country. If found to be in violation of immigration laws, the individual may be ordered to leave the country, commonly known as deportation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZiDPE3hLHRZhLXyjp.label: Capitalization Table
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZiDPE3hLHRZhLXyjp.definition: A Capitalization Table (Cap Table) is a document that outlines the ownership structure of a company, including the number and type of shares held by each shareholder.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZifrYlfXzRuNkG6RI.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Schuyler County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZifrYlfXzRuNkG6RI.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Schuyler County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Schuyler County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZk3zcuOoUUGWYC5W6.label: Greek, Ancient
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZk3zcuOoUUGWYC5W6.definition: The language used in ancient Greece up to the year 1453, including its grammar and vocabulary, as it relates to legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZkKQpHNkm2vdQEmj3.label: Georgia Superior Court - Montgomery County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZkKQpHNkm2vdQEmj3.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Montgomery County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Montgomery County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZn0IX2NtrfPkzFcRd.label: Primary Lateral Sclerosis
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZn0IX2NtrfPkzFcRd.definition: Primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) is a rare neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the gradual degeneration of upper motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord. This condition leads to progressive muscle stiffness, spasticity, and weakness, primarily affecting voluntary movements while sparing lower motor neurons.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZsudYglnckzDiIt6L.label: Customs and Import Duty Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZsudYglnckzDiIt6L.definition: Customs and Import Duty Payment refers to taxes, stamp duties, and surcharges levied exclusively on imported products. This includes specific levies on agricultural imports in European Union member countries and payments under the Monetary Compensation Accounts (MCA) system. Customs duties collected by EU member states on behalf of the European Union are also reported under this heading. These taxes are distinct from general goods and services taxes or excises that apply to both imported and domestically produced goods.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZvzjymwe5Jdu4nFAu.label: Duty to Mitigate Damages Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZvzjymwe5Jdu4nFAu.definition: A Duty to Mitigate Damages Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the injured party to take reasonable steps to minimize their losses or damages resulting from a breach of contract by the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBZyQS180oRBbk6avg3.label: Riparian Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RBZyQS180oRBbk6avg3.definition: Rooted in common law, riparian rights refer to the rights of landowners whose property borders a natural watercourse. Under riparian doctrine, these landowners have the right to make reasonable use of the water adjacent to or flowing over their land, provided they don't unreasonably interfere with the rights of downstream users.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBa62CLWruxRoy7VFVw.label: Matter Complexity
http://lmss.sali.org/RBa62CLWruxRoy7VFVw.definition: Classification for a given' matter's complexity, either textually (e.g., low, medium, high) or numerically (e.g., 1 through 10).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaCSXoln2zl318gfPv.label: 490 Cable/Satellite TV (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaCSXoln2zl318gfPv.definition: Action filed involving unauthorized reception of cable/satellite TV service under 47 U.S.C. § 553 (unauthorized reception of cable/satellite TV), or 47 U.S.C. § 605 (e)(3) (unauthorized use or publication of a communication)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaCjVfhep5KcxCv61v.label: Motion Objecting to Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaCjVfhep5KcxCv61v.definition: A Motion Objecting to Discharge is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to prevent the debtor from being released from certain debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaDgEh7Yc3aSPVgbLR.label: Probate due to Death / Testamentary
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaDgEh7Yc3aSPVgbLR.definition: Probate due to Death / Testamentary refers to the legal process of administering the estate of a deceased person according to their will or testament.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaGZ6KNYKsLyn8IJ2X.label: Oncology Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaGZ6KNYKsLyn8IJ2X.definition: Negligence in the field of oncology, where a healthcare provider fails to provide the appropriate standard of care in the diagnosis, treatment, or management of cancer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaJDWY4eliIvdRb35i.label: Bar Date Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaJDWY4eliIvdRb35i.definition: A Bar Date Motion in Bankruptcy is a legal request made by a debtor to set a deadline for creditors to file claims against the debtor's estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaK4xLFKOc03lK7yvo.label: Pretrial Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaK4xLFKOc03lK7yvo.definition: A pretrial conference is a court-mandated meeting between parties involved in a legal case before the trial, where they discuss the case and attempt to reach a settlement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaL12q3x6rROmJNfKo.label: Guarani
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaL12q3x6rROmJNfKo.definition: Guarani (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, spoken in Paraguay and parts of Brazil and Argentina.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaL7gtiLlgraIRVwa4.label: Trademark Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaL7gtiLlgraIRVwa4.definition: Trademark Assets are a type of Intellectual Property Assets that refer to any distinctive sign, symbol, or expression used to identify and distinguish the goods or services of one party from those of others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaZLdWyQY4GFmX1fjR.label: New York City Court - Sherrill
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaZLdWyQY4GFmX1fjR.definition: New York City Court - Sherrill: A specific court within the New York City Court system that handles legal proceedings related to the town of Sherrill.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaaZGdw6aXGlq7F2fE.label: Ijo languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaaZGdw6aXGlq7F2fE.definition: Ijo languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language top-level class and are spoken by the Ijo people in Nigeria and Equatorial Guinea.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBah224eIDAT3LANwvJ.label: New York District Court - Suffolk County - 4th District
http://lmss.sali.org/RBah224eIDAT3LANwvJ.definition: A court located in Suffolk County, New York, which is part of the larger New York District Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBam0YoKKhIiUplrUEZ.label: Florida Circuit Court - Okeechobee County - 19th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBam0YoKKhIiUplrUEZ.definition: A court located in Okeechobee County, Florida that is part of the 19th Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBao5EUoMrCMBNi3z27.label: Black
http://lmss.sali.org/RBao5EUoMrCMBNi3z27.definition: Black (Ethnicity and Race) refers to a social and cultural identity associated with people of African descent, often used to describe individuals or groups who identify as Black or African American.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBartzGrOte2TVksxcD.label: Biological Parent
http://lmss.sali.org/RBartzGrOte2TVksxcD.definition: A Biological Parent, also known as a birth parent, is an individual from whom a child inherits their genetic material. This refers to the mother, from whom a child is born, and the father, who contributes to the child's conception, distinguishing them from adoptive or step-parents.
sources: From LIST: Legal Issues Taxonomy — https://taxonomy.legal/

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaxCpyimnR8O0OxIE0.label: Whistleblower Retaliation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaxCpyimnR8O0OxIE0.definition: Retaliation against an employee who reports illegal or unethical behavior by their employer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBaxOxFMQvZEpB7rixk.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Delaware County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBaxOxFMQvZEpB7rixk.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Delaware County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBb1yZeamyO4wj2dAFJ.label: Court-Mandated Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/RBb1yZeamyO4wj2dAFJ.definition: A Court-Mandated Conference is a legal event that is required by a court order, typically held before a trial, where parties involved in a lawsuit meet to discuss the case and attempt to reach a settlement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBb2LE4oG249P86Zgdr.label: Active Employment Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RBb2LE4oG249P86Zgdr.definition: Active Employment refers to the current, ongoing employment relationship between an employee and an employer, where the employee is actively engaged in work and fulfilling job responsibilities. This status usually means that the employee is eligible for all the benefits, salary, and protections provided by the employer

http://lmss.sali.org/RBb3Q6Qo1avxssIdEUx.label: Arizona Superior Court - Graham Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBb3Q6Qo1avxssIdEUx.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Graham Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Graham County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBb7YWYUEKvDw31Xltw.label: Florida Circuit Court - Seminole County - 18th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBb7YWYUEKvDw31Xltw.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Seminole County (18th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Seminole County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbCFtSgYl1mKuI8SNc.label: Bridge Loan
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbCFtSgYl1mKuI8SNc.definition: A Bridge Loan is a short-term financing option used to bridge the gap between the purchase of a new asset and the sale of an existing one. Typically utilized in real estate transactions, bridge loans provide immediate cash flow for the borrower until permanent financing can be arranged or the existing asset is sold.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbK90zM6tKoysk6Vib.label: Date of Birth
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbK90zM6tKoysk6Vib.definition: Date of Birth is the specific day, month, and year on which an individual was born. It is a key piece of identifying information used in various legal, medical, and financial contexts, often required for verification of age, eligibility, and identity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbKQavNM8iQqNfPu2b.label: Animal Domestication Type
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbKQavNM8iQqNfPu2b.definition: Animal Domestication Type refers to the classification of animals based on their relationship and dependence on humans, distinguishing between those that have been domesticated for companionship, labor, or product provision, and those that live and thrive in the wild without human intervention.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbLGuIZj86AlYd3J72.label: Addendum Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbLGuIZj86AlYd3J72.definition: An addendum clause is a provision added to a contract that modifies or supplements the original terms of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbPbGXI0ECmsyi7dWG.label: lf_matter_id
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbPbGXI0ECmsyi7dWG.definition:
"The law firm assigned matter id or case reference number. Multiple lf_matter_id's can be billed in the same invoice.   
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbWO1nfadlG5aeLsW8.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Iron County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbWO1nfadlG5aeLsW8.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Iron County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Iron County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbWg6xic2y9L6zhfJR.label: Sweat Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbWg6xic2y9L6zhfJR.definition: Sweat evidence refers to the traces of perspiration found on surfaces or objects. While sweat itself contains limited DNA, the skin cells often shed within it can be analyzed for DNA, potentially connecting a person to a specific location or item.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbZiBjrGLfGZJoHRTU.label: Coalition Formation and Management Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbZiBjrGLfGZJoHRTU.definition: Coalition Formation and Management Practice involves providing legal advice and support for the creation, organization, and governance of coalitions, whether they be political, corporate, or industry-specific. This practice includes drafting agreements, navigating regulatory compliance, and facilitating collaborative strategies among coalition members.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbZycHT7XKle5NI2QX.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Madison County (3rd Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbaw40Zns8HtOb84G6.label: Georgia Superior Court - Clay County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbaw40Zns8HtOb84G6.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Clay County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clay County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbjh6B7AdBQ6Bks9h6.label: Providing Alcohol to Minor
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbjh6B7AdBQ6Bks9h6.definition: The act of giving or serving alcoholic beverages to an individual who is under the legal drinking age, which may result in legal consequences such as charges of negligence or violation of liquor laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkDB8kd8SkZbK5vvN.label: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkDB8kd8SkZbK5vvN.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim is a legal request made by a defendant to dismiss a case on the grounds that the plaintiff has failed to allege sufficient facts to support a legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkOoA0Hp0UmEnkGJO.label: Skin Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkOoA0Hp0UmEnkGJO.definition: Skin disorders encompass a range of conditions affecting the skin's structure and function, including inflammatory, infectious, and neoplastic diseases. These disorders can cause symptoms such as rashes, lesions, and systemic effects that impair the skin's ability to protect the body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkwoH1uH2PhTq4RgS.label: Buyer Consent Requirement Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbkwoH1uH2PhTq4RgS.definition: A requirement for the buyer's explicit agreement to certain terms or conditions, which is included in an affirmative covenant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbmAr7UZlvBSjbTLZe.label: Unlawful Wage Garnishment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbmAr7UZlvBSjbTLZe.definition: An unlawful wage garnishment claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the legal requirements for wage garnishment. Wage garnishment occurs when a creditor obtains a court order to deduct a portion of an employee's wages to satisfy a debt. The claim typically arises when an employer improperly withholds too much of an employee's wages or does not follow the proper legal procedures for wage garnishment, which can result in financial harm to the employee. Employers can also face liability for not protecting employees from unlawful garnishment orders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBbySQBPY3e7lHvT4NB.label: Mechanics' Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/RBbySQBPY3e7lHvT4NB.definition: A Mechanics' Lien is a type of lien that allows a contractor or supplier to place a claim on a property they have worked on if they have not been paid for their services or materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc09F49xi1kJWJxboF.label: City Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc09F49xi1kJWJxboF.definition: City Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a municipality for any harm or damage caused to individuals or property due to the actions or negligence of the city or its employees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc2FRP53sM6euO1KWy.label: Fort Sill apache Tribe of Oklahoma

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc4ZnXtFafbkduoe6F.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Piatt County (6th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc5RGWuFjIluthibNw.label: Telecommunications Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc5RGWuFjIluthibNw.definition: Industries in this group provide telecommunications and the services related to that activity (e.g., telephony, including Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP); cable and satellite television distribution services; Internet access; telecommunications reselling services). The group is primarily engaged in operating, and/or providing access to facilities for the transmission of voice, data, text, sound, and video.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc62GMUSMNXO0uGLVI.label: L350 Discovery Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc62GMUSMNXO0uGLVI.definition: A legal motion made during the discovery phase of a lawsuit, specifically related to requesting information or evidence from the opposing party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc6GT2EPDVvjwGyBkp.label: Holdover Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc6GT2EPDVvjwGyBkp.definition: A holdover clause is a provision in a contract that allows a tenant to remain in possession of a property after the lease has expired, usually on a month-to-month basis, until either party terminates the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc6oqiKweeX4V16bHr.label: Speech and Debate Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc6oqiKweeX4V16bHr.definition: A Speech and Debate Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on the constitutional provision that grants legislators immunity from civil or criminal liability for statements made during legislative proceedings. This claim protects legislators from being sued or prosecuted for defamation, libel, or other legal actions arising from their speech or debate in the legislative context.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBc8llmdnVBvfzkSbQx.label: Criminal Trespass
http://lmss.sali.org/RBc8llmdnVBvfzkSbQx.definition: To unlawfully enter land, a dwelling, or other real property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcCojuJ1oYfBUjMEaX.label: Deferred Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcCojuJ1oYfBUjMEaX.definition: A deferred appendix is a section of a document that is not included in the main body but is added as an attachment or supplement at a later time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcDacFBsjBkhx0EE8p.label: B.S. (Bachelor of Science)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcDacFBsjBkhx0EE8p.definition: The suffix "B.S." stands for "Bachelor of Science" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an undergraduate degree in a science or technology-related field. This designation signifies the individual's foundational knowledge and skills in their area of study, and is commonly used in academic, professional, and formal settings

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcGW599uGbSbjjZZtM.label: Exempted Limited Partnership
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcGW599uGbSbjjZZtM.definition: An exempted limited partnership (ELP) is a Cayman partnership that is registered under the Exempted Limited Partnership Law. The ELP Law specifically preserves relevant provisions of the Partnership Law and provides that the principles of common law and equity applicable to partnerships shall apply to ELPs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcLpRDbRNlyXpzeESd.label: 890 Other Statutory Actions (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcLpRDbRNlyXpzeESd.definition: Action primarily based on Statutes that cannot be classified under any other nature of suit, such as: Foreign Agents Registration Act 22:611- 621, Klamath Termination Act 25:564-564W-L, Federal Aid Highway Act 23:101-142, Federal Corrupt Practices Act 2:241-256, Federal Election Campaign Act, Highway Safety Act 23:401 Immigration & Nationality Act 8:1503, Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act 49:1671-1700, Naturalization Acts 8:1421/18:911, 1015, 1421, et seq., 3282 or Federal Aviation Act 49:1301 et seq.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcSS6JJPoCbbKqlNno.label: Privacy Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcSS6JJPoCbbKqlNno.definition: Privacy Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's failure to protect the privacy and confidentiality of personal or sensitive information entrusted to it by individuals or other organizations. These risks can result from inadequate data security measures, cyber attacks, or noncompliance with privacy regulations, potentially leading to data breaches, loss of trust, or legal liabilities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, reputation, and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcagDXdC2DHlXfeOe0.label: A109 Appear for/attend
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcagDXdC2DHlXfeOe0.definition: To "Appear for/attend" refers to the act of physically being present at a scheduled event or proceeding, such as a court hearing or meeting, as a participant or observer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBccNGIgjWjBcZG0ICd.label: Armed Forces Branch
http://lmss.sali.org/RBccNGIgjWjBcZG0ICd.definition: The Armed Forces Branch is a division of the government responsible for national defense and military operations. It encompasses all military branches, including the army, navy, air force, and other specialized units, ensuring the protection and security of the nation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcgw1OPn4i0DV0T1CH.label: Interpleader
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcgw1OPn4i0DV0T1CH.definition: A person who compels other parties making the same claim against him to litigate the matter between themselves to prove whose claim is good.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcjNwr4x38dfeoCwSc.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - McKinley County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcjNwr4x38dfeoCwSc.definition: A court located in McKinley County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBckTayoftAJnEN41kd.label: Amicus Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RBckTayoftAJnEN41kd.definition: An amicus brief is a written legal argument submitted to a court by a non-party who has a strong interest in the outcome of a case, typically to provide additional information or perspective on the legal issues at hand.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBckmqcc5Fc5xTyszOg.label: Employment Eligibility Verification Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RBckmqcc5Fc5xTyszOg.definition: The Employment Eligibility Verification Form (in the U.S., the I-9) is a form required by the government for all employees to verify their identity and authorization to work in the country. Employers must complete and retain an Employment Eligibility Verification Form for each person they hire, and the form must be available for inspection by authorized government officers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcqjpQEZycZw0rcbC9.label: Financial System Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcqjpQEZycZw0rcbC9.definition: The risk that the failure of a financial institution or a group of institutions can cause a systemic crisis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBcuoqBaLiPaGEYNL1f.label: Raspberries
http://lmss.sali.org/RBcuoqBaLiPaGEYNL1f.definition: Raspberries are aggregate fruits from the Rubus genus, characterized by their juicy drupelets and sweet-tart flavor. http://lmss.sali.org/RBdi2LdzXIXmAbEUPwa.definition: A court located in San Juan County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBdvVmVo4DBFTBGCs5e.definition: The temperate market segment refers to consumers or businesses located in regions characterized by moderate temperatures, typically experiencing distinct seasonal changes. http://lmss.sali.org/RBdx2EE9c4xHSypmLdJ.label: New York City Court - Kingston

http://lmss.sali.org/RBdyeqVpZ95dzn6l0hQ.label: Public Disclosure of Private Facts
http://lmss.sali.org/RBdyeqVpZ95dzn6l0hQ.definition: The public disclosure of private facts is a type of privacy claim that involves the dissemination of personal information that is not of legitimate public concern, and that would be highly offensive to a reasonable person. This includes the practice of "doxing" (aka "doxxing"), which refers to the act of publicly revealing private or identifying information about an individual without their consent, typically with malicious intent. This information can include addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, or other personal details, and the practice is often associated with online harassment or cyberbullying.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBdzXlcak91MmI7U2nH.label: Motion to Extend Time - Trial Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBdzXlcak91MmI7U2nH.definition: A Motion to Extend Time - Trial Court is a request made to a trial court to extend the deadline for a specific action or filing in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBe3wpR5ZicE4QYklVE.definition: A Tax Deduction is a reduction of a taxpayer's taxable income, lowering the amount of income subject to taxation. It operates by subtracting specific expenses or allowances from gross income, thereby decreasing the tax base before the tax rate is applied

http://lmss.sali.org/RBe8WASOOp24Pw0SKpa.label: Student Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RBe8WASOOp24Pw0SKpa.definition: A Student Visa is a type of visa issued to foreign nationals who wish to enter a country for the purpose of pursuing academic studies at an accredited educational institution. http://lmss.sali.org/RBe9qlr1zTrQ59S23u1.label: Class Action Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBe9qlr1zTrQ59S23u1.definition: A Class Action Claim is a type of civil claim where a group of individuals collectively bring a lawsuit against a defendant, typically seeking compensation for damages or harm caused by the defendant's actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBeABy5UPz4KOLOrL1L.label: Trespass to Real Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RBeABy5UPz4KOLOrL1L.definition: The concept of Trespass to Real Property refers to the intentional and unauthorized entry onto someone else's land or property, causing damage or interference with the owner's right to exclusive possession.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBeCutYFN3Ke6ZtS1GO.label: Stroke
http://lmss.sali.org/RBeCutYFN3Ke6ZtS1GO.definition: A vascular insult to the brain, commonly referred to as a stroke or cerebrovascular accident, occurs when blood flow to a part of the brain is disrupted, leading to tissue damage and neurological deficits. http://lmss.sali.org/RBfZA58JH88QrVPUBjs.definition: The right to liberty refers to the fundamental human right to freedom from unlawful or arbitrary arrest, detention, or other forms of physical restraint. http://lmss.sali.org/RBfcsZ2JrzHrZiwoKzH.definition: The act of taking someone's personal information without their consent and using it to obtain credit or loans in their name.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBfgMJEBmJrI7Wp0zUj.label: Temporary Employee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBfgMJEBmJrI7Wp0zUj.definition: A Temporary Employee is an individual hired for a specific, limited period, often to assist with seasonal workloads or to fill in for a regular employee who is absent. http://lmss.sali.org/RBfi3eGJmdDDpV4EDEf.label: Confabulation

http://lmss.sali.org/RBfjycAy2MGoz0ZBxpZ.label: Beets

http://lmss.sali.org/RBg7k9MzbiXRTuyNAP6.label: Domestication Action
http://lmss.sali.org/RBg7k9MzbiXRTuyNAP6.definition: Domestication Action refers to the legal process of making a foreign judgment enforceable in a jurisdiction different from where it was originally issued. http://lmss.sali.org/RBg7sRYxsZKH1clvAIA.label: Law Review Article
http://lmss.sali.org/RBg7sRYxsZKH1clvAIA.definition: A Law Review Article is a scholarly piece of writing published in a law review, which is a type of academic journal focused on legal and jurisprudential topics. These articles are written by legal scholars, practitioners, or law students, and they provide in-depth analysis, critique, or novel perspectives on legal theories, case law, statutes, or societal legal issues, often influencing legal thought and occasionally, policy or judicial decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgA0aJ5uSgukDmZhUY.label: Partial Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgA0aJ5uSgukDmZhUY.definition: A partial waiver is the voluntary relinquishment of some, but not all, rights or claims within a broader legal entitlement. It allows a party to retain certain rights while forgoing others, typically specified in the waiver agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgAFGiEeC2W7cHvjmy.label: Cyberbullying
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgAFGiEeC2W7cHvjmy.definition: Cyberbullying is a form of criminal harassment that involves the use of electronic communication to repeatedly intimidate, threaten, or harm another person.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgBfpeyncVHi12taLM.label: Habeas Corpus
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgBfpeyncVHi12taLM.definition: A legal concept that allows a person who is detained or imprisoned to challenge the legality of their detention and seek release.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgDm9chyMqAeDZWVJb.label: Idaho Magistrate Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgDm9chyMqAeDZWVJb.definition: Idaho Magistrate Court is a lower court in the Idaho State Court system that handles minor criminal and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKhsYfKikP4zZ8SiO.label: In Witness Whereof Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKhsYfKikP4zZ8SiO.definition: An "In Witness Whereof Clause" is a clause in a contract that identifies the parties who have signed the contract and the date of execution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKmqW5bzUXT06JKTK.label: Feature Engineering
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKmqW5bzUXT06JKTK.definition: Feature Engineering is the process of selecting, transforming, and creating input features from raw data to improve the performance and accuracy of machine learning models. This involves extracting meaningful attributes that capture essential patterns within the data, thereby enhancing the model's ability to make accurate predictions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKnOpRzmN0EAjwIwI.label: Elements of Criminal Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgKnOpRzmN0EAjwIwI.definition: The Elements of Criminal Claim refer to the specific components that must be proven in a criminal case, including the harm caused, the intent of the accused, and the causal link between the two.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgVjV5eJq1UYuSuxBe.label: Clinical Trial
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgVjV5eJq1UYuSuxBe.definition: A Clinical Trial is a research study conducted with human participants to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and side effects of new medical treatments, drugs, or interventions. These trials are essential for determining whether new therapies should be approved for use in the general population.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgXEUKwFz7Y2rqPeuT.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Randolph Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgXEUKwFz7Y2rqPeuT.definition: A court located in Randolph County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgYlfvGoXoGLN1CBxD.label: Trial Court Procedural Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgYlfvGoXoGLN1CBxD.definition: Trial Court Procedural Documents are written materials that are filed with a court during the course of a trial, such as motions, pleadings, and orders, which outline the procedural steps taken by the parties involved in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBga8WBazn3ZXEar68K.label: Accident Benefits Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBga8WBazn3ZXEar68K.definition: Law that deals with the compensation and benefits provided to individuals who have been injured in an accident.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgbDi79oDGxVYXpQrV.label: Demonstrative Bequest
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgbDi79oDGxVYXpQrV.definition: A Demonstrative Bequest is a provision in a will or trust that designates a specific monetary amount or asset to be paid or distributed from a particular source within the estate. This type of bequest combines elements of both specific and general bequests, specifying the source while also ensuring a fixed amount is given to the beneficiary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgcRZuNf8ylPXYRyYL.label: Resolution Date Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgcRZuNf8ylPXYRyYL.definition: A Resolution Date Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the date by which any disputes or issues arising from the contract must be resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgiL6PdrY9bOrLxYGw.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Language Impairment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgiL6PdrY9bOrLxYGw.definition: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Language Impairment is characterized by deficits in social communication and interaction, alongside restricted, repetitive patterns of behavior or interests. Individuals with this condition exhibit significant difficulties with language development and usage, impacting their ability to communicate effectively and engage in social interactions.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgiL6PdrY9bOrLxYGw.pref_label: Autistic Spectrum Disorder with Communication Impairment

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgl3tnuy31G2edlQGJ.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Mifflin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgl3tnuy31G2edlQGJ.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Mifflin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Mifflin County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgnpYOGVki6NkXzQwf.label: Georgia Superior Court - Butts County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgnpYOGVki6NkXzQwf.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Butts County, Georgia, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBguYnVVl5fmAxjW2p0.label: Luxury Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBguYnVVl5fmAxjW2p0.definition: The luxury segment refers to a specific portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who seek high-end, premium products and services. This segment is associated with luxury goods that offer exclusivity, superior quality, and a high level of craftsmanship, catering to consumers who are willing to pay a premium for these attributes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgw1iuKW0MTO2I9OFJ.label: Greek, Modern
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgw1iuKW0MTO2I9OFJ.definition: Greek, Modern (1453-) is a form of language that emerged after the fall of the Byzantine Empire and is still in use today.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgyUJt7qyOEtnXbAg6.label: Health Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgyUJt7qyOEtnXbAg6.definition: Health public benefit refers to government programs designed to provide medical services or financial assistance for healthcare needs to eligible individuals. This can include programs like Medicaid in the United States, which offers healthcare coverage to low-income families and individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgykmvlnXtCsXRVIBM.label: Non-economic Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgykmvlnXtCsXRVIBM.definition: Non-economic damages refer to compensation awarded in a legal matter for harm or loss that cannot be quantified in monetary terms, such as pain and suffering, emotional distress, disfigurement, and loss of consortium.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgyq2bGwkmGczszqmy.label: Bankrupt’s Voiding of Preferential Transfer of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgyq2bGwkmGczszqmy.definition: The Bankrupt's Voiding of Preferential Transfer of Property refers to the legal concept where a bankrupt individual or entity is allowed to cancel or undo any transfer of property made to a creditor within a certain time period before filing for bankruptcy, in order to ensure fair distribution of assets among all creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgzWJQz52CrObfGXDK.label: Trial Court Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgzWJQz52CrObfGXDK.definition: Trial Court Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a legal matter that involves presenting evidence and arguments before a judge or jury in a trial court, including procedures and rules specific to district courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBgzm9VXuFGCCKU9P2U.label: Scienter
http://lmss.sali.org/RBgzm9VXuFGCCKU9P2U.definition: The concept of Scienter refers to the knowledge or intent of wrongdoing by a defendant in a legal claim, which is an essential element of the plaintiff's case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBh0QM3Ors2HJuox2Ot.label: Mixed-Member Proportional Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBh0QM3Ors2HJuox2Ot.definition: Mixed-Member Proportional Representation (MMP) is an electoral system that combines elements of first-past-the-post and proportional representation. Voters typically have two votes: one for a candidate to represent their local constituency and another for a party list, with the overall composition of the legislature reflecting the proportion of party list votes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBh2R6J0MMaUZ59aYJr.label: Afar
http://lmss.sali.org/RBh2R6J0MMaUZ59aYJr.definition: Afar (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBh4IihdHcd5SdGt2qH.label: Dyslexia
http://lmss.sali.org/RBh4IihdHcd5SdGt2qH.definition: Dyslexia is a specific learning disability that affects an individual's ability to read, spell, write, and sometimes speak, due to difficulties in recognizing and processing written words and symbols. It is a neurological condition that is often hereditary and varies in severity, requiring tailored educational strategies and interventions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBh8j2DJLFLB6DShaW9.label: Motion to Waive Credit Counseling
http://lmss.sali.org/RBh8j2DJLFLB6DShaW9.definition: A Motion to Waive Credit Counseling is a formal request submitted by a debtor to a bankruptcy court to exempt them from the mandatory credit counseling requirement. This requirement is typically necessary before filing for bankruptcy, but the motion may be granted under special circumstances, such as exigency or incapacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhEKAIRXGRj45kY7Z6.label: Landlord Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhEKAIRXGRj45kY7Z6.definition: Landlord insurance is designed to provide coverage for property owners who rent out one or more residential homes, apartments, or condos. It generally covers the building structure, and it may also provide coverage for loss of rental income and liability protection. It typically does not cover the personal belongings of the tenants.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhGgWIW35Tx2mB2TQP.label: Negative Pledge
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhGgWIW35Tx2mB2TQP.definition: A Negative Pledge is a covenant in a loan agreement where the borrower agrees not to pledge any assets as collateral if doing so would result in less security for the agreement's bondholders. This provision aims to protect the interests of the bondholders by ensuring that the borrower does not take actions that would dilute the security or increase the risk associated with the debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhOGxYh9EijLWWwCV5.label: Regional Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhOGxYh9EijLWWwCV5.definition: The regional segment refers to a portion of the market that is focused on consumers and businesses for a geographical region within a country. This segment tailors its products, services, and marketing strategies to meet the needs and preferences of the regional population, often considering local culture, language, and economic conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhSOojrQ86fo0mJofJ.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Bucks County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhSOojrQ86fo0mJofJ.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court located in Bucks County, responsible for administering proceedings related to minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil disputes within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhSgKU6gYyBR6VVgW6.label: Closed During Tail Period
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhSgKU6gYyBR6VVgW6.definition: The concept of "Closed During Tail Period" refers to a specific timing of the acquisition proposal closing, where the target company is not allowed to consider any other offers during a certain period after the initial offer has been made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhX9MYw5DnHiTlEAJg.label: Rest Break
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhX9MYw5DnHiTlEAJg.definition: A "Rest Break" is a shorter break during the workday, during which employees can briefly pause from work to rest, stretch, or relax. These breaks are usually paid and are designed to improve productivity and well-being.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhfNPsv8keQ9VVfjW9.label: Proceeding Removed
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhfNPsv8keQ9VVfjW9.definition: Case Removed refers to a legal matter that has been transferred from one court to another, resulting in the case being removed from the original court's jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhgXR1QTGCoXNCPkTU.label: Hospital Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhgXR1QTGCoXNCPkTU.definition: Hospital Negligence refers to a legal claim against a medical facility for failing to provide adequate care or treatment to a patient, resulting in harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhiGuaB7KmIv6J0GhG.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Washington County (20th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkE9QAFGnMrZbdkx1.label: Small Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkE9QAFGnMrZbdkx1.definition: A type of civil claim that involves disputes of a relatively low monetary value and is resolved through a simplified and informal process known as conciliation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkRzl30PudT2hM5OE.label: Drug Equipment Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkRzl30PudT2hM5OE.definition: The unlawful manufacture, sale, purchase, possession, or transportation of equipment or devices utilized in preparing and/or using drugs or narcotics.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkx3dQ6MLH4RmvBj4.label: Whistleblower's Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhkx3dQ6MLH4RmvBj4.definition: A Whistleblower's Claim is a legal action brought by an individual who reports illegal or unethical activities within an organization, seeking protection from retaliation and potentially receiving a portion of any resulting financial penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhlqsBpfB5omRpLMcS.label: JA10 Funding (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhlqsBpfB5omRpLMcS.definition: All work relating to reviewing funding options and securing funding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmDmdZWNMpZfSRDHW.label: Remedies Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmDmdZWNMpZfSRDHW.definition: A Remedies Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the available legal remedies in the event of a breach of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmNTbNSiBiFUVXzha.label: Concealed Handgun License
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmNTbNSiBiFUVXzha.definition: A concealed handgun license (CHL), also known as a concealed carry permit or license, is an official authorization granted by a governing authority that permits an individual to carry a concealed firearm, typically a handgun, on their person in public areas. The process to obtain a CHL usually includes a background check, firearms training, and demonstration of proficiency, though specific requirements vary by jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmyZbvflQwHNAMGev.label: Voidable Release
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhmyZbvflQwHNAMGev.definition: A voidable release is a legal agreement that can be cancelled or made invalid by one of the parties involved due to certain circumstances, such as fraud or duress.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhn3Bx6FfU7CdpXPlt.label: Joint Filing Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhn3Bx6FfU7CdpXPlt.definition: A Joint Filing Agreement is an agreement between parties that allows them to file certain documents jointly, especially with regulatory agencies. Often seen in securities law, it signifies that the filers have collaborated on the document but may not agree on all points or share the same views.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhpxuVP1KPa3qKKM4U.label: Guaranteed Maximum Price Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhpxuVP1KPa3qKKM4U.definition: A Guaranteed Maximum Price Clause is a provision in a contract that sets a limit on the amount that a party will be required to pay for a project, ensuring that the cost will not exceed a certain amount.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhqGEhorn8LYtI4et3.label: As Is Purchase Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhqGEhorn8LYtI4et3.definition: A provision in a contract that states the buyer accepts the property in its current condition, without any warranties or guarantees from the seller.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhvWpwrRplNF3R3i1O.label: Interim Trustee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhvWpwrRplNF3R3i1O.definition: A trustee appointed temporarily, usually until the appointment of a permanent trustee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBhy5xMH5J79KIvhUTD.label: Visa for Intermittent Intra-Company Transferee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBhy5xMH5J79KIvhUTD.definition: Visas for intermittent intra-company transferees (in the United States, L-1A Visa) is designed for managers, executives, or specialized knowledge employees who need to travel back and forth between affiliated companies in their home country and the destination country (e.g., U.S.). In the United States, the intermittent L-1 allows the individual to stay in the U.S. for shorter periods without affecting the maximum allowable period of stay, which is typically seven years for L-1A visas and five years for L-1B visas

http://lmss.sali.org/RBi3jsUnIBZpoGWaXQ3.label: Lessee’s Default on Lease of Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/RBi3jsUnIBZpoGWaXQ3.definition: The Lessee's Default on Lease of Goods refers to the situation where the lessee fails to fulfill their obligations under a lease agreement for goods, resulting in a breach of contract and potential legal action by the lessor or creditor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBi5nYq1khAzzGeY5YZ.label: Leave-Related Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBi5nYq1khAzzGeY5YZ.definition: Leave-related claims are legal actions initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with applicable laws or the terms of an employment agreement regarding various types of leave, such as medical leave, family leave, or military leave. These claims can involve issues such as denial of leave, interference with the employee's right to take leave, or retaliation against the employee for taking leave. Employees may also bring leave-related claims if their employer fails to provide required notice or fails to provide benefits or protections required by law during the leave period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBi5ofe7gF0hhcbHBfn.label: Motion to Bifurcate
http://lmss.sali.org/RBi5ofe7gF0hhcbHBfn.definition: A Motion to Bifurcate is a legal request to separate a trial into two parts, typically to address liability and damages separately.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBi8gDlUW4dD0dzNi9S.label: DEPRECATED Attorney-Client Discussions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBi8gDlUW4dD0dzNi9S.definition: Deprecated Attorney-Client Discussions refer to the communication between a lawyer and their client that is no longer in use or recommended. It falls under the broader category of Deprecated Budgeting and Project Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiAoOzwEwAA8rSExNE.label: Matter Accumulated Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiAoOzwEwAA8rSExNE.definition: Matter Accumulated Fees: Fees accumulated for a specific legal matter within an engagement for providing legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiB3RYK0XPxs5uyTOg.label: Georgia Superior Court - Paulding County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiB3RYK0XPxs5uyTOg.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Paulding County and presided over by a judge.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiKxjgQ4fCptoehaw3.label: Qui Tam Whistleblower Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiKxjgQ4fCptoehaw3.definition: A Qui Tam Whistleblower Claim is a legal action brought by an individual who reports fraud against the government and seeks to recover damages on behalf of the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiM8kcSt8VGJhdmMZj.label: Visa for Foreign Government Employees on Official Business
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiM8kcSt8VGJhdmMZj.definition: Visa for full-time foreign government employees who will conduct official business of the foreign country at an embassy, consulate, mission or military base.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiNfuhD4bb1kCVBw7o.label: Court Filings Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiNfuhD4bb1kCVBw7o.definition: Court Filings Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining legal documents and pleadings submitted to a court, as a part of the broader Litigation Management process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiZ9niDrCJlY0UyvdZ.label: Classes of Goods and Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiZ9niDrCJlY0UyvdZ.definition: When filing for trademark registration, the classes of goods or services that the trademark covers (e.g., clothing, electronics, musical groups), as defined by the regulatory agency (e.g., U.S. Patent & Trademark Office).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBibBIyzH84MfJ4IQt0.label: Disclosure Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBibBIyzH84MfJ4IQt0.definition: A Disclosure Statement is a document filed in a bankruptcy case that provides information about the debtor's financial affairs, including assets, liabilities, income, and expenses, and is intended to assist creditors in making informed decisions about the debtor's proposed plan of reorganization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBibKbig5QuS9ec9M3W.label: Strategic Communications Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBibKbig5QuS9ec9M3W.definition: Strategic Communications Practice involves providing legal advice and services related to the management and dissemination of information to the public, media, and stakeholders, particularly in situations requiring public relations and crisis management. This legal practice ensures that communications are legally compliant, strategically effective, and aligned with the client’s objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiffdj7xlDTnrwD3OJ.label: Minnesota District Court - Sibley County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBiffdj7xlDTnrwD3OJ.definition: Minnesota District Court - Sibley County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sibley County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBiiVh0p5IxIgxM5RaC.label: Ponca Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

http://lmss.sali.org/RBikyfQNNKcwKiRGoUI.label: Proxy Contest
http://lmss.sali.org/RBikyfQNNKcwKiRGoUI.definition: A proxy contest is a struggle for control of a company where opposing factions of shareholders seek to gather enough proxy votes to win a corporate election or effect significant corporate decisions. This often occurs during annual meetings when shareholders vote on the election of directors or other major corporate issues.
examples: The 2008 proxy contest between activist investor Carl Icahn and Yahoo's board of directors.
The 2009 proxy fight at Canadian Pacific Railway led by hedge fund Pershing Square Capital Management.
The battle for control of Procter & Gamble in 2017, where Trian Fund Management sought to place its nominee on the board.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBila9ckW95W84Tk54t.label: Employment Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RBila9ckW95W84Tk54t.definition: Employment Events refer to specific milestones in an employee's work history with an organization, such as the date of hiring, date of termination, and date of re-hiring. These events are important for both administrative record-keeping and compliance with employment laws and regulations

http://lmss.sali.org/RBio9rI5z1fmHBPJU7B.label: Special Nonimmigrant Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RBio9rI5z1fmHBPJU7B.definition: This special non-immigrant visa classification is a rarely used.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBioeVhKaUUVmf39x6B.label: Mineral Resources Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBioeVhKaUUVmf39x6B.definition: Law governing the exploration, extraction, ownership, and regulation of mineral resources such as coal, metals, and precious stones, including mining rights, licensing, environmental obligations, and the equitable distribution of mineral wealth.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBisl4Hku74Euy3AAAO.label: Paroled Refugee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBisl4Hku74Euy3AAAO.definition: A Paroled Refugee is an individual who has been allowed entry into a country on a temporary basis for urgent humanitarian reasons or significant public benefit, even though they do not meet the regular admission requirements for refugees. This status provides temporary legal presence in the host country while the individual’s case is reviewed or until more permanent arrangements can be made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBix5fW3COPX4xfo2aJ.label: Breach of Fiduciary Duty by Trustee
http://lmss.sali.org/RBix5fW3COPX4xfo2aJ.definition: The breach of fiduciary duty by trustee refers to a situation where a trustee fails to act in the best interest of the beneficiaries of a trust, violating their legal obligation to manage the trust assets and affairs with loyalty, honesty, and good faith.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBizcuAme8glPLFlQSQ.label: Forcible Fondling
http://lmss.sali.org/RBizcuAme8glPLFlQSQ.definition: The touching of the private body parts of another person for the purpose of sexual gratification, forcibly and/or against that person’s will or not forcibly or against the person’s will in instances where the victim is incapable of giving consent because of his/her youth or because of his/her temporary or permanent mental or physical incapacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBj5pmPbMTTu1gawhjU.label: X304 Discovery/eDiscovery Review and Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RBj5pmPbMTTu1gawhjU.definition: Any costs associated with the inspection, review, consideration and analysis of documents and/or evidence, relevance issues, quality assurance and control when billed as an expense instead of a service. Excludes creation of privilege log (X305).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjDj4OYq8GXdV6Oimq.label: Junior Credit Ranking
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjDj4OYq8GXdV6Oimq.definition: Junior Credit Ranking refers to the priority status of junior debts, which are ranked above junior subordinated debts but below senior and senior subordinated debts in the event of liquidation. This ranking ensures that junior creditors are paid before junior subordinated creditors from the proceeds of the liquidated assets, providing them with a lower level of security compared to senior debts but higher than junior subordinated debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjGQJGYoSe1qFvjvtP.label: Collision Auto Insurance Coverage Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjGQJGYoSe1qFvjvtP.definition: Collision auto insurance covers damage to the insured's own vehicle resulting from a collision with another vehicle or object, or from flipping over. It is generally an optional coverage but may be required if the vehicle is leased or financed. A deductible usually applies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjGhGTbPYSLXYuV7eG.label: Indiana Superior Court - Vanderburgh County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjGhGTbPYSLXYuV7eG.definition: A court located in Vanderburgh County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjHlhJCrfswuGxGyjL.label: Borderline Personality Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjHlhJCrfswuGxGyjL.definition: Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) is a mental health condition characterized by pervasive instability in moods, behavior, self-image, and functioning. Individuals with BPD often experience intense episodes of anger, depression, and anxiety that can last from a few hours to days, leading to impulsive actions and unstable relationships.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjHwNNG2ASVmasLFU4.label: Forums and Venues
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjHwNNG2ASVmasLFU4.definition: Forums and Venues refer to organizational or governmental entities where proceedings occur, either as disputes or as transactions. For disputes, the term "Forum" describes the jurisdiction or court type, while "Venue" refers to the actual location, such as the courthouse, jurisdiction, or judicial district. For equities and securities, this category also includes Stock Exchanges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjIeLyl8QWh6zXpbbq.label: Neonatology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjIeLyl8QWh6zXpbbq.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a healthcare provider in the field of neonatology, resulting in harm or injury to a newborn or infant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjOPBcXmtGPLSz0VLh.label: Kansas District Court - Anderson County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjOPBcXmtGPLSz0VLh.definition: A court located in Anderson County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBjPBNzYwjjG3VNncAA.label: Gastrointestinal Hemorrhaging
http://lmss.sali.org/RBjPBNzYwjjG3VNncAA.definition: Gastrointestinal hemorrhaging refers to bleeding that occurs within the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, which includes the esophagus, stomach, intestines, and rectum. http://lmss.sali.org/RBk0I3tBzqkU5LpQDqD.definition: The U.S. Board of Tax Appeals is a specialized court that hears and decides disputes related to tax matters, operating under the jurisdiction of the U.S. Tax Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBk6ifsoekQHMhcCs8I.definition: The concept of Guardianship of Juvenile refers to the legal arrangement where a court appoints a guardian to take care of a minor's personal and financial affairs when the parents are unable to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBk9A7h5xJGkrrWCTiR.label: Court Calendaring Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBk9A7h5xJGkrrWCTiR.definition: Court Calendaring Management refers to the process of scheduling and managing court hearings and events, including the allocation of resources and coordination of participants, within the context of Litigation Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBk9r2XfiuwTXEnfSsN.definition: Kawi is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkG2FLch3L26axZhdG.definition: A joint and several liability clause is a provision in a contract that holds multiple parties responsible for fulfilling the obligations of the contract, either individually or collectively.
