http://lmss.sali.org/RBkGoNCcVWV5Ax3WkuR.definition: Minnesota District Court - Carver County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Carver County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkH8fgONlywQUnUzzP.label: English
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkH8fgONlywQUnUzzP.definition: English (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as the language of a document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkIjxd2gCzL4CEXFFh.label: Compliance Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkIjxd2gCzL4CEXFFh.definition: Risk in the way that an entity might comply (or potentially fail to comply) with applicable laws and/or regulations. This risk can arise from an organization's failure to adhere to internal policies, industry standards, or legal and regulatory requirements. Causes can include inadequate controls, lack of training, or noncompliance with ethical or governance standards, potentially leading to legal penalties, reputational damage, or loss of stakeholder trust, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkPsCsYgH9n5WAXy73.label: Breach of Meeting Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkPsCsYgH9n5WAXy73.definition: The Breach of Meeting Covenant refers to the violation of an agreement between parties to meet and discuss a specific matter, which may result in the triggering of a breakup fee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkYL8CotvNoW2KRjOr.label: Settlement Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkYL8CotvNoW2KRjOr.definition: Settlement Practice refers to the legal process of negotiating and reaching an agreement between parties involved in a legal dispute, often involving a demand for compensation or other remedy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkggTEJBkqwMy6rHhm.label: Estimate of Recoverable Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkggTEJBkqwMy6rHhm.definition: Estimate by the client and/or provider as to the amount of potential recovery

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkiXeTu9Rj1Hq7ISd2.label: Bulimia Nervosa
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkiXeTu9Rj1Hq7ISd2.definition: Bulimia Nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by recurrent episodes of binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, excessive exercise, or misuse of laxatives to prevent weight gain. Individuals with this disorder often have a preoccupation with body image and weight, leading to a cycle of bingeing and purging.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBksYN2l6OHSIYC07JV.label: Transportation Company Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RBksYN2l6OHSIYC07JV.definition: Transportation Company Negligence refers to the failure of a common carrier to exercise reasonable care in the transportation of goods or passengers, resulting in harm or injury to those goods or passengers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkuFhzhFcv5vcQJU7N.label: Advance Directive
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkuFhzhFcv5vcQJU7N.definition: This is a broad term that refers to any document in which a person specifies what actions should be taken for their health if they are no longer able to make decisions for themselves because of illness or incapacity. An advance directive can include a variety of instructions about future medical care and can encompass several types of directives, including the living will and durable power of attorney for health care

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkxcatJUXScYOxUZeB.label: Durable Power of Attorney Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkxcatJUXScYOxUZeB.definition: A Durable Power of Attorney Document is a legal instrument that grants a designated person, called an agent or attorney-in-fact, the authority to act on behalf of the principal in financial and other matters. Unlike a standard power of attorney, its durability ensures the agent's authority persists even if the principal becomes incapacitated.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBkzNeCV70lWNDKaIVq.label: Religious Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBkzNeCV70lWNDKaIVq.definition: Religious Law is a system of law based on religious texts and traditions, governing the conduct of adherents of a particular faith or belief.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBl014893nVYWtogWXL.label: L140 Document/File Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBl014893nVYWtogWXL.definition: The concept of L140 Document/File Management refers to the organization, storage, and retrieval of legal documents and files within a case, as a part of the overall case assessment, development, and administration process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBl1hItEnqhZyZo15Zn.label: Moment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBl1hItEnqhZyZo15Zn.definition: In legal terms, a Moment (Point in Time) refers to a precise, specific point on the timeline, often critical in determining the applicability, initiation, or cessation of legal rights, duties, or conditions. It is essential in contexts such as the execution of contracts, occurrence of events triggering legal consequences, or the effective date of legislation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBl1z9lfIDqPQXDledj.label: Motion for Leave to File as Amicus
http://lmss.sali.org/RBl1z9lfIDqPQXDledj.definition: A Motion for Leave to File as Amicus is a legal document filed by a non-party to a case, seeking permission from the court to submit a brief or argument in support of one of the parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBl2WJxJ69U7TybdQRU.label: Insurer
http://lmss.sali.org/RBl2WJxJ69U7TybdQRU.definition: One that insures, usually an insurance underwriter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBl5vjVYHIzfoowBfnh.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Otsego County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Otsego County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlHKm2Sl9aQa1SWLfi.definition: Identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) of the particular document stored in the systems of stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlP4jPWT9e54PHs0Ui.definition: Cash Asset Delivery refers to the settlement of a contract through the payment or receipt of a net cash amount instead of the actual delivery of the underlying assets. This method is commonly used in financial instruments and derivatives to simplify the settlement process and avoid the logistics of transferring physical assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlQosOyBcErYXnhLTX.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in New Madrid County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in that county.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlR7p65ZrtBCd56dwn.definition: DEPRECATED in favor of Proceeding Inactive

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlW5OLfCbqfO3PmxrR.definition: Debt Collection Claims refer to legal actions initiated by creditors to recover unpaid debts from borrowers. These claims encompass various legal grounds and causes of action used to pursue debt recovery through the courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlWM6X0yqMrb4z4JQY.label: 6th Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBlWM6X0yqMrb4z4JQY.definition: A Sixth Amendment claim is a legal assertion made by a defendant in a criminal case, arguing that their constitutional right to a fair trial, as guaranteed by the Sixth Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated. Such a claim may involve issues related to the right to counsel, the right to a speedy and public trial, the right to an impartial jury, or the right to be informed of the nature and cause of the accusation, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlZnLWj2FLHJZQdtrC.definition: Bhojpuri is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a language of a document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBldCYBpx2OPC1CO9iq.definition: A claim made against a manufacturer or seller of trampolines for injuries or damages caused by a defect in the product.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlnzqTSXmsRkcby7ng.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Scotland County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Scotland County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlte7uIi8bstll1B8D.definition: A Stipulation to Assume is a legal agreement between parties where one party agrees to take on the responsibility or liability for a particular matter or issue.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlxIwUQGmtmFUqirqI.definition: The Maryland State Bar Association Ethics Opinions are official statements issued by the Maryland State Bar Association regarding the ethical responsibilities of lawyers in Maryland.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBlxR3yLFkLZpmROoty.definition: Georgia District Court - Jenkins County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Jenkins County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBm27RQzgm4biiRl9h8.definition: Florida County Court - Gulf County refers to the specific court located in Gulf County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBm3VMZFqLwhzWkXh7u.definition: A community service penalty is a type of criminal penalty that requires an offender to perform unpaid work for the benefit of the community, as a form of punishment for their offense.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBm4FfOtNNc2YXqnz3P.label: Fragile X Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RBm4FfOtNNc2YXqnz3P.definition: Fragile X Syndrome is a genetic disorder caused by a mutation on the FMR1 gene located on the X chromosome. This mutation leads to a lack of the fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP), which is crucial for normal brain development.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBm5cL8Z0SM7cZxYNoi.label: Emergency Medical Assistance Coverage
http://lmss.sali.org/RBm5cL8Z0SM7cZxYNoi.definition: This refers to immediate healthcare services provided in urgent or life-threatening situations. http://lmss.sali.org/RBm5eguGsMlYYukH3Ca.label: Chichewa; Chewa; Nyanja
http://lmss.sali.org/RBm5eguGsMlYYukH3Ca.definition: A Bantu language spoken in Malawi, Zambia, and Mozambique, among other countries, belonging to the Niger-Congo language family and falling under the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBm7ueL3vs7MhR1meXo.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Phelps County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Phelps County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmCWxUTSB7HPq6seME.label: Intuitu Personae Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmCWxUTSB7HPq6seME.definition: An Intuitu Personae Clause is a contractual clause that requires the performance of a specific obligation by a particular person, based on their personal characteristics or qualifications, rather than allowing for a substitute to perform the obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmELIUkctGFVB61kQP.label: Sale of Goods Breached by Seller
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmELIUkctGFVB61kQP.definition: The Sale of Goods Breached by Seller refers to a legal concept where the seller fails to fulfill their obligations under a contract for the sale of goods, resulting in a breach of contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmJkaAHU4XPVooLcqo.definition: An Assignment by Buyer Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the buyer to transfer their rights and obligations to a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmMSJ7mT0L8wv390ep.label: Engagement Scope
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmMSJ7mT0L8wv390ep.definition: Engagement Scope refers to the specific boundaries and limitations of a project or task that a party has agreed to undertake, as defined within the context of project management objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmT9C4BPeU200EDhnC.label: "Materiality" Based Antitrust Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmT9C4BPeU200EDhnC.definition: A "Materiality" Based Antitrust Standard is a legal concept that sets a threshold for determining whether certain conduct or information is significant enough to be considered in antitrust analysis, and only conduct or information that meets this threshold will be taken into account.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmVfFGPaLW8uopGsge.label: Confidentiality Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmVfFGPaLW8uopGsge.definition: A Confidentiality Agreement is a legal contract between parties that outlines the terms and conditions for keeping certain information confidential and not disclosing it to third parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmWpxwSfdFkvTqxJf9.label: Choctaw
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmWpxwSfdFkvTqxJf9.definition: A Native American language spoken primarily in the southeastern United States, particularly in Oklahoma and Mississippi, and belonging to the Muskogean language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmYw1KPDV1aPNdh6lA.label: Promise to Make a Will
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmYw1KPDV1aPNdh6lA.definition: A Promise to Make a Will is a legal concept within Trust and Estate Claims that refers to a commitment made by one party to another to create a will in the future.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmdYQ6TGSWCf4rvBEM.label: Indiana Superior Court - Cass County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmdYQ6TGSWCf4rvBEM.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Cass County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmdeshVFbo6mEH3zVV.label: Motor Vehicle Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmdeshVFbo6mEH3zVV.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing complete automobiles, light duty motor vehicles, and heavy duty trucks (i.e., body and chassis or unibody) or (2) manufacturing motor vehicle chassis only.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmedei8nsbLYt6jAvu.label: Extradition
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmedei8nsbLYt6jAvu.definition: The concept of Extradition refers to the legal process of transferring an individual who has been accused or convicted of a crime from one jurisdiction to another for the purpose of facing trial or punishment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmgP8yq5J96GOjxdfO.label: Florida County Court - Highlands County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmgP8yq5J96GOjxdfO.definition: A court located in Highlands County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmjE8Y2ZO03zKtLQ1g.label: Analysis of Critical Vendor Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmjE8Y2ZO03zKtLQ1g.definition: Analysis of Critical Vendor Status refers to the evaluation and assessment of vendors that are essential to the operation of a business, with a focus on identifying potential risks and developing strategies to mitigate them.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmm36Vx2SKLkgqnlMQ.label: Nephrology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmm36Vx2SKLkgqnlMQ.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional in the field of nephrology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmtrsv1jU95i5fxbFa.label: Armenian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmtrsv1jU95i5fxbFa.definition: Armenian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Armenian language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmv3YXJwMzZ2Yumyn8.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Blair County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmvJugSf1nDQYfWZmz.label: Militia Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBmvJugSf1nDQYfWZmz.definition: A Militia Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or action violates the authority granted to Congress by the Militia Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Militia Clause empowers Congress to regulate and organize the militia, and prohibits states or other entities from taking actions that infringe upon this federal authority or interfere with the proper functioning of the militia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBmzTf3D5NisDVPvlDU.definition: The suffix "V" stands for "Fifth" and is used after a person's full name to indicate that they are the fifth generation in their family to bear that name. This convention helps to distinguish individuals in formal, legal, or financial documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBn0Nk6SmTN5mhJZvxt.label: Confession of Judgment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBn0Nk6SmTN5mhJZvxt.definition: A Confession of Judgment Clause is a contractual provision that allows one party to confess to a judgment in favor of the other party without the need for a trial or hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBn1mzQybXv3GivDTfK.label: Offset Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBn1mzQybXv3GivDTfK.definition: An offset clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to purchase goods or services from the other party in order to balance out payments owed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBn8bH2kJC4aaMyOTYx.definition: The Director Compensation and Governance Policy outlines the rules and guidelines for how board members are compensated and how governance activities are conducted within an organization. http://lmss.sali.org/RBpPod3eNjfLujqcKrm.label: Value Added Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBpPod3eNjfLujqcKrm.definition: Value Added Tax (VAT) Payment encompasses all general consumption taxes charged on the value added to goods and services, irrespective of the method of deduction and the stages at which the taxes are levied. Typically, VAT allows for the immediate deduction of taxes on purchases by all entities except the final consumer and is imposed at all stages of production and distribution. In some countries, this category may include taxes on financial and insurance activities due to the difficulty in separating these receipts from general VAT collections or because they are considered integral to the VAT system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBpSutJH1FlqWIYeHLV.label: Postal Service Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBpSutJH1FlqWIYeHLV.definition:
The Postal Service subsector includes the activities of the National Post Office and its subcontractors operating under a universal service obligation to provide mail services, and using the infrastructure required to fulfill that obligation.  These services include delivering letters and small parcels.  These articles can be described as those that can be handled by one person without using special equipment.  This allows the collection, pick-up, and delivery operations to be done with limited labor costs and minimal equipment.  Sorting and transportation activities, where necessary, are generally mechanized.  The restriction to small parcels distinguishes these establishments from those in the transportation industries.  These establishments may also provide express delivery services using the infrastructure established for provision of basic mail services.

The traditional activity of the National Postal Service is described in this subsector.  Subcontractors include rural post offices on contract to the Postal Service.

Bulk transportation of mail on contract to the Postal Service is not included here, because it is usually done by transportation establishments that carry other customers' cargo as well.  Establishments that provide courier and express delivery services without operating under a universal service obligation are classified in Subsector 492, Couriers and Messengers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBpV7a4XyvWmCSvE8cM.definition: Industries in this group raise or fatten animals for the sale of animals or animal products and/or raise aquatic plants and animals in controlled or selected aquatic environments for the sale of aquatic plants, animals, or their products. The group includes establishments, such as ranches, farms, and feedlots primarily engaged in keeping, grazing, breeding, or feeding animals. http://lmss.sali.org/RBq1p3bwUpzZk9djzM7.definition: Coconuts are large, fibrous fruits from the Cocos nucifera palm, known for their versatile applications in food, cosmetics, and industrial products. http://lmss.sali.org/RBq37J194MpjXkKw99p.label: Employer-Sponsored Health Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RBq37J194MpjXkKw99p.definition: This is a health insurance plan selected and partially funded by an employer as part of the benefits package for employees. The employer usually pays a portion of the premium, and the employee's share is often deducted from their paycheck.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBq67HJOHkfI3KZNpYv.label: Georgia District Court - Clarke County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBq67HJOHkfI3KZNpYv.definition: Georgia District Court - Clarke County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal disputes and criminal cases within Clarke County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBq8PaTkkZyUosewjSN.label: Non-Person Declarant
http://lmss.sali.org/RBq8PaTkkZyUosewjSN.definition: A Non-Person Declarant refers to a source of information or statement that is not a human being, such as a machine, device, animal, or inanimate object. The output or "statement" produced by a non-person declarant is not considered hearsay because the hearsay rule only applies to statements made by a person.
examples: Radar device's number showing vehicle speed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqBxJEzhWW5x12JraZ.label: Oral Copulation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqBxJEzhWW5x12JraZ.definition: Oral copulation is a sexual act involving the stimulation of the genitals by the mouth, which is considered a sex offense under the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqPr9CLKLdANUwXn8o.label: Cannabis Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqPr9CLKLdANUwXn8o.definition: Cannabis Law refers to the legal rules and regulations governing the use, possession, sale, cultivation, and distribution of cannabis, both for medical and recreational purposes. These laws vary significantly between jurisdictions, ranging from total prohibition to decriminalization or full legalization, and they may involve aspects of criminal, business, and health law among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqQsDFUcax8DnbXl59.label: Northern Frisian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqQsDFUcax8DnbXl59.definition: A language spoken in the northern region of the Frisian Islands, primarily in Germany, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqTXginiTXVwXPwiLf.label: U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqTXginiTXVwXPwiLf.definition: The U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) is a specialized administrative body within the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) that oversees post-grant review proceedings, inter partes review proceedings, and covered business method review proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqTc8qtgLcRbqJBVLQ.label: Limited Lifetime Warranty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqTc8qtgLcRbqJBVLQ.definition: A Limited Lifetime Warranty Clause is a provision in a warranty agreement that limits the duration of coverage to the lifetime of the product, but with certain restrictions or conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqUJxHCbbdArMkF1DO.label: Trial Court Filing Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqUJxHCbbdArMkF1DO.definition: The Trial Court Filing Event refers to the act of submitting legal documents to initiate a lawsuit in a court of law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqXppb7PRAVkJEQjSe.label: Incorporation by Reference Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqXppb7PRAVkJEQjSe.definition: An Incorporation by Reference Clause is a provision in a contract that refers to another document or agreement, making its terms and conditions a part of the current contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqapTLjJVo7v5Usf0e.label: Business and Financial Crimes Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqapTLjJVo7v5Usf0e.definition: Law that addresses criminal conduct committed in a commercial or financial context, targeting individuals and organizations that engage in illegal activities for financial gain, including fraud, money laundering, embezzlement, bribery, insider trading, and tax evasion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqexsEcuhacBIvhNhX.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Lawrence Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqexsEcuhacBIvhNhX.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Lawrence Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lawrence County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqf2fwKJwDeUYNLL3U.label: Stay of Arbitration
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqf2fwKJwDeUYNLL3U.definition: A stay of arbitration is a provisional remedy that temporarily suspends the arbitration process until a certain condition is met or a court ruling is made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqieZofpX6g9xN2RuF.label: Guam Territory Courts
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqieZofpX6g9xN2RuF.definition: The Guam Territory Courts are a subset of the U.S. Territory Courts and include the Guam Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqllOhzLheS3cnSiDA.label: Food Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqllOhzLheS3cnSiDA.definition: A food liability claim is a civil claim related to harm caused by consuming contaminated or poisoned food products.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqmfBeISZZFH0gzZDe.label: Early Neutral Evaluation Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqmfBeISZZFH0gzZDe.definition: An Early Neutral Evaluation Forum is a type of Mediation Forum where a neutral third party evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of each party's case and provides a non-binding assessment to help the parties reach a settlement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqxthrq8TQqT5jS5qv.label: WC480 Alternative Fee Arrangements
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqxthrq8TQqT5jS5qv.definition: This code includes all non-hourly or other alternative fee arrangements for tasks and activities in this phase.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqyMMilyJsOelem8C8.label: Interference with Contractual Relationship
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqyMMilyJsOelem8C8.definition: Interference with Contractual Relationship is the intentional or negligent interference by a third party with a contractual relationship between two parties, resulting in damages to one or both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqz2xBMxkFDjWqhXmQ.label: Citation to Statutes
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqz2xBMxkFDjWqhXmQ.definition: A document's citations to statutes and other enacted laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBqzHpgV8FMC1X07S4c.label: Texas Court of Civil Appeals
http://lmss.sali.org/RBqzHpgV8FMC1X07S4c.definition: The Texas Court of Civil Appeals is a specific court within the Texas State Courts system that hears appeals in civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBr6bDd1I5S2sHmzWzk.label: International Organization Visa - Employees and Their Families
http://lmss.sali.org/RBr6bDd1I5S2sHmzWzk.definition: An International Organization Visa for employees and their families is a specialized visa category that allows staff members of international organizations, as well as their immediate family members, to reside in a host country for the duration of their assignment. This visa often comes with certain privileges and immunities to facilitate the employees' work and may allow family members to engage in limited employment or educational activities, depending on the host country's regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrB0kZKDyLmTxd4wBU.label: DEPRECATED: M&A Target Industry - Favoring two tags: (1) Acquiree and (2) Industry from Mergers and Acquisitions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrB0kZKDyLmTxd4wBU.definition: A M&A Target Industry is a specific sector or area of business that a party aims to acquire or merge with as part of their overall Mergers and Acquisitions objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrBYbsaP35Zqr9ZrYF.label: Chemical Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrBYbsaP35Zqr9ZrYF.definition: This industry group is based on the transformation of organic and inorganic raw materials by a chemical process and the formulation of products. It industry group includes establishments that make: chemicals, synthetic dyes, rubber, synthetic fibers, pesticides, fertilizers, paint, and cleaning materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrFgjDPDE2OQPetJGw.label: Hotel Liability for Personalty Loss
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrFgjDPDE2OQPetJGw.definition: Hotel Liability for Personalty Loss refers to the legal responsibility of a hotel to compensate for the loss or damage of personal property belonging to its guests.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrQ5TxsIktzAkyFafe.label: Reimbursement of Expenses Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrQ5TxsIktzAkyFafe.definition: A Reimbursement of Expenses Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any expenses incurred in the performance of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrSWvfPR3YZFl63qup.label: Neurological Collapse States
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrSWvfPR3YZFl63qup.definition: Neurological Collapse States refer to conditions characterized by severe impairment of brain function, leading to a significant reduction or absence of conscious awareness and neurological activity. These states can arise from various causes, including trauma, disease, or systemic failure, and are critical in determining legal and medical decisions regarding life support and end-of-life care.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrU2WDoG0tMMa6lSJn.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 8th
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrU2WDoG0tMMa6lSJn.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 8th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrUb9V2u6f7iVR1RBN.label: Civil Contract Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrUb9V2u6f7iVR1RBN.definition: Law that deals with agreements between private entities in countries operating under civil law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrVaoukv7lz2OM69u2.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Butler County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrVaoukv7lz2OM69u2.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Butler County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Butler County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrVarC8whnDQsjQLml.label: Land Banking
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrVarC8whnDQsjQLml.definition: Land Banking involves the strategic acquisition and holding of parcels of land by individuals, companies, or government entities with the intent of future sale or development. This practice aims to control the use and development of land, often leading to increased land value over time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrbUpWawQHlBkPTsHq.label: JM00 Costs Assessment (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrbUpWawQHlBkPTsHq.definition: Work related to the assessment or agreement of costs following trial or settlement of the underlying action

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrdxdOgjCI6JEcoON2.label: Iloko
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrdxdOgjCI6JEcoON2.definition: A language spoken in the Philippines, specifically in the Ilocos Region, characterized by its unique vocabulary and grammar.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrjry4X0Uiy3k5OKO9.label: Inquiry Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrjry4X0Uiy3k5OKO9.definition: Inquiry Practice refers to the legal and procedural framework governing the conduct of formal investigations into matters of public concern, often initiated by government bodies or legislative entities. These inquiries aim to uncover facts, make recommendations, and provide accountability, typically involving extensive fact-finding, evidence gathering, and public hearings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrkknwL9ihBF3j9Ogj.label: Kachin; Jingpho
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrkknwL9ihBF3j9Ogj.definition: A language spoken by the Kachin and Jingpho people, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrktFpYEb3bjRtxQuW.label: Successors and Assigns Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrktFpYEb3bjRtxQuW.definition: A Successors and Assigns Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the rights and obligations of the parties to be transferred to another person or entity in the event of a merger, acquisition, or other change in ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrrzMTvR8PsZjtQnyU.label: Georgia Superior Court - Screven County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrrzMTvR8PsZjtQnyU.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Screven County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Screven County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrs0FH5hpFyVnTb3mb.label: Political Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrs0FH5hpFyVnTb3mb.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with the political climate and operating context of an organization — such as the potential for negative consequences arising from political events, decisions, or changes in the regulatory environment that may affect an organization's operations, investments, or overall business climate. These risks can include policy shifts, government instability, geopolitical tensions, or trade restrictions, potentially leading to financial losses, operational disruptions, or reduced market opportunities

http://lmss.sali.org/RBrtp0YHl0BzYELcXRE.label: Lease Termination Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBrtp0YHl0BzYELcXRE.definition: A Lease Termination Agreement is a mutual agreement between the landlord and tenant to end the lease before its typical expiration date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBruJuhQHB6JHVTvEpk.label: Criminal Mayhem
http://lmss.sali.org/RBruJuhQHB6JHVTvEpk.definition: The intentional and unlawful act of causing injury to another person, resulting in serious bodily harm or disfigurement, with the intent to cause such harm.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBruQmY8NEKJ8135OUk.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Hickory County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBruQmY8NEKJ8135OUk.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Hickory County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Hickory County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBs00pxquaGFJOMMwLU.label: Burford Abstention
http://lmss.sali.org/RBs00pxquaGFJOMMwLU.definition: A legal doctrine known as Burford Abstention allows federal courts to decline jurisdiction over complex state regulatory schemes in order to avoid interfering with state administrative processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBs07T1DHY78EfBS2G3.label: Motion to Substitute Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/RBs07T1DHY78EfBS2G3.definition: A Motion to Substitute Counsel is a formal request made to a court by a party in a legal proceeding to replace their current attorney with a new one.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsAWTzoeiDxN6j8TYn.label: Binding Letter of Intent Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsAWTzoeiDxN6j8TYn.definition: A Binding Letter of Intent Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the parties' agreement to be bound by the terms of a letter of intent, which is a preliminary agreement that sets out the basic terms of a proposed transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsBXvBV1L5NIzFFrig.label: Entity Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsBXvBV1L5NIzFFrig.definition: Entity Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining legal entities, such as corporations or partnerships, within a business or organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsEIXP6aC5K5e5EdpQ.label: New York City Court - Olean
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsEIXP6aC5K5e5EdpQ.definition: A court located in Olean, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsFqa5TMQWMQHxVngr.label: Social Security Contribution
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsFqa5TMQWMQHxVngr.definition: A Social Security Contribution refers to the payment made by employees and employers to fund the social security system, which provides benefits for retirement, disability, and survivorship. These contributions are typically deducted from wages and matched by employers, ensuring financial support for eligible beneficiaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsVax4c8Bdvzok8MTZ.label: Business and Consumer Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsVax4c8Bdvzok8MTZ.definition: The Business Services industry group comprises establishments engaged in providing services not specifically provided for elsewhere in the classification system. Establishments in this sector are primarily engaged in activities such as equipment and machinery repairing, promoting or administering religious activities, grantmaking, advocacy, and providing drycleaning and laundry services, personal care services, death care services, pet care services, photofinishing services, temporary parking services, and dating services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsVewe5WXuB0ltZtb5.label: E102 Outside printing
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsVewe5WXuB0ltZtb5.definition: The concept of E102 Outside printing refers to the expenses incurred for printing services that are outsourced to a third-party vendor, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of E100 Expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsezVocJhSeAs8wS8l.label: Georgia Superior Court - Monroe County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsezVocJhSeAs8wS8l.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Monroe County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Monroe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsiX2FSnOKhxvLGKoU.label: Cross-Border Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsiX2FSnOKhxvLGKoU.definition: Cross-Border Practice, also known as comparative law practice and international practice,  involves lawyers providing legal services concerning legal matters that span the laws of two or more jurisdictions. This practice requires a deep understanding of the legal systems, regulations, and cultural considerations of the relevant jurisdictions.
examples: Advising On International Trade Agreements: Providing legal advice on compliance with trade agreements between countries.
Drafting And Reviewing International Contracts: Creating contracts that must comply with the legal requirements of multiple jurisdictions.
Facilitating Cross-Border Corporate Transactions: Assisting in mergers and acquisitions where the entities involved are located in different countries.
Handling Cross-Border Dispute Resolution: Representing clients in litigation or arbitration that involves parties from different jurisdictions.
Navigating Cross-Border Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring that clients adhere to the regulatory standards of all relevant jurisdictions in their operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBso92NcgN204DAOkEB.label: UTBMS MA00 Preliminary Matters
http://lmss.sali.org/RBso92NcgN204DAOkEB.definition: UTBMS MA00 Preliminary Matters refers to the initial legal matters that need to be addressed in a merger or acquisition, as classified under the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions code set.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsoAkNZjTUEHqmsNGd.label: Work for Hire Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsoAkNZjTUEHqmsNGd.definition: A Work for Hire Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that any work created by an individual in the course of their employment or under a contract belongs to the employer or the contracting party, rather than the individual who created it.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsoKzIgyNkEeQX7ln7.label: Gay
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsoKzIgyNkEeQX7ln7.definition: Gay refers to a sexual orientation in which an individual is attracted to members of the same sex. It is a term commonly used to describe men who are attracted to other men, but it can also be used more broadly to describe anyone attracted to individuals of the same sex.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsqO7iW9SmBHyROk4S.label: Royalty Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsqO7iW9SmBHyROk4S.definition: A Royalty Payment is a payment made to the owner of a patent, copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property for the right to use, produce, or sell the owner's creation. These payments are typically a percentage of the revenue generated from the use of the intellectual property or a fixed amount per unit sold.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsqRUFBCnbsERzdeQt.label: LLC Operating Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsqRUFBCnbsERzdeQt.definition: An LLC Operating Agreement is a document governing the internal operations of a Limited Liability Company (LLC). It outlines the financial and managerial rights and duties of its members.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsrdSKopgzK2vX0cBb.label: Workflow Automation Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsrdSKopgzK2vX0cBb.definition: Workflow Automation Management refers to the use of technology to streamline and optimize legal processes, specifically in the context of improving efficiency and reducing errors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsvhDZqoSPZPxWazGO.label: Indiana Superior Court - Newton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsvhDZqoSPZPxWazGO.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - Newton County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within Newton County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBsvpMvvLEArd0Rts82.label: Matter Tax on Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RBsvpMvvLEArd0Rts82.definition: A Matter Tax on Fees is a type of Tax Detail and Engagement Fee Detail that refers to a tax imposed on the fees charged for legal services provided in a specific matter or case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBswUxhDzdF1LeNDZ0N.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Marion County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBswUxhDzdF1LeNDZ0N.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Marion County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Marion County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt0SN4pvSLYS7btxE4.label: Economic Development Service
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt0SN4pvSLYS7btxE4.definition: Economic development refers to the efforts and policies aimed at improving the economic well-being and quality of life in a community, often involving job creation, business growth, and improvements in infrastructure. Laws and regulations in this area can encompass a wide range of topics, including zoning, public funding, tax incentives, environmental assessments, and employment standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt1Zb6XPgscZkJYkcc.label: Witness Statement Recording
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt1Zb6XPgscZkJYkcc.definition: A Witness Statement Recording is a type of transcript or recording that captures the spoken testimony of a witness in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt3Kyn3iW32LWSjKBg.label: Custodian
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt3Kyn3iW32LWSjKBg.definition: A person who is authorized to maintain legal custody of a person or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt449Gy4YQBuVqNLxE.label: Governmental Law Division
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt449Gy4YQBuVqNLxE.definition: A Governmental Law Division is a legal entity within a government, responsible for providing legal services to government agencies, officials, and the public. It ensures legal compliance, represents the government in legal matters, and offers legal advice on policy and administrative issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt6PLnwAaeJLOUww0s.label: Manslaughter
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt6PLnwAaeJLOUww0s.definition: The unlawful killing of a human being without malice aforethought, but with either intent to cause harm or reckless disregard for human life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt8W7zWavzkmABVprU.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Drew Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt8W7zWavzkmABVprU.definition: A court located in Drew County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBt9SkQTPZ4TuHLPr07.label: Recruiting Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RBt9SkQTPZ4TuHLPr07.definition: Recruiting Management refers to the process of attracting, selecting, and hiring qualified candidates for job positions within an organization. It falls under the broader category of People Management, which involves overseeing and developing the workforce of an organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtDk7Nj1CfI5hn0NUx.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Marshall County (10th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtE2hBOMPY3e6w556I.label: Certificate of Credit Counseling
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtE2hBOMPY3e6w556I.definition: A Certificate of Credit Counseling is a document that verifies an individual has completed a credit counseling course and is required for those filing for bankruptcy or restructuring.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtI1NMNyrTTDFr6Oj9.label: Parenting Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtI1NMNyrTTDFr6Oj9.definition: A Parenting Plan is a legal document that outlines the arrangements and responsibilities of parents or guardians regarding the care and upbringing of their child or children. It typically includes details about custody, visitation schedules, decision-making authority, and other matters related to the child's welfare. These plans are often established during divorce or separation proceedings or as part of co-parenting agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtPRWx3uk0VHvFqhjk.label: "Constructive Knowledge - Role-based" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtPRWx3uk0VHvFqhjk.definition: A Material Adverse Effect (MAE) is a legal term that refers to a negative change or event that has a significant impact on a party's ability to fulfill their obligations under a contract or agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtPtW4K2v5gMVDBHyO.label: Uncoded languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtPtW4K2v5gMVDBHyO.definition: Uncoded languages refer to languages that do not have a standardized system of writing or representation, making them difficult to translate or interpret in legal contexts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtSHHOKBn1ldvDy5NI.label: Minnesota District Court - Beltrami County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtSHHOKBn1ldvDy5NI.definition: The Minnesota District Court - Beltrami County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Beltrami County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtSpHXbtvwniblhrnz.label: Consumer Privacy Ombudsman
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtSpHXbtvwniblhrnz.definition: A person appointed to investigate individuals' privacy complaints against maladministration, especially that of public authorities.
sources: Scherff v. S. Tex. Coll. (S.D. Tex., 2017)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtWPPzVN1JuKRFeSgQ.label: Ducks
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtWPPzVN1JuKRFeSgQ.definition: Ducks are domesticated waterfowl belonging to the family Anatidae, commonly raised for their meat, eggs, and feathers. http://lmss.sali.org/RBtZFVleTznsPmr5BJa.label: Personal Jurisdiction by Consent
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtZFVleTznsPmr5BJa.definition: The concept of "Personal Jurisdiction by Consent" refers to a court's authority over a party in a legal matter based on that party's voluntary agreement or submission to the court's jurisdiction, rather than any traditional basis for jurisdiction such as physical presence or domicile.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtf1nxagk3C03uC0mi.label: Funeral Practices
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtf1nxagk3C03uC0mi.definition: Funeral Practices are the various rituals, ceremonies, and customs performed to honor and remember a deceased person. These practices vary greatly across different cultures, religions, and legal systems, often reflecting the beliefs and traditions of the community.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtg2nbhNR8X0uUI0xg.label: Indiana City Court - Delaware County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtg2nbhNR8X0uUI0xg.definition: Indiana City Court - Delaware County is a specific court located in Delaware County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtq46qYyMBWWalN0Li.label: A106 Communicate - with client
http://lmss.sali.org/RBtq46qYyMBWWalN0Li.definition: To "Communicate (with client)" means to exchange information or ideas with a person or entity for the purpose of providing legal services, as part of the broader category of "Activities".

http://lmss.sali.org/RBttCLW0UwFss2Gkam9.label: Internist Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBttCLW0UwFss2Gkam9.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by an internist, which result in harm or injury to a patient, and which form the basis of a medical malpractice claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBtwM7GiEX8JQMVsA3F.label: Redwood Valley or Little River Band of Pomo Indians of the Redwood Valley Rancheria California

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu3WEhpPdjyx7Ompuy.label: Natural Condition
http://lmss.sali.org/RBu3WEhpPdjyx7Ompuy.definition: A public entity is not responsible for harm resulting from natural conditions on unimproved public property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu4G0fGR03P9qzzvvp.label: Firm Of Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/RBu4G0fGR03P9qzzvvp.definition: A "Firm Of Counsel" is a type of lawyer who is affiliated with a law firm and provides legal advice and services to the firm's clients on a regular basis, but is not an employee or partner of the firm.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu597RTexOtgZtqxbW.label: Qualified Income Offset Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBu597RTexOtgZtqxbW.definition: A Qualified Income Offset Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the reduction of one party's income by the amount of benefits received by the other party, typically in the context of divorce or separation agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu6E4FIN36mCV5l7SJ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Champaign County (6th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu9BLHjvdwCpFHHB5P.label: Interference with Testamentary Expectancy
http://lmss.sali.org/RBu9BLHjvdwCpFHHB5P.definition: The concept of Interference with Testamentary Expectancy refers to a legal claim that arises when someone intentionally interferes with another person's expected inheritance or gift, causing harm or damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBu9E8BEAJceCEPHitt.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Lawrence Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/RBu9E8BEAJceCEPHitt.definition: A court located in Marion County, Lawrence Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuByI5hOLvoWf2QVnt.label: Texas District Court - Lamar County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuByI5hOLvoWf2QVnt.definition: A Texas District Court located in Lamar County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuClJDn4xw8zw9X8LM.label: Failure To Discharge a Mandatory Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuClJDn4xw8zw9X8LM.definition: The failure to fulfill a required obligation, which may result in legal liability, specifically within the context of government tort law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuGkiZ1cc2CwMFQqiu.label: Mutual Termination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuGkiZ1cc2CwMFQqiu.definition: A mutual termination clause is a provision in a contract that allows both parties to agree to end the contract before its natural expiration date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuGlAbE6sLj7sQNKsd.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Marion County (4th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuHmAe6jQq5gQSLIXZ.label: Citation to Legislation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuHmAe6jQq5gQSLIXZ.definition: A document's citations to bills and other legislation (e.g., bills before a legislature, bills before congress).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuPVAcB52MFzxOD0Ov.label: Bankruptcy Exemptions
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuPVAcB52MFzxOD0Ov.definition: Bankruptcy Exemptions are legal protections that allow individuals filing for bankruptcy to keep certain assets, such as a primary residence or personal property, from being seized by creditors to satisfy outstanding debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuTEIGtnRtDRIUgtUf.label: Payable-on-Death Account
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuTEIGtnRtDRIUgtUf.definition: A Payable-on-Death (POD) Account is a financial account, such as a bank account or a certificate of deposit, that allows the account holder to designate a specific beneficiary who will receive the funds in the account upon the account holder's death. This designation operates outside of the probate process, making it a straightforward way to transfer assets to a chosen beneficiary without the need for a will or going through the probate court.
sources: From LIST: Legal Issues Taxonomy — https://taxonomy.legal/

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuTLSda3k0mZNe5Lak.label: Motion to Relate
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuTLSda3k0mZNe5Lak.definition: In certain court jurisdictions (e.g., N.D. Cal.), where a newly filed case relates to a previously filed case, a party may a motion to consider whether the case should be related. Example: N.D. Cal. Local Rule 3-12. https://www.docketalarm.com/cases/California_Northern_District_Court/5--20-cv-08570/Klein_et_al_v._Facebook_Inc/68/#q=%22motion+to+relate%22

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuYThXwp8tJjNWkTeu.label: Parking Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuYThXwp8tJjNWkTeu.definition: A parking violation is a type of traffic violation claim that involves the improper or illegal parking of a vehicle, often resulting in a fine or penalty.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBug6da9NMQ6RZtjP0R.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Blair County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBug6da9NMQ6RZtjP0R.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Blair County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Blair County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBukB9MGGdY4Kwx3b6i.label: Limitation of Liability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBukB9MGGdY4Kwx3b6i.definition: A Limitation of Liability Clause is a provision in a contract that limits the amount of damages that one party can be held liable for in the event of a breach or other legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBupMNrVFsvvEqeTXga.label: Ohio Municipal Court - Montgomery County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBupMNrVFsvvEqeTXga.definition: Ohio Municipal Court - Montgomery County: A specific municipal court located in Montgomery County, Ohio, with jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBusXAFmusc8rmd1TIo.label: Individual Education Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RBusXAFmusc8rmd1TIo.definition: An Individual Education Plan (IEP) is a legally-binding document developed for public school students who qualify for special education services. It outlines specific learning objectives, accommodations, and services tailored to meet the unique educational needs of the student.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBuzLLhB1RPtbyiMhR2.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Wasco County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBuzLLhB1RPtbyiMhR2.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Wasco County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Wasco County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBv025DyVvHsv6oLYLW.label: Pain Management Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RBv025DyVvHsv6oLYLW.definition: Negligent or improper treatment of pain by a medical professional, resulting in harm or injury to the patient, which may lead to a legal claim for medical malpractice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBv4XsEwEtXuQ1OHVJc.label: Medical - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RBv4XsEwEtXuQ1OHVJc.definition: Real estate property buildings, offices, and campuses leased to members or organizations within the healthcare community.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBv7LOFaVU167SpNTDA.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Owen County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBv7LOFaVU167SpNTDA.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Owen County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Owen County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBv8Zrd9V7Mu8TIPAv4.label: Improper Lane Change Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBv8Zrd9V7Mu8TIPAv4.definition: An Improper Lane Change Claim involves an allegation that a driver has changed lanes in a manner that violates traffic regulations, potentially endangering other road users. This claim can lead to civil penalties or administrative actions and often requires detailed examination of the circumstances and evidence surrounding the incident.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBv8tsFMEhNa4pjfOEP.label: Obligation of Contracts Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBv8tsFMEhNa4pjfOEP.definition: An Obligation of Contracts Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Obligation of Contracts Clause of the United States Constitution by impairing the obligations of existing contracts, without a legitimate public purpose, thereby infringing on the sanctity and enforceability of contractual rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvDpLOc2SljLyBGh9l.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Barton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvDpLOc2SljLyBGh9l.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Barton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Barton County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvQXP0KnTbPvw7ptRx.label: Case Management Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvQXP0KnTbPvw7ptRx.definition: A Case Management Hearing, also known as a Status Conference, is a type of Hearing that is focused on managing the progress of a legal case and ensuring that it is moving forward in an efficient and effective manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvUHaXLDCiXZLpgSYj.label: Motion for Joinder
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvUHaXLDCiXZLpgSYj.definition: A Motion for Joinder is a legal request made in trial courts or bankruptcy proceedings to combine two or more cases or parties into a single action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvXYVuffq7XXEmGpCJ.label: Truck Transportation Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvXYVuffq7XXEmGpCJ.definition: Industries in this group provide over-the-road transportation of cargo using motor vehicles, such as trucks and tractor-trailers. This group includes general freight trucking and specialized freight trucking.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvXrgFYSglMKygVTVf.label: Prevailing Market Rate Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvXrgFYSglMKygVTVf.definition: A Prevailing Market Rate Clause is a provision in a contract that sets the price or rate for goods or services based on the current market conditions at the time of performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBva4JPrQQFKxm9TJ18.label: Disability Healthcare Coverage
http://lmss.sali.org/RBva4JPrQQFKxm9TJ18.definition: This type of healthcare coverage is geared towards individuals who have a disability that significantly impairs their ability to function normally. Coverage often includes specialized medical services, treatments, and assistive devices. In the U.S., people with certain disabilities are eligible for Medicare or Medicaid.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvcGQitj3LfJ0UBIbd.label: Entered a Location
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvcGQitj3LfJ0UBIbd.definition: "Entered a Location" refers to the act of a person or object crossing a geographic boundary to reside, conduct business, or exist within a jurisdiction. Examples include a person becoming a permanent resident of a state for tax purposes, an immigrant arriving in a destination country, or a product being imported into a country for trade purposes. These events often come with legal and regulatory implications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvfJW4HbL3Y7Guu9EN.label: Legal Separation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvfJW4HbL3Y7Guu9EN.definition: Legal Separation: A legal process that allows a married couple to live apart while remaining legally married, often involving court orders regarding property division, child custody, and support.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvh4DAeyZX28uepVm0.label: Legal Work Location - Country
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvh4DAeyZX28uepVm0.definition: Country where the legal services work is being performed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvhPeoPwTNYsc19VBp.label: Government Immunity
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvhPeoPwTNYsc19VBp.definition: Government Immunity is a legal concept that shields government officials and entities from being held liable for certain actions or omissions in the course of their official duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvkyGNXJdg8pV3aykC.label: Wealth Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvkyGNXJdg8pV3aykC.definition: Taxes levied regularly (in most cases annually) on net wealth, i.e. taxes on a wide range of movable and immovable property, net of debt. It is sub-divided into taxes paid by individuals, and taxes paid by corporate enterprises, according to the criteria set out in §31(a) above. If separate figures exist for receipts paid by institutions, the tax payments involved are added to those paid by corporations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvpEzZpYd3kw7DyUZ9.label: Gross Revenue
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvpEzZpYd3kw7DyUZ9.definition: The aggregate income generated from all forms of engagement before any costs, taxes, or deductions, offering a preliminary look at financial performance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvs4zROaonjMftsSlq.label: Constitutional Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvs4zROaonjMftsSlq.definition: Constitutional Claims refer to legal actions brought by individuals or groups asserting that their constitutional rights have been violated by the government or other entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvtCSVEohZRlEtuIRX.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Franklin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvtCSVEohZRlEtuIRX.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Franklin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvtywUiDKBUTbufifI.label: Deposition Posture
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvtywUiDKBUTbufifI.definition: Deposition Posture refers to the specific role or position taken by a party during a deposition, such as observing, defending, or taking the deposition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBvzzJGpcyW6OBUB9dH.label: Bashkir
http://lmss.sali.org/RBvzzJGpcyW6OBUB9dH.definition: Bashkir (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4QGqu7KaYX7Z4KyF.label: Sango
http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4QGqu7KaYX7Z4KyF.definition: Sango is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4nW47AeaVOJH6ZYL.label: Conspirator
http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4nW47AeaVOJH6ZYL.definition: A Conspirator is an individual who participates in an agreement with one or more persons to commit an illegal act. The person actively engages in planning or executing the crime with others. Often, a Conspirator is not a Defendant (e.g., unindicted coconspirator).

http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4tJDz3nCHbRJ7eDV.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Linn County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBw4tJDz3nCHbRJ7eDV.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Linn County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Linn County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwASyimDk8ym29hrCN.label: Georgia Superior Court - Fulton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwASyimDk8ym29hrCN.definition: A court located in Fulton County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwCBEkk4rjHhUROUmp.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Ogle County (15th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwJHfGDENhqEC2cSrA.label: Probate due to Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwJHfGDENhqEC2cSrA.definition: Probate due to Abuse: The legal process of administering the estate of a deceased person when the reason for filing is related to abuse.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwJPJAvmqt3I7jlS6D.label: Minnesota District Court - Murray County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwJPJAvmqt3I7jlS6D.definition: Minnesota District Court - Murray County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Murray County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKgWqOf6CrTgM4xYO.label: Georgia Superior Court - Greene County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKgWqOf6CrTgM4xYO.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Greene County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Greene County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKqPTnDjdV6pSxQ2N.label: Privilege Log
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKqPTnDjdV6pSxQ2N.definition: A privilege log is a document that lists the documents or information that a party claims are privileged and therefore protected from disclosure during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKwSFW3uE61bNkjKn.label: Superseding Intervening Cause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwKwSFW3uE61bNkjKn.definition: An intervening cause that breaks the chain of causation and relieves the defendant of liability, but only if it is unforeseeable and supersedes the defendant's original act or omission.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwMhlMYnN7SRBNxJwA.label: oasis:collection
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwMhlMYnN7SRBNxJwA.definition: A collection of metadata related to actors in the OASIS standard, including roles, agents, and figures.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwNJhZd68pWJO0BUwQ.label: Visa for Staff of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwNJhZd68pWJO0BUwQ.definition: The Visa for Staff of Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement (in the U.S, the O-2 Visa) is designed for individuals who will accompany and assist a visa holder in their field of extraordinary ability or achievement. In the United States, the O-2 visa is typically granted based on the demonstration that the accompanying individual has skills and experience that are essential to the O-1 visa holder's activity or performance. The duration of the O-2 visa is generally tied to that of the principal O-1 visa holder

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwUL1KJIJngnQ17RlN.label: Guide
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwUL1KJIJngnQ17RlN.definition: Document describing how to do a particular legal process, often containing links to other documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwVZgUU1nbWTCfkaoa.label: Asset-Backed Commercial Paper
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwVZgUU1nbWTCfkaoa.definition: ABCP is a type of short-term debt instrument that is backed by a pool of financial assets, such as trade receivables, auto loans, credit card debt, residential mortgages, or other asset-backed securities (ABS). The maturity of ABCP typically ranges from 1 to 270 days, with an average of around 30 days.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwZjjQmoJgjgi1yx1Y.label: Unpaid Wages Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwZjjQmoJgjgi1yx1Y.definition: An unpaid wages claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not paying the employee their earned wages. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to pay employees for all hours worked and to pay at least the minimum wage rate. The claim can include allegations of employers failing to pay the employee their regular pay, overtime pay, earned commissions, or other forms of compensation. Employees may also bring unpaid wages claims for non-payment of bonuses or other benefits owed to them.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwcQUr7RyVgoK5QL9j.label: No Delegation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwcQUr7RyVgoK5QL9j.definition: A "No Delegation Clause" is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from transferring their obligations or responsibilities to another party without the consent of the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBweKrw4uyPC8etlC1X.label: Assumption of Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RBweKrw4uyPC8etlC1X.definition: Assumption of Risk is a legal defense that asserts that the plaintiff voluntarily and knowingly assumed the risks associated with a particular activity or situation, and therefore cannot hold the defendant liable for any resulting harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBweqaHNxwkEbdKlg1W.label: Chibcha
http://lmss.sali.org/RBweqaHNxwkEbdKlg1W.definition: Chibcha (Language) is a structured system of communication used by the Chibcha people, characterized by its own grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwgCSrndWQriCjEO63.label: Engagement Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwgCSrndWQriCjEO63.definition: An agreement, often in the form of a letter, where a legal service provider (e.g., firm, lawyer) and client set forth the terms of a legal engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwtmiPdGwSiWn7y7cu.label: Notice of Proposed Use, Sale, or Lease of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwtmiPdGwSiWn7y7cu.definition: A Notice of Proposed Use, Sale, or Lease of Property is a written communication that informs interested parties of the intention to use, sell, or lease a particular property, and is typically required by law to be provided in advance of any such action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBwwTwUrZR2dFpL1mfZ.label: Terminated Employment Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RBwwTwUrZR2dFpL1mfZ.definition: Terminated Employment Status indicates that an employee's relationship with an organization has formally ended, either due to resignation, layoffs, or dismissal. In this status, the employee is no longer on the payroll and usually loses eligibility for company-provided benefits, with the termination often documented for record-keeping and compliance purposes

http://lmss.sali.org/RBx2qkjiSH2sAIzeihU.label: By Document / Artifact
http://lmss.sali.org/RBx2qkjiSH2sAIzeihU.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee per document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBx6La3kXJAk7zEAA69.label: Right of Inspection
http://lmss.sali.org/RBx6La3kXJAk7zEAA69.definition: The Right of Inspection is the legal entitlement of a shareholder or member of a corporation or partnership to examine and review the company's books, records, and other relevant documents to ensure transparency and accountability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBx7ocbIu8JTeBLppS1.label: City Councilperson
http://lmss.sali.org/RBx7ocbIu8JTeBLppS1.definition: A City Councilperson is an elected official who serves as a member of a city's legislative body, typically known as the city council. This individual is responsible for proposing, debating, and voting on local ordinances, policies, and budgets that govern the municipality and affect its residents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxF2Q4McIQEOKyoWEj.label: Ex Parte Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxF2Q4McIQEOKyoWEj.definition: Ex Parte Communication refers to a communication between one party and a decision-maker without the presence or knowledge of the other party involved in the matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxGUw3MJVJVdwE6vZ7.label: International Data Transfer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxGUw3MJVJVdwE6vZ7.definition: An International Data Transfer Clause is a provision in a contract that governs the transfer of personal data across international borders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxKeVhpTgz7EH0VaUk.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Tillamook County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxKeVhpTgz7EH0VaUk.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Tillamook County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Tillamook County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxR7hcvIRuO4hydhUq.label: Bank Misconduct When Relying on Power of Attorney
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxR7hcvIRuO4hydhUq.definition: Bank Misconduct When Relying on Power of Attorney: The wrongful or illegal actions taken by a bank when it relies on a power of attorney granted by a customer to conduct transactions on their behalf, often resulting in harm or loss to the customer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxVnU1ZxAPUQRCekjo.label: North Carolina Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxVnU1ZxAPUQRCekjo.definition: The North Carolina Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of North Carolina, with the authority to hear appeals from lower state courts and to interpret and apply the state's laws and constitution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxetsKuwVLTQzShK6x.label: Probate Reason of Neglect/Abandonment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxetsKuwVLTQzShK6x.definition: Probate Reason of Neglect/Abandonment refers to a legal ground for filing a probate case where the decedent's property was neglected or abandoned by the heirs or beneficiaries, leading to the need for court intervention to distribute the assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxgbh59bC7QKQ5Bq8N.label: Sustainable Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxgbh59bC7QKQ5Bq8N.definition: The sustainable and eco-friendly segment refers to a portion of the market that is characterized by consumers who prioritize environmental sustainability and ethical practices in their purchasing decisions. This segment includes products and services that are designed with a focus on reducing environmental impact, using renewable resources, and promoting social responsibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxjRC2M7rs4alrx3XX.label: Indiana Superior Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxjRC2M7rs4alrx3XX.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Washington County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxjnpn5QHodww4lTfX.label: Indigenous and Tribal Religious Laws
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxjnpn5QHodww4lTfX.definition: Indigenous and Tribal Religious Laws are the traditional rules, customs, and practices developed and followed by indigenous and tribal communities, often based on spiritual beliefs and ancestral teachings, that govern various aspects of their communal and personal lives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxogC0vDtYDDR540By.label: Client Practice Group
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxogC0vDtYDDR540By.definition: The primary group within the law department that is performing or overseeing the legal work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxpcLUyjt7mqe6yPaL.label: Rights Agreement Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxpcLUyjt7mqe6yPaL.definition: A Rights Agreement Representation is a statement made by a party in a legal matter regarding their ownership or control of certain rights, and the assurance that they have the authority to enter into an agreement related to those rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RBxqZs1JzyYftyuWzx1.label: Bystander Emotional Distress
http://lmss.sali.org/RBxqZs1JzyYftyuWzx1.definition: The concept of Bystander Emotional Distress refers to the legal claim that a person who witnesses the harm caused to another person can also suffer emotional distress and can seek compensation for it, under the Infliction of Emotional Distress claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RC162PeqaXFH2TskW9B.label: Textile Mills Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RC162PeqaXFH2TskW9B.definition:
Industries in the Textile Mills subsector group establishments that transform a basic fiber (natural or synthetic) into a product, such as yarn or fabric that is further manufactured into usable items, such as apparel, sheets, towels, and textile bags for individual or industrial consumption.  The further manufacturing may be performed in the same establishment and classified in this subsector, or it may be performed at a separate establishment and be classified elsewhere in the Manufacturing sector.

The main processes in this subsector include preparation and spinning of fiber, knitting or weaving of fabric, and the finishing of the textile.  The NAICS structure follows and captures this process flow.  Major industries in this flow, such as preparation of fibers, weaving of fabric, knitting of fabric, and fiber and fabric finishing, are uniquely identified.  Texturizing, throwing, twisting, and winding of yarn contain aspects of both fiber preparation and fiber finishing and are classified with preparation of fibers rather than with finishing of fibers.

NAICS separates the manufacturing of primary textiles and the manufacturing of textile products (except apparel) produced from purchased primary textiles, such as fabric.  The manufacturing of textile products (except apparel) from purchased fabric is classified in Subsector 314, Textile Product Mills, and apparel from purchased fabric is classified in Subsector 315, Apparel Manufacturing.

Excluded from this subsector are establishments that weave or knit fabric and make garments.  These establishments are included in Subsector 315, Apparel Manufacturing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RC1Ba5YP8y1uxOkQF7L.label: Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries
http://lmss.sali.org/RC1Ba5YP8y1uxOkQF7L.definition:
Industries in the Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries subsector group establishments that produce or organize and promote live presentations involving the performances of actors and actresses, singers, dancers, musical groups and artists, athletes, and other entertainers, including independent (i.e., freelance) entertainers and the establishments that manage their careers.  The classification recognizes four basic processes: (1) producing (i.e., presenting) events; (2) organizing, managing, and/or promoting events; (3) managing and representing entertainers; and (4) providing the artistic, creative, and technical skills necessary to the production of these live events.  Also, this subsector contains four industries for performing arts companies.  Each is defined on the basis of the particular skills of the entertainers involved in the presentations.

The industry structure for this subsector makes a clear distinction between performing arts companies and performing artists (i.e., independent or freelance).  Although not unique to arts and entertainment, freelancing is a particularly important phenomenon in this Performing Arts, Spectator Sports, and Related Industries subsector.  Distinguishing this activity from the production activity is a meaningful process differentiation.  This approach, however, is difficult to implement in the case of musical groups (i.e., companies) and artists.  These establishments tend to be more loosely organized and it can be difficult to distinguish companies from freelancers.  For this reason, NAICS includes one industry that covers both musical groups and musical artists.

This subsector contains two industries for Industry Group 7113, Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events, one for those that operate facilities and another for those that do not.  This is because there are significant differences in cost structures between those promoters that manage and provide the staff to operate facilities and those that do not.  In addition to promoters without facilities, other industries in this subsector include establishments that may operate without permanent facilities.  These types of establishments include performing arts companies; musical groups and artists; spectator sports; and independent (i.e., freelance) artists, writers, and performers.

Excluded from this subsector are nightclubs.  Some nightclubs promote live entertainment on a regular basis and it can be argued that they could be classified in Industry Group 7113, Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events.  However, since most of these establishments function as any other drinking place when they do not promote entertainment and because most of their revenue is derived from sale of food and beverages, they are classified in Subsector 722, Food Services and Drinking Places.

The registration process involves providing basic information about the employer and the intended H-1B beneficiary (employee). The registration system aims to streamline the H-1B application process and make it more efficient for both employers and USCIS
