http://lmss.sali.org/RCStCy1kvRpYfhq2blC.definition: Washington Superior Court - Ferry County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Ferry County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCStGtm69GBom9l4xlC.label: Committee Charter
http://lmss.sali.org/RCStGtm69GBom9l4xlC.definition: A Committee Charter is a formal document that outlines the purpose, authority, and responsibilities of a committee within an organization. It serves as a guiding framework for the committee's operations, defining its objectives, scope of work, membership, decision-making process, and reporting requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCStQecSbrQ9eSy3bg4.label: Superseded Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCStQecSbrQ9eSy3bg4.definition: The previously effective law has been superseded by some authority (e.g., statute).

http://lmss.sali.org/RCSul6dCtZERIZrQhOB.label: Minnesota District Court - Traverse County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCSul6dCtZERIZrQhOB.definition: Minnesota District Court - Traverse County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Traverse County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCSvrR5MnsIsSjPdVYJ.label: Email Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCSvrR5MnsIsSjPdVYJ.definition: Email Management refers to the process of organizing, storing, and retrieving electronic messages in a business or legal setting.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCSx31xBISrYHFCYIgu.label: Asset Delivery Attribute
http://lmss.sali.org/RCSx31xBISrYHFCYIgu.definition: The Asset Delivery Attribute indicates whether the settlement of an option, when exercised, is made in cash or involves the physical delivery of the underlying instruments. This attribute defines the method by which the option holder receives value upon exercising the option.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCSzzOZbxaoMSQ3BfwJ.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Fountain County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCSzzOZbxaoMSQ3BfwJ.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Fountain County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Fountain County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCT6lR1LjkRk9c9jMlj.label: Transfer of Ownership Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCT6lR1LjkRk9c9jMlj.definition: A Transfer of Ownership Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which ownership of a particular asset or property is transferred from one party to another.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCT9Ji3xwVRmaAm7oP7.label: International Organization Visa - Diplomats
http://lmss.sali.org/RCT9Ji3xwVRmaAm7oP7.definition: An International Organization Visa for diplomats refers to a specialized visa category that allows foreign diplomats representing their countries at international organizations to enter and reside in a host country for the duration of their diplomatic assignment. This visa comes with specific diplomatic privileges and immunities in accordance with international law to facilitate their diplomatic duties and interactions within the international organization's context.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTDgda7nF6Jjm41aGQ.label: Mutual Limitation of Liability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTDgda7nF6Jjm41aGQ.definition: A mutual limitation of liability clause is a provision in a contract where both parties agree to limit their liability to a certain amount or exclude certain types of damages in case of breach or other legal claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTK7TqCR4kDGaX2z7V.label: Motion to Expunge
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTK7TqCR4kDGaX2z7V.definition: A Motion to Expunge is a legal request made in trial courts or bankruptcy proceedings to remove or erase a record or document from the court's official records.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTMP0o99zMc6vuBbTI.label: Flat Buyer Consent Requirement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTMP0o99zMc6vuBbTI.definition: A Flat Buyer Consent Requirement is a legal concept that refers to the specific requirement for a buyer's consent in a transaction, without any additional conditions or qualifications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTOKjYuZWSDY4D5arH.label: Debt Security Offering Method
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTOKjYuZWSDY4D5arH.definition: Debt Security Offering Method refers to the various strategies and processes employed by issuers to sell debt securities to investors. These methods can vary based on the type of investors targeted, regulatory requirements, and the desired speed and confidentiality of the issuance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTQTwPeKNEuojbGUyd.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending ITC Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTQTwPeKNEuojbGUyd.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending ITC Investigation is a legal request to pause a court case while an investigation is conducted by the International Trade Commission.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTQmXmV8s83AYswBJr.label: Arbitrary and Capricious
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTQmXmV8s83AYswBJr.definition: A legal standard of review used by appellate courts to determine whether an agency's decision was made without any rational basis or in an unpredictable manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTVO33fpYYluy40LKb.label: Unsolicited Information Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTVO33fpYYluy40LKb.definition: An Unsolicited Information Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the conditions under which unsolicited information provided by one party to the other will be treated as confidential and not used for any purpose other than the intended purpose.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTYuUGjXvFGHrhl6Pw.label: Zuni Tribe of the Zuni Reservation

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTZcVDmicdOgwzJEom.label: Reservation of Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTZcVDmicdOgwzJEom.definition: A Reservation of Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to retain certain rights or defenses even after entering into the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCThJJxvpYzIQdmsefC.label: Articulation Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RCThJJxvpYzIQdmsefC.definition: An Articulation Disorder is a speech disorder characterized by difficulties in correctly producing speech sounds, leading to mispronunciations that can affect intelligibility. This condition can result from various factors, including developmental delays, structural anomalies, neurological impairments, or hearing loss.
examples: Phonetic articulation disorder, where a child consistently substitutes one sound for another, such as saying "wabbit" instead of "rabbit," due to difficulty in producing the correct sound.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTi5ncHpG7fN8DcDwg.label: New Jersey Special Statutory Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTi5ncHpG7fN8DcDwg.definition: A New Jersey Special Statutory Court is a specialized court within the New Jersey State Courts system that is created by statute to handle specific types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTiU3W5CpVCeWnO9En.label: Fee Increase or Decrease
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTiU3W5CpVCeWnO9En.definition: A Fee Increase or Decrease is a type of discount or credit that modifies the original cost of legal services provided, resulting in either an increase or decrease in the overall fee charged.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTkrwRVc8D4iivSoK0.label: Unilateral Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTkrwRVc8D4iivSoK0.definition: A unilateral waiver is the voluntary relinquishment of a legal right or claim by one party, without requiring the consent or agreement of another party. It is often used in contexts where the waiving party has sole control over the right being forfeited.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTmoU2BbiIxrDeGj7q.label: Georgia Superior Court - Walton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTmoU2BbiIxrDeGj7q.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Walton County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Walton County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTnebwmInNgHYwFLgA.label: Employment Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTnebwmInNgHYwFLgA.definition: An "Employment Record" is a structured historical record that documents an individual's employment-related information, including details about their work history, positions held, employers, dates of employment, and relevant achievements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTshAosx8ku4YGMpA0.label: Current Policy Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTshAosx8ku4YGMpA0.definition: A current policy clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to comply with the most up-to-date policies and regulations related to the subject matter of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTyWuwAAdk4X3BrHs0.label: Akkadian
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTyWuwAAdk4X3BrHs0.definition: Akkadian is an ancient language used in Mesopotamia, characterized by its cuneiform script and grammar, and is considered a predecessor to modern-day Semitic languages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTynzAwJhrTUyUakE3.label: Consideration - Real Estate Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTynzAwJhrTUyUakE3.definition: Consideration of real estate assets refer to the land, buildings, and other property-related resources that are transferred from the one party to another as part of the deal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCTzTfQ8g3oId4ykzTy.label: Fetal Alcohol Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RCTzTfQ8g3oId4ykzTy.definition: Fetal Alcohol Syndrome (FAS) is a severe form of Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders (FASD) resulting from prenatal alcohol exposure. It is characterized by growth deficiencies, distinctive facial anomalies, and central nervous system dysfunction, leading to intellectual disabilities, behavioral problems, and learning difficulties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0BYJMl0DPrYYohwA.label: Perpetual Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0BYJMl0DPrYYohwA.definition: A Perpetual Asset is a financial instrument that does not have a fixed maturity date, allowing it to exist indefinitely without a predetermined end. This attribute is common in certain types of equity and debt instruments, providing ongoing returns or obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0diyqr2PcjtNSiEv.label: Smart Contracts Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0diyqr2PcjtNSiEv.definition: Smart Contracts Management refers to the process of overseeing and administering the creation, execution, and enforcement of digital contracts that are self-executing and self-enforcing, utilizing blockchain technology and computer code to automate the performance of contractual obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0vhYMGrdY9EsjmN2.label: Data Leakage
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU0vhYMGrdY9EsjmN2.definition: In the context of AI, data leakage refers to the introduction of information into the training data that the system is expected to infer but should not legitimately have access to during model training. This results in a model that appears to perform well during evaluation on the test set but demonstrates poor performance during deployment when evaluated on new data sets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU1FrfEgIGJ9hxZXDb.label: Gbaya
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU1FrfEgIGJ9hxZXDb.definition: Gbaya is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU2QNIenbG6BiZ0IcY.label: Motion to Allow Payment Arrearages
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU2QNIenbG6BiZ0IcY.definition: A Motion to Allow Payment Arrearages is a request made in a bankruptcy case to permit the debtor to pay off missed payments over time, rather than in a lump sum.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU6ReSCEN31kllOAIa.label: Overtime Pay
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU6ReSCEN31kllOAIa.definition: Overtime pay refers to the additional compensation provided to employees who work hours in excess of what is considered standard or regular for a given period, typically a workweek. The rate for overtime pay is often higher than the employee's regular hourly wage, commonly set at one and a half times the standard rate or more, depending on labor laws and employment contracts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU6cL02zgQvulp4Vx8.label: Preparer
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU6cL02zgQvulp4Vx8.definition: A Preparer is an individual or entity responsible for completing and submitting documentation on behalf of someone else, typically for a specific legal or financial process. Examples include immigration preparers, who assist with immigration paperwork, and bankruptcy preparers, who help file bankruptcy documents, although their roles may be limited by law in providing legal advice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCU7t1b9rWuUjGuFf81.label: Insurance Broker Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCU7t1b9rWuUjGuFf81.definition: Insurance Broker Malpractice refers to a type of malpractice claim that arises from the actions or omissions of an insurance broker in the course of providing insurance services to a client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUAcLSyxeRKsnkjTyd.label: Engagement Service Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUAcLSyxeRKsnkjTyd.definition: The Service Status concept refers to the current state or condition of a particular legal service, such as whether it is open, closed/ended, or canceled.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUEkyjCqG7yCPQB6OZ.label: Necessary and Proper Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUEkyjCqG7yCPQB6OZ.definition: A Necessary & Proper Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular law or action exceeds the authority granted to Congress by the Necessary and Proper Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Necessary and Proper Clause empowers Congress to pass laws that are necessary and proper for carrying out its enumerated powers, and that any law or action must be directly linked to an enumerated power in order to be constitutionally valid.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUIB6wyjoiIrYc2gTK.label: Georgia Superior Court - Turner County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUIB6wyjoiIrYc2gTK.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Turner County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Turner County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUIlUpsVsyQs46CyHT.label: Local Ruleset
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUIlUpsVsyQs46CyHT.definition: A Local Ruleset is a specific set of rules that govern a particular jurisdiction or court, typically created by the court itself or a local governing body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUKwheT0x2k2ltyleh.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Philadelphia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUKwheT0x2k2ltyleh.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Philadelphia County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Philadelphia County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUP1bJBitIbJFQ1SXl.label: Input VAT Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUP1bJBitIbJFQ1SXl.definition: Input VAT Payment refers to the Value Added Tax paid on purchases of goods and services that a business can reclaim or offset against the VAT collected on sales. This mechanism ensures that VAT is ultimately paid only on the value added at each stage of production.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUPRwxWXJ35yaRIp8m.label: Convertible Note
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUPRwxWXJ35yaRIp8m.definition: A Convertible Note is a form of short-term debt that converts into equity, usually in conjunction with a future financing round. The investor lends money to a startup and instead of getting the money back with interest, the investor receives equity in the company. Each convertible note is usually an unsecured, short-term debt instrument that converts into equity — typically preferred shares — under specified conditions, such as a future funding round. The conversion to equity can be mandatory in some conditions or elective in others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUSvXaOqGr627CnjhR.label: Cash Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUSvXaOqGr627CnjhR.definition: Cash public benefit refers to government programs that provide direct financial assistance to individuals or families who meet certain eligibility criteria, such as income level or employment status. These cash benefits, which can include unemployment compensation, welfare payments, or emergency relief funds, are intended to help recipients meet basic living expenses like housing, utilities, and food.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUXIdFpIxrgm2u6Xlk.label: Dispute Resolution Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUXIdFpIxrgm2u6Xlk.definition: A Dispute Resolution Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the process for resolving any disagreements or conflicts that may arise between the parties involved, typically through negotiation, mediation, or arbitration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUXzL8Z4Ddh2CK6TBh.label: Family Law and Matrimonial Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUXzL8Z4Ddh2CK6TBh.definition: Family Law and Matrimonial Claims refer to legal disputes and proceedings related to issues such as divorce, custody, adoption, and guardianship, among others, that arise within the context of family relationships.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUa4FQQIoJDB6oF65b.label: Spouse of Lawful Permanent Resident
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUa4FQQIoJDB6oF65b.definition: The Spouse of Lawful Permanent Resident Visa (V-1 Visa) is a nonimmigrant visa granted to the spouse of a U.S. Green Card holder whose immigrant visa petition (Form I-130) has been pending for more than three years. This visa allows the spouse to enter, reside, and work in the U.S. while awaiting the final processing of their Green Card application.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUatnmycqhC5V3tIvg.label: Title to Assets Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUatnmycqhC5V3tIvg.definition: Title to Assets Representation is a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party certifies that the target company holds clear and unencumbered title to its assets. This representation assures the buyer that the assets being acquired are free from liens, claims, encumbrances, or disputes, and that the target company has the full right to transfer them as part of the transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUdHmEfhSFnodlHzFT.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Pike County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUdHmEfhSFnodlHzFT.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Pike County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pike County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUj7BUa4TPnpoDUQLK.label: Closing Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUj7BUa4TPnpoDUQLK.definition: Closing Management refers to the process of managing the legal aspects of a transaction, specifically the final stages of completing the deal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUjnmv57gJQKiEhT9n.label: Accord and Satisfaction
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUjnmv57gJQKiEhT9n.definition: An accord and satisfaction is a legal defense that arises when a debtor offers to pay a creditor a sum of money in exchange for the creditor releasing the debtor from further liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUmQO7BJx34w9vocOj.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Polk Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUmQO7BJx34w9vocOj.definition: A court located in Polk County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUpPopDGKxmMR0zrgJ.label: Right to Exclusive Use
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUpPopDGKxmMR0zrgJ.definition: The Right to Exclusive Use refers to the legal authority granted to an individual or entity to have sole access to a particular property, asset, or area for a specific purpose. This right may be conferred through a lease, contract, or other legal arrangement and usually means that no one else can use the asset or space for the duration of the agreement, subject to any conditions or limitations outlined therein.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqAm74lUE8pmrNqTa.label: Interim Operations Provisions
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqAm74lUE8pmrNqTa.definition: Interim Operations Provisions are legal clauses that are included in a contract to regulate the actions of parties during the period between the signing of the contract and its completion, often to protect the interests of one or more parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqGer9HHWVokBHORB.label: Notice of Disposition Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqGer9HHWVokBHORB.definition: A Notice of Disposition Clause is a provision in a legal document that specifies how property or assets will be distributed or disposed of upon a certain event, such as death or termination of a contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqLsm8scxPw20xrcL.label: Clean Water Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUqLsm8scxPw20xrcL.definition: A Clean Water Claim is a legal action brought under environmental law seeking to enforce or protect the right to clean water.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUsZ8s2Mv3N35ZYav1.label: oasis:Obligation
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUsZ8s2Mv3N35ZYav1.definition: An "Obligation" is a type of deontic specification in the OASIS ontology, indicating a requirement or duty that must be fulfilled.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUshq33YKYbi0RQdiJ.label: Craniofacial Bone Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUshq33YKYbi0RQdiJ.definition: Maxilla, orbit, or temporal fossa cancer refers to malignant tumors originating in the bones and surrounding structures of the upper jaw (maxilla), eye socket (orbit), and the temporal fossa, which is located at the side of the skull. These cancers can significantly impact functions such as vision, chewing, and facial symmetry and often require complex, multidisciplinary treatment approaches.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUshq33YKYbi0RQdiJ.pref_label: Maxilla, Orbit, or Temporal Fossa Cancer

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUtNAEY6SLedQqmx0H.label: Fixed Maturity Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUtNAEY6SLedQqmx0H.definition: A Fixed Maturity Asset is a financial instrument where the principal amount is repaid in full at a specified maturity date. This type of asset provides a predictable repayment schedule, offering investors assurance of receiving their principal investment at the end of the term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCUuDgbKnORPEWWjF69.label: Integration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCUuDgbKnORPEWWjF69.definition: An integration clause is a contractual provision that declares that the written agreement is the final and complete expression of the parties' intentions, and that any prior or contemporaneous agreements or understandings are merged into the written agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCV40j08zvRl2faFV72.label: Classifications of Representations and Warranties
http://lmss.sali.org/RCV40j08zvRl2faFV72.definition: "Classifications of Representations and Warranties" refer to the categorization of assertions made by one party to another in a contractual agreement regarding the state of affairs, facts, or promises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCV6eP6RzLiRexxjYkN.label: First Right of Refusal Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCV6eP6RzLiRexxjYkN.definition: A First Right of Refusal Clause is a provision in a contract that grants a party the opportunity to purchase or lease property before it is offered to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCV8vn22i4KoYOJSTBT.label: Minnesota District Court - Ramsey County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCV8vn22i4KoYOJSTBT.definition: Minnesota District Court - Ramsey County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Ramsey County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVFpYnFloozYsCuVDE.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Atchison County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVFpYnFloozYsCuVDE.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in Atchison County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVJ5a6DNKj7RLr4tBm.label: Failure to Meet Projections Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVJ5a6DNKj7RLr4tBm.definition: The Failure to Meet Projections Language refers to a clause in a contract that outlines the consequences if a party fails to meet the projected goals or expectations outlined in the agreement, specifically in relation to Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Definition - Carveouts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVKNrnBSzR5wFD9yB7.label: Arbitrators/Mediators Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVKNrnBSzR5wFD9yB7.definition: The Arbitrators/Mediators Expense concept refers to the costs incurred by parties in a legal matter for the services of an impartial third party who facilitates negotiations and resolution of disputes outside of court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVLV5Fm13Fv8wmoMwB.label: Assonet Band of the Wampanoag Nation

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVMobXFl279UVXHDF5.label: Absolute Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVMobXFl279UVXHDF5.definition: Absolute Privilege: A legal immunity that protects government officials from being held liable for statements made during official proceedings, even if those statements are defamatory or otherwise harmful.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPI1urZIhFYA7MHoD.label: Asbestos Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPI1urZIhFYA7MHoD.definition: Asbestos Claims refer to legal claims made by individuals who have suffered harm due to exposure to asbestos, seeking compensation for damages such as medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPXawvdz10Y7VzSrN.label: Notice and Right to Cure Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPXawvdz10Y7VzSrN.definition: A Notice and Right to Cure Clause is a provision in a legal agreement that requires a party to provide notice of a breach and an opportunity to cure the breach before taking legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPsOqzFXJYDU8JqSh.label: Business Process Outsourcing Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVPsOqzFXJYDU8JqSh.definition: A Business Process Outsourcing Agreement is a legal contract between a company and an external service provider, where the provider undertakes specific business tasks or processes on behalf of the company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVScmAKNuwNtt98P0W.label: Forensic Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVScmAKNuwNtt98P0W.definition: A forensic expert is a professional who specializes in the application of scientific methods and techniques to investigate and analyze evidence in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVTMxVNrsAdKOruCSm.label: Pharmaceutical and Medicine Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVTMxVNrsAdKOruCSm.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing biological and medicinal products; (2) processing (i.e., grading, grinding, and milling) botanical drugs and herbs; (3) isolating active medicinal principals from botanical drugs and herbs; and (4) manufacturing pharmaceutical products intended for internal and external consumption in such forms as ampoules, tablets, capsules, vials, ointments, powders, solutions, and suspensions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVWv9hGtjZg3y3kidS.label: Pee Dee Indian Nation of Upper South Carolina

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVY0cWq1dTHKAIL8c1.label: Prime Minister
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVY0cWq1dTHKAIL8c1.definition: A prime minister is the head of government in many parliamentary systems, responsible for running the country's day-to-day operations and leading the executive branch. Typically appointed from the majority party or coalition in the legislature, the prime minister sets government policy, oversees the cabinet, and represents the country domestically and internationally.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVcM3sOcvblrq6S72c.label: Utility Patent Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVcM3sOcvblrq6S72c.definition: A utility patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a new and useful invention, such as a process, machine, manufacture, or composition of matter, for a certain period. It includes detailed information about the invention, its utility, and the scope of protection granted.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVdRCEbHmTOMoJpqz6.label: Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVdRCEbHmTOMoJpqz6.definition: A Complaint is a formal legal document filed by a plaintiff that sets forth the allegations and claims against a defendant in a civil lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVddRYkryBzCKQd9n4.label: Borderline Intellectual Functioning
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVddRYkryBzCKQd9n4.definition: Borderline Intellectual Functioning is characterized by an IQ score that is above the range for intellectual disability but significantly below average. Individuals with this condition may experience difficulties with cognitive tasks and adaptive functioning, but their challenges are not severe enough to qualify as an intellectual disability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVdu7SLWG41yGP4XqR.label: Motion to Amend
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVdu7SLWG41yGP4XqR.definition: A Motion to Amend is a formal request made to a court or tribunal to modify or change a previously filed document or pleading, such as a complaint, petition, or judgment, in order to correct errors or provide additional information.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVgUOBkWuuqGzcT79h.label: Ownership of Information Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVgUOBkWuuqGzcT79h.definition: A clause in a legal document that specifies who has the right to possess and control certain information.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVhtG0BzR5cKrRW3Mk.label: Utu Utu Gwaitu Paiute Tribe of the Benton Paiute Reservation, California

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVmRtg7r6lWxfu4nde.label: Business Disparagement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVmRtg7r6lWxfu4nde.definition: The act of making false or misleading statements about a business or its products or services, with the intention of causing harm to its reputation or financial standing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVn9Ew2WyR8O4O5WGD.label: Guardianship
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVn9Ew2WyR8O4O5WGD.definition: The legal concept of Guardianship refers to the legal authority granted to a person to make decisions on behalf of another individual who is unable to make decisions for themselves due to mental or physical incapacity, with specific application to family law and matrimonial claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVpRy3tdakHoo4AGuJ.label: Public Record Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVpRy3tdakHoo4AGuJ.definition: A public record document is an official record created, maintained, and accessible by a government agency or public body, which can be used as evidence in legal proceedings. These documents include a wide range of materials, such as birth certificates, property deeds, and court records, and are generally considered reliable and admissible under the public records exception to the hearsay rule.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCVqY5WIdGV0LldQQN1.label: Motion to Incur Debt
http://lmss.sali.org/RCVqY5WIdGV0LldQQN1.definition: A Motion to Incur Debt is a request made in a bankruptcy case seeking court approval to obtain new debt or credit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCW4ROCsdWndMwqVoSx.label: Retaliatory Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RCW4ROCsdWndMwqVoSx.definition: Retaliatory Discrimination refers to the act of an employer taking adverse action against an employee in response to the employee's complaint or opposition to discriminatory practices in the workplace.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCW9GxEn2YGRbQJH4bb.label: matter_final_bill
http://lmss.sali.org/RCW9GxEn2YGRbQJH4bb.definition: Field used to specify whether this is the final bill for the matter_id.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWBcku2CHpJg9vFxuI.label: Birth Details
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWBcku2CHpJg9vFxuI.definition: Birth Details refer to specific information about an individual's birth, commonly including Date of Birth, Country of Birth, and City of Birth. These details are often required in legal, medical, and governmental contexts for identification, verification of nationality, and eligibility for certain rights or benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWBpbZ8mrjRQt2kv0a.label: Private Equity Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWBpbZ8mrjRQt2kv0a.definition: Private Equity refers to investments made in private companies that are not publicly traded, typically by institutional investors or high net worth individuals, with the goal of generating high returns through various strategies such as leveraged buyouts, growth capital, and venture capital.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWIQELESHBIRuxNPqV.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 10th
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWIQELESHBIRuxNPqV.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 10th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWP2fmtmSbIUUpHixF.label: Florida Circuit Court - Sarasota County - 12th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWP2fmtmSbIUUpHixF.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Sarasota County (12th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Sarasota County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWPazSKtsKeiuSKjKM.label: Contributory Patent Infringement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWPazSKtsKeiuSKjKM.definition: Contributory Patent Infringement refers to the act of knowingly aiding, abetting, inducing, or encouraging another party to infringe on a patent, with the knowledge that the actions being encouraged constitute patent infringement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWRu8dBDakdwPSqrG2.label: Lease Related Guaranty
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWRu8dBDakdwPSqrG2.definition: A Lease Related Guaranty is a promise by a third party (the guarantor) to fulfill the tenant's obligations under a lease if the tenant fails to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWYnSGVWCkhPmv9LGg.label: Texas District Court - El Paso County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWYnSGVWCkhPmv9LGg.definition: A Texas District Court located in El Paso County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWcxRUlvh0IiaM4DKj.label: Benchmarking Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWcxRUlvh0IiaM4DKj.definition: A benchmarking clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the comparison of a company's performance or costs against those of other similar companies in the industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWiST7asLorKz5m0Ti.label: Human Resources Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWiST7asLorKz5m0Ti.definition: A Human Resources Document is any formal record, form, or piece of information related to the management of personnel within an organization. These documents can include employment contracts, performance evaluations, and company policies related to human resources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWjCCdnj8LB2NBxVfo.label: Brain Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWjCCdnj8LB2NBxVfo.definition: Brain cancer is a type of cancer that arises from the brain cells, tissues, or the meninges (the protective membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord). It can be primary, originating in the brain, or secondary, resulting from the spread of cancer from other body parts, and requires treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWpJVQosPsfEO3EbEf.label: Burns
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWpJVQosPsfEO3EbEf.definition: Burns are injuries to the skin or other tissues caused by exposure to heat, chemicals, electricity, or radiation. They are categorized by severity into first, second, third, and fourth degrees based on the depth and extent of tissue damage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWq9R7YTQV7KDEusXV.label: Georgia Superior Court - Wilkes County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWq9R7YTQV7KDEusXV.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Wilkes County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWvotUzDQHj2nTJxdu.label: Florida County Court - Gilchrist County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWvotUzDQHj2nTJxdu.definition: A court located in Gilchrist County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWxP1FKXmowxHLeZPg.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Columbia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWxP1FKXmowxHLeZPg.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Columbia County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCWzAq3N0oEDS6MRoHM.label: Insuring Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCWzAq3N0oEDS6MRoHM.definition: An Insuring Agreement Clause is a specific provision within a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of an insurance policy, including the scope of coverage and the obligations of the insurer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCX3HwOMFSz6vLwgDSW.label: Off-the-Clock Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCX3HwOMFSz6vLwgDSW.definition: An off-the-clock claim is a legal action initiated by an employee who alleges that their employer required them to perform work-related tasks outside of their normal working hours without providing appropriate compensation, such as overtime pay. These tasks can include checking work emails or taking work-related phone calls outside of work hours, or completing work assignments after clocking out for the day. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable wage and hour laws, which require employers to compensate employees for all hours worked, including overtime.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCX4SslBC62ANLM7bvj.label: Appellee
http://lmss.sali.org/RCX4SslBC62ANLM7bvj.definition: A party against whom an appeal is taken.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCX6thWbJsZ9XBzNHlp.label: Georgia District Court - Pierce County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCX6thWbJsZ9XBzNHlp.definition: Georgia District Court - Pierce County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal disputes and criminal cases within Pierce County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXB2wgaZlWXJoi0RkQ.label: Indiana Superior Court - Howard County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXB2wgaZlWXJoi0RkQ.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Howard County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Howard County.

"In the European Union (and possibly in other areas of the world) it is required that an invoice contain the words, ""This is a Tax Invoice"" or ""This is not a Tax Invoice"". 

It would be possible for the law firm to submit an invoice containing all line items details and designated ""This is a Tax Invoice"" in this field, and for the receiving system to display a view of the invoice to the Client and Law Firm that satisfies the requirements for the Tax Invoice required by law in many countries.  In this situation, the law firm may not need to send a separate tax invoice to the Client.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXEKfVCVD0OP99eykT.label: Indiana Superior Court - Jasper County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXEKfVCVD0OP99eykT.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Jasper County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Jasper County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXGOMXoLDBe0RSRTpd.label: New York Supreme Court - Orange County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXGOMXoLDBe0RSRTpd.definition: A court located in Orange County, New York that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXKHit5xKTluVcolPm.label: Foreign Agents Registration Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXKHit5xKTluVcolPm.definition: A Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) claim involves legal action taken against individuals or entities for failing to comply with the disclosure and registration requirements mandated by FARA. Such claims seek to enforce transparency and accountability regarding foreign influence on U.S. political and public processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXZS96ySWIuhlC6yiT.label: Trisomy X Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXZS96ySWIuhlC6yiT.definition: Trisomy X Syndrome, also known as XXX Syndrome, is a genetic condition where a female has three X chromosomes instead of the usual two. This extra chromosome affects development and can lead to a range of physical, cognitive, and behavioral symptoms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXeWRy44K8uXDP7vv5.label: Application for Renewal of Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXeWRy44K8uXDP7vv5.definition: An Application for Renewal of Judgment is a legal document filed in bankruptcy proceedings seeking to extend the time period for collecting a debt that has already been reduced to a judgment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXh9pueQyHdL8Ua9Zc.label: Facsimile Signature Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXh9pueQyHdL8Ua9Zc.definition: A facsimile signature clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the use of a reproduced signature, typically in the form of a fax or scanned image, as a valid and binding signature.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXiUipi6wkkqalyBH2.label: Admiralty and Maritime Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXiUipi6wkkqalyBH2.definition: Law that governs nautical issues and private maritime disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXmZbkCGNYfkmZHX1W.label: Interference with Prospective Relations
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXmZbkCGNYfkmZHX1W.definition: The concept of Interference with Prospective Relations refers to the intentional and unjustified interference with a party's potential or anticipated business relationships or economic advantages, causing harm or loss to that party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXo6eQMlbZx9milrSa.label: Environmental Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXo6eQMlbZx9milrSa.definition: Risk of financial loss due to environmental disasters or changes in environmental regulation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXoaxDQzImfLTr6iEU.label: Educational Quality Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXoaxDQzImfLTr6iEU.definition: The Educational Quality Objective refers to the goal of ensuring a high standard of education for all students, irrespective of their socio-economic or cultural backgrounds. This objective emphasizes the delivery of comprehensive, well-rounded, and effective educational experiences, utilizing optimal resources, curriculum standards, teaching methodologies, and continuous assessment to promote student success and lifelong learning.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXorl2fj2P6I15SoL4.label: Partnership Liability for Debts
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXorl2fj2P6I15SoL4.definition: The concept of Partnership Liability for Debts refers to the legal responsibility of partners in a partnership to pay off any debts incurred by the partnership, even if it means using their personal assets to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXrYpp1ijYGjHeVTcU.label: Payment for Services Rendered Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXrYpp1ijYGjHeVTcU.definition: A Payment for Services Rendered Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for compensating a party for services provided.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCXw2fA0rxsKWlnKljA.label: Transportation Accessibility Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCXw2fA0rxsKWlnKljA.definition: A claim of this type arises when transportation services, whether public or private, are not accessible to individuals with disabilities. This can range from buses not having accessible ramps to airports not providing appropriate assistance for passengers with mobility challenges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCY2rPRVd5uyRkzjCbg.label: Equipment Purchase Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCY2rPRVd5uyRkzjCbg.definition: An Equipment Purchase Agreement is a legally binding contract between a buyer and a seller outlining the terms and conditions of the sale of specific equipment or machinery. It typically includes details such as the purchase price, payment terms, warranties, delivery arrangements, and any conditions or representations related to the equipment being sold.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCY715s1Fibw8DAELIe.label: Retainer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCY715s1Fibw8DAELIe.definition: A retainer clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to pay a fee in advance to secure the services of another party for a specified period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCY7ICwJXQDaZ5H4Dei.label: Zuni
http://lmss.sali.org/RCY7ICwJXQDaZ5H4Dei.definition: Zuni (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCY8A7phqZ78VpWZvsY.label: Vehicular Manslaughter
http://lmss.sali.org/RCY8A7phqZ78VpWZvsY.definition: The unlawful killing of a human being caused by the operation of a motor vehicle by a person who acted with gross negligence or recklessness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYA9t4C95OY9BuUePM.label: No Prepayment Penalty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYA9t4C95OY9BuUePM.definition: A "No Prepayment Penalty Clause" is a provision in a contract that prohibits the imposition of a fee or penalty for paying off a debt or obligation before its due date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYDX8hnu5kIkQvASjO.definition: Oregon Attorney General Opinions are legal interpretations and advice provided by the Attorney General of Oregon, which are binding on state agencies and officials.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYRgvTOu5aHIRGaDKd.definition: Action by a prisoner to vacate or modify a sentence imposed in federal court, other than a death sentence, under 28 U.S.C. § 2255.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYWBM14SHledqhIVbs.label: Indemnification and Hold Harmless Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYWBM14SHledqhIVbs.definition: An indemnification and hold harmless clause is a contractual provision in which one party agrees to protect and defend another party against any claims or losses arising from a particular transaction or relationship, and to assume all liability for any damages or costs incurred as a result.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYfSzAfTNk1LK596vN.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Jefferson County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Jefferson County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYhVEVy4bHoXKXxQpR.definition: Georgia District Court - Houston County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system located in Houston County, responsible for hearing and deciding legal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYi6mS48NndWCB54a2.label: Pretrial Motion Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYi6mS48NndWCB54a2.definition: The practice of filing and arguing motions before a trial, typically seeking to resolve issues or disputes before the trial begins.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYkYK8jh1ruAfssfFk.label: Arizona Superior Court - Coconino Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYkYK8jh1ruAfssfFk.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Coconino Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Coconino County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYl3LbuEyYdPvG9kHx.label: Intangible Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYl3LbuEyYdPvG9kHx.definition: Intangible assets are non-physical assets that an entity owns, which have value due to the rights or privileges they provide to the entity. Examples include patents, copyrights, trademarks, brand recognition, and goodwill, which can contribute to a company's long-term revenue but cannot be physically touched or seen.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYo60aK7ekkWrw9Q22.label: Internet Broadcast
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYo60aK7ekkWrw9Q22.definition: An Internet Broadcast is the transmission of audio, video, or multimedia content over the internet to reach a dispersed online audience. This form of broadcasting includes live streaming, on-demand videos, and internet radio, allowing users to access content via computers, smartphones, and other internet-enabled devices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCYoss9teEw39jxfYYd.label: Lamba
http://lmss.sali.org/RCYoss9teEw39jxfYYd.definition: A language spoken by the Lamba people, primarily in Zambia and Congo.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZ6fXRHbuqgdaGFajr.definition: Direct Deposit is an electronic method of transferring funds directly from one bank account to another, commonly used for payroll or benefit disbursements. http://lmss.sali.org/RCZ9I5zrMz731FLCpcw.definition: Swedish (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Swedish language, which is a subset of the broader category of Language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZ9kvhPqkbzBah4g5M.definition: A Taxes Motion (Bankruptcy) is a request made by a debtor in bankruptcy court seeking permission to pay taxes owed by the debtor or the bankruptcy estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZCK6qP0xWqSwV6FS3.definition: A Texas District Court located in Henderson County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZKKR8AaSUeaXQmBzP.definition: An Acknowledgement and Acceptance Clause is a provision in a legal document where a party acknowledges and accepts the terms and conditions of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZMmaW4xt2Nk20utwS.definition: Lower Sorbian is a Slavic language spoken in eastern Germany, primarily in the state of Brandenburg.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZNYDVB8sGeXXGpZUW.definition: A tabletop exercise practice involves legal work related to conducting simulated scenarios to test and evaluate the effectiveness of an organization’s plans and procedures for handling emergencies or specific situations, such as cybersecurity incidents or disaster recovery. http://lmss.sali.org/RCZPcs1dLAWF1Ug5GeT.label: California Superior Court - Butte Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCZPcs1dLAWF1Ug5GeT.definition: A California Superior Court in Butte County is a specific court within the California Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Butte County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCZQdKH230Tk1EJrtOx.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court is a court system within the Massachusetts State Courts that handles cases related to housing, district, probate and family, juvenile, and land court matters, as well as the Boston Municipal Court and the Massachusetts Superior Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCaeZbTg74NX3xyNzsk.label: Food Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RCaeZbTg74NX3xyNzsk.definition:
Industries in the Food Manufacturing subsector transform livestock and agricultural products into products for intermediate or final consumption.  The industry groups are distinguished by the raw materials (generally of animal or vegetable origin) processed into food products.

The food products manufactured in these establishments are typically sold to wholesalers or retailers for distribution to consumers, but establishments primarily engaged in retailing bakery and candy products made on the premises not for immediate consumption are included.

Establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing beverages are classified in Subsector 312, Beverage and Tobacco Product Manufacturing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCbIs82TvJdzuch0zpH.label: Coma

http://lmss.sali.org/RCbLjaI2HGm94nXmkyp.definition: The concept of "Substantial Performance of Contract Allowing Recovery" refers to a legal claim that allows a party to recover damages even if they have not fully performed their contractual obligations, as long as their performance was substantial and in good faith.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCbOw1sEIV1yKNGOXgj.definition: Phlebotomy Negligence refers to a type of medical negligence claim that arises when a healthcare professional fails to perform a blood draw procedure with the appropriate standard of care, resulting in harm to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCbTzAu806zaUHfadN7.definition: Also known as "appropriative rights," diversion rights allow entities to divert water from its natural source for use in a different location. This system is common in parts of the western United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCbrZc9nUSYGtNJnMNo.definition: A Board Secretary, also known as Secretary of the Board, is an officer responsible for managing the administrative tasks of a board of directors, including preparing agendas, recording meeting minutes, and maintaining corporate governance documents. http://lmss.sali.org/RCc2g99sFHEbUR6mIr1.definition: Excise Tax Practice refers to the application, administration, and enforcement of taxes imposed on specific goods, services, or activities, such as alcohol, tobacco, fuel, and gambling. http://lmss.sali.org/RCc50c8MA7S8aeFuufx.label: Product Liability Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/RCc50c8MA7S8aeFuufx.definition: Product Liability Defenses refer to the legal arguments and strategies used by defendants in a product liability case to defend against claims of liability for harm caused by their product, including arguments related to the inherent safety of the product, the scope of its intended use, the knowledge and experience of the user, and the balance of risks and benefits associated with the product.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCc5UaQRTagjPA2b0YS.label: Assuming Facts Not in Evidence Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RCc5UaQRTagjPA2b0YS.definition: Assuming Facts Not in Evidence is an objection raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question or statement implies the existence of facts that have not been formally introduced or established as evidence in the case. http://lmss.sali.org/RCc7iDhMaikuzxNI08H.label: Freedom from Torture
http://lmss.sali.org/RCc7iDhMaikuzxNI08H.definition: Freedom from torture is a fundamental human right that prohibits the use of torture and other cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment against individuals. This right is enshrined in various international treaties, such as the United Nations Convention Against Torture, and is considered a non-derogable right, meaning it cannot be suspended under any circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCc94Vj4Zzg6u1bIiC6.label: Ganda
http://lmss.sali.org/RCc94Vj4Zzg6u1bIiC6.definition: Ganda (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary used in Uganda and surrounding regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcN0m0EJwmJ8I7rTl8.definition: A Quality Guarantee Clause is a specific type of clause found in a contract that ensures the quality of goods or services provided under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcONOqbeZp3iIDXbl7.definition: An Employment Disciplinary Event refers to actions taken by an employer to address an employee's misconduct, performance issues, or violations of company policies, short of termination. http://lmss.sali.org/RCcObg4twiFtz9WZqgG.label: Judicial Branch Monitoring Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcObg4twiFtz9WZqgG.definition: Judicial Branch Monitoring Practice involves the continuous observation, analysis, and reporting of activities and decisions within the judiciary, including court rulings, legal precedents, and judicial appointments. http://lmss.sali.org/RCcOuaZSzwQXj0T0WXy.label: Trademark Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcOuaZSzwQXj0T0WXy.definition: A Trademark Registration Document is the official certificate issued by a governmental authority, such as the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), confirming the registration of a specific trademark. http://lmss.sali.org/RCcQHyZbjBHsXsm0zrZ.definition: Tortious Interference Claims refer to legal claims made by a party against another for intentionally interfering with their contractual or business relationships, resulting in economic harm or loss.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcT6eEFcReXFZqoAC9.label: Case Management Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcT6eEFcReXFZqoAC9.definition: A Case Management Order is a legal directive issued by a court that outlines the procedures and deadlines for managing a specific case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcT9pKRvmEbeb6fm1J.definition: Negligence committed by an internist, which is a type of medical malpractice claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcUqT9sneDczCJi10e.definition: A Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) Claim arises when an individual or entity is accused of violating the FCPA, which prohibits bribery of foreign officials to obtain or retain business. This claim involves allegations of unlawful payments, gifts, or offers made to foreign officials to influence their actions or decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcWasK7LnVMXipm7uQ.label: Visitor
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcWasK7LnVMXipm7uQ.definition: A visitor is an individual who temporarily enters a specific location, such as a country, city, or residence, for various purposes. Visitors can include tourists, who travel for leisure and exploration; business visitors, who come for work-related activities; or guests invited to a residence for social or personal reasons. The nature of the visit and applicable regulations, such as visa requirements or entry permissions, can differ based on the visitor's purpose and destination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCcZ4MjUhqQHbZjYzjl.label: Schizoaffective Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcZ4MjUhqQHbZjYzjl.definition: Schizoaffective Disorder is a mental health condition characterized by the presence of both schizophrenia symptoms and mood disorder symptoms (either depressive or manic episodes). http://lmss.sali.org/RCcidDCaGrSequSQ0hn.label: Termination Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCcidDCaGrSequSQ0hn.definition: Law encompassing rules by which an employer may terminate an employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCd74urSVFTnw2GfIux.definition: Intermediate Representations and Warranties refer to the statements and assurances made by parties involved in a contract or agreement that fall between standard and extensive warranties. http://lmss.sali.org/RCd7dxcIdPTFV8qoraP.definition: Minnesota District Court - Cass County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Cass County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdB7JSwa396MLuCEkq.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors Holding Claims Secured by Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdB7JSwa396MLuCEkq.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors Holding Claims Secured by Property, also known as Schedule D, requires the debtor to list all creditors who have claims secured by the debtor's property. This schedule provides details about each secured claim, including the creditor's name, the amount owed, the collateral securing the debt, and the value of that collateral.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdC2rTRkY2tgCKDkEv.label: Federal Preemption
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdC2rTRkY2tgCKDkEv.definition: The concept of Federal Preemption refers to the legal principle that federal law takes precedence over state law in cases where there is a conflict between the two.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdGQADpA4fjQkLdVXl.label: Motion for Protective Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdGQADpA4fjQkLdVXl.definition: A Motion for Protective Order is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy or discovery case to limit or prevent the disclosure of certain information or evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJG6uCwl9vj0GwxJe.label: matter segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJG6uCwl9vj0GwxJe.definition: A matter segment is a component of LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 that includes various details related to a legal matter, such as matter ID, description, billing type, associated line items, and contact information.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJXw1Ml7DIBqmouWa.label: Exception
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJXw1Ml7DIBqmouWa.definition: In a legal context, an exception refers to a situation or circumstance that deviates from the general rule or norm. Exceptions are typically invoked to address specific conditions or cases that require special consideration or treatment within a legal framework.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJaVUt3j1jUiuWsWF.label: Demand Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdJaVUt3j1jUiuWsWF.definition: The demand amount refers to the specific sum of money or compensation requested in a demand letter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdSl46deaOIbeRjXir.label: Capias Ad Respondendum
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdSl46deaOIbeRjXir.definition: A "Capias Ad Respondendum" is a legal concept within the categories of Judicial and Procedural Tort Claims, which refers to a writ or order issued by a court to arrest and bring a defendant before the court to answer to a civil action or lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdTwXctGNifiHhWMqm.label: Right of Offset Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdTwXctGNifiHhWMqm.definition: A Right of Offset Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to offset or deduct any amount owed to them by the other party from any amount owed by them, in order to settle the debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCddPTrGFlYsUNpYRkJ.label: Analysis of Vendor Contracts
http://lmss.sali.org/RCddPTrGFlYsUNpYRkJ.definition: The concept of "Analysis of Vendor Contracts" refers to the examination and evaluation of agreements between a company and its suppliers or service providers, with a focus on identifying potential risks and ensuring compliance with legal and business requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdjeyRaYgHqnJ1OOQM.label: Negative Pledge Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdjeyRaYgHqnJ1OOQM.definition: A Negative Pledge Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits a party from creating any new liens or encumbrances on their assets, which could negatively affect the other party's security interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdqWcnwAed6csMGUCJ.label: Motion to Exclude Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdqWcnwAed6csMGUCJ.definition: A Motion to Exclude Witness is a formal request made to the court to prevent a particular witness from testifying in a trial or hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdu7fx4MtIenywNiQo.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Owen County Circuit 2
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdu7fx4MtIenywNiQo.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear a wide range of civil and criminal cases within Owen County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCdubrnMGiLMb8Z4ULy.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Morris County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCdubrnMGiLMb8Z4ULy.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Morris County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Morris County and serving the surrounding area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCe2UcxPCCx8zj1pIvx.label: Georgia District Court - Toombs County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCe2UcxPCCx8zj1pIvx.definition: A court located in Toombs County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCe75WRWjkm4BZkAjom.label: Direct Debt Offering
http://lmss.sali.org/RCe75WRWjkm4BZkAjom.definition: A Direct Debt Offering refers to the issuance of debt securities by a borrower directly to investors, without the involvement of underwriters or intermediaries. This approach allows the issuer to raise capital efficiently, often at a lower cost, by bypassing traditional financial institutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeBJGHSTNvkUHCeiTp.label: Tsonga
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeBJGHSTNvkUHCeiTp.definition: Tsonga is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeEdzen5sS4qh0lfvn.label: Allied Legal Professional
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeEdzen5sS4qh0lfvn.definition: An allied legal professional supports the delivery of legal services through specialized skills and knowledge. These professionals work in various roles, such as paralegals, law librarians, and legal marketing personnel, all enabling legal service providers (e.g., law firms) to deliver legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeG3mRd2kFDSwM398N.label: Supplementary Papers
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeG3mRd2kFDSwM398N.definition: Supplementary Papers refer to additional documents submitted to a court after the initial filing of an appeal, specifically in relation to requests for rehearing or further supplements to the original filing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeKmVl4PL78uA2J5r5.label: Political Questions
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeKmVl4PL78uA2J5r5.definition: Political questions refer to issues that courts deem inappropriate for judicial review because they involve decisions best made by the legislative or executive branches of government. In such cases, the judiciary typically refrains from ruling, citing a lack of judicially manageable standards and the need to respect the separation of powers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeMeMkbzNzWOKmp6Xa.label: Roadway Dedication
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeMeMkbzNzWOKmp6Xa.definition: Roadway Dedication is the legal process by which a private entity or individual transfers land to a public entity for the specific purpose of constructing or expanding a public road. This act typically requires formal documentation, legal agreements, and may involve negotiations between private and public parties to meet local planning and zoning requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeRtGBTwYZfFytTgBA.label: Dry Creek Rancheria Band of Pomo Indians, California

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeW5YvXStJRALEvcnZ.label: Cybercrime Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeW5YvXStJRALEvcnZ.definition: Law that addresses criminal activities conducted through or targeting computer systems, networks, and digital technologies, including hacking, identity theft, online fraud, data breaches, and cyberstalking.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeXAZJ8y359CuicTAz.label: Cross-Designation
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeXAZJ8y359CuicTAz.definition: Cross-Designation refers to the act of designating a party or a document in a legal case with a different name or title than originally given, and it falls under the category of Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeYuXiU2d2WV3BlrRt.label: Somatic Symptom Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeYuXiU2d2WV3BlrRt.definition: Somatic Symptom Disorder is characterized by one or more physical symptoms that cause significant distress or impairment in daily functioning, with excessive thoughts, feelings, or behaviors related to the symptoms. The physical symptoms cannot be fully explained by a medical condition, substance use, or another mental disorder.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeZAhlt48BDPGyJqTt.label: Manchu
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeZAhlt48BDPGyJqTt.definition: Manchu is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCebyurX2mFkPJG9ftr.label: Moksha
http://lmss.sali.org/RCebyurX2mFkPJG9ftr.definition: A language spoken by the Moksha people, who reside primarily in the Mordovia region of Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCedm84EEdwbf9nS0mg.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Union Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCedm84EEdwbf9nS0mg.definition: A court located in Union County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeiGFdK6TTSZb0MaH3.label: Tay-Sachs Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeiGFdK6TTSZb0MaH3.definition: Tay-Sachs disease is a rare, inherited neurodegenerative disorder caused by a deficiency of the enzyme hexosaminidase A. This deficiency leads to the accumulation of GM2 gangliosides, which are toxic to nerve cells.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeiXNGpqL4H3jo1g1N.label: Indiana Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeiXNGpqL4H3jo1g1N.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCeqZ5Gnoh3zTiHapbn.label: Class Action Waiver Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCeqZ5Gnoh3zTiHapbn.definition: A Class Action Waiver Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits a group of individuals from collectively bringing a legal claim against the other party, requiring each individual to pursue their claim individually.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCespHBbSU4qDbW9ING.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Union County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfEmZKHJ2JUVJNGfHY.label: Subpoena
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfEmZKHJ2JUVJNGfHY.definition: A subpoena is a legal document that requires a person to appear in court or produce evidence for a case, and is a type of discovery document used in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfISGW5BAPrZbKoiHK.label: tax_item_fee segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfISGW5BAPrZbKoiHK.definition: A tax_item_fee segment is a component of the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard that includes information about a specific tax or fee charged in a legal matter, identified by a unique transaction ID and file item number.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfKzG52fFBC0jP2yAJ.label: Divehi; Dhivehi; Maldivian
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfKzG52fFBC0jP2yAJ.definition: A language spoken in the Maldives, also known as Divehi or Dhivehi, which belongs to the top-level class of Language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfMR0vgLX4LlEGrQud.label: New York Traffic Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfMR0vgLX4LlEGrQud.definition: New York Traffic Court is a specialized court within the New York State Courts system that handles traffic violations and related matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfMU02GZfQ9SBjEPUi.label: Filing Receipt Number
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfMU02GZfQ9SBjEPUi.definition: A Filing Receipt Number, such as an immigration filing receipt number or other regulatory filing receipt number, is a unique identifier assigned to an application or filing submitted to a government agency, indicating that the submission has been received and officially acknowledged. This number is used to track the progress of the filing and corresponds to the specific case for reference during the processing period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfOoWbuAOqLv617rVN.label: Eating Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfOoWbuAOqLv617rVN.definition: Eating Disorders are characterized by disturbances in eating behavior and preoccupation with, and excessive self-evaluation of, body weight and shape. Symptoms and signs may include, but are not limited to, restriction of energy consumption when compared with individual requirements; recurrent episodes of binge eating or behavior intended to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or misuse of laxatives; mood disturbances, social withdrawal, or irritability; amenorrhea; dental problems; abnormal laboratory findings; and cardiac abnormalities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfQRpRfV3qAA0eRlZO.label: Money Order Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfQRpRfV3qAA0eRlZO.definition: Money Order Payment involves the use of a money order, a pre-funded paper document resembling a check, to transfer funds between parties. Money orders are typically issued by financial institutions, post offices, or retail stores and offer a secure method of payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfQprqaO3Nb7M6GPJx.label: Disinhibited Social Engagement Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfQprqaO3Nb7M6GPJx.definition: Disinhibited Social Engagement Disorder (DSED) is a condition in children characterized by overly familiar behavior with strangers and a lack of appropriate reticence in new social situations. It often arises from severe neglect or inconsistent caregiving during early childhood, leading to indiscriminate social interactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfRIysIHRumFT5rXKO.label: Manufacturing Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfRIysIHRumFT5rXKO.definition: An expert in the field of manufacturing, including managers and workers with experience in the manufacturing industry. 10 U.S.C. § 2197

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfSJ8Gah4DUEi6X9KG.label: Scotts Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfTYhRY0yHi8PxYz3H.label: Heart Transplant
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfTYhRY0yHi8PxYz3H.definition: A heart transplant is a surgical procedure in which a diseased or damaged heart is replaced with a healthy donor heart. It is a significant intervention for end-stage heart failure or severe coronary artery disease, and involves lifelong medical management to prevent rejection of the donor heart and to manage post-transplant complications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfYMvIctPZa694cMtY.label: Washington Superior Court - Grant County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfYMvIctPZa694cMtY.definition: Washington Superior Court - Grant County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Grant County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfcvrgclqHgT22bdGK.label: Ohio Board of Unauthorized Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfcvrgclqHgT22bdGK.definition: The Ohio Board of Unauthorized Practice is a regulatory body established by the Ohio State Courts to oversee and prevent the unauthorized practice of law in Ohio.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfdkasigpXYpOViJrD.label: Bribery
http://lmss.sali.org/RCfdkasigpXYpOViJrD.definition: The offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting of anything of value (i.e., a bribe, gratuity, or kickback) to sway the judgment or action of a person in a position of trust or influence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCfelbasSktrrLmIWzv.definition:
