http://lmss.sali.org/RCr9KWbpVYATsjZ9QXU.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Dallas County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Dallas County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCr9crjYeZtrcEUQ2Dc.label: Data Analytics Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCr9crjYeZtrcEUQ2Dc.definition: Data Analytics Management refers to the process of collecting, organizing, and analyzing data to gain insights and make informed decisions, within the broader context of Data Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrGuD8SOr6nVEdcxW6.definition: A tax_item_expense segment is a component of the LEDES XML E-Billing Ver. 2.2 standard that includes information about a specific tax expense, such as a tax identification number and file item number.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrH7qmUR43b0Wpyjno.definition: Review of Documents Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a legal matter, specifically involving the examination and analysis of documents collected and produced during the case, and may include the identification of relevant information and potential evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrTf9ZkUrd8tgXOWt0.label: Criminal False Imprisonment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrTf9ZkUrd8tgXOWt0.definition: The concept of Criminal False Imprisonment refers to the intentional and unlawful confinement or restraint of an individual against their will, without legal justification or authority, and with the knowledge that the confinement is unlawful.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrVPCBH6CAlY5Qotfi.label: New Jersey County Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrVPCBH6CAlY5Qotfi.definition: A New Jersey County Court is a court of law that has jurisdiction over cases within a specific county in New Jersey, and is a subcategory of the New Jersey State Courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrXixViB5t2DJrWiNW.label: Ethics Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrXixViB5t2DJrWiNW.definition: An Ethics Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the ethical standards and principles that the parties agree to abide by during the course of their relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrY0WmfjbMJnGXxC46.label: JJ50 Applications relating to Costs alone (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrY0WmfjbMJnGXxC46.definition: Includes applications for security for costs, costs capping and protective costs orders.  Does not include budgeting or costs management orders which are dealt with at [JB40].   Does not include applications proceeding as to costs alone where a substantive application for some other relief has settled.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrc6QcfJgD3VcA5D9e.label: Proxy Vote
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrc6QcfJgD3VcA5D9e.definition: A Proxy Vote is a form of voting in which a member of a decision-making body delegates their voting power to a representative to vote in their absence. This mechanism allows for continued representation and participation in the voting process when the original voter cannot be physically present or chooses not to attend a meeting or election.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrctN8FUd3Tj5gi4DW.label: Food and Cash Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrctN8FUd3Tj5gi4DW.definition: Food and cash public benefit refers to government programs that provide financial assistance and food resources to individuals or families in need. Cash benefits, often delivered through electronic benefit transfer (EBT) cards or direct deposits, are intended to help cover basic living expenses, while food benefits, such as the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in the United States, are designated for purchasing eligible food items.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrkuhfEvrGj2ITZSLQ.label: Automobile Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrkuhfEvrGj2ITZSLQ.definition: "Automobile Registration" refers to the official process of recording essential information about an automobile, such as its make, model, and ownership, with a government authority. This registration, often represented by a certificate or license plate, is required for the vehicle to be legally driven on public roads.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCroY6MyuPipipJMQll.label: Concussion
http://lmss.sali.org/RCroY6MyuPipipJMQll.definition: Mild traumatic brain injury (concussion) is a form of TBI resulting from a blow or jolt to the head that temporarily disrupts brain function. Symptoms can include headache, confusion, dizziness, and memory loss, and while typically short-term, they may require rest and medical monitoring.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCrshoNA9Tc4Xswrj0v.label: Knowledge Qualifiers
http://lmss.sali.org/RCrshoNA9Tc4Xswrj0v.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Definition - "Knowledge" Qualifiers: A term used in legal agreements to describe a negative change or event that has occurred or is likely to occur, and which is known or should have been known by a party based on their level of knowledge or investigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCs05yTimZuTa2X0ov7.label: Kaibab Band of Paiute Indians of the Kaibab Indian Reservation

http://lmss.sali.org/RCs2kzwpPKOdGEpbe0B.label: Exchange Debt for Debt
http://lmss.sali.org/RCs2kzwpPKOdGEpbe0B.definition: An asset exchange involving the replacement of one form of debt with another. This often aims to take advantage of better terms or to extend the maturity of the debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCs5oguF0b3mA15pozh.label: Structure Diagram Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCs5oguF0b3mA15pozh.definition: Structure Diagram Management refers to the management of diagrams that represent the structure of legal transactions and solutions, and is a subcategory of Legal Transaction Management and Legal Point Solutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCs6PrRlQMVdPf1fvEe.label: Business Visa Exception
http://lmss.sali.org/RCs6PrRlQMVdPf1fvEe.definition: A Business Visa Exemption refers to a special arrangement where nationals from certain countries are allowed to enter another country for short-term business activities without the need for a traditional business visa. This is often part of broader visa-free entry agreements or reciprocal arrangements between countries, and is generally time-limited

http://lmss.sali.org/RCs6etFXnGmkzFlg08S.label: Satellite Broadcast
http://lmss.sali.org/RCs6etFXnGmkzFlg08S.definition: A Satellite Broadcast is the transmission of television and radio signals via communication satellites, delivering content to a wide audience across vast geographical areas. This form of broadcasting provides access to various programming, including live events, news, entertainment, and educational shows, typically received through satellite dishes and decoders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsAVtlCawxj4NWI5z3.label: Appellate Argument Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsAVtlCawxj4NWI5z3.definition: Appellate Argument Practice refers to the specialized legal practice of preparing and presenting arguments before an appellate court, with the aim of persuading the court to overturn or modify a lower court's decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsHBFMC8MvFbusiy8v.label: Acceleration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsHBFMC8MvFbusiy8v.definition: An acceleration clause is a provision in a contract that allows the creditor to demand immediate payment of the entire outstanding balance if the debtor fails to meet certain obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsMg9PSHTWeBjdWc5K.label: Appraisal Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsMg9PSHTWeBjdWc5K.definition: Appraisal Management refers to the process of overseeing and coordinating the evaluation of an individual's performance or value, within the context of managing people.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsRWbVwZat6lud2K3X.label: Hearing Disability
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsRWbVwZat6lud2K3X.definition: A Hearing Disability is a partial or total inability to hear sounds in one or both ears, which can affect communication, social interaction, and daily activities. This condition can range from mild hearing loss to profound deafness and may require the use of hearing aids, cochlear implants, or other assistive devices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsSG3CCLhnxP2AJIMa.label: Cooperative
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsSG3CCLhnxP2AJIMa.definition: A cooperative is a legal entity that is owned and operated by its members, who share in the profits and decision-making of the organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsdjZhEaN6MkCTDTSN.label: Walloon
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsdjZhEaN6MkCTDTSN.definition: A dialect of French spoken in Wallonia, Belgium.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsgBzhoO77TRUSo5O7.label: Abbreviated New Drug Application Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsgBzhoO77TRUSo5O7.definition: An Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) Claim arises when there is a dispute or legal challenge related to the submission or approval of an ANDA, which allows for the marketing of a generic drug that demonstrates bioequivalence to an already approved brand-name drug. This claim can involve issues of patent infringement, exclusivity rights, or regulatory compliance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsjV1Tf5Rfsrlny4Wz.label: Declaration of Chapter 13 Income
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsjV1Tf5Rfsrlny4Wz.definition: A Declaration of Chapter 13 Income is a written statement that discloses the income of an individual who has filed for Chapter 13 bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsmd5DYFkJAobBpn9c.label: Notice of Lodging
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsmd5DYFkJAobBpn9c.definition: Notice of filing physical items (e.g., thumb drives, videotapes) with the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCssZ0eE4LoAphnQlNX.label: Natural Resources Extraction Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RCssZ0eE4LoAphnQlNX.definition: A natural resources extraction real estate asset refers to a property that contains or is believed to contain natural resources such as minerals, oil, gas, or timber, which can be extracted for economic value. This asset is significant in the realms of property law, environmental law, and resource management, as it encompasses the rights and regulations related to the extraction and use of these resources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsvCP3AkYwAzs61PUw.label: Interstitial Lung Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsvCP3AkYwAzs61PUw.definition: Interstitial lung disease (ILD) refers to a group of disorders characterized by inflammation and scarring of the interstitium (the tissue and space around the air sacs) in the lungs. This group of diseases leads to progressive lung damage, impaired gas exchange, and respiratory symptoms such as cough and shortness of breath.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCsxlBJa1VPfKS15PYD.label: Dismissal for Violation of Rules
http://lmss.sali.org/RCsxlBJa1VPfKS15PYD.definition: Dismissal for Violation of Rules refers to the termination of employment due to an employee's failure to comply with company policies or regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCszNUWTj3EZU1PyqBZ.label: Midwife Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RCszNUWTj3EZU1PyqBZ.definition: Negligent actions or omissions by a midwife during the provision of care to a mother and/or baby, resulting in harm or injury, and giving rise to a legal claim for compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCt3KWyx6hFyRJ3Qz6V.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Johnson County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RCt4wkd1PH8v5glNnrd.label: Motion to Approve Settlement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCt4wkd1PH8v5glNnrd.definition: A Motion to Approve Settlement is a formal request made to a court to approve a proposed agreement between parties to a legal dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCt52WPblmd5m4aeEoO.label: Disclosure of Compensation of Attorney for Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/RCt52WPblmd5m4aeEoO.definition: The Disclosure of Compensation of Attorney for Debtor refers to the requirement for a bankruptcy attorney to disclose their compensation to the court and other parties involved in the bankruptcy case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCt65mNyk22gR9GTCYX.label: Consumer Loan Broker Acting Improperly
http://lmss.sali.org/RCt65mNyk22gR9GTCYX.definition: A Consumer Loan Broker Acting Improperly refers to a situation where a broker who arranges loans for consumers engages in unethical or illegal behavior, such as misrepresenting loan terms or charging excessive fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtD5sIYZEcmrBcfl11.label: Cash Collateral Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtD5sIYZEcmrBcfl11.definition: A Cash Collateral Motion in Bankruptcy is a legal request made by a debtor to use cash or cash equivalents that are held as collateral by a creditor, in order to continue operating their business during the bankruptcy process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtFIirbvfhYX6LWgN6.label: Mongolian
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtFIirbvfhYX6LWgN6.definition: Mongolian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Mongolian language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtJD0HhBY5n4xkKpNW.label: Strawberries
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtJD0HhBY5n4xkKpNW.definition: Strawberries are small, red, and fragrant aggregate fruits belonging to the Fragaria genus, known for their sweet flavor and juicy texture. They are widely consumed fresh or processed into jams, desserts, and beverages and are valued for their high vitamin C content, antioxidants, and dietary fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtLOuj6Tcw6HFDYYKd.label: Waiver of Liability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtLOuj6Tcw6HFDYYKd.definition: A waiver of liability clause is a provision in a legal document that releases a party from responsibility for any harm or injury that may occur as a result of participating in an activity or using a product, typically signed by the participant or user.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtU0ElUNpeeUR9YnWv.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Huntington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtU0ElUNpeeUR9YnWv.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Huntington County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Huntington County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtUZjZqZ1lszDFiDOL.label: Illinois Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtUZjZqZ1lszDFiDOL.definition: Illinois Circuit Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Illinois that hears civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtVfpt9Z1mctdNNYHg.label: Post-Polio Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtVfpt9Z1mctdNNYHg.definition: Post-Polio Syndrome (PPS) is a condition that affects polio survivors years after recovery from the initial poliomyelitis infection. It is characterized by new or worsening muscle weakness, fatigue, and pain, often developing 15 to 40 years after the original polio illness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtVq1uma9QpsVZHKZu.label: Insurance Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtVq1uma9QpsVZHKZu.definition: An Insurance Document is a formal written record that encompasses all types of materials related to the underwriting, administration, and execution of insurance policies. Examples include insurance forms, policies, and reinsurance agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtWar1Rv2apxn4Yos7.label: Incumbency Certificate
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtWar1Rv2apxn4Yos7.definition: An Incumbency Certificate is a legal document issued by a corporation or organization, certifying the names and positions of its current officers, directors, and, in some cases, key employees. It serves as official evidence of the authority of specific individuals to act on behalf of the corporation or organization in legal and financial transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtXmoyNyzTwobUpfqa.label: oasis:Collection
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtXmoyNyzTwobUpfqa.definition: A collection in the LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA that includes figures, agents, roles, times, and temporal characteristics.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtZI50lx0N3BZKzUVk.label: Copyright Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtZI50lx0N3BZKzUVk.definition: Law that protects the original creative works of persons by granting exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, and commercialize their work for a defined period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtaGoTlIVgWGJlK5BX.label: Dogrib
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtaGoTlIVgWGJlK5BX.definition: Dogrib is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtbS6xiCv6ms49UDzf.label: DOC
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtbS6xiCv6ms49UDzf.definition: A Microsoft Word document file from Microsoft Office 2003 or earlier.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCthbEuajfX7qrWV1Yx.label: Employment Authorization Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RCthbEuajfX7qrWV1Yx.definition: Employment Authorization Documents (EADs) are permits granted by a country's immigration authority to allow foreign nationals to work legally within its borders. Types of EADs can include those for students, refugees or asylum seekers, dependents of primary visa holders, and individuals under special humanitarian or temporary protection programs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCty0MaQzrLC9KnzjM7.label: Employment Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RCty0MaQzrLC9KnzjM7.definition: Employment Claims refer to legal actions brought by employees against their employers for various reasons such as discrimination, wrongful termination, wage theft, and harassment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtywVRVD4Xs8wjArKE.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Perry Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtywVRVD4Xs8wjArKE.definition: A court located in Perry Township, Marion County, Indiana, with limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCtzoC3NovhdNJ9sa1m.label: Sports Competitor Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RCtzoC3NovhdNJ9sa1m.definition: This type of visa allows amateur or professional athletes to enter a country temporarily to participate in events where they may earn prize money. It does not permit employment beyond prize winnings and is typically subject to conditions and duration limits based on the specifics of the competition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCu23ODfsnYICpdMNOQ.label: Effective Date Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCu23ODfsnYICpdMNOQ.definition: An Effective Date Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the date on which the agreement becomes legally binding and enforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCu2nHDUXf9PZsTy3LF.label: Private Company
http://lmss.sali.org/RCu2nHDUXf9PZsTy3LF.definition: Company whose stock is not publicly available on a public stock exchange, as recognized by the relevant jurisdictions' authority — and is not required by relevant legal authorities to make public disclosures (e.g., operations, finance).

http://lmss.sali.org/RCu3g7pQiYUGC4S8DLO.label: Magistrate Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RCu3g7pQiYUGC4S8DLO.definition: A judicial officer who usually conducts proceedings that deal with minor or preliminary matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCu7hQ9r1Giq9eP0uyD.label: Probationary Period Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCu7hQ9r1Giq9eP0uyD.definition: A probationary period clause is a provision in a contract that outlines a trial period during which an employee's performance is evaluated before a permanent employment decision is made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuCSHjddnPfMqSM8V7.label: Purchase Order Number
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuCSHjddnPfMqSM8V7.definition: A Purchase Order Number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific purchase order within an Engagement Fee Detail, used to track and manage the procurement of goods or services related to the engagement for providing legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuDTJZ0uTvvUeTdEUL.label: Charitable Donation
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuDTJZ0uTvvUeTdEUL.definition: A Charitable Donation is a voluntary gift of money, goods, or services given to a non-profit organization or cause that serves the public interest. This type of donation is typically tax-deductible and is made with the intention of supporting philanthropic activities, addressing social needs, or promoting the welfare of others without expectation of direct personal benefit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuE3FnKYsvUGhRY9Va.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Cambria County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuE3FnKYsvUGhRY9Va.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Cambria County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuLCDo6EMKAYab9Nxb.label: Dogs
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuLCDo6EMKAYab9Nxb.definition: Dogs are domesticated mammals belonging to the species Canis lupus familiaris, known for their loyalty, intelligence, and diverse roles in human society. They serve as companions, working animals, and service animals, and come in a wide variety of breeds with specific traits and purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuRoNV5l2Ug3xlieMu.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Franklin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuRoNV5l2Ug3xlieMu.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Franklin County is a court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that hears civil and criminal cases within Franklin County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuTj4Z7aSLh4BBpXWs.label: Transit Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuTj4Z7aSLh4BBpXWs.definition: A transit visa is a short-term visa that allows travelers to pass through a foreign country en route to another destination. This type of visa is generally valid for a very limited period, often 24 to 72 hours, and does not permit the holder to engage in activities like tourism or business within the transit country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuVuSbt7t27L45izKa.label: New York Supreme Court - Madison County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuVuSbt7t27L45izKa.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Madison County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Madison County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCucFDChZrjSodvK2qa.label: Cable Broadcast
http://lmss.sali.org/RCucFDChZrjSodvK2qa.definition: A Cable Broadcast is the transmission of television content through coaxial or fiber-optic cables to subscribers, providing access to a wide range of channels and programming. This form of broadcasting offers both live and on-demand content, including news, entertainment, sports, and educational shows, delivered to viewers via a cable television service.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuhDmyUHjn92exJ8dx.label: Willful Misconduct
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuhDmyUHjn92exJ8dx.definition: Intentional and reckless behavior that goes beyond mere negligence, often resulting in harm or injury to another person or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuhulltRlDN8kiH5so.label: Cardiovascular Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuhulltRlDN8kiH5so.definition: Cardiovascular disorders encompass any condition that impairs the normal functioning of the heart or the circulatory system, including arteries, veins, capillaries, and lymphatic vessels. These disorders can be congenital, present from birth, or acquired, developing over time due to various factors such as lifestyle or disease.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCui7kRZ1IHGac2ed72.label: Payment Terms and Conditions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCui7kRZ1IHGac2ed72.definition: A Payment Terms and Conditions Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the specific terms and conditions related to payment, including the amount, timing, and method of payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCujc24SO051l1CHsI3.label: Kansas District Court - Osage County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCujc24SO051l1CHsI3.definition: A court located in Osage County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCulYK8bdxrPcMxJ4Mq.label: Nepal Bhasa; Newari
http://lmss.sali.org/RCulYK8bdxrPcMxJ4Mq.definition: A language spoken in Nepal, also known as Newari.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCumhwfe7bWcT6Z8Z8s.label: Executive Branch
http://lmss.sali.org/RCumhwfe7bWcT6Z8Z8s.definition: The executive branch is responsible for implementing, administering, and enforcing the laws enacted by the legislative branch. It is typically headed by a president, prime minister, or monarch, and includes various administrative agencies and departments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCunOHyyWbA6TE8yLmJ.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Lewis County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCunOHyyWbA6TE8yLmJ.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Lewis County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Lewis County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuoN1SbcBaYKFf1hvY.label: Deceptive Insurance Practices
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuoN1SbcBaYKFf1hvY.definition: Deceptive Insurance Practices refer to any fraudulent or misleading actions taken by an insurance company or its representatives in order to deny or delay payment of a claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCupvWn9VGZaKYrXGgK.label: Administration Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RCupvWn9VGZaKYrXGgK.definition: An Administration Agreement in the context of private fund administration refers to a contract where a third-party administrator is appointed to manage operational functions like accounting, reporting, and compliance for a private investment fund. This agreement delineates the scope of services, responsibilities, and fees related to the administration of the fund.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuq0E1VHziF6kMZjDX.label: Electrical Patent
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuq0E1VHziF6kMZjDX.definition: An electrical patent is a legal protection granted to inventors of new and useful electrical inventions, such as circuits, electrical devices, and systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCur49RAT1EIW8XTjJB.label: Business Acquisition Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RCur49RAT1EIW8XTjJB.definition: A Business Acquisition Report is a disclosure document filed with securities regulators detailing the acquisition of another business. It typically includes financial statements and the rationale behind the acquisition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCurUksxnjgPwYWpCSq.label: Permission
http://lmss.sali.org/RCurUksxnjgPwYWpCSq.definition: Permission refers to the formal consent or authorization granted by an authority, allowing an individual or entity to perform a certain action that would otherwise be illegal or against the rules.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCurvxSL5eDB7IasGyF.label: Native American
http://lmss.sali.org/RCurvxSL5eDB7IasGyF.definition: A Native American is a person who belongs to one of the indigenous peoples of North America, with a distinct cultural and historical heritage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuus493FlHkCuRCdg8.label: Medical Malpractice Defenses
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuus493FlHkCuRCdg8.definition: Medical Malpractice Defenses are legal arguments or strategies used by defendants in a medical malpractice case to defend against the plaintiff's claims of negligence or wrongdoing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCuv1eyebu3W695hYQu.label: Akan
http://lmss.sali.org/RCuv1eyebu3W695hYQu.definition: Akan is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, primarily spoken in Ghana and Ivory Coast.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCv1mXvS4wBS00uefnL.label: State-Provided Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RCv1mXvS4wBS00uefnL.definition: State-provided public benefit refers to assistance programs that are administered and funded at the state or provincial level. These can include state-specific healthcare programs, housing assistance, and educational grants.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCv49x0e2CZIS9zJF5l.label: Oregon State Board of Nursing
http://lmss.sali.org/RCv49x0e2CZIS9zJF5l.definition: The Oregon State Board of Nursing is a government entity responsible for regulating and overseeing the practice of nursing within the state of Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCv6Kq9tkPBxjujeEY7.label: COMI (Center of Main Interest)
http://lmss.sali.org/RCv6Kq9tkPBxjujeEY7.definition: COMI, or Center of Main Interest, refers to the primary location where a debtor conducts its principal business operations and is recognized as the central point of its economic activities. This concept is crucial in cross-border insolvency cases to determine jurisdiction and the appropriate forum for the main insolvency proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCv7U8QMO0eXXgAQhDF.label: Motion for Attorney Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RCv7U8QMO0eXXgAQhDF.definition: A Motion for Attorney Fees is a request made by a party in a legal case to recover the costs of their attorney's services, which may include fees, interest, and other expenses incurred during the proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvCVeq4R5ADTlwj8c2.label: Export Compliance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvCVeq4R5ADTlwj8c2.definition: An Export Compliance Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to comply with applicable laws and regulations related to the export of goods or technology.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvECdTswFHO1Tyc4TQ.label: Real Estate Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvECdTswFHO1Tyc4TQ.definition: Payment of Recurrent Taxes on Immovable Property refers to the regular, often annual, tax payments made by property owners to local or national governments based on the assessed value of their real estate. These taxes fund public services such as education, infrastructure, and emergency services.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvECdTswFHO1Tyc4TQ.pref_label: Payment of Recurrent Taxes on Immovable Property

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvIzbBC4HsPoR3TCjr.label: Intellectual Property Ownership Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvIzbBC4HsPoR3TCjr.definition: A provision in a contract that establishes the ownership rights of intangible creations, such as inventions, literary and artistic works, and symbols.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvN4Jy8MpRyRObl8Dq.label: Wrongful Birth Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvN4Jy8MpRyRObl8Dq.definition: A wrongful birth claim is a type of personal injury claim brought by parents who allege that they were not properly informed by a medical professional of the risk of having a child with a genetic or congenital abnormality, resulting in the birth of a child with such abnormality.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvQU2fvoNVPyE33SCK.label: Wiretap Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvQU2fvoNVPyE33SCK.definition: A wiretap claim is a civil claim that alleges the illegal interception of electronic communications, such as phone calls or emails.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvUeqSzQeb2dseyMDN.label: Legatee
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvUeqSzQeb2dseyMDN.definition: A legatee is an individual or entity named in a will to receive personal property or money from the estate of the deceased. This term differentiates from a devisee, who inherits real property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvV18Mbbb9FYFXbHt1.label: Regulatory Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvV18Mbbb9FYFXbHt1.definition: Events related to legal services surrounding regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCvfcnTIQL3IhFBUvFv.label: Pharmacology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCvfcnTIQL3IhFBUvFv.definition: Pharmacology Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that involves errors or negligence in the prescription, administration, or monitoring of medication by a healthcare professional.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCviQIdzAw8dzCCf1RA.label: Requests for Production
http://lmss.sali.org/RCviQIdzAw8dzCCf1RA.definition: Requests for Production are a type of Discovery Document that require a party to provide specific documents or items for inspection and copying by the opposing party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwOQFDqbdzy8RMR6Ni.definition: The Impossibility of Performance is a legal defense in civil litigation that arises when a party is unable to fulfill their contractual obligations due to circumstances beyond their control, such as an act of God or a change in the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwP2Lqyk5kERhIpNCm.definition: A Petition for Treaty Skilled Worker Visa (in the U.S., TN application) refers to the process of applying for a TN (Trade NAFTA) visa at the U.S.-Canada or U.S.-Mexico border. The TN visa is available to Canadian and Mexican citizens engaged in specific professional occupations. Applicants must meet the qualifications outlined in the NAFTA agreement and provide the necessary documentation to demonstrate eligibility. Upon approval, the TN visa allows individuals to work in the U.S. temporarily in qualifying professional roles

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwT0yMShmi5V0Q2Y9Y.definition: A wage theft claim is a legal action taken by an employee against an employer for the unlawful withholding of wages or benefits that the employee is entitled to receive.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwhWgOANCG4Vft4IxJ.definition: Corporate Meeting Management refers to the process of organizing and managing meetings for corporations, including scheduling, logistics, and documentation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwl2Flj2LauuaT4NBr.label: Sworn Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/RCwl2Flj2LauuaT4NBr.definition: A sworn complaint is a formal written statement made under oath by a person alleging wrongdoing by another party, typically used in legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwlj6Rhf9wYptTX59P.label: Bankruptcy Plan's Substantial Consummation Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RCwlj6Rhf9wYptTX59P.definition: A legal principle where a court can determine that a bankruptcy plan has been sufficiently executed, preventing parties from initiating new actions or modifications related to the plan. http://lmss.sali.org/RCwr6bTpRxLwVueZsWM.label: Purchase Receipt
http://lmss.sali.org/RCwr6bTpRxLwVueZsWM.definition: A Purchase Receipt is a financial document provided by a seller to a buyer as proof of a completed transaction. It details the goods or services purchased, the amount paid, and often the method of payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwxVWPUdbPjn2tWtFJ.label: Trespass
http://lmss.sali.org/RCwxVWPUdbPjn2tWtFJ.definition: The act of unlawfully entering or interfering with someone else's property, whether it be real property or personal property, resulting in potential liability for the trespasser.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCwxbPXNA8weZDagHlC.label: Collaboration Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCwxbPXNA8weZDagHlC.definition: Collaboration Management refers to the process of coordinating and managing the sharing of information and resources among individuals or groups within a legal context, including the use of extranets, virtual data rooms, and collaboration platforms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCx06H2IQcN5MiSP1I4.label: Evidence Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RCx06H2IQcN5MiSP1I4.definition: Evidence Management refers to the process of collecting, organizing, and preserving evidence in a legal case, with the aim of ensuring its admissibility and reliability in court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCx3FC9y7b4eohni3V5.label: No Liability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RCx3FC9y7b4eohni3V5.definition: A no liability clause is a type of contractual clause that absolves one party from any legal responsibility or obligation for any damages or losses incurred by the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCx52UAWgVQUnCDTQXl.label: Automobile Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RCx52UAWgVQUnCDTQXl.definition: An automobile insurance policy is a contract between a policyholder and an insurance company that provides financial protection against losses arising from accidents, theft, or other events affecting a motor vehicle. The policy specifies the types of coverage included, such as liability, collision, and comprehensive, and requires the payment of premiums to maintain this coverage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCx6P4tGp5nXq3MFCQ4.label: Fraudulent Concealment by Fiduciary
http://lmss.sali.org/RCx6P4tGp5nXq3MFCQ4.definition: The fraudulent concealment by fiduciary concept refers to the intentional act of a person in a position of trust or confidence, such as a trustee or executor, to hide or withhold material information from another party for personal gain or to cause harm.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCx9GuPni9uwMsDX2m5.label: Negligent Operation of Activity Requiring Franchise or License
http://lmss.sali.org/RCx9GuPni9uwMsDX2m5.definition: Negligent Operation of Activity Requiring Franchise or License refers to a legal claim for damages resulting from the careless or reckless operation of a business or activity that requires a franchise or license to operate, such as a taxi service or a liquor store.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCxESJf8hEmdCOJRnru.label: Asset Turnover Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RCxESJf8hEmdCOJRnru.definition: Asset Turnover Practice refers to the legal analysis and evaluation of a company's asset turnover ratio, which measures the efficiency of a company's use of its assets to generate revenue.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCxF1lchaeaQxEwQDoG.label: Short-term Spousal Support
http://lmss.sali.org/RCxF1lchaeaQxEwQDoG.definition: Short-term Spousal Support, also known as temporary alimony or maintenance, is financial support paid by one spouse to the other for a limited and predefined duration. It is typically awarded during the divorce process to provide financial assistance to a lower-earning spouse until a final divorce settlement is reached or until they can achieve financial self-sufficiency. The duration and amount of short-term spousal support are determined by court orders or agreements between the parties and are designed to address immediate financial needs during the divorce proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCxI8cqNSzWB8ZAuv6R.label: Proceeding Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RCxI8cqNSzWB8ZAuv6R.definition: "Proceeding Status" refers to the current stage or status of a legal or regulatory process, whether it's a court proceeding or a regulatory proceeding. http://lmss.sali.org/RCyNQLUTI4qbFjqdcfQ.definition: Vesting refers to the process by which an individual gains unconditional ownership or entitlement to certain assets or benefits over time, often subject to meeting specific conditions or remaining in employment for a predetermined period. http://lmss.sali.org/RCySmY2p2KUDkrD6zQl.definition: Law governing the legal treatment of minors who commit criminal offences or are subject to care and protection proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyakDwElnRzRmzVOEz.definition: Senior Housing - Real Estate Asset refers to a type of real estate asset that is specifically designed and intended for senior citizens to reside in.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyfbSWUN7UQO4MrzYS.definition: A dispositive power clause is a type of contractual clause that grants the holder the authority to make decisions or take actions that affect the rights and obligations of the parties involved in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyiIJGtNEak4RyWAnP.definition: The California Court of Appeal - 2d Dist. is a specific division of the California Court of Appeal that hears appeals from trial courts in the second appellate district of California.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyjjPq9S1d8UX7vWnn.definition: A language spoken in the Cook Islands, including the Rarotongan dialect, used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCymFqZ4uzSi1MXyfIU.definition: A Party Admission is a statement made by a party to a legal proceeding that is offered as evidence against that party. http://lmss.sali.org/RCymTK9PkDxPhuegLa7.label: Florida County Court - Santarosa County
http://lmss.sali.org/RCymTK9PkDxPhuegLa7.definition: A court located in Santa Rosa County, Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyoRbJCKvGKcUEcbb4.definition: The concept of Criminal Causation refers to the causal relationship between the defendant's actions and the resulting harm or injury, which is an essential element of a criminal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCysgFaHvUWbK1LiVRw.label: Monthly Recurring Revenue
http://lmss.sali.org/RCysgFaHvUWbK1LiVRw.definition: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) is a financial metric commonly used by subscription-based businesses to measure the total amount of revenue generated each month from recurring subscriptions. http://lmss.sali.org/RCyuvHXwYHCW7uqjkdp.label: New York Supreme Court - Clinton County

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyv1d3vWqiho7RhyPB.definition: Tahitian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Tahiti and other French Polynesian islands.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyxRxLaFWEAqsqfWxv.definition: Work that relates to the identification of potential experts and preparing their evidence for trial (excludes expert evidence in relation to interim applications).

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyy7qI6HWUM7pA5dh8.definition: The concept of "Irrelevant" refers to evidence or information that is not related or connected to the legal matter at hand and therefore cannot be used to support or refute a party's arguments or claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCyyVoj3dBNsrCR9jfz.label: Tax Authority Reference
http://lmss.sali.org/RCyyVoj3dBNsrCR9jfz.definition: Tax Authority Reference: A specific identifier assigned by a tax authority to a fee invoice detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCz0OhGJQscjwPvw2jQ.label: New York City Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RCz0OhGJQscjwPvw2jQ.definition: New York City Court is a court of law located in New York City that has jurisdiction over a variety of legal matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCz1SYWoNDDTDvPr0kS.definition: The Cross-Examination of Witness is the questioning of a witness by the opposing party during a trial, aimed at testing the credibility and accuracy of their testimony.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCz2Sfebb42XJeRyFof.definition: A writ appeal is a legal action taken by a party who is dissatisfied with a lower court's decision, requesting a higher court to review and potentially overturn the decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCz8lpUNOWlxcgMSwmG.definition: The concept of "Caring for Collateral or Security" refers to the legal responsibility of an agent to properly maintain and protect assets that have been pledged as security for a loan or other obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzD82dQgANaiGfk432.definition: Kidney cancer is a type of cancer that originates in the kidneys, the two bean-shaped organs responsible for filtering blood and producing urine. The most common type is renal cell carcinoma, and treatments often include surgery, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and, in some cases, radiation therapy.
http://lmss.sali.org/RCzD82dQgANaiGfk432.pref_label: Kidney, Adrenal Gland, or Ureter Cancer

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzEqK9mhxGTmmz2g2T.label: Minor in Possession of Alcohol
http://lmss.sali.org/RCzEqK9mhxGTmmz2g2T.definition: A Minor in Possession of Alcohol refers to the illegal act of a person under the legal drinking age possessing or consuming alcohol, which falls under the category of Liquor Law Violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzNI1QoW4KZCDSoIqj.definition: Bankruptcy Initiation Type refers to the classification of bankruptcy proceedings based on who initiates the process. http://lmss.sali.org/RCzQzQSPRAB9cLkvDtB.label: Water Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RCzQzQSPRAB9cLkvDtB.definition: Water rights are legal entitlements allowing the holder to use water from a particular source (like a river, stream, or underground source). http://lmss.sali.org/RCzRvNX42Gf1JVgbCj5.label: Electoral Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/RCzRvNX42Gf1JVgbCj5.definition: A formal legal document filed with a court or tribunal in some jurisdictions, such as the United Kingdom, to challenge the validity or outcome of an election, often based on alleged irregularities, violations of election laws, or misconduct by candidates or election officials. Electoral petitions serve as a mechanism for aggrieved parties to seek legal redress and ensure the integrity of the electoral process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzSKMBlxesjpmOv2Gb.definition: A clause in a contract that specifies the inclusion of exhibits, which are documents or other materials that are attached to and made a part of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzUXCcw0tXLGGdeAIx.definition: Franchise Law refers to the legal rules and regulations that govern the relationship between a franchisor (a business that licenses their brand and model) and a franchisee (an individual or entity that operates under that brand in a business arrangement).

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzVJL7xHCPdcNwnHbt.definition: Appellate Filings - Rehearing and Supplements refer to additional documents submitted to a higher court after a decision has been made, including petitions for a rehearing or en banc review, and supplementary papers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RCzlWFvfjmjFHvFcoPw.definition: Lumbar spinal stenosis resulting in compromise of the cauda equina is a condition where narrowing of the spinal canal in the lumbar region causes compression of the cauda equina, a bundle of nerve roots located at the end of the spinal cord. http://lmss.sali.org/RD0eI0kZbrRDzdWWH6W.label: Government Official
http://lmss.sali.org/RD0eI0kZbrRDzdWWH6W.definition: A government official is an individual who holds a position of authority within a governmental organization, either elected or appointed. Their responsibilities vary widely depending on their role and the level of government they serve, but they are generally tasked with implementing laws, managing public services, and representing the interests of their constituents or the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/RD0eQlnhd3jz3LFSNTu.label: Saving Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RD0eQlnhd3jz3LFSNTu.definition: A saving clause is a clause in a contract that preserves certain rights or obligations even if other parts of the contract are found to be invalid or unenforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RD0k9FMiaDhDD2ymOcx.definition: A "Negative Pledge Agreement" is a contractual clause or standalone agreement where a debtor promises not to encumber assets with liens, or offer them as collateral, without the consent of a specific creditor. http://lmss.sali.org/RD0oo5Ny1qyvDZPLYDJ.definition: A truck is a motor vehicle designed to transport cargo, ranging from small pickups to large commercial trucks used for transporting goods.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDAQMAQLYgoUdaKQquA.label: Background Check
http://lmss.sali.org/RDAQMAQLYgoUdaKQquA.definition: A background check is a process through which an individual's personal, criminal, credit, and/or employment history is investigated and verified, typically by an employer, landlord, or other decision-maker. Background checks are often conducted to assess an individual's suitability for employment, housing, or other opportunities, as well as to ensure the safety and security of a workplace or community. Common elements of a background check may include verifying identity, checking criminal records, reviewing credit history, confirming education and employment history, and examining professional licenses or certifications. In many jurisdictions, background checks are regulated by laws such as the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) to protect individual privacy and prevent discrimination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDAhXhTsJ9aWo9fb5MI.label: Meal Break Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDAhXhTsJ9aWo9fb5MI.definition: A meal break violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the legal requirement to provide a duty-free meal break of a certain duration during the workday. The claim typically arises when an employer either denies or interrupts the meal break, does not provide the break in accordance with applicable labor laws, or requires the employee to perform work duties during the meal break. In some cases, employers may also be liable for meal break violations if they do not compensate employees for certain types of work performed during meal breaks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDB03224BF1b7177ab9.label: United States Marshals Service

http://lmss.sali.org/RDEsNxpV351E5TtKBHJ.definition: A Specific Bequest is a provision in a will or trust that designates a particular item or specific piece of property to be given to a designated beneficiary. http://lmss.sali.org/RDEvBLG5q10etxCpBPD.definition: Notarization Management refers to the process of managing and overseeing the authentication and certification of legal documents by a notary public, including the verification of signatures and identities of the parties involved, and the proper execution of the document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFFbc26B23f106826b.label: Bureau of Labor Statistics
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFFbc26B23f106826b.definition: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is a unit of the United States Department of Labor. It is the principal fact-finding agency for the U.S. government in the broad field of labor economics and statistics and serves as a principal agency of the U.S. Federal Statistical System.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFFozWk14Ts7EFMFQ4.label: Liberty Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFFozWk14Ts7EFMFQ4.definition: A Liberty Clause claim is a legal assertion related to the Due Process Clauses of the Fifth and Fourteenth Amendments of the United States Constitution. These clauses prohibit the federal government (Fifth Amendment) and state governments (Fourteenth Amendment) from depriving any person of "life, liberty, or property" without due process of law. A claim involving the Liberty Clause might arise in situations where an individual argues that a government action has unduly restricted their personal freedoms without proper legal procedures or justification.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFL8kZyR3c9ZZnIdis.label: Civil Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFL8kZyR3c9ZZnIdis.definition: Civil Law is a legal system that is primarily based on written codes and statutes, rather than case law. This system emphasizes comprehensive sets of laws that are codified and accessible, guiding judges in applying the law to individual cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFMd9KTufdLa5bOSiM.label: Travel Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFMd9KTufdLa5bOSiM.definition: Travel Expense refers to the costs incurred by an individual or organization for transportation, lodging, meals, and other related expenses while traveling for business or other purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFRFxY94fI8g3YrioL.label: Socialist Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFRFxY94fI8g3YrioL.definition: Socialist Law is a legal system that developed in communist states, primarily based on the principles of Marxism-Leninism. This system emphasizes state ownership of property, centralized planning, and the role of the state in enforcing laws that promote socialist values.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFRUssa9OxEwcySpHx.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFRUssa9OxEwcySpHx.definition: Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) are investment vehicles that represent claims to the cash flows from pools of mortgage loans, primarily residential or commercial properties. Investors in MBS receive periodic payments derived from the principal and interest of the underlying mortgages, offering a means to invest in real estate without direct property ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFS05TC0KeQMxUVL41.label: Public Utility Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFS05TC0KeQMxUVL41.definition: Public Utility Liability is the legal responsibility of a utility company for any harm caused to the public due to their actions or negligence, and falls under the categories of agency and vicarious liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFVNGSUecNr2IRWrum.label: Prisoner Trust Fund Account Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFVNGSUecNr2IRWrum.definition: A Prisoner Trust Fund Account Statement is a financial record of an inmate's account that holds money earned or received while incarcerated, used for purchasing items from the prison commissary or for other approved expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFZ0a18F6aSNTJygcE.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Lonoke Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFZ0a18F6aSNTJygcE.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Lonoke Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lonoke County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFaLEA8xsVvAShHpCm.label: Exculpatory Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFaLEA8xsVvAShHpCm.definition: An exculpatory clause is a type of contractual clause that releases one party from liability for certain actions or events, typically used in situations where one party is assuming a risk.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFd7fIt2iST6CSAzHK.label: Health Care Directive
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFd7fIt2iST6CSAzHK.definition: A Health Care Directive is a legal document that outlines an individual's wishes regarding medical treatment and end-of-life care in the event they become unable to make decisions for themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFg3sCAGTiKXmwjQQ6.label: Mortgagee Failing to Cancel Redeemed Mortgage
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFg3sCAGTiKXmwjQQ6.definition: When a mortgagee fails to cancel a redeemed mortgage, it refers to the legal concept where a lender fails to release a borrower's property from the mortgage lien after the loan has been fully paid off, which can result in legal claims by the borrower against the lender.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFgKHH89MV9zwwkinV.label: 11th Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFgKHH89MV9zwwkinV.definition: An Eleventh Amendment claim is a legal argument asserting that a lawsuit against a state government or its agencies violates the Eleventh Amendment of the United States Constitution, which provides states with sovereign immunity from certain types of lawsuits in federal courts. These claims typically involve disputes over whether a state has consented to be sued or if there are specific exceptions that permit the lawsuit to proceed despite the Eleventh Amendment's protections.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFhkhLQDtnN9dqbZSY.label: Insurance Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFhkhLQDtnN9dqbZSY.definition: Law governing the regulation of insurance products, providers, and contracts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFhtJuTWcY7UZGV9F5.label: Dispute Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFhtJuTWcY7UZGV9F5.definition: Dispute Events refer to the various stages and actions that occur during a legal disagreement between parties, including but not limited to negotiations, mediations, and arbitrations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFlPu4VKGyebs9dqmg.label: Malignant Melanoma
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFlPu4VKGyebs9dqmg.definition: Malignant melanoma is an aggressive type of cancer that originates in melanocytes, the cells responsible for producing melanin, the pigment that gives skin its color. This cancer can develop in the skin, eyes (ocular melanoma), or mucosal surfaces (mucosal melanoma), and is known for its high potential to metastasize to other parts of the body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFmGucxTUBmP6gnVaQ.label: General Economic or Financial Conditions Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFmGucxTUBmP6gnVaQ.definition: General Economic or Financial Conditions Language refers to a provision in a contract that outlines the impact of economic or financial conditions on the agreement, typically used as a carveout to a Material Adverse Effect definition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFnGjQt5EwLENQv2FE.label: Speculation Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFnGjQt5EwLENQv2FE.definition: Speculation Objection is a legal objection raised when a question or testimony calls for an answer based on conjecture or guesswork rather than personal knowledge or facts. It is used to prevent witnesses from providing opinions or conclusions without a proper foundation

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFoKM7HHYoemFKMblV.label: Appearance
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFoKM7HHYoemFKMblV.definition: Appearance refers to a litigation event where a party or their representative appears before a court or tribunal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFtT8VHRZZ9zHgfThM.label: Motion for New Trial - Jury's Passion or Prejudice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFtT8VHRZZ9zHgfThM.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Jury's Passion or Prejudice is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to grant a new trial due to the jury being influenced by emotions or biases rather than the evidence presented.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFveJUxPEC3PsVBaGd.label: Limited Partnership
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFveJUxPEC3PsVBaGd.definition: A Limited Partnership is a business entity that consists of one or more General Partners and one or more Limited Partners. The General Partner may be an individual or an entity, such as a corporation. Typically, the General Partners are liable for any and all of the company's financial obligations, while the Limited Partners possess no liability for the company's debts, obligations or actions. General Partners usually possess all the rights and responsibilities of managing the business entity, including all of its activities and financial matters. They also hold general liability for the debts, obligations, and activities of the Limited Partnership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFwOzDi3E8DQ0OxTKb.label: Antitrust and Competition Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFwOzDi3E8DQ0OxTKb.definition: Law that promotes fair competition between businesses by prohibiting anti-competitive practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDFykS6WHtTXBe9eTuw.label: Railway Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDFykS6WHtTXBe9eTuw.definition: Law that concerns railways and associated legal and business concerns.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDG1DigHnA9gTd942dA.label: Experience Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDG1DigHnA9gTd942dA.definition: Experience Management is the process of capturing, sharing, and utilizing knowledge gained through practical application and personal involvement, within the broader context of Knowledge Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDG2D6aa5zEjErLgRR6.label: Release of Claims Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDG2D6aa5zEjErLgRR6.definition: A Release of Claims Clause is a legal provision that releases one party from any future claims or liabilities related to a specific matter, typically included in a contract or settlement agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDG52XDG7PciceSDs6z.label: Georgia District Court - Bacon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDG52XDG7PciceSDs6z.definition: Georgia District Court - Bacon County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Bacon County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDG5k1MI4paggxoHDpG.label: Civil Cover Sheet
http://lmss.sali.org/RDG5k1MI4paggxoHDpG.definition: A Civil Cover Sheet is a document used in trial court practice to provide basic information about a civil case, such as the parties involved and the nature of the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDG7lQkIHDmB4JptSZI.label: Emotional Incapacity
http://lmss.sali.org/RDG7lQkIHDmB4JptSZI.definition: Emotional incapacity refers to an individual's inability to manage or cope with their emotions effectively, often resulting in difficulty forming or maintaining relationships, making decisions, or participating in daily activities. Emotional incapacity may be considered in certain legal contexts, such as family law or mental health-related cases, to assess a person's competence or decision-making abilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGDqe9RukedToMQPIH.label: UTBMS Codes
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGDqe9RukedToMQPIH.definition: A standardized set of codes used to classify legal services and expenses, with specific subcategories for litigation, mergers and acquisitions, and UK-based services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGEsoao5aZ2ERuRx1s.label: New York Supreme Court - Queens County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGEsoao5aZ2ERuRx1s.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Queens County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Queens County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGIZfcVMbKaH4Q9q1q.label: Bulgarian
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGIZfcVMbKaH4Q9q1q.definition: Bulgarian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Bulgaria and by Bulgarian speakers worldwide.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGIjQ5KFSiL6lvfZWJ.label: Individual Health Insurance Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGIjQ5KFSiL6lvfZWJ.definition: This is a health insurance policy purchased by an individual independently of an employer or government program. Coverage and costs vary widely depending on the plan chosen and the needs of the individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGL2gCEacTZDXEK0m1.label: Solicitation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGL2gCEacTZDXEK0m1.definition: The concept of Solicitation refers to the act of encouraging, requesting, or commanding another person to commit a crime, with the intent that the crime be committed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGOxa3zykBrtkzQH2M.label: Inventory
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGOxa3zykBrtkzQH2M.definition: Inventory refers to the goods or materials that a business holds for the ultimate purpose of resale or production.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGR7PTYD8TltxEq0F8.label: Direct-Examination of Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGR7PTYD8TltxEq0F8.definition: The Direct-Examination of Witness is a legal practice that involves questioning a witness by the party who called them to testify, in order to elicit testimony that supports their case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGU3sieR05Uau7foPN.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Perry County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGU3sieR05Uau7foPN.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Perry County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Perry County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGUE77tzDuRstdi916.label: Professional Association
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGUE77tzDuRstdi916.definition: A Professional Association is an organization founded and operated by professionals who share a common field of expertise or occupation. The association promotes standards, offers networking opportunities, and provides various professional development resources to its members.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGdgxwCGXpkY1zfT2W.label: Tax Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGdgxwCGXpkY1zfT2W.definition: Federal, State, and Local tax law governing the imposition, collection, and administration of taxes by government authorities on individuals, businesses, and other entities, including income tax, corporate tax, sales tax, capital gains tax, estate tax, and international taxation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGfZvjxKkkV1k4WPIt.label: Judeo-Arabic
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGfZvjxKkkV1k4WPIt.definition: Judeo-Arabic is a language that combines elements of Arabic and Hebrew and is used primarily by Jewish communities in Arabic-speaking regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGjZdpYvY4ShyRaUk4.label: Podiatry Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGjZdpYvY4ShyRaUk4.definition: Podiatry Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the negligence or wrongdoing of a podiatrist in the treatment of a patient's foot or ankle.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGqfLUbuwRxUjg3IsH.label: Technical Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGqfLUbuwRxUjg3IsH.definition: Technical Analysis refers to the process of examining and evaluating technical data and information in order to draw conclusions and make recommendations in the context of a legal matter, and is a subcategory of Fact Investigation and Development.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGsmxjwpvJYqbtWhOn.label: Direct Public Offering Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGsmxjwpvJYqbtWhOn.definition: A Direct Public Offering (DPO) is a financial instrument that allows a company to offer its shares directly to the public, often without the need for intermediaries like underwriters or brokers. Unlike traditional Initial Public Offerings (IPOs), a DPO bypasses many of the costly fees and requirements, enabling smaller companies to raise capital more directly from individual investors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGwBeS4gYTapVdJVkh.label: Reserved for local use
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGwBeS4gYTapVdJVkh.definition: Reserved for local use (Language): A term or label that is specific to a particular jurisdiction or organization and is not commonly used outside of that context, within the framework of language as a system of communication.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGxMvEGEtKh6j2sYSI.label: Penis Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGxMvEGEtKh6j2sYSI.definition: Penis cancer is a malignant tumor originating in the tissues of the penis, typically starting in the skin cells or the internal structures of the penis. It can present with symptoms such as growths or sores on the penis, unusual discharge, and bleeding, often requiring treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDGzDAg0NG69tiLGrfu.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Berks County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDGzDAg0NG69tiLGrfu.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court located in Berks County, responsible for administering proceedings related to minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil disputes within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDH4TmBTUfr1cbih6FR.label: Georgia Superior Court - Baldwin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDH4TmBTUfr1cbih6FR.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Baldwin County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Baldwin County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDH4wLod07cxmOXhe8X.label: Out-Of-Town Travel Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RDH4wLod07cxmOXhe8X.definition: Expenses incurred by an individual while traveling outside of their usual place of business, which may include transportation, lodging, meals, and other related costs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDH6PhhXYNXaBHi0DaF.label: Zoning Ordinance
http://lmss.sali.org/RDH6PhhXYNXaBHi0DaF.definition: A Zoning Ordinance is a set of legal regulations adopted by municipal or other local government bodies that specifies the types of land use permitted within certain geographic areas. The ordinance usually includes zoning maps and text detailing the land use regulations for different zones, such as residential, commercial, industrial, and other specialized categories.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDH9WWZMu71xyUZdsXm.label: Description of Assets in Controversy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDH9WWZMu71xyUZdsXm.definition: For a given dispute, a description of the assets that are potentially exposed or subject to recovery.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHJ4Q5iyZp6K8oJKI4.label: Originating Matter
http://lmss.sali.org/RDHJ4Q5iyZp6K8oJKI4.definition: An originating matter refers to a legal case or issue that originates or is initiated within a particular law firm or jurisdiction. This term is used to distinguish cases that are started by the firm from those that are transferred or referred from other sources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHJhfFYcDRaw6JawyE.label: New York Supreme Court - Delaware County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDHJhfFYcDRaw6JawyE.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Delaware County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Delaware County, New York, which is a subordinate court of the New York Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHLOOTVz2R1AolC2vp.label: Tax Total Detail Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RDHLOOTVz2R1AolC2vp.definition: Tax Total Detail Fees refers to the specific fees associated with tax details within an engagement for providing legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHOh7mNzIbwwpeSoSL.definition: A claim for falling on a mopped waxed floor is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injury or harm as a result of slipping and falling on a floor that has been recently mopped and waxed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHjAwlLByKLSxzNMXu.definition: Malayalam is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHqB1dsVPRVK2FvWVg.definition: The law department's administrator for a given matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHv9Tjmp5Fx3nLta0L.definition: A groundwater contamination claim is a legal action seeking compensation for damages caused by the pollution of underground water sources, falling under the category of environmental law claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHxZj9C8S7MdjpOL32.definition: A court located in Sandoval County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHxdKMEfDyzDx5MekF.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Dutchess County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Dutchess County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHxqqccrFgHpo4wXQ7.definition: A Motion to Quash Subpoena is a legal request to invalidate or nullify a subpoena that has been issued by a court or other legal authority, typically on the grounds that it is overly broad, unduly burdensome, or otherwise improper.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHy0fohxdt17f81JKT.label: Georgia Superior Court - Stewart County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDHy0fohxdt17f81JKT.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Stewart County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Stewart County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDHyde1aAtEFya2CPX2.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Hempstead Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDHyde1aAtEFya2CPX2.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Hempstead Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Hempstead County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDI1bEVzANxFwdtMoYL.label: ODR - Human Facilitation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDI1bEVzANxFwdtMoYL.definition: ODR - Human Facilitation refers to the process of resolving disputes online with the assistance of a human facilitator, within the context of an Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Forum.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDI3pNq6Si4QwICRZPu.label: Title to Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RDI3pNq6Si4QwICRZPu.definition: Title to property refers to the legal ownership and right to use, possess, and transfer a particular piece of property, whether real estate or personal property. Holding the title signifies that the person or entity has recognized rights and interests in that property, often evidenced by a deed or similar document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDI5SwYpUkYU0PrqZjB.label: Misstatement of Evidence Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RDI5SwYpUkYU0PrqZjB.definition: A Misstatement of Evidence Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the opposing counsel or a witness has inaccurately represented the evidence on record. This objection seeks to ensure that the evidence is accurately portrayed and understood by courts, factfinders, and decisionmakers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDI9XAYR5hnHirZpvyL.label: Intentional Interference with Prospective Business Relationship
http://lmss.sali.org/RDI9XAYR5hnHirZpvyL.definition: Intentional Interference with Prospective Business Relationship: A tort where a third party intentionally disrupts a business relationship that is likely to occur, causing economic harm to the plaintiff.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDID0cGe2fNM0q91Gft.label: Bulletin
http://lmss.sali.org/RDID0cGe2fNM0q91Gft.definition: A Bulletin, also known as a Newsletter, is a periodic publication distributed to a specific audience, providing news, updates, and information relevant to the readers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDIE7xCNpjTooM42da0.label: Georgia District Court - McIntosh County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDIE7xCNpjTooM42da0.definition: A court located in McIntosh County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.
