http://lmss.sali.org/RDQuQN3mVLJzSmHuOJ0.definition: Automatic Stay Practice refers to the legal practice of obtaining and enforcing an automatic stay, which is a court order that stops creditors from taking certain actions against a debtor or the debtor's property during a bankruptcy proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDQxFX5gW03WCTdtQbA.label: Joint Venture Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDQxFX5gW03WCTdtQbA.definition: A Joint Venture Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of a business arrangement between two or more parties who agree to pool their resources and expertise to achieve a specific goal or project. It defines the terms under which multiple parties collaborate on a specific project or business venture, delineating responsibilities, profit-sharing, and decision-making processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDQy4rbUg82ScgiiXEQ.label: Email Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/RDQy4rbUg82ScgiiXEQ.definition: A communication that occurs via email.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDQzPIGAYAJOycP1PTg.label: Expert Disclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/RDQzPIGAYAJOycP1PTg.definition: Expert Disclosure refers to a document filed in a trial court that contains information about an expert witness and their opinions or findings related to the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR0l4gqvF9gBsdircg.label: Procedural Unconscionability Permitting Contract Rescission
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR0l4gqvF9gBsdircg.definition: Procedural Unconscionability Permitting Contract Rescission: A legal concept that allows a contract to be cancelled due to unfair or oppressive terms or conditions that were imposed upon one party during the formation of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR1AJkDUG6oGrulj8H.label: Petition for Visa for Specialty Occupation Workers from Australia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR1AJkDUG6oGrulj8H.definition: The petition for a visa for specialty occupation workers from Australia (in the U.S., E-3 Visa) allows Australian citizens to work in the destination country (e.g., U.S.) in specialty occupations and requires an employer-sponsored petition along with certain qualifications and documentation

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR1ySU0Df7aSSFS6sb.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Merger Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR1ySU0Df7aSSFS6sb.definition: A claim made in an antitrust case involving the merger of two or more companies that operate in the same market or industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR2XuDtkJLVnUyAZLk.label: Cabbage
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR2XuDtkJLVnUyAZLk.definition: Cabbage is a leafy vegetable from the Brassica oleracea species, characterized by its dense, leafy head and mild, slightly peppery flavor. It is consumed raw or cooked and is valued for its nutritional benefits, including high levels of vitamins C and K, fiber, and antioxidants.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR4CWCtlDVYQookPOW.label: Signage Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR4CWCtlDVYQookPOW.definition: A Signage Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the rules and requirements for displaying signs on a property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR5dI4ShAOiAZuKuJO.label: Tax Tier Amount Tax
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR5dI4ShAOiAZuKuJO.definition: Tax Tier Amount Tax is a subcategory of Tax Tier Detail and refers to the specific amount of tax owed in a given tax tier.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR5wOQPBHqmIfQ0Je7.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Adams County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR5wOQPBHqmIfQ0Je7.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Adams County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR62EhSfFkPJikgF1R.label: Georgia District Court - Baldwin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR62EhSfFkPJikgF1R.definition: Georgia District Court - Baldwin County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Baldwin County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR762ETZykxzu0RfYB.label: Employee Pension and Benefits Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR762ETZykxzu0RfYB.definition: Law governing the establishment, management, and regulation of employee pension plans and workplace benefits, including retirement savings, health insurance, and other entitlements, aimed at protecting employees' rights and ensuring the proper administration of benefit programs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDR8hWYIaoudg2qZmCb.label: Breach of Employment Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RDR8hWYIaoudg2qZmCb.definition: The Breach of Employment Contract is a violation of the terms and conditions agreed upon by an employer and employee, resulting in legal claims and potential damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRCaFxX4hpUklgNnVS.label: Mergers and Acquisitions Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRCaFxX4hpUklgNnVS.definition: Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Objectives refer to the specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions constructed by parties involved in a merger or acquisition transaction, including deal structure, deal size, governing law, jurisdiction, deal protection, closing conditions, remedies, consideration, target industry, and material adverse effect (MAE) language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRGO4SNAI4TgGaTWdT.label: Friulian
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRGO4SNAI4TgGaTWdT.definition: Friulian is a written or spoken structured system of communication that belongs to the Language top-level class and is used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRGTEmt5utZCTjOXRU.label: Hash Identifier
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRGTEmt5utZCTjOXRU.definition: A hash identifier, also known as a document checksum, is a unique alphanumeric code generated by applying a cryptographic hash function to the content of a document or file. This identifier serves as a digital fingerprint, ensuring the integrity and authenticity of the document by allowing any alterations to be easily detected.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRJ2p8Hf5xd65KSlMp.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Westmoreland County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRJ2p8Hf5xd65KSlMp.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court located in Westmoreland County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRKtwDIWw4KlYnDIvL.label: Forfeiture of Deposit Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRKtwDIWw4KlYnDIvL.definition: A forfeiture of deposit clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to keep the deposit paid by the other party if the contract is breached.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRM7rFMjRTVI3Dc4ZP.label: Secured Credit Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRM7rFMjRTVI3Dc4ZP.definition: A UCC Financing Statement is a legal form filed by a secured creditor to give public notice that it has or may have an interest in the personal property of a debtor (a borrower or buyer). This statement is mainly used in the United States under the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) to perfect a security interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRQ8kHj86R1wPX4sdL.label: Romansh
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRQ8kHj86R1wPX4sdL.definition: Romansh is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRT3PxWR7SGOSRucoS.label: Termination of Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRT3PxWR7SGOSRucoS.definition: Termination of public benefit refers to the cessation of financial assistance or services provided to an individual or family under a specific public benefit program. This can occur for various reasons, including exceeding income or asset limits, failing to meet ongoing eligibility requirements, or fraudulent activity, and generally requires formal notification and may offer an appeals process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRVyo42lMH12fyHOhE.label: Counterfeit Identification Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRVyo42lMH12fyHOhE.definition: Counterfeit Identification Management refers to the process of managing and preventing the production and distribution of fake identification documents, such as passports or driver's licenses, in order to protect intellectual property rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRZ05RUD0ScNOff4dj.label: AAA Consumer Arbitration Rules
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRZ05RUD0ScNOff4dj.definition: The AAA Consumer Arbitration Rules are a set of guidelines and procedures established by the American Arbitration Association for resolving disputes between consumers and businesses through arbitration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRa5lUoXHzZDEwMWp3.label: Mining - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRa5lUoXHzZDEwMWp3.definition: A mining real estate asset is a type of property that includes land and any minerals or resources that can be extracted from it, such as coal or gold.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRbMzlHcPhFE796EjE.label: Off-Road Vehicle
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRbMzlHcPhFE796EjE.definition: An off-road vehicle is a type of motorized vehicle specifically designed for use on rough and unpaved terrain. Examples of off-road vehicles include All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs), commonly known as four-wheelers, and dune buggies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRkJH9MROZvuHcG4Q9.label: Kansas District Court - Crawford County, Pittsburg
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRkJH9MROZvuHcG4Q9.definition: Kansas District Court - Crawford County, Pittsburg is a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Crawford County and is located in the city of Pittsburg.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRle33VTACIf5AG2PP.label: Georgia Superior Court - Murray County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRle33VTACIf5AG2PP.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Murray County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Murray County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRpJk0pctY0wgArzOc.label: Hoarseness
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRpJk0pctY0wgArzOc.definition: Hoarseness is a voice disorder characterized by a rough, raspy, or strained vocal quality, often resulting from inflammation, overuse, or irritation of the vocal cords. This condition can cause difficulties in speaking clearly and may be associated with underlying medical issues such as laryngitis, vocal cord nodules, or gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRqzI5PsE3KeAC0Bnu.label: Untenantability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRqzI5PsE3KeAC0Bnu.definition: An untentantability clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to terminate the agreement if the property becomes uninhabitable or unusable for its intended purpose due to circumstances beyond the control of either party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRtdRsP3hE41SciqpJ.label: Capital Infrastructure Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRtdRsP3hE41SciqpJ.definition: Capital Infrastructure Risk is the potential for financial loss or operational disruptions stemming from the failure, damage, or obsolescence of physical assets or structures, such as buildings, equipment, or transportation systems — apart from IT infrastructure (listed separately). These risks can result from natural disasters, accidents, poor maintenance, or insufficient investment in upgrades and replacements, impacting a company or government's ability to function effectively.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDRxFXV3PLnh7otzXO3.label: Total Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/RDRxFXV3PLnh7otzXO3.definition: A total waiver is the complete and voluntary relinquishment of all legal rights or claims associated with a particular entitlement. This waiver is unequivocal and leaves no remaining rights or remedies regarding the subject matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDS7WYdgzmG5Cxsruu1.label: Motion to Enforce Settlement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDS7WYdgzmG5Cxsruu1.definition: A Motion to Enforce Settlement is a legal request made to a court to enforce the terms of a previously agreed upon settlement between parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDS8DPtuFReTFfJ5nGC.label: Goods
http://lmss.sali.org/RDS8DPtuFReTFfJ5nGC.definition: Goods: Tangible or intangible items that are capable of being owned or possessed and that have value or usefulness to their owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSAWe9k1IFytX4jHcL.label: Crisis Management Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSAWe9k1IFytX4jHcL.definition: Crisis Management Practice refers to the specialized legal advisory services aimed at assisting clients in navigating and mitigating the impact of a crisis situation. This practice involves providing strategic advice, legal risk assessment, and comprehensive crisis response planning to ensure clients effectively manage legal challenges arising from crises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSBerlLWg1ntpLqDQn.label: Property & Premises Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSBerlLWg1ntpLqDQn.definition: Property & Premises Liability Claims refer to legal claims made against a property owner or occupier for injuries or damages suffered by individuals on their property due to unsafe or hazardous conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSBwBXfh6AL27SJfxv.label: Arkansas District Court - Hot Spring Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSBwBXfh6AL27SJfxv.definition: A court located in Hot Spring County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSG9aHXNov7sdCs9DT.label: Subpoena Assertion Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSG9aHXNov7sdCs9DT.definition: Subpoena Assertion Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a legal matter related to the assertion of a subpoena, including the preparation, filing, and enforcement of such subpoenas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSGwRwdZg1C8a8u1t2.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Alexander County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSJGnziFiGNbAae0bV.label: Citation to the Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSJGnziFiGNbAae0bV.definition: A document's citations to the record (e.g., exhibits, appendices, deposition transcripts, declarations).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSK8CbOPdmMwMyMIlw.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSK8CbOPdmMwMyMIlw.definition: The New Mexico Magistrate Court is a court within the New Mexico State Courts system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, civil cases, and traffic violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSOXweG6Sol05y3uQX.label: Rules of Appellate Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSOXweG6Sol05y3uQX.definition: A court's body of procedural rules governing appeals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSTWxMJK0mcdxB1oQt.label: Age Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSTWxMJK0mcdxB1oQt.definition: Discrimination against an individual or group based on their age, typically in the workplace or other professional settings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSX126wEHguoKDOWIJ.label: Public Sexual Activity
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSX126wEHguoKDOWIJ.definition: Public Sexual Activity: Engaging in sexual acts or conduct in a public place, which is considered a criminal misdemeanor offense.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSYPGgBlFz5eWNtwoM.label: Decisionmaker for Legal Disputes
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSYPGgBlFz5eWNtwoM.definition: A person, entity, or group that makes legal or factual determinations in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSaSdXEtbnEh5QMsjc.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Essex County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSaSdXEtbnEh5QMsjc.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Essex County is a trial court within the New Jersey court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Essex County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSdOk0bkJNfe4njT2b.label: Patient's Duty to Provide for Own Well-being
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSdOk0bkJNfe4njT2b.definition: Patient's duty to provide for own well-being requires a plaintiff to use reasonable care to provide for their own well-being.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSepz944v79Sc4zhy0.label: Document Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSepz944v79Sc4zhy0.definition: Document attributes refer to the properties or characteristics associated with a document, often used for identification, categorization, sorting, and retrieval. These might include aspects like the document's title, author, creation date, file type, size, and any other metadata that may be useful or relevant to the document's management or organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSk3b6njlCWyMpyaX7.label: Total Amount - Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSk3b6njlCWyMpyaX7.definition: Total, cumulative amount paid in fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSlEZ7FiSZx0V5qw5K.label: Right of Set Off Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSlEZ7FiSZx0V5qw5K.definition: A right of set off clause is a provision in a contract that allows a party to offset or deduct a debt owed to them by the other party from any amount owed to that party under the same contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSmGRMaYfZ97elBp5t.label: Termination Without Cause Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSmGRMaYfZ97elBp5t.definition: A Termination Without Cause Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to end the agreement without providing a reason or justification.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSnnZnBb7V1U8cQnVj.label: M.D. (Doctor of Medicine)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSnnZnBb7V1U8cQnVj.definition: The suffix "M.D." stands for "Doctor of Medicine" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have completed the requisite training and education to practice medicine. This suffix signifies the individual's medical credentials and is commonly used in healthcare settings, academic environments, and formal documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDSy8i7St0wjYKKO1GY.label: Spend Down Strategy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDSy8i7St0wjYKKO1GY.definition: A spend-down strategy refers to the deliberate reduction of personal assets in order to qualify for means-tested public benefits (e.g., Medicaid). The strategy involves incurring allowable medical expenses or transferring assets within legal guidelines to meet the eligibility criteria for assistance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDT0sTxTzy44jempxyH.label: Malicious Criminal Prosecution
http://lmss.sali.org/RDT0sTxTzy44jempxyH.definition: The concept of Malicious Criminal Prosecution refers to the intentional and wrongful initiation of criminal proceedings against an individual without probable cause, with the intention of causing harm or injury to that individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDT0zvh3SyxJG3wU7L1.label: JF20 Obtaining and reviewing documents (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDT0zvh3SyxJG3wU7L1.definition: Obtaining and reviewing documents to determine relevance (applicable to both manual and e-disclosure).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDT5IoSIx0PT2VoHSIg.label: Contractor Negligence Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDT5IoSIx0PT2VoHSIg.definition: A claim made against a contractor for their failure to exercise reasonable care in the construction process, resulting in harm or damage to a party involved in the project.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDT9HdGssfLC6RPAX15.label: Collateral
http://lmss.sali.org/RDT9HdGssfLC6RPAX15.definition: Collateral is an asset or property pledged by a borrower to a lender as security for a loan or other obligation, to mitigate the risk of default. If the borrower fails to meet the obligations, the lender has the right to seize the collateral.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTAI65vxZkLEnbmYBM.label: Justice of the Peace
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTAI65vxZkLEnbmYBM.definition: A judicial officer who in some jurisdictions is permitted to enforce the laws for the preservation of the public peace.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTDXQz4ql3VH1whcDL.label: LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTDXQz4ql3VH1whcDL.definition: A LINE_ITEM_DESCRIPTION is a component of the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard that provides a description of a specific item or service being billed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTGT3HfIlSn9KsUiMt.label: Ultrahazardous Activities
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTGT3HfIlSn9KsUiMt.definition: An activity that is so inherently dangerous that the person engaging in it is strictly liable for any resulting harm, regardless of whether they were negligent or not.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTHgoW8m5JR3krr3sN.label: Burial
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTHgoW8m5JR3krr3sN.definition: Burial is the process of placing a deceased person's body into the ground, typically accompanied by a funeral ceremony. It involves legal and cultural practices that vary widely across different societies and legal systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJ1tqsxUpy2Pr0awP.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Newton Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJ1tqsxUpy2Pr0awP.definition: A court located in Newton County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJZtMRTeYLWXGgOgY.label: Franchise Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJZtMRTeYLWXGgOgY.definition: A Franchise Agreement is a legally binding contract between a franchisor and a franchisee that outlines the terms and conditions of the franchise relationship, including the rights and obligations of both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJh978Kylt2e8dVRt.label: Bihari languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTJh978Kylt2e8dVRt.definition: Bihari languages are a group of languages spoken in the Indian state of Bihar and neighboring regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTLKnK6c4P9b74FFQk.label: Marshallese
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTLKnK6c4P9b74FFQk.definition: Marshallese (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in the Marshall Islands.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTMM3ZoEewjTi905Xi.label: Amended and Restated Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTMM3ZoEewjTi905Xi.definition: An Amended and Restated Agreement Clause is a provision in a legal document that outlines the changes made to an existing agreement and replaces it in its entirety with a new agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTPef6LjCeQg2TUb7a.label: Prevailing Wage
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTPef6LjCeQg2TUb7a.definition: The "Prevailing Wage" is the hourly wage, typically established by government authorities, that is paid to workers in a specific locality or industry for a particular type of labor. It is intended to ensure that workers on government-funded projects or in certain sectors receive a fair and competitive wage, often based on the average wage rates for similar work in the region.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTQjBfa6Pz2zGqI91y.label: Notice of Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTQjBfa6Pz2zGqI91y.definition: A Notice of Hearing is a written communication that informs a party of a scheduled hearing or proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTRvcsDvO0p9ngadut.label: Pharmacovigilance
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTRvcsDvO0p9ngadut.definition: Pharmacovigilance is the scientific and systematic process of monitoring, assessing, detecting, and preventing adverse effects or any other drug-related problems, primarily focusing on the safety of pharmaceutical products after they have been released on the market. It aims to enhance patient care and safety in relation to the use of medicines and to support public health programs by providing reliable, balanced information for the effective assessment of the risk-benefit profile of medicinal products.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTe5WVrJHr2uNV3gCj.label: Florida Circuit Court - Gulf County - 14th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTe5WVrJHr2uNV3gCj.definition: A court located in Gulf County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDThzy2Xz9Qod9RsXB0.label: Arkansas District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDThzy2Xz9Qod9RsXB0.definition: The Arkansas District Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the Arkansas State Courts system, responsible for hearing cases related to civil and criminal matters within specific counties in Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTk2HkCDoobuZxiZmy.label: Psychotic Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTk2HkCDoobuZxiZmy.definition: Psychotic Disorder is a broad category of mental health conditions characterized by a loss of contact with reality, which can manifest through symptoms such as hallucinations, delusions, disorganized thinking, and impaired insight. Individuals with psychotic disorders may experience significant disturbances in perception, thought processes, and behavior, affecting their ability to function in daily life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTkwu3quFACZFZBO4X.label: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Carmel City
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTkwu3quFACZFZBO4X.definition: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Carmel City is a specific court located in Hamilton County, Carmel City, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTssrbZ5NgolOONBAo.label: Public Records Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTssrbZ5NgolOONBAo.definition: A Public Records Act Claim is a legal claim made against a government agency for failure to provide access to public records as required by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDTuEXdt1qP78ZmBC7H.label: Domain Name Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDTuEXdt1qP78ZmBC7H.definition: Domain Name Management refers to the legal management and protection of internet domain names, including registration, transfer, and dispute resolution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDU2osFIfcoIYIGo3mD.label: Minnesota District Court - Lake of the Woods County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDU2osFIfcoIYIGo3mD.definition: Minnesota District Court - Lake of the Woods County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake of the Woods County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDU738SBFrF3AibVH8o.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Juniata County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDU738SBFrF3AibVH8o.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Juniata County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDU9BW2n6MsqEo5mVvf.label: Analysis of Cash Collateral
http://lmss.sali.org/RDU9BW2n6MsqEo5mVvf.definition: Analysis of Cash Collateral refers to the examination and evaluation of the cash or cash equivalents that are pledged as collateral in a legal matter, typically in the context of bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUB3io9lgbCahwrWVg.label: Immigrant Visa for Children and Spouses of Lawful Permanent Residents
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUB3io9lgbCahwrWVg.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Children and Spouses of Lawful Permanent Residents" enables spouses and unmarried children of permanent residents to immigrate and reside in the host country. This visa type facilitates family unity by granting permanent residency status to qualifying family members of lawful permanent residents. In the U.S. a "lawful permanent resident" is the holder of a Green Card.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUDvoBnJWk7AbMAk4b.label: Waiver of Moral Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUDvoBnJWk7AbMAk4b.definition: A Waiver of Moral Rights Clause is a provision in a legal agreement where an individual relinquishes their right to be credited as the author of their work or to object to any changes made to their work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUGVt1vbpSSIVTdHla.label: Progressive Muscular Atrophy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUGVt1vbpSSIVTdHla.definition: Progressive muscular atrophy (PMA) is a neurodegenerative condition characterized by the gradual degeneration and atrophy of lower motor neurons, leading to progressive muscle weakness and wasting. Unlike Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), PMA primarily affects lower motor neurons and often has a slower progression.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUJ8eqUEJJfwh4Yaut.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Opposition
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUJ8eqUEJJfwh4Yaut.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Opposition is a request made to a court to allow additional time beyond the original deadline for a party to submit their opposition to a motion or appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUXLHMIHsq7xxqpPsp.label: Lead Poisoning Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUXLHMIHsq7xxqpPsp.definition: A claim for damages resulting from exposure to toxic levels of lead, typically in the context of personal injury litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUbdvazFHqN6ZAsMwo.label: Continuous Matching Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUbdvazFHqN6ZAsMwo.definition: The Continuous Matching Rights concept refers to the ongoing entitlement of a party to have their rights matched with those of another party, as outlined in the Matching Rights Language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUeVcYpQzvSPm94gCp.label: JC00 Initial and Pre-action protocol work (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUeVcYpQzvSPm94gCp.definition: Work relating to the obtaining of instructions, identification of witnesses, dealing with locus and evidential issues, dealing with and identifying legal issues arising from the case and strategy, and dealing with any protocol related matters, if not covered elsewhere.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUfioNTFPFVT77jjhr.label: Termination of Lease Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUfioNTFPFVT77jjhr.definition: A Termination of Lease Clause is a provision in a lease agreement that outlines the circumstances under which the lease can be terminated before the end of its term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUh2eoTMgiwXCaceBJ.label: Abuse of Discretion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUh2eoTMgiwXCaceBJ.definition: The abuse of discretion is a legal concept that refers to a situation where a judge or other decision-maker has acted in a manner that is unreasonable, arbitrary, or capricious, and has therefore exceeded the bounds of their lawful authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUpsTyXQ0DzRptj7UY.label: Sole Remedy Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUpsTyXQ0DzRptj7UY.definition: A Sole Remedy Clause is a provision in a contract that limits the available remedies to only those specified in the clause, thereby excluding any other legal remedies that may be available.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUw6Gmues6LVh20PiP.label: Florida Circuit Court - Broward County - 17th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUw6Gmues6LVh20PiP.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Broward County (17th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Broward County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDUwV1w6s9IIIXMTIcu.label: A101 Plan and prepare for
http://lmss.sali.org/RDUwV1w6s9IIIXMTIcu.definition: To "Plan and prepare for" (A101) means to engage in activities that involve creating a strategy or course of action in anticipation of a future event or task, as part of a larger set of activities (A100).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDV2029Q3Zi4LQ1ehMJ.label: Patent Concept Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RDV2029Q3Zi4LQ1ehMJ.definition: Patent Concept Objectives encompass key criteria like Novelty, Obviousness, and Inventive Step that an invention must satisfy to be patentable. These objectives ensure the invention is new, non-obvious, and represents a significant step beyond existing knowledge or technology.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDV31y8dF7HZU3rLq8I.label: Petition for Rehearing En Banc
http://lmss.sali.org/RDV31y8dF7HZU3rLq8I.definition: A Petition for Rehearing En Banc is a legal document filed with an appellate court requesting a full panel of judges to review and reconsider a prior decision made by a smaller panel of judges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDV74m3ydS2I72hZ88M.label: Litigation Burdens of Proof
http://lmss.sali.org/RDV74m3ydS2I72hZ88M.definition: Burden that a party must bear to prove its claims, defenses, and/or remedies (e.g., beyond a reasonable doubt, clear and convincing).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDV9p8R7hPvWmMR1Xyi.label: Resisting Arrest
http://lmss.sali.org/RDV9p8R7hPvWmMR1Xyi.definition: Resisting Arrest refers to the act of using force or violence to prevent a law enforcement officer from lawfully arresting or detaining an individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVAkMUqTspkV96S96B.label: Vacated Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVAkMUqTspkV96S96B.definition: The previously effective law has been vacated by some authority (e.g., appellate court, judge, regulator).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVIoY32XuDBB0M2msV.label: Iranian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVIoY32XuDBB0M2msV.definition: Iranian languages are a group of languages spoken in Iran and other parts of the world, including Afghanistan and Tajikistan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVKCF2MYLIH0vHjs8j.label: New York City Court - Plattsburgh
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVKCF2MYLIH0vHjs8j.definition: New York City Court - Plattsburgh is a specific court located in Plattsburgh, New York that falls under the jurisdiction of the larger New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVQLifN70TJSPCRJJL.label: Police Officer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVQLifN70TJSPCRJJL.definition: A member of a police force or other organization of a municipality who is responsible for the prevention and detection of crime and the enforcement of the general criminal laws of the state. Aldazabal v. Carey, 396 N.Y.S.2d 84, 58 A.D.2d 120 (N.Y. App. Div. 1977)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVati6GgBeKY5WWTCE.label: New York City Court - Albany
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVati6GgBeKY5WWTCE.definition: New York City Court - Albany is a specific court located in Albany, New York that falls under the broader category of New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVbjWsWiybGzxviskH.label: Right to Life
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVbjWsWiybGzxviskH.definition: The right to life is a fundamental human right that protects individuals from arbitrary or unlawful deprivation of life. This right is upheld by various international legal instruments, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, and prohibits practices like extrajudicial killings, enforced disappearances, and the death penalty in some contexts

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVdjLF5bcB64xE1k3f.label: Rule Type
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVdjLF5bcB64xE1k3f.definition: A Rule Type is a specific type of Litigation Procedural Rule that outlines the procedures and requirements for a particular type of legal case, such as a pilot case or a case with complex issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVnpktUoB2rpE5n0wQ.label: Legislative Branch
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVnpktUoB2rpE5n0wQ.definition: The legislative branch is responsible for creating, amending, and repealing laws. It is typically composed of one or more bodies, such as a parliament, congress, or assembly, with elected representatives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVr1KEcbWz5PxfUKVm.label: L250 Other Written Motions and Submissions
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVr1KEcbWz5PxfUKVm.definition: A written request or argument submitted to a court or other legal authority during the pre-trial phase of a case, which does not fall under the category of a formal pleading.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVtW9pxx7DVUlXOsBr.label: Underwriter
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVtW9pxx7DVUlXOsBr.definition: An underwriter is an individual or institution that underwrites a financial transaction. Underwriting is the process by which an underwriter takes on financial risk for a fee. The risk most typically involves loans, insurance, or investments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDVwhFhxsnIXL7c4Ids.label: matter_billing_type
http://lmss.sali.org/RDVwhFhxsnIXL7c4Ids.definition:
"Code indicating how the matter is billed.  Valid values and their descriptions are:  
CT - Contingency Fee - When the law firm's fee is based on a percentage of the amount recovered by the law firm client in a plaintiff's action.  
FF - Flat Fee - When the firm is paid a flat fee on the matter only.
GW - Goodwill Work - Where the firm has performed services for free for the client on a matter and provides information on the work performed in a separate $0 invoice to the client.
MPF - Multi-Payor Fees - When the cost of services provided on a matter is split by multiple clients of the firm regardless of any other matter_billing_type that may apply.  
TM - Time & Materials - When the bill is based on hours worked, or where there may be a combination of hourly billing plus a flat fee by task arrangement.
A null value defaults to ""TM"".
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RDW3J82S0DDEwC7sGGF.label: Debtor-In-Possession
http://lmss.sali.org/RDW3J82S0DDEwC7sGGF.definition: A debtor in possession in United States bankruptcy law is a person or corporation who has filed a bankruptcy petition, but remains in possession of property upon which a creditor has a lien or similar security interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDW9GnnMxBDL2FyRntN.label: Motion for Joint Administration
http://lmss.sali.org/RDW9GnnMxBDL2FyRntN.definition: A Motion for Joint Administration is a request made in a bankruptcy case to consolidate multiple related cases into one administrative proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDW9YCTDxlwNXGs7P3q.label: Order, Resolution, or Vote Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDW9YCTDxlwNXGs7P3q.definition: An Order, Resolution, or Vote Clause claim refers to a legal argument challenging the constitutionality of an action taken by a legislative body, such as a Congress or a state legislature, based on the requirements outlined in the Order, Resolution, or Vote Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim asserts that a particular action, such as passing a resolution or adopting a vote, violates the constitutional procedures outlined in the Clause, potentially rendering it invalid or unconstitutional.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWDi7o4XYIl6YajH1X.label: Asset Redeemability Structure
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWDi7o4XYIl6YajH1X.definition: Asset Redeemability Structure indicates whether units of an investment are traded on the secondary market or whether the fund continually stands ready to sell new units and redeem outstanding units on demand. Closed-end units are typically sold on an organized exchange or over-the-counter market and are usually not redeemed, while open-end funds continually sell new units to the public and redeem outstanding units on demand, resulting in fluctuating levels of outstanding capital.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWDmPGg8Rb7SXNFVvW.label: Public Policy and Government Affairs Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWDmPGg8Rb7SXNFVvW.definition: Rules surrounding lobbying and political advocacy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWI8MUWQm1rMjaPbJY.label: Permitted Disclosure Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWI8MUWQm1rMjaPbJY.definition: A Permitted Disclosure Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the sharing of confidential information between parties under certain circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWIJRl0fjTf5Emrkls.label: Request for Physical or Mental Examination
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWIJRl0fjTf5Emrkls.definition: A Request for Physical or Mental Examination is a type of Discovery Document that asks for an individual to undergo a medical examination to provide evidence in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWJGEB9ZSIFtiudFTT.label: Volunteers
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWJGEB9ZSIFtiudFTT.definition: Volunteers, in a military context, are individuals who willingly enlist or offer their services to the armed forces without being conscripted or otherwise compelled. This category encompasses those who join the military of their own accord, often driven by patriotism, career opportunities, or a desire to serve their country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWJZrq8Da9VyYjZnQ2.label: E116 Trial transcripts
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWJZrq8Da9VyYjZnQ2.definition: Trial transcripts (E116) are a type of expense (E100) incurred during legal proceedings, which involve a written or recorded record of the trial proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWM2ZTf9fWHTXZodUL.label: Life or Health Insurance Obtained by Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWM2ZTf9fWHTXZodUL.definition: Life or Health Insurance Obtained by Fraud: Insurance policies for life or health that are acquired through deceitful means, such as providing false information or concealing relevant facts, with the intention of obtaining benefits that would not have been granted otherwise.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWO9e3d1PHVMSpNzlX.label: Admiralty Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWO9e3d1PHVMSpNzlX.definition: An Admiralty Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Admiralty Clause of the United States Constitution. This claim contends that the law or action infringes upon the federal government's exclusive jurisdiction over admiralty and maritime matters, which are governed by the federal admiralty laws, and thus exceeds the authority of the enacting entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWVesCoFAhMWbGonYK.label: Dismissal With Prejudice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWVesCoFAhMWbGonYK.definition: Dismissal with prejudice is a legal ruling that permanently prevents the same case from being brought to court again, due to a decision made on the merits of the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWWq9dPgM6L43mmjO1.label: Motion to Amend Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWWq9dPgM6L43mmjO1.definition: A Motion to Amend Complaint is a formal request made to a court to modify or change the allegations or claims made in a legal complaint.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWZFPdf6vWiJ2dOzUI.label: Debtor Repayment Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWZFPdf6vWiJ2dOzUI.definition: A Debtor Repayment Plan is a legal document that outlines a debtor's proposed plan to repay their debts to creditors, typically filed as part of a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWa2Zxkb8Cm2LvqU1B.label: Statutory Tax Districts Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWa2Zxkb8Cm2LvqU1B.definition: A Statutory Tax Districts Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the specific tax districts that are applicable to the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWbjk2yLNHL2dIZvyg.label: Construction of Buildings Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWbjk2yLNHL2dIZvyg.definition: The Construction of Buildings subsector comprises establishments primarily responsible for the construction of residential and non-residential buildings. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, or maintenance and repairs. The onsite assembly of precut, panelized, and prefabricated buildings and construction of temporary buildings are included in this subsector. Part or all of the production work for which the establishments in this subsector have responsibility may be subcontracted to other construction establishments'usually specialty trade contractors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWljjqIvgyFd309wsZ.label: Caddo
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWljjqIvgyFd309wsZ.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Caddo people, primarily in Oklahoma and Texas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWn66DRoabJ8uDfGxu.label: Chronic Hyperglycemia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWn66DRoabJ8uDfGxu.definition: Chronic Hyperglycemia refers to longstanding abnormally high levels of blood glucose, which leads to long-term diabetic complications by disrupting nerve and blood vessel functioning. This disruption affects multiple body systems, resulting in various complications such as diabetic peripheral neurovascular disease, diabetic retinopathy, coronary artery disease, peripheral vascular disease, diabetic gastroparesis, diabetic nephropathy, poorly healing skin infections, diabetic neuropathies, and cognitive impairments, including depression and anxiety.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWopPyVcjBdC5nr5s8.label: Material Business Change
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWopPyVcjBdC5nr5s8.definition: Material Business Changes refer to significant alterations in a company's structure, operations, or financial position that could substantially impact its value, performance, or risk profile. These changes are often substantial enough to require disclosure to shareholders and potentially regulatory bodies.
examples: Adoption Of A New Business Model
Divestiture Of A Major Business Unit
Significant Change In Product Or Service Offerings
Significant Changes In Financial Structure Or Funding
Substantial Rebranding Or Corporate Identity Change
Substantial Shift In Target Market Or Customer Base

http://lmss.sali.org/RDWrlAT5y1sm1PdlKJz.label: Prosecutor
http://lmss.sali.org/RDWrlAT5y1sm1PdlKJz.definition: A prosecutor is a legal professional responsible for representing the government in criminal cases by presenting evidence, building a case against the defendant, and seeking their conviction. Prosecutors also have a duty to ensure that justice is served and that defendants' rights are upheld throughout the legal process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDX5p4uoAPpgs9Kpcvu.label: Life Estate
http://lmss.sali.org/RDX5p4uoAPpgs9Kpcvu.definition: A Life Estate is a form of property ownership where an individual holds the rights to use, occupy, and benefit from a property for the duration of their life. Upon the individual's death, ownership of the property reverts back to the original owner or a designated remainderman, as stipulated in the life estate agreement

http://lmss.sali.org/RDX6d1gZG7nkRrDFAC6.label: Reckless Driving
http://lmss.sali.org/RDX6d1gZG7nkRrDFAC6.definition: Reckless Driving: A criminal misdemeanor offense that involves operating a vehicle with a willful or wanton disregard for the safety of others on the road.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDX7ApD3ffVkG2puGf5.label: Georgia District Court - Troup County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDX7ApD3ffVkG2puGf5.definition: A court located in Troup County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXAV4XKSeAH6UANaTS.label: Georgia District Court - Effingham County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXAV4XKSeAH6UANaTS.definition: A court located in Effingham County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXGSErk4hb33h7aNUW.label: Aerospace Product and Parts Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXGSErk4hb33h7aNUW.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing aircraft, missiles, space vehicles and their engines, propulsion units, auxiliary equipment, and parts thereof.
