http://lmss.sali.org/RDXWXSTW4ZzVYvqi7SD.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Boone Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXWXSTW4ZzVYvqi7SD.definition: A court located in Boone County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXXLndQ4d5yLcQlwSa.label: Breach of Implied Warranty of Good & Workmanlike Services - Repair & Modification
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXXLndQ4d5yLcQlwSa.definition: The Breach of Implied Warranty of Good & Workmanlike Services - Repair & Modification refers to a violation of the implied promise that a service provider will perform repairs or modifications in a competent and skillful manner, resulting in harm or damages to the recipient of the service.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXYJseFmtwJ0dEJIJe.label: Interstate Commerce Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXYJseFmtwJ0dEJIJe.definition: An Interstate Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation violates the authority of the federal government to regulate commerce among the states. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Interstate Commerce Clause grants Congress the power to regulate trade and commerce that crosses state boundaries, thereby restricting state interference in this domain.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXgmpfUo5dLRVuYC4y.label: LAW_FIRM_ADDRESS_2
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXgmpfUo5dLRVuYC4y.definition: The concept LAW_FIRM_ADDRESS_2 refers to the second line of the address of a law firm and is a component of the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDXkwxIi3KAhHgOwNwZ.label: Emergency Medicine Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDXkwxIi3KAhHgOwNwZ.definition: Negligence or wrongdoing by a medical professional in the emergency medicine setting, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDY4QpsDp1NklR7ZYZK.label: Court Forms Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDY4QpsDp1NklR7ZYZK.definition: Court Forms Management refers to the process of organizing and maintaining legal forms used in court proceedings, including their creation, storage, and retrieval.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDY5JkSXEk1XWFQZSGt.label: Psychiatrist Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDY5JkSXEk1XWFQZSGt.definition: Psychiatrist Negligence refers to a legal claim of medical negligence against a psychiatrist, where the patient alleges that the psychiatrist failed to provide the appropriate standard of care resulting in harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDY8w5WkoSMUU7wnFtp.label: Definition of Environmental Laws Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDY8w5WkoSMUU7wnFtp.definition: A provision in a contract that outlines the legal requirements and obligations related to the protection and preservation of the natural environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYCzvjhh34AUNOOpAC.label: Motion to Set Last Day to File Proofs of Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYCzvjhh34AUNOOpAC.definition: A Motion to Set Last Day to File Proofs of Claim is a request made in a bankruptcy case to establish a deadline for creditors to submit their claims for payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYJvpA4OSIoic83GF6.label: Pennsylvania Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYJvpA4OSIoic83GF6.definition: The Pennsylvania Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Pennsylvania and serves as the final court of appeals for all cases arising in the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYKcS4RxtGZzDW14I2.label: Uncontested Divorce
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYKcS4RxtGZzDW14I2.definition: An Uncontested Divorce is a type of divorce in which both spouses mutually agree on all the key terms and issues related to the dissolution of their marriage. This includes matters such as property division, child custody and support, spousal support, and any other relevant issues. In an uncontested divorce, the spouses often work together to create a settlement agreement, making the divorce process more efficient and less adversarial than a contested divorce.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYLvwR33Ob6p8RPpj8.label: Successor Trustee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYLvwR33Ob6p8RPpj8.definition: A trustee who accepts ownership, power, and responsibility of a trust from a prior trustee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYMGpETSAwljfSaCqH.label: Appellate Filings
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYMGpETSAwljfSaCqH.definition: A document filed by a party in an appellate proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYMSvTzMQvR5oJWYzg.label: Fiduciary Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYMSvTzMQvR5oJWYzg.definition: Fiduciary duty is a legal obligation requiring one party, the fiduciary, to act in the best interest of another party, typically a beneficiary or principal, with loyalty and care. This duty is paramount in relationships involving trust and confidence, such as those between trustees and beneficiaries, corporate directors and shareholders, or financial advisors and clients.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYOJik4Ek7UYqiT9NB.label: Quantum Meruit
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYOJik4Ek7UYqiT9NB.definition: A claim for quantum meruit is a legal action seeking payment for the reasonable value of services or goods provided, when there is no contract or the contract is unenforceable, and is typically brought under the category of equitable relief or quasi-contract claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYPEe8LDb2JFBgJwwq.label: Company Constitution
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYPEe8LDb2JFBgJwwq.definition: A Company Constitution is a legal document that sets out the rules and regulations governing the internal management of a corporation. It is a comprehensive framework encompassing everything from director duties to shareholder rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYRWCSnEAUwPAZRo9i.label: Right of First Refusal Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYRWCSnEAUwPAZRo9i.definition: A Right of First Refusal Agreement (ROFR) is a legal contract that grants a specified party the priority to purchase a particular asset before the owner is allowed to sell the asset to others. This agreement is often utilized in business ventures and real estate transactions to give existing stakeholders a chance to maintain their stake in the face of potential external interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYSyeRap9Wa0DD0GpX.label: JL10 Advocacy (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYSyeRap9Wa0DD0GpX.definition: Preparation by advocates of written and oral openings, closings or skeleton arguments; preparation for examination of witnesses; preparation of and for all applications made during trial;  considering all submissions of other parties; attendance of advocates during trial.  Includes all dealings by advocates with others (e.g. solicitors, clients, witnesses) for these purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYUxkPiLp2EZ5uutWc.label: Motion to Compel
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYUxkPiLp2EZ5uutWc.definition: A Motion to Compel is a legal request made to a court to force the opposing party to comply with a discovery request or court order.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYXJiAhmtnHefLg0ck.label: Sealed Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYXJiAhmtnHefLg0ck.definition: A sealed document is a legal record that is kept confidential and is not accessible to the public or even to parties in a case unless permitted by the court. The sealing of a document restricts its availability to protect sensitive information, trade secrets, or to comply with privacy laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYXXp95X3xGt2LwsMQ.label: Kurdish
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYXXp95X3xGt2LwsMQ.definition: Kurdish (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Kurdish language, used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYfwqvvBji91Apg5Fu.label: Diabetic Ketoacidosis
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYfwqvvBji91Apg5Fu.definition: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) is an acute, potentially life-threatening complication of diabetes mellitus characterized by dangerously high blood glucose levels and acidosis. It results from severe insulin deficiency, which can be caused by missed or inadequate insulin therapy or acute illness. DKA typically requires hospitalization to address complications such as dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, and insulin deficiency. Serious treatment-related complications may include cardiac arrhythmias, intestinal necrosis, and cerebral edema with seizures. Recurrent episodes can stem from mood or eating disorders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYgyZtCDjdZhHjAHrT.label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYgyZtCDjdZhHjAHrT.definition: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord, leading to muscle weakness, atrophy, and eventually paralysis. This condition results in the loss of voluntary muscle control and can impact speaking, swallowing, and breathing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYh2aODcMWS8YJE0zG.label: Military Veteran
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYh2aODcMWS8YJE0zG.definition: A military veteran is an individual who has previously served in the armed forces of a country, including the army, navy, air force, or other branches of service, and has completed their active duty or reserve obligations. Military veterans may have served in various capacities, ranks, and locations during their time in service. In many countries, including the United States, veterans are protected from discrimination and are eligible for various benefits, such as healthcare, education, and employment support, in recognition of their service.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYj1DEoVRVQCqpd9e7.label: Kabyle
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYj1DEoVRVQCqpd9e7.definition: A Berber language spoken by the Kabyle people in Algeria and other parts of North Africa.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYo9GqUF2NekYBK0Yn.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Martin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYo9GqUF2NekYBK0Yn.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Martin County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Martin County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYtKeG7R5P2QWzI0TO.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Appellate Division
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYtKeG7R5P2QWzI0TO.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Appellate Division is a specific court within the New Jersey State Courts system that hears appeals from lower courts and administrative agencies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDYtySFryjreKK7rjGk.label: Vendor Advisory Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RDYtySFryjreKK7rjGk.definition: Vendor Advisory Services refers to professional advice and guidance provided by a consultant or manager to vendors, aimed at improving their business operations and strategies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ14973koe1NCl0Hln.label: Chronic Pulmonary Hypertension
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ14973koe1NCl0Hln.definition: Chronic pulmonary hypertension is a condition characterized by persistently high blood pressure in the pulmonary arteries, which carry blood from the heart to the lungs. This condition leads to increased workload on the right side of the heart and can cause symptoms such as shortness of breath, fatigue, and chest pain.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ5N65rzLMrWP1gdno.label: Minnesota District Court - Cottonwood County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ5N65rzLMrWP1gdno.definition: Minnesota District Court - Cottonwood County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cottonwood County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ6AutVo86NJbp7kaM.label: Federal-Question Jurisdiction
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZ6AutVo86NJbp7kaM.definition: Federal-Question Jurisdiction refers to the authority of federal courts to hear cases that involve federal law or the U.S. Constitution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZAgsukRg0vnJUlTFp.label: Motion for Relief due to Mistake, Inadvertence, Surprise, and Excusable Neglect
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZAgsukRg0vnJUlTFp.definition: A Motion for Relief due to Mistake, Inadvertence, Surprise, and Excusable Neglect is a legal request to the court to set aside a previous order or judgment due to a mistake, oversight, unexpected event, or reasonable excuse.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZD8z35laaMMzT4c2I.label: Change Management Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZD8z35laaMMzT4c2I.definition: Change Management Risk refers to the potential for negative outcomes or disruptions when an organization undergoes transformations, such as implementing new processes, technology, or organizational structures. These risks may arise from poor planning, ineffective communication, resistance to change, or inadequate training, ultimately impacting employee morale, productivity, and the overall success of the change initiative

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZJLfOjb6fGWxLAccP.label: Vegetative State
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZJLfOjb6fGWxLAccP.definition: A vegetative state is a condition in which a person is awake but shows no signs of awareness or response to the environment. It is characterized by the presence of sleep-wake cycles without cognitive function, often resulting from severe brain injury. This concept involves complex issues related to medical decision-making, guardianship, and end-of-life care. Legal challenges may arise in determining the rights and best interests of individuals in a vegetative state, particularly regarding life-sustaining treatments and the recognition of advance directives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZXRFqBEyaZfhzAPC6.label: Afrikaans
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZXRFqBEyaZfhzAPC6.definition: A language spoken in South Africa and Namibia, derived from Dutch and characterized by its use of double negatives and the placement of the verb at the end of a sentence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZheTVf7I18ZoLopiO.label: Mandingo
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZheTVf7I18ZoLopiO.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, including in countries such as Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZn9XqGRUL9FjCb0Ft.label: Acute Leukemia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZn9XqGRUL9FjCb0Ft.definition: Acute leukemia is a rapidly progressing cancer of the blood and bone marrow characterized by an excessive accumulation of immature white blood cells. This condition includes subtypes such as acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), with specific criteria for disability consideration depending on the treatment timeline and residual impairments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZoIYilBH1LmrdwWpa.label: Loss of Spousal Consortium
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZoIYilBH1LmrdwWpa.definition: The loss of the benefits and companionship of a spouse due to injury or death caused by the negligence or wrongful act of another.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZqAEp47Hwg3SOSMpD.label: Firm Partner / Shareholder
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZqAEp47Hwg3SOSMpD.definition: A Firm Partner/Shareholder is a lawyer who holds an ownership interest in a law firm, either as an equity or non-equity partner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZwfs502BqZEX5R8ns.label: Applied Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZwfs502BqZEX5R8ns.definition: The legal authority (e.g., judicial opinion, statute, regulation) has been applied by some decisionmaker (e.g., judge, regulator).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZzBk331JIB0uRonHJ.label: Permanent Injunction
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZzBk331JIB0uRonHJ.definition: A Permanent Injunction is a court order that prohibits a party from performing a specific act or engaging in certain conduct, and remains in effect indefinitely or until modified or dissolved by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDZzr8ea6OmlnWKGtsl.label: US Chapter 9 Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDZzr8ea6OmlnWKGtsl.definition: Chapter 9 bankruptcy is a bankruptcy for municipalities ' cities, towns, counties and school districts, for example. Municipalities that file chapter 9 earn protection from creditors while they develop a plan for adjusting their debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa0Qu7gpJEIhpO0REO.label: Settlement, Demand, and Collection Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa0Qu7gpJEIhpO0REO.definition: Settlement and Demand Practice refers to the legal work performed in the course of a legal matter related to resolving disputes and negotiating settlements, including the drafting and sending of demand letters and the negotiation of settlement agreements, as well as collection of debts and judgments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa0nehxECXxnQM6X3g.label: Senior Citizen Healthcare Coverage
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa0nehxECXxnQM6X3g.definition: This refers to healthcare plans specifically designed to cater to the needs of individuals who are in their senior years, generally those 65 and older. In the U.S., Medicare is the primary provider of healthcare coverage for seniors, offering various plans that include hospital stays, medical services, and prescription drugs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa235W3e4GpNFMzMKx.label: Gujarati
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa235W3e4GpNFMzMKx.definition: Gujarati (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Gujarati-speaking community.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa3bNuK3I8gEb8o8QW.label: Submarine
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa3bNuK3I8gEb8o8QW.definition: A Submarine is a watercraft capable of underwater operation, designed for long-duration submersion and navigation below the surface. Submarines are used for military purposes, scientific research, exploration, and underwater construction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa4bldOTcRUQoNUN6H.label: Discount Amount - Fee or Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa4bldOTcRUQoNUN6H.definition: Discount Amount - Fee or Expense refers to a reduction in the amount charged for legal services or expenses incurred during the engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDa9H7vsP8lgf6xV5Uj.label: Lis Pendens
http://lmss.sali.org/RDa9H7vsP8lgf6xV5Uj.definition: A Lis Pendens is a legal notice filed in the public records to give notice of pending litigation concerning real property, and is considered a provisional remedy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaA16ZI0m8oFDhOhvs.label: End-to-End Case Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaA16ZI0m8oFDhOhvs.definition: End-to-End Case Management refers to the process of managing a legal case from start to finish, including all aspects of litigation management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaG72AxEbSIOleCwu3.label: Anders Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaG72AxEbSIOleCwu3.definition: An Anders Brief is a type of appellate brief filed by court-appointed counsel when they believe there are no non-frivolous issues to raise on appeal and seek to withdraw from representation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaLGYaVeH9E9giCd3M.label: Anti-Money Laundering Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaLGYaVeH9E9giCd3M.definition: An Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Claim arises when an individual or entity is accused of violating regulations designed to prevent and detect money laundering activities. This claim involves allegations of failing to implement adequate controls, procedures, and reporting mechanisms to prevent the laundering of illicit funds.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaMEtpy0Rpk7CVaaje.label: E112 Court fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaMEtpy0Rpk7CVaaje.definition: Court fees are expenses related to the cost of filing and processing legal documents and cases in court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaMa8JZwja0SX59zWG.label: Syndicated
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaMa8JZwja0SX59zWG.definition: Syndicated refers to a financial arrangement where multiple lenders or investors jointly provide funds to a borrower or project, sharing the associated risks and returns. This structure is commonly used in large loans, debt issues, or investments that exceed the capacity or risk tolerance of a single lender or investor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaNIjG3Bz5mnMEssDH.label: Rules of Civil Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaNIjG3Bz5mnMEssDH.definition: A court's body of procedural rules governing criminal actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaOGV6LGc4JwU1Wti9.label: Scenic and Sightseeing Transportation Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaOGV6LGc4JwU1Wti9.definition: Industries in this group utilize transportation equipment to provide recreation and entertainment. These activities have a production process distinct from passenger transportation carried out for the purpose of other types of for-hire transportation. transport may be by ground, air, rail water or other means. This process does not emphasize efficient transportation; in fact, such activities often use obsolete vehicles, such as steam trains, to provide some extra ambiance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaSB2jPSyxhENCWJMx.label: JJ40 Applications concerning evidence (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaSB2jPSyxhENCWJMx.definition: Work performed related to applications concerning evidence

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaTRqpmFIMnCLfvJny.label: Motion to Remove to State Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaTRqpmFIMnCLfvJny.definition: A Motion to Remove to State Court is a legal request to transfer a case from a federal court to a state court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaX0mn1Z8fDrW3Zkzp.label: Illegal Re-Entry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaX0mn1Z8fDrW3Zkzp.definition: The concept of "Illegal Re-Entry" refers to the act of a person who has been deported from a country, returning to that country without proper authorization, which is considered a crime against the government and falls under the category of immigration claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDadGXcBW7U3XjPOj3R.label: 443 Housing/Accommodations (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDadGXcBW7U3XjPOj3R.definition: Action filed under the Fair Housing Act (Title VII), 42 U.S.C. § 3601 & 3602.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaeVI4hTfVRmOF5apR.label: New York City Court - Beacon
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaeVI4hTfVRmOF5apR.definition: A court located in Beacon, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaew5hGoYnj0f4z1JG.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Stone County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaew5hGoYnj0f4z1JG.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Stone County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal cases within Stone County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDahKqXGI4trE9V8iw0.label: Rules Binding Lawyers
http://lmss.sali.org/RDahKqXGI4trE9V8iw0.definition: "Rules binding lawyers" refer to the set of ethical, procedural, and evidentiary regulations that govern the conduct and practice of attorneys. These rules include professional responsibility standards, civil and criminal procedure rules, and evidence rules, all of which guide lawyers in their representation of clients, litigation processes, and courtroom conduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaigFnprDRzy8eup60.label: Macedonian
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaigFnprDRzy8eup60.definition: Macedonian (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Macedonian region.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDajhASEYQna0SEDI7A.label: Community Property Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDajhASEYQna0SEDI7A.definition: A community property claim relates to the legal concept of community property in certain jurisdictions. In divorce or dissolution of a marriage, community property refers to assets and debts acquired during the marriage that are considered jointly owned by both spouses. A community property claim involves asserting a legal right to an equitable division of these shared assets and liabilities between the divorcing parties

http://lmss.sali.org/RDajnccd65kNvgaHQuk.label: Yiddish
http://lmss.sali.org/RDajnccd65kNvgaHQuk.definition: Yiddish is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a language used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDam6s9rjtisocy1Cr2.label: Georgia District Court - Mitchell County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDam6s9rjtisocy1Cr2.definition: Georgia District Court - Mitchell County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Mitchell County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDarLVBaNH9SetGsvZF.label: Kansas District Court - Montgomery County, Independence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDarLVBaNH9SetGsvZF.definition: The Kansas District Court - Montgomery County, Independence is a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Montgomery County, Kansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDasa2GPMH7sK8GqVU6.label: Land Dayak languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDasa2GPMH7sK8GqVU6.definition: Land Dayak languages are a group of languages spoken by the indigenous Dayak people in Borneo, characterized by their unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDasuhtvHEXMxv6E0Jf.label: Georgia Superior Court - Burke County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDasuhtvHEXMxv6E0Jf.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Burke County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Burke County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDatLu9dZnKX5r6ztRW.label: Buddhist Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDatLu9dZnKX5r6ztRW.definition: The Buddhist religion is a spiritual tradition and philosophical system originating in ancient India, centered around the teachings of Siddhartha Gautama, known as the Buddha. In legal contexts, it may relate to the recognition of Buddhist principles in laws, the protection of Buddhist religious practices and sites, and the accommodation of Buddhist beliefs in various legal frameworks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDaw97JTKnRKAoTAu6u.label: German, Old High
http://lmss.sali.org/RDaw97JTKnRKAoTAu6u.definition: Old High German (ca.750-1050) is a historical language that was spoken in parts of Europe during the early Middle Ages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDb5NaTE1GUBVmvGsTg.label: Matter Resolution
http://lmss.sali.org/RDb5NaTE1GUBVmvGsTg.definition: A matter's resolution — the point at which the legal matter is resolved. Some Providers refer to this as a "pencils down" period. This event may differ from `Matter Closure`, which may occur later.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDb7NPu0QbGvP11RGfP.label: Interlingue; Occidental
http://lmss.sali.org/RDb7NPu0QbGvP11RGfP.definition: A constructed language designed to be easy to learn and understand, with a simplified grammar and vocabulary, intended for use as a universal second language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDb7mHsQQLLSVsxIdQi.label: Labor Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RDb7mHsQQLLSVsxIdQi.definition: Labor rights are the legal and social protections designed to ensure fair treatment, equitable wages, and safe working conditions for workers. These rights can include the freedom to organize and join labor unions, the right to collective bargaining, and protection from unlawful discrimination or harassment in the workplace.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDb8aZxNJsmCvQGbfiF.label: Real Property Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDb8aZxNJsmCvQGbfiF.definition: Law that governs the various forms of ownership and tenancy in real property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbAKgnNWH9gfbPfjrq.label: Georgia Superior Court - Union County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbAKgnNWH9gfbPfjrq.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Union County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Union County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbDt5n4osubVafgim4.label: Broker-Dealer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbDt5n4osubVafgim4.definition: A Broker-Dealer is a financial firm or individual that buys and sells securities on behalf of clients (acting as a broker) or for its own account (acting as a dealer). Broker-dealers are essential in facilitating securities transactions, providing market liquidity, and offering investment advice and services to individual and institutional investors.
examples: Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC: An investment bank with broker-dealer operations facilitating securities trading and market making.
Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC: A global financial services firm offering broker-dealer services among other financial solutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbLAS6qswjO9THxoH0.label: Ocularist Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbLAS6qswjO9THxoH0.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by an ocularist, such as improper fitting or fabrication of an artificial eye, resulting in harm to the patient, which may give rise to a medical malpractice claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbPkac12BNESLyUsRj.label: Job Search
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbPkac12BNESLyUsRj.definition: Job search refers to the process of looking for employment opportunities in a specific field or industry. This activity often involves creating a resume, applying for jobs through various channels such as online job boards or company websites, networking, and participating in interviews. It is frequently a requirement for receiving certain types of public benefits, such as unemployment insurance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbPxkhMd0cybxwkTWi.label: US Chapter 11 - Small Business Debtors
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbPxkhMd0cybxwkTWi.definition: Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code allows small businesses to restructure their debts while continuing operations under court supervision. It provides a mechanism for small businesses to create a repayment plan to satisfy creditors and emerge as a viable entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbTsm6UiUkrXtgSq8h.label: Georgia Superior Court - Fayette County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbTsm6UiUkrXtgSq8h.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Fayette County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within Fayette County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbYhA2hITtFSxcbyAd.label: Special Economic Zone
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbYhA2hITtFSxcbyAd.definition: A Special Economic Zone (SEZ) is a designated geographic area that is subject to unique economic regulations and policies, distinct from the rest of the geography, to promote foreign investment, economic growth, and job creation. These zones often offer tax incentives, simplified export-import procedures, and other regulatory relaxations to attract businesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbaJ11MNLGfMNxu3S9.label: 690 Other Nature of Suit (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbaJ11MNLGfMNxu3S9.definition: Action primarily based on Acts or Bills that cannot be classified under any other nature of suit, such as: Endangered Species Act, Federal Hazardous Substance Act 15:1261, Game & Wildlife Act 15:256C et seq. (Penalty), Federal Trade Commission Act 15:41-51 (Penalty), Federal Coal Mine Health & Safety Act 30:801 et seq. (Penalty), Load Line Act 46:85-85G, McGuire Bill (Federal Fair Trade) 15:45L Penalty, Marihuana Tax Act 50 STAT 551, Motorboat Act 46:526-526T, National Traffic & Motor Vehicle Safety Act penalty 49:1655, Veterans' Benefit Act, Title 38 Penalty.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbbUJ2GU3xWVdXFDTf.label: Women's Suffrage Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbbUJ2GU3xWVdXFDTf.definition: A Women's Suffrage claim is a legal assertion that a government has denied or restricted the right to vote to citizens on the basis of sex, effectively providing women the right to vote.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbbqAnmYyVrvQ9aMcR.label: Assumption of Lease Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbbqAnmYyVrvQ9aMcR.definition: An Assumption of Lease Clause is a provision in a contract that obligates a party to take over the rights and obligations of an existing lease agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbhplt4ns4BXyfsWO3.label: Liability for Breach of Contract Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbhplt4ns4BXyfsWO3.definition: Liability for Breach of Contract Clause refers to the legal responsibility that arises when a party fails to fulfill their obligations as outlined in a specific clause within a contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbm4Kfsl4eSMWiwIMs.label: Production of Documents Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbm4Kfsl4eSMWiwIMs.definition: The Production of Documents Practice refers to the specific legal practice of collecting and producing documents in the course of a legal matter, which falls under the broader category of Document Collection and Production Practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbn4C7kOPV11Bo2PwV.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Monroe County (20th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbrzFzgheftqJ09xcT.label: Recognition of Foreign Restructuring Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbrzFzgheftqJ09xcT.definition: Recognition of foreign restructuring involves the acknowledgment and enforcement of a foreign insolvency proceeding by domestic courts. In the U.S., Chapter 15 of the Bankruptcy Code facilitates this process, allowing foreign debtors to access U.S. courts to protect their assets and restructure their debts under international cooperation principles.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbwTZhFW2BCJ7Svgud.label: Reverse Mortgage Foreclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbwTZhFW2BCJ7Svgud.definition: Reverse Mortgage Foreclosure is the legal process in which a lender takes possession of a property after the borrower, typically an older homeowner, fails to meet the conditions of the reverse mortgage agreement. This can occur due to reasons like the death of the borrower, failure to pay property taxes or insurance, or permanently moving out of the home. The property is then sold to repay the loan balance and any associated costs

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbyX1SuwIsejbZGgdJ.label: Agent’s Liability for Principal’s Obligation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbyX1SuwIsejbZGgdJ.definition: The concept of "Agent's Liability for Principal's Obligation" refers to the legal responsibility of an agent to fulfill the obligations of their principal, such as paying debts or fulfilling contracts, and being held liable for any failure to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDbz1PVc6y57oOb9jAI.label: Civil Remedies / Relief Sought
http://lmss.sali.org/RDbz1PVc6y57oOb9jAI.definition: Civil Remedies/Relief Sought refers to the legal actions or requests made by a party in a civil litigation case to obtain a specific remedy or relief, such as monetary damages, injunctions, or declaratory judgments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc0eHNQ19MPBBKXzPj.label: Retaliatory Constructive Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc0eHNQ19MPBBKXzPj.definition: An employer's action of making working conditions intolerable for an employee with the intention of forcing them to quit, in response to the employee's protected activity, such as reporting discrimination or harassment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc18tvw80m2XZa1y9Q.label: Central Khmer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc18tvw80m2XZa1y9Q.definition: Central Khmer is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in Cambodia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc33cOIljrKrMeiGE5.label: Vacancy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc33cOIljrKrMeiGE5.definition: Vacancy refers to the state of a property or space being unoccupied or not in use. This can occur in both residential and commercial real estate, indicating that no tenant or occupant currently resides or operates in the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc5b4bhho0ZlS639sc.label: Indiana Superior Court - Montgomery County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc5b4bhho0ZlS639sc.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Montgomery County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Montgomery County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc5eGHNVYIXrZ2LUlE.label: Legend On Stock Certificates Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc5eGHNVYIXrZ2LUlE.definition: A Legend On Stock Certificates Clause is a contractual clause that requires certain information to be printed on stock certificates, such as restrictions on transfer or ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc7piSp7AQVVtZbWrc.label: Prime Brokerage Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc7piSp7AQVVtZbWrc.definition: A Prime Brokerage Agreement is a contract between a prime brokerage firm and a client, usually a large institutional investor such as a hedge fund, wherein the firm agrees to provide a range of services. These services often include securities lending, leveraged trade execution, cash management, and custodial services, tailored to support the client's investment operations and risk management strategies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDc9DVnOHM4a1xADu1l.label: Nation-Provided Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RDc9DVnOHM4a1xADu1l.definition: Nation-provided public benefit refers to social assistance programs that are administered and funded by a country's federal or national government. Examples include national healthcare systems, unemployment insurance, and pension schemes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcEbdiv7bBBmCCHnuf.label: Wolof
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcEbdiv7bBBmCCHnuf.definition: Wolof is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, and is a language used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcHMoS3C5uaJBjMXbu.label: Big Valley Band of Pomo Indians of the Big Valley Rancheria

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcMYLM1s52QUHMUqXH.label: Mississippi Court of Chancery
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcMYLM1s52QUHMUqXH.definition: The Mississippi Court of Chancery is a specific court within the Mississippi State Courts system that has jurisdiction over equity cases, such as trusts and estates, and is responsible for administering proceedings related to those cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcQ2WqIyuInoKQbith.label: Cumulative Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcQ2WqIyuInoKQbith.definition: An Objection to Cumulative Evidence is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the evidence being presented is repetitive and does not add any new information to the case. This objection aims to prevent the unnecessary prolongation of the proceeding and to avoid undue emphasis on certain evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcQeRUeRBFv6LAUqv2.label: Consignee Liability for Damaged Art
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcQeRUeRBFv6LAUqv2.definition: The legal responsibility of the recipient of art to compensate for any damage that occurs during transportation or storage, as a subset of the broader concept of agent liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcVpfRrSd4FwqGHfy1.label: Tibetan
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcVpfRrSd4FwqGHfy1.definition: A language spoken in Tibet and surrounding regions, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcYekhTJ86j75m36NI.label: Florida County Court - Okeechobee County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcYekhTJ86j75m36NI.definition: A court located in Okeechobee County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within the county.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcaloxNRJ4e7P8ZOTe.label: UTBMS MF31 Executive Compensation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcaloxNRJ4e7P8ZOTe.definition: UTBMS MF31 Executive Compensation refers to a specific code within the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) classification system used to categorize legal services related to executive compensation in corporate mergers and acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDciV0KcilNdHNXFnci.label: Specialized Design Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDciV0KcilNdHNXFnci.definition: This industry group comprises establishments providing specialized design services (except architectural, engineering, and computer systems design).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcixojGy0LiH0RgM0k.label: Motion in Limine to Exclude Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcixojGy0LiH0RgM0k.definition: A Motion in Limine to Exclude Evidence is a request made by a party in a legal case to prevent certain evidence from being presented at trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcp1lVjFmVYqh4GNn2.label: Khasi
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcp1lVjFmVYqh4GNn2.definition: Khasi is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in parts of India and Bangladesh.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcp2uVE5L0VTqsmiMb.label: Oromo
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcp2uVE5L0VTqsmiMb.definition: A language spoken by the Oromo people, primarily in Ethiopia and Kenya.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcqZjm5IuSM32Fwao0.label: Interference with Economic Relations
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcqZjm5IuSM32Fwao0.definition: The concept of Interference with Economic Relations refers to the intentional and unjustified interference with a business relationship or contract, resulting in economic harm to one or more parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcuchgTocD4ty3Tubg.label: Vague and Ambiguous Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcuchgTocD4ty3Tubg.definition: A Vague and Ambiguous Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question posed by the opposing counsel is unclear, lacks specificity, or could be interpreted in multiple ways. This objection aims to ensure that questions are precise and understandable, facilitating accurate and relevant responses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcwQ9CINEnNEXwDxXr.label: Reentry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcwQ9CINEnNEXwDxXr.definition: The concept of "Reentry" refers to the process of a tenant returning to a rental property after being evicted or leaving voluntarily, and the legal issues that may arise in relation to this return.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcxWpNdzt0WrHF3moX.label: Probate Reason of Modification/Change in Guardianship or Conservatorship
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcxWpNdzt0WrHF3moX.definition: A Probate Reason of Modification/Change in Guardianship or Conservatorship refers to the specific reason for a subsequent probate filing related to a change or modification in the appointed guardian or conservator for an individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcyKarip8O7CgJJ308.label: Commodities Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcyKarip8O7CgJJ308.definition: Law governing commodities and futures trading activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDcz315eBeqG5wSi2Vt.label: Emergency Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/RDcz315eBeqG5wSi2Vt.definition: Defendant did not have to obtain the patient's informed consent to perform the medical procedure because an emergency existed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDd4jyF4IYVDSohWIK7.label: Non-Litigation Recovery Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDd4jyF4IYVDSohWIK7.definition: A Non-Litigation Recovery Practice is a specialized area of legal practice that involves the analysis and recovery of assets outside of the courtroom setting.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDd58dXFjZCGxvrOQhl.label: Salvage
http://lmss.sali.org/RDd58dXFjZCGxvrOQhl.definition: The concept of Salvage refers to the legal remedy of recovering property or goods that have been lost or damaged, typically through the efforts of a third party who is entitled to compensation for their services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDd63DtLij8pHg8wXM6.label: Class Action Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDd63DtLij8pHg8wXM6.definition: A Class Action Notice is a formal written communication that informs a group of people that they are part of a legal action and provides them with information about their rights and options in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDd8gfLHyG7F1G8TyO9.label: Washington Superior Court - Spokane County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDd8gfLHyG7F1G8TyO9.definition: Washington Superior Court - Spokane County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Washington, located in Spokane County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdFGHseVXqGwd7WX5P.label: Ransomware Attack
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdFGHseVXqGwd7WX5P.definition: In a ransomware attack, malicious software encrypts a victim's data and demands payment (usually in cryptocurrency) to restore access. Failure to pay often results in the permanent loss of the encrypted data.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdGnNOWg4a966477kS.label: Cybersecurity Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdGnNOWg4a966477kS.definition: Failure to exercise reasonable care in protecting computer systems and data from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction, resulting in harm or damage to individuals or organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdLo2isiJ66JtQdLPn.label: Hobbies Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdLo2isiJ66JtQdLPn.definition: The hobbies market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in activities and products related to leisure and recreational pursuits. This segment encompasses products and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek to engage in hobbies for relaxation, enjoyment, and personal fulfillment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdLpxBmvfUPIxQmbfo.label: Municipal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdLpxBmvfUPIxQmbfo.definition: A Municipal Court is a type of court that has jurisdiction over cases involving violations of local ordinances and state laws within a specific city or town.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdMucRftztKt4Ag7Wz.label: Intellectual Property Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdMucRftztKt4Ag7Wz.definition: Law protecting the legal rights to inventions, designs, and artistic works.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdRprjbOuL8IayaYIO.label: Minnesota District Court - Waseca County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdRprjbOuL8IayaYIO.definition: Minnesota District Court - Waseca County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Waseca County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdUp8HFRm79ET8eCVi.label: Consular Dependent Application
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdUp8HFRm79ET8eCVi.definition: "Consular Dependent Application" relates to the process by which family members of valid non-immigrant visa holders (in the U.S., A-1, A-2, A-3) apply for their own visas to accompany the principal visa holder to the destination country (e.g., U.S.).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdWdXWcG2Ct2hdCwts.label: Early Termination Right Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdWdXWcG2Ct2hdCwts.definition: An Early Termination Right Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one or both parties to end the agreement before its scheduled expiration date under certain circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdYYplUqDM91yk1w1J.label: Santee Indian Nation of South Carolina

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdZDW8VIPVbM8gI4n7.label: Article 2 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdZDW8VIPVbM8gI4n7.definition: An Article II claim refers to a legal assertion grounded in the provisions of Article II of the U.S. Constitution, which defines the powers and responsibilities of the Executive Branch, primarily the President. A claim could arise when there's a dispute over the interpretation or application of these powers, including issues related to executive orders, presidential authority, or the conduct of foreign affairs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdbKVTI9bO7vy088NI.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Norfolk County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdbKVTI9bO7vy088NI.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Norfolk County is a court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdgYa5ZbqVnS9aGrOw.label: Corporation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdgYa5ZbqVnS9aGrOw.definition: An organization formed with state governmental approval to act as an artificial person that is empowered with legal rights usually only reserved for individuals, such as to sue and be sued, issue shares of stock to raise funds (unless it is non-profit), own property, hire employees or loan and borrow money.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdjkPGm9qMhNy2gVmY.label: Fee Billed
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdjkPGm9qMhNy2gVmY.definition: Fee Billed: The amount of money charged by a lawyer to a client for legal services rendered, as specified in the engagement fee detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdoEKHOgJY4VjQvAmy.label: Alternative Monthly Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdoEKHOgJY4VjQvAmy.definition: An Alternative Monthly Report is a disclosure document typically filed by insiders or significant shareholders to report on their activities and holdings. It is often required by securities regulators on a monthly basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdonUhn8b2x65zyhSd.label: Treble Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdonUhn8b2x65zyhSd.definition: Treble damages refer to a type of monetary damages that are awarded to a plaintiff in a lawsuit and are three times the amount of actual damages suffered.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdqsk03WML25mgKSsp.label: Other Specific Goods and Services Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdqsk03WML25mgKSsp.definition: Other Specific Goods and Services Tax Payment includes taxes on the extraction of minerals, fossil fuels, and other exhaustible resources from privately-owned deposits or those owned by another government, along with any other unallocable receipts from taxes on specific goods and services. These taxes are typically assessed as a fixed amount per unit of quality or weight, but can also be a percentage of value, and are recorded when the resources are extracted. Payments from the extraction of resources from government-owned deposits are classified as rent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdrEo6jdSjhATSFIyo.label: By Capped Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdrEo6jdSjhATSFIyo.definition: Engagement fee model where the parties agree upon a maximum cost (i.e., “cap”).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdt7BM9BNO95XHQ6o6.label: Civil Court Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdt7BM9BNO95XHQ6o6.definition: A lawsuit; all or some part of a cause heard and determined by a court. Any legal step or action taken at the direction of, or by the authority of a court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdtZm4pPvpzbVPKEXE.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Wright County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdtZm4pPvpzbVPKEXE.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Wright County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Wright County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdyFBvyLgKcKdg3zfv.label: Deed Restriction Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdyFBvyLgKcKdg3zfv.definition: A deed restriction clause is a provision in a contract that limits the use or development of a property, typically in order to maintain certain standards or preserve certain rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdyPvY5xsn96YiRSMn.label: Polymyositis and Dermatomyositis
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdyPvY5xsn96YiRSMn.definition: Polymyositis and dermatomyositis are related disorders that are characterized by an inflammatory process in striated muscle, occurring alone or in association with other autoimmune disorders or malignancy. The most common manifestations are symmetric weakness, and less frequently, pain and tenderness of the proximal limb-girdle (shoulder or pelvic) musculature. There may also be involvement of the cervical, cricopharyngeal, esophageal, intercostal, and diaphragmatic muscles.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDdz3J6xqNZfHwiRt3a.label: Property Surface Right
http://lmss.sali.org/RDdz3J6xqNZfHwiRt3a.definition: Property Surface Right refers to the legal entitlement to use and control the surface of a piece of land, but not the air above it or the minerals below it. This right is often relevant in land leasing situations, such as when the subsurface rights are leased for mineral extraction while the surface rights are used for agricultural or residential purposes

http://lmss.sali.org/RDe0RKU39BlhcyACJW3.label: Contractual Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDe0RKU39BlhcyACJW3.definition: A contract's clauses (e.g., choice of venue, force majeure, disclaimers).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDe2vf3uDT9xFWO9aQv.label: New York City Court - Johnstown
http://lmss.sali.org/RDe2vf3uDT9xFWO9aQv.definition: A court located in Johnstown, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDe37IpVB41x5rfauvn.label: Clawback Provision Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDe37IpVB41x5rfauvn.definition: A Clawback Provision Clause is a contractual clause that allows a party to recover previously paid compensation or benefits from an employee or executive in certain circumstances, such as a financial restatement or misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDe68jx5rJZKxRUio1W.label: Act of Co-employee Not Within the Scope of Employment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDe68jx5rJZKxRUio1W.definition: An act of a fellow employee that falls outside the scope of their job duties and is not related to the employer's business or interests, which may not be compensable under industrial injury claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDe9T6OMBcR00gwdQpF.label: Receipt Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RDe9T6OMBcR00gwdQpF.definition: A Receipt Event refers to when a person or entity receives a letter, filing, or other document in a legal or administrative process. This event marks the point at which the relevant entity or authority officially acknowledges the submission, initiating the subsequent steps in the process, such as review, assessment, or response.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeCr0S9MyVnTKETs4U.label: source_app
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeCr0S9MyVnTKETs4U.definition:
"The name of the program used to generate this invoice, e.g. ""Elite"".  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeH9slXtJOmFPiZhIz.label: Visa for Diplomats and Foreign Government Officials
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeH9slXtJOmFPiZhIz.definition: A visa for diplomats and foreign government officials is a specialized type of visa that allows individuals representing their home country's government to enter another country for official duties. These visas often come with certain privileges and immunities, as outlined by international law, to enable the holders to perform their roles effectively without legal hindrance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeHRgHYGz10XjAP70x.label: Cree
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeHRgHYGz10XjAP70x.definition: A language spoken by the Cree people, which is a member of the Algonquian language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeIfNmaOW4Lj7ALUs2.label: Mortgage Holder Breaching Escrow Obligations
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeIfNmaOW4Lj7ALUs2.definition: The Mortgage Holder Breaching Escrow Obligations concept refers to the situation where a party who holds a mortgage fails to fulfill their obligation to properly manage and disburse funds held in escrow for taxes, insurance, or other related expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeJemYyjpOIYuJ3YXC.label: Civil Union
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeJemYyjpOIYuJ3YXC.definition: A civil union is a legally recognized arrangement similar to marriage, which provides some of the legal and social protections afforded to married couples. However, it may lack some of the federal benefits and recognition that come with marriage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeR0053Q1cPSk9hSjO.label: Accommodation and Food Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeR0053Q1cPSk9hSjO.definition: The Accommodation and Food Services industry group comprises establishments providing customers with lodging and/or preparing meals, snacks, and beverages for immediate consumption. The sector includes both accommodation and food services establishments because the two activities are often combined at the same establishment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeT3IwQX4XRp2NQltD.label: Exchange
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeT3IwQX4XRp2NQltD.definition: An exchange is a marketplace where securities, commodities, derivatives and other financial instruments are traded.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeWjTZogrlt1XvduSP.label: Spousal Support
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeWjTZogrlt1XvduSP.definition: Spousal support refers to the financial assistance provided by one spouse to the other after separation or divorce, typically to maintain the standard of living established during the marriage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeXT5Kv4E7Dr18IlbA.label: Rest Break Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeXT5Kv4E7Dr18IlbA.definition: A rest break violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the legal requirement to provide rest breaks of a certain duration during the workday. The claim typically arises when an employer either denies or interrupts the rest break, does not provide the break in accordance with applicable labor laws, or requires the employee to perform work duties during the rest break. In some cases, employers may also be liable for rest break violations if they do not compensate employees for certain types of work performed during rest breaks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDeZlellOVEkUBkTSbL.label: Student
http://lmss.sali.org/RDeZlellOVEkUBkTSbL.definition: A student is an individual who is enrolled in an educational institution, such as a school, college, or university, for the purpose of acquiring knowledge, skills, and qualifications. Students engage in a structured learning process to pursue academic or vocational goals, typically under the guidance of teachers or instructors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDebWvZPYljGPGcwuhN.label: Missouri Circuit Court - McDonald County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDebWvZPYljGPGcwuhN.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - McDonald County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in McDonald County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDef8aRK4pZQeql9eOh.label: Small Intestine Transplantation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDef8aRK4pZQeql9eOh.definition: Small intestine transplantation is a surgical procedure where a diseased or non-functional small intestine is replaced with a healthy donor intestine. This transplant is typically performed for patients with severe intestinal failure or dysfunction who cannot absorb nutrients effectively through other means.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDefVOzoV0h0oR8Ys3g.label: Breakup Fee Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDefVOzoV0h0oR8Ys3g.definition: A Breakup Fee Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to pay a specified amount of money to the other party if the contract is terminated before completion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDejyPBHivIaQcmk3SJ.label: Commodities - Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RDejyPBHivIaQcmk3SJ.definition: Commodities are basic goods or raw materials that are interchangeable with other goods of the same type and used as a basis for creating other goods and services. As investment assets, they can be traded on exchanges and include metals, energy resources, agricultural products, and more, offering diversification benefits but also subject to market volatility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDesaWHAeV52XIBg1EK.label: Intern
http://lmss.sali.org/RDesaWHAeV52XIBg1EK.definition: An intern is an individual, often a student, who works temporarily for an organization to gain practical experience in a specific industry. Internships can be paid or unpaid and are often seen as a stepping stone to full-time employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDesytbN8TFMKoWlfrw.label: Wetland
http://lmss.sali.org/RDesytbN8TFMKoWlfrw.definition: A Wetland Area is a type of land area characterized by the presence of water, either permanently or seasonally, and hosts specific types of vegetation and wildlife adapted to saturated conditions. Wetland areas are often subject to environmental regulations aimed at their protection, management, and conservation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDf1QQsIRXdoXon43Ls.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Center Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDf1QQsIRXdoXon43Ls.definition: A court located in Marion County, Center Township, Indiana that has limited jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and small claims cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDf1tfWLrzvdgWUXtzX.label: Dual Capacity Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/RDf1tfWLrzvdgWUXtzX.definition: The Dual Capacity Doctrine is a legal concept that allows an injured employee to sue their employer in a capacity other than their employer, such as a manufacturer or seller of a defective product, in addition to receiving workers' compensation benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDf2ErI2PphgXfrRGPp.label: Rights of the Disabled
http://lmss.sali.org/RDf2ErI2PphgXfrRGPp.definition: Rights of the disabled refer to the legal and ethical entitlements designed to ensure that individuals with disabilities have equal access to opportunities and resources, free from discrimination. These rights may include accessible public facilities, reasonable workplace accommodations, and equal educational opportunities, and are often supported by both international treaties and national laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDf4B5E0keYsSuUMn4y.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Greene County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDf4B5E0keYsSuUMn4y.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Greene County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDf4tm45mbz5CHnfIm9.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Gentry County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDf4tm45mbz5CHnfIm9.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Gentry County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Gentry County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfEU8knfMhgMdtzlQO.label: A100 Activities
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfEU8knfMhgMdtzlQO.definition: A100 Activities refer to the specific tasks involved in the UTBMS Litigation code set, including communicating with clients and outside counsel, managing data and files, conducting research, drafting and revising documents, and appearing for/attending hearings or meetings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfPKcyAwOrC1M6ZhHE.label: County Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfPKcyAwOrC1M6ZhHE.definition: County Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a county government for any harm or damage caused to individuals or property due to the actions or negligence of the county or its employees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfQSn0sz23OYcxH4Ny.label: Maine Superior Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfQSn0sz23OYcxH4Ny.definition: The Maine Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction within the Maine State Courts system, with authority to hear civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfQwgEfZY9s4jK5GRX.label: Motion to Dismiss Case for Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfQwgEfZY9s4jK5GRX.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Case for Abuse is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to terminate the proceedings due to the debtor's alleged abuse of the bankruptcy system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfVOYip9VRmSX7YTmk.label: Subject Person Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfVOYip9VRmSX7YTmk.definition: A Subject Person Clause is a clause in a contract that identifies a specific individual or group of individuals who will be affected by the terms of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfVweLrytKI5Xf16Lb.label: Washington Superior Court - Lewis County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfVweLrytKI5Xf16Lb.definition: Washington Superior Court - Lewis County is a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Lewis County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfWR4bW2pSANcrrVnQ.label: New York Supreme Court - St. Lawrence County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfWR4bW2pSANcrrVnQ.definition: The New York Supreme Court - St. Lawrence County is a court of general jurisdiction located in St. Lawrence County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfZqM7f4PqixahPhKn.label: Physical Intrusion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfZqM7f4PqixahPhKn.definition: Physical intrusion, also known as Breaking and entering, is the act of entering a building or other property without authorization. It can also include entering through fraud, threats, or collusion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfdb8MayZaABJg6Qub.label: Variable Rate Dividend Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfdb8MayZaABJg6Qub.definition: Variable Rate Payment, also known as Adjustable Rate Payment, refers to a type of dividend income where the dividend rate is periodically adjusted, typically based on a benchmark yield or market interest rates. This adjustment allows the dividend payments to fluctuate with changing economic conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfdmGR6iPi4k2t6ecI.label: Retail Trade Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfdmGR6iPi4k2t6ecI.definition: The Retail Trade industry group comprises establishments engaged in retailing merchandise, generally without transformation, and rendering services incidental to the sale of merchandise. The retailing process is the final step in the distribution of merchandise; retailers are, therefore, organized to sell merchandise in small quantities to the general public. This sector comprises two main types of retailers: store and nonstore retailers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfeGpPrijZkvT8pR4l.label: Underage Betting
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfeGpPrijZkvT8pR4l.definition: Underage Betting refers to the illegal practice of individuals below the legal age limit participating in gambling activities, either online or at physical venues. This activity violates gambling laws and regulations designed to protect minors from the risks associated with gambling.
