http://lmss.sali.org/RDfing9IpbVPBzKhXt4.label: Finno-Ugrian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfing9IpbVPBzKhXt4.definition: The Finno-Ugrian languages are a group of languages that belong to the Language class and include Finnish, Estonian, and Hungarian, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfnCokk0ZPNcWVRrvb.label: Immigrant Visa for Returning Resident
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfnCokk0ZPNcWVRrvb.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Returning Resident" allows former permanent residents who have lived abroad beyond their visa's permitted duration to re-enter and resume permanent residency. This visa is issued to individuals who can demonstrate that they left the country with intentions to return but faced unforeseen circumstances preventing their timely re-entry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDftFxuGBK7sBFFDQDK.label: Virginia State Bar District Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDftFxuGBK7sBFFDQDK.definition: A Virginia State Bar District Committee is a sub-division of the Virginia State Courts responsible for administering and overseeing legal proceedings within a specific geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDfwCFFw23Fb7WhqmrY.label: Pets
http://lmss.sali.org/RDfwCFFw23Fb7WhqmrY.definition: Pets are domesticated animals kept primarily for companionship, enjoyment, or protection rather than for commercial or agricultural purposes. They include a wide variety of animals such as dogs, cats, birds, and reptiles, each governed by specific regulations and care standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDg788JxNCux1yh8kv0.label: Grand Traverse Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgBS5EeklCPfEekGg8.label: Probate due to Financial Exploitation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgBS5EeklCPfEekGg8.definition: Probate due to Financial Exploitation: The legal process of distributing the assets of a deceased person who was financially exploited during their lifetime, as a reason for filing a probate case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgEiiX23zftUP0Mggf.label: Exclusivity Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgEiiX23zftUP0Mggf.definition: An exclusivity clause is a provision in a contract that restricts one or more parties from engaging in certain activities or relationships with others, as agreed upon in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgGcpXGlTkoTivF8Ol.label: State Legislator
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgGcpXGlTkoTivF8Ol.definition: A State Legislator is an elected official who serves as a member of a state's legislative body, responsible for drafting, debating, and voting on state laws and policies. This individual represents a specific district or constituency within the state and participates in the legislative process, including committee work, budget approval, and oversight of state agencies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgLz1KvQn0YL8W61rW.label: Marital Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgLz1KvQn0YL8W61rW.definition: Marital Status refers to the legal state of being single, married, divorced, separated, or widowed, for an individual person. This concept is considered in several areas of law (e.g., Tax Law, Bankruptcy Law)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgMBlG1guG5IgcW8Mo.label: Excludes National Entitlements
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgMBlG1guG5IgcW8Mo.definition: In immigration law, the term "Does Not Establish Federal Benefits" often appears on identification documents issued by states to indicate that these documents are not sufficient to establish eligibility for federal benefits or entitlements. In the U.S., this is relevant in the context of the Real ID Act, which sets forth the federal standards that state-issued identification must meet for various purposes, including access to certain federally regulated facilities and federal benefits

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgOy1qgbrL03Hwqx3p.label: Washington Superior Court - Douglas County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgOy1qgbrL03Hwqx3p.definition: Washington Superior Court - Douglas County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Douglas County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgVB4WVDZlTPsDrKwK.label: Motion to Supplement Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgVB4WVDZlTPsDrKwK.definition: A Motion to Supplement Record is a formal request made to a higher court to add additional evidence or information to the existing record on appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgWPAyRCiWaRZZ6Moa.label: Document Collection and Production Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgWPAyRCiWaRZZ6Moa.definition: Document Collection and Production Events refer to the events that occur during the process of collecting and producing documents in the context of legal discovery.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgYvcxGFzIpakLIzxX.label: No Contact
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgYvcxGFzIpakLIzxX.definition: No Contact: A condition of a criminal disposition that prohibits any communication or physical contact between the offender and the victim or other specified individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgZFYp1iCuW1Tod7uo.label: Non-Hearsay Out-of-Court Statement Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgZFYp1iCuW1Tod7uo.definition: A Non-Hearsay Out-of-Court Statement Objective refers to a purpose for admitting an out-of-court statement into evidence that does not rely on the truth of the content of the statement itself. This includes statements not offered for the truth of the matter asserted, nonassertive conduct, non-propositions, verbal acts, and "statements" made by a declarant that is not a person, such as a machine or device.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgbjRGvnprxnFm9CAq.label: Curfew, Loitering, and Vagrancy Violations
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgbjRGvnprxnFm9CAq.definition: The violation of a court order, regulation, ordinance, or law requiring the withdrawal of persons from the streets or other specified areas; prohibiting persons from remaining in an area or place in an idle or aimless manner; or prohibiting persons from going from place to place without visible means of support.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgc0ozkPbaLa7zgflN.label: INVOICE_NUMBER
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgc0ozkPbaLa7zgflN.definition: A unique identifier assigned to an invoice, as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgczJfFgWyMd7BE9Qt.label: Cash Management Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgczJfFgWyMd7BE9Qt.definition: A Cash Management Motion is a request made in a bankruptcy case for authorization to continue managing and using cash and financial assets in the ordinary course of business.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgf40X2zWrBd4DCVOa.label: Florida Circuit Court - Lee County - 20th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgf40X2zWrBd4DCVOa.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Lee County (20th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Lee County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgfJ9px8R3zyHRQWsZ.label: Counter-Claimant
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgfJ9px8R3zyHRQWsZ.definition: A person who brings a counterclaim (e.g., a defendant who asserts a claim against a plaintiff).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgjhbmB7dyOPIvBHKk.label: Motor Vehicle Dealership Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgjhbmB7dyOPIvBHKk.definition: Motor Vehicle Dealership Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a car dealership for any harm or damages caused to a customer or third party as a result of the dealership's actions or negligence in the sale or maintenance of a vehicle.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgolAdNltx3eUppC1L.label: War or Terrorism Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgolAdNltx3eUppC1L.definition: War or Terrorism Language refers to clauses in contracts, often in merger and acquisition agreements, that address the implications or consequences of war, acts of terrorism, or related geopolitical events. These provisions can dictate how risks associated with such events are allocated between parties, specify circumstances under which obligations might be suspended or terminated due to these events, or provide conditions for renegotiation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgpIiompgCgCaPKkQz.label: Brokerage Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgpIiompgCgCaPKkQz.definition: A Brokerage Agreement is a contract between an investor and a brokerage firm allowing the latter to act as the investor's agent in buying and selling securities. The agreement stipulates commission fees, account terms, and other conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgrU5wbwPkTSi8eTw4.label: Trainee Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgrU5wbwPkTSi8eTw4.definition: A Trainee Visa is a type of visa that allows foreign nationals to enter a country for the purpose of participating in a training or internship program. This type of visa is often designed to provide individuals with an opportunity to gain practical experience, skills, and knowledge in a specific field.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgtTWZTLwFeKDDYS85.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Sussex County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgtTWZTLwFeKDDYS85.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Sussex County is a specific court within the New Jersey Superior Court Appellate Division that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sussex County, New Jersey.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgxELEkBS4D5jFJwIL.label: Visa for Families of Specialty Occupation Workers from Australia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgxELEkBS4D5jFJwIL.definition: The visa for families of Specialty Occupation Workers from Australia, often associated with the E-3D visa in the United States, allows the spouse and dependent children of an E-3 visa holder to accompany them to the U.S. While the primary E-3 visa holder is authorized to work in a specialty occupation, the family members may also apply for work authorization, subject to certain conditions and limitations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDgzzzXaha6B5WvuEDB.label: Nogai
http://lmss.sali.org/RDgzzzXaha6B5WvuEDB.definition: Nogai is a language that belongs to the Turkic language family and is spoken primarily in Russia and Kazakhstan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDh0fUeo8oXmuCf3hN3.label: Matrimonial Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDh0fUeo8oXmuCf3hN3.definition: Laws relating to marriage, civil unions, and domestic partnerships.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDh40CO7HUNG1LKgW1j.label: 04_3 Bankruptcy (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDh40CO7HUNG1LKgW1j.definition: 04_3 Bankruptcy (PACER NoS) refers to the specific category within the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes that deals with bankruptcy cases filed in federal court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDh5iUj2DUQmAu1pPnA.label: Deficiency Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDh5iUj2DUQmAu1pPnA.definition: A deficiency judgment is a legal ruling issued by a court when the proceeds from the sale of a foreclosed property are insufficient to cover the outstanding debt owed by the borrower to the lender. This judgment allows the lender to pursue the borrower for the remaining balance of the debt after the sale of the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDh5klPaM0KQn7Ll4pP.label: 370 Other Fraud (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDh5klPaM0KQn7Ll4pP.definition: Action primarily based on fraud relating to personal property that cannot be classified under any other nature of suit. (Excludes any property that is not real property)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDh6NKq4ma0Y3KPEiof.label: Motion for Interlocutory Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RDh6NKq4ma0Y3KPEiof.definition: A Motion for Interlocutory Appeal is a request made to a higher court to review a decision made by a trial court before the trial has concluded.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhAMIVyMH4GfvMFXFg.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Quay County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhAMIVyMH4GfvMFXFg.definition: A court located in Quay County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhDrKlGIksdoCcKjnB.label: Fax Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhDrKlGIksdoCcKjnB.definition: A communication that occurs via facsimile (fax).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhKPHl3Ulo5f91mzu2.label: Lockup Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhKPHl3Ulo5f91mzu2.definition: A Lockup Agreement is a contract between a company's insiders and underwriters that prohibits the insiders from selling their shares for a specified period post-initial public offering (IPO). This helps stabilize the stock price after the IPO by preventing an influx of shares onto the market.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhNySrCE4oy0o8qmUl.label: Visa for Spouse of Crime Victim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhNySrCE4oy0o8qmUl.definition: The U-2 Visa is a derivative visa granted to the spouse of a principal U Nonimmigrant Visa holder (U-1 Visa). It allows the spouse to enter and remain in the U.S. as long as the principal U Visa holder maintains their status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhTbfA9WACnFGtRuw8.label: Divorce
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhTbfA9WACnFGtRuw8.definition: The legal process of ending a marriage, either due to fault or without fault, including issues such as property division, child custody, and spousal support.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhTcHUNxUGDRmxL1iJ.label: Agoraphobia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhTcHUNxUGDRmxL1iJ.definition: Agoraphobia is an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense fear of being in situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable during a panic attack. This fear often leads to avoidance of a variety of situations, such as being outside alone, being in a crowd, or traveling in a vehicle, which can significantly impair daily functioning and social interactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhXPkOAHznKvU1lxwL.label: Use of Proceeds Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhXPkOAHznKvU1lxwL.definition: A Use of Proceeds Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies how the funds received from a transaction will be allocated and used.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhZWHoYtGaz11Yejcs.label: Motor Vehicle Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhZWHoYtGaz11Yejcs.definition: Motor Vehicle Negligence refers to a legal claim for damages resulting from the careless or reckless operation of a motor vehicle, which causes injury or harm to another person.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhhApr0eDVle3F076W.label: Finance and Lending Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhhApr0eDVle3F076W.definition: Law supporting the function of providing loans or other financing to businesses or individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhozYsETUMPfcvDb0T.label: Motion to Request Publication of Memorandum Disposition
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhozYsETUMPfcvDb0T.definition: A Motion to Request Publication of Memorandum Disposition is a formal request made to an appellate court to publish a memorandum disposition, which is a written statement summarizing the court's decision, in order to make it available for citation in future cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhuUYGA3gvjmG8Tcig.label: Binding Effect Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhuUYGA3gvjmG8Tcig.definition: A Binding Effect Clause is a clause in a contract that ensures that the terms and obligations of the contract are legally enforceable by all parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDhvWIsvqcsGHZCNoyq.label: Regulatory Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDhvWIsvqcsGHZCNoyq.definition: A regulatory investigation is a formal inquiry conducted by a governmental or regulatory agency to examine whether laws, regulations, or industry standards have been violated. It aims to ensure compliance, enforce rules, and protect public interests in various sectors such as finance, healthcare, and environmental protection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDi3Lq2bR8EsG5eTnSk.label: Sunflowers
http://lmss.sali.org/RDi3Lq2bR8EsG5eTnSk.definition: Sunflowers are flowering plants from the Helianthus annuus species, known for their large, bright yellow blooms and edible seeds. They are cultivated for their seeds, which are used to produce oil, snacks, and bird feed, and are valued for their high nutritional content, including healthy fats and vitamins.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDi7A9GutlkahNHpXCk.label: International Organization Employee Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RDi7A9GutlkahNHpXCk.definition: International Organization Employee Visa is a visa category for employees of designated international organizations (e.g., NATO, World Bank), allowing them to enter the U.S. to perform official duties. This category includes G-1 to G-5 visas, each corresponding to different levels and types of employees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDi9IBe3fXekAYxFM4p.label: Sac and Fox Nation of Missouri in Kansas and Nebraska

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiAXVeZj9z8vfXK65z.label: Motion to Dismiss Charge
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiAXVeZj9z8vfXK65z.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Charge is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to dismiss a specific charge against them, typically due to a lack of evidence or legal basis for the charge.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiBTXGUqnHN38GgNbu.label: Trial Transcripts Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiBTXGUqnHN38GgNbu.definition: Trial Transcripts Expense refers to the costs incurred for obtaining a written or recorded verbatim record of the proceedings that took place during a trial, including the testimony of witnesses, arguments of counsel, and rulings of the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiCXfLKJN3y1Mmr1do.label: Monarch
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiCXfLKJN3y1Mmr1do.definition: A Monarch is a sovereign head of state, typically a king or queen, who reigns over a country or territory by hereditary right or election. This individual holds a position of supreme authority within a monarchy, often serving as both the ceremonial figurehead and, in some cases, an active participant in governance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiDvnKtdnAMatKQuf0.label: Shadow Docket
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiDvnKtdnAMatKQuf0.definition: The Shadow Docket refers to a set of decisions and orders issued by a court (e.g., the Supreme Court of the United States), without full briefing or oral argument. These decisions, often related to emergency appeals and procedural orders, can have significant legal implications but receive less public scrutiny and transparency than cases on the court's regular docket.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiLWlRyvnYVMYqBTsA.label: Matter Commentary
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiLWlRyvnYVMYqBTsA.definition: A Matter Commentary refers to comments or notes provided on a specific legal matter, often related to a filing or application. In the context of immigration, it could involve written remarks, explanations, or clarifications provided alongside documents or submissions to provide additional context or information for the reviewing authorities or parties involved

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiLwtYIecGXBEpLAa0.label: Florida Circuit Court - Citrus County - 5th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiLwtYIecGXBEpLAa0.definition: A court located in Citrus County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiRVLCipn93y5m4Xet.label: Outlicense Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiRVLCipn93y5m4Xet.definition: An outlicense clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to grant a license to use or sell a product or technology to another party outside of the original agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiVfYrNwYdmawA7b4v.label: Receiver
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiVfYrNwYdmawA7b4v.definition: A neutral person (often a professional trustee) appointed by a judge to take charge of the property and business of one of the parties to a lawsuit and receive his/her rents and profits while the right to the moneys has not been finally decided.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiYVKMDZiMUiO6XVCI.label: Invoice Start Date
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiYVKMDZiMUiO6XVCI.definition: The Invoice Start Date is a specific detail within the broader category of Fee Invoice Detail, referring to the date on which invoicing for legal services begins.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDifpD5IXarDdCKxCD7.label: Property Right to Profit
http://lmss.sali.org/RDifpD5IXarDdCKxCD7.definition: In civil law systems, the Right to Profit ("droit de prendre") refers to a real right that allows an individual or entity to enter another's land to extract resources like minerals, timber, or fish. This right is usually granted through a contract or license and is subject to the terms and conditions specified therein, as well as overarching legal regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDigDgTiLFmt7iX3436.label: Dispute Service
http://lmss.sali.org/RDigDgTiLFmt7iX3436.definition: A process that describes a conflict/adversarial event potentially or actually involving a second party. This can include government entity or internal investigation

http://lmss.sali.org/RDign9opONc6uL7W3U2.label: Lower Sioux Indian Community in the State of Minnesota

http://lmss.sali.org/RDin1xJsNqPCl5y7yYS.label: Demotion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDin1xJsNqPCl5y7yYS.definition: Demotion is the reassignment of an employee to a lower rank, position, or salary grade, typically as a disciplinary measure or due to performance issues. This action reduces the employee's responsibilities, authority, and often their compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDiv7JSMR8QXdJG121J.label: Long Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RDiv7JSMR8QXdJG121J.definition: A Long Form is an extensive version of a document that provides detailed terms, conditions, and provisions. It is used in various legal contexts, such as contracts, agreements, and reports, to ensure thorough coverage of all relevant aspects and legal requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDj7pgP2OjIDNhdPGJX.label: Foreign Representative
http://lmss.sali.org/RDj7pgP2OjIDNhdPGJX.definition: A person or body authorized in a foreign proceeding to administer the reorganization or the liquidation of the debtor's assets or affairs or to act as a representative of such foreign proceeding. 11 U.S.C. § 101(24).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjAxpyYpFwGX4QsvKn.label: Drag Along Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjAxpyYpFwGX4QsvKn.definition: A Drag Along Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that allows majority shareholders to force minority shareholders to sell their shares in the company if a certain percentage of the majority shareholders agree to sell their own shares.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjG5GB80UToe2Zfmrn.label: Tortious Breach of Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjG5GB80UToe2Zfmrn.definition: The Tortious Breach of Contract is a legal concept that occurs when one party breaches a contract and causes harm or damages to the other party, resulting in a tort claim in addition to a breach of contract claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjGVtbkpmSvuHjMNBo.label: Adversarial Machine Learning
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjGVtbkpmSvuHjMNBo.definition: Adversarial Machine Learning refers to the study and design of algorithms that can withstand intentional manipulation or adversarial attacks. These attacks aim to deceive machine learning models by supplying deceptive inputs, highlighting vulnerabilities and the need for robust defenses in AI systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjMjjBlt5UcxM5InqA.label: Rescue of Prisoner
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjMjjBlt5UcxM5InqA.definition: The Rescue of Prisoner is a criminal act against the government that involves the unlawful liberation of a person who is being held in custody.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjNHCI7OvgyF5iA8iH.label: Pre-Hearing Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjNHCI7OvgyF5iA8iH.definition: A pre-hearing statement is a written document submitted before a legal proceeding that outlines the facts and arguments that a party intends to present at the hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjOh6OGqNh0VtIkoak.label: Australian languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjOh6OGqNh0VtIkoak.definition: Australian languages are a group of structured systems of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in Australia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjRoem7owEgBlK43ag.label: Loan Consent Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjRoem7owEgBlK43ag.definition: A "Loan Consent Agreement" is a formalized contract that modifies the terms of an existing loan agreement, often requiring the consent of the lender, borrower, and sometimes third parties involved. The document specifies the changes to be made to the original terms, conditions, or covenants of the loan and serves as an official authorization for those modifications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjSwzNAc318saqmjDA.label: Georgia District Court - Fulton County Magistrate Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjSwzNAc318saqmjDA.definition: A court located in Fulton County, Georgia that has limited jurisdiction over certain civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjU8RHQLhUkyz96hGh.label: Parental Leave
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjU8RHQLhUkyz96hGh.definition: Parental leave is a type of leave granted to employees who are becoming parents, either through childbirth or adoption. It allows parents to take time off from work to care for and bond with their new child. Parental leave can be paid or unpaid, depending on company policies and government regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjUoobx1AqjQmI5HwK.label: Heir
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjUoobx1AqjQmI5HwK.definition: An heir is an individual legally entitled to inherit some or all of the estate of a deceased person under the laws of intestacy. The status of an heir typically depends on the relationship to the deceased and the hierarchy of succession established by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjZR2Ci5EFAMKJbMe4.label: Timeshare Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjZR2Ci5EFAMKJbMe4.definition: Timeshares are a form of fractional ownership where multiple parties hold rights to use a property, typically a vacation home or resort unit, for a specific period each year. The ownership structure and usage rights can vary, but generally, timeshare owners are obligated to pay an initial purchase price along with recurring maintenance fees, and they may be able to exchange their timeshare for different locations through a network.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjeyL29mqIZy1eACYH.label: Academic Publisher
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjeyL29mqIZy1eACYH.definition: An academic publisher produces, distributes, and often oversees the peer-review process for scholarly works such as books, journals, and conference proceedings. In the legal field, academic publishers play a crucial role in disseminating legal scholarship, ensuring the quality and integrity of academic discourse by managing the peer-review process, and providing a platform for legal scholars, practitioners, and students to share their research and insights with the broader academic community and professionals in the field.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjfaOqGD56LVxjz7Cg.label: Director Emeritus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjfaOqGD56LVxjz7Cg.definition: A Director Emeritus Clause is a provision in a contract that grants a former director of a company an honorary title and certain privileges, such as attending board meetings, without having any voting rights or responsibilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjgrbYXRnQ1XO9Uq5t.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Tioga County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjgrbYXRnQ1XO9Uq5t.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Tioga County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Tioga County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjmrAnUSooACWGC6eG.label: Estimated Duration
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjmrAnUSooACWGC6eG.definition: The Estimated Duration is a concept within Project Management Objectives that refers to the anticipated length of time required to complete a project or task.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjtOK0ImFu85csCq3M.label: Bankruptcy Disbursement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjtOK0ImFu85csCq3M.definition: The distribution of funds to creditors in a bankruptcy or restructuring event.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDjycdIbGH57Q15ZsiM.label: School Expulsion
http://lmss.sali.org/RDjycdIbGH57Q15ZsiM.definition: School expulsion is a severe disciplinary action taken by educational institutions in response to serious or persistent student misconduct or rule violations. It involves the permanent removal of a student from the school, preventing them from attending classes and participating in school activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkB4hqzLrfXeDv4Ayn.label: Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkB4hqzLrfXeDv4Ayn.definition: An appendix is a document attached to a legal brief or filing that provides additional information or evidence to support the arguments made in the main document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkFM8mILWnb2wlemaY.label: Kansas District Court - Riley County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkFM8mILWnb2wlemaY.definition: A court located in Riley County, Kansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkGGfnhr4K7mNJJahV.label: UTBMS MF40 Environmental
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkGGfnhr4K7mNJJahV.definition: A category within the UTBMS coding system used to classify legal services related to environmental issues in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkHPRJ8epPXSGiWavH.label: Motion to Exclude Hearsay Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkHPRJ8epPXSGiWavH.definition: A Motion to Exclude Hearsay Witness is a legal request to prevent a witness from testifying in court based on the fact that their testimony is based on hearsay evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkIRpvtzD5THQGcZfE.label: Private Placement Memorandum
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkIRpvtzD5THQGcZfE.definition: An Offering Memorandum is a legal document outlining the objectives, risks, and terms of an investment involved in a private offering. It is not registered with public securities regulators and is intended for accredited or sophisticated investors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkKltCs6qv3E5GLBaS.label: Election
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkKltCs6qv3E5GLBaS.definition: An election is a formal decision-making process in which eligible individuals, often referred to as voters, select a choice or representative from among multiple candidates or options. Elections are used in democracies to fill various public offices or decide on legislation and public policy issues, ensuring that the will of the people is reflected in governance and leadership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkLJ6mPMkvoXudc5ms.label: Court-Appointed Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkLJ6mPMkvoXudc5ms.definition: An expert who is appointed by a court, judge, or judicial body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkMmwVhgxwiwuOmif1.label: Failure to Signal Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkMmwVhgxwiwuOmif1.definition: A Failure to Signal Claim involves allegations that a driver has not used proper turn or lane change signals as required by traffic laws, leading potentially to misunderstandings or accidents on the road. Such claims are typically processed through traffic courts or administrative bodies and may result in fines or other penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkMsDzhDxQxUN8FKhO.label: Nil Paid Letters
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkMsDzhDxQxUN8FKhO.definition: Nil Paid Letters, also known as Unpaid Share Subscription Rights, are temporary documents issued by a company offering new shares to existing shareholders. These letters allow shareholders to trade the rights to subscribe to the new shares before payment is required, but they do not represent ownership until the shares are fully paid.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkQo1QSPUFnnAt3IIi.label: Provider First Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkQo1QSPUFnnAt3IIi.definition: The concept of "Provider First Name" refers to the given name of an individual who is a legal services provider.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkRMPTPEu06hA4xUSO.label: Quechua
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkRMPTPEu06hA4xUSO.definition: Quechua is a structured system of communication, both written and spoken, that is used in certain regions of South America and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkRxKHNQx5WN6SKW7M.label: Motion to Deconsolidate Case Association
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkRxKHNQx5WN6SKW7M.definition: A Motion to Deconsolidate Case Association is a request made in a bankruptcy case to separate it from another related case that was previously consolidated, allowing it to proceed independently.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkTQlAysvxJLf1TZYO.label: Estoppel by Deed
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkTQlAysvxJLf1TZYO.definition: A legal principle that prevents a party from denying the truth of a statement made in a deed or other legal document, when that party's previous actions or words have relied upon the truth of that statement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkWZtlhJVbVdxHsT52.label: Reserve Based Lending Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkWZtlhJVbVdxHsT52.definition: Reserve Based Lending Practice involves legal work focused on asset-based lending where the loan is secured by the value of a borrower's reserves.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkY60gHdSvN4pl6vmX.label: Plums
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkY60gHdSvN4pl6vmX.definition: Plums are smooth-skinned stone fruits from the Prunus genus, known for their juicy flesh and sweet-tart flavor. They are consumed fresh, dried as prunes, or used in cooking, baking, and preserves, valued for their vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkZ1f1SIdbFYRwzAad.label: Real Estate Lease
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkZ1f1SIdbFYRwzAad.definition: A Real Estate Lease is a contract wherein the owner (lessor) grants the right to occupy and use their property to another party (lessee) for a specified period in exchange for rental payments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkZBjHchWXuRh8dwpG.label: Demolition
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkZBjHchWXuRh8dwpG.definition: Demolition is the process of tearing down or dismantling a building or structure, often to clear land for new construction or to remove unsafe or obsolete buildings. This process involves various techniques and machinery, including manual labor, wrecking balls, and controlled explosives, to safely and efficiently bring down the structure. The demolition may be the result of a legal proceeding (e.g., condemnation).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDka3Y1Nf4XVfulwZDb.label: Museums, Historical Sites, and Similar Institutions Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDka3Y1Nf4XVfulwZDb.definition: Industries in the Museums, Historical Sites, and Similar Institutions subsector engage in the preservation and exhibition of objects, sites, and natural wonders of historical, cultural, and/or educational value.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkarukhII43Ov0AvgW.label: Application to Defer Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkarukhII43Ov0AvgW.definition: An Application to Defer Fee is a request made in the context of a bankruptcy proceeding to delay payment of a fee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkc9fh6vYvZbJc7ERu.label: L400 Trial Preparation and Trial
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkc9fh6vYvZbJc7ERu.definition: L400 Trial Preparation and Trial refers to the process of preparing for and conducting a trial, including tasks such as drafting written motions, preparing expert witnesses, attending hearings, and making post-trial submissions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkcKVfaV3t8ah0WJGd.label: No Parking Zone Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkcKVfaV3t8ah0WJGd.definition: This infraction takes place when a vehicle is parked in an area explicitly designated as a "No Parking" zone, usually marked by signs or pavement markings. The driver is generally subject to a fine and may also have their vehicle towed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkcbxTTJZnhBvdqxhx.label: Analysis of Vendor Communications
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkcbxTTJZnhBvdqxhx.definition: The concept of Analysis of Vendor Communications refers to the examination and evaluation of communications between a company and its vendors in order to assess the legal implications and potential risks associated with their commercial arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkeXkYjY816eSnxFpP.label: Purpose Specification Principle
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkeXkYjY816eSnxFpP.definition: Purpose Specification is the privacy principle that the purposes for which personal data are collected should be specified not later than at the time of data collection and the subsequent use limited to the fulfilment of those purposes or such others as are not incompatible with those purposes and as are specified on each occasion of change of purpose.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkgSuo1lKCSb4OpDS1.label: Status Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkgSuo1lKCSb4OpDS1.definition: A status report is a written document that provides an update on the current state of a particular matter or situation, typically used in the context of legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkj6GTtRxusz974SJZ.label: Hostile Work Environment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkj6GTtRxusz974SJZ.definition: A Hostile Work Environment is a type of work environment harassment where an employee is subjected to unwelcome and discriminatory behavior or conduct that is severe or pervasive enough to create an intimidating, hostile, or offensive work environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkjjpRFIJCel5zDSHi.label: Telugu
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkjjpRFIJCel5zDSHi.definition: Telugu is a structured system of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, which is a member of the Language class and is primarily spoken in the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkk8gcmuzzzVELKIao.label: Examination Under Oath
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkk8gcmuzzzVELKIao.definition: A formal proceeding often used by insurance companies to obtain information about a claim — usually before a suit is filed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkk9CxYrUrCvDOCrf8.label: Georgia District Court - Early County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkk9CxYrUrCvDOCrf8.definition: Georgia District Court - Early County is a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Early County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDknkUgvOz8oQItOWa7.label: Retention Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDknkUgvOz8oQItOWa7.definition: A Retention Related Agreement is a legally binding contract between an employer and an employee, often a key or high-value employee, with the aim of retaining the employee within the company for a specified period. This type of agreement typically includes provisions for financial incentives, such as bonuses or stock options, and may also outline conditions or obligations the employee must meet to receive these incentives. The primary goal is to encourage employee loyalty and discourage them from leaving the organization during a critical period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkqXQLaqeFlhG4isnk.label: Article 1 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkqXQLaqeFlhG4isnk.definition: An Article I claim refers to a legal argument based on the provisions of Article I of the U.S. Constitution, which outlines the powers, limits, and functions of the legislative branch. Such a claim might arise when there is a dispute over the exercise or limitation of these powers, including matters related to taxation, regulation of commerce, or the creation and enforcement of laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkwKnlvFjjIktxrGok.label: Action Prohibited/Omission Required by the Agreement Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkwKnlvFjjIktxrGok.definition: A requirement to refrain from certain actions or to perform certain omissions as specified in the language of an agreement, which is a carveout from the definition of Material Adverse Effect (MAE).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkwyaka1G06Txgxv0p.label: Discrimination Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkwyaka1G06Txgxv0p.definition: Protection from discrimination on grounds such as race, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, color, age, political affiliation, ethnicity, religion, and disability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkx69t1kBP7tevuzMM.label: LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkx69t1kBP7tevuzMM.definition: LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 is a standardized format for electronic legal invoices, including specific data elements such as invoice date, client name, matter name, timekeeper information, and line item details.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkxy1u3kzfwPuVV7mW.label: Private Attorneys General Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDkxy1u3kzfwPuVV7mW.definition: The Private Attorneys General Act (PAGA) is a California law that allows employees to bring claims on behalf of the state against their employers for labor code violations. By acting as private attorneys general, employees can seek penalties for themselves and their co-workers, thereby helping to enforce labor laws when government agencies may lack the resources to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDkyvakPJOfKkE1fIgG.label: Central Council of the Tlingit and Haida Indian Tribes

http://lmss.sali.org/RDl6QbTQGH1NHhJQIGL.label: Promise to Appear
http://lmss.sali.org/RDl6QbTQGH1NHhJQIGL.definition: A Promise to Appear is a legal document filed in trial court practice that requires a defendant to appear in court at a specified time and date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDl90CtvzlRvgqzOdEV.label: Foster Parent
http://lmss.sali.org/RDl90CtvzlRvgqzOdEV.definition: A parent through the foster-care system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlDfo4nHT5jjHxPDTJ.label: Minnesota District Court - Court of App.
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlDfo4nHT5jjHxPDTJ.definition: Minnesota District Court - Court of App. is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that hears appeals from lower courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlEXekdN0luZyCBy8N.label: New York City Court - Rome
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlEXekdN0luZyCBy8N.definition: A court located in Rome, New York City that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlJbtDLk5qzFpShmHL.label: Dargwa
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlJbtDLk5qzFpShmHL.definition: Dargwa is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in the North Caucasus region of Russia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlLiUerCzhw1bT6PwH.label: Malagasy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlLiUerCzhw1bT6PwH.definition: Malagasy is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, that is specific to the Malagasy people and culture.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMcO2Z8pjPCG9qNdG.label: Sole Proprietorship
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMcO2Z8pjPCG9qNdG.definition: A sole proprietorship, also known as the sole trader, individual entrepreneurship or proprietorship, is a type of enterprise that is owned and run by one person and in which there is no legal distinction between the owner and the business entity. The sole trader receives all profits (subject to taxation specific to the business) and has unlimited responsibility for all losses and debts. Every asset of the business is owned by the proprietor and all debts of the business are the proprietor's. It is a "sole" proprietorship in contrast with partnerships (which have at least two owners).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMcnPEFzMJer6LE0d.label: Government Contracts Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMcnPEFzMJer6LE0d.definition: Laws relating to contracts in which the government is a party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMwQ5nSrgZMByjzjt.label: Government Representative
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlMwQ5nSrgZMByjzjt.definition: A Government Representative refers to any individual who acts on behalf of a governmental body, whether they are an elected official, an appointed official, or a regular employee. The term encompasses a wide range of roles, from high-ranking government officials who make policy decisions to government employees who carry out administrative tasks, all serving the interests of the state or public they represent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlOYpoyiuxcjxw0pEa.label: Storm in Progress
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlOYpoyiuxcjxw0pEa.definition: A "Storm in Progress" is a legal concept within the context of civil defenses and litigation, referring to a situation where a legal matter is currently ongoing and actively being pursued.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlUNUSYsLydg1YtgDP.label: Farmland
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlUNUSYsLydg1YtgDP.definition: In legal services, Farmland relates to areas designated for agricultural activities, with specific legal frameworks for land use, agricultural labor, and contractual agreements for sale or lease. Issues can range from zoning laws to crop patents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlYI2CbQn1u95Hs6ot.label: Committed Relationship Partner
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlYI2CbQn1u95Hs6ot.definition: A Committed Relationship Partner is an individual who is in a stable, long-term relationship characterized by mutual commitment, love, and shared responsibilities, but not necessarily legally recognized as a spouse. This status implies a serious, ongoing partnership that may include cohabitation and joint decision-making in various aspects of life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlbGQZTZoVQjWgt84H.label: Spouse Liable for Other Spouse’s Debt
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlbGQZTZoVQjWgt84H.definition: When one spouse is responsible for the debt of the other spouse, typically due to a joint account or co-signing a loan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlhbcek4X5EXc5Oz0v.label: Pleura or Mediastinum Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlhbcek4X5EXc5Oz0v.definition: Pleura or mediastinum cancer refers to malignant tumors originating in the pleura, the thin tissue covering the lungs and lining the chest cavity, or in the mediastinum, the central compartment of the thoracic cavity. These cancers can significantly affect respiratory function and often require complex diagnostic and therapeutic approaches due to their proximity to vital structures.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDljdV2b9barqaJJzrD.label: JD00 ADR / Settlement (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDljdV2b9barqaJJzrD.definition: Work that is directed to settlement including ADR

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlkcCHHTrvFbBSyra6.label: Prior Identification
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlkcCHHTrvFbBSyra6.definition: Prior Identification is a statement made by a witness identifying a person after perceiving them, which is admissible as non-hearsay evidence if the witness testifies at a trial or hearing and is subject to cross-examination concerning the statement. This rule allows for the admission of identification statements made by a witness during or shortly after observing the person in question, including statements made while identifying the person in a photo or lineup.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlpNTM91CJvuA6kO8m.definition:
"The currency for this invoice.  Use ISO 4217 currency codes set forth by International Standards Organization (www.iso.org.).  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlr5S451KBicxyvfYI.label: Chinese
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlr5S451KBicxyvfYI.definition: Chinese (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a means of document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlvdw8KMPnrnVfAl81.label: Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlvdw8KMPnrnVfAl81.definition: A petition is a formal written request submitted to a court or other authority, typically seeking a specific legal action or remedy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlzJI9mdSvHCyKvBrB.label: Lobbying
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlzJI9mdSvHCyKvBrB.definition: The act of pleading for or arguing in favor of something or actively supporting a cause or proposal; the act of attempting to influence the actions, policies, or decisions of officials in their daily life, most often legislators or members of regulatory agencies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDlzPpqTf5hPCjbN8mP.label: Investment Adviser Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RDlzPpqTf5hPCjbN8mP.definition: An Investment Adviser Registration Document is a formal document filed with the country's financial regulator (e.g., U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)) by investment advisers or other entities to register their services and provide essential information to the public and regulatory authorities. The document typically includes details about the entity's business practices, conflicts of interest, disciplinary information, and background of the principals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDm1Wc3WaGUjT6bq1bx.label: Covenant in Deed Violated
http://lmss.sali.org/RDm1Wc3WaGUjT6bq1bx.definition: A covenant in deed violated refers to a breach of a legally binding agreement related to property ownership or use, which can result in liability claims against the responsible party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDm4CkZkgtTpjMCb7LT.label: Breach of Implied Warranty Against Infringement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDm4CkZkgtTpjMCb7LT.definition: The Breach of Implied Warranty Against Infringement refers to a violation of an implied promise that a product or service does not infringe on the intellectual property rights of others, which can result in legal action against the party responsible for the breach.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDm4nVQ4Ad7tXBBYvbj.label: Death Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDm4nVQ4Ad7tXBBYvbj.definition: A Death Claim is a legal action seeking compensation for the death of an individual caused by the negligence or intentional act of another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDm6JYS1CRyCvUIWyon.label: Savings Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDm6JYS1CRyCvUIWyon.definition: A savings clause is a clause in a contract that preserves certain rights or obligations even if other parts of the contract are found to be invalid or unenforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDm9mvoBd5B4aS18jAG.label: Domestic Terrorism
http://lmss.sali.org/RDm9mvoBd5B4aS18jAG.definition: The unlawful use of violence and intimidation, often against civilians, in order to achieve political or social objectives within the borders of a particular country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmAEspds13rC77t5qR.label: North American Tribes
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmAEspds13rC77t5qR.definition: North American tribes refer to the various indigenous groups native to the North American continent, including tribes like the Navajo, Cherokee, Sioux, and Iroquois among many others. Each tribe has its own unique culture, language, and history, and they are recognized as the original inhabitants of specific regions within North America

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmCf4BbT72RDSwn3FM.label: Indiana Superior Court - Floyd County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmCf4BbT72RDSwn3FM.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Floyd County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Floyd County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmGwGoxsHn40UUjKCx.label: Impact Assessment Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmGwGoxsHn40UUjKCx.definition: Assessment of the environmental consequences (positive and negative) of a plan, policy, program, or actual projects prior to the decision to move forward with the proposed action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmHm8XikjkCUxdyjBk.label: Appellate Practice Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmHm8XikjkCUxdyjBk.definition: A document used in appellate practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmMvfS7VH8N4X9I8NY.label: Small Estate Probate
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmMvfS7VH8N4X9I8NY.definition: Small Estate Probate refers to a type of probate filing where the estate being administered is of relatively low value and can be settled without the need for a full probate process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmOUUaUXvrBRDI0fdc.label: Shoeprint Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmOUUaUXvrBRDI0fdc.definition: Shoeprint evidence consists of marks or impressions left by shoes on various surfaces. These impressions can reveal patterns, sizes, and unique characteristics or wear of the shoe. Forensic experts analyze shoeprints to determine the type and brand of shoe, and sometimes even link it back to a specific pair of shoes or individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmPjMB6ncDEWXBHlzW.label: Motion for Observation on Cross-Examination
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmPjMB6ncDEWXBHlzW.definition: A Motion for Observation on Cross-Examination is a formal request made by a party in a trial court to allow them to observe the opposing party's cross-examination of a witness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmQLk7WWZub9xOSlGs.label: 08_3 Federal Tax Suits (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmQLk7WWZub9xOSlGs.definition: 08_3 Federal Tax Suits (PACER NoS) refers to a specific category of legal cases related to federal tax disputes, as classified by the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmQq0XAYJEd80paX18.label: Equity Commitment Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmQq0XAYJEd80paX18.definition: Equity Commitment Letter is a written promise by an investor or financial institution to provide a specified amount of equity capital to a company, usually under certain conditions. It's typically used to show commitment during financing rounds or mergers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmU14J5KmNjzUOFHR6.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Macon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmU14J5KmNjzUOFHR6.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Macon County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Macon County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmWYfyZEmPXtJ6U1Rx.label: Appellate Court Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmWYfyZEmPXtJ6U1Rx.definition: A judge in an appellate court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmWybToQBMZK8DKVMq.label: Minnesota District Court - Faribault County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmWybToQBMZK8DKVMq.definition: Minnesota District Court - Faribault County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Faribault County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmZbwmBBKWQ3vGof1s.label: Commitment to a Mental Health Facility
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmZbwmBBKWQ3vGof1s.definition: Commitment to a mental health facility refers to the legal process by which an individual is placed into a psychiatric hospital or clinic for treatment. This can be voluntary, with the individual's consent, or involuntary, often due to concerns about the person's safety or the safety of others, based on established legal criteria and medical evaluations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmbgHQXJxEvx3QYfR6.label: Document Components
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmbgHQXJxEvx3QYfR6.definition: A document's legally relevant, substantive contents (e.g., clauses, citations, legal issues, facts) that contribute to the document's relevance substantively.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmpvD4XLJx0kkUTZ3Q.label: Expert Engagement Type
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmpvD4XLJx0kkUTZ3Q.definition: A collection of the types of arrangements for which a party may engage an expert.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmqL9Kn22x04GlhHEm.label: Motion to Remand Case
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmqL9Kn22x04GlhHEm.definition: A Motion to Remand Case is a formal request made by a party in a legal case to send the case back to a lower court for further proceedings or reconsideration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDmsvdtBrrw46UnCDJ0.label: Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmsvdtBrrw46UnCDJ0.definition: An Order, also known as a Ruling, is a written document issued by a trial court that directs parties to take certain actions or makes a decision on a specific matter in a legal case.
