http://lmss.sali.org/RDmvKM0SzzRk5pP450d.label: Indiana Superior Court - Knox County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDmvKM0SzzRk5pP450d.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within Knox County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDn0Wn8ZBClXqSOIhdL.label: Kongo
http://lmss.sali.org/RDn0Wn8ZBClXqSOIhdL.definition: Kongo (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary used in the Kongo region of Africa.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDn0b6dDytXqi3nEm99.label: Bipolar Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RDn0b6dDytXqi3nEm99.definition: Bipolar Disorder is a psychiatric condition characterized by extreme mood swings that include emotional highs (mania or hypomania) and lows (depression). These mood swings can affect energy levels, activity, behavior, and the ability to carry out daily tasks, often requiring long-term treatment to manage symptoms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnCt3sjeU7doO2F3MV.label: oasis:Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnCt3sjeU7doO2F3MV.definition: A violation is a type of deontic specification within the OASIS ontology, indicating a breach of a legal or ethical obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnD2fvOdZErNFUzPEo.label: International Organization Visa - Attendants, Servants, and Personal Employees
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnD2fvOdZErNFUzPEo.definition: An International Organization Visa for attendants, servants, and personal employees is a specialized visa category that allows individuals to accompany representatives or officials of international organizations while they are stationed in a host country for official duties. This visa is generally subject to specific conditions and may require the sponsoring international organization or official to assume certain responsibilities for the employee's welfare and legal status in the host country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnEuJ1VsP5Slnusvfy.label: Peaches
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnEuJ1VsP5Slnusvfy.definition: Peaches are juicy, sweet stone fruits from the Prunus persica species, characterized by their fuzzy skin and aromatic flesh. They are consumed fresh, canned, or used in culinary applications such as desserts, jams, and beverages, valued for their vitamins, antioxidants, and dietary fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnI8TS5UbaKbjNAqTq.label: Miscellaneous Provisions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnI8TS5UbaKbjNAqTq.definition: A Miscellaneous Provisions Clause is a contractual clause that includes additional terms and conditions that are not covered by other clauses in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnIuhbbvS0zCuqfgnt.label: Rice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnIuhbbvS0zCuqfgnt.definition: Rice is a cereal crop belonging to the species Oryza sativa (Asian rice) or Oryza glaberrima (African rice), known for its edible starchy grains that are a staple food for more than half of the world's population. Cultivated primarily in flooded fields called paddies, rice provides essential carbohydrates, proteins, and vitamins, and is used in a variety of culinary dishes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnJ5pHeJZuA0vHQXYa.label: "Intervening Event" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnJ5pHeJZuA0vHQXYa.definition: Intervening Event Language refers to the specific language used to describe a triggering event that causes a change in recommendation in a legal matter, such as a breach or violation of fiduciary duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnL4l8qrBNbxrIunu2.label: Minnesota District Court - Polk County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnL4l8qrBNbxrIunu2.definition: Minnesota District Court - Polk County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Polk County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnLOdTNWmEc4EhZ0SZ.label: Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnLOdTNWmEc4EhZ0SZ.definition: A judge is a public official appointed to decide cases in a court of law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnLf26coWNR0YMpax0.label: Notice of Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnLf26coWNR0YMpax0.definition: A Notice of Appeal is a formal document filed with a court of law to challenge a decision made by a lower court or administrative agency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnM62nfhCCuZ9SeRwQ.label: New York Supreme Court - Broome County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnM62nfhCCuZ9SeRwQ.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Broome County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Broome County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnOT11bijp73ZvXW0E.label: Forward Looking Statements Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnOT11bijp73ZvXW0E.definition: A Forward Looking Statements Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the expectations or projections of future events or performance, and typically includes a disclaimer that actual results may differ.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnXWERwhDCf1pKjMxf.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Greene County (7th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnbxazqAWfPyFjrjdn.label: Ambulatory Health Care Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnbxazqAWfPyFjrjdn.definition: Industries in this group provide health care services directly or indirectly to ambulatory patients and do not usually provide inpatient services. Health practitioners in this subsector provide outpatient services, with the facilities and equipment not usually being the most significant part of the production process. This group includes offices of physicians, dentists, chiropractors, optometrists, psychologists, mental health practitioners, podiatrists, etc.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDncsU66gjMTS2uIVpd.label: Memorandum of Understanding
http://lmss.sali.org/RDncsU66gjMTS2uIVpd.definition: A Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) is a non-binding agreement between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions of a potential future relationship or partnership. While generally not legally enforceable, it serves to clarify the expectations and responsibilities of each party involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnpxjqW6G1NosV3EO9.label: Leveraged Buyout
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnpxjqW6G1NosV3EO9.definition: A Leveraged Buyout (LBO) is a financial transaction where a company is acquired primarily using borrowed funds, often by taking on substantial debt. The assets of the company being acquired, and often those of the acquiring company, are used as collateral for the loans.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDnrnreSiKWtQ7CGtMq.label: Termination of Service Agreement Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDnrnreSiKWtQ7CGtMq.definition: A Termination of Service Agreement Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which the agreement can be ended by one or both parties, specifically related to the provision of services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo00CLlnwYJISZbyYU.label: Hyperglycemia
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo00CLlnwYJISZbyYU.definition: Hyperglycemia is an abnormally high level of blood glucose that can result from inadequate insulin production or insulin resistance. It may produce both acute and long-term complications affecting various body systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo0CW96yRvaIo64VE0.label: Qualified Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo0CW96yRvaIo64VE0.definition: Qualified Privilege: A legal protection that allows a person to make a statement without fear of being sued for defamation, as long as the statement was made in good faith and for a legitimate purpose.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo0Uvbe7rPxFLMv8sX.label: Oil and Gas Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo0Uvbe7rPxFLMv8sX.definition: Law pertaining to the acquisition and ownership rights in oil and gas beneath the soil prior to discovery and following its extraction, and the adjudication of disputes regarding those rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo1CLTrPNMYM7DQzGf.label: Purchase Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo1CLTrPNMYM7DQzGf.definition: A Purchase Order is a formal document issued by a buyer to a seller, indicating types, quantities, and agreed prices for products or services. It serves as an official offer to buy products or services and becomes a legally binding contract once accepted by the seller.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo32S8Iiy3iZI4aTq3.label: Indictment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo32S8Iiy3iZI4aTq3.definition: An indictment is a formal accusation of a crime, issued by a grand jury based on evidence presented by a prosecutor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo4EB15aAkKgGEEjd4.label: International Trade Commission Dispute
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo4EB15aAkKgGEEjd4.definition: An International Trade Commission (ITC) Dispute, also known as ITC, refers to a legal conflict brought before the U.S. International Trade Commission regarding unfair import investigations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo81N034NYuEZm3nSN.label: Interference with Prospective Business Relationship
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo81N034NYuEZm3nSN.definition: The Interference with Prospective Business Relationship is the intentional or negligent interference with a party's potential economic advantage by a third party, causing harm to the party's business relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDo84hNAJ8jArm6IstX.label: Response
http://lmss.sali.org/RDo84hNAJ8jArm6IstX.definition: A Response is a type of Litigation Document that is filed by a party in a legal case to answer or reply to a complaint or petition filed by the opposing party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoBt2Jgqz0zeHUEjLH.label: Class Size
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoBt2Jgqz0zeHUEjLH.definition: The number of individuals or entities included in a putative class action, representing the potential members of the class if the class is certified by the court. Class size affects both the scope of the lawsuit and the procedural requirements for class certification.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoDkMeyyv3wWo719J2.label: Marriage Creation Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoDkMeyyv3wWo719J2.definition: From the state-court filing standard (NODS) dataset.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoGqog9X0YSf54QEUT.label: Family-Based Immigration Request
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoGqog9X0YSf54QEUT.definition: A Family-Based Immigration Request is a type of immigration application where an individual seeks to enter or remain in a destination country based on their familial relationship to a citizen or legal resident of that country. This usually involves sponsorship by the relative and can include spouses, children, parents, and sometimes more extended family, depending on the country's immigration laws

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoLngQAXQVu1WYzZlG.label: Ordinances
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoLngQAXQVu1WYzZlG.definition: A law enacted by a local government (usually a city or municipality).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoLvqqUYFVe32IFsV2.label: Reversed Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoLvqqUYFVe32IFsV2.definition: The previously effective law has been reversed by some authority (e.g., appellate court, judge, regulator).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoR0jtx5DG8yQrqK7Z.label: Motion for Extension of Time Regarding Transcript
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoR0jtx5DG8yQrqK7Z.definition: A Motion for Extension of Time Regarding Transcript is a request made in a bankruptcy case to extend the deadline for submitting a written or recorded copy of court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoUEumMbiSgMFPdoAt.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Will County (12th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoVjK6X9A4SRaAWzuo.label: Corrected Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoVjK6X9A4SRaAWzuo.definition: A corrected appendix is a section added to a document that contains additional information or corrections, and is a subset of the larger category of appendices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoc5fkIs4N79QVKf9t.label: Defensive Asylum
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoc5fkIs4N79QVKf9t.definition: Defensive asylum is a form of asylum claimed by individuals who are in removal proceedings before an immigration court. Unlike affirmative asylum, defensive asylum is raised as a defense against being removed from the destination country (e.g., United States) and requires the applicant to present their case before an immigration judge.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDogQnL3ZlyZ3uEhWUv.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Venango County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDogQnL3ZlyZ3uEhWUv.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Venango County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Venango County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDogbxm1U7IjF2fwD8v.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Indiana County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDogbxm1U7IjF2fwD8v.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Indiana County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoj85ZEWURdraHC9oQ.label: Process Server
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoj85ZEWURdraHC9oQ.definition: A person who serves legal process, bringing a defendant into a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDoqFy7w8Dr7R9MC1LS.label: Promissory Estoppel
http://lmss.sali.org/RDoqFy7w8Dr7R9MC1LS.definition: A legal doctrine that prevents a party from going back on a promise made to another party, even if the promise was not supported by consideration, when the other party relied on the promise to their detriment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDosxMJGwf9BqQr182u.label: Product Warranty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDosxMJGwf9BqQr182u.definition: A product warranty clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a manufacturer's promise to repair or replace a product if it fails to meet certain standards or expectations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDp0NLOQTxSSd2KlCkm.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Mercer County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDp0NLOQTxSSd2KlCkm.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Mercer County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Mercer County and serving the surrounding area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDp2iJvixmB0QYvkdMx.label: tax_on_tax_id
http://lmss.sali.org/RDp2iJvixmB0QYvkdMx.definition:
"In a ""tax-on-tax"" situation (described above), the tax_on_tax_id is the tx_id of the tax that should be included in the tax calculation for the current tx_id.  For example, in Canada the TVQ tax includes not only the line items taxed, but also the GST tax for these line items.  The proper response to this tax_on_tax_id field would be the tx_id for the GST tax.

Although we are currently not aware of any such situation, it may be the case in a jurisdiction that there is a tax-on-tax-on-tax situation.  It is anticipated that this field would hierarchically grow as necessary.  Using the example in the previous paragraph, say that tax3 includes TVQ and GST taxes.  Since the TVQ tax already shows the hierarchical relationship with GST in the tax_on_tax_id field, tax 3 would list the tx_id for TVQ in this tax_on_tax_id field.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RDp74c34xALuehr10JA.label: Pardon Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RDp74c34xALuehr10JA.definition: A Pardon Proceeding is a legal process within Criminal Proceedings that seeks to grant forgiveness or clemency to a convicted individual by a government authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDp8cEr3KYyVDenm1P9.label: Claims Against Real Estate Agents and Brokers
http://lmss.sali.org/RDp8cEr3KYyVDenm1P9.definition: Claims Against Real Estate Agents and Brokers refers to legal actions taken against individuals or companies who act as intermediaries in real estate transactions, alleging breach of duty or negligence in their representation of clients.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpAp4LyD2fbdllVsni.label: Motion for Order to Show Cause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpAp4LyD2fbdllVsni.definition: A Motion for Order to Show Cause is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case asking the court to require a party to appear and explain why they should not be held in contempt for failing to comply with a court order or other legal obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpDMlGCrVutGXBg33t.label: Stipulation to Continue Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpDMlGCrVutGXBg33t.definition: A Stipulation to Continue Hearing is a legal agreement between parties involved in a case to postpone a scheduled hearing to a later date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpJ0GzjpaYXGdVGipP.label: General / Summary Probate
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpJ0GzjpaYXGdVGipP.definition: General/Summary Probate is a type of probate filing that is used for small estates with limited assets and straightforward distribution processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpNoF3OruNHqrls00v.label: Control Position
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpNoF3OruNHqrls00v.definition: An M&A Control Position refers to a stake in a company acquired through mergers and acquisitions that gives the holder significant influence over corporate decisions. This control is often achieved by obtaining a majority of voting shares or a significant minority stake sufficient to influence board decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpOssFHxoz2zUvWjIG.label: ADR Judicial Settlement Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpOssFHxoz2zUvWjIG.definition: A settlement conference facilitated by a judge or a neutral third party in an Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) forum to resolve disputes outside of the court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpPBwLDFWEwrDVvvUx.label: Wind Power Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpPBwLDFWEwrDVvvUx.definition: Law governing the development, regulation, and operation of wind energy projects, including licensing, land use, environmental impact, grid connection, and incentives promoting the generation of electricity from wind resources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpPrzyG145FEMbdXJE.label: Aggravated
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpPrzyG145FEMbdXJE.definition: An unlawful attack by one person upon another wherein the offender uses a weapon or displays it in a threatening manner, or the victim suffers obvious severe or aggravated bodily injury involving apparent broken bones, loss of teeth, possible internal injury, severe laceration, or loss of consciousness. This also includes assault with disease (as in cases when the offender is aware that he/she is infected with a deadly disease and deliberately attempts to inflict the disease by biting, spitting, etc.).

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpSHREg1iX3oSwUoij.label: Motion for Conditional Use of Cash Collateral
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpSHREg1iX3oSwUoij.definition: A Motion for Conditional Use of Cash Collateral is a request made in a bankruptcy case to allow a debtor to use cash collateral under certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpaN9hLN8jGKrKBnQ2.label: Conflicts Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpaN9hLN8jGKrKBnQ2.definition: Conflicts Management refers to the process of identifying and resolving potential conflicts of interest within a law firm or legal department, in order to ensure ethical and professional conduct in the provision of legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpdFq22AZ4tOCImIJU.label: Avoidant/Restrictive Food Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpdFq22AZ4tOCImIJU.definition: Avoidant/Restrictive Food Intake Disorder (ARFID) is an eating disorder characterized by an extreme avoidance or restriction of food intake, which can lead to significant nutritional deficiencies, weight loss, or impairment in social and occupational functioning. Unlike Anorexia Nervosa, ARFID does not involve a distorted body image or an intense fear of gaining weight but may include aversions to certain foods or fear of adverse consequences from eating.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpdutTNI2rbLZMnb9o.label: State Governmental Body
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpdutTNI2rbLZMnb9o.definition: A regional governmental body, such as a state or provincial government, operates at a level below the national government but above local governments like cities or municipalities. These bodies have jurisdiction over a specific geographic area and possess their own set of powers and responsibilities, often delineated by a constitution or charter. They typically consist of executive, legislative, and judicial branches, and they manage issues more localized than those of the national government but broader than those of city or town governments. Examples include U.S. state governments, Canadian provincial governments, or Indian state governments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDphbylt1EMyB0YxHvM.label: Albanian
http://lmss.sali.org/RDphbylt1EMyB0YxHvM.definition: A language spoken in Albania and other parts of the Balkans, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDphmWpcqgHRbQbOJeG.label: DEPRECATED Passive Income, favoring Unearned Income
http://lmss.sali.org/RDphmWpcqgHRbQbOJeG.definition: Passive Income refers to earnings derived from activities in which the individual is not actively involved. This includes income from investments, rental properties, dividends, interest, royalties, and other sources that do not require continuous effort or direct labor to maintain.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpizZcACsM7yyhWpT5.label: Forward-looking Material Adverse Effect Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpizZcACsM7yyhWpT5.definition: A Forward-looking Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Standard is a legal language used in contracts that refers to a future event or circumstance that could have a negative impact on a party's ability to fulfill their obligations under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjOyejC570NEmEPgJ.label: inv_reference
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjOyejC570NEmEPgJ.definition:
"If the firm is submitting a Credit Note (an instrument required by statute or regulation that corrects a previously issued Tax Invoice -- see INVOICE.tax_invoice for more discussion) or is submitting an invoice that corrects an invoice previously rejected by a bill reviewer, enter the inv_id of the original invoice being corrected.  

As described above, law firms are required by regulation to supply the Tax Invoice number being corrected.  It is therefore expected that the receiving system will store this information and display it to bill reviewers.  
  
In addition, in situations where the submission corrects an invoice rejected by a bill reviewer, this field can be used by the receiving system to electronically verify the correction submitted so that these submissions could be approved electronically instead of being routed to a bill reviewer for approval.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjRd4voHUosNqZM5f.label: Governmental Monitoring Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjRd4voHUosNqZM5f.definition: Governmental Monitoring Practice entails the systematic observation and analysis of activities and decisions across various branches of government to ensure transparency, accountability, and compliance with legal standards. This practice helps organizations and individuals stay informed about legislative, executive, and judicial developments that may impact their interests.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjbhF3hJ1Ttc3I2Zt.label: Motion to File Amended Proof of Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpjbhF3hJ1Ttc3I2Zt.definition: A Motion to File Amended Proof of Claim is a request made in a bankruptcy case to modify or update a previously filed claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDplPdJJQ6YnEbE1gSX.label: Breach of Implied Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RDplPdJJQ6YnEbE1gSX.definition: The Breach of Implied Contract is a legal claim that arises when one party fails to fulfill an obligation that was not explicitly stated in a contract, but was understood to be a part of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpsD9QKYJV3FTgsBK8.label: Price Changes Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpsD9QKYJV3FTgsBK8.definition: A Price Changes Clause, also known as a Price Adjustment Clause, is a provision in a contract that allows for adjustments to the price of goods or services based on certain conditions or events.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpsuZXSAXxqOOdwmtk.label: Motion for More Definite Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpsuZXSAXxqOOdwmtk.definition: A Motion for More Definite Statement is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case or in response to a complaint, asking the opposing party to provide a clearer and more specific statement of their claims or defenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDptEuaqrgkf8FuH43f.label: Co-Sale Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDptEuaqrgkf8FuH43f.definition: A Co-Sale Agreement, also known as a Tag-Along Agreement, is a legal document that allows minority shareholders to join a sale initiated by majority shareholders. This agreement ensures that the minority shareholders receive the same terms and conditions as the majority shareholders in a sale, thereby protecting their interests during significant corporate transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpweIrA3HDW0JHli21.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Dauphin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpweIrA3HDW0JHli21.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Dauphin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpxJoYy0ZH8kjALxIS.label: Intervening Event - Occurs After Signing
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpxJoYy0ZH8kjALxIS.definition: An intervening event that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement, which may affect the execution or performance of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpyAiJAkOLYF4nSQ8w.label: Ownership of Proprietary Information Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpyAiJAkOLYF4nSQ8w.definition: A clause in a legal agreement that specifies the ownership rights of confidential or proprietary information.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDpyBngXFa5AbXmNbs4.label: Motion to Consolidate for Trial
http://lmss.sali.org/RDpyBngXFa5AbXmNbs4.definition: A Motion to Consolidate for Trial is a request made in bankruptcy proceedings to combine two or more related cases into a single trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqCng7YEHdBz2zoTT5.label: UK Legal Aid Agency
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqCng7YEHdBz2zoTT5.definition: The Legal Aid Agency, formerly known as the Legal Services Commission, is an organization responsible for providing legal aid and ensuring that individuals who cannot afford legal representation have access to legal assistance. It oversees the funding and administration of legal aid services, promoting equal access to justice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqDtWGfpALJQWQamsJ.label: Acupuncture Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqDtWGfpALJQWQamsJ.definition: Acupuncture Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the improper or negligent use of acupuncture treatment by a healthcare provider.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqIUhEDro3wtb8hoMA.label: La Posta Band of Diegueno Mission Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqKPOVV6UU9v1jJAG2.label: Georgia District Court - Sumter County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqKPOVV6UU9v1jJAG2.definition: Georgia District Court - Sumter County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Sumter County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqKmIZtUArhFb6sGnV.label: Donning and Doffing Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqKmIZtUArhFb6sGnV.definition: A "Donning and Doffing Claim" is a legal term typically used in employment and labor law. It refers to a situation where employees claim that they should be compensated for the time spent putting on (donning) and taking off (doffing) specialized work attire or equipment required by their job, such as uniforms, safety gear, or tools. These claims often involve disputes over whether such activities should be considered part of the workday and eligible for compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqSn32zsjxExcBFzIY.label: Tort Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqSn32zsjxExcBFzIY.definition: Tort Claims are civil claims that arise from a wrongful act or omission that causes harm or injury to another person, property, or reputation, and for which the injured party may seek compensation or damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqUscsJQ4QGIvPJ4Lv.label: Notice of Appearance
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqUscsJQ4QGIvPJ4Lv.definition: A Notice of Appearance is a written document filed with a court or administrative agency by an attorney or party indicating that they are representing a party in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqVPka7eHSjmOCv3Jt.label: C.F.A. (Chartered Financial Analyst)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqVPka7eHSjmOCv3Jt.definition: The suffix "C.F.A." stands for "Chartered Financial Analyst" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have passed a series of exams and met other requirements set forth by the CFA Institute. This designation signifies the individual's expertise in investment management and financial analysis, and it is commonly used in finance, investment, and academic settings

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqZ6dzBBYqQ9q4QLVJ.label: Spinal Muscular Atrophy
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqZ6dzBBYqQ9q4QLVJ.definition: Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) is a genetic disorder characterized by the progressive degeneration and loss of motor neurons in the spinal cord, leading to muscle weakness and atrophy. This condition primarily affects the muscles used for activities such as crawling, walking, sitting up, and controlling head movement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqaMgjoBHJjd0NlpwR.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Putnam County (10th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqbXQfTmSJ3T58T8vu.label: Performance Improvement Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqbXQfTmSJ3T58T8vu.definition: A Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) is a formal document outlining specific goals and actions an employee must take to improve their performance to meet organizational standards. This plan typically includes a timeline, measurable objectives, and support resources to help the employee achieve the required improvements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqcp9XTePnZ0Qo3yuJ.label: Florida Circuit Court - Pasco County - 6th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqcp9XTePnZ0Qo3yuJ.definition: A court located in Pasco County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqfHjeoofHfEMkxsTg.label: Mayor
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqfHjeoofHfEMkxsTg.definition: A Mayor is the highest-ranking official in a municipal government, typically elected by the public or appointed by a city council. This individual serves as the chief executive officer of a city or town, responsible for overseeing local government operations, implementing policies, and representing the municipality in various capacities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqfiEi1fdryT1nfQCM.label: M&A F6 Real Property Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqfiEi1fdryT1nfQCM.definition: M&A F6 Real Property Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a merger and acquisition transaction that involves real estate property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqgSZq9it4dKcFtVEG.label: Avestan
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqgSZq9it4dKcFtVEG.definition: Avestan is an ancient language used in Zoroastrian scriptures and rituals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqs9RKXgdCBT4XRXtg.label: Cumberland County Association for Indian People

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqst57bGParr7Rufgi.label: Osteopathic Medicine Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqst57bGParr7Rufgi.definition: Negligent or improper treatment by an osteopathic physician that results in harm to a patient, giving rise to a legal claim for damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqvTdg5IFDf2Oyf3zT.label: Rules of Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqvTdg5IFDf2Oyf3zT.definition: Procedural rules governing the use of evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDqvWcvBcUV4cKSUqlF.label: Rental and Leasing Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RDqvWcvBcUV4cKSUqlF.definition: Industries in this group include establishments that provide a wide array of tangible goods, such as automobiles, computers, consumer goods, and industrial machinery and equipment, to customers in return for a periodic rental or lease payment. thee include those that are engaged in renting consumer goods and equipment and those that are engaged in leasing machinery and equipment often used for business operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDr1CpwhU45BvpMKyuL.label: Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDr1CpwhU45BvpMKyuL.definition: Claims made under the Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, which regulates the safety and labeling of food, drugs, and cosmetics.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDr2w9AvQVNGuLJy9Bo.label: Nervous System Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RDr2w9AvQVNGuLJy9Bo.definition: Nervous system cancer encompasses malignant tumors originating in the central nervous system (CNS), which includes the brain and spinal cord, as well as primary cancers of the peripheral nerves or spinal roots. This category includes high-grade tumors such as glioblastoma multiforme, ependymoblastoma, diffuse intrinsic brain stem gliomas, and other aggressive malignancies that may be primary, metastatic, progressive, or recurrent following initial anticancer therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDr6DXAcukDYZgOiiRN.label: 14th Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDr6DXAcukDYZgOiiRN.definition: Fourteenth Amendment claims are legal actions initiated by an individual alleging that their rights under the Fourteenth Amendment of the United States Constitution have been violated by the government or a government actor. The Fourteenth Amendment guarantees equal protection under the law and due process of law to all persons, and applies to actions taken by state and local governments. Fourteenth Amendment claims may arise in various contexts, such as when an individual is discriminated against on the basis of race, gender, national origin, or other protected categories, when an individual is deprived of their liberty or property without due process of law, or when an individual is denied equal protection of the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDr8czb8jRHPdT9hRXj.label: Motion to Compel Discovery
http://lmss.sali.org/RDr8czb8jRHPdT9hRXj.definition: A Motion to Compel Discovery is a legal request made by one party to another party in a lawsuit, asking the court to order the other party to provide information or evidence that has not been previously disclosed or produced.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrCSeuostMVOEldU6F.label: Child Support Guidelines
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrCSeuostMVOEldU6F.definition: Child Support Guidelines are legal regulations or guidelines established by a government authority to determine the amount of financial support that a non-custodial parent is required to provide for their child or children. These guidelines take into account factors such as the parents' incomes, the child's needs, and the cost of living. They provide a standardized method for calculating child support payments, ensuring fairness and consistency in support orders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrCoGiMIXR6TcVXppI.label: Deposition Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrCoGiMIXR6TcVXppI.definition: Deposition Practice refers to the legal process of obtaining sworn testimony from a witness outside of court, typically conducted in a lawyer's office or other location, as part of the discovery process in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrOf3SHxglDoN9i4Ol.label: Managing Member
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrOf3SHxglDoN9i4Ol.definition: A managing member is an individual or entity responsible for the day-to-day operations and decision-making of an organization. This role includes overseeing business activities, making strategic decisions, and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrZfl9rDyGVk1ikSmx.label: Sale of Personal Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrZfl9rDyGVk1ikSmx.definition: The sale of personal property refers to the transfer of ownership of tangible items that are not considered goods under the law, such as vehicles or furniture, in exchange for payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrbY6MeW8iV9jZP5Qx.label: 07 Labor (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrbY6MeW8iV9jZP5Qx.definition: 07 Labor (PACER NoS) refers to a category of legal cases related to labor disputes, including issues such as fair labor standards, employee retirement benefits, and labor-management relations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrbZG920yfTooNWzf8.label: Peoria Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrcKoNF4E3TH0ysVHI.label: Other Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrcKoNF4E3TH0ysVHI.definition: An "Other Expense" is a type of cost that is not categorized under any specific expense category, but is still necessary and reasonable for the completion of a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrdvM2UI4EaC7URSea.label: Litigation Finance Company
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrdvM2UI4EaC7URSea.definition: A Litigation Finance Company is a specialized financial institution that provides funding to plaintiffs or law firms to cover legal costs in exchange for a share of any potential recovery or settlement from a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrgrPYJPo0Rj0YG5xJ.label: Data Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrgrPYJPo0Rj0YG5xJ.definition: Data Management refers to the process of organizing, storing, protecting, and maintaining data in a way that allows for efficient retrieval and use, specifically within the context of legal use cases such as API and API Management, IP Analytics Management, Market Intelligence Management, Data Extraction Management, Judicial Analytics Management, Data Analytics Management, and Data Visualization Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrjdMr6JuXngZ2scLY.label: Impress a Trust
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrjdMr6JuXngZ2scLY.definition: To "Impress a Trust" means to create an equitable claim on property by demonstrating that it was intended to be held in trust, even if it was not formally declared as such.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrk9I7Oz0ljIvj9sBa.label: Failure to Provide Personnel Records Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrk9I7Oz0ljIvj9sBa.definition: A failure to provide personnel records claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not complying with the legal requirement to provide access to or copies of the employee's personnel file. Personnel files often contain important employment-related documents such as performance evaluations, disciplinary actions, and employment contracts, and the claim arises when an employer refuses or fails to provide the requested records within the time frame mandated by applicable laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrnwGGWfbRHXRTryYp.label: Eligible Compensation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrnwGGWfbRHXRTryYp.definition: An Eligible Compensation Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the types of compensation that are considered eligible for certain benefits or purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDroRAFhNybTCHv1WlH.label: Employment Warning
http://lmss.sali.org/RDroRAFhNybTCHv1WlH.definition: An Employment Warning is a formal notice issued by an employer to an employee, indicating that their behavior or performance is unacceptable and needs improvement. This warning serves as an official record of the issue and a step in the disciplinary process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDromh3M6jNePoeyJQq.label: Wholesale Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDromh3M6jNePoeyJQq.definition: A "Wholesale Agreement" is a contractual arrangement between a supplier or manufacturer and a wholesaler, specifying the terms under which goods will be purchased in bulk for resale to retailers or direct to end consumers. The agreement typically addresses pricing, payment terms, delivery, and other obligations of both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrqvB0giEGZjdStNjB.label: Tamashek
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrqvB0giEGZjdStNjB.definition: Tamashek is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in parts of North Africa.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrrTWdsiEL8Ey5l6dT.label: Ugaritic
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrrTWdsiEL8Ey5l6dT.definition: A language used in ancient Ugarit, which was located in modern-day Syria.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrsazMNuWvJplFux9k.label: Gerrymandering Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrsazMNuWvJplFux9k.definition: A gerrymandering claim alleges that electoral district boundaries have been drawn in a way that intentionally advantages or disadvantages a particular political party or group. This manipulation, often based on party affiliation, race, or ethnicity, seeks to distort the electoral process to favor one group over another, thereby undermining the principle of fair representation. Such claims challenge the legitimacy and fairness of the redistricting process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrxE6R22Oc5nTiVjdj.label: Dissolution
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrxE6R22Oc5nTiVjdj.definition: Dissolution is the process of legally dissolving a business entity, such as a company or nonprofit, involving the winding down of operations, settling of debts, and distribution of remaining assets. It marks the formal termination of the entity's legal existence and cessation of business activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDrxLQS4WPXUa6tUdBG.label: Obligation Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RDrxLQS4WPXUa6tUdBG.definition: Obligation Analysis is the process of examining and evaluating the legal responsibilities and duties of a debtor in a bankruptcy or financial restructuring matter, including the analysis of various considerations such as vendor agreements, utilities, securities reporting, liens, financial reports, insurance, cash usage, debt agreements, dischargeability, employee benefits, pensions, and environmental issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDryUQXGgybBl5istVH.label: LINE_ITEM_TOTAL
http://lmss.sali.org/RDryUQXGgybBl5istVH.definition: The LINE_ITEM_TOTAL concept refers to the total amount charged for a specific line item in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDryg4foL6XLmuRtSwK.label: Workers' Compensation Retaliation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDryg4foL6XLmuRtSwK.definition: Retaliation by an employer against an employee for filing a workers' compensation claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDs4GGRr5BzwWdb6Lci.label: Project Manager
http://lmss.sali.org/RDs4GGRr5BzwWdb6Lci.definition: In project management, a person who oversees a project's planning an execution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDs4RXqtrzif7ulCp2k.label: Survey
http://lmss.sali.org/RDs4RXqtrzif7ulCp2k.definition: A survey in a legal context refers to a comprehensive review or analysis of laws, regulations, or practices. It aims to identify trends to inform legal strategy, compliance, or research.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDs5asGGt5TxuJZasFd.label: Antitrust - Vertical Agreement/Conspiracy Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDs5asGGt5TxuJZasFd.definition: A claim made under antitrust law alleging an agreement or conspiracy between parties at different levels of a supply chain to restrain trade or competition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDs9eCLoiQpyTdMrksg.label: Neurosurgery Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDs9eCLoiQpyTdMrksg.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a neurosurgeon that results in harm or injury to a patient, and which is the subject of a legal claim for damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsA0EjhyOEG9HBBGLs.label: Sense Impression Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsA0EjhyOEG9HBBGLs.definition: Sense Impression Objectives refer to the purposes for admitting out-of-court statements that describe or explain an event or condition while the declarant was perceiving it or immediately thereafter, as well as statements relating to a startling event or condition made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement caused by the event or condition. These objectives, which include present sense impressions and excited utterances, are exceptions to the hearsay rule due to the reliability of statements made in the moment or under the influence of a startling event.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsAyltQe2aok0szo92.label: Patent Search Process
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsAyltQe2aok0szo92.definition: The Patent Search Process involves systematically searching through patent databases to identify existing patents and patent applications that are relevant to a particular invention or technology. This process helps determine the novelty and patentability of the invention, guiding subsequent patent application strategies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsCZVkz53SQX78pFJZ.label: Taxing Jurisdiction Country
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsCZVkz53SQX78pFJZ.definition: A Taxing Jurisdiction Country is a specific country that has the authority to impose and collect taxes on a particular entity or individual, as defined within the context of Tax Detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsDXHKUsZoJfz87jnz.label: Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsDXHKUsZoJfz87jnz.definition: A violation is an act or instance of breaking or failing to comply with a rule, regulation, contract, or law, which can lead to legal consequences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsG6EEnGfPZ0wI0t2f.label: Statement of Good Faith
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsG6EEnGfPZ0wI0t2f.definition: A Statement of Good Faith is a written declaration made in a Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document, expressing the honest intention of the declarant to act in good faith towards the other parties involved in the proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsKpwzMbtWv0rHSNo4.label: Stuttering
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsKpwzMbtWv0rHSNo4.definition: Stuttering, also known as stammering, is a speech disorder characterized by disruptions in the normal flow of speech, including repetitions of sounds, syllables, or words, prolongations of sounds, and involuntary pauses or blocks. These disruptions can vary in frequency and severity and often cause significant communication challenges and anxiety.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsNu801voNxdpEeagw.label: Limited Guardianship of Adult
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsNu801voNxdpEeagw.definition: A Limited Guardianship of Adult is a legal arrangement where a guardian is appointed to make decisions for an adult who is unable to make decisions for themselves, but only in specific areas as determined by the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsOpfSABvJyDKct77t.label: Motion to Exclude Fact Witness
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsOpfSABvJyDKct77t.definition: A Motion to Exclude Fact Witness is a legal request to prevent a witness from testifying in court based on the fact that their testimony is not relevant or admissible as evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsQrw7ploG6C5BFKKN.label: No Third Party Beneficiaries Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsQrw7ploG6C5BFKKN.definition: A No Third Party Beneficiaries Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that the agreement is only between the parties involved and does not confer any rights or benefits to any third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsUlVQxaIAflOYepmX.label: Bicyclist Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsUlVQxaIAflOYepmX.definition: The legal responsibility of a person riding a bicycle for any harm or injury caused to others, as part of a claim for personal injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsWDLg5JUKHPw6my6Q.label: Risk Management Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsWDLg5JUKHPw6my6Q.definition: Risk Management Objective refers to a specific goal or target that an organization aims to achieve through the identification, assessment, and prioritization of potential risks and the implementation of strategies to mitigate or manage those risks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsXFlhl3SWyKzTqYbF.label: Present Sense Impression
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsXFlhl3SWyKzTqYbF.definition: A Present Sense Impression is a statement describing or explaining an event or condition made while or immediately after the declarant perceived it. This hearsay exception is based on the belief that statements made in the moment, without time for reflection or fabrication, are inherently reliable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsaH0AuQk6sV9PUheD.label: International Organization Meeting Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsaH0AuQk6sV9PUheD.definition: A International Organization Meeting Visa (in the U.S., a G-2 visa) is issued to representatives of recognized foreign governments traveling to the U.S. temporarily to attend meetings of designated international organizations. This visa category also includes their immediate family members.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDshNH0y5Y0Etqyds8q.label: Texas District Court - Williamson County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDshNH0y5Y0Etqyds8q.definition: A Texas District Court located in Williamson County, which is a trial court of general jurisdiction in Texas, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsi1iFzDwi17R5cdXA.label: Georgia Superior Court - Berrien County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsi1iFzDwi17R5cdXA.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Berrien County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDspRIwoJTlopUDjSgL.label: Elements of Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDspRIwoJTlopUDjSgL.definition: Elements of Claim: The essential components that must be proven in a legal action in order to establish a valid claim, including but not limited to the specific facts, legal theories, and evidence necessary to support the claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDspheq1ywN6ph6VaPC.label: Visitation of Grandparents
http://lmss.sali.org/RDspheq1ywN6ph6VaPC.definition: The concept of Visitation of Grandparents refers to the legal right of grandparents to visit their grandchildren, which is often a part of custody and visitation claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDssVEBqP6cGxOvyIar.label: Asthma
http://lmss.sali.org/RDssVEBqP6cGxOvyIar.definition: Asthma is a chronic respiratory condition characterized by inflammation and narrowing of the airways, leading to recurrent episodes of wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing. It requires long-term management through medication, lifestyle changes, and avoidance of triggers to control symptoms and prevent attacks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDswXyA54Z3tSp18RnK.label: Insurance Regulatory Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDswXyA54Z3tSp18RnK.definition: Insurance Regulatory Practice involves representing companies, brokers, and other entities in complying with the regulatory requirements imposed by insurance regulatory authorities. This legal service includes obtaining licenses, navigating regulatory changes, and ensuring adherence to financial solvency, consumer protection, and reporting obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDsxHT4FlaoALPmeZmT.label: Respondent
http://lmss.sali.org/RDsxHT4FlaoALPmeZmT.definition: The respondent is the party against whom a petition is filed, especially one on appeal. The respondent can be either the plaintiff or the defendant from the court below, as either party can appeal the decision thereby making themselves the petitioner and their adversary the respondent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDt4vQCYDfY0R9fZ5FN.label: Document / Artifact
http://lmss.sali.org/RDt4vQCYDfY0R9fZ5FN.definition: A written, drawn, presented, or memorialized representation of thought or expression, including evidence such as recordings and other artifacts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDt62pgSC6uT3vmSjG8.label: Unemployment Compensation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDt62pgSC6uT3vmSjG8.definition: A claim made by an individual who has lost their job and is seeking financial assistance from the government to support themselves while they search for new employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtF3TBuYodaMEI2cA1.label: Motion to Disqualify Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtF3TBuYodaMEI2cA1.definition: A Motion to Disqualify Judge is a legal request to remove a judge from a case due to a conflict of interest or bias, which may prevent a fair trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtFkLR3v97fran5zQ3.label: Obligation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtFkLR3v97fran5zQ3.definition: An obligation is a legal or moral duty that requires a certain course of action or behavior, often enforceable by law or ethical principles.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtGL89WprtWamR7WEh.label: Petition for Treaty Investor Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtGL89WprtWamR7WEh.definition: An E-2 petition refers to the application process for obtaining an E-2 Treaty Investor Visa in the United States. The E-2 visa is available to individuals from countries that have a qualifying treaty with the U.S. It allows foreign nationals who are making a substantial investment in a U.S. enterprise to enter the U.S. for the purpose of developing and managing that investment. The E-2 visa can be applied for by investors, employees of the investor's enterprise, or the enterprise itself. The petition involves demonstrating the substantiality of the investment and meeting other eligibility criteria as outlined by U.S. immigration laws and regulations

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtGwjcx99cEgGWhK2D.label: General Ticket (Party Block) Electoral System
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtGwjcx99cEgGWhK2D.definition: The general ticket, also known as the party block electoral system, is a voting method in which voters select a party rather than individual candidates, and the party receiving the majority of votes wins all the seats available. This system is designed to ensure cohesive party representation but can result in the overrepresentation of the majority party.
examples: Full Slate Voting: Some municipal elections in the United States
Party Block Voting: U.S. Electoral College system before the 12th Amendment

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtLLvVCAkIl6MqCGzK.label: Collateral Order Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtLLvVCAkIl6MqCGzK.definition: Collateral Order Appeals are a type of appeal that can be made during a legal proceeding, which allows a party to challenge a specific issue that is separate from the main case and cannot be resolved later, even if the main case is still ongoing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtNMmgT67aq8UDVBNl.label: Juvenile Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtNMmgT67aq8UDVBNl.definition: A Juvenile Court is a specialized court that has jurisdiction over cases involving minors, typically those under the age of 18, who have been accused of committing a crime or engaging in delinquent behavior.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtTiVdHgoc3I27yCV5.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Carroll County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtTiVdHgoc3I27yCV5.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Carroll County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Carroll County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtYReEP1pIEFHvlzGG.label: Partial Vision Loss
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtYReEP1pIEFHvlzGG.definition: Partial Vision Loss refers to a significant reduction in vision that cannot be fully corrected with conventional glasses, contact lenses, or surgery. This condition affects the ability to perform everyday tasks and may involve difficulties with visual acuity, contrast sensitivity, peripheral vision, or depth perception.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDtgiank9cPXBJiBHga.label: Judicial Arbitration and Mediation Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RDtgiank9cPXBJiBHga.definition: Judicial Arbitration and Mediation Services (JAMS) is an alternative dispute resolution (ADR) venue that provides arbitration and mediation services to parties in legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDudpkFU4l1qFgz09YH.definition: Providing Alcohol to Intoxicated Adult: The act of giving or serving alcoholic beverages to an adult who is already intoxicated, which can result in legal liability for the provider.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuf39SqsoMEvQNTewH.definition: The Bank's Wrongful Dishonor of Negotiable Instrument refers to the act of a bank refusing to pay a negotiable instrument, such as a check or promissory note, without a valid reason, resulting in damages to the party presenting the instrument.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDufYPVrD5csP6JDYMx.label: Georgia Superior Court - Macon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDufYPVrD5csP6JDYMx.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Macon County, Georgia, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuglENJJNibMF8YDtm.label: Probate Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RDuglENJJNibMF8YDtm.definition: A probate claim is a legal action brought to settle the estate of a deceased person, including the distribution of assets and payment of debts, and is a type of civil claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDugn9PmvLpHcwSlx9c.label: Washington Superior Court - Klickitat County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDugn9PmvLpHcwSlx9c.definition: Washington Superior Court - Klickitat County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Klickitat County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDukS1DVkKKku4ERh2r.label: Subrogation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDukS1DVkKKku4ERh2r.definition: Subrogation is a legal concept where an insurance company steps into the shoes of its insured and assumes their rights to recover damages from a third party who caused the loss, after the insurance company has paid out a claim to the insured.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDukTetrGS7uJf9Ylpc.label: Motion for Arbitration
http://lmss.sali.org/RDukTetrGS7uJf9Ylpc.definition: A Motion for Arbitration is a formal request made to a court or arbitrator to resolve a dispute through arbitration rather than litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDumnatrYH4kRxr787b.label: Notice of Abandonment of Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RDumnatrYH4kRxr787b.definition: A Notice of Abandonment of Property is a written communication that informs interested parties that a property has been abandoned by its owner and is available for possession by another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDutJ0S1ZSetoLvJRxa.label: Investigator / Examiner
http://lmss.sali.org/RDutJ0S1ZSetoLvJRxa.definition: An investigator or examiner is person or group that conducts investigations or examinations on behalf of a governmental criminal or regulatory agency, court, or self-regulatory organization, or in connection with internal, congressional, or other investigations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuvu3dUJz2utfkB5G6.label: Visual Field Loss
http://lmss.sali.org/RDuvu3dUJz2utfkB5G6.definition: Visual Field Loss refers to a reduction or loss of the normal field of vision, affecting peripheral or central sight. This condition can result from various underlying causes such as glaucoma, stroke, or retinal damage, significantly impacting daily activities and the ability to navigate environments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuwJvV62Cfl9rlFJij.label: Release of Medical Records Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RDuwJvV62Cfl9rlFJij.definition: A Release of Medical Records Form is a legal document signed by a patient or their legal representative to authorize the sharing of their medical records with specified parties. This can be for the purpose of transferring care, obtaining a second opinion, or for legal needs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuyHZDRBvSF1vlAJM9.label: Negligent Infliction of Emotional Distress on a Bystander
http://lmss.sali.org/RDuyHZDRBvSF1vlAJM9.definition: The concept of Negligent Infliction of Emotional Distress on a Bystander refers to a legal claim made by a person who has suffered emotional harm as a result of witnessing an injury or harm caused to another person due to someone else's negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDuzCluPExGae1dWj6Q.label: Tax Tiers
http://lmss.sali.org/RDuzCluPExGae1dWj6Q.definition: Tax Tiers refer to the different levels or brackets of taxation that are applied to different income or asset levels, as defined in Tax Tier Detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDv8hBbEMrPuIgEyXvl.label: Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RDv8hBbEMrPuIgEyXvl.definition: An appeal is a legal process in which a higher court reviews a decision made by a lower court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvDO34EpHvEMqQWXw1.label: Perinatology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvDO34EpHvEMqQWXw1.definition: Perinatology Malpractice refers to medical malpractice claims related to the care of pregnant women and their fetuses, including issues related to prenatal testing, labor and delivery, and neonatal care.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvL7Pxoo5G3sPWI7Ip.label: Expert Witness Deposition
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvL7Pxoo5G3sPWI7Ip.definition: An expert witness deposition is a legal proceeding where an expert witness is questioned under oath outside of court, typically in a lawyer's office, in order to obtain evidence for a trial or other legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvQ6D4uKhEjQP7gLgN.label: Organization Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvQ6D4uKhEjQP7gLgN.definition: An Organization Representation is a statement made by a party in a legal matter regarding the status, structure, or operations of a company or other entity, which is supported by a warranty that the information provided is accurate and complete.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvQuaxSojEqV7COK0F.label: Texas District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvQuaxSojEqV7COK0F.definition: Texas District Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Texas that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvTvjD3P4k9thkgiT7.label: Discount Amount - Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvTvjD3P4k9thkgiT7.definition: Discount Amount - Fee refers to a reduction in the fee charged for legal services provided, either as a percentage or a fixed amount.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvUGgl6XjksYTzpRcE.label: Negative Advertisement
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvUGgl6XjksYTzpRcE.definition: A Negative Advertisement is a type of advertising that focuses on criticizing or discrediting a competitor, individual, or opposing viewpoint rather than promoting the advertiser's own product or message. These advertisements are often used in political campaigns and competitive business markets to highlight perceived flaws, mistakes, or negative attributes of the target.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvVBJAIjWJ6V7k3Hor.label: Governmental Civil Law Division
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvVBJAIjWJ6V7k3Hor.definition: A Governmental Civil Law Division is a governmental entity that handles civil legal matters involving the government. It provides legal advice to government agencies, represents the government in civil litigation, and ensures compliance with civil laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvY0TcDt3VYHZiiDhP.label: Consideration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvY0TcDt3VYHZiiDhP.definition: A consideration clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the exchange of something of value between parties, which is necessary for the contract to be legally binding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvZM18iP0lVTYqMAOz.label: Visa for Child of Victim of Human Trafficking
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvZM18iP0lVTYqMAOz.definition: The Visa for Child of Victim of Human Trafficking is a derivative visa granted to the child of a principal T-1 Visa holder. The visa allows the child to enter and remain in the U.S. as long as the principal T-1 Visa holder maintains their status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvd595QjUByS6fw9Le.label: Tenancy in Common
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvd595QjUByS6fw9Le.definition: Tenancy in Common is a form of concurrent property ownership where multiple individuals hold separate and undivided interests in the same property. Each tenant in common has the right to sell, transfer, or bequeath their individual share without the consent of the other co-owners, and upon death, their interest passes to their heirs rather than the remaining co-owners.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvgpVtu5XifhG7S8qk.label: Instance
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvgpVtu5XifhG7S8qk.definition: An LMSS Instance - A document that fully describes one or more legal matters

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvoXpLEwrCw49W70qd.label: Wagoner Rule
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvoXpLEwrCw49W70qd.definition: The Wagoner Rule is a legal defense in civil litigation that prevents a trustee from suing third-party professionals for damages caused by the trustee's own misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvpqXyTVnn4iSlRfw4.label: Colorado River Abstention
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvpqXyTVnn4iSlRfw4.definition: A legal doctrine that allows federal courts to abstain from hearing cases that involve complex state water rights issues in the Colorado River Basin.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvqI3YurzXDXZKeOIl.label: Role in Project Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvqI3YurzXDXZKeOIl.definition: An individual's role in the matter in project management terms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvqZlbFc0a0Ah7rQrq.label: DOCX
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvqZlbFc0a0Ah7rQrq.definition: A Microsoft Word file that was introduced by Microsoft with the release of Microsoft Office 2007.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvswMr1SCgZ3jjThYE.label: Basal Cell Carcinoma
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvswMr1SCgZ3jjThYE.definition: Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, originating in the basal cells found in the epidermis, the skin's outermost layer. It typically grows slowly and rarely metastasizes but can cause significant local damage if not treated, often requiring surgical excision or other localized treatments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDvuhcO7t3vWCZIkWPl.label: Statutory Compliance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RDvuhcO7t3vWCZIkWPl.definition: A Statutory Compliance Clause is a provision in a legal agreement that requires the parties to comply with specific laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDw3C0Q9SA9H8y85Zz4.label: Profitability Metrics
http://lmss.sali.org/RDw3C0Q9SA9H8y85Zz4.definition: Profitability metrics are financial measures used to assess a business's ability to generate profit relative to its revenue, assets, equity, or other financial metrics. These metrics evaluate the net financial gains or losses relative to the costs and investments made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwA2C5kO5T37PMjFme.label: Right to Bear Arms Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwA2C5kO5T37PMjFme.definition: A right to bear arms claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to keep and bear arms, as protected by the Second Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. The Second Amendment guarantees the right of individuals to keep and bear arms for self-defense and other lawful purposes. A right to bear arms claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts the right to own or possess firearms, when a government actor denies a permit or license to possess firearms, or when an individual or group is punished for exercising their Second Amendment rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwDmcN0z56JIukw0vY.label: Disturbing the Peace
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwDmcN0z56JIukw0vY.definition: The act of disturbing the peace refers to behavior that disrupts public order and tranquility, and is classified as a criminal misdemeanor offense.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwGA2wsl0Gd2FDYqr9.label: South Carolina Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwGA2wsl0Gd2FDYqr9.definition: The South Carolina Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of South Carolina, responsible for hearing appeals and making final decisions on legal disputes within the state court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwISw0syjjwmS6Upyi.label: Reckless Involuntary Manslaughter
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwISw0syjjwmS6Upyi.definition: The unlawful killing of a person without intent, caused by a reckless disregard for human life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwKZmUGcjAuR74XG4w.label: Tic Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwKZmUGcjAuR74XG4w.definition: Tic Disorders involve the presence of repetitive, involuntary movements or vocalizations. They may include simple motor tics, such as blinking or head jerking, and complex tics, such as jumping or uttering words or phrases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwKxHFcrBZNohdOalD.definition: Rajasthani (Language) is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, specifically used in the region of Rajasthan, India.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwUP18FQocGTgNd4Md.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Certain Family Members of Citizens of Host Country" permits specified family members of citizens to immigrate with rights to reside permanently. http://lmss.sali.org/RDwX4hjSSjdLB4a9gnV.definition: Medical Device Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the use of a faulty or defective medical device during a medical procedure.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwYaUfGBr5UZFb2zWl.definition: Contributory Negligence: A legal defense that asserts that the plaintiff's own negligence contributed to their injury or damages, and therefore the defendant should not be held fully liable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwajUPdKVdK5tlwiUj.label: Eminent Domain
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwajUPdKVdK5tlwiUj.definition: The concept of Eminent Domain (Taking) refers to the power of the government to take private property for public use, with just compensation to the owner, as authorized by the Constitution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwd5PDZ9zTHHMKlx2y.label: Auditability of an AI System
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwd5PDZ9zTHHMKlx2y.definition: Auditability refers to the ability of an AI system to undergo an assessment of its algorithms, data, and design processes to determine whether the system is functioning as intended. Auditability does not necessarily imply that information about business models and intellectual property must always be openly available, but ensuring traceability and logging mechanisms from the early design phase can help enable the system's auditability

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwmq7JOH4W6fDC0SxZ.definition: Adyghe or Adygei is a language belonging to the Language top-level class, spoken by the Adyghe people in the North Caucasus region of Russia, and is used in legal matters as a means of communication or evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwq7PYH0atP5hCMh8B.label: Equitable Estoppel
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwq7PYH0atP5hCMh8B.definition: Equitable Estoppel is a legal principle that prevents a party from denying or asserting a right, claim, or fact that is inconsistent with their previous conduct or representations, when such denial or assertion would result in injustice or harm to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwrtWEQ5TXWvWsESfm.label: Tupi languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RDwrtWEQ5TXWvWsESfm.definition: A group of languages spoken in Brazil, characterized by complex phonetics and grammar, and historically used by indigenous peoples in the region.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwwoOv1gj5cseOKF2r.definition: The Arkansas Circuit Court - Cleveland Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cleveland County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDwyGtg5lfOTDRyDmpG.definition: A Motion to File Joint Brief is a formal request made to the court by two or more parties in a legal case, seeking permission to submit a single brief that represents their collective arguments and positions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDx4PuWu7ZznwNEGW6r.label: Fruit Crops
http://lmss.sali.org/RDx4PuWu7ZznwNEGW6r.definition: Fruit crops are plants cultivated primarily for their edible fruits, which are consumed fresh, processed, or used in various food products. http://lmss.sali.org/RDx9FsmTptzCZ54ccXa.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Clark County
http://lmss.sali.org/RDx9FsmTptzCZ54ccXa.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Clark County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Clark County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxGK5OqVpRO03T7ZY8.definition: The concept of Intent refers to the state of mind of a person who acts with a purpose or goal in mind, and is an essential element of a legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxXbFOfpBJ1GxErWgd.definition: Household Motor Vehicle Tax Payment refers to user taxes levied on motor vehicles owned by households. http://lmss.sali.org/RDxZHOiHBvxpV8qBVb8.definition: A Motion for Relief from Stay is a legal request made in bankruptcy proceedings to lift the automatic stay that prevents creditors from taking collection actions against the debtor or the debtor's property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxZjKnm3grueUeRmKR.definition: A Written Form Requirement Clause is a clause in a contract that specifies that any modifications or waivers to the contract must be in writing to be valid.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxaorxe2dEXlrWrIAN.label: Auditory Processing Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxaorxe2dEXlrWrIAN.definition: Auditory Processing Disorder (APD) is a condition where the brain has difficulty interpreting and processing sounds, even though the individual's hearing is typically normal. This disorder affects the ability to understand speech, particularly in noisy environments, and can lead to challenges in communication, learning, and following directions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxbjBJjqwTXjdafXhf.label: Elect at Exercise Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxbjBJjqwTXjdafXhf.definition: An Elect at Exercise Asset is a financial instrument where the method of delivery of the underlying asset is determined at the time of exercise. This flexibility allows the option holder to choose between physical delivery and cash settlement based on prevailing market conditions or personal preferences at the moment of exercising the option.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxcIY3H7tMKY9RIefO.label: New Jersey Department of Labor - Workmen's Compensation Bureau
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxcIY3H7tMKY9RIefO.definition: The New Jersey Department of Labor - Workmen's Compensation Bureau is a government entity responsible for administering proceedings related to workmen's compensation claims in the state of New Jersey.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxd28CzQaMv6As09I9.label: Nevada District Court - Las Vegas Township
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxd28CzQaMv6As09I9.definition: The Nevada District Court - Las Vegas Township is a specific court within the Nevada District Court system, located in Las Vegas, with jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxf4VqU0aYYzfTFlKF.label: Motion for Speedy Trial
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxf4VqU0aYYzfTFlKF.definition: A Motion for Speedy Trial is a formal request made by a party in a trial court to expedite the proceedings and ensure a prompt trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RDxg2CDlW3pNJJnGPSy.label: Tech Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RDxg2CDlW3pNJJnGPSy.definition: Tech Segment refers to businesses that apply scientific knowledge and technological advancements to various industries, resulting in innovative products, services, and solutions. This tag is used in conjunction with other Industries to encompasses a wide range of sectors. For example Tech + Financial Industry = FinTech (financial technology). Tech + Biology = BioTech (biotechnology). Tech + Law = LegalTech (legal technology). Adding Tech tech indicates that the company is focused on leveraging technology to enhance their respective industries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RE2D2e5FE497aD82650.label: Publishing Industries
http://lmss.sali.org/RE2D2e5FE497aD82650.definition:
Industries in the Publishing Industries subsector group establishments engaged in publishing newspapers, magazines, other periodicals, books, directories, and software.  In general, establishments known as publishers issue copies of works for which they usually possess copyright.  Works may be in one or more formats including print form, CD-ROM, proprietary electronic networks, or exclusively on the Internet.  Publishers may publish works originally created by others for which they have obtained the rights and/or works that they have created in-house.  Publishers may publish only and license rights to others to distribute their content, or they may publish and distribute content they create or own.  Software publishing is included here because the activity, creation of a copyrighted product and bringing it to market, is equivalent to the creation process for other types of intellectual products.

In NAICS, publishing--the reporting, writing, editing, and other processes that are required to create an edition of a newspaper, for example--is treated as a major economic activity in its own right, rather than as a subsidiary activity to a manufacturing activity, printing.  Thus, publishing is classified in the Information sector; whereas, printing is in the Manufacturing sector.  The Publishing Industries subsector excludes printed products, such as manifold business forms and appointment books, for which information is not the essential component.  Establishments producing these items are included in Subsector 323, Printing and Related Support Activities.

Reproduction of prepackaged software is treated in NAICS as a manufacturing activity, and custom design of software to client specifications is included in the Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services sector.  These distinctions arise because of the different ways that software is created, reproduced, and distributed.

Music publishers and establishments primarily engaged in the production, or production and distribution, of motion pictures and sound recordings are included in Subsector 512, Motion Picture and Sound Recording Industries.  Establishments not engaged in publishing and exclusively obtaining rights from publishers to broadcast and distribute content are included in Subsector 516, Broadcasting and Content Providers.
