For example, a job posting for a restaurant server may require applicants to be at least 18 years of age so they can legally serve alcohol. Another example is requiring at least one security hospital treatment assistant assigned to each psychiatric hospital ward to be the same gender as the ward's patients.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFXc2NtinmfJhHDBnbV.label: Provisional Remedies
http://lmss.sali.org/RFXc2NtinmfJhHDBnbV.definition: Provisional Remedies are temporary legal measures sought by a party in a civil matter to preserve the status quo or prevent irreparable harm until a final decision is made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFYLTPZWRREWDLqyzEX.label: A121 Review and Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RFYLTPZWRREWDLqyzEX.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, the inspection, review, consideration and analysis of documents and/or evidence. Includes coding and relevance issues. Excludes creation of privilege log (A124 ).

http://lmss.sali.org/RFaPio4mlb48F4I6Jc9.label: Sports Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RFaPio4mlb48F4I6Jc9.definition: Sports Law deals with the legal issues and regulations pertaining to the sports industry, including professional and amateur athletics. It covers a wide range of topics such as contracts, doping, governance, and the rights and obligations of athletes and sports organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFanQiAnBUnqQS4PNIu.label: Extension Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RFanQiAnBUnqQS4PNIu.definition: An Extension Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the continuation of the agreement beyond its original term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFbo1oe9cJzQBiZOpja.label: Executive Compensation Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RFbo1oe9cJzQBiZOpja.definition: A specialized area of legal practice that deals with the compensation of executives in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFcc1hLGAY0GgnjkxuG.label: Volapük
http://lmss.sali.org/RFcc1hLGAY0GgnjkxuG.definition: A constructed language created in the late 19th century by Johann Martin Schleyer, which was intended to be a universal language for international communication.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFeC4TqOYKdmvZk68QO.label: Insurance Carrier Defrauded or Exploited
http://lmss.sali.org/RFeC4TqOYKdmvZk68QO.definition: When an insurance company has acted dishonestly or taken advantage of a policyholder, resulting in financial harm to the policyholder.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFi2biTCtSyMF5I2GrN.label: Motion to Complete Production of Reporters Transcript at Government Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RFi2biTCtSyMF5I2GrN.definition: A Motion to Complete Production of Reporters Transcript at Government Expense is a legal request for the government to pay for the creation of a complete transcript of court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFiPHB15V5fi2AKA6IC.label: Summons
http://lmss.sali.org/RFiPHB15V5fi2AKA6IC.definition: A summons is a legal document issued by a court that commands a person to appear before the court at a specific time and place to respond to a legal action or complaint.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFjY2mO804t9gJNy5Dn.label: Impersonation / Identity Theft
http://lmss.sali.org/RFjY2mO804t9gJNy5Dn.definition: Falsely representing one’s identity or position, and acting in the character or position thus unlawfully assumed, to deceive others and thereby gain a profit or advantage, enjoy some right or privilege, or subject another person or entity to an expense, charge, or liability which would not have otherwise been incurred.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFpBjIfzU3RXCegOpVh.label: Period of Duration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RFpBjIfzU3RXCegOpVh.definition: A period of duration clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the length of time that the agreement will remain in effect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFpHjjyeQAAERzH5snl.label: Public Health Emergency
http://lmss.sali.org/RFpHjjyeQAAERzH5snl.definition: Public health emergency refers to an occurrence or imminent threat of a health condition, usually caused by bioterrorism, a pandemic, or a large-scale natural disaster, that poses a substantial risk of harm to a community. In such cases, governments often mobilize resources and implement special measures to protect public health and safety

http://lmss.sali.org/RFqnX5yQ8bOQLLDSeyd.label: Little Traverse Bay Bands of Odawa Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RFrien46eAPSSbu8Wgo.label: Shoplifting
http://lmss.sali.org/RFrien46eAPSSbu8Wgo.definition: The act of taking merchandise from a store without paying for it, which is classified as a criminal offense of a minor nature.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFxt2cSeT2RBVN8WSY8.label: Fee Charge Description
http://lmss.sali.org/RFxt2cSeT2RBVN8WSY8.definition: A Fee Charge Description is a specific detail within an Engagement Fee that outlines the amount and nature of the fees charged for legal services provided.

http://lmss.sali.org/RFzBl42TJ4hAndb7h9Z.label: New York City Court - Elmira
http://lmss.sali.org/RFzBl42TJ4hAndb7h9Z.definition: A court located in Elmira, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RG06B87qkXrj4iQBwon.label: oasis:Metadata-Actor
http://lmss.sali.org/RG06B87qkXrj4iQBwon.definition: An oasis:Metadata-Actor is a type of agent that is defined within the LegalXML OASIS SCHEMA and can be further classified as a dctermsAgent, oasis:Expression, oasis:LegalRuleMLDocument, oasis:collection, or oasis:actor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RG0fhXoj6WTAggLjEkg.label: Georgia Superior Court - Pickens County
http://lmss.sali.org/RG0fhXoj6WTAggLjEkg.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Pickens County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within Pickens County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RG0kxB4cikzMEBEWFCv.label: 06 Forfeiture / Penalty (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RG0kxB4cikzMEBEWFCv.definition: The concept of "06 Forfeiture/Penalty (PACER NoS)" refers to a specific category within the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes that deals with the legal process of seizing property as a penalty for drug-related offenses under 21 U.S.C. § 881.

http://lmss.sali.org/RG8KMwTTcR-af5jqEDj.label: PA230 Clearance Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RG8KMwTTcR-af5jqEDj.definition: All actions associated with determining whether a proposed product or process might be covered by the claims of patents and/or published patent applications, including definition of the scope and field of the search, searching, search field integrity checking, analysis of search results, and reporting to client. Also known as a "right-to-use" or "non-infringement" search, the field of a clearance search is often limited to the patent claims in a very narrow technical area. The purpose of an infringement search is to determine whether there are claims in those patent documents that might be broadly construed to cover a well-defined, commercial embodiment of a product or process. Since interpretation of the patent claims may require review of the disclosure, patentability and clearance investigations are sometimes performed concurrently. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal clearance opinion directed at specific patents should be prepared separately under PA710.

http://lmss.sali.org/RG8kSMylipyZnmq2GVa.label: New York City Court - Ithaca
http://lmss.sali.org/RG8kSMylipyZnmq2GVa.definition: A court located in Ithaca, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGCpbuNOHtlNDogCc7d.label: Reasonable Belief
http://lmss.sali.org/RGCpbuNOHtlNDogCc7d.definition: A reasonable belief is a standard of proof in litigation where a party must demonstrate that they held a belief that was objectively reasonable under the circumstances, in order to meet their burden of proof.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGD2LvcZSCA07tK5mqk.label: Mesa Grande Band of Diegueno Mission Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RGD5s0tdbIIT2bX068Z.label: Recovery of a Chattel / Replevin
http://lmss.sali.org/RGD5s0tdbIIT2bX068Z.definition: The concept of Recovery of a Chattel or Replevin refers to the legal action taken to recover personal property that has been wrongfully taken or detained by another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGDeLOS6gclKMduTkkQ.label: Genetic Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RGDeLOS6gclKMduTkkQ.definition: Genetic evidence, commonly known as DNA evidence, refers to the unique genetic material found in cells, body fluids, or tissues. It is used in forensic science to identify or exclude individuals as sources of the material, providing a powerful tool for linking suspects to crime scenes or victims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGEgmKbY18qXXUvDzNA.label: "Superior Offer, or Acquisition Proposal reasonably likely/expected to result in a Superior Offer" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RGEgmKbY18qXXUvDzNA.definition: A "Superior Offer, or Acquisition Proposal reasonably likely/expected to result in a Superior Offer" is a proposal made during a legal matter that is expected to be better than any other offers made, and triggers an exception to a previously agreed upon no-shop covenant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGEouAo51bku9BbBZNL.label: Texas District Court - Randall County
http://lmss.sali.org/RGEouAo51bku9BbBZNL.definition: A Texas District Court located in Randall County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGEvRqPhTjbwhcFWfzJ.label: Annuity
http://lmss.sali.org/RGEvRqPhTjbwhcFWfzJ.definition: An annuity is a financial product or arrangement that provides a series of payments made at equal intervals over a specified period. Annuities are commonly used for retirement income, insurance, and investment purposes, and can be structured as fixed, variable, immediate, or deferred, depending on the timing and variability of payments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGFG6LdQMDh5PGrImjE.label: Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RGFG6LdQMDh5PGrImjE.definition: A statement is a written or spoken declaration of facts or opinions, typically made under oath or affirmation, and used as evidence in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGI4PhR8gNWSUrBwEMg.label: Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Delayed
http://lmss.sali.org/RGI4PhR8gNWSUrBwEMg.definition: The concept of "Buyer Consent Not Unreasonably Delayed" refers to the requirement that a buyer's consent to a legal matter must be given in a timely manner, without any unnecessary or unreasonable delays.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGJ5W6CSr3oftkNlugN.label: Washington Superior Court - Clark County
http://lmss.sali.org/RGJ5W6CSr3oftkNlugN.definition: Washington Superior Court - Clark County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Clark County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGK6KYY8XqLTyeigvEA.label: Work Break
http://lmss.sali.org/RGK6KYY8XqLTyeigvEA.definition: "Work Break" typically refers to a short period of rest or pause during the workday, allowing employees to recharge or relax briefly before resuming their tasks. It can vary in duration and purpose, such as a coffee break, lunch break, or a quick break to stretch and refocus.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGMtqJaTuraqFEBqi0W.label: Amendment to Promissory Note Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RGMtqJaTuraqFEBqi0W.definition: An Amendment to Promissory Note Clause is a specific provision added to a promissory note that modifies the terms of the original agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGOLr7MpVSIaLa12TCw.label: PA210 State-of-the-Art Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RGOLr7MpVSIaLa12TCw.definition: All actions associated with determining the state of the art in a particular area of technology, including definition of the scope and field of the search, searching, analysis of search results, and reporting to client. Also known as a "collection" search, a state-of-the- art search is the broadest and most general type of patent search with a field that may include published patent applications, expired and unexpired patents, non-patent literature, and/or other sources. State-of-the-art searches are typically conducted, if at all, during the conceptual design phase when the scope of the investigation is least defined. State-of-the-art searches may also be used to help identify technology that is disclosed in expired patents and may therefore be freely copied by anyone. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGOU62BPz1QTVsWRE2N.label: Employment Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/RGOU62BPz1QTVsWRE2N.definition: Employment Attributes describe the various statuses and characteristics that define an individual's current or past relationship with an employer. These attributes can include whether the employment is full-time or part-time, and the employee's current status such as active, inactive, or terminated, which helps in administrative tracking and benefits allocation

http://lmss.sali.org/RGPW9vXuCzRuL2YAyHp.label: Additional Rent Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RGPW9vXuCzRuL2YAyHp.definition: An Additional Rent Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a tenant to pay for expenses beyond the base rent, such as property taxes or maintenance costs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGPbZoO8Vm2RRxpN47H.label: Annual Incentive Plan Bonus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RGPbZoO8Vm2RRxpN47H.definition: An Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) Bonus Clause is a specific provision within a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for receiving a bonus payment based on the achievement of certain performance goals over a one-year period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGPj715HBTSaqcAzs3A.label: TR740 Licensing
http://lmss.sali.org/RGPj715HBTSaqcAzs3A.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing trademark license.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGRlexTF9nmZ1BSpxAX.label: Immigrant Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RGRlexTF9nmZ1BSpxAX.definition: An immigrant visa is issued to foreign nationals who intend to live permanently in the U.S. This visa category includes various types, such as family-based, employment-based, and diversity lottery visas, leading to permanent resident status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGSVmXZ5WBFZQRboAF2.label: Transfer Stipulation
http://lmss.sali.org/RGSVmXZ5WBFZQRboAF2.definition: Transfer Stipulation refers to a legal agreement between parties involved in an appellate case, outlining the terms and conditions of transferring the case from one court to another.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGSYEjChlHNtLNr8xML.label: U.S. Code
http://lmss.sali.org/RGSYEjChlHNtLNr8xML.definition: A law enacted and codified by the United States Congress.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGT3tGgtVynOYPLDG2m.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Monroe County
http://lmss.sali.org/RGT3tGgtVynOYPLDG2m.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Monroe County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Monroe County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGUf0CMA7MXICpk8Z1k.label: Arkansas District Court - Crawford Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RGUf0CMA7MXICpk8Z1k.definition: A court located in Crawford County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGVC4iLBAv5yqaFh8rY.label: Compensation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RGVC4iLBAv5yqaFh8rY.definition: A Compensation Clause, also known as a Payment Clause, is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for payment in the event of a breach or termination of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGVpvFoX2DAROTk85G2.label: Bantu languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RGVpvFoX2DAROTk85G2.definition: A group of languages spoken in sub-Saharan Africa, characterized by their use of Bantu grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGVrDmO3wOb1JN6PDlL.label: Election Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RGVrDmO3wOb1JN6PDlL.definition: Legal procedures and regulations governing elections.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGWmi9tzlu0RlsKBkKs.label: Miniwarehouses and Self-Storage Units - Real Estate Asset

http://lmss.sali.org/RGXy0oNocTZtCwtwcSR.label: U.S. President
http://lmss.sali.org/RGXy0oNocTZtCwtwcSR.definition: The U.S. President is the head of state and government, responsible for executing federal laws, commanding the armed forces, and representing the United States in diplomatic matters. Elected to a four-year term, the President serves as both the chief executive officer of the federal government and the commander-in-chief of the military.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGYaQfL3oZHWDSaLNo3.label: Status - Responded
http://lmss.sali.org/RGYaQfL3oZHWDSaLNo3.definition: Status of "Responded" typically indicates that a response or action has been provided in relation to a previous request, inquiry, or communication. This could refer to providing additional information, documentation, or clarification in response to a query from authorities (e.g., immigration authorities, patent office, trademark office) or other relevant parties during the application process

http://lmss.sali.org/RGby6vUcfplpGBjYXaI.label: Release
http://lmss.sali.org/RGby6vUcfplpGBjYXaI.definition: A Release is a legal defense used in civil litigation that involves the relinquishment or surrender of a claim or right by one party to another. A Release can also be a legal document in which one party agrees not to pursue legal action against another party in exchange for compensation or other considerations. It signifies the conclusion of a claim or potential claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGcHWmeLzS8uv0M776z.label: B220 Employee Benefits/Pensions
http://lmss.sali.org/RGcHWmeLzS8uv0M776z.definition: Review issues such as severance, retention, 401K coverage and continuance of pension plan

http://lmss.sali.org/RGcqiLEe0IK8lPRt5mF.label: Motion for Summary Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RGcqiLEe0IK8lPRt5mF.definition: A Motion for Summary Judgment is a request made by a party in a legal case asking the court to rule in their favor without a trial, based on the evidence presented in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGgWUd90RQdeUSpcqDD.label: Tip Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RGgWUd90RQdeUSpcqDD.definition: A tip violation claim refers to a legal action initiated by an employee, usually in the service industry, alleging that their employer has violated federal, state, or local laws governing tipped employees. Common examples of tip violations include employers improperly pooling tips, taking a portion of tips, or failing to pay the required minimum wage to tipped employees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGgud6WEj4JVLWr3BQE.label: Jewish Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/RGgud6WEj4JVLWr3BQE.definition: The Jewish Religion, or Judaism, is a monotheistic faith rooted in the covenantal relationship between the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and the children of Israel, as detailed in the Hebrew Bible. In legal contexts, it often involves issues related to religious freedoms, accommodations for religious observances, and the recognition of Jewish holidays and dietary laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGhPDhmBGvFQqjh8ORG.label: Indiana Superior Court - White County
http://lmss.sali.org/RGhPDhmBGvFQqjh8ORG.definition: The Indiana Superior Court - White County is a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over cases within White County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGhcPktpuzKTEKWsL4k.label: Physician Violation of Patient Confidentiality
http://lmss.sali.org/RGhcPktpuzKTEKWsL4k.definition: The concept of Physician Violation of Patient Confidentiality refers to the breach of trust by a medical professional who discloses private information about a patient without their consent, potentially resulting in legal claims for medical malpractice and privacy violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGioQx9HST8m6z44tGP.label: A126 Evidence/Exhibit Creation and Preparation
http://lmss.sali.org/RGioQx9HST8m6z44tGP.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, the creation, export or delivery of trial evidence or exhibits including: creation of video clips and other demonstrative evidence from the collection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGkDyYmOTwUEstuQWdg.label: Government-Regulated Defined Contribution Account
http://lmss.sali.org/RGkDyYmOTwUEstuQWdg.definition: A Government-Regulated Defined Contribution Account, such as a 401(k) or Thrift Savings Plan, is a retirement savings account where an individual contributes a fixed amount or a percentage of their salary into a fund. The government regulates these accounts to provide tax advantages, and the ultimate benefit received is dependent on the performance of the investments chosen within the account.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGlEckAmITq2P8F_5mJ.label: PA299 Other Patent Investigation and Analysis
http://lmss.sali.org/RGlEckAmITq2P8F_5mJ.definition: Use only for patent investigation and analysis activities that can not be included under a previous code, under PA710 (Opinion Preparation), or as instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGm7jrTspmRi606c5XW.label: Malpractice Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RGm7jrTspmRi606c5XW.definition: Malpractice Claims refer to civil claims of negligence or malfeasance brought against a professional or tradesperson, such as a doctor, lawyer, accountant, or architect, for failing to meet the standard of care expected in their field.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGmCjcGucxczfY9xvyj.label: DEPRECATED: Formerly Tax Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RGmCjcGucxczfY9xvyj.definition: Deprecated concept that was formerly related to tax risk.
