http://lmss.sali.org/RGoYysWgSTfIx2GA9xv.definition: Active Status refers to the current operational condition or state of an entity, such as an account, membership, or project, indicating that it is in good standing and fully functional. In legal and business contexts, an entity with active status is generally compliant with all requirements and obligations, allowing it to engage in its designated activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGpjAh2s6SRXnZuoQLp.label: Washington Commission on Professional Ethics
http://lmss.sali.org/RGpjAh2s6SRXnZuoQLp.definition: The Washington Commission on Professional Ethics is a government entity within the Washington State Courts that oversees and regulates ethical conduct of legal professionals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGpqNajAdZ8mqxfcUaK.label: Arizona Superior Court - Santa Cruz Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RGpqNajAdZ8mqxfcUaK.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Santa Cruz Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Santa Cruz County, Arizona.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGrDBe4o2VsLIvcRupa.label: Will Contest
http://lmss.sali.org/RGrDBe4o2VsLIvcRupa.definition: A Will Contest is a legal claim challenging the validity of a will, typically based on allegations of fraud, undue influence, lack of capacity, or improper execution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGrNllUoKqoToBQ3CTM.label: Arizona Superior Court - Pima Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RGrNllUoKqoToBQ3CTM.definition: The Arizona Superior Court - Pima County is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Pima County, Arizona.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGrP50kf21RhCVFzDgi.label: Court Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RGrP50kf21RhCVFzDgi.definition: Court Costs: Expenses incurred in the course of a legal proceeding that are typically paid by the losing party, including fees for court clerks, marshals, and reporters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGrXuVATYPRc56MkpFu.label: Consensual Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/RGrXuVATYPRc56MkpFu.definition: A consensual lien is a type of lien that is created by agreement between the parties involved, allowing the lienholder to have a security interest in the property of the debtor until the debt is paid off.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGsUOggnA0rNAVA0uxy.label: M&A B Purchase / Merger Agreement Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RGsUOggnA0rNAVA0uxy.definition: The M&A B Purchase/Merger Agreement Practice refers to the legal work involved in negotiating and drafting agreements for the purchase or merger of companies, as a component of the broader M&A practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGsi8yDSJVynToXHP6J.label: Florida Circuit Court - Washington County - 14th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RGsi8yDSJVynToXHP6J.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Washington County (14th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Washington County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGvDd1LWO2w0H7qGaNt.label: Reasonable Accommodation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RGvDd1LWO2w0H7qGaNt.definition: This claim is brought forward when an employer, school, or service provider fails to make reasonable adjustments or modifications that would allow an individual with a disability to access employment opportunities, services, or benefits. The nature of the accommodation depends on the individual's needs and the context, but it aims to ensure equal opportunities and non-discrimination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGwPYMOUrxlxZFIvTL3.label: Equipment Lease
http://lmss.sali.org/RGwPYMOUrxlxZFIvTL3.definition: An equipment lease is a contractual agreement in which one party (the lessor) grants another party (the lessee) the right to use and possess specific equipment for a predetermined period in exchange for periodic rental payments. These agreements often include terms related to maintenance, insurance, and the lessee's responsibilities during the lease term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGwW3AjJQKusxWkOrvI.label: Restructuring Support Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RGwW3AjJQKusxWkOrvI.definition: Document where parties agree to terms that will expedite the restructuring process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGwortSox0oBPyp9H9d.label: Matching Rights Period
http://lmss.sali.org/RGwortSox0oBPyp9H9d.definition: A Matching Rights Period is a specific period of time during which a party has the right to match the terms of a proposed transaction or agreement, as outlined in the Matching Rights Language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGxK3uoinK5lhCbzOr5.label: Turkish, Ottoman
http://lmss.sali.org/RGxK3uoinK5lhCbzOr5.definition: Turkish, Ottoman (1500-1928) is a language used during the Ottoman Empire period in Turkey and surrounding regions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RGxoT943fyMiM3To2aw.label: New York Supreme Court - New York County
http://lmss.sali.org/RGxoT943fyMiM3To2aw.definition: The New York Supreme Court - New York County is a court of general jurisdiction located in New York County, which is a subdivision of the New York Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RH2Wku3c8iuEwwCvz5L.label: Lead
http://lmss.sali.org/RH2Wku3c8iuEwwCvz5L.definition: Person or organization leading an aspect of the matter (e.g., Lead Counsel, Lead Businessperson, etc.).

http://lmss.sali.org/RH3E5nD8r0YneI6AAPh.label: Short Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RH3E5nD8r0YneI6AAPh.definition: A Short Form is a condensed version of a longer document, capturing the essential terms and conditions without the extensive detail. It is used in various legal contexts, such as contracts, agreements, and reports, to provide a succinct overview of the main points.

http://lmss.sali.org/RH8jvsAVSmzyIoVl6oG.label: Commercial Publisher
http://lmss.sali.org/RH8jvsAVSmzyIoVl6oG.definition: A commercial publisher operates to produce and distribute various types of publications, such as books, magazines, or digital content, with the primary goal of generating profit. Unlike academic publishers, commercial publishers often focus on broader audiences and market-driven topics. In the legal sector, commercial publishers might produce legal texts, practice guides, or public-facing materials that appeal to professionals, students, or the general public, with revenue generated through sales, subscriptions, or advertising.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHBAWBNGU2uLqb1Hf0Y.label: One-Step Merger
http://lmss.sali.org/RHBAWBNGU2uLqb1Hf0Y.definition: A One-Step Merger is a type of merger where the acquiring company merges directly with the target company, without the need for a separate shareholder vote on the merger agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHDMQlGgzEEMmjp5J2N.label: task_code
http://lmss.sali.org/RHDMQlGgzEEMmjp5J2N.definition:
"Task code for this line item, e.g. ""L110"". Only one code per line item.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RHEBDj55KU1X33SfjWr.label: Non-consensual Pornography Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RHEBDj55KU1X33SfjWr.definition: A revenge porn claim is a legal assertion that an individual's private, sexually explicit images or videos have been distributed without their consent, typically as an act of revenge or harassment. This claim seeks redress for the invasion of privacy, emotional distress, and potential reputational harm caused by the unauthorized dissemination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHKyHQoZVQByJMrXrhD.label: WC510 Appellate Proceedings/Motions Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RHKyHQoZVQByJMrXrhD.definition: Research appellate issues, Draft response to motions/other filings, Arguing motions/other findings, Attend motion hearing, Travel to & from motion hearing, Prepare notice of appeal, Designing appellate record, Extraordinary writs/appellate proceedings, Review responses to appellate petition, Prepare response to appellate petition, Prepare petition appendix

http://lmss.sali.org/RHMeichLVmy6Ok0awBy.label: Dogri
http://lmss.sali.org/RHMeichLVmy6Ok0awBy.definition: A language spoken primarily in the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHNTT12ao72q3s8CyYy.label: Fee Simple Subject to a Condition Subsequent
http://lmss.sali.org/RHNTT12ao72q3s8CyYy.definition: A fee simple subject to a condition subsequent is a type of freehold estate in real property that grants ownership rights to the holder, subject to a specified condition, with the potential for forfeiture if the condition is violated. Unlike fee simple determinable, this estate does not automatically revert to the grantor upon breach of the condition; instead, the grantor retains the right to re-enter and reclaim the property, but must take affirmative action to enforce this right.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHQCq2MZ2qxhPK6rPVZ.label: Georgia Superior Court - Rabun County
http://lmss.sali.org/RHQCq2MZ2qxhPK6rPVZ.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Rabun County, Georgia, with authority over civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHQzoezpyEQRrPtGKay.label: Surgical Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RHQzoezpyEQRrPtGKay.definition: Surgical Negligence refers to a type of medical malpractice where a surgeon fails to provide the expected standard of care during a surgical procedure, resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHSZPHkLvnB6N4bgIo6.label: Business Torts and Actions
http://lmss.sali.org/RHSZPHkLvnB6N4bgIo6.definition: Business Torts and Actions are civil claims related to wrongful acts committed by one business against another, including unfair competition, false advertising, theft of intellectual property, and interference with contracts or business relationships.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHU1IfTNMJFFPEpELXs.label: By Stage / Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RHU1IfTNMJFFPEpELXs.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays a predetermined fee through a matter's stages (e.g., "through initial pleadings" or "through discovery" or "through dispositive motions" or "through trial")

http://lmss.sali.org/RHUIfd8WQSMckRB0AAy.label: Monthly Retainer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RHUIfd8WQSMckRB0AAy.definition: A Monthly Retainer Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to pay a fixed amount of money to the other party on a monthly basis in exchange for services or goods provided.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHVF9rBHDyMHmpGYQyj.label: Motion to Suppress
http://lmss.sali.org/RHVF9rBHDyMHmpGYQyj.definition: A Motion to Suppress is a legal request made by a party in a trial to exclude evidence from being presented in court, typically due to a violation of the defendant's constitutional rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHXDdSfiFTbmrGb8xoh.label: Unfair Trade Practices
http://lmss.sali.org/RHXDdSfiFTbmrGb8xoh.definition: Unfair Trade Practices refer to any deceptive or fraudulent business practices that harm consumers or competitors, and are considered illegal under competition law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHYWovoWsSPi2VwXPS9.label: L609 Quality assurance and control
http://lmss.sali.org/RHYWovoWsSPi2VwXPS9.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHZTIZfN6Fbrf6azREx.label: Pre-Closing Covenants
http://lmss.sali.org/RHZTIZfN6Fbrf6azREx.definition: "Pre-Closing Covenants" are commitments or obligations that parties agree to fulfill or abide by prior to the completion of a transaction, such as a merger or acquisition. These covenants ensure that the parties maintain certain conditions, avoid specific actions, or perform particular tasks leading up to the transaction's formal closure, preserving the deal's integrity and value.

http://lmss.sali.org/RH_1AK1sfSsWwaT-fpE.label: TR250 Publication Watches
http://lmss.sali.org/RH_1AK1sfSsWwaT-fpE.definition: All actions associated with planning, completing, and reporting the results of periodic searches for conflicting trademarks. For example, this may include monitoring the file history of trademark applications, and/or publication for opposition. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be expensed under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHagFJXtPsCCn5dbENW.label: Statutes
http://lmss.sali.org/RHagFJXtPsCCn5dbENW.definition: A law enacted by a government's legislative branch.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHbafeB3iGRJL6ZD0aG.label: Credit Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RHbafeB3iGRJL6ZD0aG.definition: A credit report is a detailed record of an individual's or entity's credit history, including information about their borrowing and repayment activities, outstanding debts, and any instances of late payments or defaults. Lenders and financial institutions use credit reports to assess the creditworthiness of a borrower before extending credit or loans.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHcRiu0QYL4kyB2wZND.label: Georgia Superior Court - Early County
http://lmss.sali.org/RHcRiu0QYL4kyB2wZND.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Early County refers to a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Early County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHdDglsu8S0eiLb25eV.label: L653 First pass document review
http://lmss.sali.org/RHdDglsu8S0eiLb25eV.definition: Activies and actions related to performing first pass document review such as determining relevancy, issue coding, tagging, and initial privilege determination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHds6ASdDxLnHtdhd8e.label: Georgia Superior Court - Glascock County
http://lmss.sali.org/RHds6ASdDxLnHtdhd8e.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Glascock County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHfeijrOTjaF7qpuoGI.label: invoice segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RHfeijrOTjaF7qpuoGI.definition:
"Information on the Invoices submitted by the Firm for the Client.  There will be 1 or more INVOICE segments per CLIENT segment.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RHkmZvJbjGoqHTMCUIR.label: Insurance Carrier Bad Faith
http://lmss.sali.org/RHkmZvJbjGoqHTMCUIR.definition: The concept of Insurance Carrier Bad Faith refers to the intentional or reckless failure of an insurance company to fulfill its contractual obligations to its policyholders, such as denying a valid claim or failing to investigate a claim in a timely manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHlJGYtPscvqUc4icpk.label: Additional Matching Rights Period
http://lmss.sali.org/RHlJGYtPscvqUc4icpk.definition: A period of time granted to a party in a legal matter, allowing them the opportunity to match the terms of a proposed transaction before it is finalized, in addition to the previously established matching rights period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHpE6T1bTO65UNmJqVS.label: Employer's Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing
http://lmss.sali.org/RHpE6T1bTO65UNmJqVS.definition: The Employer's Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing refers to a legal claim made by an employee against their employer for violating the implied promise of good faith and fair dealing in the employment relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHqSGY9j6DiileorokN.label: Motion to File Supplemental Excerpts of Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RHqSGY9j6DiileorokN.definition: A Motion to File Supplemental Excerpts of Record is a formal request made to a court to allow additional evidence to be added to the record of a case, beyond what was originally submitted.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHqTgT2qpg1odifoEnq.label: Business Partner Breaching Fiduciary Duty to Co-Partner
http://lmss.sali.org/RHqTgT2qpg1odifoEnq.definition: When a business partner fails to uphold their legal obligation to act in the best interest of their co-partner, they are breaching their fiduciary duty and can be held liable for any resulting damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHqmAJXMNndwznZfBHE.label: Writ of Attachment
http://lmss.sali.org/RHqmAJXMNndwznZfBHE.definition: A Writ of Attachment is a court order to seize or take control of a specific property or assets before the final judgment in a lawsuit, ensuring that the property will not be disposed of or hidden by the defendant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHrIIrzJpjzV7eD3r5U.label: Hemiplegia
http://lmss.sali.org/RHrIIrzJpjzV7eD3r5U.definition: Hemiplegia is a condition characterized by paralysis or severe weakness on one side of the body, typically resulting from brain injuries such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, or neurological diseases. This condition affects motor function, coordination, and sensation on the affected side, significantly impacting daily activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHvP1bbr9Twm9do6grf.label: TR799 Other Trademark Prosecution
http://lmss.sali.org/RHvP1bbr9Twm9do6grf.definition: Use only for other trademark related tasks that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RHwCmZ2yKrJobzC86GC.label: Information Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RHwCmZ2yKrJobzC86GC.definition: The Information industry group comprises establishments engaged in the following processes: producing and distributing information and cultural products, providing the means to transmit or distribute these products as well as data or communications, and processing data.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI17i7CTo0jyl3UdFuT.label: Korean
http://lmss.sali.org/RI17i7CTo0jyl3UdFuT.definition: Korean (Language) refers to the structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Korean language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI1gLnqfSOzaWwvJxu4.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Hancock County (9th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RI2amMkwxQGg3O1kvbo.label: Board Chair
http://lmss.sali.org/RI2amMkwxQGg3O1kvbo.definition: A Corporate Chair, or Chairman of the Board, is the presiding officer of a company's board of directors, responsible for leading board meetings and ensuring effective board governance. The Chair facilitates discussions, oversees board functions, and often acts as a liaison between the board and executive management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI3QONzSYBIXBgMFfpU.label: Judicial Dissent
http://lmss.sali.org/RI3QONzSYBIXBgMFfpU.definition: Judicial Dissent refers to a written opinion by a judge or judges who disagree with the majority decision in a legal case, outlining their reasoning and arguments for a different outcome.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI3SkxW8PHQy8jO9uIX.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Clay County
http://lmss.sali.org/RI3SkxW8PHQy8jO9uIX.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Clay County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Clay County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI3riNSovdiUprXBu86.label: Early Neutral Evaluation Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RI3riNSovdiUprXBu86.definition: An Early Neutral Evaluation Event is a phase within a Mediation Event where a neutral third party evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of each party's case to facilitate settlement negotiations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI5hwGjH6o0HX7MTQbZ.label: Subsequent Probate Filing Reason
http://lmss.sali.org/RI5hwGjH6o0HX7MTQbZ.definition: Subsequent Probate Filing Reason refers to the specific reasons for filing a probate case after the initial filing, such as financial exploitation, restoration, death, incapacity, abuse, neglect, abandonment, fees and costs, modification, or substance abuse.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI63dP4qF6Nelmq7238.label: Washington Superior Court - Thurston County
http://lmss.sali.org/RI63dP4qF6Nelmq7238.definition: Washington Superior Court - Thurston County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Thurston County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RI6KFc3fCmcfzA2Zlup.label: Escrow Letter Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RI6KFc3fCmcfzA2Zlup.definition: An Escrow Letter Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a third party to hold funds or property until certain conditions are met, typically used in real estate transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIBBxK4TkYe8LDSOqtH.label: Pardon
http://lmss.sali.org/RIBBxK4TkYe8LDSOqtH.definition: A pardon is an official act by a government authority, typically the executive branch, that absolves an individual of any legal consequences for a crime they have been convicted of. It effectively erases the conviction from the individual's criminal record, signifying forgiveness and allowing the individual to regain rights lost due to the conviction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIBFgpbQ38dlD4wCMRI.label: Mediation Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/RIBFgpbQ38dlD4wCMRI.definition: A Mediation Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum that facilitates communication and negotiation between parties in a dispute, with the goal of reaching a mutually acceptable resolution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RICbnAjD2tT1fD7oBUL.label: Physician Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RICbnAjD2tT1fD7oBUL.definition: Physician Negligence refers to the failure of a medical practitioner to provide the standard of care expected of them, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RICvcZa71w8UKH411jz.label: Prosecutorial Misconduct
http://lmss.sali.org/RICvcZa71w8UKH411jz.definition: Prosecutorial misconduct refers to unethical or illegal actions committed by a prosecutor during a criminal case. This misconduct can include hiding evidence, making false statements, engaging in improper witness coaching, or other actions that violate a defendant's rights or the rules of legal ethics. When proven, prosecutorial misconduct can lead to the dismissal of charges, mistrial, or disciplinary action against the prosecutor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RICy8SUXTTEByxkvAQV.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Auto Financing
http://lmss.sali.org/RICy8SUXTTEByxkvAQV.definition: An Analysis of Pre-Petition Auto Financing involves reviewing and assessing automobile financing agreements and related financial activities conducted before the filing of a bankruptcy petition. This analysis helps determine the validity, priority, and enforceability of claims against the debtor’s vehicle within the bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIE2Dl7hRD0DSFfqAPH.label: JD10 Mediation (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RIE2Dl7hRD0DSFfqAPH.definition: Work related to proposals for mediation, preparation and attendance at the mediation and any follow-up work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIEdvjJfG7brutJLh2e.label: Blue Pencil Doctrine Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RIEdvjJfG7brutJLh2e.definition: A Blue Pencil Doctrine Clause is a provision in a contract that allows a court to modify or remove any unenforceable or illegal portions of the contract while leaving the rest of the agreement intact.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIGjHuSyrXSIgY9BHO5.label: Norwegian Nynorsk; Nynorsk, Norwegian
http://lmss.sali.org/RIGjHuSyrXSIgY9BHO5.definition: Norwegian Nynorsk is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a variation of the Norwegian language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIID6TwX1zfh0pWeJje.label: Real Estate Design Review
http://lmss.sali.org/RIID6TwX1zfh0pWeJje.definition: Real Estate Design Review is the process by which proposed architectural and site designs for a development project are evaluated for their adherence to local design standards, aesthetics, and land use compatibility. This review is usually conducted by a designated committee or governing body and may involve public hearings, expert consultations, and revisions to the initial plans.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIJ4bPoH3UCJNKCSOdi.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Cambria County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIJ4bPoH3UCJNKCSOdi.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Cambria County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIJdsy4FtlIY1Dfn4jL.label: Samoan
http://lmss.sali.org/RIJdsy4FtlIY1Dfn4jL.definition: A language spoken in Samoa and other Pacific islands, characterized by a unique phonology and grammar.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIKYiLwdzOMJsPyy5ui.label: Employee Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RIKYiLwdzOMJsPyy5ui.definition: Employee Fraud refers to the deliberate act of deception by an employee aimed at obtaining unauthorized benefits, such as stealing assets, manipulating financial statements, or misappropriating company funds, often resulting in financial loss and legal liability for the organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RILQypXcjvqd1GxNIcq.label: Law Enforcement
http://lmss.sali.org/RILQypXcjvqd1GxNIcq.definition: A department of persons who enforce laws, investigate crimes, and make arrests.

http://lmss.sali.org/RILtMHLpDM8luT3w9ni.label: Irrelevant Evidence Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RILtMHLpDM8luT3w9ni.definition: An Irrelevant Evidence Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the evidence being presented is not related to the issues at hand or does not have any probative value. This objection aims to prevent the introduction of extraneous information that could distract or mislead the decision-maker.

http://lmss.sali.org/RILuqAMxcqNJm8vHgoO.label: Visa for Families of Skilled Workers
http://lmss.sali.org/RILuqAMxcqNJm8vHgoO.definition: A Visa for Families of Skilled Workers, such as the U.S. H-4 Visa, is a category of visa that allows the immediate family members (spouse and dependent children) of skilled workers with certain types of visas to accompany them to the host country. These family members are often granted the right to reside in the country and, in some cases, may be eligible to apply for work authorization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIMzJ5opssCCB2tKCqE.label: Pro Bono Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RIMzJ5opssCCB2tKCqE.definition: Pro Bono Management refers to the management of legal services provided by lawyers and law firms on a voluntary basis, typically for individuals or organizations who cannot afford legal representation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIOjneXO96zMhlYgGHi.label: Major Weight-Bearing Joint Surgery
http://lmss.sali.org/RIOjneXO96zMhlYgGHi.definition: Reconstructive surgery or surgical arthrodesis of a major weight-bearing joint involves surgical procedures aimed at repairing or stabilizing large joints that support significant body weight, such as the hip, knee, or ankle. This type of surgery is performed to restore function, alleviate pain, and improve stability in joints severely affected by injury, disease, or degeneration.
http://lmss.sali.org/RIOjneXO96zMhlYgGHi.pref_label: Reconstructive Surgery or Surgical arthrodesis of a Major Weight-bearing Joint

http://lmss.sali.org/RIPGUOqov5ujn1dMUQF.label: Suburban Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RIPGUOqov5ujn1dMUQF.definition: The suburban market segment refers to a group of consumers or businesses located in the suburbs, areas that are typically situated on the outskirts of urban centers and characterized by a mix of residential and commercial zones. This segment is distinguished by its unique lifestyle and consumption patterns, often blending urban convenience with a more spacious and family-oriented environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIPyGUpyktHtX5nzig7.label: Chairman Emeritus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RIPyGUpyktHtX5nzig7.definition: A Chairman Emeritus Clause is a contractual provision that grants a former chairman of a company certain privileges or rights, such as a seat on the board of directors or an honorary title.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIQnXfIDi8YStyeDYke.label: Equal Protection Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RIQnXfIDi8YStyeDYke.definition: An equal protection claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their Fourteenth Amendment right to equal protection under the law has been violated by the government or a government actor. The Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment prohibits the government from treating individuals or groups differently based on their race, gender, national origin, or other protected categories. An equal protection claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government enacts a law or policy that treats certain individuals or groups unfairly or unequally, or when a government actor engages in discriminatory conduct. Examples of unequal treatment can include unequal enforcement of laws, unequal access to public services or benefits, or unequal treatment in the criminal justice system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RISXpicfJlkGlawzTdc.label: Kashmiri
http://lmss.sali.org/RISXpicfJlkGlawzTdc.definition: Kashmiri (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in the Kashmir region, including in legal documents, artifacts, evidence, testimony, proceedings, and other legal aspects.

http://lmss.sali.org/RITVzcNUrw2Bg0fvFue.label: Lease Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/RITVzcNUrw2Bg0fvFue.definition: A Lease Related Agreement refers to any supplementary contract or document associated with a primary lease agreement, addressing specific terms, conditions, or scenarios that might arise during the lease period. Examples include lease renewals, extensions, terminations, subleases, assignments, and guaranties, among others. These agreements provide clarity and legal framework for particular aspects or contingencies of the lease relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIVIkx09k4mvjoAwOWM.label: Lead Matter Designation
http://lmss.sali.org/RIVIkx09k4mvjoAwOWM.definition: Designation as parent-level matter, where one or more other matters may be subsidiary matters or subset matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIViC7vaOR6iUf5SXhR.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Union County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIViC7vaOR6iUf5SXhR.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Union County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Union County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIWfMispL6dMcdxJSr8.label: Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/RIWfMispL6dMcdxJSr8.definition: A hearing is a legal event within the context of litigation, where parties present arguments and evidence to a judge or other decision-maker.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIZ1TFgWm4QlpKpNfSe.label: Proceeding Reopened
http://lmss.sali.org/RIZ1TFgWm4QlpKpNfSe.definition: The concept of "Case Reopened" refers to a legal matter that was previously closed or resolved, but has now been reopened for further proceedings or consideration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIaHjndY8TxGhHZoz0c.label: L654 Second pass document review
http://lmss.sali.org/RIaHjndY8TxGhHZoz0c.definition: Activities and actions related to second pass QC of data and documents coded for relevancy, issue codes, tagging, and initial privilege determination during the first pass review.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIbkyG0mW87iAWUYXnI.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Barnstable County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIbkyG0mW87iAWUYXnI.definition: The Massachusetts Superior Court - Barnstable County is a court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that hears civil and criminal cases within Barnstable County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIcJiPyMr0udTEI4FQc.label: Action for Commission on Exclusive Right to Sell Listing
http://lmss.sali.org/RIcJiPyMr0udTEI4FQc.definition: A legal claim made by a real estate agent or broker against another agent or broker for the exclusive right to sell a property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIdM5DPqxstxxdcx26h.label: Motion to Dismiss Case for Failure to Make Plan Payments
http://lmss.sali.org/RIdM5DPqxstxxdcx26h.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Case for Failure to Make Plan Payments is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to dismiss the case due to the debtor's failure to make payments as required by the bankruptcy plan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIeCXTfrz4XsbRYcwow.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Lincoln Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RIeCXTfrz4XsbRYcwow.definition: A court located in Lincoln County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIeTFTPy9Um78489NqJ.label: Independent Contractor Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RIeTFTPy9Um78489NqJ.definition: Law that pertains to the classification and treatment of individuals who provide services to a company or organization as non-employees, typically in the context of labor and employment law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIfTG1iAif1rTjqEjkR.label: Contested Adoption
http://lmss.sali.org/RIfTG1iAif1rTjqEjkR.definition: A Contested Adoption occurs when one or more parties object to the adoption of a child, challenging the suitability or rights of the prospective adoptive parents. Such disputes often arise from biological parents who have not consented to the adoption, disagreements among family members, or concerns regarding the child's best interests.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIiAUUotf5l7jLvMEKX.label: Income Fund
http://lmss.sali.org/RIiAUUotf5l7jLvMEKX.definition: An Income Fund is an investment fund that regularly distributes its investment profits to shareholders in the form of dividends or interest payments. These funds aim to provide a steady income stream to investors by focusing on assets that generate regular income.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIl8s2tEaoYUUYasF92.label: Loitering
http://lmss.sali.org/RIl8s2tEaoYUUYasF92.definition: The act of remaining in a public place for an extended period of time without a clear purpose or legitimate reason, often in violation of local laws or ordinances related to curfew, loitering, or vagrancy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIoxgZ18NnsMKE9jq2I.label: Florida Circuit Court - Madison County - 3rd Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RIoxgZ18NnsMKE9jq2I.definition: A court located in Madison County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIq5KFUvDX7zWNSq4Hz.label: Castle Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/RIq5KFUvDX7zWNSq4Hz.definition: The Castle Doctrine is a legal principle derived from English Common Law that gives individuals the right to use force, including deadly force, to protect themselves against an intruder in their home. This doctrine essentially states that a person's home is their castle, and they have the right to defend it without the duty to retreat first, under certain conditions depending on jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIqmNDUxiSH9LkSnGG7.label: Board Vice Chair
http://lmss.sali.org/RIqmNDUxiSH9LkSnGG7.definition: A Board Vice Chair is a board officer who assists the Board Chair in leading the board of directors and may assume the Chair's duties in their absence. The Vice Chair supports board governance, facilitates meetings, and collaborates with other board members to advance the organization’s strategic objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIr4xRYy8mPYHnWo5Ew.label: C.P.A. (Certified Public Accountant)
http://lmss.sali.org/RIr4xRYy8mPYHnWo5Ew.definition: The suffix "C.P.A." stands for "Certified Public Accountant" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have met the educational and examination requirements to be certified as a public accountant. This designation signifies the individual's expertise in accounting practices and is commonly used in professional, academic, and formal settings

http://lmss.sali.org/RIrsxdvut2uYOncb3fC.label: AAA Labor Arbitration Rules
http://lmss.sali.org/RIrsxdvut2uYOncb3fC.definition: The AAA Labor Arbitration Rules are a set of rules created by the American Arbitration Association specifically for labor disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIrvLs2yTbuMPM8mt0y.label: Plaintiff Case-in-Chief
http://lmss.sali.org/RIrvLs2yTbuMPM8mt0y.definition: Plaintiff Case-in-Chief refers to the presentation of evidence and arguments by the plaintiff in a trial, before the defendant presents their own case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIs67yembSkWDzBnAic.label: WC230 Conferences with Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RIs67yembSkWDzBnAic.definition: Preparing for conference, attending conference, reporting on conference with Judge

http://lmss.sali.org/RIvzknlyUpeJfSqdYkH.label: New York Supreme Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIvzknlyUpeJfSqdYkH.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Washington County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Washington County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIx4wseXHDgt3SLWCIj.label: Security Offerings and Capital Markets Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RIx4wseXHDgt3SLWCIj.definition: Law governing the issuance, trading, and regulation of securities such as stocks, bonds, and other financial instruments in capital markets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIxCLIZ7Gd89hPQmSSi.label: M.S. (Master of Science)
http://lmss.sali.org/RIxCLIZ7Gd89hPQmSSi.definition: The suffix "M.S." stands for "Master of Science" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an advanced academic degree in a science-related field. This designation signifies the individual's specialized knowledge and research skills in their area of study, and is commonly used in academic, research, and professional settings

http://lmss.sali.org/RIxQhe3WJ1o8Kb3p9GP.label: New York Supreme Court - Albany County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIxQhe3WJ1o8Kb3p9GP.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Albany County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Albany County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIxZRp4UxyqiBeFnokF.label: Citrus Fruits
http://lmss.sali.org/RIxZRp4UxyqiBeFnokF.definition: Citrus fruits are a group of fruits from the Citrus genus, known for their juicy segments, aromatic rinds, and distinctive sour to sweet flavors. They are cultivated in tropical and subtropical regions and are rich in vitamin C, antioxidants, and essential nutrients, widely consumed fresh or used in juices, culinary applications, and flavorings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RIypBuUY0BMgKDo4F40.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Montgomery County
http://lmss.sali.org/RIypBuUY0BMgKDo4F40.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Montgomery County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Montgomery County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ1zSdR52W8L2gNWWyq.label: Contract Modification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ1zSdR52W8L2gNWWyq.definition: A contract modification clause is a provision in a contract that allows for changes to be made to the original agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ2spkLaFKaXIIurB8o.label: Refundable Deposit Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ2spkLaFKaXIIurB8o.definition: A refundable deposit clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to provide a deposit to the other party, which will be returned if certain conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ4c5efwPEoWH1XeoJx.label: Immigration Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ4c5efwPEoWH1XeoJx.definition: Immigration Court is an administrative forum that handles legal proceedings related to immigration matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ5qwfxRAfTOLboWpZp.label: Investment Bank
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ5qwfxRAfTOLboWpZp.definition: An investment bank is a financial institution that specializes in providing advisory services for mergers and acquisitions, underwriting new debt and equity securities, and facilitating the buying and selling of securities for both institutional and individual investors. Investment banks play a critical role in capital markets by helping companies raise capital and providing strategic advisory services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ61TGrGW9MPUfWuqYm.label: 840 Trademark (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ61TGrGW9MPUfWuqYm.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a trademark claim

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7AbKi8Al2xc1FYEO7.label: Wrongful Discharge in Violation of Public Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7AbKi8Al2xc1FYEO7.definition: The concept of "Wrongful Discharge in Violation of Public Policy" refers to the termination of an employee by an employer in a manner that violates public policy, such as firing an employee for refusing to engage in illegal activities or for reporting illegal conduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7M50VwxB1VdhcRhCZ.label: Motion to Sell Property Free and Clear
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7M50VwxB1VdhcRhCZ.definition: A Motion to Sell Property Free and Clear is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to sell a property without any liens or claims against it, allowing the proceeds to be used to pay off creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7P2VbioQVexfXhjLw.label: Tax Incentive
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7P2VbioQVexfXhjLw.definition: A Tax Incentive is a provision in tax law designed to encourage specific behaviors or activities by reducing a taxpayer's tax burden. It encompasses various mechanisms such as tax credits, deductions, exemptions, and preferential rates aimed at promoting certain economic or social objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7piLl6k76qESLjp7i.label: New York Supreme Court - Cayuga County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ7piLl6k76qESLjp7i.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Cayuga County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Cayuga County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJ9ORBE2bbdkqT1X753.label: Modality
http://lmss.sali.org/RJ9ORBE2bbdkqT1X753.definition: Modality refers to the way in which a statement or proposition is expressed, indicating the degree of possibility, necessity, or contingency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJAVqPEzzt7D0FUsahs.label: Defamation Per Se
http://lmss.sali.org/RJAVqPEzzt7D0FUsahs.definition: Defamation Per Se is a type of defamation that is inherently harmful and does not require proof of damages to be awarded compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJBCv6NjjLGmBlexeux.label: Captive Insurance Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RJBCv6NjjLGmBlexeux.definition: Captive Insurance Law governs the formation, regulation, and operation of captive insurance companies, which are wholly-owned subsidiaries created to insure the risks of their parent companies or related entities. This legal practice involves compliance with jurisdictional regulations, financial solvency requirements, and risk management strategies specific to captive insurers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJBX_s2v0SF22u9OPS_.label: B240 Tax Issues
http://lmss.sali.org/RJBX_s2v0SF22u9OPS_.definition: Analyses and advice regarding tax-related issues, including the preservation of net operating loss carry forwards

http://lmss.sali.org/RJC40G3TxG4CIj1rBvh.label: Pennsylvania Municipal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RJC40G3TxG4CIj1rBvh.definition: The Pennsylvania Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the Pennsylvania State Courts system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving small amounts of money.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJDv6vLdyS8CpmrxnJH.label: L602 Interviews
http://lmss.sali.org/RJDv6vLdyS8CpmrxnJH.definition: Activities and actions related to the conducting of interviews with custodians, data stewards, or other individuals or groups within the organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJEhNjPDXIeJRMwifVr.label: Mistake in Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RJEhNjPDXIeJRMwifVr.definition: A Mistake in Contract is a legal claim that arises when one or both parties to a contract make an error in the terms of the agreement, which can render the contract void or unenforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJGMnN7yTc0q47GdgOf.label: Washington Superior Court - San Juan County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJGMnN7yTc0q47GdgOf.definition: Washington Superior Court - San Juan County is a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within San Juan County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJGl3m5lEh511PiRXIM.label: Oregon Board of Governors
http://lmss.sali.org/RJGl3m5lEh511PiRXIM.definition: The Oregon Board of Governors is a governing body within the Oregon State Courts system responsible for overseeing and regulating various legal proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJHWzkMlxDKB0Yh7qTs.label: New York Supreme Court - Greene County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJHWzkMlxDKB0Yh7qTs.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Greene County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Greene County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJIWuwH3zSiGYulf7Kl.label: A119 Culling & Filtering
http://lmss.sali.org/RJIWuwH3zSiGYulf7Kl.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, activities associated with grouping and filtering documents for processing. Includes deduplication, deNIST*, etc. Excludes culling and filtering associated with the creation of a Privilege Log (A124).

http://lmss.sali.org/RJKpVvwNySrKM39s51L.label: Child Care Cost Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RJKpVvwNySrKM39s51L.definition: A Child Care Cost Claim is a request made by a parent or guardian to receive financial assistance or reimbursement for expenses related to the care of their child. This may include costs associated with daycare, after-school programs, or babysitters. Such claims are often made to government agencies or employers through childcare subsidy programs or flexible spending accounts.
sources: From LIST: Legal Issues Taxonomy — https://taxonomy.legal/

http://lmss.sali.org/RJL4HDUmZp1VEEZ7lCw.label: Intellectual Property Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RJL4HDUmZp1VEEZ7lCw.definition: Intellectual Property Claims refer to legal actions taken by a party to protect their exclusive rights to intangible assets such as patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJMHIP73KFeE7kZfxyG.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Umatilla County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJMHIP73KFeE7kZfxyG.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Umatilla County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Umatilla County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJNjtiH5YbwPgqnslhg.label: Expert System Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RJNjtiH5YbwPgqnslhg.definition: Expert System Management refers to the use of artificial intelligence and computer technology to improve and streamline legal processes, specifically in the management of expert systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJO4MF6G4Qq8ysP3Ncf.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Multnomah County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJO4MF6G4Qq8ysP3Ncf.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Multnomah County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Multnomah County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJONzuc8TWoSjc6E1Ks.label: Emergency Hearing Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RJONzuc8TWoSjc6E1Ks.definition: An Emergency Hearing Motion (Bankruptcy) is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case for an urgent court hearing to address a specific issue or matter related to the bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJOT8wKPef5jg7CJ6RQ.label: Fraud Prevention Regulation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RJOT8wKPef5jg7CJ6RQ.definition: A Fraud Prevention Regulation Claim (aka Red Flags Rule) stems from regulations by a regulator (e.g., U.S. FTC) that requires certain businesses and organizations to implement a written identity theft prevention program. Such rules are designed to detect, prevent, and mitigate identity theft by identifying and responding to "red flags," which are patterns, practices, or specific activities that indicate the possible existence of identity theft.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJPmwN3dU0x1Hk5Wgu3.label: Motion to Expedite
http://lmss.sali.org/RJPmwN3dU0x1Hk5Wgu3.definition: A Motion to Expedite is a request made to the court to accelerate the proceedings of a legal case, typically due to time-sensitive circumstances or the need for a prompt resolution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJR5fUevfKoAitP71be.label: LAW_FIRM_POSTCODE
http://lmss.sali.org/RJR5fUevfKoAitP71be.definition: A law firm's postal code as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJR8oLdp2skjpPNMkMy.label: Financial Contagion Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RJR8oLdp2skjpPNMkMy.definition: The risk that financial instability in one sector or region spreads to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJSlyaZIuNwnFZmW16u.label: Ripeness
http://lmss.sali.org/RJSlyaZIuNwnFZmW16u.definition: Ripeness refers to the readiness of a case for judicial review, usually meaning that the issues are sufficiently clear and well-defined to be considered by a court. A case that is not ripe is generally dismissed because taking it up prematurely would involve the court in abstract or hypothetical questions, rather than an existing dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJUEBi1isIMI3tc2P5D.label: RPA Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RJUEBi1isIMI3tc2P5D.definition: RPA Management refers to the process of managing and optimizing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology in order to improve legal processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJUIzk2X2iGhCfzQDC1.label: Description of Asset Exposure
http://lmss.sali.org/RJUIzk2X2iGhCfzQDC1.definition: For a given dispute, a description of the assets that are potentially exposed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJV2685HIFNwCtEkfUW.label: Private Nuisance
http://lmss.sali.org/RJV2685HIFNwCtEkfUW.definition: A private nuisance is a type of legal wrong that occurs when one person's use of their property interferes with another person's use and enjoyment of their own property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJWxS8OHzFXYiezRzXg.label: Litigation Hold Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RJWxS8OHzFXYiezRzXg.definition: A Litigation Hold Event is a specific event within the context of a legal dispute where a party is required to preserve relevant evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJX2Kya1DhsuMFeE2u9.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  McKean County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJX2Kya1DhsuMFeE2u9.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - McKean County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJXaGPoBofqzwIbf2Og.label: Financial Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RJXaGPoBofqzwIbf2Og.definition: An expert who opines on areas of finance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJYPMabsxdXaPxqRr2R.label: Employee Recruitment Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RJYPMabsxdXaPxqRr2R.definition: An employee recruitment event where an employer seeks to attract and identify potential candidates for employment. This relates to immigration law, where for some matters, employers must demonstrate that there are no qualified U.S. workers available for the position and that hiring a foreign worker will not adversely affect the wages and working conditions of similarly employed U.S. workers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJYtazd7gP1AYMehqPs.label: Implied Waiver
http://lmss.sali.org/RJYtazd7gP1AYMehqPs.definition: An implied waiver occurs when a party's actions or inaction demonstrate an intentional relinquishment of a legal right or claim, even without explicit statements. It is inferred from conduct that is inconsistent with the continued assertion of the right.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJZX5NxMkmARJD5H0wh.label: Poison Pill Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJZX5NxMkmARJD5H0wh.definition: A poison pill clause is a provision in a contract that is designed to deter or prevent a hostile takeover by making the target company less attractive to the acquiring company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJbDr7vyKhyM0okCvFy.label: Official Aramaic ; Imperial Aramaic
http://lmss.sali.org/RJbDr7vyKhyM0okCvFy.definition: Official Aramaic and Imperial Aramaic are ancient languages used between 700-300 BCE in official and imperial contexts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJcsaWm3o1Z8BCAnKQK.label: No Agency Relationship Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJcsaWm3o1Z8BCAnKQK.definition: A "No Agency Relationship Clause" is a provision in a contract that explicitly states that no agency relationship is created between the parties, meaning that neither party has the authority to act on behalf of the other.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJcvZf0WPCrk1oomwhN.label: Freedom from Arbitrary Detention
http://lmss.sali.org/RJcvZf0WPCrk1oomwhN.definition: Freedom from arbitrary detention is a human right that prohibits the unlawful or unjustifiable arrest or imprisonment of individuals. This right is upheld by various international legal instruments, such as the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, and aims to ensure due process and legal protections for those accused of crimes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJgCz3oLM22bNgWILGy.label: Standalone Material Adverse Effect Termination Right
http://lmss.sali.org/RJgCz3oLM22bNgWILGy.definition: A Standalone Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Termination Right, is a legal provision that allows a party to terminate a contract if an event or circumstance occurs that has a significant negative impact on the value or profitability of the subject matter of the contract, and this provision is not tied to any other termination rights in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJgDMa4vsZ9MenkawJN.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Chicot Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RJgDMa4vsZ9MenkawJN.definition: A court located in Chicot County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its designated geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJglWgiEuS4QGY2hMgm.label: Engagement Fee Description
http://lmss.sali.org/RJglWgiEuS4QGY2hMgm.definition: Freeform text describing the engagement fee model.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJk2EQyQmnUVnPU4b3w.label: Disease-Related Fractures
http://lmss.sali.org/RJk2EQyQmnUVnPU4b3w.definition: Pathologic fractures occur when a bone breaks in response to minimal or no trauma due to an underlying disease or condition that weakens the bone structure. These fractures are typically associated with conditions such as osteoporosis, tumors, or infections that compromise bone integrity.
http://lmss.sali.org/RJk2EQyQmnUVnPU4b3w.pref_label: Pathologic Fractures Due to Any Cause

http://lmss.sali.org/RJlp1OGx7ZwGezwMkUl.label: Disorderly House
http://lmss.sali.org/RJlp1OGx7ZwGezwMkUl.definition: A Disorderly House is a type of crime against the public that involves maintaining a dwelling or establishment where illegal activities, such as prostitution or gambling, take place.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJmaVPo5ZqlRDL0YDQi.label: N'Ko
http://lmss.sali.org/RJmaVPo5ZqlRDL0YDQi.definition: A writing system used to write the Mande languages of West Africa, characterized by a distinctive script with geometric shapes and lines.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJnI6bbKxJYLpPd3sHY.label: Oil Spill Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RJnI6bbKxJYLpPd3sHY.definition: A claim made under environmental law for damages resulting from an oil spill.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJnZnA9TBQVHmreODfN.label: PPT
http://lmss.sali.org/RJnZnA9TBQVHmreODfN.definition: A Microsoft PowerPoint file from from Microsoft Office 2003 or earlier.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJnxhN2bkiWDlP8X0ZW.label: State Destruction of Private Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RJnxhN2bkiWDlP8X0ZW.definition: The State Destruction of Private Property is the legal concept where the government takes possession of private property for public use without the owner's consent, and compensates the owner for the fair market value of the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJoZMthwG4TT4ztkfGb.label: Unreasonable Search and Seizure Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RJoZMthwG4TT4ztkfGb.definition: Unreasonable search and seizure refers to a violation of an individual's rights under the constitution, protecting individuals from unwarranted government intrusions into their privacy by requiring that searches and seizures conducted by law enforcement or government agents must be reasonable and, in most cases, based on probable cause supported by a warrant. An unreasonable search and seizure may occur when law enforcement officers or government agents conduct a search or seizure without a warrant, without probable cause, or when the scope of the search or seizure exceeds the limits of the warrant. Examples of unreasonable searches and seizures include warrantless searches of a person's home, an arrest without probable cause, or an overly invasive search of a person or their belongings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJqPShTtGIItbvQVRHy.label: Patent Infringement - Plant Patents
http://lmss.sali.org/RJqPShTtGIItbvQVRHy.definition: The unauthorized use, sale, or importation of a patented plant variety without the owner's permission.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJrrXlPFFEEesmT50PW.label: Accrued Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJrrXlPFFEEesmT50PW.definition: An Accrued Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that ensures the preservation of rights that have already been acquired by the parties involved, even if the contract is terminated or modified.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJvItAmZFV8Dj3T9Vxx.label: Consent Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RJvItAmZFV8Dj3T9Vxx.definition: A Consent Judgment is a legal decision made by a court that is agreed upon by both parties involved in a dispute, rather than being imposed by the court itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJwVxPuEkHL7MzOgV0U.label: OFAC Certification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RJwVxPuEkHL7MzOgV0U.definition: A provision in a contract that requires a party to certify that they are not on the list of individuals or entities sanctioned by the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC).

http://lmss.sali.org/RJwi6pYDZFvq1WqGQrP.label: Theft from Building
http://lmss.sali.org/RJwi6pYDZFvq1WqGQrP.definition: A theft from within a building which is either open to the general public or where the offender has legal access.

http://lmss.sali.org/RJwxL2Io8HByycz4ShS.label: Minnesota District Court - Roseau County
http://lmss.sali.org/RJwxL2Io8HByycz4ShS.definition: Minnesota District Court - Roseau County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Roseau County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RK0Q6ufxPf7imBt2XN9.label: Elective Share
http://lmss.sali.org/RK0Q6ufxPf7imBt2XN9.definition: A legal right of a surviving spouse to claim a portion of their deceased spouse's estate, regardless of what is stated in the deceased spouse's will, in order to prevent disinheritance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RK0i5py6LdHGXhMS9gJ.label: Stillbirth
http://lmss.sali.org/RK0i5py6LdHGXhMS9gJ.definition: The concept of Stillbirth refers to the loss of a fetus after the 20th week of pregnancy, which may be attributed to medical malpractice and can result in legal claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RK3aguLouTWyzbkeYmq.label: A113 Communicate (witnesses)
http://lmss.sali.org/RK3aguLouTWyzbkeYmq.definition: Any communication by letter, fax, email, telephone, meetings and conferences with witnesses in the legal matter

http://lmss.sali.org/RK3djL6tQYM6HO97Deh.label: Motion to Stay Execution of Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RK3djL6tQYM6HO97Deh.definition: A Motion to Stay Execution of Judgment is a request made to temporarily halt the enforcement of a court order or judgment, typically to allow for further legal proceedings or to provide time for the party to comply with the order or judgment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RK5PDvSB6WBAF62b78C.label: Nonverbal Learning Disability
http://lmss.sali.org/RK5PDvSB6WBAF62b78C.definition: Nonverbal Learning Disability (NVLD) is a neurological condition characterized by significant difficulties with visual-spatial, motor, and social skills, despite strong verbal abilities. Individuals with NVLD may struggle with tasks requiring coordination, interpreting nonverbal cues, and spatial awareness, impacting their academic and social functioning.

http://lmss.sali.org/RK6eLsHaKDF9uflImSi.label: New York Supreme Court - Suffolk County
http://lmss.sali.org/RK6eLsHaKDF9uflImSi.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Suffolk County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Suffolk County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKAu5zvBMqnQ8fixz5S.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Henry County 3
http://lmss.sali.org/RKAu5zvBMqnQ8fixz5S.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Henry County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKBlQ2mgZn3CTwBfUYI.label: Motor Neuron Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RKBlQ2mgZn3CTwBfUYI.definition: Motor neuron disorders are a group of progressive neurological diseases that affect the motor neurons, which are the nerve cells responsible for controlling voluntary muscles. These disorders lead to muscle weakness, atrophy, and eventual paralysis as the motor neurons degenerate and die.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKDBqW2rSLcrXUmqa4w.label: Support Personnel of Athletes or Entertainers
http://lmss.sali.org/RKDBqW2rSLcrXUmqa4w.definition: This visa (in the U.S., P-1S Visa) is designated for support personnel who are an integral part of the performance of an athlete or entertainer or entertainment group (in the U.S., P1A or P-1B). In the United States, this visa allows these essential support personnel to accompany the principal visa holder for the duration of the event, competition, or performance. The initial period of stay is tied to the P-1 or P-1B visa holder's duration, with the possibility of extensions

http://lmss.sali.org/RKDE8MNcuf9xAklLasK.label: Matter Tax on Expenses
http://lmss.sali.org/RKDE8MNcuf9xAklLasK.definition: Matter Tax on Expenses: A specific type of tax detail that pertains to the engagement fee detail and is related to the expenses incurred during the provision of legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKHoFLg3ZAgHUi07aaY.label: German
http://lmss.sali.org/RKHoFLg3ZAgHUi07aaY.definition: German (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a means of document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect, and is a subcategory of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKIJK5k2JFkQw4UvNU2.label: Aviation Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RKIJK5k2JFkQw4UvNU2.definition: A type of civil claim that arises from incidents related to aviation, such as accidents or injuries, and involves seeking compensation for damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKIYD2zDw4nfizmybGc.label: Proceeding Open / Pending
http://lmss.sali.org/RKIYD2zDw4nfizmybGc.definition: The legal state of a court case that has been filed and is awaiting further action or resolution, including cases that have been transferred to a new forum or reopened.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKJ5erTCqs0aPHQ1Moc.label: Prejudgment Attachment
http://lmss.sali.org/RKJ5erTCqs0aPHQ1Moc.definition: Prejudgment Attachment refers to the legal process of seizing a defendant's property before a judgment is made in a lawsuit, in order to secure payment of a potential judgment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKKRGOkIme6pnG2BSeP.label: License (Agreement)
http://lmss.sali.org/RKKRGOkIme6pnG2BSeP.definition: A License (Agreement) is a legal document that grants permission to use a particular product or service under certain terms and conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKNmAyQdQmYmw5fsChh.label: Luba-Katanga
http://lmss.sali.org/RKNmAyQdQmYmw5fsChh.definition: Luba-Katanga (Language) is a structured system of communication spoken in the Katanga region of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKPvHfkKJDBu4dMzMbL.label: Chipewyan; Dene Suline
http://lmss.sali.org/RKPvHfkKJDBu4dMzMbL.definition: Chipewyan and Dene Suline are indigenous languages spoken in Canada by the Chipewyan and Dene Suline peoples.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKSxl5JUd6LkgLzSCWF.label: Automatic Termination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RKSxl5JUd6LkgLzSCWF.definition: An automatic termination clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the circumstances under which the agreement will end without the need for further action by either party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKTUVhpkOGaH53JFNJ4.label: Judicial Legal Conclusion
http://lmss.sali.org/RKTUVhpkOGaH53JFNJ4.definition: An asserted legal argument, proposition, or point of law, as adopted by a decisionmaker (e.g., judge, magistrate, arbitrator).

http://lmss.sali.org/RKU1YwvdEmNI3WiBCdB.label: Assignment of Magistrate Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RKU1YwvdEmNI3WiBCdB.definition: The "Assignment of Magistrate Judge" concept refers to the process of assigning a magistrate judge to a case, which falls under the broader category of assigning judges to cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKUCwOJGfYiSc7zU1qk.label: Cybersecurity Incident
http://lmss.sali.org/RKUCwOJGfYiSc7zU1qk.definition: A Cybersecurity Incident is an event that compromises the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of information systems, data, or networks. These incidents can result from malicious activities such as data breaches, data tampering, denial of service attacks, malware infections, phishing attacks, or ransomware attacks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKUS7DGbQzcxcZL62kr.label: Minnesota District Court - Isanti County
http://lmss.sali.org/RKUS7DGbQzcxcZL62kr.definition: Minnesota District Court - Isanti County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Isanti County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKWm5NGo58V8gx7E48q.label: Response to Counterclaim
http://lmss.sali.org/RKWm5NGo58V8gx7E48q.definition: A response filed by a defendant in a lawsuit against a counterclaim made by the plaintiff, falling under the category of legal pleadings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKXOIeewQztJfJjnEdN.label: Negligent Interference with Contractual Relationship
http://lmss.sali.org/RKXOIeewQztJfJjnEdN.definition: Negligent Interference with Contractual Relationship is a legal claim that arises when a third party's careless actions cause a breach of contract between two parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKY2B2HNSx5K82dgVN6.label: Immigration Petitions and Applications
http://lmss.sali.org/RKY2B2HNSx5K82dgVN6.definition: Immigration petitions and applications are formal requests submitted to immigration authorities for specific immigration benefits, such as visas, green cards, or naturalization. In the United States, for example, forms like the I-130 (Petition for Alien Relative) or the I-485 (Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status) are commonly used for family-based immigration, while the I-129 (Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker) is used for employment-based visas.

  "

http://lmss.sali.org/RKarf0DKzL0qZLGQlut.label: Employee Layoff Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RKarf0DKzL0qZLGQlut.definition: Employee layoff event refers to the temporary or permanent separation of employees from their jobs due to economic conditions, organizational restructuring, or other non-performance-related factors. Unlike terminations for misconduct or performance issues, layoffs are generally not the fault of the employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKbNrS4w1Sje9SRlafd.label: Board Treasurer
http://lmss.sali.org/RKbNrS4w1Sje9SRlafd.definition: A Board Treasurer is a board officer responsible for overseeing the financial affairs of an organization, including budget planning, financial reporting, and ensuring sound financial governance. The Treasurer works closely with management to monitor financial performance and ensure compliance with financial policies and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKbpQIEXS8ulF5ANmmf.label: Elamite
http://lmss.sali.org/RKbpQIEXS8ulF5ANmmf.definition: A language that was spoken in ancient Elam, which is now modern-day Iran.
