http://lmss.sali.org/RKcU29Hc3QmmKCxPZ6o.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily hourly charges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKcwyowTRKE0MJBBcW0.label: Disclosure Schedules
http://lmss.sali.org/RKcwyowTRKE0MJBBcW0.definition: Disclosure Schedules are documents that provide detailed information about a company's assets, liabilities, contracts, and other important information that is relevant to a merger or acquisition transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKexhdVzZjFztyyADrm.label: Apricots
http://lmss.sali.org/RKexhdVzZjFztyyADrm.definition: Apricots are small, golden-orange stone fruits from the Prunus armeniaca species, characterized by their smooth, velvety skin and sweet-tart flavor. They are consumed fresh, dried, or processed into jams, juices, and desserts, valued for their high vitamin A and fiber content, as well as their antioxidant properties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKgOBuUzUaz2T5XTUY3.label: UTBMS MF50 Intellectual Property and Technology
http://lmss.sali.org/RKgOBuUzUaz2T5XTUY3.definition: A legal billing code used to categorize services related to the acquisition or transfer of intellectual property and technology assets, falling under the broader category of UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A).

http://lmss.sali.org/RKj3panTdxsJ7nFn11C.label: 8th Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RKj3panTdxsJ7nFn11C.definition: An Eighth Amendment claim is a legal argument asserting that an individual's constitutional protection against cruel and unusual punishment, as guaranteed by the Eighth Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated. Such claims typically involve disputes over the conditions of confinement, the use of excessive force, or the imposition of excessive fines or bail, and aim to protect the basic human rights and dignity of individuals subject to punishment or detention.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKlwTYjHZjCA0RDu28H.label: 04_2 Immigration (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RKlwTYjHZjCA0RDu28H.definition: Immigration (PACER NoS) refers to the category of legal cases related to immigration matters, as classified by the PACER Nature of Suit (NoS) Codes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKnJD7hIKD8zdjyLv9u.label: Antitrust - Tying Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RKnJD7hIKD8zdjyLv9u.definition: A tying claim in antitrust law refers to a situation where a seller requires a buyer to purchase a second product or service as a condition of purchasing the first product or service, which may be considered anti-competitive behavior.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKoMhHeiuDB6Js7z1UV.label: Deemed Contribution and Distribution Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RKoMhHeiuDB6Js7z1UV.definition: A Deemed Contribution and Distribution Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies how contributions and distributions will be treated as if they were made on a certain date, regardless of when they were actually made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKpFHh3Rd9jQVUWKzNe.label: Invoice Other ISO
http://lmss.sali.org/RKpFHh3Rd9jQVUWKzNe.definition: A type of fee invoice detail that pertains to non-ISO charges on an invoice for legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKppctNnwfRJlk3uGTi.label: Professional Conduct Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RKppctNnwfRJlk3uGTi.definition: Professional Conduct Claims refer to legal claims or allegations made against laypersons or professionals, asserting that they have breached established standards of practice, ethics, or legal requirements for a field. These claims can encompass a range of violations, including malpractice, unauthorized practice, and other breaches of professional duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKqMtq4VODwvUGdxe07.label: Legal Opinion Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RKqMtq4VODwvUGdxe07.definition: A legal opinion document is a written statement by a legal expert, usually an attorney or a law firm, expressing their professional judgment on the legal aspects of a transaction, agreement, or legal issue. It provides an analysis of the legality, enforceability, or compliance of the matter in question with applicable laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKqxeuifrYkNfCxyHq5.label: Administration of Environmental Quality Programs Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RKqxeuifrYkNfCxyHq5.definition: The Administration of Environmental Quality Programs subsector groups government establishments primarily engaged in the administration of environmental quality.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKsQ8wAiKiOfAtbV7KR.label: False Advertising Act Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/RKsQ8wAiKiOfAtbV7KR.definition: A False Advertising Act Violation is a claim that a party has made false or misleading statements in connection with the promotion or sale of a product or service, in violation of the False Advertising Act and related laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RKwy59EX4GiOqTgFpfF.label: Payment of Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RKwy59EX4GiOqTgFpfF.definition: Payment of public benefit refers to the disbursement of financial assistance or provision of services to eligible recipients under a specific public benefit program. Payments can be made through various methods such as direct deposit, checks, or electronic benefit transfer (EBT) cards, and are generally subject to periodic reviews or re-certifications to confirm ongoing eligibility

http://lmss.sali.org/RKzL5nW7IGg4mvAPFX2.label: Transactional Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RKzL5nW7IGg4mvAPFX2.definition: Any process that involves two or more parties in creation of a contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL3gReDyHSimEbolEXX.label: Information Technology Outsourcing Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RL3gReDyHSimEbolEXX.definition: An Information Technology Outsourcing Agreement is a contractual arrangement where a company engages an external service provider to manage and deliver its information technology services. This agreement may specify the scope of IT services, performance standards, and data security measures.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL5kF16ii6m2oiRzkwP.label: Due Diligence Request List
http://lmss.sali.org/RL5kF16ii6m2oiRzkwP.definition: A Due Diligence Request List is a compilation of questions and document requests directed towards the party undergoing due diligence, typically furnished by the buyer or auditor. This list guides the gathering of information and serves as a framework for what will be scrutinized in the due diligence process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL5mO8y4RD5bCOJyHGx.label: Georgia Superior Court - Dodge County
http://lmss.sali.org/RL5mO8y4RD5bCOJyHGx.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Dodge County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Dodge County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL6IwJNQxCn3yiGkoQE.label: 368 Asbestos Personal Injury Product Liability (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RL6IwJNQxCn3yiGkoQE.definition: Action alleging personal injury or death caused by exposure to asbestos products.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL7IXFcChVOHHB88Ted.label: Amortized Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RL7IXFcChVOHHB88Ted.definition: An Amortized Asset is a financial instrument where the principal amount is gradually reduced through regular payments over the life of the asset. These payments typically include both interest and principal, leading to a decrease in the outstanding balance until the loan is fully repaid by the maturity date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL7sqh8NY6UuTxs6rer.label: Notary Public
http://lmss.sali.org/RL7sqh8NY6UuTxs6rer.definition: A person authorized by a state to administer oaths, certify documents, attest to the authenticity of signatures, and perform official acts in commercial matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL81V0ATCWzMgdSPue1.label: Credit Card Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RL81V0ATCWzMgdSPue1.definition: A Credit Card Agreement is a legally binding contract between a credit card issuer and a cardholder outlining the terms and conditions under which the cardholder may use the credit card. This agreement specifies the interest rates, fees, billing processes, and cardholder obligations associated with the card.

http://lmss.sali.org/RL8upqvT6ptpt48fdkR.label: High School Diploma
http://lmss.sali.org/RL8upqvT6ptpt48fdkR.definition: A High School Diploma is an academic credential awarded upon successful completion of a secondary education program. It signifies the completion of basic education requirements and prepares individuals for higher education or employment

http://lmss.sali.org/RLBM0VyyiS-eBir8kHg.label: TR750 Domain Names gTLDs Domain Name Filing  Generic
http://lmss.sali.org/RLBM0VyyiS-eBir8kHg.definition: All actions associated with completing a domain name application (including renewal) that is to be filed as a generic top-level domain (gTLD), e.g., .com. The domain name applications should be filed through the current domain name provider unless otherwise instructed.
http://lmss.sali.org/RLBM0VyyiS-eBir8kHg.pref_label: TR750 Domain Names - gTLDs Domain Name Filing - Generic

http://lmss.sali.org/RLC0L5JdLdjdUXjSDZ5.label: Materiality Scrape Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RLC0L5JdLdjdUXjSDZ5.definition: A Materiality Scrape Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies that in the event of a conflict between the materiality definition in the contract and that in another agreement, the definition in the other agreement will be used.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLCgcyVpMJC9pO2jdog.label: Turnover and Other General Goods and Services Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RLCgcyVpMJC9pO2jdog.definition: Turnover and Other General Goods and Services Tax Payment refers to multi-stage cumulative taxes and taxes where elements of consumption taxes are combined with multistage taxes. These taxes are levied each time a transaction takes place, without deduction for taxes paid on inputs. Multi-stage taxes can incorporate elements of value-added or sales taxes, leading to taxation at multiple points in the supply chain.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLFu5dgP9RPeqjoBV8L.label: A117 Special Handling Copying/Scanning/Imaging (Internal)
http://lmss.sali.org/RLFu5dgP9RPeqjoBV8L.definition: Any special oversized copying, binding, scanning, imaging and photograph reproduction which requires manual handling

http://lmss.sali.org/RLFy69g18M213jDVncE.label: Employer Improperly Handling Employee Wages
http://lmss.sali.org/RLFy69g18M213jDVncE.definition: Employer Improperly Handling Employee Wages: The act of an employer mishandling or failing to properly pay an employee for their work, which may include withholding wages, failing to pay overtime, or other violations of wage and hour laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLHydbKoAHpmxbjRTt3.label: African Union
http://lmss.sali.org/RLHydbKoAHpmxbjRTt3.definition: AU (African Union): A continental union consisting of 55 member states located in Africa, aimed at promoting economic, social, and political integration, and resolving conflicts among member states.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLIUiQhEdVo5i68qgFN.label: STEM Training Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/RLIUiQhEdVo5i68qgFN.definition: In United States immigration law, the F-1 STEM Training Plan refers to the plan developed by an international student pursuing studies in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) field in the U.S. This plan is a component of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) extension for F-1 students, which allows them to work in the U.S. for an additional 24 months after completing their degree. The STEM Training Plan outlines how the student's employment will be related to their field of study and how it will contribute to their practical training and skill development.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLIW6W1ctClGqwD8mjb.label: Real Estate Zoning Modifications
http://lmss.sali.org/RLIW6W1ctClGqwD8mjb.definition: Real Estate Zoning Modifications refer to changes in the zoning classifications or rules governing the use, development, or characteristics of a specific parcel of land. These modifications are generally initiated by property owners and require approval from local zoning authorities, often after public hearings, assessments, and legal evaluations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLIvW0w85MZ3NIl5JwP.label: Paternity / Parentage Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RLIvW0w85MZ3NIl5JwP.definition: A Paternity/Parentage Claim is a legal action brought to establish the identity of a child's biological father or mother, typically in the context of family law or matrimonial claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLJT8v5yTfRQ6xRfJAq.label: Bank’s Wrongful Payment of Negotiable Instrument
http://lmss.sali.org/RLJT8v5yTfRQ6xRfJAq.definition: The Bank's Wrongful Payment of Negotiable Instrument refers to a situation where a bank makes a payment on a negotiable instrument without proper authorization or without verifying the authenticity of the instrument, resulting in a loss to the rightful owner of the instrument.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLLg8Yazwudc8ePg2wA.label: Resume
http://lmss.sali.org/RLLg8Yazwudc8ePg2wA.definition: A "Resume," also known as a "Curriculum Vitae (CV)," is a concise and structured document that provides an overview of an individual's education, work experience, skills, achievements, and qualifications. It is typically used for job applications and serves as a summary of an individual's professional background.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLNc7gzywoZLESpwFH8.label: Chiropractor Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RLNc7gzywoZLESpwFH8.definition: Chiropractor Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from the negligent or intentional actions of a chiropractor, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLNlm7nXyJQLJmk8qYn.label: Indemnification
http://lmss.sali.org/RLNlm7nXyJQLJmk8qYn.definition: Indemnification is a legal remedy sought by a party to be protected from financial loss or liability resulting from a specific event or action, and may be implied or granted by contract or court order.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLQedrDmb0dGL0RqZmF.label: Amputation
http://lmss.sali.org/RLQedrDmb0dGL0RqZmF.definition: Amputation is the surgical removal of a limb or extremity, such as an arm, leg, foot, hand, toe, or finger. This procedure is often performed to treat severe injuries, infections, diseases like diabetes or cancer, or as a result of traumatic accidents, leading to significant changes in mobility and functionality.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLQhKk8z0rpekZczxDu.label: Makasar
http://lmss.sali.org/RLQhKk8z0rpekZczxDu.definition: Makasar is a language that belongs to the Austronesian language family and is primarily spoken in the South Sulawesi province of Indonesia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLS5ckaqGABRJiaZXih.label: Promotion Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RLS5ckaqGABRJiaZXih.definition: A promotion clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions for an individual or entity to receive a promotion or advancement in their position or status.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLU11iHuZBaaEfnzH84.label: Application to Have Filing Fee Waived
http://lmss.sali.org/RLU11iHuZBaaEfnzH84.definition: An Application to Have Filing Fee Waived is a request made by an individual or entity to waive the fee required to file for bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLUhMvi3MhVl3g0U3Ng.label: Georgia District Court - Stephens County
http://lmss.sali.org/RLUhMvi3MhVl3g0U3Ng.definition: Georgia District Court - Stephens County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Stephens County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLUlLDCY6QSlmf3wit5.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RLUlLDCY6QSlmf3wit5.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Washington County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Oregon, located in Washington County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdictional boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLZaLo9ThQG-7pr07Xw.label: PA440 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RLZaLo9ThQG-7pr07Xw.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with the Patent Office of the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under PA300, including Appeals, Oppositions, Interferences, and other ex-parte and inter-partes proceedings. Includes collecting evidence, preparing and filing motions, briefs, responses, replies, surreplies, and other documents, attending conferences, depositions, hearings, and other proceedings. Does not include requests for supervisory action ("Petitions" in the U.S.) under PA430. Note that external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLZkUlOQ7OxJrFjOoi7.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Monroe County
http://lmss.sali.org/RLZkUlOQ7OxJrFjOoi7.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court located in Monroe County, which is responsible for handling minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLZy6MF5nrxWaeidziM.label: Minnesota District Court - Kanabec County
http://lmss.sali.org/RLZy6MF5nrxWaeidziM.definition: A court located in Kanabec County, Minnesota that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLcSDERYA3ASx8GMSI9.label: Standing
http://lmss.sali.org/RLcSDERYA3ASx8GMSI9.definition: Lack of Standing: A defense raised in a civil lawsuit where the plaintiff does not have the legal right to bring the claim because they are not directly affected or harmed by the defendant's actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLeoyLBvoSHSI4IT2hj.label: WC420 Expert Witnesses
http://lmss.sali.org/RLeoyLBvoSHSI4IT2hj.definition: Preparing for examination of expert witness, Interview/meeting with expert witness, Preparing for cross-examination of expert witness, Review & analysis of deposition /trial transcripts

http://lmss.sali.org/RLfon8bNUHStAbjyLVB.label: Dangerous Condition of Public Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RLfon8bNUHStAbjyLVB.definition: A Dangerous Condition of Public Property refers to a situation where a government entity fails to maintain its property in a safe condition, resulting in harm or injury to the public.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLgHTtQCYRd9TkvlIEa.label: Assignment of Security Interest Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RLgHTtQCYRd9TkvlIEa.definition: An Assignment of Security Interest Clause is a provision in a legal agreement that allows a creditor to transfer their security interest in a property to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLjUh6xcnt4knFQvcaK.label: Variable Rate Interest Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RLjUh6xcnt4knFQvcaK.definition: A Variable Rate Interest Payment is a type of interest payment structure where the interest rate can change over the life of the debt instrument. This structure allows for interest rate adjustments based on predetermined factors such as market indices, step-up/step-down schedules, or other benchmarks, providing flexibility in response to changing economic conditions or issuer circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLoXC2eBfPEh1ZhasNd.label: Connecticut Court of Common Pleas - Appellate Division

http://lmss.sali.org/RLrqGkP9fi5OO2Rhptt.label: Personal Income
http://lmss.sali.org/RLrqGkP9fi5OO2Rhptt.definition: Personal income refers to the total earnings an individual receives from various sources, including wages, salaries, investments, and business activities. It encompasses all monetary inflows before taxes and deductions and serves as the basis for calculating tax liabilities and evaluating financial well-being.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLrtLJRtkFiOrxYX91x.label: Grebo
http://lmss.sali.org/RLrtLJRtkFiOrxYX91x.definition: A language spoken by the Grebo people in Liberia and Ivory Coast.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLrx27QGpu0s2hBlvQ6.definition: Exterior Signage Clause: A provision in a contract that specifies the terms and conditions related to the display of signs or other advertising materials on the exterior of a building or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLsl7jyymzMjTB1sWJ6.label: Personality Disorder Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/RLsl7jyymzMjTB1sWJ6.definition: A Military Personality Disorder Discharge refers to the release of a service member from active duty based on the diagnosis of a personality disorder that interferes with their ability to effectively serve in the military. This type of discharge is typically considered administrative and is based on the assessment that the disorder existed prior to service and was not a result of or aggravated by military duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLvhxz3b1k2IU3MaAge.label: Crimes Against the Public
http://lmss.sali.org/RLvhxz3b1k2IU3MaAge.definition: Crimes Against the Public are offenses that harm or disrupt the general welfare and safety of society, including but not limited to prostitution, disorderly conduct, rioting, weapons offenses, unlawful assembly, criminal gang participation, unlawful gaming and lotteries, curfew violations, loitering, vagrancy, disorderly house, failure to disperse, and drug crimes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLwlJvit_SiyF8SPyPz.definition: Any software licensing or user access fees associated with subscription- or SaaS-based fees. Indicate # of users as units; if different rates depending on user type, split into multiple expense lines by rate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLxL22W67GcWCpN6VKZ.label: Equity Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/RLxL22W67GcWCpN6VKZ.definition: Equity Related Agreement is an umbrella term for agreements related to ownership interest in a company. It outlines terms and conditions associated with equity ownership, including rights and responsibilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RLyrii562E72Ns6JtXA.label: Georgia Superior Court - Ben Hill County
http://lmss.sali.org/RLyrii562E72Ns6JtXA.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Ben Hill County and having authority over civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM0XnUSy17NaRBdBmDx.label: Witness List
http://lmss.sali.org/RM0XnUSy17NaRBdBmDx.definition: A witness list is a document that contains the names of individuals who may be called upon to testify in a legal proceeding related to bankruptcy and restructuring.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM1302VsZ3oF1kJWNkx.label: Kansas District Court - Marion County
http://lmss.sali.org/RM1302VsZ3oF1kJWNkx.definition: Kansas District Court - Marion County: A specific court within the Kansas District Court system located in Marion County, responsible for administering legal proceedings within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM35ursk6terURihawI.label: Mass Torts Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RM35ursk6terURihawI.definition: Mass torts law is an area of law that deals with legal actions involving numerous plaintiffs against one or a few defendants, where the plaintiffs allege harm caused by common actions or products. These cases often involve complex negotiations and litigation due to the large number of claimants, extensive evidence, and significant legal and financial stakes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM46E1YF0hTNl4lsMh0.label: Texas District Court - Guadalupe County
http://lmss.sali.org/RM46E1YF0hTNl4lsMh0.definition: A court located in Guadalupe County, Texas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM5NNS6Pt6sOGNkkMEK.label: Annual Information Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RM5NNS6Pt6sOGNkkMEK.definition: The Annual Information Form, also known as Form 10-K in the U.S., is an extensive disclosure document filed annually that includes a detailed account of a company's financial performance and operations. It is required by securities regulators and is intended for shareholders and potential investors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM6KeGyv1uH0zuGDufn.label: Caselaw and Common Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RM6KeGyv1uH0zuGDufn.definition: The law as established by the outcome of previously decided court cases (e.g., judicial opinions).

http://lmss.sali.org/RM6VrtfziMgMan8tAl6.label: Uniformity Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RM6VrtfziMgMan8tAl6.definition: A Uniformity Clause claim refers to a legal argument challenging the constitutionality of a tax or revenue-related law based on the requirements outlined in the Uniformity Clause of a particular jurisdiction's constitution. This claim asserts that the law violates the Uniformity Clause by imposing taxes or burdens in a manner that is not uniform or equal across the affected individuals or entities, potentially rendering it invalid or unconstitutional. The Uniformity Clause typically aims to ensure fairness and equality in taxation or revenue measures.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM83MuWEVQF14MZqJHo.label: Death Certificate
http://lmss.sali.org/RM83MuWEVQF14MZqJHo.definition: A Death Certificate is an official document issued by a government authority that records the details of a person's death. It typically includes information such as the deceased individual's name, date and place of death, cause of death, and the attending physician's or coroner's signature. Death certificates are important for legal and administrative purposes, including the settlement of the deceased person's estate and handling matters related to inheritance, insurance, and funeral arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM8MNiSWdzUOtPxknfk.label: New Jersey Superior Court - Somerset County
http://lmss.sali.org/RM8MNiSWdzUOtPxknfk.definition: The New Jersey Superior Court - Somerset County is a court of general jurisdiction within the New Jersey state court system, located in Somerset County and serving the surrounding area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM8uFdNbkVDabwW32Bv.label: Religious Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/RM8uFdNbkVDabwW32Bv.definition: A Religious Law System is a legal framework grounded in religious beliefs, texts, and traditions, governing both the moral and legal aspects of the lives of its adherents. These systems derive their authority from sacred scriptures and religious institutions, and often encompass both private conduct and public law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RM9xLNaRTTvo1CwFn80.label: Legal Aid Organization
http://lmss.sali.org/RM9xLNaRTTvo1CwFn80.definition: A Legal Aid Organization is a non-profit entity that provides free or low-cost legal assistance to individuals who cannot afford private legal representation. http://lmss.sali.org/RMAQl6YOUChd9mXqKxy.label: Intellectual Property Indemnification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RMAQl6YOUChd9mXqKxy.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any legal costs or damages resulting from a claim of intellectual property infringement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMCOdQKgX53SQsK4bTU.definition: A forum selection clause claim is a legal argument or plan that asserts a specific venue for resolving a dispute, and is supported by legal or other professional frameworks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMDFW4aA6Bbtce0T9sq.definition: A legal presumption that a person is deceased when they have been absent for a certain period of time without any evidence of being alive, often used in trust and estate claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMDptTKAPE4Nk8RRmz1.definition: The concept of Negligent Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage refers to a situation where a party's careless actions cause harm to another party's potential economic opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMFG9JGby2DHjcvNy6J.definition: Language used in a legal document that describes actions or events that would violate a party's fiduciary duties, specifically in relation to a no-shop covenant, an intervening event, or a superior offer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMJlgPsFOJLiurc5NOu.definition: A state-run pension account is a retirement savings program managed by the government, funded through taxation or mandatory contributions. These accounts typically provide defined benefits upon retirement, ensuring a basic income for retirees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMjVUkapXKFedjNxnlp.label: Laches
http://lmss.sali.org/RMjVUkapXKFedjNxnlp.definition: Laches is a legal defense that argues that a plaintiff has unreasonably delayed in bringing a claim, causing prejudice to the defendant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMmqDogmlGEOTbDl6Gg.definition: Dangerous Domesticated Animals: Domesticated animals that have a propensity to cause harm or injury to humans or other animals, and are subject to specific legal regulations and liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RMo0rWec8owXGDAYl6P.label: Concurrent Interest
http://lmss.sali.org/RMo0rWec8owXGDAYl6P.definition: Concurrent Interest refers to the situation where two or more parties simultaneously hold ownership interests in the same piece of property. http://lmss.sali.org/RMp106nIJRsFkB6OvTr.label: Liable
http://lmss.sali.org/RMp106nIJRsFkB6OvTr.definition: In a civil legal context, "liable" is a determination made by a court that a party is legally responsible or accountable for a particular harm, injury, or legal obligation. http://lmss.sali.org/RMsjauKT3Gp0pGU1YUn.label: Liability to Property Trespassers

http://lmss.sali.org/RN2D91ENKaHvvID40zU.definition: The Business and Administrative Services group comprises establishments performing routine support activities for the day-to-day operations of other organizations. http://lmss.sali.org/RN3TubQIlusDFnPgrNA.definition: Mental Disability, often referred to as a mental disorder or psychiatric disability, encompasses a wide range of conditions that affect an individual's thinking, feeling, behavior, or mood. http://lmss.sali.org/RNG9iWCh6PiLzjlKAmm.definition: The act of making a false statement that implies a negative meaning about someone, which harms their reputation or standing in the community, and is considered a form of defamation under the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNGU8QWMp7rXGtmxJE4.definition: Minnesota District Court - Lake County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNHqNN2uGjQJB1oN7np.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Tompkins County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Tompkins County, New York, with authority to hear and decide legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNI5jlSTZ3Ii77c0FMY.label: In Pari Delicto
http://lmss.sali.org/RNI5jlSTZ3Ii77c0FMY.definition: A defense in civil litigation that asserts that both parties are equally at fault and therefore neither can recover damages from the other.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNICD9MDcFQJJX6nxX1.label: Legal Proposition
http://lmss.sali.org/RNICD9MDcFQJJX6nxX1.definition: A legal proposition is a statement that outlines a principle, rule, or application of law that arguably applies to a particular legal matter, usually in writing. Legal propositions are foundational components of legal arguments, supported by statutes, case law, or other legal authorities to persuade a stakeholder (e.g., decisionmaker, opposing counsel, a counterparty) to reach a particular conclusion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNIFM9MIeDzd7WQTT6W.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Douglas County
http://lmss.sali.org/RNIFM9MIeDzd7WQTT6W.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Douglas County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Douglas County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNJR37ek3zONvzTVH9P.label: Database
http://lmss.sali.org/RNJR37ek3zONvzTVH9P.definition: A Database is a structured collection of data that is stored and organized in a manner that allows for efficient retrieval, modification, and management of information. Databases are commonly used in various applications ranging from simple data logging systems to complex relational databases for large organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNLKjc7piwQtkp8yXzM.label: Date Filed
http://lmss.sali.org/RNLKjc7piwQtkp8yXzM.definition: The "Date Filed" concept refers to the specific date on which a document or artifact was officially submitted or recorded, and is a component of the larger category of "Document Components".

http://lmss.sali.org/RNLV5Rk9cgCFDDTHRBp.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hernando County - 5th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RNLV5Rk9cgCFDDTHRBp.definition: A court located in Hernando County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNQ-wMsECS8Oxe6o5ml.definition: This phase includes all tasks related to subsequent maintenance and renewal requirements under the terms of the transaction or project such as monitoring of lease agreements, routine waivers and coordination of UCC requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNSW9gql73jyCBIqTe5.label: Discount Amount - Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RNSW9gql73jyCBIqTe5.definition: Discount Amount - Expense refers to the reduction in cost incurred by a client for expenses related to legal services provided, as opposed to fees charged for the services themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNSwAshjiwHs39Hzl7n.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Harding County
http://lmss.sali.org/RNSwAshjiwHs39Hzl7n.definition: A court located in Harding County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNTEwOnsaiI3lR6MvF8.label: Public Benefit Coverage Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RNTEwOnsaiI3lR6MvF8.definition: Public Benefit Coverage Objective refers to the goal of a legal service provider in determining client eligibility for public benefits. This can encompass various types of assistance including cash or food benefits, as well as specific healthcare services (e.g., birth control, dental care, prescriptions, optical services).

http://lmss.sali.org/RNTYkBVeXztmcHkabwE.label: Visa for Temporary Agricultural Workers
http://lmss.sali.org/RNTYkBVeXztmcHkabwE.definition: A Temporary Agricultural Workers Visa is a type of visa designed to allow foreign nationals to work temporarily in the agricultural sector of a host country. These visas are typically issued to address seasonal labor needs, such as planting, harvesting, or other farm-related activities that require a temporary influx of workers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNUBxUepOEIOvagLHcD.label: Extraordinary Ability Non-Immigrant Visa Types
http://lmss.sali.org/RNUBxUepOEIOvagLHcD.definition: An O visa is issued to foreign nationals with extraordinary ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, allowing them to enter the U.S. to continue work in their field. This visa category includes O-1 for individuals with extraordinary ability, O-2 for essential support personnel, and O-3 for their immediate family members.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNUGmrpcfQUKZlrclal.label: WC120 Analysis/Strategy
http://lmss.sali.org/RNUGmrpcfQUKZlrclal.definition: Thinking, Strategizing, and Planning for a case, including preparing for/attending initial strategy conference with adjuster/employer/ nurse case manager, discussions/writing /meetings on case strategy, preparation of litigation plan & updates, communication on case strategy/trial strategy with adjuster/ employer/nurse case manager

http://lmss.sali.org/RNUWCvAay3JJ2Jtnrxx.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Lycoming County
http://lmss.sali.org/RNUWCvAay3JJ2Jtnrxx.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Lycoming County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNUiEzpRIjQmJpv69ij.label: Redemption Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RNUiEzpRIjQmJpv69ij.definition: A redemption claim is a legal action in which a party seeks to regain ownership or rights to property that has been foreclosed upon or sold due to nonpayment of a debt or other financial obligations. In some cases, property owners or debtors have the opportunity to "redeem" their property by paying off the outstanding debt, including associated costs and fees, within a specified period defined by law. Redemption claims can be part of the foreclosure process, allowing individuals or entities to reclaim their property under certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNVlq2ReYjeb3r8UkUY.label: Proposed Findings of Fact
http://lmss.sali.org/RNVlq2ReYjeb3r8UkUY.definition: Proposed Findings of Fact refer to a written document submitted to the court by a party in a legal case, outlining the facts that they believe have been proven during the trial or hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNVmOiJzfp0FYujNYja.label: Subscription Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RNVmOiJzfp0FYujNYja.definition: Subscription Agreement is a contract between a company and an investor, stipulating the terms under which the investor can purchase shares or other securities from the company. It includes the purchase price, the number of shares, and representations and warranties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNVukeUKKKNxWuboyhf.label: Blood Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RNVukeUKKKNxWuboyhf.definition: Blood evidence includes any traces of blood found at a crime scene, whether in liquid form, stains, or spatter patterns. Forensic experts analyze this evidence for DNA, blood type, and other factors to identify individuals or recreate events related to a crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNYDfoq9SukIrHmKWwd.label: Oral Argument
http://lmss.sali.org/RNYDfoq9SukIrHmKWwd.definition: Oral Argument refers to a formal presentation made by attorneys to a judge or appellate court, where they argue the legal issues in a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNZHXKejBSAXNHVOVL0.label: Missouri Circuit Court - St. Louis County
http://lmss.sali.org/RNZHXKejBSAXNHVOVL0.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court - St. Louis County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within St. Louis County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNZJitFp7QVOw5DetMb.label: WC110 Fact Investigation/Development
http://lmss.sali.org/RNZJitFp7QVOw5DetMb.definition: All actions to investigate, understand the facts of matter, including interviewing of client personnel/potential witnesses/Conference with employer, review of file documents, investigation/surveillance/background search and security and claims materials, review of employer/personnel/wage records, legal research for initial case assessment purposes, development of factual and legal issues, identify potential experts, review of medical records regarding work status, treatment plan and maximum medical improvement, obtain and review medical/legal claims records for prior injuries/diseases/disability/W.C. Claims

http://lmss.sali.org/RNZh8z8NYtzCDK8vDD1.label: Failure to Warn
http://lmss.sali.org/RNZh8z8NYtzCDK8vDD1.definition: The failure of a manufacturer or seller to provide adequate warning or instruction about the potential dangers of a product, which can result in liability for any resulting harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNcZ1qWuPW9micDFa1s.label: Florida Circuit Court - Palm Beach County - 15th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RNcZ1qWuPW9micDFa1s.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Palm Beach County (15th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Palm Beach County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNdgiymWwkT49ZpJ74J.label: Statement of Intent
http://lmss.sali.org/RNdgiymWwkT49ZpJ74J.definition: A Statement of Intent is a written document that outlines the intentions of a party involved in a bankruptcy or restructuring process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNgF2Fm-NRYuenKbDrv.label: TR599 Other International Trademark Application Preparation and Filing

http://lmss.sali.org/RNi45s6cmCBv45JEmZf.label: Right of Reversion Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RNi45s6cmCBv45JEmZf.definition: A right of reversion clause is a provision in a contract that allows the original owner to regain ownership of the property or asset if certain conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNj767hrvvCAvvkhN7A.label: Workplace-run Pension Account
http://lmss.sali.org/RNj767hrvvCAvvkhN7A.definition: A workplace-run pension account is a retirement savings plan provided and managed by an employer, often involving contributions from both the employer and the employee. These plans can include defined benefit plans, which promise a specified monthly benefit at retirement, and defined contribution plans, which depend on the amount contributed and the performance of the investments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNjgofhOnpSLNktEz0V.label: Motion to Confirm Arbitration Award
http://lmss.sali.org/RNjgofhOnpSLNktEz0V.definition: A Motion to Confirm Arbitration Award is a formal request made to a trial court to recognize and enforce an arbitration decision that has been made by an arbitrator or arbitration panel.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNkV7LzvMYADIWekkjt.label: Sikh Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RNkV7LzvMYADIWekkjt.definition: Sikh Law pertains to the customs, traditions, and guidelines derived from the teachings of the Guru Granth Sahib and the ten Sikh Gurus, though it is not a formalized legal system like some other religious laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNkhUYPhiQvGHbAYwX9.label: L620 Collection (NOS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RNkhUYPhiQvGHbAYwX9.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily charges on a per custodian or a flat/fixed fee basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNlaIvo9pK9MgOcwKug.label: Case Assessment, Development, Administration
http://lmss.sali.org/RNlaIvo9pK9MgOcwKug.definition: The concept of Case Assessment, Development, Administration refers to the process of evaluating and managing a legal case, including analyzing strategies, investigating and developing facts, coordinating with co-parties, and managing documents and files.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNoW92yXeKjoc34E3Hz.label: Engagement Fee Model
http://lmss.sali.org/RNoW92yXeKjoc34E3Hz.definition: The model (e.g., hourly, fixed fee, contingency fee) by which legal services are obtained.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNok1Pv9Qm5zVhe94vZ.label: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RNok1Pv9Qm5zVhe94vZ.definition: Energy Law Regulatory Objectives are the legal and policy goals that guide the regulation, management, and development of energy resources and systems. These objectives aim to ensure energy security, sustainability, economic efficiency, and environmental protection.
