http://lmss.sali.org/RNs1DqvTluBrBvOZc71.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Elk County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNt4IsI5ZrD4FYS4eJL.label: Hotels and Public Houses
http://lmss.sali.org/RNt4IsI5ZrD4FYS4eJL.definition: Hotels and Public Houses are a type of real estate asset within the hospitality industry, which provide lodging and/or food and beverage services to the public.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNtr2KMwM33LplYnmmx.label: Domestic Violence
http://lmss.sali.org/RNtr2KMwM33LplYnmmx.definition: Domestic Violence refers to physical, emotional, or sexual abuse that occurs within a domestic relationship, such as between spouses or partners, and is considered a form of criminal assault.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNw3wCvXyyjEPknfOpi.label: Relationship-Based Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RNw3wCvXyyjEPknfOpi.definition: The relationship-based market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in products and services related to romantic relationships, lifestyle choices, and significant life events. This segment encompasses a wide range of offerings, from dating services to wedding planning, all designed to support and enhance various aspects of personal relationships

http://lmss.sali.org/RNxm9AKR1c3d1YRrLU6.label: Standard Moroccan Tamazight
http://lmss.sali.org/RNxm9AKR1c3d1YRrLU6.definition: Standard Moroccan Tamazight is a written or spoken structured system of communication that is a member of the Berber language family and is the official language of Morocco alongside Arabic.

http://lmss.sali.org/RNxsUvTPNCIdBO4CojR.label: Pampanga; Kapampangan
http://lmss.sali.org/RNxsUvTPNCIdBO4CojR.definition: A language spoken in the Philippines, specifically in the province of Pampanga, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RO1j8FWXas50yVNMQcE.label: U.S. Federal Courts
http://lmss.sali.org/RO1j8FWXas50yVNMQcE.definition: U.S. Federal Courts are a subset of the U.S. Courts and include the U.S. Courts of Appeal, U.S. Federal Courts - Specialty, U.S. Bankruptcy Courts, U.S. Bankruptcy Appellate Panels, U.S. District Courts, and the U.S. Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RO2re1BEj8OQIqxYNLI.label: Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RO2re1BEj8OQIqxYNLI.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Adversary Proceeding is a formal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to terminate a separate legal action brought against them within the bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RO4ttNX3SmFnQslBoDr.label: Stomach Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RO4ttNX3SmFnQslBoDr.definition: Stomach cancer, also known as gastric cancer, is a type of cancer that develops from the lining of the stomach. It can spread to other parts of the body if not treated and typically requires treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RO6KuY2FLub0BPWNMab.label: EBITDA Bonus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RO6KuY2FLub0BPWNMab.definition: A provision in a contract that entitles a party to receive a bonus based on the calculation of earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA).

http://lmss.sali.org/RO739nyMfh9Lau6VMIp.label: Successor Corporation Liable for Predecessor
http://lmss.sali.org/RO739nyMfh9Lau6VMIp.definition: When a new company takes over the assets and liabilities of a previous company, the new company can be held responsible for any legal claims against the previous company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RO8W3uYqZbxQFddl0J0.label: Nevada District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RO8W3uYqZbxQFddl0J0.definition: The Nevada District Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Nevada, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdictional boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROCGfHVibJfHEgIMx6B.label: Oregon Workers' Compensation Division
http://lmss.sali.org/ROCGfHVibJfHEgIMx6B.definition: The Oregon Workers' Compensation Division is a state agency responsible for administering the workers' compensation system in Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROCLY_ZaKRkiTZG7f4M.label: X124 Publications/Books/Treatises
http://lmss.sali.org/ROCLY_ZaKRkiTZG7f4M.definition: Costs for any publications, books or treatises Excludes LEXIS, Westlaw or similar online legal research service (X111)

http://lmss.sali.org/RODIh5doD5cIn7VwSsh.label: Plant Patent Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RODIh5doD5cIn7VwSsh.definition: A plant patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a new and distinct variety of a plant for a certain period. It includes detailed information about the plant's unique characteristics, such as its appearance, genetic makeup, and cultivation methods.

http://lmss.sali.org/RODsAVADydNHhEWk3l5.label: JJ10 Applications relating to originating process or Statement of Case or for default or summary Judgment (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RODsAVADydNHhEWk3l5.definition: Includes applications as to service or jurisdiction, to strike out or amend all or part of a claim or Statement of Case, or for the variation of parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROFTPGB5XT_CY9Ycsf2.label: TR440 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/ROFTPGB5XT_CY9Ycsf2.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with the Trademark Office of the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under TR300, including Appeals, Oppositions, and other ex-parte and inter-parties proceedings. Includes collecting evidence, preparing and filing motions, briefs, responses, replies, surreplies, and other documents, attending conferences, depositions, hearings, and other proceedings. Does not include requests for supervisory action ("Petitions" in the U.S.) under TR430. Note that governmental fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROGL71W5AsqFShCIMkO.label: Stipulation to Abandon
http://lmss.sali.org/ROGL71W5AsqFShCIMkO.definition: A Stipulation to Abandon is a legal agreement between parties in which they voluntarily give up or relinquish their rights or interests in a property or legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROKa6DaZIoBNouy8ZNq.label: Event Postponed / Rescheduled
http://lmss.sali.org/ROKa6DaZIoBNouy8ZNq.definition: Event Postponed / Rescheduled: A change in the scheduled date or time of an event.

http://lmss.sali.org/RORCUYDiiZxOrpiC8Ni.label: Corporate Vice President
http://lmss.sali.org/RORCUYDiiZxOrpiC8Ni.definition: A Corporate Vice President is an executive officer responsible for leading specific departments or functions within a company and supporting the President or CEO in executing strategic initiatives. The Vice President may oversee operations, sales, finance, or other divisions, often holding a key leadership role within the organization's hierarchy.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROT1GuNtl9h4QU8jrvA.label: Derivatives Investment Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/ROT1GuNtl9h4QU8jrvA.definition: Derivatives Investment Assets are financial instruments whose value is derived from an underlying asset, index, or security. Examples include options, futures, and swaps, and these derivatives are often used for hedging risk or for speculative purposes, offering the potential for high returns but also carrying high risk.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROT5i4M3OcSpvgyDmrj.label: Firm Innovation Personnel
http://lmss.sali.org/ROT5i4M3OcSpvgyDmrj.definition: Firm innovation personnel are individuals within a law firm or legal organization who are responsible for driving innovation and implementing new technologies or processes. They focus on improving efficiency, enhancing service delivery, and creating new business models to keep the firm competitive in an evolving legal landscape.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROTdtGQjm30XPpZAiSy.label: Cloverdale Rancheria of Pomo Indians of California

http://lmss.sali.org/ROUpQdhkPSoD6KqAyy7.label: Automatic Stay
http://lmss.sali.org/ROUpQdhkPSoD6KqAyy7.definition: An Automatic Stay is a legal concept that arises in the context of bankruptcy and restructuring events, which prohibits creditors from taking certain actions against the debtor or the debtor's property.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROVoteNIJhmVHBMrDVS.label: Social Health Insurance (SHI)
http://lmss.sali.org/ROVoteNIJhmVHBMrDVS.definition: Social Health Insurance is a healthcare system funded by contributions from employers and employees, rather than general taxation. This model is commonly found in European countries like Germany, and it generally offers a wide range of healthcare services to contributors.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROW7qlXG8U8BEevfun7.label: Cross-Defendant
http://lmss.sali.org/ROW7qlXG8U8BEevfun7.definition: A person against who a cross-claim is brought.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROWic2EEHARyyBGyKra.label: Civil Assault
http://lmss.sali.org/ROWic2EEHARyyBGyKra.definition: Civil Assault: A legal claim for damages resulting from intentional conduct that causes a person to fear an imminent harmful or offensive contact.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROWsW3Tkpc2YQmbHQeh.label: Mining and Natural Resources Extraction Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/ROWsW3Tkpc2YQmbHQeh.definition: The Mining and Natural Resources Extraction industry group comprises establishments that extract naturally occurring mineral solids, such as coal and ores; liquid minerals, such as crude petroleum; and gases, such as natural gas. The term mining is used in the broad sense to include quarrying, well operations, beneficiating (e.g., crushing, screening, washing, and flotation), and other preparation customarily performed at the mine site, or as a part of mining activity.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROXoGoFjJyTfBVV5Iy3.label: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County
http://lmss.sali.org/ROXoGoFjJyTfBVV5Iy3.definition: New York Supreme Court - Rensselaer County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that hears civil and criminal cases within Rensselaer County.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROYGjbUvBWQuH0oH4MK.label: 462 Naturalization Application (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/ROYGjbUvBWQuH0oH4MK.definition: Action seeking review of denial of an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1447(b)] or alleging failure to make a determination regarding an application for naturalization [8 U.S.C. § 1421(c)].

http://lmss.sali.org/ROYaKdqmAn8EdjV8wNs.label: Financial Indicators
http://lmss.sali.org/ROYaKdqmAn8EdjV8wNs.definition: Financial Indicators are quantitative measures that provide insights into the financial performance of a business or investment. Examples include balance, which can help in evaluating an entity's financial health and growth potential.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROZmTXLTXjHkl2dG0WM.label: Reasonableness
http://lmss.sali.org/ROZmTXLTXjHkl2dG0WM.definition: The concept of Reasonableness refers to the standard of review used by appellate courts to determine whether a lower court's decision was based on a rational and justifiable interpretation of the law and the facts presented in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROaMRBgiyTQ-jvPJLkT.label: B130 Asset Disposition
http://lmss.sali.org/ROaMRBgiyTQ-jvPJLkT.definition: Sales, abandonment and transaction work related to asset disposition

http://lmss.sali.org/ROakK54UeI9iwaSUHGK.label: Florida County Court - Baker County
http://lmss.sali.org/ROakK54UeI9iwaSUHGK.definition: Florida County Court - Baker County is a specific court within the Florida County Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Baker County, Florida.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROb7P1zmS9dqMfXoFzh.label: Business of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/ROb7P1zmS9dqMfXoFzh.definition: Business of Law refers to the management and administration of legal services, including tasks such as client portal management, procurement management, and pricing management, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RObDXKmoefrAqYpuco4.label: Pre-Judgment Interest
http://lmss.sali.org/RObDXKmoefrAqYpuco4.definition: Pre-Judgment Interest refers to the interest that accrues on a monetary award from the time the cause of action arose until the judgment is entered, and is intended to compensate the plaintiff for the loss of use of the money during that period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RObTyeuV6yxdWyj5mj1.label: Use and Permission Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RObTyeuV6yxdWyj5mj1.definition: Use and Permission Tax Payment includes taxes levied for the use of goods or permission to use goods or perform activities. These taxes are distinct from those assessed on the value of the goods themselves and are usually fixed amounts. This category also covers pollution taxes not based on the value of specific goods. Distinguishing between compulsory user charges and license fees considered as taxes and those regarded as non-tax revenues can be challenging.
http://lmss.sali.org/RObTyeuV6yxdWyj5mj1.pref_label: Taxes on use of goods, or on permission to use goods or perform activities

http://lmss.sali.org/ROdGbjIXGMksEMO7vXE.label: Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice
http://lmss.sali.org/ROdGbjIXGMksEMO7vXE.definition: A Stipulated Voluntary Dismissal with Prejudice is a legal agreement between parties in a lawsuit where the plaintiff agrees to dismiss the case permanently and cannot bring the same claim again in the future.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROdgCqB8F4yKPFPqrDw.label: Document Production Event
http://lmss.sali.org/ROdgCqB8F4yKPFPqrDw.definition: A Document Production Event is a specific type of event within the legal field that involves the creation and collection of documents for a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROgOHUkJpQfCQ0v4X2Q.label: L634 Exception handling
http://lmss.sali.org/ROgOHUkJpQfCQ0v4X2Q.definition: Activities and actions related to exception of both electronic and paper documents requiring special handling. Includes decryption.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROguS5c2GcVcG9HTujC.label: Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/ROguS5c2GcVcG9HTujC.definition: A Written Consent in Lieu of Meeting Clause is a provision in a contract that allows the parties to give their consent to a decision without holding a formal meeting, as long as the consent is given in writing.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROhQrThJyS0l40fB7FD.label: oasis:role
http://lmss.sali.org/ROhQrThJyS0l40fB7FD.definition: A role within the OASIS organization, with subtypes of Editor and Author.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROjPJRe8A3yz1LHkzla.label: Missouri Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/ROjPJRe8A3yz1LHkzla.definition: The Missouri Supreme Court is the highest court in the state of Missouri and serves as the final court of appeals for cases within the state court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROjlFsq58MnIV2nxc0I.label: Garnishee
http://lmss.sali.org/ROjlFsq58MnIV2nxc0I.definition: A person who owes a debt to a judgment debtor, or a person other than the judgment debtor who has property in his possession or custody in which a judgment debtor has an interest. NY CPLR § 105.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROkZDnVdIp3LYIkTizM.label: Motions Regarding Litigation Scope
http://lmss.sali.org/ROkZDnVdIp3LYIkTizM.definition: A Motion Regarding Litigation Scope is a formal request made to a trial court to determine the boundaries and extent of a legal case, including which issues will be addressed and which parties will be involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROn8Ax97B0Gx5rgsNR7.label: E100 Expenses
http://lmss.sali.org/ROn8Ax97B0Gx5rgsNR7.definition: E100 Expenses refer to the costs incurred during litigation that are categorized under the UTBMS Litigation code set, including but not limited to copying, postage, delivery services, expert fees, and travel expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROnsDnsqxwjC17x5c1J.label: Petition for Rehearing
http://lmss.sali.org/ROnsDnsqxwjC17x5c1J.definition: A Petition for Rehearing is a formal request made to an appellate court to reconsider its decision in a case, typically filed after an unfavorable ruling, and is a type of Appellate Filing.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROnyVftkF9oj643l1BO.label: Deceptive Use of Credit-Bureau Name
http://lmss.sali.org/ROnyVftkF9oj643l1BO.definition: The deceptive use of a credit-bureau name refers to the illegal practice of falsely representing oneself as a credit bureau or using a name similar to a credit bureau in order to deceive consumers, which falls under the broader categories of consumer credit and unfair debt collection claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROon9w3fWFgCuXMEGnk.label: Synthetic Data
http://lmss.sali.org/ROon9w3fWFgCuXMEGnk.definition: Synthetic data is data that is artificially generated by a computational process rather than being collected through sensory means or manually created by humans. It is typically produced by a model trained to replicate the characteristics and structure of its original training data, aiming to maintain a similar  distribution.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROpQIHXREpd924RIs9B.label: Texas Court of Appeals - 9th
http://lmss.sali.org/ROpQIHXREpd924RIs9B.definition: The Texas Court of Appeals - 9th is a specific intermediate appellate court in Texas that hears appeals from lower courts within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROqkYuzXx4hg7XafuJW.label: Breach of Confidentiality Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/ROqkYuzXx4hg7XafuJW.definition: The Breach of Confidentiality Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the disclosure of confidential information to third parties without authorization, and establishes remedies for any unauthorized disclosure.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROrs8bvOQp0ODEh7faA.label: JL30 Judgment and post-trial activity (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/ROrs8bvOQp0ODEh7faA.definition: Considering draft judgments, preparing and considering any written responses to the court, submissions or skeleton arguments in relation to judgment or consequential orders, preparation for and attendance at hearings when reserved judgments handed down or consequential orders considered, all dealings relating to form of judgment or order.  Includes all meetings and communications relating thereto.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROsVayXVFpGeABpmhf1.label: Required-Report Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/ROsVayXVFpGeABpmhf1.definition: A privilege that protects from disclosure any reports that are required by law or regulation to be prepared and submitted to a government agency or other authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROtFPghetZooCW3zD2j.label: Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/ROtFPghetZooCW3zD2j.definition: The Attorney-Client Corporate Privilege is a legal concept that protects confidential communications between a corporation and its attorneys from being disclosed in court proceedings, as long as the communications were made for the purpose of seeking legal advice.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROuL2AhKuh7UjMe5KjA.label: Minnesota District Court - Mower County
http://lmss.sali.org/ROuL2AhKuh7UjMe5KjA.definition: Minnesota District Court - Mower County refers to a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Mower County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROyhLvxNqG0ntjsjhlu.label: Indiana Superior Court - Huntington County
http://lmss.sali.org/ROyhLvxNqG0ntjsjhlu.definition: A court located in Huntington County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/ROztkhKmbrEt01W6yV2.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Bucks County
http://lmss.sali.org/ROztkhKmbrEt01W6yV2.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Bucks County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Bucks County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RP1-6cR46SCGMvAaO6P.label: X115 Out-of-Town Travel
http://lmss.sali.org/RP1-6cR46SCGMvAaO6P.definition: Any airfare, ground transportation (taxi, subway, train), rental car, mileage, parking, and hotel associated with out-of-town travel. Excludes include billable travel time (A112). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

http://lmss.sali.org/RP1hPiIyR5MgIIB2MEv.label: Furniture and Home Furnishings Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/RP1hPiIyR5MgIIB2MEv.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new furniture and home furnishings.  Establishments in this industry group with fixed point-of-sale locations may operate from showrooms and have substantial areas for the presentation of their products.  Establishments in this industry group may provide incidental services, including interior decorating, product assembly, installation, or repair services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RP1pWHzFMMBgTeweVm2.label: Tax on Tax
http://lmss.sali.org/RP1pWHzFMMBgTeweVm2.definition: Tax on Tax refers to a tax levied on another tax, resulting in an increased tax liability for the taxpayer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPBEBqN3r4YqvAj19Jw.label: Higher Education Degree
http://lmss.sali.org/RPBEBqN3r4YqvAj19Jw.definition: A Post-secondary Degree Level refers to the education attained after completing high school or its equivalent. This encompasses a range of academic qualifications including associate's degrees, bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, doctoral degrees (e.g., PhD), and professional degrees (e.g., MD, JD), which are awarded by colleges, universities, and professional schools after successful completion of specific courses or programs of study.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPBMYOdZCFTe7DFkGlF.label: Partner Breaching Duty to Co-Partner
http://lmss.sali.org/RPBMYOdZCFTe7DFkGlF.definition: When a partner fails to fulfill their legal obligation to another partner in a business entity, resulting in harm or damages, it is considered a breach of duty to co-partner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPCoOZAngR2KbFh-lLx.label: PA730 Assignments and Security Interests
http://lmss.sali.org/RPCoOZAngR2KbFh-lLx.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing assignment (i.e. previously registered or filed application) or security interest, including review of file history, checking status and meeting with client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPCs4TMV6qaCpR6uZaC.label: Contempt Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RPCs4TMV6qaCpR6uZaC.definition: An appeal made to challenge a decision of contempt of court, which can only be made by a party who has standing and has followed the proper procedural rules.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPDgZrLStW6ryA0kkMP.label: Pets Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RPDgZrLStW6ryA0kkMP.definition: A Pets Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and responsibilities of pet ownership within the context of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPF67693uGlG8d4nEmf.label: Event Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RPF67693uGlG8d4nEmf.definition: The risk that a specific event will impact the market or a particular industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPGDNmtfA7Qi3PN2ZZw.label: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County
http://lmss.sali.org/RPGDNmtfA7Qi3PN2ZZw.definition: Georgia District Court - Emanuel County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Emanuel County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPJjpgwgftZn5tRlnqO.label: Specialty Court Rules
http://lmss.sali.org/RPJjpgwgftZn5tRlnqO.definition: Procedural rules governing specialty courts (e.g., bankruptcy courts, immigration courts)

http://lmss.sali.org/RPM041NVgcHH9WYfIo0.label: Public Fund
http://lmss.sali.org/RPM041NVgcHH9WYfIo0.definition: Public funds are investment funds that are registered with securities regulators and open to the general public.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPMr3QYg5HQ52rYNIbe.label: Motion to Vacate Default Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RPMr3QYg5HQ52rYNIbe.definition: A Motion to Vacate Default Judgment is a legal request to set aside a court decision made against a party who failed to appear or respond to a lawsuit, based on the grounds of excusable neglect or mistake.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPO0AIJrvVPHegyxLNP.label: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Service
http://lmss.sali.org/RPO0AIJrvVPHegyxLNP.definition: Regulatory Eligibility Determination Legal Service refers to the specialized legal assistance provided by lawyers or legal experts to assess an individual's or entity's eligibility for a specific regulated activity or benefit before formally filing an application. This pre-assessment typically includes a review of relevant laws and regulations, analysis of documentation, and consultation to ensure that the applicant meets the necessary criteria to maximize the chances of approval.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPOTUgLxDXoTM1Sg444.label: Consul
http://lmss.sali.org/RPOTUgLxDXoTM1Sg444.definition: A consul is a government official who represents their country in a foreign city, often with the aim of assisting and protecting the citizens and interests of their home country. Unlike ambassadors, consuls do not engage in diplomatic negotiations but focus on administrative and practical matters such as issuing visas, aiding in trade relations, and assisting nationals in distress.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPRRa6kLRgNUtQnRPgQ.label: Religious Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RPRRa6kLRgNUtQnRPgQ.definition: The religious market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers based on their religious beliefs and practices. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who follow specific religious faiths, taking into account factors such as religious observances, dietary restrictions, and spiritual needs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPRatFSgQjNECY7TV4c.label: Limited Partnership Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RPRatFSgQjNECY7TV4c.definition: A Limited Partnership Agreement is a legal contract that outlines the terms, conditions, and structure of a limited partnership (LP). It specifies the roles, responsibilities, rights, and obligations of the general and limited partners, as well as details regarding profit distribution, capital contributions, and the management of the partnership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPSB7FRYHJJgR9AtveA.label: Traffic Accident Indicator
http://lmss.sali.org/RPSB7FRYHJJgR9AtveA.definition: Y/N - True if an incident involved a traffic accident; false otherwise.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPSmmGN6nIW5v4oXioa.label: Discovery Cost-shifting
http://lmss.sali.org/RPSmmGN6nIW5v4oXioa.definition: The concept of Discovery Cost-shifting refers to the allocation of expenses related to the process of obtaining evidence in a legal case, where the burden of paying for the discovery is shifted from one party to another.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPT3CBYx4T4i7bKz-_R.label: X127 Deposition Transcripts
http://lmss.sali.org/RPT3CBYx4T4i7bKz-_R.definition: Any court reporter and transcript fees associated with the taking of a deposition. Excludes videotape deposition costs (X308).

http://lmss.sali.org/RPVH5QmsYwXZsVzYrSQ.label: National Government Representative
http://lmss.sali.org/RPVH5QmsYwXZsVzYrSQ.definition: A National Government Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves at the highest level of a country's government, typically in the executive or legislative branch. This individual is responsible for making, debating, or executing national laws and policies, representing constituents or the nation as a whole, and participating in governance at the federal level.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPX81K5b71qm3sbcVC9.label: Elem Indian Colony of the Sulphur Bank Rancheria

http://lmss.sali.org/RPYDjxtEqiSevtQg9r6.label: Base Amount - Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RPYDjxtEqiSevtQg9r6.definition: Base Amount - Expense refers to the fixed fee charged by a lawyer for expenses incurred during the provision of legal services, such as travel expenses or filing fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPZh1T6Q1ssFyRu6wdr.label: Peculiar Risk of Harm
http://lmss.sali.org/RPZh1T6Q1ssFyRu6wdr.definition: Peculiar Risk of Harm refers to the legal principle that if a party hires an independent contractor to perform work that is likely to create a special risk of bodily harm to others, and fails to take necessary precautions, they may be held liable for any resulting harm caused to employees of the contractor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPaOcw0TUrkfmwzyz8s.label: Hiri Motu
http://lmss.sali.org/RPaOcw0TUrkfmwzyz8s.definition: A language spoken in Papua New Guinea, characterized by a simplified grammar and vocabulary, and used in legal matters within that region.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPb06WAlDAIre3vwTKQ.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County
http://lmss.sali.org/RPb06WAlDAIre3vwTKQ.definition: The New Mexico Magistrate Court - Taos County is a specific court within the New Mexico Magistrate Court system that has jurisdiction over certain types of cases in Taos County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPbYgTnMQm-O3ZoWqSI.label: Iron Ore Mining
http://lmss.sali.org/RPbYgTnMQm-O3ZoWqSI.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) developing mine sites, mining, and/or beneficiating (i.e., preparing) iron ores and manganiferous ores valued chiefly for their iron content and/or (2) producing sinter iron ore (except iron ore produced in iron and steel mills) and other iron ore agglomerates.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPh8aR0hguQPyn0Z23M.label: Freedom of Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/RPh8aR0hguQPyn0Z23M.definition: A freedom of religion claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to freedom of religion has been violated by the government or a government actor. The First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution guarantees that the government shall not establish an official religion (the Establishment Clause) or prohibit the free exercise of religion (the Free Exercise Clause). A freedom of religion claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government body enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts religious practices, when a government actor favors one religion over another, or when an individual or group is discriminated against or denied benefits based on their religious beliefs or practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPk5l5ow4n9U5uSx87P.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Beaver County
http://lmss.sali.org/RPk5l5ow4n9U5uSx87P.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Beaver County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPkiSm11zOecVvnpuZ5.label: Senior Citizen
http://lmss.sali.org/RPkiSm11zOecVvnpuZ5.definition: A senior citizen, also referred to as an elderly person, is an individual who has reached an age where they are generally considered to be in the later stage of life, often defined as 65 years old or older in many societies. This age group may be eligible for certain benefits like retirement pensions, healthcare coverage, and various social services designed to support their well-being.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPm86pyeavm3je8v0rY.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County
http://lmss.sali.org/RPm86pyeavm3je8v0rY.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Lake County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lake County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPmxKo7VSI6mX0Ibh7m.label: Wielding a Weapon
http://lmss.sali.org/RPmxKo7VSI6mX0Ibh7m.definition: Wielding a Weapon refers to the act of carrying, brandishing, or using a weapon in a manner that can cause harm or instill fear in others. This cause of action is typically associated with criminal charges or civil liability resulting from the threat or actual use of a weapon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPqwOKkYYHygKvKl24n.label: Malware Infection
http://lmss.sali.org/RPqwOKkYYHygKvKl24n.definition: Malware infection refers to a computer system being compromised by malicious software designed to damage, disrupt, or gain unauthorized access. This can include viruses, worms, trojans, and spyware.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPs4oGWa0fkJt9wkcTU.label: Jury Selection / Voire Dire
http://lmss.sali.org/RPs4oGWa0fkJt9wkcTU.definition: The concept of Jury Selection/Voire Dire refers to the process of questioning potential jurors to determine their suitability for serving on a jury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPs7E9aIvJVquW92BCP.label: Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute
http://lmss.sali.org/RPs7E9aIvJVquW92BCP.definition: A Motion to Dismiss for Failure to Prosecute is a request made to a court to dismiss a case due to the plaintiff's failure to take action or move the case forward.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPsTTfnn4RDqWS2XEYo.label: P240 Real and Personal Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RPsTTfnn4RDqWS2XEYo.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from a real and personal property perspective.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPwAjD9D1KwiPvatTVO.label: Counselor-Pupil Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RPwAjD9D1KwiPvatTVO.definition: A legal privilege that protects confidential communications between a counselor and their pupil from being disclosed without the consent of the pupil.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPxLPeiWGvmkHvdX9is.label: Family Law Events
http://lmss.sali.org/RPxLPeiWGvmkHvdX9is.definition: Family Law Events are specific types of Transaction Events that pertain to legal actions related to marriage and domestic partnerships, including events such as dissolution and creation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPyFBwCWspgOG8SD9zx.label: Florida County Court - Orange County
http://lmss.sali.org/RPyFBwCWspgOG8SD9zx.definition: A court located in Orange County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RPzuFFXebWVvkhzE9KZ.label: Letter Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/RPzuFFXebWVvkhzE9KZ.definition: A communication that occurs via physical letter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQ1Ag0nBDfe33vXin18.label: Otolaryngology Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RQ1Ag0nBDfe33vXin18.definition: Negligent or wrongful conduct by a medical professional in the field of otolaryngology, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQ1HxGIGyREydwZNRx-.label: PA720 Portfolio Analysis and Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RQ1HxGIGyREydwZNRx-.definition: All action associated with reviewing, analyzing, documenting, and managing a portfolio of patents. Includes patent "due diligence" during transactional analysis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQ69YOKe39BaW5qr4XU.label: By Fixed Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RQ69YOKe39BaW5qr4XU.definition: Engagement model where a client pays a predetermined fee — sometimes by milestone (e.g., by document, by stage) or by a bundle of matters (e.g., by portfolio).

http://lmss.sali.org/RQ6iO0ivBmjUGyRfenp.label: Indiana Superior Court - Morgan County, Superior Court3
http://lmss.sali.org/RQ6iO0ivBmjUGyRfenp.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Morgan County, Indiana, with authority over civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQAqmmGxk00iFPwlR9A.label: Mayan languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RQAqmmGxk00iFPwlR9A.definition: Mayan languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Central America, characterized by complex grammatical structures and a rich cultural heritage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQCElvOlsspVF9SbcJW.label: Transporting Stolen Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RQCElvOlsspVF9SbcJW.definition: The act of moving or carrying property that has been unlawfully taken from its rightful owner, with the knowledge that it has been stolen.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQCLOEGc3ZcnMCEpJoR.label: Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/RQCLOEGc3ZcnMCEpJoR.definition: A Motion to Dismiss Single Debtor is a legal request made by a party in a bankruptcy case to dismiss the case for a single debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQCqQcWqriNQ2XBCucD.label: Child
http://lmss.sali.org/RQCqQcWqriNQ2XBCucD.definition: A Child is an individual who is the offspring of one or more parents, either biologically or through legal processes like adoption. In legal contexts, a child is often considered a minor and is under the guardianship of their parent(s) or legal guardian(s) until reaching the age of majority.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQCyNdB6QvP6zcWKkpQ.label: Political Vote Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RQCyNdB6QvP6zcWKkpQ.definition: The Political Vote Privilege is a legal right or immunity granted to individuals that allows them to cast their vote in political elections without fear of retaliation or discrimination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQGzAjBWLRfJIJGsChG.label: Forfeiture Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RQGzAjBWLRfJIJGsChG.definition: A forfeiture proceeding is a legal process in which the government seeks to take possession of property that is believed to have been used in or obtained through criminal activity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQHOmkOaGlrYDX5xdhY.label: Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RQHOmkOaGlrYDX5xdhY.definition: The Breach of Implied-in-Law Contract refers to a situation where a party fails to fulfill an obligation that is not explicitly stated in a contract, but is implied by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQImOz9ZZbhO1585ZdP.label: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted
http://lmss.sali.org/RQImOz9ZZbhO1585ZdP.definition: Statements Not Offered for the Truth of the Matter Asserted are out-of-court statements that are admitted into evidence for a purpose other than proving the truth of the content of the statement itself. These statements are not considered hearsay because they are not relied upon for their truthfulness, but rather for another legally relevant purpose.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQK2U69tYGz8WI47zMg.label: Deal Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RQK2U69tYGz8WI47zMg.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Language refers to a legal provision in mergers and acquisitions contracts that outlines specific circumstances or events that would have a significant negative impact on the value or operations of the target company, and may allow the acquiring party to terminate the agreement or renegotiate the terms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQK2hPELdaFnrBqNkJF.label: Merger
http://lmss.sali.org/RQK2hPELdaFnrBqNkJF.definition: The concept of "Merger" refers to a type of M&A deal structure where two or more companies combine into a single entity, with one surviving entity and the others being absorbed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQKn9DJ8Sq6C9iOXGuL.label: Dividend Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RQKn9DJ8Sq6C9iOXGuL.definition: A Dividend Payment is a distribution of a portion of a company's earnings to its shareholders, typically in the form of cash or additional shares. Dividends are usually paid out regularly (e.g., quarterly) and are intended to provide a return on investment to shareholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQLBTAwgrpijWFVGwUX.label: Public Space Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/RQLBTAwgrpijWFVGwUX.definition: A Public Space Committee is an organized group of individuals, often within local government or a relevant agency, that oversees, plans, and makes recommendations for the development, maintenance, and use of public spaces within a community. This committee typically collaborates with urban planners, landscape architects, and community stakeholders to create spaces that serve public needs and enhance community welfare.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQR64SI6XmYz5JlNaDU.label: Document Collections by Areas of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RQR64SI6XmYz5JlNaDU.definition: Document Collections by Areas of Law are a type of Transactional Document that group together various legal documents related to specific areas of law, such as Real Estate, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Trusts and Estate Planning.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQRTfaSTLSpiHEtG1I2.label: L679 Quality assurance and control
http://lmss.sali.org/RQRTfaSTLSpiHEtG1I2.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQRjrUU73Agr85EoUCz.label: Cross-Appellant
http://lmss.sali.org/RQRjrUU73Agr85EoUCz.definition: A litigant who makes a cross-appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RQS7ykFD4LHOhpUTYBu.label: Kansas District Court - Allen County

http://lmss.sali.org/RQa2XJIA9q6qPcaXFxY.label: tax_total_detail_expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RQa2XJIA9q6qPcaXFxY.definition:
"Total taxable amount of expenses attributable to this tx_id, including amounts associated with MATTER_DISC_CRED where disc_cred_category = ""Exp"".

Using the Math Statement on the next tab in this workbook:  
   The total for pre-split expense items for this tx_id
+ The total for post-split expense items for this tx_id  
   tax_total_detail_exp  
  
If tx_id is a Tiered Tax, the value in this field should be 0.

Certain taxes are calculated not only on line items, but also include another tax for these line items -- a ""tax on tax"" situation.  For example, in Canada both Quebec and Prince Edward Island have specific taxes calculated on the sum of the line items plus the federal tax paid on those line items.  In situations like this, the tax_total_detail_expense figure stated should include the other tax attributable to the line items so that the math statement for total_tax_on_expense is correct.
"

Covers interviews of client personnel and potential witnesses, review of documents to learn the facts of a potential case, work with an investigator, and all related communications and correspondence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS4MNLzEw9KGWGaiRAb.label: Governmental Branch
http://lmss.sali.org/RS4MNLzEw9KGWGaiRAb.definition: The branches of government typically refer to the three main divisions of a democratic system: the legislative, which makes laws; the executive, which enforces and administers laws; and the judicial, which interprets laws. These branches are designed to balance power and ensure that no single entity has unchecked authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS51XczTItzSjgT9JkL.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Columbia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RS51XczTItzSjgT9JkL.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Columbia County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Columbia County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS5wd0YB9ptr6ZMVKde.label: USCIS Administrative Appeals Office
http://lmss.sali.org/RS5wd0YB9ptr6ZMVKde.definition: The USCIS Administrative Appeals Office is a specific administrative venue within the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services where individuals can appeal certain immigration-related decisions made by USCIS.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS6Pedvqd6vX99HwyhZ.label: Limitations on Antitrust Efforts Standards
http://lmss.sali.org/RS6Pedvqd6vX99HwyhZ.definition: Limitations on Antitrust Efforts Standards refer to specific provisions or rules that restrict the extent to which antitrust efforts can be pursued in a legal matter, such as dollar-based, materiality-based, or MAE-based standards, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS8ee1giqjAUuHky0lJ.label: Product Disparagement
http://lmss.sali.org/RS8ee1giqjAUuHky0lJ.definition: The act of making false or misleading statements about a product or service with the intention of harming its reputation or sales, which falls under the broader category of defamation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RS9mRCkEGyE2dgW38uD.label: Double Jeopardy
http://lmss.sali.org/RS9mRCkEGyE2dgW38uD.definition: The concept of Double Jeopardy refers to the legal principle that prohibits an individual from being prosecuted or punished twice for the same offense after a final judgment has been made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSAIWX8LNImanB6naIx.label: Mandatory Sentence
http://lmss.sali.org/RSAIWX8LNImanB6naIx.definition: A Mandatory Sentence is a predetermined punishment specified by law for a particular criminal offense, leaving the judge with no discretion to individualize the sentence. This type of sentence requires the court to impose a specific penalty upon conviction, regardless of mitigating factors or the judge's personal assessment of the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSCPj3Fx9eMWODAmY3A.label: AI Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RSCPj3Fx9eMWODAmY3A.definition: AI Discrimination refers to the differential treatment of individuals based on factors such as ethnicity, culture, or religion. This discrimination can arise from institutional and individual biases embedded in AI processes, cultural and social biases within the data, technical limitations of hardware or software, or the context of an AI system's application that results in unequal treatment of groups.
examples: Mobley v. Workday, Inc., Case No. 3:23-cv-00770 (N.D. Cal.)

http://lmss.sali.org/RSCidDameEbWpwdfeB2.label: Claim for Falling on Water
http://lmss.sali.org/RSCidDameEbWpwdfeB2.definition: A claim for falling on water is a legal action brought by a plaintiff who has suffered injury due to slipping and falling on a wet surface, and is based on the legal theory of negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSDHiPDqk0hrANSy6LD.label: Actions Required Under Transaction Agreement Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RSDHiPDqk0hrANSy6LD.definition: Actions Required Under Transaction Agreement Language refers to the specific obligations and duties that must be fulfilled by parties involved in a legal transaction as outlined in the agreement, and which are exempted from the Material Adverse Effect (MAE) definition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSEc3J4h5XdVfKKWBG7.label: Secondary Legal Authorities
http://lmss.sali.org/RSEc3J4h5XdVfKKWBG7.definition: Documents and other materials that discuss, explain, analyze, and critique the law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSHYQbtLmQEohpuZo4F.label: 360 Other Personal Injury (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RSHYQbtLmQEohpuZo4F.definition: Action primarily based on personal injury or death caused by negligence or intentional misconduct, including suits brought against the United States under the Federal Tort Claims Act, and which cannot be classified under any other nature of suit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSJbyWqh5i2aZY6Lhu1.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Gilliam County
http://lmss.sali.org/RSJbyWqh5i2aZY6Lhu1.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Gilliam County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Gilliam County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSKL41xYBRouOTYsPIs.label: WC150 Budgeting
http://lmss.sali.org/RSKL41xYBRouOTYsPIs.definition: Preparation of budget, correspondence regarding budget

http://lmss.sali.org/RSKhkueU3XG90GBOjmm.label: Subpoena Fees Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RSKhkueU3XG90GBOjmm.definition: The Subpoena Fees Expense refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for issuing and serving a subpoena to a witness or a third party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSLfWI5W2feb69g3Pt8.label: Provider Practice Group
http://lmss.sali.org/RSLfWI5W2feb69g3Pt8.definition: Name of the provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) practice group.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSMJnKR45WOlErpn2hR.label: Plea Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RSMJnKR45WOlErpn2hR.definition: A plea agreement is a legal document that outlines an agreement between a defendant and prosecutor, in which the defendant agrees to plead guilty or no contest to a charge in exchange for a reduced sentence or other concessions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSPymfq5oST-qqPPju8.label: X132 Medical Record Service Provider Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RSPymfq5oST-qqPPju8.definition: Any third party medical record service provider fees billed as an expense as opposed to a service, when this task is outsourced to a third party and paid by the law firm or legal vendor
http://lmss.sali.org/RSPymfq5oST-qqPPju8.pref_label: X132 Medical Record Service Provider Fees

http://lmss.sali.org/RSQjOF7ik8OIL93pvrq.label: Parental Alienation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RSQjOF7ik8OIL93pvrq.definition: The intentional or unintentional behavior of one parent that causes a child to reject or fear the other parent, leading to a claim in a custody or visitation dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSQv7ZDHINY1wzeWmqx.label: Summary of Ballots
http://lmss.sali.org/RSQv7ZDHINY1wzeWmqx.definition: A summary of ballots is a document that provides a condensed version of the votes cast by creditors or shareholders in a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSRxb9psAJdqf8rppoi.label: Judicial and Procedural Tort Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RSRxb9psAJdqf8rppoi.definition: Judicial and Procedural Tort Claims refer to legal claims made against individuals or entities for their wrongful actions or omissions during legal proceedings, such as perjury, abuse of process, or spoliation of evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSW1hnn0sR0SmxBYhWO.label: Treating Physician
http://lmss.sali.org/RSW1hnn0sR0SmxBYhWO.definition: Physician who has treated a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSYBzf149Mi5KE0Ytmp.label: Area of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RSYBzf149Mi5KE0Ytmp.definition: The practice area into which a legal matter or legal area of study falls (e.g., Criminal Law, Real Property Law, Mergers and Acquisitions Law, Personal and Family Law, Tax and Revenue Law).

http://lmss.sali.org/RSYiZ4yVmjEDGYqpxWG.label: Indiana Town Court - Marion County, Washington Twp.
http://lmss.sali.org/RSYiZ4yVmjEDGYqpxWG.definition: A local court in Marion County, Washington Township, Indiana that handles minor criminal and traffic offenses, as well as small claims and civil cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSa8f99iCBoeRSiuE5X.label: Birth Certificate
http://lmss.sali.org/RSa8f99iCBoeRSiuE5X.definition: A Birth Certificate is an official document issued by a government authority that records the details of a person's birth. It typically includes information such as the individual's full name, date and place of birth, parentage, and, in some cases, other relevant details like the attending physician. Birth certificates serve as legal proof of identity and are often required for various official purposes, including obtaining identification documents and accessing government services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSaWJiL83AYWewC1BSt.label: Motion to Obtain Credit
http://lmss.sali.org/RSaWJiL83AYWewC1BSt.definition: A Motion to Obtain Credit is a request made in a bankruptcy case by a debtor seeking permission to obtain credit or incur debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSfJ7GMQEftc9GFM2yY.label: Sexual Orientation Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RSfJ7GMQEftc9GFM2yY.definition: Discrimination based on an individual's sexual orientation, which involves treating someone unfavorably because of their sexual orientation, whether real or perceived.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSfWLD6VgkWm2v5HbRf.label: Contributory Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RSfWLD6VgkWm2v5HbRf.definition: A type of social security benefit funded by contributions from employees, employers, or both, typically through payroll taxes. Eligibility for contributory benefits is usually based on the individual's contribution history and may include benefits such as retirement pensions, disability insurance, and unemployment insurance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSfkA1olJTk6vIVZuP8.label: P250 Employee/Labor
http://lmss.sali.org/RSfkA1olJTk6vIVZuP8.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from an employee benefits and labor perspective.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSgMCLeMm8fZCrNYibg.label: Family Practitioner Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RSgMCLeMm8fZCrNYibg.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by a family practitioner in the course of providing medical care to a patient, resulting in harm or injury to the patient or a failure to diagnose or treat a medical condition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSgsMnqHZACTfpDfFz3.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Grundy County (13th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RSiPWdkvszwMnsoFXft.label: New York Court of Appeals
http://lmss.sali.org/RSiPWdkvszwMnsoFXft.definition: The New York Court of Appeals is the highest court in the New York State court system, responsible for hearing appeals from lower courts and making final decisions on legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSjxzxDT4ctm5XV9WFI.label: ACCOUNT_TYPE
http://lmss.sali.org/RSjxzxDT4ctm5XV9WFI.definition: A type of account used in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSk58vy4yOtGYBiNHGj.label: Coastal Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RSk58vy4yOtGYBiNHGj.definition: A Coastal Real Estate Asset refers to property located along the coastlines of oceans or seas. These assets typically offer scenic views, access to water-based activities, and come with unique environmental and regulatory considerations related to coastal management and conservation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSlvXSRrQSEGiNYhyhq.label: P400 Initial Document Preparation/Filing
http://lmss.sali.org/RSlvXSRrQSEGiNYhyhq.definition: This phase includes all tasks undertaken to prepare transaction documents and opinions prior to their being sent to non-client third parties. Also includes all tasks undertaken to file documents (including regulatory filings). All related communications with the client and review of client generated transaction documentation should be coded here.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSoAiGPfiabUiYu7kiU.label: Evergreen Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RSoAiGPfiabUiYu7kiU.definition: An evergreen clause is a provision in a contract that automatically renews the agreement at the end of its term unless one of the parties gives notice to terminate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSq6tKFNaCWBuzwBECD.label: Household Income
http://lmss.sali.org/RSq6tKFNaCWBuzwBECD.definition: Household income is the combined total income of all people living in a single household, regardless of their relationship to each other. This metric is often used for demographic, tax, and social services analysis to assess the economic status of a household.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSrWbfWvuIGTmJfHfS6.label: Motion Setting Property Value
http://lmss.sali.org/RSrWbfWvuIGTmJfHfS6.definition: A motion setting property value is a type of motion filed in a bankruptcy case that seeks to determine the value of a particular property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSrukbySsHLNTSeIzry.label: Guardianship of Minor
http://lmss.sali.org/RSrukbySsHLNTSeIzry.definition: The legal concept of Guardianship of Minor refers to the legal authority and responsibility given to a person or entity to care for and make decisions on behalf of a minor child who is not able to care for themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSs6-LAMjRa-IbkcU9d.label: PA110 Fact Investigation and Development
http://lmss.sali.org/RSs6-LAMjRa-IbkcU9d.definition: All actions to investigate and understand the facts of a matter that are not included under another patent task code below. Covers interviews of client personnel and potential witnesses, review of documents to learn the facts of a potential case, work with an investigator, and all related communications and correspondence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSv0HBRq8RHUfm3K53Z.label: Payee Name - Fee or Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RSv0HBRq8RHUfm3K53Z.definition: Payee Name - Fee or Expense refers to the specific details of the payment recipient and the type of payment, whether it is a fee or an expense, within the context of an engagement for legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSvnkHylKwz4zrvnJyY.label: Structure Chart
http://lmss.sali.org/RSvnkHylKwz4zrvnJyY.definition: A structure chart for an investment fund is a visual diagram that outlines the legal, financial, and operational relationships among the various entities involved in the fund's setup. It's used to clearly illustrate how an investment fund is organized, including:

http://lmss.sali.org/RSwOCeFhWxUA3fOiTvl.label: Government Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/RSwOCeFhWxUA3fOiTvl.definition: Government Benefits are financial assistance programs provided by the government to individuals in need, designed to support basic living expenses, healthcare, and other essential needs. These benefits include payments such as Social Security, unemployment benefits, and welfare payments, which help to ensure a safety net for the vulnerable and unemployed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSxEoUiMU4gjY4l6L5x.label: Expert Interview Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RSxEoUiMU4gjY4l6L5x.definition: Expert Interview Practice refers to the process of conducting interviews with individuals who possess specialized knowledge or expertise relevant to a legal matter, as part of the fact investigation and development phase of a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSxqnpTrjCFiSvwj6Qm.label: Sundanese
http://lmss.sali.org/RSxqnpTrjCFiSvwj6Qm.definition: Sundanese (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Sundanese people of West Java, Indonesia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSyBCrobkgiOYQQYtjU.label: Motion to Stay Preliminary Injunction
http://lmss.sali.org/RSyBCrobkgiOYQQYtjU.definition: A Motion to Stay Preliminary Injunction is a request made to a court to temporarily suspend or delay the enforcement of a preliminary injunction until a final decision is made on the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSyZC1U45WKt3jyewRo.label: Negotiable Instrument Forged or Stolen Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RSyZC1U45WKt3jyewRo.definition: A Negotiable Instrument Forged or Stolen Claim is a legal claim related to a written promise to pay a specific amount of money that has been fraudulently created or taken without authorization, and is related to banking, commercial paper, and creditor claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSyqLe07ukzuw558ceE.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Jackson County
http://lmss.sali.org/RSyqLe07ukzuw558ceE.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Jackson County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Jackson County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RSzCwueGYDrOVEQKbRy.label: Yao
http://lmss.sali.org/RSzCwueGYDrOVEQKbRy.definition: Yao (Language) is a specific written or spoken structured system of communication that is a member of the Language class, and is used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RT2d0T4EpePjvAggumq.label: Treaty Trader Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RT2d0T4EpePjvAggumq.definition: The Treaty Trader Visa is a visa category designed for nationals of countries with which the United States maintains a treaty of commerce and navigation. The visa allows individuals or companies to enter and conduct substantial trade activities, such as the exchange of goods, services, or technology, between the host and treaty countries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RT6dErffo0x5SrTSUjs.label: Statement of Operations
http://lmss.sali.org/RT6dErffo0x5SrTSUjs.definition: A Statement of Operations is a financial document that provides information on a company's revenues, expenses, and profits or losses during a specific period of time, and is typically used in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RT7xQmfA7w5HT02clIp.label: Daubert Motion Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RT7xQmfA7w5HT02clIp.definition: Daubert Motion Practice refers to the process of challenging the admissibility of expert testimony in court, based on the standards set forth in the Daubert case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RT9I91BM6M79va9A3fx.label: Galibi Carib
http://lmss.sali.org/RT9I91BM6M79va9A3fx.definition: Galibi Carib is a language that belongs to the Cariban language family and is spoken by the Galibi people in parts of South America.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTAn3dDVBaCFjkv1YPD.label: License Grant Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RTAn3dDVBaCFjkv1YPD.definition: A License Grant Clause is a provision in a contract that gives permission to use a specific intellectual property right, such as a patent or trademark, for a certain purpose or period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTC1UNfuHw77z9Xtvw4.label: L120 Analysis/Strategy
http://lmss.sali.org/RTC1UNfuHw77z9Xtvw4.definition: The concept of L120 Analysis/Strategy refers to the process of evaluating and developing a plan of action for a legal case, including identifying key issues and potential outcomes, and determining the best course of action to achieve the desired result.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTCexs4EcZ0vfM4pPLU.label: Intervenor-Plaintiff
http://lmss.sali.org/RTCexs4EcZ0vfM4pPLU.definition: A person who intervenes or seeks to intervene as a plaintiff in a civil action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTHm2BxeaziDbm5655G.label: Cost Metrics
http://lmss.sali.org/RTHm2BxeaziDbm5655G.definition: Metrics that specifically focus on the expenses and costs incurred in the process of delivering services or goods, used for budgeting, financial planning, and pricing strategies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTI29HdGI4AAyxdGoow.label: Adequate Protection Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RTI29HdGI4AAyxdGoow.definition: Adequate Protection Practice refers to the legal practice of ensuring that a creditor's interest in collateral is protected during bankruptcy proceedings, typically through the use of cash or other forms of relief from stay.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTIk6DV0AfMJI4lRJV9.label: Georgia Superior Court - Stephens County
http://lmss.sali.org/RTIk6DV0AfMJI4lRJV9.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Stephens County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Stephens County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTJNciPxYJF2fnXbCOR.label: Pancreas Transplantation
http://lmss.sali.org/RTJNciPxYJF2fnXbCOR.definition: Pancreas transplantation is a surgical procedure that involves replacing a diseased or non-functional pancreas with a healthy donor pancreas. This transplant is often performed for patients with severe type 1 diabetes who have difficult-to-manage blood sugar levels and complications from the disease.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTK9LsRPqLC3UUnUHDi.label: King
http://lmss.sali.org/RTK9LsRPqLC3UUnUHDi.definition: A King is a male monarch who holds the highest royal title and serves as the sovereign ruler of a kingdom or realm. This hereditary or elected position typically involves both ceremonial duties and varying degrees of political power, depending on the constitutional structure of the country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTM0OWNVhLnesUlYZpd.label: Victim
http://lmss.sali.org/RTM0OWNVhLnesUlYZpd.definition: A victim is an individual who suffers harm, injury, loss, or hardship due to an unlawful act, omission, or negligence of another party. This harm can manifest physically, emotionally, financially, or in any other form detrimental to the individual's well-being or rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTNLwK1SAJaRJJu2kYr.label: Judicial Concurrence
http://lmss.sali.org/RTNLwK1SAJaRJJu2kYr.definition: Judicial concurrence refers to the agreement of one or more judges with the majority opinion in a court case, but for different reasons or with additional commentary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTNQ4Vy4EmCR3CstGC6.label: Motion to File Amended Complaint
http://lmss.sali.org/RTNQ4Vy4EmCR3CstGC6.definition: A Motion to File Amended Complaint is a formal request made to the court to allow a party to modify or add to their original complaint in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTPFix1eiYqgdushRun.label: Knowledge Type
http://lmss.sali.org/RTPFix1eiYqgdushRun.definition: Knowledge Type is a subclass of Document/Artifact and includes various types of documents such as FAQs, training materials, reports, exemplar documents, templates, forms, guides, directories, playbooks, articles, presentations, and expert opinions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTQ0YxjPmPJnWEazF5U.label: Easement After Property Divided
http://lmss.sali.org/RTQ0YxjPmPJnWEazF5U.definition: A legal right to use someone else's property for a specific purpose, which arises after the property has been divided among different owners.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTQA7duTNS3UDL2qbEM.label: 820 Copyright (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RTQA7duTNS3UDL2qbEM.definition: Action filed in support or to dispute a copyright claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTRiaL5f3fTMDVviJJv.label: Welfare Payments
http://lmss.sali.org/RTRiaL5f3fTMDVviJJv.definition: Welfare Payments are financial assistance provided by the government to individuals and families in need, aiming to ensure a minimum standard of living. These payments are designed to support basic necessities such as food, housing, and healthcare for low-income and vulnerable populations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTSI7ogxo4mf2wErPNx.label: Vestibular Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RTSI7ogxo4mf2wErPNx.definition: Disturbance of labyrinthine-vestibular function involves a condition characterized by frequent episodes of balance disturbances, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), and progressive hearing loss. Diagnosis typically requires evidence of impaired vestibular function through tests such as caloric or other vestibular assessments, as well as documented hearing loss established by audiometry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTSiUmV98XcJo4iDnUh.label: Paralegal
http://lmss.sali.org/RTSiUmV98XcJo4iDnUh.definition: A paralegal is a level of provider in legal services who is responsible for timekeeping and other administrative tasks, but is not a licensed attorney.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTVkevOi2bFkhjrdwtS.label: Including Without Limitation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RTVkevOi2bFkhjrdwtS.definition: An "Including Without Limitation Clause" is a provision in a contract that clarifies that the listed items are not an exhaustive list and that other items may also be included.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTWQRXoa1bWkzWCxuXh.label: Motion to Extend Time to Comply with Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RTWQRXoa1bWkzWCxuXh.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to Comply with Order is a request made to a court to allow additional time to fulfill a previously issued order.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTWpoh9tHMCjgHHoS1i.label: Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage
http://lmss.sali.org/RTWpoh9tHMCjgHHoS1i.definition: The concept of Interference with Prospective Economic Advantage refers to the intentional or negligent actions of one party that prevent another party from realizing potential economic benefits or advantages that were reasonably expected to occur in the future.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTWvb5uqwKdP7PxTczN.label: Federal Tort Claims Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RTWvb5uqwKdP7PxTczN.definition: A Federal Tort Claims Act Claim is a legal claim made against the United States government for damages caused by the negligent or wrongful acts of federal employees acting within the scope of their employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTYNiFiKhmVWxFoHHyZ.label: Engagement Start Date
http://lmss.sali.org/RTYNiFiKhmVWxFoHHyZ.definition: The date at which a provider (e.g., law firm, ALSP) is engaged by a Buyer (e.g., corporation, client)

http://lmss.sali.org/RTYcaxmISiFpVr6KReW.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RTYcaxmISiFpVr6KReW.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Washington County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Washington County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTYeTQAYNOjSSk2iqxM.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Gasconade County
http://lmss.sali.org/RTYeTQAYNOjSSk2iqxM.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in Gasconade County, which is responsible for hearing and deciding civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTZQhQ2JqBccyztlJbR.label: Motion for Interest on a Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RTZQhQ2JqBccyztlJbR.definition: A Motion for Interest on a Judgment is a request made to the court to add interest to a previously awarded judgment, typically to compensate for the delay in payment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTabAEF89w0gqe89WQ2.label: Special Immigrant Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RTabAEF89w0gqe89WQ2.definition: A "Special Immigrant Visa" provides permanent residency to individuals who have assisted a host country’s government in a high-risk capacity, often in conflict zones. This visa type primarily supports interpreters, translators, and other personnel who face danger due to their association with the host country’s military or government entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTdz0XIy1RFA1hRKHlz.label: Latvian
http://lmss.sali.org/RTdz0XIy1RFA1hRKHlz.definition: A language spoken in Latvia and used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTfFJVgqB5so6U5f7y0.label: Motion for Findings of Fact
http://lmss.sali.org/RTfFJVgqB5so6U5f7y0.definition: A Motion for Findings of Fact is a formal request made by a party in a trial court asking the judge to make specific factual determinations based on the evidence presented at trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTfHZC0YshysT9Mc1Ic.label: Latin
http://lmss.sali.org/RTfHZC0YshysT9Mc1Ic.definition: A language that was spoken in ancient Rome and is still used in legal contexts today.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTfuHMNjRRfSojEjNSX.label: X114 Local Travel
http://lmss.sali.org/RTfuHMNjRRfSojEjNSX.definition: Any ground transportation (taxi, subway), mileage and parking associated with local travel. Excludes billable travel time (A115). If client requires a more granular breakdown, law firm or legal vendor should submit separate itemized expense line items.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTh6PFbxMqxyQ8NBd57.label: EMS Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RTh6PFbxMqxyQ8NBd57.definition: Negligence by emergency medical services providers, including paramedics and ambulance personnel, in the treatment or transport of patients.

http://lmss.sali.org/RThFcG5dCn83Go9oqt0.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County
http://lmss.sali.org/RThFcG5dCn83Go9oqt0.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Callaway County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Callaway County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTidRiJfp65AGi8fDsf.label: Treason
http://lmss.sali.org/RTidRiJfp65AGi8fDsf.definition: The act of betraying one's country by levying war against it or by giving aid or comfort to its enemies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTkZSNEo9hmAI7bY18F.label: Tangerines
http://lmss.sali.org/RTkZSNEo9hmAI7bY18F.definition: Tangerines are small citrus fruits belonging to the Citrus reticulata species, known for their bright orange color, sweet flavor, and easy-to-peel skin. They are consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary dishes, valued for their high vitamin C content and aromatic zest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTpYaDRmxvCO6KPgPLG.label: LAW_FIRM_STATEorREGION
http://lmss.sali.org/RTpYaDRmxvCO6KPgPLG.definition: A geographic location where a law firm is located, as defined by the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTrOdLMv42M5l7864YC.label: Sales Commission Due from Principal
http://lmss.sali.org/RTrOdLMv42M5l7864YC.definition: Sales Commission Due from Principal refers to the legal claim made by an agent or salesperson against their principal for payment of a commission owed for the sale of goods or services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTruf7ld2Vx1Xb4i88a.label: Outside Printing Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RTruf7ld2Vx1Xb4i88a.definition: Expenses related to printing materials or services that are outsourced to a third-party vendor, rather than being produced in-house.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTsxRn6gXkqWe75ZW5n.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Livingston County (11th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RTtFkYWBuiqc2GMupJD.label: By Contingency Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RTtFkYWBuiqc2GMupJD.definition: Engagement fee model where if a matter is successful, the provider is paid a percentage of a client’s recovery.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTtZtn67Cvp0TersB7y.label: Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage
http://lmss.sali.org/RTtZtn67Cvp0TersB7y.definition: An Analysis of Pre-Petition Mortgage involves the examination and evaluation of mortgage agreements and related financial transactions that occurred before the filing of a bankruptcy petition. This analysis helps determine the validity, priority, and enforceability of claims against the debtor's property within the bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTvhgnc8JDUg9dP9sFv.label: European Call Option Style
http://lmss.sali.org/RTvhgnc8JDUg9dP9sFv.definition: A European Call Option Style is a type of option contract that can only be exercised for a short, specified period just prior to its expiration, usually on a single day. This restriction contrasts with American-style options, which can be exercised at any time before expiration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTvmhlWl6bokNJwlrEn.label: Condition Precedent Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RTvmhlWl6bokNJwlrEn.definition: A condition precedent clause is a provision in a contract that specifies an event or action that must occur before the parties are obligated to perform their respective duties under the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTxfNOfdvqgdC7o0NJp.label: tax_tier_max
http://lmss.sali.org/RTxfNOfdvqgdC7o0NJp.definition:
"The maximum amount of this tax tier expressed in INVOICE.inv_currency.

Use the value ""TOP"" to indicate that the top tier extends to infinity.
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RTyOWLTtwSMwIw3JDKh.label: Governor
http://lmss.sali.org/RTyOWLTtwSMwIw3JDKh.definition: A Governor is the chief executive officer of a state, commonwealth, or territory within a federal system of government. This official is typically elected by the populace and is responsible for implementing state laws, managing the state government, and serving as the state's top representative in dealings with other states and the federal government.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTyoF6vOGn0G3py0iRk.label: Number of Employees
http://lmss.sali.org/RTyoF6vOGn0G3py0iRk.definition: Number of Employees refers to the total count of individuals employed by a business or organization, either on a full-time or part-time basis. This metric is often used for various purposes including business valuation, eligibility for certain benefits or programs, and as an indicator of company size and capacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RTzCl6pL4nmd45HEBPC.label: Breach of Nonsolicitation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RTzCl6pL4nmd45HEBPC.definition: A breach of nonsolicitation agreement occurs when a party violates the terms of a contract that prohibits them from soliciting or attempting to solicit the employees, clients, or customers of another party, typically their former employer or business partner. Nonsolicitation agreements are often included in employment contracts, partnership agreements, or business sale agreements to protect a company's relationships with its workforce and clientele.

http://lmss.sali.org/RU1dvjPyTUgMePOcj2Y.label: Contested Divorce
http://lmss.sali.org/RU1dvjPyTUgMePOcj2Y.definition: A Contested Divorce is a type of divorce in which the spouses are unable to reach an agreement on key issues such as division of property, child custody, spousal support, or other matters related to the dissolution of their marriage. In a contested divorce, these issues are typically resolved through litigation, with a court making decisions on behalf of the spouses. It often involves a more lengthy and adversarial legal process compared to an uncontested divorce, where the parties agree on the terms of the divorce.

http://lmss.sali.org/RU20xmO7EqpYUmPGUbj.label: Contact Name Suffix - III (Third)
http://lmss.sali.org/RU20xmO7EqpYUmPGUbj.definition: The suffix "III" stands for "Third" and is used after a person's full name to distinguish them as the third generation to bear that name in their family. Typically, it follows a grandfather, father, and son who all share the same name, and it helps in differentiating among them in formal, legal, or financial documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUAD4q6o0o2WNncfXZ9.label: Management Information Circular
http://lmss.sali.org/RUAD4q6o0o2WNncfXZ9.definition: A Management Information Circular is a document prepared by a company's management to provide shareholders with material information needed to make informed voting decisions at a shareholders' meeting. It often includes proposals, background information, and recommendations from the board of directors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUBVBTCdh2Pbwc0lQCu.label: Multifamily Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RUBVBTCdh2Pbwc0lQCu.definition: Real estate properties that include more than one unit for residential inhabitants including residential buildings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUCs1tfF1J4XdhUkIhP.label: Lung Transplantation
http://lmss.sali.org/RUCs1tfF1J4XdhUkIhP.definition: Lung transplantation is a surgical procedure in which one or both diseased lungs are replaced with healthy lungs from a donor. This treatment is typically considered for patients with end-stage lung disease, such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or pulmonary fibrosis, who have not responded to other therapies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUDVKmMNlScgBVLBkFr.label: Equity Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/RUDVKmMNlScgBVLBkFr.definition: An Equity Committee represents the interests of equity holders (shareholders) in a bankruptcy or restructuring process. This committee ensures that the rights and priorities of shareholders are considered in negotiations, particularly in scenarios where their investments are at risk of being diluted or wiped out.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUE4fCCSnGX1wIK324E.label: Transportation and Logistics Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RUE4fCCSnGX1wIK324E.definition: The Transportation and Logistics industry group includes industries providing transportation of passengers and cargo, warehousing and storage for goods, scenic and sightseeing transportation, and support activities related to modes of transportation. Establishments in these industries use transportation equipment or transportation related facilities as a productive asset. The type of equipment depends on the mode of transportation. The modes of transportation are air, rail, water, road, and pipeline.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUGjHiVKuUfRusC0Y0n.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Lehigh County
http://lmss.sali.org/RUGjHiVKuUfRusC0Y0n.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Lehigh County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Lehigh County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUH9A0VJfKpItj0UkMl.label: Citations to Another Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RUH9A0VJfKpItj0UkMl.definition: A document's citations to other documents (e.g., legal authorities, exhibits, other documents).

http://lmss.sali.org/RUHHWvrkkhfYJoqYNBm.label: Criminal Court Proceeding
http://lmss.sali.org/RUHHWvrkkhfYJoqYNBm.definition: A criminal lawsuit; all or some part of a cause heard and determined by a criminal court. Any legal step or action taken at the direction of, or by the authority of a court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUIqGhvuDiTnRQCirEM.label: Prostate Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RUIqGhvuDiTnRQCirEM.definition: Prostate cancer is a type of cancer that develops in the prostate gland, a small gland in men that produces seminal fluid. It can range from slow-growing tumors that may need minimal treatment to aggressive cancers that require surgery, radiation, and hormone therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUKEFNs3cAPlchHsKzI.label: Probate Filing
http://lmss.sali.org/RUKEFNs3cAPlchHsKzI.definition: A probate filing is a legal document submitted to a court to initiate the process of settling a deceased person's estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUKosBKos93GRq1MSF5.label: BILLING_END_DATE
http://lmss.sali.org/RUKosBKos93GRq1MSF5.definition: The term BILLING_END_DATE refers to the date on which a billing period ends, as defined in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.
