http://lmss.sali.org/RUM0A3dwvk0A2dp3WHx.label: Dispositive Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/RUM0A3dwvk0A2dp3WHx.definition: Dispositive Motions are requests made by a party in a trial court seeking a final resolution of a case or a particular issue, such as a motion for summary judgment or a motion to dismiss.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUMWCvOxBQwmKCo5QSH.label: A116 Training
http://lmss.sali.org/RUMWCvOxBQwmKCo5QSH.definition: Training services provided by the law firm or legal vendor and billed as an hourly service. Typically technical or project training associated with eDiscovery.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUNLCn2Rg6sTs0a0jQP.label: Colleges, Universities, and Professional Schools Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RUNLCn2Rg6sTs0a0jQP.definition: Colleges, universities, and professional schools furnishing academic courses and granting academic degrees. The requirement for admission is at least a high school diploma or equivalent general academic training.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUONxLx7ihWUFSchVpQ.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Morgan County (7th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RUSb5QrMEDZ08KAseN2.label: No Assignment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RUSb5QrMEDZ08KAseN2.definition: A No Assignment Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from transferring their rights or obligations under the contract to a third party without the consent of the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUSp1dTDgTdSNrnzYeJ.label: X203 Patent and Trademark Prosecution Application Official Fees, Excluding Prosecution Post-Issuance and Opposition Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RUSp1dTDgTdSNrnzYeJ.definition: Any Patent and Trademark Prosecution official fees paid to governmental and quasi-governmental entities in order to obtain a patent or trademark, including those paid to Patent and Trademark Offices, the World Intellectual Property, Notaries, consulates, and embassies. Excludes post-issuance prosecution (X204) or opposition (X205) fees.
http://lmss.sali.org/RUSp1dTDgTdSNrnzYeJ.pref_label: X203 Patent and Trademark Prosecution Application Official Fees, Excluding Prosecution Post-Issuance and Opposition Fees

http://lmss.sali.org/RUTsQkj9wvpljBOY43M.label: ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/RUTsQkj9wvpljBOY43M.definition: An ADR Court-Annexed Arbitration Forum is a type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum that is attached to a court and provides a process for resolving disputes outside of the traditional court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUVt2zxRb01mmkyekoJ.label: M.Eng. (Master of Engineering)
http://lmss.sali.org/RUVt2zxRb01mmkyekoJ.definition: An M.Eng. (Master of Engineering) is a postgraduate degree focused on engineering studies, emphasizing technical and applied knowledge. It signifies advanced expertise in engineering principles and practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUWO4SzoPWpYF7vZ3XA.label: Medicare Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RUWO4SzoPWpYF7vZ3XA.definition: The intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to Medicare services or claims, with the aim of obtaining unauthorized benefits or payments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUWo4rTje8tmScJe3su.label: Florida Circuit Court - Dixie County - 3rd Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RUWo4rTje8tmScJe3su.definition: A court located in Dixie County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUa6dszEbFB6cvEQ7YJ.label: Design Patent Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RUa6dszEbFB6cvEQ7YJ.definition: A design patent registration document is a legal certificate issued by a patent office that grants the holder exclusive rights to a unique visual design of a functional item for a certain period. It includes details about the design's appearance, such as shape, pattern, or ornamentation, and protects against unauthorized copying or imitation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUcPPYzzCgp6UWVZFcR.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Fulton County (9th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RUclb4qgNeqT7BM6Xum.label: New York Court of General Sessions
http://lmss.sali.org/RUclb4qgNeqT7BM6Xum.definition: The New York Court of General Sessions is a court within the New York State Courts system that has jurisdiction over criminal cases and some civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUe8QeHNPxqLXKU67bE.label: Regulatory Filing Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RUe8QeHNPxqLXKU67bE.definition: A Regulatory Filing Event refers to a specific action or submission made to comply with regulations or requirements set forth by a governing authority. In the context of immigration, it could involve submitting applications, documents, or forms that adhere to the regulations and procedures established by immigration authorities for various immigration-related matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUgWyAVlkn9ysIUzCG1.label: Matter ID
http://lmss.sali.org/RUgWyAVlkn9ysIUzCG1.definition: Matter ID refers to a unique identifier assigned to a specific legal matter within an engagement for providing legal services. That matter identifier (e.g., IRIs, UUIDs, GUIDs) can be created and stored within the systems of various stakeholders (e.g., vendors, sellers, buyers, courts, regulators).

http://lmss.sali.org/RUhRF0bxk2nZewt5TXb.label: client segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RUhRF0bxk2nZewt5TXb.definition:
"Information on the Client(s) for whom bills are submitted by the Firm.  There will be 1 or more CLIENT segments per FIRM segment.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RUmONc5iSj1yZKjF900.label: Indiana Circuit Court - LaGrange County
http://lmss.sali.org/RUmONc5iSj1yZKjF900.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within LaGrange County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUobaus05ydHUoZmACf.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County
http://lmss.sali.org/RUobaus05ydHUoZmACf.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Osage County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Osage County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUpb2bykLxJnhab3xVG.label: Expert Opinion
http://lmss.sali.org/RUpb2bykLxJnhab3xVG.definition: A document reflecting a belief or judgment, as provided by an expert on the subject.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUrIiX9pApJERjw9wly.label: Muslim Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/RUrIiX9pApJERjw9wly.definition: The Muslim Religion, or Islam, is a monotheistic faith based on the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad as recorded in the Quran. In legal contexts, it often relates to the protection of religious freedoms, the accommodation of Islamic practices such as prayer and fasting, and the recognition of Islamic laws and principles in certain legal systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUuDWZLAZI7Rou9y32Z.label: New York Supreme Court - Rockland County
http://lmss.sali.org/RUuDWZLAZI7Rou9y32Z.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Rockland County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Rockland County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUvMOMCmbTp27AnZV1J.label: PA330 Design Application Preparation - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RUvMOMCmbTp27AnZV1J.definition: All actions associated with completing a design patent (but not utility or utility model) application or design registration application that are to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, and transmittals) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Note that government fees and external drafting expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUwbclRem903TXG34rJ.label: Motion for Appointment of Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/RUwbclRem903TXG34rJ.definition: A Motion for Appointment of Counsel is a formal request made to the court by a defendant or a party in a legal proceeding, asking the court to appoint an attorney to represent them in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUx3YyhyIjf894QZe0I.label: Cucumbers
http://lmss.sali.org/RUx3YyhyIjf894QZe0I.definition: Cucumbers are elongated, green fruit vegetables from the Cucumis sativus species, known for their crisp texture and refreshing taste. They are commonly consumed raw in salads, pickled, or used as a garnish, and are valued for their hydrating properties and low calorie content.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUyAKJyIAwIEovlayrf.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RUyAKJyIAwIEovlayrf.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Washington County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RUz5QyUsRrfB4wcSSaG.label: Local
http://lmss.sali.org/RUz5QyUsRrfB4wcSSaG.definition: Actor attribute designating locality (e.g., local counsel, local expert, local business contact).

http://lmss.sali.org/RUzewRE4oS6Wl4n_61L.label: X103 Copy Service (External)
http://lmss.sali.org/RUzewRE4oS6Wl4n_61L.definition: Any black & white or color copy, binding and reassembly charges when that service is performed by an external party and paid by the law firm or legal vendor

http://lmss.sali.org/RV0F8lGQrfK24XHFZSs.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case
http://lmss.sali.org/RV0F8lGQrfK24XHFZSs.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 11 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed bankruptcy case under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV0dq8QPEbNwUHpUhpw.label: Indiana Circuit Court - White County
http://lmss.sali.org/RV0dq8QPEbNwUHpUhpw.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - White County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Indiana that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within White County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV1sBg6qkfqNkfEqQ8F.label: Environmental Review Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RV1sBg6qkfqNkfEqQ8F.definition: An Environmental Review Claim is a legal action asserting that a project or action has not adequately complied with environmental impact assessment requirements mandated by law. Such claims typically allege insufficient analysis of potential environmental effects, failure to consider alternatives, or inadequate mitigation measures for identified impacts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV2ZQoSTHhim67C40O9.label: Claim for Falling on Commercial Sidewalk
http://lmss.sali.org/RV2ZQoSTHhim67C40O9.definition: A claim for falling on a commercial sidewalk is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injuries due to a slip-and-fall accident caused by the negligence of a commercial property owner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV45b8NoF16FFpjXgZY.label: Misdemeanor Manslaughter
http://lmss.sali.org/RV45b8NoF16FFpjXgZY.definition: Misdemeanor Manslaughter is a type of negligent manslaughter that occurs when a person commits a misdemeanor offense that results in the death of another person.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV4L5X2yX1m5QEAPC9Y.label: Middle Eastern / North African
http://lmss.sali.org/RV4L5X2yX1m5QEAPC9Y.definition: Middle Eastern / North African (MENA) is an ethnicity that refers to individuals who originate from or have ancestry in the regions of the Middle East and North Africa, which encompass countries such as Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Israel, Lebanon, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey, among others. This diverse group of people shares historical, cultural, linguistic, and religious ties, while also exhibiting distinct differences across the various nations and communities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV6DB7ikfBh1Se9GKkl.label: Crow Creek Sioux Tribe of the Crow Creek Reservation, South Dakota

http://lmss.sali.org/RV8ATKVyGWueW8Gl7jH.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Clarion County
http://lmss.sali.org/RV8ATKVyGWueW8Gl7jH.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Clarion County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RV8T-TUTtS9-kr1RXT4.label: X110 Conference Call/Video Call/Webinar Charges
http://lmss.sali.org/RV8T-TUTtS9-kr1RXT4.definition: Multi party communication whether by telephone, video or external

http://lmss.sali.org/RV8mJWGZnQhe2gDARKv.label: Winner-Take-All - Multi-Winner System
http://lmss.sali.org/RV8mJWGZnQhe2gDARKv.definition: A winner-take-all multi-winner system is an electoral method where multiple candidates are elected from a single district, and the candidates with the highest number of votes win the available seats. This system can lead to one party or group dominating the representation, often marginalizing minority party voters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVACuOK3kyHPHbuGCIP.label: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/RVACuOK3kyHPHbuGCIP.definition: Probate Reason of Substance Abuse refers to the legal grounds for filing a subsequent probate case due to the decedent's substance abuse issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVD4ZmefjRAqkzGhLFq.label: PA710 Opinion Preparation
http://lmss.sali.org/RVD4ZmefjRAqkzGhLFq.definition: All action associated with the completing formal legal opinions on the validity, enforceability, infringement, and/or non-infringement of a patent claim. Includes opinions on infringement of a client's patent by a non-client infringer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVG1zLys64KOCQFR2Mh.label: European Union
http://lmss.sali.org/RVG1zLys64KOCQFR2Mh.definition: The European Union (EU) Government is a permanent or semi-permanent administrative entity of the European Union that oversees and administers specific governmental functions within the EU.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVHae1yV9vZnwi9C1SU.label: Customer Lifetime Value
http://lmss.sali.org/RVHae1yV9vZnwi9C1SU.definition: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) is a metric that represents the total net profit a company expects to earn from a customer throughout their entire relationship. It is calculated by multiplying the average value of a customer transaction by the number of repeat transactions and the average retention time in a specific period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVIYQNBMB0MGLfA80mW.label: Inuktitut
http://lmss.sali.org/RVIYQNBMB0MGLfA80mW.definition: A language spoken by the Inuit people in Canada and parts of Greenland, characterized by a complex system of inflection and agglutination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVIiXA1507iI23MP579.label: Sign On Bonus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RVIiXA1507iI23MP579.definition: A sign-on bonus clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions of a bonus payment made to an employee upon joining a company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVKj4pw4RpRSJCBRSnP.label: Anti-Bribery Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RVKj4pw4RpRSJCBRSnP.definition: An Anti-Bribery Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits the offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting of any form of bribe or kickback in connection with the performance of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVLgJukt9MTZNfTewtx.label: M&A Practice Components
http://lmss.sali.org/RVLgJukt9MTZNfTewtx.definition: M&A Practice Components refers to the specific tasks and activities involved in the process of mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, drafting and negotiating agreements, regulatory compliance, financing, and post-closing matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVLnDjXxMQLiYj_P1mF.label: X402 Transaction Fee
http://lmss.sali.org/RVLnDjXxMQLiYj_P1mF.definition: Delivery of information on a transaction basis as opposed to a per user license fee or a subscription fee. Indicate # of transactions as units; if pricing varies by transaction, split into multiple expense lines by rate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVLx2dVu1mCR6g3MCbf.label: Immigrant Visa for Professionals Holding Advanced Degrees and Persons of Exceptional Ability
http://lmss.sali.org/RVLx2dVu1mCR6g3MCbf.definition: An "Immigrant Visa for Professionals Holding Advanced Degrees and Persons of Exceptional Ability" provides permanent residency to individuals who possess either an advanced degree or exceptional ability in specific fields. This visa targets professionals whose skills contribute significantly to national interests, including those who qualify under the National Interest Waiver.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVOc1zKdFtj7aZLlJME.label: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County
http://lmss.sali.org/RVOc1zKdFtj7aZLlJME.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pipestone County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pipestone County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVPwUkNgWhlwyYWWSPr.label: Legal System Types
http://lmss.sali.org/RVPwUkNgWhlwyYWWSPr.definition: Legal System Types refer to the various frameworks of laws, rules, and institutions that govern the legal processes and procedures within a jurisdiction. These systems encompass distinct traditions, principles, and methodologies that have evolved over time, influenced by cultural, religious, and historical factors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVRrqw2QfVD6UcPQLUM.label: Permanent Resident
http://lmss.sali.org/RVRrqw2QfVD6UcPQLUM.definition: A Permanent Resident is an individual who has been granted the right to live indefinitely within a country, typically after meeting certain eligibility criteria. In the United States, for example, this status is commonly referred to as having a "Green Card," and it grants the holder various rights and responsibilities, including the ability to work and reside in the country long-term, but does not confer citizenship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVYBDQv9HD2DkAuvbf5.label: Immigration Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RVYBDQv9HD2DkAuvbf5.definition: National statutes, and regulations governing immigration into and deportation from a country including issues of naturalization and citizenship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVYE8m0kOdcthY0Q7Nz.label: Marathi
http://lmss.sali.org/RVYE8m0kOdcthY0Q7Nz.definition: Marathi is a structured system of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, which is a subcategory of the Language class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVYssk48JQ3Ouv98v8U.label: Privacy Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/RVYssk48JQ3Ouv98v8U.definition: A Privacy Related Agreement refers to a contract or clause that stipulates how personal data will be processed, protected, and maintained. It underscores the obligations of parties in relation to data privacy and compliance with privacy laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVZJBUCRB7cgWN1CIbe.label: Fact Investigation and Development
http://lmss.sali.org/RVZJBUCRB7cgWN1CIbe.definition: Fact Investigation and Development refers to the process of gathering and analyzing evidence and information related to a legal matter, including interviewing witnesses and experts, analyzing technical data, and assessing the validity of claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVaHiNBU68DENmeHicn.label: Copyright Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RVaHiNBU68DENmeHicn.definition: Copyright assets are a type of intellectual property asset that refers to the exclusive legal right to use and distribute original works of authorship, such as books, music, and software.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVb21uLogD0tHfUUQ8K.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1
http://lmss.sali.org/RVb21uLogD0tHfUUQ8K.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 1 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over cases in Monroe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVbr7id7xk8cwbPPGi6.label: Leading Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RVbr7id7xk8cwbPPGi6.definition: An objection to a leading question is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that a question posed by the opposing counsel improperly suggests an answer to the witness. Leading questions are generally not allowed during direct examination but may be permitted during cross-examination.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVcKXB7NRBykY3TIXPp.label: Military Active Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/RVcKXB7NRBykY3TIXPp.definition: "Military Active Duty" refers to a period during which individuals in the armed forces are in full-time service, actively engaged in their duties, and can be deployed at any time. This status contrasts with reserve or part-time duties and involves more direct involvement in military operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVcQsyiR3zEN86uQG2O.label: Affirmative Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/RVcQsyiR3zEN86uQG2O.definition: An affirmative covenant is a legally binding promise made by one party to another to take specific actions or refrain from certain activities, as outlined in a contract or agreement, in order to fulfill a particular obligation or achieve a specific goal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVd315wFUPDWLD0jxW0.label: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort
http://lmss.sali.org/RVd315wFUPDWLD0jxW0.definition: Indemnification from Person Ordering Tort: A legal concept that refers to the compensation or protection provided to a party who is held liable for a tortious act, but is entitled to be reimbursed by the person who ordered or directed the act.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVd5x2Wxn3QTD6v05fP.label: General Discharge Under Honorable Conditions
http://lmss.sali.org/RVd5x2Wxn3QTD6v05fP.definition: Often referred to simply as a General Discharge, this type indicates satisfactory service but the individual fell short of meeting all expectations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVepUKz5GeHoBckLITW.label: Analysis of Cash Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RVepUKz5GeHoBckLITW.definition: Analysis of Cash Management: A process of examining and evaluating the flow and use of cash within an organization, including the identification of areas for improvement and the development of strategies to optimize cash management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVigIsxb77jdaMmSGZ3.label: Georgia District Court - Worth County
http://lmss.sali.org/RVigIsxb77jdaMmSGZ3.definition: Georgia District Court - Worth County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Worth County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVjXsbn73egfflZ0Tt2.label: Law Codified by Statute
http://lmss.sali.org/RVjXsbn73egfflZ0Tt2.definition: Law Codified by Statute refers to legal rules and regulations that have been enacted by a legislative body and are binding and enforceable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVmjCRgjA2bEt3UKK0Z.label: Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy
http://lmss.sali.org/RVmjCRgjA2bEt3UKK0Z.definition: The Failure to Exhaust Administrative Remedy is a legal defense in civil litigation where the plaintiff has not completed all required administrative procedures before filing a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVn3lZhV5O5EjbLVLKO.label: Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit
http://lmss.sali.org/RVn3lZhV5O5EjbLVLKO.definition: An Insurance Carrier Supplying Defense of Suit is an insurance claim concept that refers to the situation where an insurance company provides legal defense to its policyholder in a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVoruROtalNTiniXRiH.label: War Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RVoruROtalNTiniXRiH.definition: A War Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a particular action or law exceeds the constitutional authority granted to the government in times of war. This claim is based on the interpretation that the War Clause, which grants Congress the power to declare war, also imposes limitations on the government's actions during war, such as the exercise of certain powers or the infringement of individual rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVoyN9hN3m5gy3So01Z.label: Debt Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RVoyN9hN3m5gy3So01Z.definition: A Debt Agreement is a legally binding contract between a debtor and creditor(s) that outlines the terms and conditions for repayment of a debt, including any interest or fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVqw56uVNOkyhXBm2PR.label: Successor in Interest Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/RVqw56uVNOkyhXBm2PR.definition: The I-140 Successor in Interest Petition is a process in the United States through which a new employer or entity assumes the sponsorship of an employment-based immigrant visa (green card) petition that was previously filed by a predecessor employer. This is relevant when the original petitioner goes out of business or undergoes a merger, acquisition, or other organizational change. The new employer or entity can file a Successor in Interest Petition to continue the green card process for the beneficiary (foreign worker) without starting the process anew, provided certain conditions are met.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVrGUsz9mLtn4m0umUx.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Clinton County (4th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RVs5lqs-PTb-gR1loCq.label: B410 General Bankruptcy Advice/Opinions
http://lmss.sali.org/RVs5lqs-PTb-gR1loCq.definition: Analysis, advice and/or opinions regarding potential bankruptcy related issues, where no bankruptcy case has been filed

http://lmss.sali.org/RVu433XojPQPseoDXhi.label: Population Density Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RVu433XojPQPseoDXhi.definition: The population density market segment classifies consumers or businesses based on the density of people in their geographic area, such as urban, rural, or suburban regions. This segmentation helps businesses understand and address the varying needs, preferences, and purchasing behaviors of customers living in areas with different levels of population concentration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVu6AgZO4SQGptuNzFn.label: B140 Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings
http://lmss.sali.org/RVu6AgZO4SQGptuNzFn.definition: Matters relating to termination or continuation of automatic stay under 362 and motions for adequate protection
http://lmss.sali.org/RVu6AgZO4SQGptuNzFn.pref_label: B140 Relief from Stay/Adequate Protection Proceedings

http://lmss.sali.org/RVuAyQj50pIz8jDPu5j.label: Visa for Free Trade Agreement Professionals
http://lmss.sali.org/RVuAyQj50pIz8jDPu5j.definition: A Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Professionals Visa is a type of visa that allows citizens of countries that have signed a free trade agreement with a particular country to work in that country under specific conditions. These visas often facilitate the movement of professionals such as businesspeople, traders, and certain skilled workers, aiming to promote economic cooperation and trade between the countries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVuDnK7AiYmwBIiwrvk.label: Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product
http://lmss.sali.org/RVuDnK7AiYmwBIiwrvk.definition: The concept of "Product Misuse or Use Beyond Scope of Product" refers to a defense in product liability cases where the defendant argues that the plaintiff's injury was caused by using the product in a way that was not intended or foreseeable by the manufacturer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVubKvyXsZmbXfGzkCV.label: Vaccine Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RVubKvyXsZmbXfGzkCV.definition: Failure to provide proper care or attention in administering vaccines, resulting in harm or injury to the patient, and the legal claims that arise from such negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVv0k98jG6bWDGZeERS.label: Status - Denied
http://lmss.sali.org/RVv0k98jG6bWDGZeERS.definition: Status of "Denied" indicates that an application, request, or action has been reviewed and declined by the relevant authority, signaling that the individual's request or application did not meet the necessary criteria or legal requirements, resulting in a denial of the intended action, status change, or benefit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVvp2JPNslacBG1RX4C.label: Request for Budget
http://lmss.sali.org/RVvp2JPNslacBG1RX4C.definition: Document where a Buyer asks a Legal Services Provider for a budget.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVwRWXtHikrVmnlD5rX.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RVwRWXtHikrVmnlD5rX.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 12 Claim is a type of claim made in a bankruptcy case filed under Chapter 12 of the Bankruptcy Code, which provides relief to family farmers or fishermen.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVx9guOHg7qUQmnVpHt.label: Service of Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RVx9guOHg7qUQmnVpHt.definition: The concept of "Service of Document" refers to the act of delivering legal documents to the parties involved in a litigation event.

http://lmss.sali.org/RVy4vloCiTC20a0-Ukt.label: B185 Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts
http://lmss.sali.org/RVy4vloCiTC20a0-Ukt.definition: Analysis of leases and executory contracts and preparation of motions specifically to assume or reject
http://lmss.sali.org/RVy4vloCiTC20a0-Ukt.pref_label: B185 Assumption/Rejection of Leases and Contracts

http://lmss.sali.org/RVzVYYsHCLbINZp94ZW.label: Tax Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RVzVYYsHCLbINZp94ZW.definition: A Tax Form is a standardized document used to report financial information to taxation authorities. It is the primary means for individuals and organizations to file tax returns, claim deductions, and comply with tax laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW06GROiybG7iqcJsak.label: Indemnification Provisions Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RW06GROiybG7iqcJsak.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate the other for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the contract, typically related to legal claims or liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW4e3hHh2LWHKBUhsLZ.label: By Time with Blended Rate
http://lmss.sali.org/RW4e3hHh2LWHKBUhsLZ.definition: Engagement fee model where a client pays for the legal service provider's number of expended hours, but rather than paying for a person's individualized rate (e.g., partner's higher rate, associate's lower rate), the provider pays an average billable rate — regardless of which lawyer performs the work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW4mSymHgCQUaRsE9qZ.label: disc_cred
http://lmss.sali.org/RW4mSymHgCQUaRsE9qZ.definition:
"The disc_credit field is used to track discounts and credits that the law firm may need to submit on the expense item.

EIA - Expense Item Adjustment - A flat adjustment (reduction or credit) applied to the fee item
EID - Expense Item Discount - client receives a percentage discount that is assessed at the expense item level
EIDHR - Expense Item Discounted Hourly Rate - the discounted hourly rate or unit rate applied to the expense item
EIFF - Expense Item is billed at a Flat Fee
Other - Any other type of discount of credit applied to the line item
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RW5myKZOaxNl6EtRtjl.label: Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor
http://lmss.sali.org/RW5myKZOaxNl6EtRtjl.definition: The concept of "Undue Influence Over Testator or Settlor" refers to the situation where someone exerts pressure or control over a person creating a trust or will, causing them to make decisions that they would not have made otherwise.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW6LrybdH8vy8EeskNZ.label: Robust AI
http://lmss.sali.org/RW6LrybdH8vy8EeskNZ.definition: Robust AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that are both technically and socially resilient, designed to prevent unintentional harm. Technically robust AI systems are built to handle diverse conditions and adversarial attacks, while socially robust AI systems are designed to function ethically within societal contexts, ensuring safety, reliability, and fairness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW6nX4aKqrx1jH86Azc.label: Health Insurance Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/RW6nX4aKqrx1jH86Azc.definition: Health insurance benefits refer to any medical coverage provided to employees as part of their compensation package, which pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured, often including preventive care and prescription medication.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW7P6EPg4NMe8dhyO52.label: Budgeting Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RW7P6EPg4NMe8dhyO52.definition: Budgeting Management refers to the process of planning and controlling the financial resources of a business or organization within the legal industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW86HuZD6w8Ia2M8FaB.label: Intervening Event - Known at Signing
http://lmss.sali.org/RW86HuZD6w8Ia2M8FaB.definition: An Intervening Event - Known at Signing is a specific type of event that occurs after the signing of a legal agreement and has been anticipated by the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW948YsVlH1YKDiRZ2e.label: Collaboration Platform Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RW948YsVlH1YKDiRZ2e.definition: Collaboration Platform Management refers to the management of a system or software that enables individuals or groups to work together on a project or task, including the coordination of communication, data sharing, and workflow.

http://lmss.sali.org/RW9FnieEgcOjplA0pwC.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Gallatin County (2nd Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RWBJWyGRVpzzWPJzkMQ.label: Cornish
http://lmss.sali.org/RWBJWyGRVpzzWPJzkMQ.definition: Cornish (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a member of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWCGOVQ05YswHiy7g3l.label: Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RWCGOVQ05YswHiy7g3l.definition: A Motion to Stay Proceedings Pending Appeal is a request made to a court to pause legal proceedings until an appeal is resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWEp6MxDNXmmOv5sA1G.label: Arkansas District Court - Garland Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RWEp6MxDNXmmOv5sA1G.definition: A court located in Garland County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWGactOKvTU2NUvBOMh.label: PA560 Validation Patent Application Preparation - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RWGactOKvTU2NUvBOMh.definition: All actions associated with the preparation and filing of applications for validation of an issued regional patent outside of the ('domestic') home country of the applicant. Note that PCT National Phase Entry is a continuing application process included under PA350 or PA550.
http://lmss.sali.org/RWGactOKvTU2NUvBOMh.pref_label: PA560 Validation Patent Application Preparation - International

http://lmss.sali.org/RWI3FSZADDKSQNARn0I.label: Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/RWI3FSZADDKSQNARn0I.definition: U.S. federal courts' body of procedural rules governing appeals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWIHny9UXFuBj5mDBhG.label: Three-fifths Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RWIHny9UXFuBj5mDBhG.definition: A Three-fifths Clause claim is a legal assertion tied to Article I, Section 2, Clause 3 of the U.S. Constitution, historically known as the Three-fifths Clause. This clause counted enslaved individuals as three-fifths of a person for purposes of representation and taxation, but it was effectively rendered obsolete by the Thirteenth Amendment, which abolished slavery.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWKIphtLSAmBsHlh8PV.label: Key Employee Incentive Program Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RWKIphtLSAmBsHlh8PV.definition: A Key Employee Incentive Program Motion (KEIP) is a request made in a bankruptcy case to provide incentives to key employees to remain with the company during the bankruptcy process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWLKWLYuVzXk91nvlM2.label: Threatened Battery Assault
http://lmss.sali.org/RWLKWLYuVzXk91nvlM2.definition: The concept of Threatened Battery Assault refers to a criminal assault where the perpetrator intentionally causes the victim to fear immediate bodily harm or offensive contact, without actually making physical contact.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWMC7hld3nTKhi7NQaw.label: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County
http://lmss.sali.org/RWMC7hld3nTKhi7NQaw.definition: Indiana Superior Court - Porter County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Porter County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWN8gXg8mMconiOdy9r.label: Ohio Court of Common Pleas
http://lmss.sali.org/RWN8gXg8mMconiOdy9r.definition: The Ohio Court of Common Pleas is a specific court within the Ohio State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases at the county level.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWNAwJemBq0gDs7LXfC.label: Common Carrier Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RWNAwJemBq0gDs7LXfC.definition: Common Carrier Liability refers to the legal responsibility of transportation companies, such as railroads, trucking companies, and cruise ships, to ensure the safety of their passengers and cargo while in transit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWNHtgqXOWSnS2m1dFK.label: Tax Payment Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RWNHtgqXOWSnS2m1dFK.definition: A tax payment event refers to the specific occasion when an individual or entity remits payment to a tax authority to settle or reduce a tax liability.
sources: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

http://lmss.sali.org/RWNZbjN1XUktd64HAkF.label: Docketing Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RWNZbjN1XUktd64HAkF.definition: Docketing Management refers to the process of managing and tracking legal cases and their associated deadlines and events. It falls under the broader category of Litigation Management, which encompasses all aspects of managing a legal case from start to finish.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWO631rpp13LcEogAg3.label: Private-run Pension Account
http://lmss.sali.org/RWO631rpp13LcEogAg3.definition: A private-run pension account is a retirement savings account managed by a private financial institution, such as a bank or investment firm. These accounts are typically funded by individual contributions and can offer various investment options.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWQ1VzFGkwqQcJsOtiy.label: Undetermined
http://lmss.sali.org/RWQ1VzFGkwqQcJsOtiy.definition: A language that has not been identified or determined in the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWQDIVGfiJTqMGzauv1.label: Georgia Superior Court - Banks County
http://lmss.sali.org/RWQDIVGfiJTqMGzauv1.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Banks County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Banks County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWQJp6eT8pE6nx0CIBf.label: Query
http://lmss.sali.org/RWQJp6eT8pE6nx0CIBf.definition: An LMSS Query - A document fragment that can be used as a query against a database

http://lmss.sali.org/RWQW185M6gqosVVQA1G.label: Arbitration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RWQW185M6gqosVVQA1G.definition: An arbitration clause is a provision in a contract that requires any disputes arising from the contract to be resolved through arbitration rather than through the court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWS7oVs9s2563KGt41L.label: Equitable Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RWS7oVs9s2563KGt41L.definition: A claim that seeks fairness and justice, rather than a legal remedy, and is based on principles of equity and conscience.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWTtXwQzuQiiY2QFdTs.label: X403 Hardware Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RWTtXwQzuQiiY2QFdTs.definition: Any hardware purchased, including cell phones/PDAs/Blackberries; desktops/laptops/tablets; DVD/CD Drives; external hard drives; servers; USB drives or future technology hardware device. Excludes material costs for electronic media devices used to move a data collection in eDiscovery (X307).

http://lmss.sali.org/RWW9nr4E8H7aqmwxXKY.label: Indiana Superior Court - Putnam County
http://lmss.sali.org/RWW9nr4E8H7aqmwxXKY.definition: A court located in Putnam County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWY8na2AqBFimdTjpmn.label: Drafting Drafting Notes
http://lmss.sali.org/RWY8na2AqBFimdTjpmn.definition: Drafting Notes are annotations made by writers and editors during the document drafting process. These notes often include comments, suggestions, and explanations to aid in the development and refinement of the document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWYR2MYY5JsW5YkzH1k.label: Chronic Soft Tissue Surgical Intervention
http://lmss.sali.org/RWYR2MYY5JsW5YkzH1k.definition: A soft tissue injury or abnormality under continuing surgical management involves damage or dysfunction affecting non-bone structures such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, or skin that requires ongoing surgical intervention. This management is aimed at repairing or reconstructing the damaged soft tissues and addressing any related complications or functional impairments.
http://lmss.sali.org/RWYR2MYY5JsW5YkzH1k.pref_label: Soft Tissue Injury or Abnormality Under Continuing Surgical Management

http://lmss.sali.org/RWYcSQUDAGyvW8SbysB.label: Double Trigger Acceleration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RWYcSQUDAGyvW8SbysB.definition: A Double Trigger Acceleration Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the acceleration of vesting or payment of compensation upon the occurrence of two specified events, such as a change in control of a company and termination of employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWaLpBF5pSZ-1t10mNn.label: PA540 Plant Patent Preparation - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RWaLpBF5pSZ-1t10mNn.definition: All actions associated with completing plant patent applications that are to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, including translations, review of any invention disclosure materials or parent applications, drafting of application including pre-filing revision of parent applications, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client Note that government fees and other external expenses are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWb1ilIw9ru5NEHVikY.label: Avoidance Action Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RWb1ilIw9ru5NEHVikY.definition: Avoidance Action Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice area, which involves pursuing actions to recover assets or payments made by a debtor prior to filing for bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWbPAh7ECyzOSOedIWC.label: Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference
http://lmss.sali.org/RWbPAh7ECyzOSOedIWC.definition: A Motion to Postpone Settlement Conference is a request made by one party in a legal case to delay the scheduled settlement conference to a later date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWcN8kYNVo5CHwUvVK8.label: Florida Circuit Court - Collier County - 20th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RWcN8kYNVo5CHwUvVK8.definition: A court located in Collier County, Florida that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWfJ7MkBNT8Rm9SUxAP.label: Disclosure Letter Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RWfJ7MkBNT8Rm9SUxAP.definition: A Disclosure Letter Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires one party to provide the other party with a letter disclosing certain information related to the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWfagTf41k5BuDMRrHd.label: Medical Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RWfagTf41k5BuDMRrHd.definition: A person who holds a health care professional degree from a university or college, who has engaged in the practice of that profession, and who has knowledge or skill about the subject upon which he is called to testify or provide an opinion. See Fla. Stat. § 766.202(5); Fort Walton Beach Medical Center, Inc. v. Dingler, 697 So.2d 575 (Fla. App. 1997).

http://lmss.sali.org/RWgCqlNHf4u64L3sIGJ.label: Church Slavic; Old Slavonic; Church Slavonic; Old Bulgarian; Old Church Slavonic

http://lmss.sali.org/RWlWc2fE5xP32fuVJcD.definition: A Motion to Amend Schedules is a formal request made in bankruptcy proceedings by a debtor seeking to modify previously filed schedules of assets, liabilities, income, expenses, or other financial statements. This motion is typically necessary when new information becomes available or errors are discovered in the original filings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWrcINuspgUzc0EOUVr.definition: Konkani is a written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is a specific language within the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWrtAe5CMLI7fbH42S6.definition: A Microsoft Excel spreadsheet file from Microsoft Office 2003 or earlier.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWsi8ZKlV5vySWFsf0K.label: Intestinal Failure
http://lmss.sali.org/RWsi8ZKlV5vySWFsf0K.definition: Intestinal failure is a condition where the intestines are unable to absorb sufficient nutrients and fluids to maintain health, often due to severe functional or structural abnormalities. This condition can result from diseases or surgical interventions that significantly impair the digestive tract's ability to process and absorb essential nutrients, requiring interventions such as total parenteral nutrition (TPN) or enteral nutrition support.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWtKj3lDFQbBIBiS1CI.label: Waiver and Release Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RWtKj3lDFQbBIBiS1CI.definition: A waiver and release clause is a provision in a contract that releases a party from liability for certain actions or events, and waives the right to pursue legal action related to those actions or events.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWuvLsuFkQUB1cyfBVe.label: Proper Cause Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RWuvLsuFkQUB1cyfBVe.definition: A Proper Cause Clause is a specific type of clause found within a contractual agreement that outlines the acceptable reasons for terminating the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWvgM9yTRAokhCdqUfl.label: oasis:Roles
http://lmss.sali.org/RWvgM9yTRAokhCdqUfl.definition: A group or set of responsibilities or functions assigned to a person or entity within the context of the OASIS Collection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWwZkkSpjTtW19tzDq6.label: E114 Witness fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RWwZkkSpjTtW19tzDq6.definition: A witness fee is a type of expense incurred in legal proceedings, specifically referring to the compensation paid to a person who testifies as a witness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWwpJSTVYRnmRU2qfiP.label: Motion to Determine Final Cure and Mortgage Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RWwpJSTVYRnmRU2qfiP.definition: A Motion to Determine Final Cure and Mortgage Payment is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to determine the final amount needed to pay off a mortgage and bring it current.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWyivPLyBOY3TzWAIEc.label: Quasi-Contract Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RWyivPLyBOY3TzWAIEc.definition: A quasi-contract claim is a legal claim that arises when one party receives a benefit from another party, even though there was no actual contract between them, and the law implies a promise to pay for that benefit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWyyjFeGJPSetUwHMyC.label: Quarterly Report
http://lmss.sali.org/RWyyjFeGJPSetUwHMyC.definition: A Quarterly Report is a financial report issued by a company every three months to provide an update on its earnings, expenses, and net income. It is required by securities regulators and is aimed at investors and analysts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RWzW0Ull1BsiWxpJOvy.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bartow County
http://lmss.sali.org/RWzW0Ull1BsiWxpJOvy.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Bartow County, Georgia, with authority over civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RX1CNAXsKKxbwc9dtMo.label: M&A G Shareholder / Board Matters Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RX1CNAXsKKxbwc9dtMo.definition: A legal practice area that deals with matters related to shareholders and the board of directors in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RX4IL0dBTdT6NybOqie.label: Overtime Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RX4IL0dBTdT6NybOqie.definition: An overtime violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not properly compensating them for overtime work. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable federal, state, or local overtime laws, which require employers to pay eligible employees at a higher rate for any hours worked beyond a certain number per week or per day. The claim can include allegations of employers failing to pay the required overtime rate, miscalculating the employee's overtime pay, or not properly tracking the employee's overtime hours.

http://lmss.sali.org/RX4QtTsK3lPhoabmq1b.label: Estimated, Budgeted, and Actual Engagement Variables
http://lmss.sali.org/RX4QtTsK3lPhoabmq1b.definition: Quantitative amounts used to create and monitor budgets

http://lmss.sali.org/RX6zJERPeREKdgekJR5.label: C400 Third Party Communication
http://lmss.sali.org/RX6zJERPeREKdgekJR5.definition: This phase includes all discussions with third parties not otherwise covered above, such as communications with regulators or parties to contracts with the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RX7LMEGauSHvxLoGPjI.label: New Jersey Prerogative Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RX7LMEGauSHvxLoGPjI.definition: A New Jersey Prerogative Court is a specialized court within the New Jersey State Courts system that has jurisdiction over appeals of administrative agency decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RX8z2hQDK9CGK8WapNE.label: Buying Stolen Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RX8z2hQDK9CGK8WapNE.definition: The act of purchasing property that has been unlawfully taken, with knowledge of its illegal origin.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXACUSnhIUR8d5HQo41.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Lea County
http://lmss.sali.org/RXACUSnhIUR8d5HQo41.definition: A court located in Lea County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXAOdy7NJAxWjMtDJP9.label: Due Diligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RXAOdy7NJAxWjMtDJP9.definition: Due Diligence is the process of conducting a thorough investigation and analysis of a company or business before a merger or acquisition takes place.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXCe0DzCxhUZaUndsmA.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Hendricks County
http://lmss.sali.org/RXCe0DzCxhUZaUndsmA.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Hendricks County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXDxuYOR20sbhobsDjI.label: Venue Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RXDxuYOR20sbhobsDjI.definition: A Venue Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the location or jurisdiction where any legal disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXEKEEEApoXTYB4DbjU.label: Mediation Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RXEKEEEApoXTYB4DbjU.definition: A Mediation Event is a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Event that involves a neutral third party facilitating communication and negotiation between parties in conflict, with the goal of reaching a mutually acceptable resolution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXGV6ePwodxQFisKH9U.label: Kalmyk; Oirat
http://lmss.sali.org/RXGV6ePwodxQFisKH9U.definition: A language spoken by the Kalmyk people, a Mongolic ethnic group, and the Oirat people, a group of Mongolian and Turkic peoples.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXGznUd2OUQDT1pNurq.label: Waiver of Service of Summons
http://lmss.sali.org/RXGznUd2OUQDT1pNurq.definition: A waiver of service of summons is a legal document that allows a defendant to waive their right to be formally served with a summons and complaint, thereby expediting the legal process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXHQZK42pRQWHk3hrKf.label: L619 Quality assurance and control
http://lmss.sali.org/RXHQZK42pRQWHk3hrKf.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXJQyrWA3QzSp_h9wcZ.label: A127 Project Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RXJQyrWA3QzSp_h9wcZ.definition: Discovery or eDiscovery project management services, including budgeting and case assessment of the project and quality assurance and control. Excludes legal project management of a matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXLAGe4FhY6gwdxiXOP.label: Litigation Finance Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RXLAGe4FhY6gwdxiXOP.definition: Litigation finance management refers to the process of managing the financial aspects of a legal case, including funding, budgeting, and accounting, in order to maximize the potential return on investment for the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXMzFFnblmTeTdQl8R3.label: inv_due_date

"

http://lmss.sali.org/RXNDomJj6civMNyyCWU.label: Part-Time Employee
http://lmss.sali.org/RXNDomJj6civMNyyCWU.definition: A Part-Time Employee is an individual who works fewer hours per week than what is considered full-time by their employer or by labor laws. While part-time employees may have more flexible schedules, they often have limited or no access to benefits like health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXO2u2WBkUUcEG1jczL.label: Arbitration Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RXO2u2WBkUUcEG1jczL.definition: Arbitration, a form of alternative dispute resolution (ADR), is a way to resolve disputes outside the courts. The dispute will be decided by one or more persons (the "arbitrators", "arbiters" or "arbitral tribunal"), which renders the "arbitration award".

http://lmss.sali.org/RXOdr5IztYezpYhJ58W.label: Dissolution for Oppression
http://lmss.sali.org/RXOdr5IztYezpYhJ58W.definition: The concept of "Dissolution for Oppression" refers to a legal claim made by shareholders or partners against a corporation or partnership alleging that the majority shareholders or partners have acted oppressively towards the minority, resulting in the dissolution of the entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXQTeOHq3J1THe0R0ch.label: Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Deliberations
http://lmss.sali.org/RXQTeOHq3J1THe0R0ch.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Improper Jury Deliberations is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to set aside the verdict and order a new trial due to improper conduct during jury deliberations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXQnkHW0j2QdRb0IfFC.label: Approval Signatures Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RXQnkHW0j2QdRb0IfFC.definition: An Approval Signatures Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to sign and approve the agreement in order for it to be legally binding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXSQ7cfAYqk20qAg9n2.label: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RXSQ7cfAYqk20qAg9n2.definition: Bankruptcy and Restructuring Objectives refer to the specific aims, goals, plans, and intentions that are constructed by a party in a legal matter related to bankruptcy and restructuring, including the protection of property from damage, rebuttal of presumption of undue hardship, and avoidance action claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXSTGSDxWOEtAveyXQu.label: Child Dependency Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RXSTGSDxWOEtAveyXQu.definition: Child Dependency Court refers to a specialized court that deals with cases involving children who have been removed from their homes due to abuse or neglect, and determines their custody and care arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXTVFyja2dLSk6WhA4X.label: Romany
http://lmss.sali.org/RXTVFyja2dLSk6WhA4X.definition: Romany (Language) is a structured system of communication used by the Romani people, consisting of grammar and vocabulary specific to their culture and traditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXUBSz3yoeVHJivezes.label: Originating Country
http://lmss.sali.org/RXUBSz3yoeVHJivezes.definition: Destination Country, in the context of immigration, refers to the country to which an individual is moving or has moved, with the intention of residing there either temporarily or permanently. The destination country's immigration laws and policies determine eligibility for entry, length of stay, and other rights or obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXUZLFDt5AEWdeJTvjC.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Grady County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXUksQm2NIuuXlTt8Kw.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Monroe County Circuit 8 is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Monroe County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXWEf3lGBrgauuX6Jz9.definition: A collection of documents or resources related to time, as defined by the OASIS organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXWF0lWxYTqOJzmV5T5.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories). Primarily charges on a per GB, per custodian. or a flat/fixed fee basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXXpBE98TBttHxMYU6T.label: Capitalized Terms Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RXXpBE98TBttHxMYU6T.definition: A Capitalized Terms Clause is a specific clause within a contract that identifies and defines capitalized terms used throughout the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXYs8ARlSsDYANh0mkR.label: Knowledge Management Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RXYs8ARlSsDYANh0mkR.definition: Knowledge Management Services refers to professional services that involve the strategic management of an organization's knowledge resources, including the creation, sharing, and utilization of knowledge assets, and are provided by consultants or managers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXbt7cdUEMfV7rYcvAY.label: Motion to Certify Appealability
http://lmss.sali.org/RXbt7cdUEMfV7rYcvAY.definition: A Motion to Certify Appealability is a formal request made to an appellate court to determine whether an appeal can be pursued, typically in cases where the lower court has denied the appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXeHqH3kjWyPOUS0Ur8.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Potter County
http://lmss.sali.org/RXeHqH3kjWyPOUS0Ur8.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Potter County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXfDG78SSnJOuZPWGq2.label: Exhaustion of Remedies
http://lmss.sali.org/RXfDG78SSnJOuZPWGq2.definition: Exhaustion of remedies refers to the legal principle that a litigant must have pursued and used up all available administrative or legal remedies before seeking judicial review. This requirement ensures that the appropriate administrative or lower court authority has had the opportunity to correct its own errors before higher-level intervention is sought

http://lmss.sali.org/RXfXLGRPEBYVhCPvNyO.label: New York City Court - Mt. Vernon
http://lmss.sali.org/RXfXLGRPEBYVhCPvNyO.definition: A court located in Mt. Vernon, New York that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXglkHnO0P9PdVdDRHi.label: Workers Compensation Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RXglkHnO0P9PdVdDRHi.definition: Law addressing wage replacement and medical benefits to employees injured in the course of employment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXhRW62NYQ5imtM7qjD.label: Homeowners Association Forclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/RXhRW62NYQ5imtM7qjD.definition: Homeowners Association Foreclosure is the legal process by which a Homeowners Association (HOA) takes possession of a property within its jurisdiction due to the homeowner's failure to pay association fees or fines. The property is subsequently sold to satisfy the outstanding debt, and the process is governed by state laws and the HOA's governing documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXizJApS5kWwMAN5ASY.label: Turnkey Project Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RXizJApS5kWwMAN5ASY.definition: A turnkey project clause is a provision in a contract that requires the contractor to complete the project and deliver it to the client in a fully operational state, with all necessary components and systems in place.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXjDfewdQzKTt5d3klR.label: Definition of Net Profits Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RXjDfewdQzKTt5d3klR.definition: A Net Profits Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies how profits will be calculated and distributed among parties involved, after deducting expenses and taxes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXm7wVUZI5oaEyhIjwN.definition:
"The EXTEND_DATA segment is the child of EXTEND_HEADER segment.  There will be 1 or more EXTEND_DATA segments per EXTEND_HEADER.

"

http://lmss.sali.org/RXnlQU3DRiWI6bIqVpQ.label: Management Committee
http://lmss.sali.org/RXnlQU3DRiWI6bIqVpQ.definition: A Management Committee typically oversees the daily operations of an organization, managing broader aspects than those typically handled by an executive committee. This committee is often composed of senior managers across different departments and is responsible for implementing the strategic decisions made by the board or executive committee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXnzQysl2uTvYtIymII.label: New York District Court - Nassau County - 3rd District
http://lmss.sali.org/RXnzQysl2uTvYtIymII.definition: New York District Court - Nassau County (3d Dist.) is a specific court within the New York District Court system, located in Nassau County and designated as the third district.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXp0ibWO1zpZWKyMqG6.label: Responses to Interrogatories
http://lmss.sali.org/RXp0ibWO1zpZWKyMqG6.definition: Responses to Interrogatories are written answers to a set of questions posed by one party to another during the discovery phase of a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXp8t2nB5dALSDMaBPt.label: New York Supreme Court - Kings County
http://lmss.sali.org/RXp8t2nB5dALSDMaBPt.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Kings County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Brooklyn, New York, with authority to hear both civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXqUHEvzRbwMVanU83I.label: Florida County Court - Pasco County
http://lmss.sali.org/RXqUHEvzRbwMVanU83I.definition: A court located in Pasco County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXsXosZCy47wwhrxpKR.label: Relative Sponsorship Request
http://lmss.sali.org/RXsXosZCy47wwhrxpKR.definition: The Relative Sponsorship Request (in the U.S., I-130 Petition), is the initial step in the process of sponsoring a family member for a family-based immigrant visa (in the U.S., a Green Card). In the United States, the petitioner, typically a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, files Form I-130 with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) to establish the qualifying relationship with the intending immigrant relative. Once the I-130 petition is approved, the sponsored relative can proceed with the green card application process, which often involves waiting for a visa number to become available in the appropriate family preference category.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXtqH1isyfJZSq6DysK.label: Customs Recordal Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RXtqH1isyfJZSq6DysK.definition: Customs recordal is a legal mechanism that allows intellectual property rights holders to register their trademarks or other IP rights with customs authorities. This registration enables customs officials to monitor and detain shipments that may contain counterfeit or infringing goods.
examples: For example, Gucci could record its trademarks with the U.S. Customs, allowing those customs officials to monitor and detain shipments that may contain counterfeit or infringing Gucci knockoff products.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXulUTrM46ncTtuz4lq.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Saline County (1st Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RXvyHIpVSIj87YDgW3O.label: Groundwater Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RXvyHIpVSIj87YDgW3O.definition: Groundwater rights concern the use of water that exists beneath the surface of the land, often in underground reservoirs or aquifers. Regulations and allocations vary by region and can depend on factors like recharge rates and overall availability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXwl9xfFnpmQn8Ex816.label: Client Identification Detail
http://lmss.sali.org/RXwl9xfFnpmQn8Ex816.definition: Client Identification Detail refers to specific information about a client, such as their organizational unit, business manager, internal counsel, ID, practice group, administrator, tax ID, and name, which is used for invoicing and identifying the legal services buyer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXx1zuWf6YAl8qcKgze.label: Pleadings
http://lmss.sali.org/RXx1zuWf6YAl8qcKgze.definition: Pleadings are formal written documents submitted to a court that outline the claims and defenses of parties involved in a legal dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RXypSiEOq4bBRYqxNk4.label: Pattern or Practice Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RXypSiEOq4bBRYqxNk4.definition: A "Pattern or Practice Claim" refers to a legal claim alleging that a defendant has engaged in a systematic and repeated pattern of discriminatory or unlawful behavior, rather than isolated incidents. This concept is often used in civil rights and employment law cases. In the U.S., these claims are brought under laws like Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, where the claimant must demonstrate that the defendant's actions were not random or isolated but were part of a consistent and regular practice of discrimination or illegal conduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RY1TTGFsmT6uPGVwcqu.label: B250 Real Estate
http://lmss.sali.org/RY1TTGFsmT6uPGVwcqu.definition: Review and analysis of real estate-related matters, including purchase agreements and lease provisions (e.g., common area maintenance clauses).

http://lmss.sali.org/RY4TSTaBNQP-bGyH_S-.label: X125 ATE Premiums/Insurance
http://lmss.sali.org/RY4TSTaBNQP-bGyH_S-.definition: The cost of ATE (After the Event) Insurance to indemnify legal costs in the event the litigation or arbitration is unsuccessful

http://lmss.sali.org/RY5tQA0D4QmmoLs_EG_.label: PA260 Infringement Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RY5tQA0D4QmmoLs_EG_.definition: All actions associated with determining which of a client's patent claims may cover a non-client's products or processes, including collecting patent and/or product information, obtaining any product samples, comparing the products to the client's patent claims, and reporting the results to the client. Work of outside vendors, such as private investigators, in assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal infringement opinion should be prepared separately under PA710, including any formal documentation that is to be used in order to support a complaint for patent infringement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RY5ufSFTqChUTFowO4X.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RY5ufSFTqChUTFowO4X.definition: Alternative Dispute Resolution Management refers to the process of resolving legal disputes outside of the traditional court system, such as through mediation or arbitration, and involves managing the various stages of the ADR process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RY7Okz6UVvinizq4WwE.label: Security Safeguards Principle
http://lmss.sali.org/RY7Okz6UVvinizq4WwE.definition: Security safeguards is the privacy principle that data should be protected by reasonable security safeguards against such risks as loss or unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification or disclosure of data.

http://lmss.sali.org/RYBYPyL2gM5QaDN08fT.label: New York Supreme Court - Onondaga County
http://lmss.sali.org/RYBYPyL2gM5QaDN08fT.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Onondaga County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Onondaga County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RYJonbQYtTIOmF1td8b.label: X301 Discovery/eDiscovery Collection-Third Party
http://lmss.sali.org/RYJonbQYtTIOmF1td8b.definition: Any costs associated with the retrieval of collection materials from a third party when billed as an expense instead of a service

http://lmss.sali.org/RYJsmKGBPlYJFgJkblp.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Benton County
http://lmss.sali.org/RYJsmKGBPlYJFgJkblp.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Benton County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Benton County, Missouri.
