http://lmss.sali.org/RZisChrUg3JTZGhCXcy.definition: L100 Case Assessment, Development and Administration refers to the process of evaluating and managing a legal case, including conducting factual investigations, analyzing legal strategies, managing documents and files, and engaging experts or consultants.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZm4akQHkbU4y4YWTSS.label: Child Custody Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RZm4akQHkbU4y4YWTSS.definition: A Child Custody Claim is a legal action brought by a parent seeking to obtain custody of their child, which falls under the broader category of Custody and Visitation Claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZojj6PEz8orW8MqRfo.label: Georgia Superior Court - Lincoln County
http://lmss.sali.org/RZojj6PEz8orW8MqRfo.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Lincoln County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Lincoln County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZpXC8azgPShroNSWz8.label: Idea Misappropriation - Contract Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RZpXC8azgPShroNSWz8.definition: The wrongful taking or use of another's idea or concept, specifically in the context of a breach of contract claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZq4CqTDNRMm4TxzH7A.label: X123 Publication Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RZq4CqTDNRMm4TxzH7A.definition: Any fees associated with publishing an official notice on the matter as required by statute. Excludes electronic or bound resource material purchased for use as a reference (X124) or legal research service costs (X111).

http://lmss.sali.org/RZqH7JNatWEJopG8p0A.label: Writ of Garnishment
http://lmss.sali.org/RZqH7JNatWEJopG8p0A.definition: A Writ of Garnishment is a legal mechanism whereby a court orders a third party to withhold funds they owe to the debtor and to direct the payment to the creditor instead. It's commonly used to collect on a judgment by seizing wages, bank account funds, or other assets that are in the hands of someone other than the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZsGyxMUhmKdCLwhHLL.label: Motion Picture and Video Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RZsGyxMUhmKdCLwhHLL.definition: The Motion Picture and Video Industry is a branch of the Recording Industry that involves the production and distribution of films and videos for entertainment or educational purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZsTFWTBqN0UOX5YzXy.label: Clinic Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RZsTFWTBqN0UOX5YzXy.definition: Clinic Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from negligent actions or omissions by healthcare providers in a clinic setting.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZsfzywFYpJOHfnZcR9.label: Motion to Compel Supplementation of Excerpts of Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RZsfzywFYpJOHfnZcR9.definition: A Motion to Compel Supplementation of Excerpts of Record is a legal request to require additional information to be added to a previously submitted record or evidence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RZt6wRozUsGTgVqOixI.label: Visa for Artist or Entertainer in a Reciprocal Exchange Program
http://lmss.sali.org/RZt6wRozUsGTgVqOixI.definition: This visa (in the U.S., the P-2 visa) is designed for artists or entertainers who will perform as part of a reciprocal exchange program between an organization in the destination country (e.g., U.S.) and an organization in another country. In the United States, the P-2 visa allows for a temporary stay tied to the duration of the specific performance or event, generally for a period of up to one year, with options for extension

http://lmss.sali.org/RZzNoXBTkunbHQAMplP.label: Georgia Superior Court - Evans County
http://lmss.sali.org/RZzNoXBTkunbHQAMplP.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Evans County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Evans County.

http://lmss.sali.org/R_MGSPsWTUiMpGardoo.label: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/R_MGSPsWTUiMpGardoo.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding electrical and electronic equipment for motor vehicles and internal combustion engines. The products made can be used for all types of transportation equipment (i.e., aircraft, automobiles, trucks, trains, ships) or stationary internal combustion engine applications.
examples: Alternators and generators for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Coils, ignition, internal combustion engines, manufacturing
Distributors for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Electrical control chips (modules), motor vehicle, manufacturing
Electrical ignition cable sets for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Generators for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Ignition wiring harness for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Instrument control panels (i.e., assembling purchased gauges), automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing
Spark plugs for internal combustion engines manufacturing
Windshield washer pumps, automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/R_OVXBSFNTfms-t-Aop.label: A112 Billable Travel Time
http://lmss.sali.org/R_OVXBSFNTfms-t-Aop.definition: Travel time billed by the timekeeper when other billable services are not performed for the client. Includes time spent waiting for a calendar/court call or other scheduled out-of-office event associated with the matter when other billable services are not performed for the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/R_UXEGujyQI69OqDPI_.label: X101 Copies/Blowbacks/Printing-Black & White (Internal)
http://lmss.sali.org/R_UXEGujyQI69OqDPI_.definition: Any black & white copies, blowbacks, digital prints from images, printing or reprinting costs billed on a per page basis when that printing is performed in-house and not by an external vendor

http://lmss.sali.org/R__bAx9MRFy6G0jOlyv.label: Support Activities for Coal Mining
http://lmss.sali.org/R__bAx9MRFy6G0jOlyv.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing support activities for coal mining (except geophysical surveying and mapping, site preparation, construction, and transportation activities) on a contract or fee basis. Exploration for coal is included in this industry. Exploration services include traditional prospecting methods, such as taking core samples and making geological observations at prospective sites.

http://lmss.sali.org/R_h5LrUKRtCgncaMMz_.label: Telephone Apparatus Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/R_h5LrUKRtCgncaMMz_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing wire telephone and data communications equipment. These products may be stand-alone or board-level components of a larger system. Examples of products made by these establishments are central office switching equipment, cordless and wire telephones (except cellular), PBX equipment, telephone answering machines, LAN modems, multi-user modems, and other data communications equipment, such as bridges, routers, and gateways.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra12OYzEcXANwkxxmK1.label: Negligent Exposure of Another to Disease or Toxic Substances
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra12OYzEcXANwkxxmK1.definition: Negligent Exposure of Another to Disease or Toxic Substances: The failure to exercise reasonable care in preventing the exposure of another person to a disease or toxic substance, resulting in harm or injury to that person.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1YZ2HiyZdVfoMJAbR.label: inv_start_date
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1YZ2HiyZdVfoMJAbR.definition:
"The starting date for the billing period.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1ZjvLdH7yzudCHZix.label: Month to Month Tenancy Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1ZjvLdH7yzudCHZix.definition: A month-to-month tenancy clause is a provision in a contract that allows a tenant to occupy a property on a monthly basis without a fixed term commitment.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1pFt020q4utPl7CCL.label: Creditor Matrix
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra1pFt020q4utPl7CCL.definition: A Creditor Matrix or Creditor List is a document that lists the names and addresses of all creditors in a bankruptcy or restructuring case.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra2VdrpsNnu6KYdaGT9.label: Mixed-Member Majoritarian Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra2VdrpsNnu6KYdaGT9.definition: Mixed-Member Majoritarian Representation (MMM), also known as Parallel Voting, is an electoral system combining first-past-the-post and proportional representation elements, but the two components operate independently. Voters typically have two votes: one for a candidate in a single-member district and another for a party list, with seats filled separately by each method without adjusting for proportionality.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra3R25ovg7enPXr0a0z.label: Utilities Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra3R25ovg7enPXr0a0z.definition: A Utilities Motion (Bankruptcy) is a request made by a utility company in a bankruptcy case to receive payment for providing essential services such as electricity, gas, or water to the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra6EHlbqrpUT9rxM2Pt.label: Author
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra6EHlbqrpUT9rxM2Pt.definition: An Author is a specific type of Role in Document or oasis:role that refers to the individual or entity responsible for creating or originating a written work.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra6tBo0zHHVrNc5BmHW.label: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra6tBo0zHHVrNc5BmHW.definition: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Rights refer to the legal and ethical protections aimed at ensuring individuals are not discriminated against based on their sexual orientation or gender identity. These rights may include freedom from persecution, equal employment opportunities, and access to healthcare and social services, and are increasingly recognized in international human rights law and national legislation.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ra8NCYdJb9YwmAxaOmL.label: Drug Crimes
http://lmss.sali.org/Ra8NCYdJb9YwmAxaOmL.definition: The violation of laws prohibiting the production, distribution, and/or use of certain controlled substances and the equipment or devices utilized in their preparation and/or use.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaBYuS5jx75uCCFVCzL.label: Writ of Execution
http://lmss.sali.org/RaBYuS5jx75uCCFVCzL.definition: A Writ of Execution is a court order granted to enforce a judgment of possession or to collect on a judgment of monetary damages by allowing the seizure or transfer of the debtor's property by authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaBmh0xc5Ks5Nek44du.label: Primary Care Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RaBmh0xc5Ks5Nek44du.definition: Negligence by a primary care physician in providing medical treatment or advice to a patient, resulting in harm or injury to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaCNymQDK4cCroLbq84.label: Impairment of Kidney Function
http://lmss.sali.org/RaCNymQDK4cCroLbq84.definition: Impairment of kidney function refers to a reduction in the kidneys' ability to filter waste products and excess fluids from the blood. This condition can vary in severity and may lead to chronic kidney disease, necessitating medical management or interventions to prevent further deterioration.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaE0yNxl79wosO0dNpK.label: Trial Court Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/RaE0yNxl79wosO0dNpK.definition: A Trial Court Forum is a level of court forum where legal proceedings are conducted and judgments are made, typically involving the presentation of evidence and witnesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaGE48yicwYTUmAcoEj.label: Sac River Band of the Chickamauga - Cherokee

http://lmss.sali.org/RaK9Nhu5Alxalhuh4CM.label: Back Pay
http://lmss.sali.org/RaK9Nhu5Alxalhuh4CM.definition: Back Pay refers to the wages, benefits, or other forms of compensation owed to an employee for past work performed but not yet paid. This could arise due to miscalculation, wage disputes, legal settlements, or retroactive pay increases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaQIRktfYrGWDS7HAq0.label: Donation
http://lmss.sali.org/RaQIRktfYrGWDS7HAq0.definition: A Donation is a voluntary gift of money, goods, services, or property given to an individual, organization, or cause without expectation of reciprocation or direct personal benefit. This act of giving is typically motivated by altruism, support for a specific mission or goal, or a desire to contribute to societal well-being.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaSUkwgm6NE3TznRNys.label: National Upper House Legislator
http://lmss.sali.org/RaSUkwgm6NE3TznRNys.definition: A National Upper House Legislator is a member of the higher chamber in a bicameral national legislature, typically responsible for providing a check on the lower house and representing broader state or regional interests. This official participates in crafting, debating, and voting on national legislation, often with special powers such as confirming executive appointments or ratifying treaties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaTFMaI3WJbEKbswbaq.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  York County
http://lmss.sali.org/RaTFMaI3WJbEKbswbaq.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - York County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaV7idwCeVbMb3CYq4k.label: Motion to Settle
http://lmss.sali.org/RaV7idwCeVbMb3CYq4k.definition: A Motion to Settle is a legal request made by one party to a lawsuit to resolve the case through a mutually agreed upon settlement, rather than proceeding to trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaWObOphVqdpQ8MspdR.label: Advertising Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RaWObOphVqdpQ8MspdR.definition: Advertising Law regulates the practices and methods of promoting products, services, and brands to ensure that advertisements are truthful, non-deceptive, and fair. It encompasses regulations on commercial speech, consumer protection, and compliance with industry standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaYhztvtpscasYcvEpQ.label: Retention Bonus Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RaYhztvtpscasYcvEpQ.definition: A retention bonus clause is a provision in a contract that offers an incentive payment to an employee to encourage them to remain with the company for a specified period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raa0PzFhxKvb9wz31HZ.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Income
http://lmss.sali.org/Raa0PzFhxKvb9wz31HZ.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Income, also known as Schedule I, requires the debtor to disclose all sources of income, including wages, salaries, business income, rental income, and other earnings. This schedule provides a detailed account of the debtor's financial resources, helping the court and creditors assess the debtor's ability to repay debts.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raa2imyBqrpa2SmbpG5.label: Notice and Opportunity to Cure Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Raa2imyBqrpa2SmbpG5.definition: A Notice and Opportunity to Cure Clause is a provision in a contract that requires one party to notify the other party of a breach or default and provide them with a chance to remedy the situation before taking legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raa91YOvuRhWrd2Q67R.label: A118 Collection-Forensic
http://lmss.sali.org/Raa91YOvuRhWrd2Q67R.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, the forensic acquisition and analysis of data that includes active files, deleted files and file fragments using specialized software or hardware

http://lmss.sali.org/RaaV6cOHBcFdUd7UxJy.label: Massachusetts Trial Court - Land Court Department
http://lmss.sali.org/RaaV6cOHBcFdUd7UxJy.definition: The Massachusetts Trial Court - Land Court Department is a specialized division within the Massachusetts Trial Court that handles cases related to real property disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rad9U0Bfny1ljSqwlvC.label: Semitic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/Rad9U0Bfny1ljSqwlvC.definition: Semitic languages are a group of languages that originated in the Middle East and are characterized by a common set of grammatical features and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RadAvJ7EdvJm13pHxKG.label: Client Relationship Role
http://lmss.sali.org/RadAvJ7EdvJm13pHxKG.definition: A lawyer's client relationship role refers to the various capacities in which an attorney interacts with and manages clients on behalf of a law firm. Examples include a billing partner (who oversees billing and invoicing matters), a responsible attorney (who is in charge of managing a specific legal matter), and a relationship attorney (who is in charge of an overall client relationship).

http://lmss.sali.org/RaddjgkPy5FHxbBpncC.label: Motion to Quash Service
http://lmss.sali.org/RaddjgkPy5FHxbBpncC.definition: A Motion to Quash Service is a legal request to invalidate or nullify a summons or other legal notice that was improperly served to a party in a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RadgKbGJ3NluNEV56hm.label: UTBMS MF30 Employment, Labor and Employee Benefits
http://lmss.sali.org/RadgKbGJ3NluNEV56hm.definition: A category within the UTBMS coding system used to classify legal services related to employment, labor, and employee benefits, which falls under the broader category of Mergers and Acquisitions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RadjVWRPrVJLYqNWRIz.label: Third-Party Summons
http://lmss.sali.org/RadjVWRPrVJLYqNWRIz.definition: A third-party summons is a legal document that requires a person who is not a party to a lawsuit to appear in court or provide evidence related to the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RadodspGwi9RYMx8hqn.label: Free Cash Flow Conversion Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RadodspGwi9RYMx8hqn.definition: A Free Cash Flow Conversion Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the conversion of a company's free cash flow into equity or debt securities.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rafw4pSzJ3S3d8sq6qu.label: Court Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/Rafw4pSzJ3S3d8sq6qu.definition: A Court Forum is a type of Dispute Forum that is administered by an organization or government entity and has specific levels and jurisdiction types for resolving legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RagNxp8dZ7BJZizfnV5.label: Construction Flooding Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RagNxp8dZ7BJZizfnV5.definition: The concept of Construction Flooding Negligence refers to a legal claim of negligence against a party involved in construction activities, where the negligence resulted in flooding or water damage to property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RahBth1PX724xMYkraW.label: Employer Breach of Employee Manual
http://lmss.sali.org/RahBth1PX724xMYkraW.definition: The concept of "Employer Breach of Employee Manual" refers to a legal claim made by an employee against their employer for failing to comply with the terms outlined in the company's employee manual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RahHAOYpslPuxq9W77A.label: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Noblesville City
http://lmss.sali.org/RahHAOYpslPuxq9W77A.definition: Indiana City Court - Hamilton County, Noblesville City is a specific court located in Hamilton County that operates under the jurisdiction of the Indiana City Court, handling cases related to city ordinances and traffic violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaioguABQM2bX_rskBz.label: Audio and Video Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/RaioguABQM2bX_rskBz.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic audio and video equipment for home entertainment, motor vehicles, and public address and musical instrument amplification. Examples of products made by these establishments are digital video recorders, televisions, stereo equipment, speaker systems, household-type video cameras, jukeboxes, and amplifiers for musical instruments and public address systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RajWDoRCFhj6iaJ3ITv.label: Initial Public Offering Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RajWDoRCFhj6iaJ3ITv.definition: An Initial Public Offering (IPO) is the process of offering shares of a private company to the public for the first time in order to raise capital, and is a type of Equity Financing.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raka03e8c9MzVaikHDZ.label: Health Care Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/Raka03e8c9MzVaikHDZ.definition: Health Care Fraud refers to the intentional deception or misrepresentation of information related to health care services or products, with the aim of obtaining unauthorized benefits or payments from a health care program or insurer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RalaaNQ3RajBddzUzN1.label: Architect Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RalaaNQ3RajBddzUzN1.definition: Architect Malpractice refers to a type of malpractice claim that arises from the negligent or wrongful actions of an architect in the design or construction of a building or structure.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ram7eqYuiBBxhcC5bDy.label: Disclaimer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Ram7eqYuiBBxhcC5bDy.definition: A disclaimer clause is a contractual provision that limits or excludes liability or responsibility for certain risks, damages, or warranties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RanhiLFv1QydJ0wONSe.label: Naturalization Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RanhiLFv1QydJ0wONSe.definition: A Naturalization Clause claim is a legal assertion related to Article I, Section 8, Clause 4 of the United States Constitution, which grants Congress the power "To establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization." This clause provides the federal government with the authority to set the rules for becoming a U.S. citizen. A claim involving the Naturalization Clause may arise in situations where there is a dispute over the application or interpretation of federal immigration and naturalization laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RaoUknSK5XanlmEQsAn.label: Definition of Change of Control Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RaoUknSK5XanlmEQsAn.definition: A Change of Control Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to terminate or modify the agreement if the other party undergoes a change in ownership or control.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raojf3kwmQ_6MSifRe3.label: B190 Other Contested Matters (excluding assumption/rejection motions)
http://lmss.sali.org/Raojf3kwmQ_6MSifRe3.definition: Analysis and preparation of all other motions, opposition to motions and reply memoranda in support of motions
http://lmss.sali.org/Raojf3kwmQ_6MSifRe3.pref_label: B190 Other Contested Matters (excluding assumption/rejection motions)

http://lmss.sali.org/RapVco8sDRuGIvozynO.label: TR760 Domain Names - ccTLDs Domain Name Filing - Country Code
http://lmss.sali.org/RapVco8sDRuGIvozynO.definition: All actions associated with completing a domain name application (including renewal) that is to be filed as a country code top-level domain (ccTLD), e.g., .jp, .uk, .tv. The domain name applications should be filed through the current domain name provider unless otherwise instructed.
http://lmss.sali.org/RapVco8sDRuGIvozynO.pref_label: TR760 Domain Names - ccTLDs Domain Name Filing - Country Code

http://lmss.sali.org/Raqj2XMH0Rvy5lG12tO.label: WC330 Depositions
http://lmss.sali.org/Raqj2XMH0Rvy5lG12tO.definition: Preparing deposition notices and subpoenas, Communicating with witnesses and/or opposing counsel, Discussing deposition strategy with adjuster/employer and/or witness, Preparing witnesses, Reviewing medical records/documents/claims file for deposition preparation, Preparing direct/cross examination questions for depositions, Attending depositions, Travel to and from depositions, Prepare deposition summaries/reports to client

http://lmss.sali.org/RaugsP6wniCtAbGQO8t.label: Florida Circuit Court - Nassau County - 4th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RaugsP6wniCtAbGQO8t.definition: A court located in Nassau County, Florida that is part of the larger Florida Circuit Court system, which handles civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RavbbRJfj6893jzfMtO.label: Kansas District Court - Coffey County
http://lmss.sali.org/RavbbRJfj6893jzfMtO.definition: Kansas District Court - Coffey County refers to a specific court within the Kansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Coffey County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RavfMdPWC2GQVXsbXt0.label: Indiana Town Court - Hendricks County, Brownsburg Town
http://lmss.sali.org/RavfMdPWC2GQVXsbXt0.definition: A court located in Brownsburg Town, Hendricks County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over local ordinance violations and minor criminal offenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raw03V8d0o2ILRa4VEp.label: Data Breach
http://lmss.sali.org/Raw03V8d0o2ILRa4VEp.definition: A "Data Breach" refers to an incident in which unauthorized individuals gain access to confidential data, often resulting in the exposure or theft of sensitive information. Such breaches can compromise personal, financial, or business-related data, posing risks to individuals, organizations, and stakeholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RawJ8s5nRdIt85WOvY1.label: Abuse of Process
http://lmss.sali.org/RawJ8s5nRdIt85WOvY1.definition: The concept of "Abuse of Process" refers to the misuse of legal procedures or the justice system for an ulterior motive, such as to harass or intimidate someone, rather than for the legitimate pursuit of justice.

http://lmss.sali.org/Raye9wszOl53QEcjEAC.label: Polar Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/Raye9wszOl53QEcjEAC.definition: The Polar Market Segment targets consumers or businesses situated in regions experiencing extremely cold temperatures, such as polar and subpolar zones. Products and services in this segment are designed to address the challenges of living in frigid climates, including insulation, heating solutions, and specialized clothing.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb1azCsSHRLiyTTBbwG.label: X202 Patent and Trademark Searching and Monitoring
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb1azCsSHRLiyTTBbwG.definition: Any searching and monitoring costs, including any monitoring or watch service for a trademark, brand or domain name. Excludes on-line legal research (X111) or discovery/eDiscovery culling and filtering (X302).
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb1azCsSHRLiyTTBbwG.pref_label: X202 Patent and Trademark Searching and Monitoring

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb33ejPtclmIHJbqwTN.label: Unit per Task
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb33ejPtclmIHJbqwTN.definition: A "Unit per Task" is a type of unit used to measure the cost of a specific task or activity within a legal engagement, such as drafting a contract or attending a hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb5DUKDN9ZXr5IK0opP.label: Agent Breaching Fiduciary Duty to Principal
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb5DUKDN9ZXr5IK0opP.definition: An agent breaching their legal obligation to act in the best interest of their principal, often an employee breaching their duty to their employer.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb6m6EzxbJjnkThunYk.label: Investors' Rights Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb6m6EzxbJjnkThunYk.definition: An Investors' Rights Agreement (IRA) is a legal document that delineates the rights, privileges, and protections afforded to investors, particularly those investing in private companies. It often includes provisions concerning information rights, anti-dilution protections, and registration rights, among others, aimed at protecting the investors' interests and ensuring they have access to critical information.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb7gzABtK0FO1Zs5Z71.label: Joint Insurance Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb7gzABtK0FO1Zs5Z71.definition: A Joint Insurance Agreement allows two or more parties to be jointly insured under one policy. This ensures that all parties have coverage and defines how liabilities or benefits are distributed among them.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb83PjlzxELY9WY21pS.label: Association
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb83PjlzxELY9WY21pS.definition: An association refers to an organized group of individuals or entities that join together for a common purpose or goal. These groups can take various forms, and they often have specific missions, objectives, and membership requirements. Associations are commonly established to promote shared interests, advocacy, networking, and collaboration among their members.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb8qtSl6pvANroExswq.label: Florida Circuit Court - Jackson County - 14th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb8qtSl6pvANroExswq.definition: The Florida Circuit Court - Jackson County (14th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Jackson County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb98lvP9PRY6qFHj7mH.label: L652 Objective and Subjective coding

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb9GfavYKEROCJss0JJ.label: Lack of Case or Controversy
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb9GfavYKEROCJss0JJ.definition: The term "case or controversy" refers to the requirement that courts may only hear matters involving actual, ongoing disputes between parties with a concrete interest in the outcome. This requirement ensures that the judiciary only resolves real conflicts and does not give advisory opinions or engage in issues that are moot, not ripe, or non-justiciable. In the United States, this falls under Article III of the Constitution.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rb9ymr4tGQwciL1lrwg.label: Trademark Registration Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rb9ymr4tGQwciL1lrwg.definition: The Trademark Registration Process involves filing an application with a governmental authority, such as the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), that includes the name, logo, or other mark to be registered, along with the goods or services it will represent. The application undergoes examination for distinctiveness and potential conflicts with existing trademarks; if approved, a Trademark Registration Document is issued, granting the owner exclusive rights to use the mark in commerce for the specified goods or services

http://lmss.sali.org/RbAyL0ru5m8CyqAShGV.label: Motions in Appellate Courts
http://lmss.sali.org/RbAyL0ru5m8CyqAShGV.definition: Motions in Appellate Courts are requests made by parties in a higher court seeking a specific action or decision, such as a motion to expedite a case or a motion for summary disposition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RbBEyI6-RSh6mCX_mlM.label: PA220 Patentability Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RbBEyI6-RSh6mCX_mlM.definition: All actions associated with determining the approximate scope of patent protection that may be available for a client's invention, including definition of the scope and field of the search, searching, analysis of search results, and reporting to client. Also known as a "novelty" or "prior art" search, the field of a patentability search is often similar to that of a state-of-the-art search. However, patentability searches are typically conducted after any market research or conceptual engineering has been completed so that the scope of the investigation is described by at least an informal structural or functional description of an invention. Often a patentability search will also locate expired and/or lapsed patents disclosing technology that may be freely copied in order to improve the invention. Thus, a patentability search may include various aspects of a state-of-the-art search. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rbv1HNLT3FGddLr9tkZ.definition: An Equity Mutual Fund is an investment fund that pools capital from multiple investors to buy a diversified portfolio of stocks or equities. http://lmss.sali.org/Rc3fpKzNOlwHWBICwHG.label: Annual Recurring Revenue

http://lmss.sali.org/RcLuFIVZBrM4AhteZ4J.definition: The Travel Document Issuing Country refers to the country that has issued the travel document or other identification suitable for international travel. This country is usually responsible for the traveler's consular needs and is the authority to which foreign governments will refer for identification and verification purposes

http://lmss.sali.org/RcMZgiwSAaHpqXMO4nq.label: Implied Indemnification
http://lmss.sali.org/RcMZgiwSAaHpqXMO4nq.definition: A legal concept where one party is obligated to compensate another party for damages or losses, even if there is no explicit agreement to do so, due to actions or statements that created a reasonable expectation of indemnification.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcNTXUIeabR8yZj0Gio.label: Nonacquiescence
http://lmss.sali.org/RcNTXUIeabR8yZj0Gio.definition: Nonacquiescence refers to the practice where a government agency chooses not to follow or implement a court ruling that directly affects the agency's actions or policies. This may happen when the agency disagrees with the decision or believes that it only applies to the specific case and not to its general procedures or regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcP9tLiIhGT0pZaCrB0.label: Contract Duration Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RcP9tLiIhGT0pZaCrB0.definition: A Contract Duration Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the length of time that the contract will remain in effect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcPCCRQUx0nlNBGvI8K.label: Obviousness
http://lmss.sali.org/RcPCCRQUx0nlNBGvI8K.definition: Obviousness in legal terms refers to the lack of novelty and inventiveness in an invention, making it ineligible for a patent. An invention is considered obvious if a person with ordinary skill in the field would find the invention predictable based on prior art.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcPmc5tXDkOmcv3W8Tx.label: Real Estate Investor
http://lmss.sali.org/RcPmc5tXDkOmcv3W8Tx.definition: Entities or individuals that invest in real property, either directly or through a real estate investment trust (REIT).

http://lmss.sali.org/RcR2xKteHARvohhigcd.label: Seating Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RcR2xKteHARvohhigcd.definition: A seating claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing reasonable seating to employees who perform tasks that can be done while seated. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to provide seating to employees when the nature of their work reasonably permits the use of seats. Employers can face liability for failing to provide seating when required, which can result in physical discomfort or injury to employees who are required to stand for long periods of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcR3bv1hvkJ6eLZsLcm.definition: Closing Arguments/Summation is a trial event where each party presents their final arguments to the jury or judge before a verdict is reached.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcTA2iQmrtqOnX3WrjJ.definition: A lawyer is a legal professional who provides legal advice and representation to clients in various legal matters, including litigation, transactions, and regulatory compliance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcUQjieg6jZJk6oJvLL.label: Appointment of Successor Trustee Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RcUQjieg6jZJk6oJvLL.definition: An Appointment of Successor Trustee Clause is a provision in a contract that designates a person or entity to take over as trustee in the event that the original trustee is unable or unwilling to continue serving.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcUv6cuttcRWxmaQw6M.label: Social Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RcUv6cuttcRWxmaQw6M.definition: Social rights are the rights that focus on ensuring individuals have access to essential social services and protections, such as healthcare, education, and housing. Often considered a subset of economic rights, social rights aim to provide a safety net and foster social cohesion, and they may be protected by international treaties as well as national laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcVabDAyOfCmuIYjaqo.label: Tax and Revenue Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RcVabDAyOfCmuIYjaqo.definition: Law which deals with the constitutional, common-law, statutory, tax treaty, and regulatory rules that constitute the law applicable to taxation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RccmkBspE9N2VkexAeF.label: Renewable Energy Law Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RccmkBspE9N2VkexAeF.definition: Renewable Energy Law Objectives refer to the legal and regulatory goals aimed at promoting the development, deployment, and integration of renewable energy sources into the energy mix. These objectives address environmental, economic, social, and technological aspects to ensure a transition to sustainable energy systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RccxQ21LARDiCtG8SaB.label: L632 Scanning - Hard Copy
http://lmss.sali.org/RccxQ21LARDiCtG8SaB.definition: Includes OCR, production of metadata, and other services involved around scanning

http://lmss.sali.org/RceM7BMd4OmxX00dRlA.label: Nephrotic Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RceM7BMd4OmxX00dRlA.definition: Nephrotic Syndrome is a kidney disorder characterized by excessive protein loss in the urine, low blood protein levels, high cholesterol, and swelling (edema). This condition results from damage to the kidney's filtering units (glomeruli) and can lead to complications requiring medical management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RceZ38f0Kx5YV2ri1nU.label: Misfeasance in Public Office
http://lmss.sali.org/RceZ38f0Kx5YV2ri1nU.definition: Misfeasance in public office is a legal cause of action in some jurisdictions (e.g., United Kingdom), where a public officer abuses their position by acting unlawfully with malice or reckless disregard for the harm caused. This tort requires proof of deliberate wrongful conduct by the officer, resulting in damage to the claimant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcedW7umYlqo0ua5vLp.label: Affiliate Non-Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/RcedW7umYlqo0ua5vLp.definition: An affiliate non-debtor is a company or entity related to a debtor through common ownership, control, or significant financial interest, but which itself is not undergoing bankruptcy proceedings. Such entities may be involved in the bankruptcy case due to financial ties, guarantees, or shared obligations with the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rcfgxuij0em7k0pjQKF.label: Recreational Immunity
http://lmss.sali.org/Rcfgxuij0em7k0pjQKF.definition: Recreational immunity exists as a defense for owners and/or occupiers of land as long as the plaintiff's recreational use was uninvited, used without fee, and there was no unreasonable risks that the owner/occupier should have known or knew existed.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rcg25mdkNuZujwumYxj.label: New York City Court - New Rochelle
http://lmss.sali.org/Rcg25mdkNuZujwumYxj.definition: A court located in New Rochelle that operates under the jurisdiction of the New York City Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rchny3YFXoQyenv6XUb.label: Trial Events
http://lmss.sali.org/Rchny3YFXoQyenv6XUb.definition: Trial Events refer to the specific events that occur during a trial, such as opening statements, witness testimony, and the receipt of a verdict.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcjE7ZFthlfdvlhZ5GC.label: Spousal Support Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RcjE7ZFthlfdvlhZ5GC.definition: A Spousal Support Claim is a legal request made by one spouse to receive financial assistance from the other spouse following a divorce or separation. This claim is typically based on factors such as income disparity, the length of the marriage, and each spouse's financial needs and contributions during the marriage. Spousal support, also known as alimony, is designed to provide financial support to the lower-earning spouse to help them maintain their standard of living or become financially independent.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rck2jHWol8s1ZYn5aZW.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Pike Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/Rck2jHWol8s1ZYn5aZW.definition: A court located in Pike County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rco6IwncDRI2APcwt3k.definition: Preparing for examination of witness, Interview/meeting with witness, Preparing for cross-examination of witness, Review & analysis of deposition/trial transcripts

http://lmss.sali.org/RcqrMBmLwAweHAkomaA.label: Respiratory Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RcqrMBmLwAweHAkomaA.definition: Respiratory disorders are a group of conditions that affect the respiratory system, including the lungs and airways, leading to symptoms such as difficulty breathing, chronic cough, and reduced oxygen intake. These disorders can range from acute conditions like asthma attacks to chronic diseases like cystic fibrosis, requiring varied treatments and management strategies to improve respiratory function and quality of life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcsmW8Wmu47y1GzwWHi.label: Testator
http://lmss.sali.org/RcsmW8Wmu47y1GzwWHi.definition: A Testator is an individual who creates and executes a valid will, specifying how their estate should be distributed after their death. http://lmss.sali.org/RcutwK5AAUoSsZbULJM.definition: The Delaware Justice of the Peace Court is a court within the Delaware State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases involving minor offenses and disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcwQtGZrohiyAqPHf1j.definition: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) is any data that can be used to identify, contact, or locate a specific individual. This includes names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, social security numbers, and other identifiers that can be linked to a particular person.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rcwn8msRtDqTFPXcgrp.label: Trademark Dilution
http://lmss.sali.org/Rcwn8msRtDqTFPXcgrp.definition: Trademark Dilution is a legal claim that arises when a party uses a similar or identical trademark to another party's famous mark, causing a likelihood of dilution of the distinctive quality of the famous mark.

http://lmss.sali.org/RcyQuaYdvmOmAVROvfH.label: Impounding Property to Pay Debt
http://lmss.sali.org/RcyQuaYdvmOmAVROvfH.definition: The concept of "Impounding Property to Pay Debt" refers to the legal process of seizing and holding property as collateral to satisfy a debt owed by the property owner, typically in cases of equitable claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RczOdaNZnrQz9v0Xg2Q.definition: When a bank fails to complete a funds transfer initiated by a customer before the customer closes their account or withdraws their authorization, resulting in the funds not being transferred, and potentially causing financial harm to the customer.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd2J0V6Magzui25PaTT.label: Promissory Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/Rd2J0V6Magzui25PaTT.definition: The concept of Promissory Fraud refers to a type of fraudulent misrepresentation where a party makes a promise with no intention of keeping it, in order to induce another party to enter into a contract or take some other action to their detriment.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd3Z1kCqjqGfSSXLxeg.label: Economic Community of West African States
http://lmss.sali.org/Rd3Z1kCqjqGfSSXLxeg.definition: ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States): A regional group of fifteen West African countries, founded to promote economic integration across the region.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd5U9LwpXnyPC2FrSlA.label: Sanctions
http://lmss.sali.org/Rd5U9LwpXnyPC2FrSlA.definition: A penalty or punishment imposed by a court or other authority for a violation of a law or rule, typically involving a fine or other restriction on one's rights or freedoms.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd5clbkJCCyveddDZeK.definition: A Certified Rent Roll Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the landlord to provide a verified list of current tenants and their corresponding rental rates.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd5fNypp3e7sdvAs1Xm.label: Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rd5fNypp3e7sdvAs1Xm.definition: An EMTALA Claim arises when a healthcare provider fails to comply with the obligations under the Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act, which requires hospitals to provide emergency medical treatment to all individuals regardless of their ability to pay. http://lmss.sali.org/Rd6d52FIPIZIR9a2kpe.label: Motion to Obtain Oral Argument
http://lmss.sali.org/Rd6d52FIPIZIR9a2kpe.definition: A Motion to Obtain Oral Argument is a formal request made to a court by a party in a legal case, asking for the opportunity to present their arguments orally before the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rd6ivGOMbi4Slsu4ynP.definition: Law governing the regulation of healthcare systems, medical practices, health insurance, patient rights, and the obligations of healthcare providers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdCJd93cSeUss1HJN1F.definition: An Order of Precedence Clause is a provision in a contract that establishes the hierarchy of conflicting terms and conditions within the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdHZOscFU3rvn6hYjUT.definition: A First-Past-the-Post (FPTP) electoral system is a voting method where the candidate with the most votes in a single-member district wins the election. This system does not require the winner to achieve a majority of the votes, only a plurality.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdJDlUZrfYfSbM98VLI.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Hamilton County is a specific court within the New York Supreme Court system, located in Hamilton County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdJQsU95Vq3NCs4Q732.definition: The unauthorized use or theft of someone else's original idea, without their permission or compensation, which can be claimed as a violation of intellectual property rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdJXzcAmlfZcyYjgz46.definition: A representation made by a party in a legal matter that confirms the approval of a particular action or decision, and is supported by legal or other professional frameworks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdKe12V6USIhAGro6Cl.definition: A Statutory Deductions Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the employer to deduct certain amounts from an employee's pay, such as taxes and social security contributions, as required by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdLKpMMz0EOY6bL9CUM.definition: A Vehicle Emissions Violation Claim involves allegations that a vehicle has exceeded the permissible emission levels set by environmental regulations, contributing to air pollution and violating environmental protection laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdLt8myHW8a9xutd93B.label: Attractive Nuisance
http://lmss.sali.org/RdLt8myHW8a9xutd93B.definition: A legal concept that refers to a hazardous condition or object on a property that is likely to attract children and may cause them harm, for which the property owner may be held liable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdN2HJ56AGgrCRp00p3.definition: Action relating to Medicare payments, including actions for payments of benefits, to recover overpayments, and for judicial review of administrative decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdN6a66644QYTrLMGgE.label: Strict Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RdN6a66644QYTrLMGgE.definition: Strict liability refers to a legal doctrine where a party is held responsible for their actions or the consequences of those actions, regardless of intent or negligence. This means that the person or entity is liable for damages even if they didn't intend to cause harm or weren't negligent in their actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdOK7keDYcH1kYilffk.label: Status - Process Outcome
http://lmss.sali.org/RdOK7keDYcH1kYilffk.definition: Status Process Outcome reflects the result or disposition of a particular process or action — at a particular point in time — often indicating the decision or outcome of an application, request, or submission within a legal or regulatory context. This status conveys the relevant authority's determination, such as "approved," "denied," "received," "responded," or "withdrawn."

http://lmss.sali.org/RdSk3rFO3zI8gEGS4lf.definition: Lessons Learned refers to the process of reflecting on past experiences and identifying what worked well and what did not, in order to improve future performance, within the context of project management objectives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdTDOX2MTCzc7MG7wTr.definition: A Fund Participation Agreement is a contract where parties agree to share in the gains or losses of a specific fund or investment. Often used in insurance, it's a way for insurers to spread risk among multiple participants.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rda1ZRiT8b4PHJQncWM.label: Tortious Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing
http://lmss.sali.org/Rda1ZRiT8b4PHJQncWM.definition: The Tortious Breach of Implied Covenant of Good Faith and Fair Dealing refers to a legal claim that arises when one party to a contract violates the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing, resulting in harm or damages to the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RdeqNhAsNWbConbs3LE.definition: A minimum wage violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not paying the required minimum wage for the work performed. http://lmss.sali.org/Re6iIaFBYiUPt64JyRg.label: Genetic Information
http://lmss.sali.org/Re6iIaFBYiUPt64JyRg.definition: Genetic information refers to data about an individual's genetic traits, which are inherited from their parents through DNA. This information can include details about an individual's genes, family medical history, and the presence or absence of specific genetic markers that may be associated with certain diseases or conditions. Genetic information is protected under various laws, such as the Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act (GINA) in the United States, which prohibits discrimination in employment and health insurance based on genetic information.

http://lmss.sali.org/Re6iNkqCNKLxfKCzJaX.label: Council of the European Union

http://lmss.sali.org/ReA0gy8mOLrqG7eTtFx.label: Spouse
http://lmss.sali.org/ReA0gy8mOLrqG7eTtFx.definition: A Spouse is a legally recognized partner in a marriage, civil union, or domestic partnership. This status confers various legal rights and responsibilities related to inheritance, taxation, healthcare decision-making, and immigration.

http://lmss.sali.org/ReNkGY1Jy8QHLlTA9ng.label: Passive Investor Disclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/ReNkGY1Jy8QHLlTA9ng.definition: A Passive Investor Disclosure is a document filed by investors who hold a significant stake in a company but do not seek to influence or control its management or operations. http://lmss.sali.org/ReOLTXdfcq1d2Y3bABY.label: Salishan languages
http://lmss.sali.org/ReOLTXdfcq1d2Y3bABY.definition: Salishan languages are a group of languages spoken by indigenous peoples in the Pacific Northwest region of North America.

http://lmss.sali.org/ReSPRTrS9XJvRaQX1Zv.definition: A Base Amount - Fee is a specific type of fee or expense that is charged for legal services, typically representing a fixed or minimum amount that must be paid by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/ReVIq4kQ4Z8kpvQr8OX.label: Certificate of Incorporation
http://lmss.sali.org/ReVIq4kQ4Z8kpvQr8OX.definition: A Certificate of Incorporation is a legal document filed with a state's Secretary of State or similar government agency to officially establish a corporation. http://lmss.sali.org/ReVpXO9NFe3lfCge2LN.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in Cape Girardeau County, which is a court of general jurisdiction in Missouri responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RedqB4xsmjzseIURMCJ.definition: To unlawfully and intentionally damage, or attempt to damage, any real or personal property by fire or incendiary device

http://lmss.sali.org/Ref4ZrgwklTv0bB1ov3.label: Family Health Insurance Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/Ref4ZrgwklTv0bB1ov3.definition: A family health insurance plan covers not just an individual policyholder but also members of their family, such as a spouse and/or children. These plans often have higher premiums but may offer a cost advantage on a per-person basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/Reh0yxWlrRrqdF73F5b.label: WC340 Expert Discovery
http://lmss.sali.org/Reh0yxWlrRrqdF73F5b.definition: Preparing expert discovery and deposition notices, Communicating with expert and opposing counsel, Preparing subpoena to secure experts (vocational/ medical/other) appearance at deposition/trial, Discussing deposition strategy, Preparation for and consultation with expert, Reviewing expert documents/records and/or films review, Drafting expert summaries, Preparation for and consultation with expert, Arranging and scheduling Independent Medical Examinations (IME) and Impairment Rating Evaluations (IRE), Review & Analysis of Independent medical examination (IME) & impairment rating evaluation (IRE), Communicating with expert (vocation/medical and other) and obtaining vocational documents

http://lmss.sali.org/RehKvgKHQ6yqWnBYOfx.label: Clearing Title
http://lmss.sali.org/RehKvgKHQ6yqWnBYOfx.definition: Clearing title refers to the process of resolving legal issues, claims, or encumbrances that could cloud the ownership status or legal rights associated with a particular property or piece of real estate. This process typically involves investigating and addressing any outstanding liens, disputes, or defects in the property's title to establish a clean and unambiguous ownership status. Clearing title is often necessary when buying or selling real estate to ensure that the buyer receives clear and marketable title to the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rej96G39bywPEUNqP4W.label: Fund Management Company
http://lmss.sali.org/Rej96G39bywPEUNqP4W.definition: A Fund Management Company is a business entity that pools money from individual and institutional investors to invest in financial securities such as stocks, bonds, or other assets. The company is responsible for making investment decisions, administering the fund, and providing asset management services, typically in exchange for management fees and performance-based compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RekH7Y6qcTZ3UyrEWZl.label: Surface Water Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RekH7Y6qcTZ3UyrEWZl.definition: These rights pertain to the use of water from sources that exist on the surface of the land, such as lakes, rivers, and streams. The allocation and usage of these rights can be based on factors like historic use, regional laws, and treaties.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ren27VK2QbFLW1uRFu8.label: Skateboard and Hover Board Liability Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Ren27VK2QbFLW1uRFu8.definition: A Skateboard and Hover Board Liability Claim is a legal claim for damages resulting from injuries caused by the use of a skateboard or hover board, falling under the category of Personal Injury Claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/Reoi7ZeQgQh6nH-Yxwr.label: PA420 Preliminary Amendment - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/Reoi7ZeQgQh6nH-Yxwr.definition: All action associated with revising an application prior to the examination of the application on its merits in the home country of the applicant for an application filed under PA300, including preparation of amendments and revised drawings that do not affect the scope of the disclosure. Note that Preliminary Amendments that are filed with a continuing application without affecting the scope of the disclosure are included under PA350. Also note that preliminary amendments extending the scope of the disclosure ("new matter" in the U.S.) in an earlier-filed application and requiring the issuance of a new application number ("continuation-in-part" or "CIP" applications in the U.S.) are included under PA310-340.

http://lmss.sali.org/RepzuKaD1tTAVt1HZzq.label: Indigent
http://lmss.sali.org/RepzuKaD1tTAVt1HZzq.definition: Indigent refers to an individual who is financially unable to afford the basic necessities of life, including the costs associated with legal proceedings. In a legal context, indigent status may qualify a person for free legal representation or the waiver of court fees under the principle of in forma pauperis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RerEUKXhKtat2sOHUL9.label: Refinancing
http://lmss.sali.org/RerEUKXhKtat2sOHUL9.definition: Refinancing is the process of replacing an existing loan with a new loan, typically with different terms, to reduce interest rates, change the loan duration, or access equity. Borrowers use refinancing to improve their financial situation, often to lower monthly payments or reduce the total interest paid over the loan's life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RerZDLB9AcmNLeGjqzf.label: New York Supreme Court - Columbia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RerZDLB9AcmNLeGjqzf.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Columbia County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Columbia County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/ReswYRsH8IbmoE68Qpg.label: Subject-Matter Jurisdiction
http://lmss.sali.org/ReswYRsH8IbmoE68Qpg.definition: Subject-Matter Jurisdiction refers to the authority of a court to hear and decide a particular type of legal dispute, based on the subject matter of the case and the laws governing it.

http://lmss.sali.org/RetcBT4W2LB4TAp4nLP.label: Motion to Allow Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RetcBT4W2LB4TAp4nLP.definition: A Motion to Allow Claims is a request made in a bankruptcy case to permit creditors to assert their claims against the debtor's estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/Revs4g1weWrrjVNT9CQ.label: State Upper House Legislator
http://lmss.sali.org/Revs4g1weWrrjVNT9CQ.definition: A State Senator is an elected official who serves as a member of the upper chamber of a state's bicameral legislature. This individual is responsible for proposing, debating, and voting on state laws, policies, and budgets, as well as representing the interests of constituents from their specific senatorial district.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rey5MjRK7y2McE1mi9D.label: Directly or Indirectly Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rey5MjRK7y2McE1mi9D.definition: A Directly or Indirectly Clause is a provision in a contract that either explicitly or implicitly imposes obligations or restrictions on a party, and is a subcategory of a Contractual Clause.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rf0sTVs4qSCixkQDhUD.label: B160 Fee/Employment Applications
http://lmss.sali.org/Rf0sTVs4qSCixkQDhUD.definition: Preparations of employment and fee applications for self or others; motions to establish interim procedures

http://lmss.sali.org/Rf6VP4ko64w2R7cvHu9.label: Financial Advisor Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rf6VP4ko64w2R7cvHu9.definition: Financial Advisor Practice refers to the professional services provided by a financial advisor in analyzing and managing assets for clients.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rf6vK5Jm2Txp5OUcUez.label: Georgia District Court - Candler County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rf6vK5Jm2Txp5OUcUez.definition: A court located in Candler County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfAEvrDz0jIqyTkkNY1.label: Grant of Right of First Offer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RfAEvrDz0jIqyTkkNY1.definition: A Grant of Right of First Offer Clause is a provision in a contract that gives a party the opportunity to purchase a specific asset before it is offered to others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfBdQ771UMEZMpb5zTU.label: Amount in Controversy / Dispute
http://lmss.sali.org/RfBdQ771UMEZMpb5zTU.definition: The amount at stake in a dispute, particularly where the jurisdictional requirements for certain courts (e.g., federal courts, small claims courts) require either maximum or minimum amounts in controversy — including both plaintiffs' claims and defendants' counterclaims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfElw4Sp3c3CCq6CpSz.label: po_number
http://lmss.sali.org/RfElw4Sp3c3CCq6CpSz.definition:
"The alphanumeric, client-assigned purchase order number or code.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RfFvGgy9HHcmP4onVyP.label: UTBMS MF60 Real Property
http://lmss.sali.org/RfFvGgy9HHcmP4onVyP.definition: A legal billing code used to classify services related to the acquisition, sale, or lease of real property, which falls under the broader category of UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A).

http://lmss.sali.org/RfFzqYYfJQUapF4EO4O.label: L633 Foreign language translation
http://lmss.sali.org/RfFzqYYfJQUapF4EO4O.definition: Activities and actions related to foreign language translation of both electronic and paper documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfHx4iRaDoRTi6QONDx.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Coos County
http://lmss.sali.org/RfHx4iRaDoRTi6QONDx.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Coos County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Coos County, Oregon.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfIBMnhOwKzYKSLAZ3W.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Pulaski County
http://lmss.sali.org/RfIBMnhOwKzYKSLAZ3W.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Pulaski County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pulaski County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfJOk9WkEpLFHLSI5Rw.label: Minnesota District Court - Lyon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RfJOk9WkEpLFHLSI5Rw.definition: Minnesota District Court - Lyon County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Lyon County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfJigJT2rTvBzyMa18N.label: Legal Clinic
http://lmss.sali.org/RfJigJT2rTvBzyMa18N.definition: A Legal Clinic is an organization that provides free or low-cost legal services to individuals and communities, often staffed by law students under the supervision of licensed attorneys. It offers practical legal education to students while serving the legal needs of underserved populations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfNcSczOsxXooaI8T73.label: Settlement Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RfNcSczOsxXooaI8T73.definition: Settlement Documents are written or recorded representations of agreements made between parties in a legal dispute, including settlement agreements, plea agreements, settlement offers, and settlement authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfOgFZX56TceH6YCfPy.label: Regulatory Guidance
http://lmss.sali.org/RfOgFZX56TceH6YCfPy.definition: Regulatory Guidance refers to formal recommendations or interpretations issued by a regulatory body to clarify or explain laws and regulations. This guidance assists organizations in understanding their legal obligations and how to achieve compliance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfP04tDTTpn4LDvwAxA.label: Due Process Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RfP04tDTTpn4LDvwAxA.definition: A due process claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or entity alleging that their right to due process, as protected by the Fifth and Fourteenth Amendments of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. Due process refers to the legal requirement that the government must respect and uphold the legal rights of individuals when carrying out actions that may affect their life, liberty, or property. A due process claim can arise in two contexts: procedural due process and substantive due process. Procedural due process claims involve allegations that the government has failed to provide adequate notice, a fair hearing, or other procedural safeguards before depriving an individual of their rights. Substantive due process claims, on the other hand, involve allegations that the government has infringed on fundamental rights or acted arbitrarily, even if proper procedures were followed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfP8o53j3SFE4IY4EPd.label: Washington Superior Court - Pacific County
http://lmss.sali.org/RfP8o53j3SFE4IY4EPd.definition: Washington Superior Court - Pacific County: A specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Pacific County, Washington.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfRbcQ0WWLnN35qpCq0.label: Counter-Defendant
http://lmss.sali.org/RfRbcQ0WWLnN35qpCq0.definition: A person against whom a counterclaim is brought.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfSV5TP9lvM2Xd6B5ds.label: Lithuanian
http://lmss.sali.org/RfSV5TP9lvM2Xd6B5ds.definition: Lithuanian (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary used in Lithuania and by Lithuanian speakers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfToPJ49XQ5WAcLwp9w.label: PA350 Continuing Application Preparation - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RfToPJ49XQ5WAcLwp9w.definition: All actions associated with completing a continuing patent application (claiming priority to an earlier-filed, parent application in the same country, without adding any new disclosure) that are to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of parent application, drafting and execution of any formal documents (such as transmittals and information disclosure statements), filing of application, and reporting to the client. Includes Divisional and Reissue Applications, and Reexamination Requests. Also includes PCT National Phase entry where the parent PCT International Application was previously filed in the same country. For PCT National Phase entry in other (non-domestic or "international") countries, use PA500. Note that (so-called "continuation-in-part") patent applications extending the scope of the disclosure (or adding "new matter" in the U.S.) in an earlier-filed application are included under PA310- 340. Also note  that government fees (and other "disbursements" in the U.S.) and external imaging expenses are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfUnRwCF7bXcPPj1Izs.label: Washington Superior Court - Whatcom County
http://lmss.sali.org/RfUnRwCF7bXcPPj1Izs.definition: Washington Superior Court - Whatcom County: A specific court located in Whatcom County, Washington that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfUzHHDIyxhUjGa9mI1.label: No Contest
http://lmss.sali.org/RfUzHHDIyxhUjGa9mI1.definition: No Contest (aka Nolo contendere) is a legal plea in which a defendant in a criminal case neither admits nor disputes the charges against them. This plea is often used as an alternative to pleading guilty or not guilty, allowing the defendant to avoid admitting guilt while still accepting punishment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfVOK1xj9nh3Tk5dRZ5.label: Exclusive Supplier Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RfVOK1xj9nh3Tk5dRZ5.definition: An Exclusive Supplier Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the exclusive right to supply goods or services to another party, thereby prohibiting the other party from obtaining those goods or services from any other source.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfXf27g03XAZTOicP78.label: Equipment Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/RfXf27g03XAZTOicP78.definition: An Equipment Related Agreement is a legally binding contract that governs the use, rental, purchase, or maintenance of specific equipment or machinery. These agreements detail terms such as ownership, responsibilities for maintenance and repair, payment arrangements, and conditions for returning or replacing the equipment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfYMpx6ooqiRae1gB0x.label: Counterpart Signatures Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RfYMpx6ooqiRae1gB0x.definition: A Counterpart Signatures Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for multiple copies of the same document to be signed separately, but still be considered as one original document.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rf_VRxncaTGqtXLG4DR.label: PA320 Non-Provisional Application Preparation - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/Rf_VRxncaTGqtXLG4DR.definition: All actions associated with completing a non-provisional utility or utility model (but not design or provisional) patent application that are to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Includes preparation of PCT, European and other regional applications when filed in the home country of the applicant. Note that government fees and external drafting expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfcfQz0nz5VI5iHiR90.label: Sedition
http://lmss.sali.org/RfcfQz0nz5VI5iHiR90.definition: Sedition is a crime against the government that involves inciting rebellion or resistance against lawful authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfdFbicHcYUHpa2L2U2.label: Implicit Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RfdFbicHcYUHpa2L2U2.definition: An Implicit Agreement is a contract or understanding inferred from the actions, behavior, or circumstances of the parties involved rather than from direct, explicit communication. Such agreements rely on the assumption that the parties have a mutual understanding based on their conduct and the surrounding context.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfdN15c44dyYEkhB4tR.label: Appellate Procedural Motions
http://lmss.sali.org/RfdN15c44dyYEkhB4tR.definition: Appellate Procedural Motions are requests made to an appellate court regarding the procedures of a case, such as substituting a party or expediting an appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfdsGohesGRhPjCfwDd.label: Luiseno
http://lmss.sali.org/RfdsGohesGRhPjCfwDd.definition: A Native American language spoken by the Luiseno people in Southern California.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rfgtsl3cveBJQwasdTQ.label: Red Light Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rfgtsl3cveBJQwasdTQ.definition: A Red Light Violation Claim involves a legal assertion that a driver has failed to comply with a red traffic light regulation, potentially leading to civil or administrative penalties. This claim can be part of broader traffic enforcement actions or disputes, often requiring adjudication or settlement.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rfl9CBKZ5O5PlWd0mq9.label: Joint Defense Group Member
http://lmss.sali.org/Rfl9CBKZ5O5PlWd0mq9.definition: A member of a Joint Defense Group.

http://lmss.sali.org/RflfcwIYLKrm5AYJX8s.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Vernon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RflfcwIYLKrm5AYJX8s.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Vernon County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Vernon County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfnYyacv7QlyD_171M2.label: PA610 Information Disclosure Statement - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RfnYyacv7QlyD_171M2.definition: All action associated with bringing prior art, or other information, to the attention of an Examiner outside the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under PA500. Note that Information Disclosure Statements that are filed with the application are included under PA500.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rfo855SOdcBh45JQeaB.label: Tax Invoice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rfo855SOdcBh45JQeaB.definition: A tax invoice is a type of fee invoice detail that provides a breakdown of the taxes charged for legal services rendered.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rfp3FLmS5d1KkQwcg33.label: Right of First Negotiation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rfp3FLmS5d1KkQwcg33.definition: A Right of First Negotiation Clause is a provision in a contract that grants one party the exclusive right to negotiate with the other party before any other potential buyers or sellers, typically in regards to a specific asset or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfpJfj2VyROWmlBXR8Y.label: PA640 Quasi-Judicial Administrative Proceedings - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RfpJfj2VyROWmlBXR8Y.definition: All action associated with completing a quasi-judicial proceeding before an administrative tribunal associated with a Patent Office outside of the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under PA500, including Appeals, Oppositions, Interferences and other ex-parte and inter-partes proceedings. Includes collecting evidence, preparing and filing motions, briefs, responses, replies, surreplies, and other documents, attending conferences, depositions, hearings, and other proceedings. Does not include requests for supervisory action ("Petitions" in the U.S.) under PA630. Note that external expenses are included under E100

http://lmss.sali.org/RfqSqIIE5qf82lRaTBZ.label: Achinese
http://lmss.sali.org/RfqSqIIE5qf82lRaTBZ.definition: Achinese is a language that belongs to the Austronesian language family and is spoken in the Aceh province of Indonesia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfrrIqKTh9me3Z5tlVD.label: Testicle Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RfrrIqKTh9me3Z5tlVD.definition: Testicle cancer, also known as testicular cancer, is a malignant tumor that originates in the tissues of one or both testicles, the male reproductive glands located in the scrotum. It includes various subtypes, such as seminomas and non-seminomas, and can cause symptoms like testicular lumps, swelling, and discomfort, often requiring treatments like surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RftL7w1KHiE4KqKXgdf.label: Bermudan Call Option Style
http://lmss.sali.org/RftL7w1KHiE4KqKXgdf.definition: A Bermudan Call Option Style is a type of option contract that can be exercised on specific dates during its life, typically more than one date but fewer than the continuous exercise rights of American options. This style offers a middle ground between the flexibility of American options and the strict single-date exercise of European options.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfuC0yNDKhOWj8FHvju.label: Credit Arrangement
http://lmss.sali.org/RfuC0yNDKhOWj8FHvju.definition: Credit Arrangement (also known as Creditor Priority or Investment Guarantee or Ranking) refers to the security, priority, or guarantee associated with a financial instrument, determining the order and likelihood of repayment in various scenarios, particularly in case of default or liquidation. This classification encompasses a range of assurances and hierarchical positions, from secured arrangements to government-backed guarantees to various levels of seniority and subordination in the capital structure.

http://lmss.sali.org/RfwjIqLfrhhnCE2TsmL.label: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RfwjIqLfrhhnCE2TsmL.definition: A COBRA claim is a legal action initiated by a former employee against their former employer for not complying with the U.S. law called the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA). COBRA requires employers with 20 or more employees to offer certain terminated employees and their eligible dependents the opportunity to continue their group health insurance coverage for a limited time after their employment ends. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable COBRA requirements, which can result in the loss of health insurance coverage for the affected individual and their dependents. Employers can face liability for violating COBRA, which can result in significant damages for the affected individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg0eYCEL8F2mZNzegLG.label: Firm Administrator
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg0eYCEL8F2mZNzegLG.definition: A Firm Administrator is a non-timekeeping provider who manages the operations and administrative tasks of a law firm.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg1FUWqjmQ3ClUqt8uH.label: L630 Processing (NOS)
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg1FUWqjmQ3ClUqt8uH.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily charges on a per GB, per custodian, or a flat/fixed fee basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg51VJguKy2cEMB8MQU.label: Amharic
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg51VJguKy2cEMB8MQU.definition: Amharic is a structured system of communication, consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters, specifically referring to the language spoken in Ethiopia and its legal context.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg7LdUvxMul9fGmqhDr.label: Mississippi Workers Compensation Opinions
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg7LdUvxMul9fGmqhDr.definition: Mississippi Workers Compensation Opinions are legal decisions made by the Mississippi State Courts regarding workers' compensation cases in Mississippi.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg84mIufn9P5PRG3Sg1.label: tk_level
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg84mIufn9P5PRG3Sg1.definition:
"The level of the timekeeper.   A full list of the codes to use can be found in the LEDES Revised Timekeeper Classifications Reference Document available on LEDES.org. 
"

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg8EBNoN6seWgXAWUMd.label: Spanish; Castilian
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg8EBNoN6seWgXAWUMd.definition: A Romance language originating in the Iberian Peninsula and spoken by over 500 million people worldwide, including in Spain, Latin America, and parts of the United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rg9ou5VEpO9X4a3p8Ns.label: E117 Trial exhibits
http://lmss.sali.org/Rg9ou5VEpO9X4a3p8Ns.definition: Trial exhibits are expenses related to the presentation of evidence in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgBl6wBl0BpLXZYtzGs.label: Motion for Relief due to Earlier Judgment's Release or Vacation

http://lmss.sali.org/RgBq3kUkMfNYtUi93XI.label: Material Adverse Effect Definition - Exceptions Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RgBq3kUkMfNYtUi93XI.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) is a term used in legal agreements to describe a significant negative change or event that could affect the value or operations of a company or asset.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgDCTIWJmAmtP06Wgn3.label: Verbal Act
http://lmss.sali.org/RgDCTIWJmAmtP06Wgn3.definition: Verbal Acts, also known as "operative words," are statements that have legal significance or create legal consequences independently of the truth of the content asserted in the statement. These statements are not considered hearsay because their relevance lies in the fact that they were made, rather than in the truthfulness of the content.
examples: In a contract case, the witness can testify to this verbal act: “I heard Smith say: ‘I will sell you Property X if you sell me Property Y.’”
In a defamation case, a witness can testify: “Smith said that Jones was a socialist.”
In an injury case, a witness could testify about hearing plaintiff cry out after the accident -- statements like “Call for help!” -- where the statement demonstrates that the plaintiff was conscious.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgF7ujwGuWAyir8hJ2F.label: Texas District Court - Brazoria County
http://lmss.sali.org/RgF7ujwGuWAyir8hJ2F.definition: A Texas District Court - Brazoria County is a specific court within the Texas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Brazoria County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgFOWv7pHAC7YARhD9O.label: Event Scheduled
http://lmss.sali.org/RgFOWv7pHAC7YARhD9O.definition: Event Scheduled refers to the status of an event that has been planned and has a set date and time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgG220j8hHyMJUlq2Iy.label: Theft from Motor Vehicle
http://lmss.sali.org/RgG220j8hHyMJUlq2Iy.definition: The theft of articles from a motor vehicle, whether locked or unlocked.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgGJ42FaxSIi6JWSbpH.label: L639 Quality assurance and control
http://lmss.sali.org/RgGJ42FaxSIi6JWSbpH.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgHKgBYfidbNNddNK2u.label: Individualized Restructuring
http://lmss.sali.org/RgHKgBYfidbNNddNK2u.definition: Individualized restructuring involves private negotiations between a debtor and one or more creditors to modify the terms of existing debt agreements. This process allows parties to tailor solutions to their specific needs without court intervention, often resulting in revised payment schedules, reduced interest rates, or partial debt forgiveness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgHUj7ZKoJL0s6JURcX.label: Suspension of Sentence
http://lmss.sali.org/RgHUj7ZKoJL0s6JURcX.definition: A Suspension of Sentence is a legal provision where a court imposes a sentence but delays or refrains from executing it, typically on certain conditions. This approach allows the offender to remain in the community under supervision, with the understanding that violating the conditions may result in the original sentence being imposed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgI0aQAlWJVu05i0Ptz.label: Matter Fees Discount or Credit
http://lmss.sali.org/RgI0aQAlWJVu05i0Ptz.definition: A Matter Fees Discount or Credit is a type of discount or credit applied to the fees charged for a specific legal matter or case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgIkxeLlMUgdaRvarT5.label: Turkish
