http://lmss.sali.org/RgIkxeLlMUgdaRvarT5.definition: Turkish (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Turkish language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgJO8cH5SRFiUKYsWFk.label: TR310 Application Preparation and Filing - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RgJO8cH5SRFiUKYsWFk.definition: All actions associated with completing a trademark or service mark application (including renewal applications) that is to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including obtaining the specimen of use from the client, scanning the specimen for electronic filing, discussion with the client to ascertain the dates of first use and first use in commerce, drafting and revision of the application, preparation and filing of the application by electronic or paper formats, and reporting the results to the client. This section includes all domestic trademark and service mark applications filed on the Principal or Supplemental Register. Note that government fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.
http://lmss.sali.org/RgJO8cH5SRFiUKYsWFk.pref_label: TR310 Application Preparation and Filing - Domestic

http://lmss.sali.org/RgODi9ftdYWYOGZpao6.label: Trial and Post-Trial Motion Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RgODi9ftdYWYOGZpao6.definition: Trial and Post-Trial Motion Practice refers to the legal procedures and actions taken by parties after a trial has concluded, including motions for a new trial, appeals, and other post-trial motions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgPGuacDwkSwCHphS7l.label: Cruel and Inhuman Treatment
http://lmss.sali.org/RgPGuacDwkSwCHphS7l.definition: The concept of "Cruel and Inhuman Treatment" refers to a claim made in a divorce case where one spouse alleges that the other has subjected them to severe physical or emotional abuse, making it impossible for them to continue the marriage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgPO0_bdCQIOa3ULZ7y.label: B210 Business Operations
http://lmss.sali.org/RgPO0_bdCQIOa3ULZ7y.definition: Issues related to debtor-in-possession operating in chapter 11 such as employee, vendor, tenant issues and other similar problems

http://lmss.sali.org/RgQLVqqo23cFKNa2n4P.label: Recoupment of Public Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RgQLVqqo23cFKNa2n4P.definition: Recoupment of public benefit refers to the action taken by a government agency to recover funds that have been overpaid to an individual or family under a public benefit program. This process may involve reducing future benefit payments, establishing repayment plans, or legal actions, and is aimed at maintaining the integrity and financial sustainability of the benefit program.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgRCZGTIbEFjQk6Kdha.label: Assault Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RgRCZGTIbEFjQk6Kdha.definition: Law relating to inflicting physical harm or unwanted physical contact upon a person or a threat or attempt to commit such an action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgS58TN6jwVhqTVxSlM.label: Intranet Implementation Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RgS58TN6jwVhqTVxSlM.definition: Intranet Implementation Services refers to the provision of consulting and management services for the development and deployment of internal computer networks within an organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgT3hiPFNllfpt00aHX.label: Expert
http://lmss.sali.org/RgT3hiPFNllfpt00aHX.definition: An expert is a person engaged on behalf of a party or party in interest to a dispute to provide services as a consulting or testifying expert. (A testifying expert would also be a "witness.")

http://lmss.sali.org/RgTAOwyM3X14mPgJflM.label: Time of Performance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RgTAOwyM3X14mPgJflM.definition: A Time of Performance Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the deadline or timeframe within which a party must fulfill their obligations under the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgTPvICekczbntNkqg4.label: D.C. Court of Appeals
http://lmss.sali.org/RgTPvICekczbntNkqg4.definition: The D.C. Court of Appeals is a court that hears appeals from lower courts in the District of Columbia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgUzw6xfhun5xfVT8ma.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Berks County
http://lmss.sali.org/RgUzw6xfhun5xfVT8ma.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Berks County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgV0GDy1p5PQCXleadL.label: Billing Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RgV0GDy1p5PQCXleadL.definition: The concept of Billing Management refers to the process of managing and organizing the financial transactions and records related to legal services provided by a law firm or legal department.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgV54oXgxhf8Ue1aYVd.label: Responsible Author
http://lmss.sali.org/RgV54oXgxhf8Ue1aYVd.definition: The Responsible Author is the individual accountable for the creation of a document. This person ensures the content's accuracy, completeness, and adherence to an organization's standards (e.g., legal standards, stylistic standards).

http://lmss.sali.org/RgWTun3b3mrKqP3fiEC.label: Post-Argument Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RgWTun3b3mrKqP3fiEC.definition: A post-argument brief is a written document submitted to an appellate court after oral arguments have been made, providing additional legal arguments or clarifications to support the party's position.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgZ0caJ_nR16ICy4Ko3.label: PA130 Document/File Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RgZ0caJ_nR16ICy4Ko3.definition: A narrowly defined task that includes creating and populating document and other databases or filing systems, that does not fit under other task codes below. Includes the planning, design, and overall management of this process. Work of outside vendors in building litigation support databases should be an expense under E100. Calendaring (or "docketing" in the U.S.) should be included under the appropriate task codes below for each matter unless, otherwise instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rgb1ovmiQ9A1GUxWiMA.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Mifflin County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rgb1ovmiQ9A1GUxWiMA.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Mifflin County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rgc3E8X3UPaUp9NDQMr.label: Access Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rgc3E8X3UPaUp9NDQMr.definition: An Access Clause is a provision in a contract that grants or restricts the right to enter or use a property or facility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgcODwztbwDeGR73Xav.label: Georgia District Court - Forsyth County
http://lmss.sali.org/RgcODwztbwDeGR73Xav.definition: A court located in Forsyth County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgcYpZhkBQt5qL99YT6.label: Employment Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RgcYpZhkBQt5qL99YT6.definition: Employment Status indicates the current state of an employee's relationship with an organization and is generally categorized as active, inactive, leave of absence, or terminated. This status is important for payroll, benefits administration, and compliance with labor laws, helping organizations manage their workforce effectively

http://lmss.sali.org/RgdepX5x7nmluAAyt6h.label: 871 IRS-Third Party 26 USC 7609 (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RgdepX5x7nmluAAyt6h.definition: Action filed under the Internal Revenue Code - Tax Reform Act of 1976 (P.L. 94-455) Third Party

http://lmss.sali.org/RgdtS7bI2kxQcBPVG5l.label: Press Release
http://lmss.sali.org/RgdtS7bI2kxQcBPVG5l.definition: A Press Release is an official statement issued to the media and other public platforms by an organization, company, or individual to disseminate news, announcements, or other information. It serves as a controlled method for conveying newsworthy updates to the public and/or stakeholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rge32jTsMN77AeMorfn.label: Investment Grade
http://lmss.sali.org/Rge32jTsMN77AeMorfn.definition: Investment Grade refers to a credit rating assigned to debt securities that are considered to have a relatively low risk of default. This classification indicates that the issuer of the security is likely to meet its payment obligations, making it suitable for more conservative investors. These ratings are assigned by credit rating agencies and generally include ratings from AAA to BBB on the Standard & Poor's and Fitch scales, and Aaa to Baa3 on the Moody's scale.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgfCndRaL8BAcfpiThP.label: Application to Employ
http://lmss.sali.org/RgfCndRaL8BAcfpiThP.definition: An Application to Employ is a formal request made by an individual or entity seeking employment in a bankruptcy case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RggP3SO950VqwsygEA5.label: Military Reserve Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/RggP3SO950VqwsygEA5.definition: Military Reserve Duty refers to the service in a military reserve force, which is composed of citizens who undergo training but typically serve part-time. Members of the reserve may be called to active duty during emergencies, conflicts, or other situations requiring additional manpower, and are otherwise obligated to participate in periodic training exercises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgkKbxs9okEV3kvzg3d.label: Client Tax ID
http://lmss.sali.org/RgkKbxs9okEV3kvzg3d.definition: The buyer's tax id number to which provider's taxes are charged.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgkTqmRjkexSr93YokY.label: Environmental Representation
http://lmss.sali.org/RgkTqmRjkexSr93YokY.definition: Environmental representation is a clause in merger and acquisition agreements where the selling party attests to the environmental condition of the assets being sold and ensures compliance with environmental laws. It serves to protect the buyer from unforeseen environmental liabilities and obligations that may arise post-acquisition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgoFZ2Ae9MZ3N5EZNBT.label: Illegality Doctrine
http://lmss.sali.org/RgoFZ2Ae9MZ3N5EZNBT.definition: The Illegality Doctrine is a legal defense used in civil litigation that argues that a plaintiff should not be able to recover damages if their claim is based on an illegal act or transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgosX7Fov7brVHrrsHP.label: Country of Birth
http://lmss.sali.org/RgosX7Fov7brVHrrsHP.definition: Country of Birth refers to the nation where an individual was born. This information is often used for legal purposes, such as determining nationality, eligibility for citizenship, or for various forms of identification. It is commonly recorded on birth certificates and passports.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rgp4MjAu5lZfrO6urG0.label: Tax Tier Taxable Amount
http://lmss.sali.org/Rgp4MjAu5lZfrO6urG0.definition: Tax Tier Taxable Amount refers to the portion of income or assets subject to taxation within a specific tax tier, as defined in the context of Tax Tier Detail.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgsvxYKhqRKNkjPVgxJ.label: Mediation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RgsvxYKhqRKNkjPVgxJ.definition: A mediation clause is a provision in a contract that requires the parties to attempt to resolve any disputes through mediation before pursuing legal action.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rgtado8LLSB6AHrpiuk.label: C300 Analysis and Advice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rgtado8LLSB6AHrpiuk.definition: This phase includes all tasks associated with analysis of both the facts and research performed (under C100 and C200) and communicating related opinions or advice to clients. Written communication, meetings, and telephone conversations during which advice is conveyed would all be captured by this phase.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgtlFP9wL8nEQ4Khh2u.label: Shelf Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/RgtlFP9wL8nEQ4Khh2u.definition: Shelf Registration is a process that allows a company to register a new issue of securities without having to sell the entire issue at once, enabling the company to sell portions of the issue over time. This method provides flexibility and efficiency in accessing capital markets as conditions become favorable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgvOKSeTwnMHbgt071z.label: Georgia Superior Court - Troup County
http://lmss.sali.org/RgvOKSeTwnMHbgt071z.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Troup County: A specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Troup County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RgwXo509JJpfvmXBqqV.label: Survivability Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RgwXo509JJpfvmXBqqV.definition: A Survivability Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies which obligations and rights of the parties will continue to be in effect after the termination or expiration of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rh1ZmkKI6R73nnYwrfX.label: Beans
http://lmss.sali.org/Rh1ZmkKI6R73nnYwrfX.definition: Beans are seeds from various species of the legume family (Fabaceae), known for their high protein, fiber, and nutrient content. They are consumed worldwide in a variety of culinary applications and are valued for their ability to improve soil fertility through nitrogen fixation.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rh44475gXAAvIp5O3Rd.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Howell County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rh44475gXAAvIp5O3Rd.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Howell County: A specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Howell County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rh4VCvmEdiv0Eb1nyCY.label: extend_data
http://lmss.sali.org/Rh4VCvmEdiv0Eb1nyCY.definition:
"Used to provide the name value pairs.  (See EXTEND_DATA Segment below)  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/Rh51oMpYnnkIQkUt41V.label: Non-Hearsay Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/Rh51oMpYnnkIQkUt41V.definition: Non-hearsay documents are written records that are admissible in court without the need for the author to testify, as they are considered exceptions to the hearsay rule. Examples include business records, public records, and learned treatises, which are deemed reliable due to their regular and official nature.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rh8kfJvBbvSgZmL504Q.label: Deponent
http://lmss.sali.org/Rh8kfJvBbvSgZmL504Q.definition: A person who is deposed in a deposition or makes an affidavit under oath.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhA1ai8KGTUaVhKjWp5.label: PA140 Budgeting
http://lmss.sali.org/RhA1ai8KGTUaVhKjWp5.definition: Covers developing, negotiating, and revising the budget for a matter that does not fit under other task codes below. Cost estimates which are included as part of other activities, such as reporting an Official Communication from a patent Office, should be included under the appropriate task codes below, unless otherwise instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhBgnef56iLBXYfPqWQ.label: Financial Concepts and Metrics
http://lmss.sali.org/RhBgnef56iLBXYfPqWQ.definition: Financial and operational indicators designed to evaluate the performance of engagements or transactions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhBvOCNsTuHs1L1cRSw.label: Supervised Release
http://lmss.sali.org/RhBvOCNsTuHs1L1cRSw.definition: In criminal justice, parole is the conditional release of an offender from incarceration, allowing them to serve the remainder of their sentence under community supervision, provided they comply with certain terms and conditions set by a parole board

http://lmss.sali.org/RhCLmyJ9TLbnSraEygi.label: Subordination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RhCLmyJ9TLbnSraEygi.definition: A subordination clause is a provision in a contract that places one obligation or agreement below another in priority, typically used in real estate transactions to subordinate a lease to a mortgage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhDPwGZJenoWvYuPAzV.label: Legal Engineering Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RhDPwGZJenoWvYuPAzV.definition: Legal Engineering Services refers to the provision of consulting and management services specifically tailored to the legal industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhDfTdqtsSPznclWiRE.label: Liquidator
http://lmss.sali.org/RhDfTdqtsSPznclWiRE.definition: A person appointed by law to liquidate assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhDqNupySkF2qsAiigB.label: EXP/FEE/INV_ADJ_TYPE
http://lmss.sali.org/RhDqNupySkF2qsAiigB.definition: A type of adjustment made to an invoice or fee statement, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhHLNxOW6JBZ7R9uH7U.label: New York Justice Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RhHLNxOW6JBZ7R9uH7U.definition: The New York Justice Court is a lower-level court within the New York State Courts system that handles minor civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhIQ5NcecT_27slV4KB.label: PA620 Preliminary Amendment - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RhIQ5NcecT_27slV4KB.definition: All action associated with revising an application prior to the examination of the application on its merits outside the home country of the applicant in an application filed under PA500, including preparation of amendments and revised drawings that do not affect the scope of the disclosure. Note that Preliminary Amendments that are filed with a continuing application, but do not affect the scope of the disclosure are included under PA550. Also note that preliminary amendments extending the scope of the disclosure in a parent application, and requiring the issuance of a new application number, are included under PA510-540.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhJ6Y2V2UWlySRIqoZ0.label: Amendment of Bylaws Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RhJ6Y2V2UWlySRIqoZ0.definition: An Amendment of Bylaws Clause is a provision within a legal document that allows for changes to be made to the bylaws of an organization or entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhJCSR4hhRWaYBDe7BF.label: C100 Fact Gathering
http://lmss.sali.org/RhJCSR4hhRWaYBDe7BF.definition: This phase includes all initial inquiries, meetings and instructions and the identification and collection of information relevant to the assignment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhM0ab89J6bNADGZjt9.label: Eviction for Nonpayment of Rent
http://lmss.sali.org/RhM0ab89J6bNADGZjt9.definition: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is a legal process through which a landlord seeks to remove a tenant from a rented property because the tenant has failed to pay the agreed-upon rent. This eviction process typically involves the landlord providing notice to the tenant, initiating legal proceedings, and obtaining a court order to regain possession of the property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhMjXchJCejHKsKf0dz.label: Domain Name Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RhMjXchJCejHKsKf0dz.definition: A domain name claim is a legal assertion by an individual or entity regarding the right to use a specific internet domain name. This claim often arises in the context of trademark disputes, cybersquatting, or domain name registration conflicts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhNl96zoCgI6solrSRV.label: Dangerous Condition of Premises
http://lmss.sali.org/RhNl96zoCgI6solrSRV.definition: A dangerous condition of premises refers to a hazardous situation or circumstance on a property that poses a risk of harm or injury to individuals who are lawfully present on the premises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhODoZEsVZp3nkeCKtJ.label: Main Proceeding (Foreign Insolvency)
http://lmss.sali.org/RhODoZEsVZp3nkeCKtJ.definition: A main proceeding in foreign insolvency is the primary insolvency case initiated in the debtor's center of main interests (COMI), typically where the debtor's principal place of business is located. This proceeding takes precedence over other insolvency proceedings and serves as the primary forum for administering the debtor's assets and restructuring efforts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhPIlWdA5ZkbV97SIha.label: U.S. Bureau of Justice Assistance
http://lmss.sali.org/RhPIlWdA5ZkbV97SIha.definition: The U.S. Bureau of Justice Assistance (BJA) is a specific governmental organization within the Office of Justice Programs that provides funding, training, and technical assistance to support law enforcement, courts, and other justice-related agencies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhPVhnve1MQnjMzFXHw.label: Capitalization Representations and Warranties
http://lmss.sali.org/RhPVhnve1MQnjMzFXHw.definition: A Capitalization Representations and Warranties is a legal concept that refers to the specific promises and guarantees made by a party in a contract regarding the accuracy and completeness of information related to the capitalization of a company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhPmRmpfrSEU2MzOj8R.label: B.B.A. (Bachelor of Business Administration)
http://lmss.sali.org/RhPmRmpfrSEU2MzOj8R.definition: A B.B.A. (Bachelor of Business Administration) is a four-year undergraduate degree centered on business and management studies. It signifies expertise in business principles and can lead to various corporate roles

http://lmss.sali.org/RhSS15bKH0If7iXJ0cH.label: Neutral Reference Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RhSS15bKH0If7iXJ0cH.definition: A Neutral Reference Clause is a clause in a contract that provides for a third-party to resolve disputes between the parties in an impartial manner, without favoring either party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhUKyVKbJz3m1giY8jG.label: Water Quality Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RhUKyVKbJz3m1giY8jG.definition: Water Quality Rights pertain to the legal entitlements and standards set to ensure the cleanliness and safety of water sources. This concept encompasses the right of individuals, communities, and ecosystems to have access to clean and uncontaminated water, as well as the regulatory measures imposed on entities to prevent pollution, manage waste discharge, and uphold the health and environmental standards associated with water sources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhUj-2XOkSeOgXSNQHd.label: WC530 Oral Argument
http://lmss.sali.org/RhUj-2XOkSeOgXSNQHd.definition: Preparing for oral argument, Argue an appeal, Travel to & from, Pre and post argument communication re appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhUwaBjg0AFfnJkZgYo.label: Acquiror
http://lmss.sali.org/RhUwaBjg0AFfnJkZgYo.definition: An acquiror is the surviving company or entity once a merger takes place. Also known as an M&A Buyer, an Acquiror is a person or entity that acquires another company or business through a merger or acquisition, and can be classified as a Strategic Buyer, Financial Sponsor, or Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhYnhgokx2efn6ro7th.label: Florida Court of Appeals - 2d District
http://lmss.sali.org/RhYnhgokx2efn6ro7th.definition: The Florida Court of Appeals - 2d District is a specific court within the Florida District Court of Appeals that hears appeals from trial courts in its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhZIlhBBQT0GZAPE5uc.label: PA250 Publication Watches
http://lmss.sali.org/RhZIlhBBQT0GZAPE5uc.definition: All actions associated with planning, completing, and reporting the results of periodic searches for new publications in connection with a specific assignee, area of technology, patent application, or issued patent. For example, this may include watching the file history of published applications for new Official Communications, responses, and/or publication for opposition. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhaZNQoWTFOFAw7x6Oc.label: Urethane and Other Foam Product (except Polystyrene) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/RhaZNQoWTFOFAw7x6Oc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing plastics foam products (except polystyrene).

http://lmss.sali.org/RhalQvSVxajqnLtE1Ez.label: 530 General (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RhalQvSVxajqnLtE1Ez.definition: Action by a federal or state prisoner currently in custody challenging the legality of confinement or other punishment. This includes claims alleging illegalities that occurred in trial (for example, ineffective assistance of counsel), sentencing (including fines and restitution orders), or disciplinary proceedings in prison (for example, loss of good time credits). Habeas petition under 28 U.S.C. § 2254 or prisoner habeas under 28 U.S.C. § 2241.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhamdxU4pSj2gQNPR6T.label: B310 Claims Administration and Objections
http://lmss.sali.org/RhamdxU4pSj2gQNPR6T.definition: Specific claim inquiries; bar date motions; analyses, objections and allowances of claims

http://lmss.sali.org/Rhc05UTwDLyZk96B8m5.label: Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker
http://lmss.sali.org/Rhc05UTwDLyZk96B8m5.definition: This visa (in the U.S.,  L-1B visa) is designed for foreign workers with specialized knowledge related to the field, products, or processes of their destination-country-based employer (e.g., U.S.-based employer). In the United States, this non-immigrant visa allows these specialized knowledge employees to be transferred from a foreign office to a U.S. office within the same company for up to five years.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhcIrFyGsYXDPO34SCt.label: Injury by Fellow Servant
http://lmss.sali.org/RhcIrFyGsYXDPO34SCt.definition: An injury caused by a co-worker or fellow employee, which may be used as a defense in a civil litigation case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhceZsFaOSAIBa7BX1v.label: Mortgage Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RhceZsFaOSAIBa7BX1v.definition: A Mortgage Agreement is a legal contract between a lender and borrower that outlines the terms and conditions of a loan used to purchase a property, including the repayment schedule and consequences of default.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rhf2lKSfLjUIErLiUTo.label: Tobacco Liability Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/Rhf2lKSfLjUIErLiUTo.definition: Tobacco Liability Claims are legal claims brought against tobacco companies for harm caused by their products, typically involving allegations of product liability and personal injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhkGSikcz67WP0eaqlF.label: Tax Total Detail Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RhkGSikcz67WP0eaqlF.definition: Tax Total Detail Expense refers to a specific type of expense related to tax details, which is a subcategory of the broader concept of tax details.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhnHQvKZZUC9aclE7QK.label: Barley
http://lmss.sali.org/RhnHQvKZZUC9aclE7QK.definition: Barley is a cereal crop belonging to the species Hordeum vulgare, known for its versatility and use in food, animal feed, and brewing. It is one of the oldest cultivated grains and plays a significant role in various culinary traditions and industrial applications.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rhoynp2M8yyCiYOwZft.label: Contact County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rhoynp2M8yyCiYOwZft.definition: Contact County refers to the geographic location of a person or entity's contact information, specifically the county in which they are located.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhpBm69SasZhZfeaz11.label: Usufruct
http://lmss.sali.org/RhpBm69SasZhZfeaz11.definition: Usufruct is a legal right granted to an individual to use, enjoy, and derive benefit from another's property without altering its substance or depleting its value. Common in civil law systems, this arrangement allows the usufructuary to exploit the property for a specified period or for their lifetime, after which the property reverts back to the owner or another designated party

http://lmss.sali.org/RhpHSn02gx8Bc6vKb1Y.label: Exemption of Presumption of Abuse Form
http://lmss.sali.org/RhpHSn02gx8Bc6vKb1Y.definition: A form used in bankruptcy cases to request exemption from the presumption of abuse, which assumes that a debtor's income is too high to qualify for Chapter 7 bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rhpdjd9p358e9Rkel80.label: Employment and Labor Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/Rhpdjd9p358e9Rkel80.definition: An employment-related agreement refers to a broad category of legally binding contracts that govern various aspects of the employer-employee relationship, such as Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs) negotiated between labor unions and employers to set terms and conditions of employment, Compensation Related Agreements detailing how compensation and benefits are structured, and Retention Related Agreements designed to retain key employees through incentives or contractual obligations. These agreements serve to define the rights, responsibilities, and expectations of both parties involved in the employment relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhpzdUQII7ofiS6SGGB.label: Landscape Buffer Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RhpzdUQII7ofiS6SGGB.definition: A Landscape Buffer Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the preservation of a natural area between two properties to provide a visual or physical barrier.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rhq_wTGzdRaGdtN6Xs8.label: TR620 Preliminary Amendment - International
http://lmss.sali.org/Rhq_wTGzdRaGdtN6Xs8.definition: All action associated with revising an application prior to the examination of the application on its merits in the home country of the applicant for an application filed under TR500, including preparation of amendments and revised drawings that does not materially alter the original drawing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhraLrb_xSHSO3h3wi0.label: X303 Bates Stamping/ Control Numbers
http://lmss.sali.org/RhraLrb_xSHSO3h3wi0.definition: Any Bates labels costs or other type of image or numbering associated with a document collection

http://lmss.sali.org/RhsOlUUEvEWJeMc6rI2.label: Limited Partnership Certificate Containing Falsehood
http://lmss.sali.org/RhsOlUUEvEWJeMc6rI2.definition: A Limited Partnership Certificate Containing Falsehood is a legal claim related to contracts and quasi-contracts, where a party has provided false information in a certificate related to a limited partnership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhsqoHcnBa85B7sx4ks.label: Florida County Court - Washington County
http://lmss.sali.org/RhsqoHcnBa85B7sx4ks.definition: Florida County Court - Washington County: A court of limited jurisdiction in Florida that handles civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Washington County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RhwOX3v5hArOvqcsngs.label: San Carlos Apache Tribe of the San Carlos Reservation

http://lmss.sali.org/RhxDxh9s5K4frlHSAtx.label: Annual Bonus Eligibility Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RhxDxh9s5K4frlHSAtx.definition: A provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which an employee is eligible to receive an additional payment on an annual basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri0YceOp2WCKGFBMaZt.label: Theft from Coin-Operated Machine
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri0YceOp2WCKGFBMaZt.definition: A theft from a machine or device which is operated or activated by the use of coins.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri4LGaOgWzMWy2yX79D.label: Hemolytic Anemias
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri4LGaOgWzMWy2yX79D.definition: Hemolytic Anemias are a group of conditions characterized by the premature destruction of red blood cells, leading to a decreased number of circulating red blood cells and a resultant anemia. The condition can be caused by intrinsic factors, such as genetic defects, or extrinsic factors, such as autoimmune reactions or infections.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri4VCm5wJTuwU7RBeBE.label: Contact Physical Address
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri4VCm5wJTuwU7RBeBE.definition: A physical location where a person or entity can be reached, which is a subcategory of contact information.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri5heF2CFMzKFkpdvXc.label: Critical Vendor Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri5heF2CFMzKFkpdvXc.definition: A Critical Vendor Motion is a request made by a bankrupt company to pay certain vendors in full, rather than in accordance with the usual bankruptcy payment schedule, in order to ensure the continued supply of essential goods or services.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri5yTyCW5b9IiLX2A9W.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri5yTyCW5b9IiLX2A9W.definition: Squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) is a type of skin cancer that originates in the squamous cells, which make up the middle and outer layers of the skin. It can grow more rapidly than basal cell carcinoma and has a higher risk of spreading to other parts of the body, requiring treatments such as surgical excision, radiation therapy, and, in some cases, chemotherapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ri7BLyFGWrHsy5PgECY.label: Teacher-Pupil Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/Ri7BLyFGWrHsy5PgECY.definition: A legal privilege that protects confidential communications between a teacher and their student from being disclosed in court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiARhF7gFzdfGxNIuZY.label: Cryptocurrency
http://lmss.sali.org/RiARhF7gFzdfGxNIuZY.definition: A cryptocurrency is a digital or virtual currency that is secured by cryptography, which makes it nearly impossible to counterfeit or double-spend.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiEbO1Srd4KMBM6So8S.label: Physical Incapacity
http://lmss.sali.org/RiEbO1Srd4KMBM6So8S.definition: Physical incapacity refers to a person's inability to perform certain tasks or engage in specific activities due to physical limitations, often caused by illness, injury, or disability. This condition can impact an individual's daily life, work, or participation in legal processes, and may require accommodations or adjustments under applicable laws, such as the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

http://lmss.sali.org/RiH6SYLZpTYe86Ax3pJ.label: PA270 Status Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RiH6SYLZpTYe86Ax3pJ.definition: All actions associated with determining the status of a published or unpublished patent application, or issued patent, including application and/or database review and forwarding report to client. Includes annuity and/or maintenance fee status investigations. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiKVPwWrNTFKiAr4s14.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Luna County
http://lmss.sali.org/RiKVPwWrNTFKiAr4s14.definition: A court located in Luna County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiMM1BYwX85twMkqv2Q.label: Invoice Description
http://lmss.sali.org/RiMM1BYwX85twMkqv2Q.definition: A description of the services provided by a lawyer or law firm, included in an invoice for fees charged.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiPQBt7SDRx-w7pavii.label: X142 Settlement Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RiPQBt7SDRx-w7pavii.definition: Any settlement costs paid by the law firm or legal vendor on behalf of the client that have not been prepaid by the client

http://lmss.sali.org/RiPvXHeWYaWVdBgIxpc.label: Blood Disorders Treated by Transplantation
http://lmss.sali.org/RiPvXHeWYaWVdBgIxpc.definition: Hematological disorders treated by bone marrow or stem cell transplantation involve diseases of the blood or bone marrow that require transplantation as a primary treatment option. These disorders typically include severe cases of leukemia, lymphoma, and other blood cancers, where conventional treatments have proven insufficient or are unsuitable.
http://lmss.sali.org/RiPvXHeWYaWVdBgIxpc.pref_label: Hematological Disorders Treated by Bone Marrow or Stem Cell Transplantation

http://lmss.sali.org/RiQEhL2NxPMLEwsFoUV.label: Erzya
http://lmss.sali.org/RiQEhL2NxPMLEwsFoUV.definition: Erzya is a Finno-Ugric language spoken by the Erzya people in Russia and is a subcategory of the Language class in the ontology.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiQHdRDZfaAIOlPy9vf.label: Bid
http://lmss.sali.org/RiQHdRDZfaAIOlPy9vf.definition: A Bid refers to a formal offer submitted by an individual or entity to undertake a specific project or provide certain goods or services at a stated price, often in response to an invitation to bid or request for proposal. This process is commonly used in public and private sector procurement to ensure competitive and fair selection of contractors or suppliers.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiQmbZDVlZqfNLx9f4O.label: 400 State Reapportionment (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RiQmbZDVlZqfNLx9f4O.definition: Action filed under the Reapportionment Act of 1929 Ch. 28, 46 Stat. 21, 2 U.S.C. § 2a.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiRZCIYSrlWbUE4T76i.label: Law Firm
http://lmss.sali.org/RiRZCIYSrlWbUE4T76i.definition: A law firm is a business entity with one or more lawyers and allied legal professionals to engage in the practice of law. It provides legal services to clients, including legal advice, representation in legal proceedings, and assistance with various legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiSet6MT9RLX2H3PCqC.label: Retainage Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RiSet6MT9RLX2H3PCqC.definition: A retainage clause is a provision in a contract that allows the withholding of a portion of payment until the completion of the project or fulfillment of certain conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiTUO750LAdgZQOGZox.label: Catastrophic Health Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/RiTUO750LAdgZQOGZox.definition: Catastrophic health insurance is a type of health coverage geared towards young adults under 30 and some low-income individuals who are exempt from other insurance requirements. These policies usually have lower premiums but higher out-of-pocket costs and are designed to protect the insured from major medical expenses, such as those incurred from severe accidents or illnesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiU7G7CzsM0qszsqDm4.label: Irrevocable Power of Attorney Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RiU7G7CzsM0qszsqDm4.definition: An irrevocable power of attorney clause is a provision in a contract that grants authority to act on behalf of another person that cannot be revoked by the grantor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiV5HHhaHN0pKJWDG4P.label: Motion to Supplement Pleading
http://lmss.sali.org/RiV5HHhaHN0pKJWDG4P.definition: A Motion to Supplement Pleading is a formal request to add additional information or documents to a previously filed legal document, such as a complaint or answer, in order to provide more complete or accurate information to the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiVfZ7BP4PauSUimCUX.label: Injunctions, Restraining Orders, and Provisional Remedies Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RiVfZ7BP4PauSUimCUX.definition: The practice of seeking and obtaining court orders, such as injunctions, restraining orders, and provisional remedies, before a trial takes place, as part of pretrial motion practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiYElk4o1PAzXUgf6xy.label: address_info segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RiYElk4o1PAzXUgf6xy.definition: "This is not an actual segment of the file, per se, like the rest of the segments listed above.  This segment contains a list of fields that will be used to represent address information.  When an address is requested in a segment, that element will be listed and all fields in this segment will be the children of that element. The EXTEND_HEADER option was purposely omitted from this segment."

http://lmss.sali.org/RiYwKEna4NZ311TVYJ2.label: Wage
http://lmss.sali.org/RiYwKEna4NZ311TVYJ2.definition: A wage is a payment or income earned by an individual in exchange for their labor or services, typically provided on an hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly basis. It represents the compensation received for work performed and is often subject to taxes and deductions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiZJZ6P6xTV8r3rhd9b.label: Benefits a Party
http://lmss.sali.org/RiZJZ6P6xTV8r3rhd9b.definition: Whom does Contractual Directionality benefit? Example:  Party A indemnifying Party B benefits Party B. Example: Party A receiving Party B's goods benefits Party A.

http://lmss.sali.org/RidbKI3ygnA3bOyKTTF.label: Data Model Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RidbKI3ygnA3bOyKTTF.definition: Risk of incorrect decision making due to reliance on faulty or misapplied mathematical models.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ridussg3A6k1qic74Jm.label: Choice of Forum Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Ridussg3A6k1qic74Jm.definition: A choice of forum clause is a contractual provision that designates a specific jurisdiction or court where any disputes arising from the contract will be resolved.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rif2nijVwenF5TjHlpZ.label: Queer
http://lmss.sali.org/Rif2nijVwenF5TjHlpZ.definition: Queer is an umbrella term used to describe a sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression that does not conform to heteronormative definitions and expectations. The term has been reclaimed by some in the LGBTQIA+ community and is often used for its inclusivity, though its meaning can vary among individuals and communities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RigrpcSYFHatuFsvX3s.label: Firm Information Services Personnel
http://lmss.sali.org/RigrpcSYFHatuFsvX3s.definition: Firm Information Services Personnel, also known as Firm IT Personnel, are professionals responsible for managing and maintaining the information technology infrastructure within a law firm or legal organization. They ensure the availability, security, and efficient operation of computer systems, networks, and data resources to support the firm's legal and administrative functions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RihNVfYYtmWzQWciwxq.label: Criminal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RihNVfYYtmWzQWciwxq.definition: A Criminal Court is a specific type of court that has jurisdiction over criminal cases and is responsible for administering proceedings related to criminal law violations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiijRwBsHpillifrZH0.label: Arkansas Circuit Court - Madison Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RiijRwBsHpillifrZH0.definition: A court located in Madison County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its designated geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RijIqw1HEfQF4ctjWUl.label: Defendant
http://lmss.sali.org/RijIqw1HEfQF4ctjWUl.definition: A defendant or respondent is a person or group against whom a criminal or civil action is brought. Actions include dispute matters (litigation, arbitration or mediation) or bankruptcy matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rijn2Efl5I4ixKTA86M.label: Spinal Cord Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/Rijn2Efl5I4ixKTA86M.definition: Spinal cord disorders involve conditions that affect the spinal cord, impairing its function and potentially causing a range of neurological and physical disabilities. These disorders can result from trauma, disease, or degeneration, impacting the transmission of nerve signals between the brain and the rest of the body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RijoEB1Jm3daO9tu8Xc.label: Georgia Superior Court - Mitchell County
http://lmss.sali.org/RijoEB1Jm3daO9tu8Xc.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Mitchell County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has the authority to hear and decide civil and criminal cases within Mitchell County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rijz2yDnioeblXoMdxo.label: Litigation Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/Rijz2yDnioeblXoMdxo.definition: Litigation Risk refers to the potential for negative consequences arising from legal disputes, claims, or lawsuits involving an organization or its representatives. This can result from contractual breaches, regulatory noncompliance, intellectual property infringement, or negligence, potentially leading to financial losses, reputational damage, or operational disruptions, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance, credibility, and sustainability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RikjKAB2GQa9wClhzmp.label: Rent Control Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RikjKAB2GQa9wClhzmp.definition: A rent control claim typically involves a dispute or legal action related to rent control regulations imposed by local or state governments. These claims can arise when landlords or tenants believe that the rent control policies have been violated, whether through excessive rent increases, failure to provide required services, or other alleged breaches of rent control laws. The resolution of such claims often involves legal proceedings, where the rights and responsibilities of landlords and tenants are assessed in light of applicable rent control regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RinXl4urWx7TwIp2Bkk.label: UTBMS MH00 Closing Matters
http://lmss.sali.org/RinXl4urWx7TwIp2Bkk.definition: The UTBMS MH00 Closing Matters is a subcategory of the UTBMS Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) code set, which pertains to the legal tasks and activities involved in finalizing a merger or acquisition transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RinkUCYEWeC702L4eg8.label: Knowledge Management Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RinkUCYEWeC702L4eg8.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's collection and management of knowledge, including intellectual property, organizational or operational information and records, and scientific data. This includes the potential for negative consequences arising from an organization's inability to effectively capture, store, share, and leverage its collective knowledge and expertise. This can result from poor knowledge management practices, inadequate systems, or employee turnover, potentially leading to inefficiencies, loss of intellectual capital, or reduced innovation and competitiveness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RinqHf65TtUhr762WKq.label: Personal Jurisdiction
http://lmss.sali.org/RinqHf65TtUhr762WKq.definition: The concept of Personal Jurisdiction refers to the power of a court to hear and decide a case involving a particular defendant, based on the defendant's connection to the forum state, as determined by the legal rules and principles governing jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RioWfXa6EStqdylbbgr.label: L600 Identification (NOS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RioWfXa6EStqdylbbgr.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories) Primarily hourly charges.

http://lmss.sali.org/RisfldMmDGDaQLFIg22.label: Surety
http://lmss.sali.org/RisfldMmDGDaQLFIg22.definition: A person or entity who promises to pay another's debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RiuB3WjtPaioVphDpqL.label: Proposed Court Filings
http://lmss.sali.org/RiuB3WjtPaioVphDpqL.definition: Proposed Court Filings are documents submitted to a court for consideration, which include proposed instructions, conclusions of law, orders, and findings of fact, and are part of the trial court practice documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RixO9y0KIw6qMu5JNNx.label: Motion to Abstain and Remand
http://lmss.sali.org/RixO9y0KIw6qMu5JNNx.definition: A Motion to Abstain and Remand is a request made in a bankruptcy case to temporarily halt proceedings and send the case back to a lower court for further review or action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RixnrA7cMNoJE25gFQ2.label: Stand Your Ground Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RixnrA7cMNoJE25gFQ2.definition: A Stand Your Ground Claim asserts a person's right to use force, including lethal force, in self-defense without the duty to retreat when faced with a perceived threat. This legal concept is grounded in the broader principle of self-defense and is often associated with gun rights and the use of firearms for personal protection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RizXelmTsUaJQ9sMAF1.label: Palauan
http://lmss.sali.org/RizXelmTsUaJQ9sMAF1.definition: Palauan is a language spoken in Palau, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RizewCP99aByX4bCvDa.label: Inupiat Community of the Arctic Slope

http://lmss.sali.org/Rizz1F27S757yJJ2KPi.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Fayette County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rizz1F27S757yJJ2KPi.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Fayette County is a court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Fayette County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj1p7FbFSLxlWfUlSPZ.label: Traffic Violation Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj1p7FbFSLxlWfUlSPZ.definition: A traffic violation claim is a type of criminal claim that involves the violation of traffic laws, such as speeding or running a red light, and the legal proceedings that follow.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj1sEpYPgArTlShkzm2.label: CLIENT_COUNTRY
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj1sEpYPgArTlShkzm2.definition: The concept of CLIENT_COUNTRY refers to the country of origin or location of a client, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic legal invoicing.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj2XfxoaqSzTELGNzBd.label: Fear
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj2XfxoaqSzTELGNzBd.definition: Fear is an emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger, usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj2eDvuk41g7ZTYP1LW.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Stark County (10th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj3K3GgCUDFW3WWZSB8.label: Motion for Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj3K3GgCUDFW3WWZSB8.definition: A Motion for Judgment is a request made by a party in a trial court asking the judge to make a decision in their favor based on the evidence presented, without the need for a trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj3zmGrjca6Tz79Qb6V.label: Criminal Fine
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj3zmGrjca6Tz79Qb6V.definition: A criminal fine is a monetary penalty imposed as a punishment for a criminal offense.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj5kjN2MfqXZWYukoJj.label: Request for Extension of Time to File Statement of Use

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj77Qrw6kgfSl2QG11l.label: Kansas District Court - Neosho County, Erie
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj77Qrw6kgfSl2QG11l.definition: A court located in Neosho County, Erie, Kansas that has jurisdiction over cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj8CP6YnshKY7MmCXai.label: Athlete Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj8CP6YnshKY7MmCXai.definition: The Athlete Visa (in the U.S., P-1A visa) is a non-immigrant visa specifically designed for internationally recognized athletes who wish to enter the destination country (e.g., U.S.) to participate in individual or team events. In the United States, this visa allows the athlete to stay for the duration of the competition, event, or performance, with a maximum initial period of up to 5 years for individual athletes and 1 year for athletic teams, with the possibility of extension.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj8YjyXQqcyq2KLPxPv.label: Interruption of Services Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj8YjyXQqcyq2KLPxPv.definition: An Interruption of Services Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the rights and obligations of parties in the event that services are interrupted or unavailable due to unforeseen circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rj97dODoMYEHkBffVjz.label: Grapefruits
http://lmss.sali.org/Rj97dODoMYEHkBffVjz.definition: Grapefruits are large citrus fruits from the Citrus × paradisi species, known for their tart to semi-sweet flavor and distinctive segmented flesh. They are consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary applications, valued for their high vitamin C content, dietary fiber, and potential health benefits, including antioxidant properties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjAR6LD9HeCJgI2GEuJ.label: New York Court on the Judiciary
http://lmss.sali.org/RjAR6LD9HeCJgI2GEuJ.definition: The New York Court on the Judiciary is a specialized court within the New York State Courts system that is responsible for investigating and disciplining judges who have engaged in misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjAfjZzqaSvOTP7iz9N.label: Washington Superior Court - Columbia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RjAfjZzqaSvOTP7iz9N.definition: Washington Superior Court - Columbia County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Columbia County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjDhDDjUUDTnXvhNYE2.label: Arugula
http://lmss.sali.org/RjDhDDjUUDTnXvhNYE2.definition: Arugula, also known as rocket, is a leafy green vegetable from the Eruca vesicaria species, known for its peppery flavor and tender texture. It is commonly used in salads, sandwiches, and as a garnish, valued for its nutritional benefits, including high levels of vitamins A, C, and K, as well as calcium and antioxidants.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjFYr8GZjMayrsvnEqX.label: Collateral Appeal
http://lmss.sali.org/RjFYr8GZjMayrsvnEqX.definition: A collateral appeal, also known as a collateral attack, is a legal challenge to a criminal conviction that occurs outside the direct appeal process. Instead of challenging the validity of the conviction based on the record of the original trial (as in a direct appeal), a collateral appeal addresses issues such as newly discovered evidence, ineffective assistance of counsel, or constitutional violations that weren't raised during the trial or on direct appeal. This form of relief is often sought after all direct appeals have been exhausted.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjGC9ag68KwoZVYSjOB.label: Fixation in a Tangible Medium
http://lmss.sali.org/RjGC9ag68KwoZVYSjOB.definition: Fixation in a Tangible Medium, a cornerstone of copyright law, requires that a work must be fixed in a medium of expression from which it can be perceived, reproduced, or otherwise communicated. This concept ensures that copyright protects not the idea itself but its expression in a form that can be physically or digitally captured and reproduced.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjId5qUUyYquw8QeFRC.label: Stale Rent
http://lmss.sali.org/RjId5qUUyYquw8QeFRC.definition: Rent that remains unpaid or uncollected for a prolonged period of time, which may be used as a defense in a civil litigation case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjK5o8Fbw2loUw6HIBr.label: Motion to Waive Filing of Excerpts of Record
http://lmss.sali.org/RjK5o8Fbw2loUw6HIBr.definition: A Motion to Waive Filing of Excerpts of Record is a request made to the court to excuse a party from submitting certain portions of the record in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjKL1UdfWL1FCPVhnbI.label: Real Estate, Rental and Leasing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RjKL1UdfWL1FCPVhnbI.definition: The industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting, leasing, or otherwise allowing the use of tangible or intangible assets, and establishments providing related services. The major portion of this sector comprises establishments that rent, lease, or otherwise allow the use of their own assets by others. The assets may be tangible, as is the case of real estate and equipment, or intangible, as is the case with patents and trademarks. This industry group also includes establishments primarily engaged in managing real estate for others, selling, renting and/or buying real estate for others, and appraising real estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjLJSsBxaQyCliIG1ik.label: X105 Word Processing
http://lmss.sali.org/RjLJSsBxaQyCliIG1ik.definition: Any in-house word processing fees. Excludes word processing associated with a Translation (X139).

http://lmss.sali.org/RjLrw4pDrBHKT8XC2lf.label: Merger of Idea and Expression
http://lmss.sali.org/RjLrw4pDrBHKT8XC2lf.definition: The Merger of Idea and Expression doctrine in copyright law applies when an idea and its expression are so intertwined that the idea cannot be expressed in any other way, making the expression non-protectable. This principle recognizes that when only one or very few ways exist to express an idea, protecting such expression would effectively grant a monopoly over the idea itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjM80CC0FA0G2sKxmlb.label: Buyer
http://lmss.sali.org/RjM80CC0FA0G2sKxmlb.definition: A buyer or purchaser generally means a person, company or entity contracting with a seller for services or merchandise to be provided or delivered for a named individual. In a strict legal sense, a buyer may also include someone who acquires title to something by deed, devise, execution, prescription, possession, occupancy, or escheat.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjNGPD1lRULk52cpTgb.label: Virgin Islands Municipal Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RjNGPD1lRULk52cpTgb.definition: The Virgin Islands Municipal Court is a court of limited jurisdiction within the Virgin Islands Territory Courts, responsible for hearing cases related to local ordinance violations and misdemeanors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjQP37RLKtTQzjd7UbR.label: US Chapter 7 Bankruptcy
http://lmss.sali.org/RjQP37RLKtTQzjd7UbR.definition: Chapter 7 bankruptcy, sometimes referred to as liquidation bankruptcy, is the most common type of bankruptcy in the U.S., and the most basic form of bankruptcy. Chapter 7 provides liquidation of an individual's property and then distributes it to creditors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjRpCaBv1XGApsSFM6u.label: Letter of Intent
http://lmss.sali.org/RjRpCaBv1XGApsSFM6u.definition: A Letter of Intent is a formal document that outlines the preliminary terms and conditions of an agreement between two or more parties. While generally not legally binding, it serves as a roadmap for future negotiations or agreements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjRtAyw9wyKc3tVk8Gs.label: Connecticut Circuit Court - Appellate Division
http://lmss.sali.org/RjRtAyw9wyKc3tVk8Gs.definition: The Connecticut Circuit Court - Appellate Division is a court within the Connecticut State Courts system that hears appeals from lower courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjSYnA2eFMtT4iBjXrC.label: Covenant Compliance
http://lmss.sali.org/RjSYnA2eFMtT4iBjXrC.definition: The concept of Covenant Compliance refers to the fulfillment of specific obligations or promises made by a party in a legal matter, as outlined in a contract or agreement, in order to meet the conditions necessary for the closing of the transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjT7upiPt7T4Pp0jalP.label: Options - Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RjT7upiPt7T4Pp0jalP.definition: Options are financial instruments that are derivatives based on the value of underlying securities such as stocks. An options contract offers the buyer the opportunity to buy or sell-depending on the type of contract they hold-the underlying asset. Unlike futures, the holder is not required to buy or sell the asset if they choose not to.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjTeQwFB9k2FjOWJuUB.label: Arraignment Cancellation
http://lmss.sali.org/RjTeQwFB9k2FjOWJuUB.definition: Arraignment Cancellation refers to the act of revoking or annulling an arraignment, which is a formal reading of criminal charges in court, before a trial takes place.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjUNVr2amglqRDrHJ5k.label: Brain Stem Death
http://lmss.sali.org/RjUNVr2amglqRDrHJ5k.definition: Brain stem death is a medical condition where an individual has irreversibly lost all brain stem functions, which are responsible for consciousness and vital bodily functions, while other parts of the brain may still have activity. It is often considered a criterion for legal death in many jurisdictions, as the loss of brain stem function is critical for maintaining life.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjVgVOLkDyEKic8xZS0.label: Credit Rating
http://lmss.sali.org/RjVgVOLkDyEKic8xZS0.definition: A Credit Rating is an evaluation of the creditworthiness of a borrower or debt instrument, assigned by a credit rating agency, reflecting the likelihood of timely repayment of principal and interest. Credit ratings range from high grades, indicating low risk, to low grades, indicating higher risk of default.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjVpll0UmmbDsm4i6IF.label: Landlord Indemnification Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RjVpll0UmmbDsm4i6IF.definition: A Landlord Indemnification Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that requires the tenant to compensate the landlord for any losses or damages incurred as a result of the tenant's actions or negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjVw48aFHTaGb_dbzGd.label: PA740 Licensing
http://lmss.sali.org/RjVw48aFHTaGb_dbzGd.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing license.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjZYQdnDbpjxRszPUNr.label: Adoption, Surrogacy, and Paternity Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RjZYQdnDbpjxRszPUNr.definition: Laws relating to adoption, surrogacy and paternity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjeDD9iABasKcahaj3M.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cole County
http://lmss.sali.org/RjeDD9iABasKcahaj3M.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Cole County: A court of law in the state of Missouri that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Cole County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjevb3ESS3v4df5PaTH.label: Data Visualization Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjevb3ESS3v4df5PaTH.definition: Data Visualization Management refers to the management of data in a way that allows for the creation and interpretation of visual representations of that data.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjh7wv7JRfbTfRxnhMj.label: Washington Shorelines Hearing Board
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjh7wv7JRfbTfRxnhMj.definition: The Washington Shorelines Hearing Board is a specialized court within the Washington State Courts system that hears cases related to the use and development of shorelines in the state.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjheI8DK7VWPU7SMAYF.label: Certificate of Limited Partnership
http://lmss.sali.org/RjheI8DK7VWPU7SMAYF.definition: A Certificate of Limited Partnership is a legal document filed with a state's Secretary of State or similar government agency to officially register a limited partnership (LP). It typically includes information such as the partnership's name, purpose, registered agent, and the names of its general and limited partners.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rji2CTzHE8qhwSeWBp2.label: Chinook jargon
http://lmss.sali.org/Rji2CTzHE8qhwSeWBp2.definition: A pidgin language used in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, combining elements of Indigenous languages and English, historically used as a lingua franca for trade and communication between Indigenous peoples and European settlers.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjk1f9sZl1EGPe1jaAc.label: Information and Participation Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjk1f9sZl1EGPe1jaAc.definition: Information and Participation Rights refer to the entitlements that allow individuals to access information held by public bodies and to participate in decision-making processes that affect their lives. These rights are often enshrined in international environmental agreements like the Aarhus Convention, as well as national laws, and aim to enhance transparency, accountability, and public involvement in governance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjkNX8mCEMI552iA5M6.label: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
http://lmss.sali.org/RjkNX8mCEMI552iA5M6.definition: Phenylketonuria (PKU) is a genetic disorder characterized by the inability to metabolize phenylalanine, an amino acid, due to a deficiency in the enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH). This leads to an accumulation of phenylalanine in the blood and brain, which can result in severe neurological and developmental issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjkYsdp52WZkUgu3vsR.label: matter_net_fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RjkYsdp52WZkUgu3vsR.definition:
