http://lmss.sali.org/RjlqATUhoynMsnhAf0W.label: National Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RjlqATUhoynMsnhAf0W.definition: The national segment refers to a portion of the market that is focused on consumers and businesses within the entire geographical boundaries of a specific country. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are tailored to meet the needs and preferences of the national population, regardless of regional differences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjmpMW11qtACb2TVsvy.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Klamath County
http://lmss.sali.org/RjmpMW11qtACb2TVsvy.definition: Oregon Circuit Court - Klamath County: A specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system located in Klamath County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjowv26wyO4F3vHf4nR.label: Ordinance Violation
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjowv26wyO4F3vHf4nR.definition: A violation of a local law or regulation, typically related to traffic, that is punishable by a fine or other penalty.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjpSZ2C3BupKvNgkdlw.label: Audit Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RjpSZ2C3BupKvNgkdlw.definition: Audit practice refers to the systematic process of evaluating and examining an organization's records, processes, operations, and performance — ensuring compliance with laws, standards, and regulations. Audits can relate to many areas of law (e.g., Tax, Employment, Regulatory).

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjssgon08OCC4KekA3L.label: Project Plan
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjssgon08OCC4KekA3L.definition: States a project's timging of deliverables, resource allocation, and activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RjySF6aXfriNAvB3VuL.label: Veteran's Healthcare Coverage
http://lmss.sali.org/RjySF6aXfriNAvB3VuL.definition: This is a type of healthcare program specifically designed for military veterans. In the U.S., the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) provides medical care to eligible veterans, which can include hospital care, outpatient services, and prescriptions.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjz4HvoZWoSg64Ud8SS.label: Action for Commission on Exclusive Agency Listing
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjz4HvoZWoSg64Ud8SS.definition: A legal claim made by a real estate agent or broker against another agent or broker for the commission earned on an exclusive agency listing.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rjzoonpmpcuz0FRku6O.label: Wakashan languages
http://lmss.sali.org/Rjzoonpmpcuz0FRku6O.definition: Wakashan languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in the Pacific Northwest region of North America, including languages such as Nuu-chah-nulth, Makah, and Kwak'wala.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rk1NNOUpV48T2rXcSuE.label: Deepfake Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rk1NNOUpV48T2rXcSuE.definition: A Deepfake Claim refers to a legal assertion involving the use of deepfake technology, which employs artificial intelligence to create or alter video and audio recordings to make them appear real. These claims often arise in the context of defamation, privacy violations, or copyright infringement, as deepfakes can be used to spread false information or unauthorized content.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rk5gLBY9OQGGsIqWybp.label: X116 Meals
http://lmss.sali.org/Rk5gLBY9OQGGsIqWybp.definition: Any meals, whether local or associated with travel, payable by the client

http://lmss.sali.org/Rk7IHXZjHuFGynkWmz9.label: JB00 Budgeting incl. costs estimates (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/Rk7IHXZjHuFGynkWmz9.definition: All work throughout the life of the case relating to budgeting and costs management, excluding the ‘costs assessment’ and ‘funding’ related work and preparation for and attendance at any costs management hearing, all of which have discrete phases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkAxZ8rb0y2TJxON5al.label: Name Change Amendment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RkAxZ8rb0y2TJxON5al.definition: A Name Change Amendment Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the modification of a party's name without invalidating the entire agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkBYUSDymzKE6kZyGrl.label: Motion to Limit Prior Art
http://lmss.sali.org/RkBYUSDymzKE6kZyGrl.definition: A Motion to Limit Prior Art is a request made during a trial to restrict the evidence that can be presented by the opposing party to only certain prior art, in order to narrow the issues at trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkCaypjvIbHnv9JaOw3.label: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Announcement of Transaction

http://lmss.sali.org/RkDYl1hXjiS2sXctgG1.label: Texas District Court - Angelina County
http://lmss.sali.org/RkDYl1hXjiS2sXctgG1.definition: A court located in Angelina County, Texas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkDm9J359mc6mQ5uj6u.label: Shareholder
http://lmss.sali.org/RkDm9J359mc6mQ5uj6u.definition: A shareholder, also referred to as a stockholder, is any person, company, or institution that owns at least one share of a company's stock (equity).

http://lmss.sali.org/RkF_JygU6SwyGAijZ3c.label: PA430 Official Communication - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RkF_JygU6SwyGAijZ3c.definition: All action associated with processing an Official Communication from a Patent Office (known as an "Office Action" in the U.S. when directed toward the merits of the application) in the home country of an application for an application filed under PA300, including initial review and any calendaring ("docketing" in the U.S.) of any response deadline, report to client with any proposed response, review of applicant's instructions and inventor's comments, preparation of amendments and/or responsive arguments, examiner interviews, and report of actions to the client. Includes activities associated with Official Communications not affecting the merits of the application, such as filing receipts, restriction/election requirements, and annuity/maintenance fee payments. Also includes "Petitions" and other requests for supervisory action that are not decided by a quasi-judicial appellate tribunal within the Patent Office, such as petitions to reinstate an abandoned application in the U.S.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkFjtfNMIuLHBAh8rzX.label: Fishing Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RkFjtfNMIuLHBAh8rzX.definition: These rights provide the holder with the privilege to catch fish in specific bodies of water. This can be governed by licenses, permits, or treaties, especially in areas with shared water resources.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkFqkFfrtGlzCVzePQ2.label: Unfair Collection Practices
http://lmss.sali.org/RkFqkFfrtGlzCVzePQ2.definition: The concept of "Unfair Collection Practices" refers to any actions taken by debt collectors that are deemed to be abusive, deceptive, or unfair towards consumers, and can result in legal claims against the collectors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkFwuqn5BPx3sEHetAA.label: Schizotypal Personality Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RkFwuqn5BPx3sEHetAA.definition: Schizotypal Personality Disorder is characterized by a pervasive pattern of eccentric behavior, cognitive distortions, and discomfort with close relationships. Individuals with this disorder may exhibit odd beliefs, unusual perceptual experiences, and suspiciousness or paranoia, alongside a marked preference for social isolation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkI43KINwzlJ3zEve2i.label: Arkansas District Court - White Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RkI43KINwzlJ3zEve2i.definition: A court located in White County, Arkansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkIejtiO3CUzgQe98NW.label: Manager
http://lmss.sali.org/RkIejtiO3CUzgQe98NW.definition: A Manager is an individual in an organization who has the responsibility of overseeing a team or a set of processes, making decisions, and ensuring that tasks and goals are successfully completed. Managers often have authority to make personnel decisions, allocate resources, and are accountable for the performance and outcomes of their team or department.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkJqtbwczvPD6XJwwxz.label: Motion for Discovery Sanctions
http://lmss.sali.org/RkJqtbwczvPD6XJwwxz.definition: A Motion for Discovery Sanctions is a legal request made by one party to the court asking for penalties or punishment against the opposing party for failing to comply with the rules of discovery during the pre-trial phase of a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkNVEeKscyIIMrlqfq8.label: Florida County Court - Martin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RkNVEeKscyIIMrlqfq8.definition: A court located in Martin County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkSzjqDiXEWoyDqDZa0.label: Job Interview
http://lmss.sali.org/RkSzjqDiXEWoyDqDZa0.definition: A job interview is a formalized conversation between a job applicant and a representative of an employing organization, aimed at assessing the applicant's suitability for a specific position. The process provides an opportunity for both the employer and the candidate to evaluate fit and compatibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkTW6noLv5Ycc4Hxw7z.label: Firm Marketing Personnel
http://lmss.sali.org/RkTW6noLv5Ycc4Hxw7z.definition: Firm Marketing Personnel refers to individuals within a legal organization who are responsible for promoting the firm's services and brand, and who are not involved in the direct provision of legal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkW2gxg1HbGOAANvNTg.label: Claims by Real Estate Agents and Brokers
http://lmss.sali.org/RkW2gxg1HbGOAANvNTg.definition: Claims by Real Estate Agents and Brokers refer to legal actions taken by these professionals in order to receive compensation for their services, such as commissions on exclusive listings or breach of implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, in relation to property and premises liability claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkWh0A5fgMwWJoxAKIA.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Butler County
http://lmss.sali.org/RkWh0A5fgMwWJoxAKIA.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Butler County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkWxaOiphQfyvbeR5QM.label: X404 Hosting Fees- Internal
http://lmss.sali.org/RkWxaOiphQfyvbeR5QM.definition: Any charges for hosting of electronic material typically associated with an application, database or data warehouse. May be on-site or off-site, but managed by the law firm or legal vendor. Excludes Data Storage Fees (X405).

http://lmss.sali.org/RkY3CCioxY8eytvUYQM.label: Indemnification of Trustee Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RkY3CCioxY8eytvUYQM.definition: A provision in a contract that requires one party to compensate and protect a trustee from any losses or damages incurred while carrying out their duties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkYMCssddpXZnIMzuMZ.label: Motion for Examination
http://lmss.sali.org/RkYMCssddpXZnIMzuMZ.definition: A Motion for Examination is a request made in a bankruptcy case for the debtor or other relevant parties to be examined under oath regarding their financial affairs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkZEAQckzKSYkegDizt.label: Causation
http://lmss.sali.org/RkZEAQckzKSYkegDizt.definition: The concept of Causation refers to the relationship between an action or event and the resulting injury or harm, and is an essential element of a legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkZYUUCh1HYX007hux7.label: Fail-to-Pay-Timely Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RkZYUUCh1HYX007hux7.definition: A fail-to-pay-timely claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not providing timely payment of wages or other compensation. The claim typically arises when an employer does not comply with applicable laws, which require employers to pay employees their earned wages at regular intervals, such as weekly or bi-weekly. The claim can also include allegations of employers not paying earned commissions, bonuses, or other forms of compensation in a timely manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkbIrzj6HiYQSEnDLqe.label: Police Misconduct
http://lmss.sali.org/RkbIrzj6HiYQSEnDLqe.definition: Police misconduct refers to wrongful or inappropriate actions committed by law enforcement officers while performing their duties. This misconduct can encompass a range of behaviors, including excessive use of force, racial profiling, false arrest, bribery, or other violations of laws, policies, or ethical standards. Cases of police misconduct may result in legal action against the officers involved, civil lawsuits, or disciplinary measures within the police department.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkbsRmxlCHsKFrpTNqz.label: Acts of God Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RkbsRmxlCHsKFrpTNqz.definition: A provision in a contract that excuses a party's performance if an unforeseeable event beyond their control, such as a natural disaster, occurs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkcDCEktixCPSnjvyoY.label: Claim for Falling on Government Sidewalk
http://lmss.sali.org/RkcDCEktixCPSnjvyoY.definition: A claim for falling on a government sidewalk is a legal action brought by an individual who has suffered injuries due to a slip-and-fall incident caused by the negligence of a government entity responsible for maintaining the sidewalk.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rkdu09MQjVaVvrQGQxN.label: Nottawaseppi Huron Band of the Potawatomi, Michigan

http://lmss.sali.org/RkhUHnvb6Tha7OXE2v2.label: L655 Privilege review
http://lmss.sali.org/RkhUHnvb6Tha7OXE2v2.definition: Activities and actions related to performing final privilege review and determination of documents, as well as all privilege log related work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkhY5BFp4cnekdObFTV.label: Drone
http://lmss.sali.org/RkhY5BFp4cnekdObFTV.definition: A Drone, or Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), is an aircraft that operates without a human pilot on board, controlled either autonomously by onboard computers or by a remote control. Drones are utilized in various fields including military operations, commercial delivery services, aerial photography, and recreational activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkjsY1yFc66NU0A4nVd.label: Indiana Superior Court - Rush County
http://lmss.sali.org/RkjsY1yFc66NU0A4nVd.definition: A court located in Rush County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkjwWEBCJoch5v1QZjW.label: Arrest Warrant
http://lmss.sali.org/RkjwWEBCJoch5v1QZjW.definition: An arrest warrant is a legal document issued by a court authorizing law enforcement to arrest and detain an individual suspected of committing a crime.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkkleTMIObttgaIgsbL.label: Soninke
http://lmss.sali.org/RkkleTMIObttgaIgsbL.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, specifically in the countries of Mali, Senegal, and Mauritania, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkkuBZSNq25iEr81d16.label: Succession Rights Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RkkuBZSNq25iEr81d16.definition: A succession rights claim pertains to a legal action filed by a family member or household member seeking the right to continue residing in a rent-controlled or rent-stabilized apartment after the original tenant has vacated or passed away. In some jurisdictions, rent control or rent stabilization laws allow certain family members or individuals who have lived with the tenant for an extended period to succeed to the tenancy and maintain the regulated rent. Succession rights claims typically involve legal proceedings to determine eligibility and establish the successor's right to remain in the rental unit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkmwkCxidQzeNwqnSEZ.label: Futures - Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RkmwkCxidQzeNwqnSEZ.definition: Futures are financial contracts obligating the buyer to purchase an asset or the seller to sell an asset and have a predetermined future date and price. A futures contract allows an investor to speculate on the direction of a security, commodity, or a financial instrument.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkoLkee3wjmDwsHW0EN.label: Traffic Ticket
http://lmss.sali.org/RkoLkee3wjmDwsHW0EN.definition: A "Traffic Ticket" is a formal notice issued by a law enforcement officer to a motorist or other road user, indicating that the individual has violated traffic regulations. It typically requires the payment of a fine or an appearance in court to address the infraction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkotJU6BE634ODFcg1S.label: Canola
http://lmss.sali.org/RkotJU6BE634ODFcg1S.definition: Canola is a type of oilseed crop derived from varieties of rapeseed (Brassica napus and Brassica rapa) that have been selectively bred to be low in erucic acid and glucosinolates. It is primarily grown for its oil, which is valued for its low saturated fat content and versatility in cooking and food production, as well as its use in biodiesel and industrial applications.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkpuQxpKXR3SZ1RqL4W.label: WC160 Settlement/Resolution
http://lmss.sali.org/RkpuQxpKXR3SZ1RqL4W.definition: Activities directed specifically to settlement, planning/participation in settlement discussions, conferences/communications with attorney, adjuster and employer, preparing settlement analysis, mediation, preparing opening statement for mediation, traveling to/from mediation, attend mediation, any and all communication regarding settlement/mediation/other non-binding procedures, preparing /drafting compromise & release agreement and order, preparing/drafting/attending motion to enforce settlement agreements, prepare settlement stipulation, preparing medicare allocation/application to CMS for pre or post settlement approval

http://lmss.sali.org/RkqaIyEUGg1YWyeLIwk.label: 320 Assault, Libel & Slander (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RkqaIyEUGg1YWyeLIwk.definition: Action alleging intentional acts of assault, libel, trade libel or slander by a private party. (Excludes a government employee)

http://lmss.sali.org/Rkqn3Q4gx00wQCTEatZ.label: Jewish Law System
http://lmss.sali.org/Rkqn3Q4gx00wQCTEatZ.definition: Jewish Law, also known as Halakha, is a legal system based on Jewish religious texts, including the Torah and Talmud. This system governs both religious and daily life aspects of observant Jews, integrating legal, ethical, and moral guidelines.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rkr4Vv34_SNiXIvMZoP.label: PA240 Validity Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/Rkr4Vv34_SNiXIvMZoP.definition: All actions associated with determining whether a patent claim is invalid including definition of the scope and field of search, searching, analysis of search results, and reporting the search results to the client. A validity search attempts to locate "prior art" documents and/or other information that were not considered during the examination of the corresponding patent application but appear to disclose the features recited in a patent claim. The field of the search can vary widely depending upon the technology under consideration. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal invalidity opinion should be prepared separately under PA710.

http://lmss.sali.org/RksoepBjdloPRXXqF06.label: Document Comparison Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RksoepBjdloPRXXqF06.definition: Document Comparison Management refers to the process of managing and analyzing differences between two or more versions of a document, within the context of document management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RktL8UcgTzfjXB8cZ4K.label: Parent-Child Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RktL8UcgTzfjXB8cZ4K.definition: The legal concept of Parent-Child Liability refers to the responsibility of a parent for the actions or debts of their child, within the context of Family Liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RktzgskoBxeRQy8BRut.label: Huntington's Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/RktzgskoBxeRQy8BRut.definition: Huntington's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the gradual onset of motor dysfunction, cognitive decline, and psychiatric symptoms due to the degeneration of neurons in the basal ganglia. It is caused by a genetic mutation in the HTT gene, leading to a typical onset in middle adulthood and requiring ongoing medical and supportive care.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkuD23yIPdAATXXFAvu.label: Tax Invoice Client ID
http://lmss.sali.org/RkuD23yIPdAATXXFAvu.definition: A Tax Invoice Client ID is a specific detail included in a fee invoice for legal services provided to a client, which identifies the client for tax purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkvRD1NfpM4aO12DEEa.label: Neurodegenerative Disorders of the Central Nervous System
http://lmss.sali.org/RkvRD1NfpM4aO12DEEa.definition: Neurodegenerative disorders of the central nervous system involve the progressive degeneration or death of nerve cells (neurons) in the brain and spinal cord. These disorders are characterized by gradual loss of cognitive, motor, or autonomic functions due to the progressive nature of neuronal damage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkxVw4JWkQkOCVdV_ds.label: TR220 Registerability Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RkxVw4JWkQkOCVdV_ds.definition: All actions associated with determining the initial availability and registerability of a particular trademark, including the definition of the scope of protection, searching, analyzing search results, and reporting results to the client. Also known as a "knock out" search, or 'preliminary' search, it is the most general type of trademark search which usually encompasses a review of trademark registry records, such as pending trademark applications, active trademark registrations, and abandoned trademark applications and registrations. Preliminary searches are conducted to determine if a full clearance investigation is warranted under TR230. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkyEzrOBRtZ6naKieB0.label: Arkansas District Court - Franklin Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RkyEzrOBRtZ6naKieB0.definition: Arkansas District Court - Franklin Cty. is a specific court within the Arkansas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Franklin County, Arkansas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RkzeibZyGqJ71RjWdj1.label: Monitor
http://lmss.sali.org/RkzeibZyGqJ71RjWdj1.definition: Under Canadian Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act (CCAA), a Monitor is an independent third party who is appointed by the Court to monitor the company's ongoing operations and assist with the filing and voting on the Plan of Arrangement.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl2eNFxvCQUqT6N1nj2.label: A114 Communicate (experts)
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl2eNFxvCQUqT6N1nj2.definition: Any communication by letter, fax, email, telephone, meetings and conferences with experts associated with the legal matter

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl3nfxtSnGaDv8Wq5MT.label: Stipulation to Approve Document
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl3nfxtSnGaDv8Wq5MT.definition: A Stipulation to Approve Document is a legal agreement between parties that acknowledges the acceptance and approval of a written or recorded representation of thought or expression.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl6PE24BNvgG9lGykrJ.label: "'Reasonably likely/expected violation' of fiduciary duties" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl6PE24BNvgG9lGykrJ.definition: A "reasonably likely/expected violation" of fiduciary duties refers to a breach of the legal obligation to act in the best interest of another party, which is anticipated or probable based on the circumstances and facts at hand, and may arise in the context of a no-shop covenant, an intervening event, or a superior offer.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl6fLTEVZYAxbZOGrrO.label: Food Poisoning Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl6fLTEVZYAxbZOGrrO.definition: A food poisoning claim is a legal action seeking compensation for harm caused by consuming contaminated food, falling under the broader categories of personal injury claims and food liability claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl85GSkvaA2yo65Frev.label: Non-Solicitation of Employees Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl85GSkvaA2yo65Frev.definition: A "Non-Solicitation of Employees Covenant" is a contractual provision where one party agrees not to approach, recruit, or hire the other party's employees for a specified duration. This type of covenant is often used in employment contracts, business sale agreements, and partnership agreements to prevent the departure of key personnel and to protect an organization's human resources from being poached by competitors or other entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rl8MHhn3ljmvtKrI8al.label: Adult Dependent Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/Rl8MHhn3ljmvtKrI8al.definition: The mistreatment or harm inflicted upon an adult who is dependent on another person for care or support, such as an elderly or disabled individual, by a caregiver or family member.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlBJzOmHGizTkwITuzj.label: Fraud Permitting Reformation or Rescission
http://lmss.sali.org/RlBJzOmHGizTkwITuzj.definition: Fraud Permitting Reformation or Rescission: A legal claim that allows for the modification or cancellation of a contract due to fraudulent behavior by one of the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlCSg20axJf8zS2Og9R.label: O-1B Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RlCSg20axJf8zS2Og9R.definition: An O-1B visa is issued to individuals with extraordinary ability in the arts or those who have demonstrated extraordinary achievement in the motion picture or television industry, evidenced by sustained national or international acclaim. This visa allows them to enter the U.S. to work in their field of artistic or entertainment expertise.
http://lmss.sali.org/RlCSg20axJf8zS2Og9R.pref_label: Exceptional Talent Visa In Arts Or Entertainment

http://lmss.sali.org/RlDwAh4h0X7Sosy5SLc.label: Attorney Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RlDwAh4h0X7Sosy5SLc.definition: Attorney Fees refer to the compensation paid to a lawyer for their legal services, which can be shifted to the losing party in a lawsuit or calculated based on the benefit or value provided to the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlGj4vFLjg29GOiAipT.label: Information Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RlGj4vFLjg29GOiAipT.definition: An Information Statement is a document that provides material information about corporate matters that require shareholder action but do not necessitate a shareholder meeting. It is often distributed prior to corporate actions like spin-offs or large asset sales.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlGo9XmfN0d2lmi5PGA.label: Grant of Rights Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RlGo9XmfN0d2lmi5PGA.definition: A Grant of Rights Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the rights being granted by one party to another.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlGrvVFkTQQKHSYDSEh.label: PA310 Provisional Application Preparation - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/RlGrvVFkTQQKHSYDSEh.definition: All actions associated with completing a provisional patent application that is to be filed in the ("domestic") home country or region of the applicant, including review of invention disclosure materials and prior art, interviews with the inventors, drafting and revision of application, preparation and execution of formal documentation (such as assignments, transmittals, and biological deposits), filing of application, and reporting to the client. Note that government fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlJ0BDpNehCvTfmz9g7.label: Covered Business Method Review
http://lmss.sali.org/RlJ0BDpNehCvTfmz9g7.definition: A Covered Business Method Review (CBM) is a type of administrative dispute proceeding practice conducted by the U.S. Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB).

http://lmss.sali.org/RlJrGWVICN3FKHYc4XQ.label: Yupik languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RlJrGWVICN3FKHYc4XQ.definition: Yupik languages are a group of indigenous languages spoken in Alaska and Siberia, characterized by complex inflectional systems and polysynthetic word formation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlKGIdwv1wMuihKAg6U.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Chester County
http://lmss.sali.org/RlKGIdwv1wMuihKAg6U.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Chester County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Chester County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlNFgB3TQfMzV26V4V7.label: Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RlNFgB3TQfMzV26V4V7.definition: Specific aims, goals, arguments, plans, intentions, designs, purposes, schemes, etc. that are constructed by a party in a legal matter, and the legal or other professional frameworks that support their execution.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlNd4fuEGnhNmnebjdy.label: oasis:agent collection
http://lmss.sali.org/RlNd4fuEGnhNmnebjdy.definition: A collection of agents within the OASIS standard framework.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlOHXQDunuaC2onsYyr.label: Asset Disposition Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RlOHXQDunuaC2onsYyr.definition: Asset Disposition Practice refers to the legal practice area that deals with the management and disposal of assets in the context of bankruptcy and financial restructuring, including the sale and abandonment of assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlOK1srhoah3VuQIedr.label: Bankruptcy Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RlOK1srhoah3VuQIedr.definition: A Bankruptcy Agreement is a legal document that outlines the terms and conditions of an agreement between a debtor and creditor in a bankruptcy or restructuring proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlPUVFgTvSbSVS64OwQ.label: TR240 Opposition Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RlPUVFgTvSbSVS64OwQ.definition: All actions associated with investigating a claim or potential claim of trademark opposition, trademark infringement or trademark dilution before a trademark office tribunal, including definition of the scope of the investigation, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the search results to the client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. This code set is for determining the facts and recommendations of an opposition matter. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710. Any subsequent work completed in a contested matter would be completed under TR440 or TR640 respectively.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlRMCLYXFcvbK8k0pP4.label: Surgery Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RlRMCLYXFcvbK8k0pP4.definition: Surgery Malpractice refers to a type of medical malpractice claim that arises from a surgical procedure that was performed negligently or incompetently, resulting in harm to the patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlTXjqGPtw94b1kwqgo.label: California Superior Court - Fresno Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RlTXjqGPtw94b1kwqgo.definition: California Superior Court - Fresno Cty. is a specific court located in Fresno County, California that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlU4i6zSPzYa6BX0Mxv.label: Termination With Cause Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RlU4i6zSPzYa6BX0Mxv.definition: A Termination With Cause Clause is a provision in a contract that allows one party to end the agreement if the other party breaches a specific condition or obligation outlined in the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlV3CYMc9EcyudQxKYL.label: Response to Cross-Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RlV3CYMc9EcyudQxKYL.definition: A response made by a party to a cross-claim filed against them, which is a type of legal document that is filed in response to a claim made by another party in a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlVwfGbgKDt6ZToBprQ.label: Escape from Correctional Facility
http://lmss.sali.org/RlVwfGbgKDt6ZToBprQ.definition: The act of leaving a correctional facility without authorization, which is considered a crime against the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlY5TKYP7Vrr3FIPsrn.label: Disfigurement
http://lmss.sali.org/RlY5TKYP7Vrr3FIPsrn.definition: Disfigurement refers to a physical impairment or alteration of a person's appearance resulting from an injury or accident, which may lead to emotional distress and loss of self-esteem.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlZPJqPkVtqcjDMl5tq.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Price Fixing Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RlZPJqPkVtqcjDMl5tq.definition: A claim made in a legal matter alleging that competitors in the same industry colluded to set prices at a certain level, in violation of antitrust laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlZdd14uUrCvqa8YJ7R.label: Authorship
http://lmss.sali.org/RlZdd14uUrCvqa8YJ7R.definition: Authorship, particularly human authorship in copyright law, designates the creation of a work by a human being, attributing legal rights and responsibilities to the creator. This principle recognizes the human creator as the source of intellectual creativity and grants them exclusive rights over their work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlZdh-wYnT4-sxkRq3g.label: X306 Discovery/eDiscovery Evidence/Exhibit Creation and Preparation
http://lmss.sali.org/RlZdh-wYnT4-sxkRq3g.definition: Any services associated with the creation, export or delivery of trial evidence or exhibits including: creation of video clips and other demonstrative evidence from the collection when billed as an expense instead of a service.
http://lmss.sali.org/RlZdh-wYnT4-sxkRq3g.pref_label: X306 Discovery/eDiscovery Evidence/Exhibit Creation and Preparation

http://lmss.sali.org/Rlbq3SekJ58WQwzlThY.label: Hindu Law
http://lmss.sali.org/Rlbq3SekJ58WQwzlThY.definition: Hindu Law is a traditional legal system governing personal matters of Hindus, primarily based on ancient scriptures like the Dharmashastra and customs followed over time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlekwKRgprnAW5voZE8.label: Nonsolicitation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RlekwKRgprnAW5voZE8.definition: A Nonsolicitation Agreement is a legal contract between parties that prohibits one party from soliciting or hiring employees or customers of the other party for a specified period of time.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlenLvEtAsXWLv9Oj6c.label: matter_total_detail_exp
http://lmss.sali.org/RlenLvEtAsXWLv9Oj6c.definition:
"Sum of all EXPENSE.total_amounts billed to this matter/invoice.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/Rlff8L3ZtchbXUTmNz0.label: 870 Taxes (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/Rlff8L3ZtchbXUTmNz0.definition: Action filed under the Internal Revenue Code (General)

http://lmss.sali.org/RlgFAjqizwHVxH4GdLh.label: Municipal Liability
http://lmss.sali.org/RlgFAjqizwHVxH4GdLh.definition: Municipal Liability refers to the legal responsibility of a city or other local government entity for the actions or omissions of its employees or agents, which may result in harm or damages to individuals or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlicKF1VRKASGfpu8nD.label: Realization
http://lmss.sali.org/RlicKF1VRKASGfpu8nD.definition: Measures the percentage of billed or invoiced work that is actually turned into revenue. It is calculated by dividing the actual revenue received by the potential revenue based on billable hours, helping firms assess the effectiveness of their billing and collection practices, as well as client payment behavior.

http://lmss.sali.org/RljZNCMmMTgK0eiS6aD.label: Country of Citizenship
http://lmss.sali.org/RljZNCMmMTgK0eiS6aD.definition: Country of Citizenship refers to the nation with which an individual holds legal membership, often acquired by birth, descent, or naturalization. This information is important for legal, immigration, and governmental matters, and is usually indicated on passports and other official identification documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rlkdw4J9BQDzBNl3DjA.label: Motion in Limine
http://lmss.sali.org/Rlkdw4J9BQDzBNl3DjA.definition: A Motion in Limine is a pretrial motion requesting the court to exclude certain evidence or testimony that may be prejudicial or irrelevant to the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RllRYdRqaLR2ddFqYgi.label: Supplemental Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RllRYdRqaLR2ddFqYgi.definition: A supplemental brief is a written document submitted to an appellate court that provides additional information or arguments in support of a previously filed appellate brief.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlmyXsj3s6KHsLHBGEG.label: Infringement Analysis Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RlmyXsj3s6KHsLHBGEG.definition: The Infringement Analysis Practice is a legal process that involves investigating and analyzing facts related to potential infringement of intellectual property rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rlt4ugwZ3FbR9vKd73y.label: Vicarious Copyright Infringement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rlt4ugwZ3FbR9vKd73y.definition: Vicarious Copyright Infringement refers to a situation where a person is held liable for copyright infringement committed by another person, even if they did not directly commit the infringement themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rlt5iQDX3K03oRlt9Mf.label: Kenaf
http://lmss.sali.org/Rlt5iQDX3K03oRlt9Mf.definition: Kenaf is a fast-growing annual plant cultivated for its fiber, which is used in the production of paper, textiles, and biodegradable composites. Known for its high biomass yield and environmental benefits, kenaf serves as a sustainable alternative to traditional raw materials in various industries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RlwizeaS0mbT9or1zig.label: Maori
http://lmss.sali.org/RlwizeaS0mbT9or1zig.definition: Maori (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the indigenous people of New Zealand, and is used in legal matters related to this culture.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rm51XYTbDjRXLDOlLzf.label: Sex Offender Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/Rm51XYTbDjRXLDOlLzf.definition: Sex offender registration is a system in which individuals convicted of certain sexual offenses are required to register their personal details, including current address and nature of their offense, with a designated government authority. This registration is typically made available to the public, either in part or in full, with the intent of informing communities about the presence of individuals who might pose a risk, and to aid law enforcement in monitoring and managing these individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rm55d3f34Y1mEEwYzLx.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Carter County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rm55d3f34Y1mEEwYzLx.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Carter County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Carter County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rm6ADz81qTi2j9TWSoG.label: X120 Title Insurance Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/Rm6ADz81qTi2j9TWSoG.definition: Any Title Service, examination and abstract costs

http://lmss.sali.org/Rm7fenxGXdqeqZ9xvpe.label: Chechen
http://lmss.sali.org/Rm7fenxGXdqeqZ9xvpe.definition: A language spoken by the Chechen people, primarily in the Chechen Republic of the Russian Federation.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rm86pesfNUaa9Ok2Ut1.label: Terms of Service
http://lmss.sali.org/Rm86pesfNUaa9Ok2Ut1.definition: Terms of Service are rules and regulations that users must agree to in order to use a service or product, typically provided online. They set forth the legal and operational boundaries of the user's relationship with the service provider.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmC8lM-4_SHmSHAprkq.label: X307 Electronic Media Cost
http://lmss.sali.org/RmC8lM-4_SHmSHAprkq.definition: Material cost only, whether CD, DVD, hard drive or other device used to move a data collection. Excludes hardware not used to move a data collection (X403).

http://lmss.sali.org/RmCCZU8GS7O8920pkDi.label: Right
http://lmss.sali.org/RmCCZU8GS7O8920pkDi.definition: A right is a moral, social, or legal entitlement to perform or refrain from certain actions, or to be in a certain state, often protected and enforceable by law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmCERXtzdqIJcW9mdbk.label: Entity Disclosure Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RmCERXtzdqIJcW9mdbk.definition: A Entity Disclosure Document is a formal document in which an entity discloses specific information, often financial or operational, to regulators, investors, or the public. These documents are generated to comply with regulatory requirements and to provide transparency in corporate activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmDPvSbRv0egHNWi7qZ.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Hancock County
http://lmss.sali.org/RmDPvSbRv0egHNWi7qZ.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Hancock County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within the geographical boundaries of Hancock County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmEMN8G28dSK3DhJ6Qm.label: Florida Circuit Court - Hendry County - 20th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RmEMN8G28dSK3DhJ6Qm.definition: A court located in Hendry County, Florida that is part of the 20th Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmGWxkvj4y9mflPYYkZ.label: Independent Contractor Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RmGWxkvj4y9mflPYYkZ.definition: An Independent Contractor Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the relationship between a company and an individual who is not an employee, but rather an independent contractor hired to perform specific services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmGrykg1NdiaxO77n1a.label: Oregon Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RmGrykg1NdiaxO77n1a.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of Oregon that hears civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmImswDIJNuUJlP7keS.label: Critical Claims Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/RmImswDIJNuUJlP7keS.definition: A Critical Claims Motion is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case that seeks to prioritize certain claims over others, often due to their importance or urgency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmKGgthC7edDxTiRIwo.label: Railroad Rolling Stock Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RmKGgthC7edDxTiRIwo.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing and/or rebuilding locomotives, locomotive frames and parts; (2) manufacturing railroad, street, and rapid transit cars and car equipment for operation on rails for freight and passenger service; and (3) manufacturing rail layers, ballast distributors, rail tamping equipment and other railway track maintenance equipment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmL6t0jxevPgTbIcHPo.label: Georgia District Court - Bibb County
http://lmss.sali.org/RmL6t0jxevPgTbIcHPo.definition: A court located in Bibb County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmLdyoCICTrG3AIcahZ.label: L690 Project Management (NOS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RmLdyoCICTrG3AIcahZ.definition: "NOS" = Not Otherwise Specified (catch-all, includes the subcategories). Activities or actions to associated with supervising or managing specific activities or actions throughout the EDRM continuum such as conducting meetings and team calls, developing work plans, budgets, forecasts, reports and other meaningful activities or for general project management not associated with a particular "L" code. Primarily charges on a hourly or a flat/fixed fee basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmNncTGKFe6ppiYH1Uy.label: Petition for Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker
http://lmss.sali.org/RmNncTGKFe6ppiYH1Uy.definition: Petition for Visa for Specialized Knowledge Worker (in the U.S., L-1B petition) refers to the process of applying for a visa for intracompany transferees with specialized knowledge who are being transferred from a foreign office to a U.S. office within the same company. In the United States, employers must file a Form I-129 petition with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), providing evidence of the employee's specialized knowledge and meeting other eligibility criteria for the L-1B visa. If approved, the employee can work in the U.S. for the sponsoring employer for a specified period

http://lmss.sali.org/RmO3UVHCbxAoZ5hY7KF.label: NATO-2 Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RmO3UVHCbxAoZ5hY7KF.definition: A NATO-2 visa is issued to representatives of NATO, including civilian employees, who are stationed in the U.S. for official duties, along with their immediate family members. This visa category also includes dependents and staff members accompanying the representatives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmPbvrdn1N9VM5z56uN.label: Car Allowance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RmPbvrdn1N9VM5z56uN.definition: A car allowance clause is a provision in a contract that provides for a specific amount of money to be paid to an employee for the use of their personal vehicle for work-related purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmQmrqdwna293DNyilB.label: Georgia Superior Court - Peach County
http://lmss.sali.org/RmQmrqdwna293DNyilB.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Peach County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Peach County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmR7UCspgSRek_dLQVP.label: TR510 Application Preparation and Filing - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RmR7UCspgSRek_dLQVP.definition: All actions associated with completing a trademark, service mark or design mark application (including renewal applications) that is to be filed in a jurisdiction outside the home country or region of the applicant, including obtaining the power of attorney, translations if necessary, obtaining supporting information and documentation from the client, discussing priority filings with the client, drafting and revision of the application, preparation and filing of the application, and reporting the results to the client. This section includes all international national applications, regional applications (such as a CTM or Benelux application), and marks filed under WIPO (Madrid Agreement and Madrid Protocol). Note that government fees and external expenses (or "disbursements" in the U.S.) are included under E100.
http://lmss.sali.org/RmR7UCspgSRek_dLQVP.pref_label: TR510 Application Preparation and Filing - International

http://lmss.sali.org/RmVAavVyS3LgkctWWvZ.label: Standardized Contractual Terms
http://lmss.sali.org/RmVAavVyS3LgkctWWvZ.definition: Standardized Contractual Terms refer to contract specifications that are uniform and predefined, including the underlying instruments, exercise price, expiration date, and contract size. These standardized options facilitate trading on specialized option exchanges, providing greater liquidity, transparency, and regulatory oversight.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmVqE62aGlOtAoEND19.label: Legal Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RmVqE62aGlOtAoEND19.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering legal services, such as those offered by offices of lawyers, offices of notaries, and title abstract and settlement offices, and paralegal services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmWz0a5ClFJyZWKEl4C.label: Phoenician
http://lmss.sali.org/RmWz0a5ClFJyZWKEl4C.definition: Phoenician (Language) is a historical written and spoken structured system of communication used by the ancient Phoenician civilization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmXvSJFAd7ebRkO0LlY.label: Coronary Artery Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/RmXvSJFAd7ebRkO0LlY.definition: Ischemic heart disease (IHD), also known as coronary artery disease (CAD), is a condition characterized by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle due to the narrowing or blockage of coronary arteries. It manifests through symptoms such as angina pectoris (chest pain), myocardial infarction (heart attack), and may require interventions like coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) or percutaneous coronary interventions (PCI).

http://lmss.sali.org/RmZKDYQf0Qfyvb6soIZ.label: A128 Collection Closing Activities
http://lmss.sali.org/RmZKDYQf0Qfyvb6soIZ.definition: Closing activities related to a Discovery or eDiscovery collection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmZvTFQIyYzdj5THA56.label: Walker River Paiute Tribe of the Walker River Reservation, Nevada

http://lmss.sali.org/RmafyqOLdKzHzFsjz4r.label: National Legislator
http://lmss.sali.org/RmafyqOLdKzHzFsjz4r.definition: A National Legislator is an elected or appointed official who serves as a member of a country's national law-making body. This individual is responsible for proposing, debating, and voting on national laws and policies, representing constituents or regions at the federal level, and providing oversight of the executive branch.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmbIWgczQaXs5xSsXa4.label: Peremptory Challenge of Judge
http://lmss.sali.org/RmbIWgczQaXs5xSsXa4.definition: A peremptory challenge of judge is a request made by a party in a legal case to remove a judge from the case without providing a reason or cause for the removal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmbeQ_5OgROW5WVQg7d.label: X117 Court and Governmental Agency Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RmbeQ_5OgROW5WVQg7d.definition: Any court or governmental agency fees, including UCC, land record filings and property tax. Excludes late fees (X122), publication costs (X123) and patent and trademark filing fees (X203, X204 and X205).
http://lmss.sali.org/RmbeQ_5OgROW5WVQg7d.pref_label: X117 Court and Governmental Agency Fees

http://lmss.sali.org/RmbqLD5B3hSuF2lwwcU.label: DEPRECATED Offsite Employment - in favor of `Remote Employment`
http://lmss.sali.org/RmbqLD5B3hSuF2lwwcU.definition: Offsite Employment refers to a work arrangement where an employee performs job duties at a location other than the employer's primary facilities, such as at a client's office or a separate project site. While offsite employees may have some degree of autonomy, they likely still fall under the employer's oversight and policies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmdTYCEp2L1zxR38YY7.label: Limes
http://lmss.sali.org/RmdTYCEp2L1zxR38YY7.definition: Limes are small, green citrus fruits from the Citrus aurantiifolia and Citrus latifolia species, known for their tart, acidic juice and aromatic zest. They are widely used in culinary applications, beverages, and as a garnish, valued for their distinctive flavor and high vitamin C content.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmfSTWUEKZURmHfs99I.label: Public Company
http://lmss.sali.org/RmfSTWUEKZURmHfs99I.definition: Company whose stock is publicly available on a public stock exchange, as recognized by the relevant jurisdictions' authority — as well as a private company that are required by relevant legal authorities to make public disclosures (e.g., operations, finance).

http://lmss.sali.org/RmhQ3nKmTrKWy38SI3P.label: Synthetic Lease
http://lmss.sali.org/RmhQ3nKmTrKWy38SI3P.definition: A Synthetic Lease is a financial arrangement that allows a company to lease an asset while maintaining the benefits of ownership for tax purposes, such as depreciation, without having the asset appear on the balance sheet as a liability. This structure is typically used for real estate or large equipment to improve financial ratios by keeping debt off the balance sheet.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rmhy1H4KJ9N7z3DswUY.label: Freddie Mac
http://lmss.sali.org/Rmhy1H4KJ9N7z3DswUY.definition: Freddie Mac, officially known as the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), is a government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) in the United States that buys mortgages from lenders and securitizes them into mortgage-backed securities. Established to increase the availability of mortgage funds, Freddie Mac plays a crucial role in the secondary mortgage market by providing liquidity, stability, and affordability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmiM5JwX7zJYQs8QRne.label: Lending Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RmiM5JwX7zJYQs8QRne.definition: A transaction whereby property is lent or given to another on condition of return or, where the loan is of money, repayment. In a loan of money, the money lent becomes the property of the borrower during the period of the loan against an undertaking to return a sum of an equivalent amount either on demand or on a specified date or in accordance with an agreed schedule of repayments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmiYQJshZzYvIsqEWLj.label: Export Control Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RmiYQJshZzYvIsqEWLj.definition: An Export Control Claim arises when an individual or entity is accused of violating regulations that govern the export, re-export, and transfer of controlled goods, technology, and services. This claim involves allegations of unauthorized exports, failure to obtain necessary licenses, or exporting to prohibited destinations or entities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmlzB7vJiJ4u219T77F.label: 850 Securities/Commodities/Exchange (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RmlzB7vJiJ4u219T77F.definition: Action filed under Small Business Investment Act 15:681, Securities Exchange Act 15:78, Securities Act 15:77, Investment Advisers Act 15:80B(1-21)

http://lmss.sali.org/RmmLDrsp8IOT1MiT8Fv.label: DEPRECATED: Entry of Default
http://lmss.sali.org/RmmLDrsp8IOT1MiT8Fv.definition: Deprecated as duplicative of `Entry of Default Judgment` http://lmss.sali.org/RZDsWeBRdamDfrXlti4iv9

http://lmss.sali.org/Rmo6lH3rho7iT8enAYS.label: Severance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rmo6lH3rho7iT8enAYS.definition: A severance clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the terms and conditions under which the agreement may be terminated by one or both parties, typically addressing issues such as notice requirements, compensation, and benefits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmqysGFQ1RYW3F9lv5u.label: Offering Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RmqysGFQ1RYW3F9lv5u.definition: An Offering Document is a comprehensive legal document provided by a company or financial entity to potential investors, detailing the terms, conditions, and risks of the investment offering. This document, often used in private placements and public offerings, includes key information such as the company's business model, financial statements, management background, and details of the security being offered.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmskzftuS8JqVb1OpPx.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors with Unsecured Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RmskzftuS8JqVb1OpPx.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Creditors with Unsecured Claims, also known as Schedule E/F, requires the debtor to list all creditors who hold unsecured claims against them. This schedule distinguishes between priority unsecured claims, which have a higher repayment priority under bankruptcy law, and non-priority unsecured claims, detailing the creditor's name, claim amount, and the nature of the claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmuN5qQ1E6gzGA02HT8.label: Antitrust - Horizontal Market Allocation Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RmuN5qQ1E6gzGA02HT8.definition: Antitrust - Horizontal Market Allocation Claims refer to legal claims that allege agreements between competitors to divide markets or customers, which violate antitrust laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rmv3aWwfnLGj1avQvTQ.label: No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception
http://lmss.sali.org/Rmv3aWwfnLGj1avQvTQ.definition: A No-Shop Covenant - Fiduciary Exception is a legal agreement that allows a target company's board of directors to consider alternative acquisition offers during a specified period, despite a prior agreement with an initial bidder, if the board determines that it is in the best interest of the company and its shareholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmwGoaD1w23VpqE9x02.label: Minnesota District Court - Aitkin County
http://lmss.sali.org/RmwGoaD1w23VpqE9x02.definition: Minnesota District Court - Aitkin County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Aitkin County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmwrC5eWQwqMDF33t75.label: Condition Subsequent Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RmwrC5eWQwqMDF33t75.definition: A condition subsequent clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the circumstances under which the contract may be terminated or modified by one or both parties after it has been executed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RmxUXX045hZKCKbSLgz.label: Caselaw Research Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RmxUXX045hZKCKbSLgz.definition: Caselaw Research Management refers to the process of organizing and analyzing legal cases for research purposes. It falls under the broader category of Legal Research.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rn0HJNM1i7G55Voo0Gz.label: Executor and Administrator
http://lmss.sali.org/Rn0HJNM1i7G55Voo0Gz.definition: A person designated to serve as the legal representative of an estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rn2rzXRRr2kRvm7KUqr.label: Texas District Court - Howard County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rn2rzXRRr2kRvm7KUqr.definition: A Texas District Court located in Howard County, which has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rn7ROJMWMxWVicJzoGu.label: Deliberative Process Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/Rn7ROJMWMxWVicJzoGu.definition: The Deliberative Process Privilege is a legal protection that allows government agencies to withhold documents and communications that are part of the decision-making process, in order to encourage open and honest discussion and debate among officials.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rn9n503V7B3fFkOQdsl.label: General Jurisdiction
http://lmss.sali.org/Rn9n503V7B3fFkOQdsl.definition: General Jurisdiction refers to a court's authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases, including those that are not related to a specific geographic location or personal connection to the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnA4PkzZNviaHynM1Fv.label: Individual Debtor
http://lmss.sali.org/RnA4PkzZNviaHynM1Fv.definition: An individual who owes money or other obligations to another party and is personally responsible for repayment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnCtzs6l2AN6S2Q2mei.label: Medical Equipment and Supplies Manufacturing Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RnCtzs6l2AN6S2Q2mei.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing medical equipment and supplies.  Examples of products made by these establishments are surgical and medical instruments, surgical appliances and supplies, dental equipment and supplies, orthodontic goods, ophthalmic goods, dentures, and orthodontic appliances.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnDeUu0kFB2F39jo4Ub.label: Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/RnDeUu0kFB2F39jo4Ub.definition: A visa is an official document or endorsement that grants the holder permission to enter, stay, or leave a specific country for a specified period. It is usually stamped or affixed to the traveler's passport and may come with various conditions such as the purpose of the visit, duration of stay, and whether multiple entries are allowed

http://lmss.sali.org/RnFpIri1VV2iMsKxfiv.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Schuylkill County
http://lmss.sali.org/RnFpIri1VV2iMsKxfiv.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Schuylkill County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnKWv1E6U2Ssc5SRsG1.label: Factual Statement
http://lmss.sali.org/RnKWv1E6U2Ssc5SRsG1.definition: A document's statement of fact (e.g., brief's recitation of facts, judicial findings of fact).

http://lmss.sali.org/RnNaJgh0NQC6AezYV3_.label: X130 Medical Records Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RnNaJgh0NQC6AezYV3_.definition: Costs for obtaining copies of medical records

http://lmss.sali.org/RnOWl7h3fn4oON5Nqa9.label: Stillaguamish Tribe of Indians of Washington

http://lmss.sali.org/RnSHqIE6kW486gQwcgL.label: Administrative Proceeding Venues
http://lmss.sali.org/RnSHqIE6kW486gQwcgL.definition: Administrative Proceeding Venues are specific government entities or organizations that oversee and manage legal proceedings related to disputes, such as the U.S. Merit Systems Protection Board or the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnTNsy3rvPXsc7tOyLn.label: Clean Air Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RnTNsy3rvPXsc7tOyLn.definition: A Clean Air Claim is a legal action brought under environmental law seeking to enforce or protect the right to clean air.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnVv902rkpko7wOd8H5.label: No Waiver Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RnVv902rkpko7wOd8H5.definition: A No Waiver Clause is a provision in a contract that states that the failure to enforce a right or remedy does not constitute a waiver of that right or remedy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnXgsUkRclonIBweCRB.label: Tendered Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RnXgsUkRclonIBweCRB.definition: A tendered contract is a legal defense in civil litigation where the defendant argues that they offered to perform a contract but the plaintiff refused to accept, thereby releasing the defendant from any further obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnY9fKaq3tOLmoz7Mxg.label: Multiple Myeloma
http://lmss.sali.org/RnY9fKaq3tOLmoz7Mxg.definition: Multiple myeloma is a malignant disease of plasma cells that primarily affects the bone marrow and is characterized by the presence of abnormal plasma cells, leading to bone destruction, hypercalcemia, anemia, and renal impairment. Diagnosis is based on the presence of monoclonal protein in the blood or urine, clonal plasma cells in the bone marrow, and related organ or tissue impairment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnZ7eyYiAky9xPb7cvR.label: Hospitality - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RnZ7eyYiAky9xPb7cvR.definition: Real estate used in the hospitality industry including hotels, travel centers, water parks, amusement facilities, golf courses, etc.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rn_3TaY75Sm6jbnOXpw.label: A123 Search Creation and Execution
http://lmss.sali.org/Rn_3TaY75Sm6jbnOXpw.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, creation and execution of electronic document searches irrespective of source of document collection. Excludes legal research (A102).

http://lmss.sali.org/RnbR8lFxaSkSRAS1aAv.label: X104 Special Handling Copying/Scanning/Imaging (Internal)
http://lmss.sali.org/RnbR8lFxaSkSRAS1aAv.definition: Any special oversized copying, binding, scanning, imaging and photograph reproduction handled in-house which requires manual handling

http://lmss.sali.org/RnbuNv1tXLTz7mzD81r.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Cass County
http://lmss.sali.org/RnbuNv1tXLTz7mzD81r.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Cass County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Cass County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RncNeMNwQvKMaiI19YL.label: Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RncNeMNwQvKMaiI19YL.definition: Industries in the Sporting Goods, Hobby, Musical Instrument, Book, and Miscellaneous Retailers subsector retail new sporting goods; new toys, games, and hobby supplies; new sewing supplies and needlework accessories; new musical instruments; new books, newspapers, magazines, and other periodicals; and other specialized lines of merchandise, such as cut flowers and floral arrangements, new office supplies and stationery, new gifts, novelty merchandise, and souvenirs, used merchandise, pets and pet supplies, art, new or used manufactured (mobile) homes, and tobacco, electronic cigarettes, and other smoking supplies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnfzkAKrjy32YoweXnz.label: Revenue Metrics
http://lmss.sali.org/RnfzkAKrjy32YoweXnz.definition: Metrics that provide a quantitative measure of the total income generated through various forms of engagement, offering valuable insights into financial health and growth opportunities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnhX3uvmcQuGpSdfW1I.label: TR260 Enforcement Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RnhX3uvmcQuGpSdfW1I.definition: All actions associated with investigating a claim or potential claim of trademark infringement, dilution or unfair competition before a court of jurisdiction, including definition of the scope of the investigation, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the search results to the client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting the investigation should be an expense under E100. This code set is for determining the facts and recommendations of an enforcement matter. Any subsequent work completed in a contested matter would be expensed under general litigation codes. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnhXmv223OLuy6W4pzI.label: 05_2 Prisoner Petitions: Other (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RnhXmv223OLuy6W4pzI.definition: 05_2 Prisoner Petitions: Other (PACER NoS) refers to a specific category of legal cases filed by prisoners that do not fall under other PACER Nature of Suit Codes, such as mandamus, civil rights, or prison conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnhiP8VAnxlbxEca8ff.label: Clear and Convincing Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RnhiP8VAnxlbxEca8ff.definition: Clear and Convincing Evidence is a standard of proof that requires evidence to be highly and substantially more probable to be true than not, and leaves no serious or substantial doubt in the mind of the factfinder.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rnjzm9w9RiDAQij6gPr.label: "'Required to comply' with fiduciary duties" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/Rnjzm9w9RiDAQij6gPr.definition: The concept of "'Required to comply' with fiduciary duties" Language refers to the specific language used in legal agreements, particularly in relation to No-Shop Covenants and the Fiduciary Standard, that outlines the obligation of parties to act in the best interest of their clients or beneficiaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnklbMBLuq1tIievGuB.label: Intervenor Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/RnklbMBLuq1tIievGuB.definition: A written submission to a court by a third party who seeks to participate in a case in order to protect their interests, which is filed during the appellate stage of the proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnmmbswQcOryRPEoDnH.label: Intellectual Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RnmmbswQcOryRPEoDnH.definition: Intellectual Disability (ID) is a developmental disorder characterized by significant limitations in both intellectual functioning (e.g., learning, reasoning, problem-solving) and adaptive behavior (e.g., social and practical skills), originating before the age of 18. Individuals with ID may experience difficulties in daily activities and require varying levels of support to live independently. This disorder is characterized by significantly subaverage general intellectual functioning, significant deficits in current adaptive functioning, and manifestation of the disorder before age 22. Signs may include, but are not limited to, poor conceptual, social, or practical skills evident in your adaptive functioning. Disorders in this category may be described in the evidence as intellectual disability, intellectual developmental disorder, or historically used terms such as “mental retardation.”

http://lmss.sali.org/RnnJLAzGV4emQlsf4z8.label: Expired Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/RnnJLAzGV4emQlsf4z8.definition: An Expired Registration violation occurs when a vehicle is operated or parked on public roads with an expired registration tag. The individual may face penalties such as fines or impoundment of the vehicle, depending on jurisdictional laws.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnoxgqP0cg3orWcTt0b.label: Oranges
http://lmss.sali.org/RnoxgqP0cg3orWcTt0b.definition: Oranges are sweet citrus fruits from the Citrus sinensis species, known for their vibrant orange color, juicy segments, and aromatic rind. They are widely consumed fresh, juiced, or used in culinary applications, and are valued for their high vitamin C content, antioxidants, and dietary fiber.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rnp7I2NuVr1j0OUm0Uc.label: Mirror Will
http://lmss.sali.org/Rnp7I2NuVr1j0OUm0Uc.definition: Mirror Wills are separate but virtually identical wills made by two people, typically spouses or partners, that reflect each other's wishes. These documents contain reciprocal provisions, usually leaving everything to each other and then to agreed-upon beneficiaries, but remain legally distinct and individually revocable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnrOyBeY7Q-SHU1oD_M.label: P270 Regulatory Reviews
http://lmss.sali.org/RnrOyBeY7Q-SHU1oD_M.definition: This task includes fact investigation/due diligence from a regulatory perspective not covered elsewhere. Includes review of agency filings (e.g., FCC, FTC, and State analogues) by a party to or the subject of the transaction or project. Also includes consumer credit reviews.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rnru8Ihfcco6PerhMz0.label: Full and Final Release Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rnru8Ihfcco6PerhMz0.definition: A Full and Final Release Clause is a provision in a contract that releases all parties from any further obligations or claims related to the subject matter of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnuLwNuTI14dlELybEW.label: Hindu Religion
http://lmss.sali.org/RnuLwNuTI14dlELybEW.definition: The Hindu Religion, or Hinduism, is a diverse and ancient religious tradition that originated in the Indian subcontinent. It encompasses a wide range of beliefs, practices, and rituals, including the worship of multiple deities, adherence to various philosophical schools, and observance of numerous festivals and ceremonies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RnwalewD2udU2ulkmws.label: Motion for New Trial - Procedural Error
http://lmss.sali.org/RnwalewD2udU2ulkmws.definition: A Motion for New Trial based on Procedural Error is a request made by a party to a lawsuit asking the court to set aside the previous trial's verdict and order a new trial due to errors in the legal procedures followed during the original trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro125cqVoenaZ6vLtgN.label: Application for Exchange Visitor Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro125cqVoenaZ6vLtgN.definition: In the United States, the "Application for Exchange Visitor Visa" refers to the DS-160 form that individuals applying for a J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa need to complete as part of the application process. The DS-160 is an online application form used by the U.S. Department of State to gather information about the applicant's background, purpose of travel, and eligibility for the J-1 visa category

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro1RKRYnlciGrhgC4Nj.label: Units - Fee or Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro1RKRYnlciGrhgC4Nj.definition: Units by which engagement payments are calculated (e.g., by hour, by result, by stage, by task)

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro1xv46xjfTzRFTe2Ex.label: Securities Commission Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro1xv46xjfTzRFTe2Ex.definition: A Securities Commission Letter is an official communication issued by a securities regulatory agency. The letter typically provides guidance, regulations, or enforcement actions related to the issuance and trading of securities in the financial market.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro4YbfJJARptSRmz6p3.label: Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community of Minnesota

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro4vnv0ndy3FOdDA3BD.label: Motion to File Brief
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro4vnv0ndy3FOdDA3BD.definition: A Motion to File Brief is a formal request made to a court or other legal authority seeking permission to submit a written document presenting arguments or information in support of a party's position in a legal case.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro7NzBFiq6eW3vKMpqp.label: Preponderance of Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro7NzBFiq6eW3vKMpqp.definition: The concept of "Preponderance of Evidence" refers to the burden of proof in a legal case where the party with the greater weight of evidence in their favor will prevail.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ro9PP70DaBQ08hhexWC.label: Legal Verification Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Ro9PP70DaBQ08hhexWC.definition: Legal Verification Management refers to the process of ensuring the accuracy and validity of legal information and documents, typically through the use of technology and specialized software, within the context of Legal Point Solutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoA3iT57OSgVnM982fP.label: Rebuttal of Presumption of Undue Hardship
http://lmss.sali.org/RoA3iT57OSgVnM982fP.definition: The Rebuttal of Presumption of Undue Hardship is a legal argument made in the context of bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings by a debtor seeking to prove that they are not able to repay their debts without experiencing undue hardship, despite the presumption that they are able to do so.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoABbJ9kEFzmBvBSGmb.label: Inadmissible Documentary Evidence Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RoABbJ9kEFzmBvBSGmb.definition: An Inadmissible Documentary Evidence Objection is raised when a party attempts to introduce a document into evidence that fails to meet the necessary legal requirements for admissibility. This objection encompasses various grounds, such as lack of proper authentication or failure to provide the original document when required by the "original writings" rule (also known as the best evidence rule).

http://lmss.sali.org/RoAfIWi25j1SiaSU9Tj.label: Tax Audit
http://lmss.sali.org/RoAfIWi25j1SiaSU9Tj.definition: A Tax Audit is an official examination of an individual's or organization's tax returns and financial records by tax authorities to verify compliance with tax laws and accuracy in reporting. This event aims to identify discrepancies, ensure proper tax payments, and address potential tax liabilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoBW81nyYipbESPEDm1.label: Early Case Assessment Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RoBW81nyYipbESPEDm1.definition: Early Case Assessment Management is the process of evaluating and analyzing a legal case at an early stage to determine its strengths, weaknesses, and potential outcomes, with the goal of developing an effective litigation strategy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoFJHL2-fSlms0q82cf.label: X138 Litigation Support Vendors
http://lmss.sali.org/RoFJHL2-fSlms0q82cf.definition: Any litigation support or eDiscovery vendor bill paid directly by the law firm or legal vendor and passed through to the client for reimbursement

http://lmss.sali.org/RoFghYhhm3xVguIrNbV.label: Motion for Preliminary Injunction
http://lmss.sali.org/RoFghYhhm3xVguIrNbV.definition: A Motion for Preliminary Injunction is a legal request made to a court asking for a temporary order to prevent a party from taking certain actions until a final decision is made in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoItqhaKPZkQ64eyGLZ.label: Faroese
http://lmss.sali.org/RoItqhaKPZkQ64eyGLZ.definition: A language spoken in the Faroe Islands, which is a subset of the broader category of languages.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoKNrz23ylFaWAaoPC3.label: Estoppel

http://lmss.sali.org/RoYkZAsVB12uyRey9Od.definition: A life sciences patent is a legal protection granted to inventors of new and useful inventions in the fields of biology, biotechnology, genetics, and medicine.
