http://lmss.sali.org/RoZR3BHVWUtxVRtYk6R.definition: A child care license (also known as a day care license) is a permit issued by governmental authorities that allows an individual or organization to legally operate a child care facility. The license confirms that the facility meets specific health, safety, and staffing standards as set by local or state regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RocF9VGGLeVGOb6LeJL.label: Motion for New Trial - Weight of the Evidence
http://lmss.sali.org/RocF9VGGLeVGOb6LeJL.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Weight of the Evidence is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to reconsider the verdict based on the argument that the weight of the evidence presented at trial was insufficient to support the decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoeU3HiA2Za6yvsDXPr.label: Tenant Improvement Allowance Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RoeU3HiA2Za6yvsDXPr.definition: A Tenant Improvement Allowance Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the amount of money a landlord will contribute towards the cost of improving a tenant's leased space.

http://lmss.sali.org/Roek5y4wjsrQS7glQQp.label: E103 Word processing
http://lmss.sali.org/Roek5y4wjsrQS7glQQp.definition: The concept of E103 Word processing refers to the expense incurred for the use of software or services that allow for the creation, editing, and formatting of text documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoekcnKsfxrjTlYTWXS.label: Florida Circuit Court - Volusia County - 7th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RoekcnKsfxrjTlYTWXS.definition: Florida Circuit Court - Volusia County (7th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system located in Volusia County, Florida.

http://lmss.sali.org/RofnAxOvRVPY0Ws2jDe.label: Publicity Covenant
http://lmss.sali.org/RofnAxOvRVPY0Ws2jDe.definition: A "Publicity Covenant" is a contractual provision in which the parties agree on how information related to the transaction or relationship will be disclosed to the public or third parties. This can include stipulations on press releases, announcements, or other public communications, ensuring that both parties have control over or give consent to how the information is presented and disseminated.

http://lmss.sali.org/RogKaTAzyBlKKbhTJxh.label: Hedge Funds
http://lmss.sali.org/RogKaTAzyBlKKbhTJxh.definition: A hedge fund is a type of investment vehicle that pools capital from accredited individuals or institutional investors and invests in a variety of assets, often using complex strategies with the goal of generating high returns. Unlike mutual funds, hedge funds are subject to fewer regulations and often employ more aggressive strategies, including short selling, leverage, and derivatives.

http://lmss.sali.org/RohAeYKXr1pmALLpxYm.label: Antitrust Representation Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RohAeYKXr1pmALLpxYm.definition: Antitrust Language refers to provisions in merger and acquisition agreements that address compliance with antitrust and competition laws. These clauses ensure that the proposed transaction does not result in anti-competitive practices or market concentration that would violate regulatory standards. They may also stipulate conditions or steps to be taken if regulatory approval is required or if there are potential antitrust concerns, such as divestitures or behavioral commitments.

http://lmss.sali.org/Roi2OUuh5i5gPUoKu8J.label: Motions on Evidence, the Record, or Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/Roi2OUuh5i5gPUoKu8J.definition: A Motion on Evidence, the Record, or Appendix is a formal request made to an appellate court to take certain actions related to the evidence, record, or appendix in a legal case, such as correcting errors or supplementing the record.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoltD3dXNzHF23P50ZX.label: Legal Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/RoltD3dXNzHF23P50ZX.definition: Legal Malpractice is the failure of an attorney to provide competent and professional legal services to a client, resulting in harm or damages to the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RomH2TIBKIxiizvn9mi.label: Oregon Circuit Court - Josephine County
http://lmss.sali.org/RomH2TIBKIxiizvn9mi.definition: The Oregon Circuit Court - Josephine County is a specific court within the Oregon Circuit Court system, located in Josephine County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RonEXmIZDyi6e1YgHfY.label: Ohio Court of Common Pleas - Cuyahoga County
http://lmss.sali.org/RonEXmIZDyi6e1YgHfY.definition: The Ohio Court of Common Pleas - Cuyahoga County is a specific court within the Ohio Court of Common Pleas system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within Cuyahoga County, Ohio.

http://lmss.sali.org/RooP304XCeb9F2CqdPZ.label: Land Settlement
http://lmss.sali.org/RooP304XCeb9F2CqdPZ.definition: Land settlement refers to the process where individuals or groups occupy and establish a community or settlement on a specific tract of land, often for agricultural, residential, or developmental purposes. This concept can encompass the historical settling of new territories, as well as modern real estate transactions where land is allocated and developed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RoomNyTyHpWaILi8UoT.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Kosciusko County
http://lmss.sali.org/RoomNyTyHpWaILi8UoT.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Kosciusko County: A court of general jurisdiction in Indiana that hears civil and criminal cases within Kosciusko County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RouKBMqFNMZxi21EPh6.label: Economic Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/RouKBMqFNMZxi21EPh6.definition: Economic Damages refer to the financial losses suffered by an individual or entity as a result of a legal matter, including lost profits, medical expenses, and future earning capacity.

http://lmss.sali.org/Roz2YupppM6kRN8NwAh.label: "More likely than not" Violate Fiduciary Duties Language
http://lmss.sali.org/Roz2YupppM6kRN8NwAh.definition: "More likely than not" Violate Fiduciary Duties Language refers to a specific phrase or wording used in legal documents that suggests a high probability of breaching fiduciary duties by a party, which may result in legal consequences.

http://lmss.sali.org/Roza5Cndr4ONBQG1SIo.label: Classes of Services
http://lmss.sali.org/Roza5Cndr4ONBQG1SIo.definition: Classes of Services: A category of intangible products or activities that are offered by a business or individual for the benefit of others, and which are distinct from physical goods or products.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp05MmBS29XeQLBR7fl.definition: A Motion to Restrict Public Access is a request made in a bankruptcy case to limit public access to certain information or documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp0HEB2LI5bBIWba7je.label: Friendly Takeover
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp0HEB2LI5bBIWba7je.definition: A friendly takeover involves the acquiring company working in cooperation with the target company's management and board of directors to negotiate and agree upon the terms of the acquisition. In a friendly takeover, both parties collaborate to ensure a smooth transition and integration of the businesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp4VHmmdm5bRBMiUXCN.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Curry County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp4VHmmdm5bRBMiUXCN.definition: A court located in Curry County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases, such as traffic violations and misdemeanors.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp5U7YvUPYHEOsnjjVc.label: Motion for Adverse Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp5U7YvUPYHEOsnjjVc.definition: A Motion for Adverse Judgment is a legal request made by a party in a lawsuit, asking the court to rule in their favor because the opposing party has failed to meet their legal obligations or has no valid defense.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp6HMd8Eea47JMlXfYv.label: Administrative Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp6HMd8Eea47JMlXfYv.definition: An Administrative Discharge refers to the release of a service member from their military obligations without the involvement of a court-martial. It is based on administrative reasons rather than punitive ones. This type of discharge can be classified into various categories, such as honorable, other than honorable, or general, based on the circumstances and reasons for the separation. Administrative discharges can result from factors like medical conditions, patterns of misconduct, or other non-judicial reasons.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp7MosoWRv7hbianctg.label: New York Supreme Court - Richmond County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp7MosoWRv7hbianctg.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Richmond County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Richmond County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of legal disputes within its geographic jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rp9XT0Bgc6xHwmBhSM9.label: Emancipation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rp9XT0Bgc6xHwmBhSM9.definition: A claim made in family law or matrimonial cases seeking the legal release of a minor from the control of their parents or guardians.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpBlnyYCfk1C83zT17j.label: Constructive Fraudulent Transfer
http://lmss.sali.org/RpBlnyYCfk1C83zT17j.definition: The concept of Constructive Fraudulent Transfer refers to a transfer of property made with the intent to defraud creditors or hinder their ability to collect debts, but without actual fraudulent intent.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpFL8eFjObYE5sneSBm.label: Personal Jurisdiction by Sufficient Contacts
http://lmss.sali.org/RpFL8eFjObYE5sneSBm.definition: The concept of "Personal Jurisdiction by Sufficient Contacts" refers to the legal authority of a court to hear a case based on a defendant's significant and continuous contacts with the forum state, even if the defendant is not physically present in the state at the time of the lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpFiHrJLCyG02ZDdhSl.label: Military Discrimination
http://lmss.sali.org/RpFiHrJLCyG02ZDdhSl.definition: The concept of Military Discrimination refers to claims of unfair treatment or prejudice based on an individual's past or present military service or affiliation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpGSntZ4otFzth3cIQi.label: Georgia Superior Court - Houston County
http://lmss.sali.org/RpGSntZ4otFzth3cIQi.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Houston County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Houston County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpJaHVwgUyWMAHbsHog.label: Major Joint Dysfunction in Extremities
http://lmss.sali.org/RpJaHVwgUyWMAHbsHog.definition: An abnormality of a major joint in any extremity refers to a condition where a significant joint in the arms or legs, such as the hip, knee, shoulder, or elbow, exhibits structural or functional deviations from the norm. These abnormalities can arise from congenital defects, injuries, or degenerative diseases and may affect joint mobility, stability, and overall function.
http://lmss.sali.org/RpJaHVwgUyWMAHbsHog.pref_label: Abnormality of Major Joint in Any Extremity

http://lmss.sali.org/RpNOHS1FAVVJkNXIN6L.definition: Dispute Proceeding Type refers to the specific legal process used to resolve a conflict between parties, such as an investigation, alternative dispute resolution, administrative proceeding, civil court proceeding, or criminal court proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpQiVFC8yqnzbrgQNE6.definition: An Application to Appoint Creditor's Committee is a formal request made in a bankruptcy case to establish a committee of creditors who will represent the interests of all creditors in the bankruptcy proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpSRZ5rs3ObDIeUpwdj.label: Requests for Production Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RpSRZ5rs3ObDIeUpwdj.definition: Requests for Production Practice refers to the legal process of requesting and obtaining documents or other tangible items from the opposing party in a legal matter, typically as part of the discovery process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpTUD0qxHw05RgxAtgC.label: Board of Zoning Appeals
http://lmss.sali.org/RpTUD0qxHw05RgxAtgC.definition: The Board of Zoning Appeals (BZA) is a specialized governmental body that hears and decides upon appeals, variances, and special exceptions related to local zoning ordinances. Typically quasi-judicial in nature, the BZA reviews cases where applicants seek relief from or challenge the strict application of zoning regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpUpIzhmShj7awqjJo0.label: Haida
http://lmss.sali.org/RpUpIzhmShj7awqjJo0.definition: Haida (Language) is a structured system of communication spoken by the Haida people, characterized by its unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpWWO4QoMRyYTyPJNtx.label: Injury Caused by Wild Animal
http://lmss.sali.org/RpWWO4QoMRyYTyPJNtx.definition: Injury Caused by Wild Animal refers to harm or damage inflicted upon a person by a non-domesticated animal, and falls under the broader category of Animal Claims.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpbFEmJoA2XP14wXKNa.label: Digital Accessibility Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RpbFEmJoA2XP14wXKNa.definition: This claim arises when digital content or services, such as websites, mobile apps, or other online platforms, are not designed or structured to be accessible to individuals with disabilities. This can include issues like lack of screen reader compatibility, missing alternative text for images, or inaccessible video content.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpgwP2pjTpKMG2IhFul.label: Independent Contractor Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RpgwP2pjTpKMG2IhFul.definition: An Independent Contractor Agreement is a contract between a company and an individual or entity hired to perform a specific task or set of tasks. The agreement specifies the nature of the work, payment terms, and clarifies that the contractor is not an employee of the company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpiGkhd21dqeqzY6R5l.label: Fugitive Slave Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RpiGkhd21dqeqzY6R5l.definition: A Fugitive Slave Clause claim refers to a legal argument based on the Fugitive Slave Clause of the United States Constitution, asserting that escaped slaves must be returned to their owners, even if they have reached a state where slavery is prohibited. It was a provision that supported the institution of slavery and compelled states to cooperate in the enforcement of slave owners' property rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpiyvcnyPAZ5hygNt0z.label: Musculoskeletal Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RpiyvcnyPAZ5hygNt0z.definition: A Mobility Disability is a condition that impairs an individual's ability to move freely and perform physical activities, often due to issues with the musculoskeletal or nervous systems. This type of disability can range from partial to complete loss of movement in various parts of the body and may require the use of assistive devices such as wheelchairs, crutches, or prosthetics.

http://lmss.sali.org/RplQCprXIJsh18m8y2A.label: Term
http://lmss.sali.org/RplQCprXIJsh18m8y2A.definition: A term is a unit of meaning that represents a specific concept or idea, and is a child of the logical formula class in the OASIS ontology.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpqNHVsUBJns1sWJI2o.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Greene County
http://lmss.sali.org/RpqNHVsUBJns1sWJI2o.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Greene County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering civil and criminal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpsLKrUlmKbiQrYqjLo.label: Limited Duration Company
http://lmss.sali.org/RpsLKrUlmKbiQrYqjLo.definition: A Limited Duration Company is a company which is registered under the International Business Companies Act with a maximum life span of fifty years.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpvX0cAHoQy91w5ZvU7.label: 2nd Amendment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RpvX0cAHoQy91w5ZvU7.definition: A Second Amendment claim is a legal action initiated by an individual or group alleging that their right to bear arms, as protected by the Second Amendment of the United States Constitution, has been violated by the government or a government actor. The Second Amendment guarantees the right of individuals to keep and bear arms for self-defense and other lawful purposes. A Second Amendment claim may arise in various contexts, such as when a government enacts a law or regulation that unduly restricts the right to own or possess firearms, when a government actor denies a permit or license to possess firearms, or when an individual or group is punished for exercising their Second Amendment rights.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpxsywUcXpBB0v63tUw.label: Invasion of Privacy Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RpxsywUcXpBB0v63tUw.definition: A claim made by an individual alleging that their right to privacy has been violated without their consent, often involving intrusion into their private affairs or public disclosure of private information.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rpy6zPVlaMKkIhe7yY9.label: Exclusion from School Activities
http://lmss.sali.org/Rpy6zPVlaMKkIhe7yY9.definition: Exclusion from school activities refers to the removal or denial of participation in various school-sponsored events, programs, or activities. This exclusion can apply to students or parents and may occur for various reasons, such as disciplinary actions, lack of consent, or failure to meet specific requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RpyimCrQmkKuZJZ5IVF.label: Excise Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RpyimCrQmkKuZJZ5IVF.definition: Excise Tax Payment refers to taxes levied as product-specific unit taxes on a predefined, limited range of goods. Excises are usually imposed at differentiated rates on nonessential or luxury goods, such as alcoholic beverages, tobacco, and energy. They may be assessed at any stage of production or distribution and are typically calculated based on the value, weight, strength, or quantity of the product. These taxes can also apply to individual products like sugar, matches, and chocolates, as well as utilities such as water, electricity, gas, and energy.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rq4ELdFEL5ItwNtbrp8.label: Development of Property Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rq4ELdFEL5ItwNtbrp8.definition: A transaction for the modification or building of something on real property.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rq5QX7mLkcqEdsfMx86.label: Declaratory Judgment Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rq5QX7mLkcqEdsfMx86.definition: A Declaratory Judgment (Claim) is a civil claim seeking a court's declaration of the parties' rights and legal obligations without ordering any specific action or awarding damages.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rq6neiK9deZLSfSa41j.label: Business Insurance Policy
http://lmss.sali.org/Rq6neiK9deZLSfSa41j.definition: A business insurance policy is a contract between a business entity and an insurance provider designed to protect the business from various risks like property damage, liability, and business interruption. The terms of the policy will outline the scope of coverage, limitations, and conditions under which claims can be made, in exchange for payment of premiums.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rq6yO1xU77t0QrBNt0S.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Sullivan County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rq6yO1xU77t0QrBNt0S.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Sullivan County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the county of Sullivan, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rq7yrbwVSqS8fuRtnzD.label: Telecommunications, Media, and Entertainment Law
http://lmss.sali.org/Rq7yrbwVSqS8fuRtnzD.definition: Telecommunications, Media, and Entertainment Law involves the legal principles, regulations, and issues that govern the entertainment industry and media enterprises, including film, music, publishing, and digital media. It encompasses various areas such as Advertising Law, Sports Law, and Entertainment Law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqBFVRMcncXt4WhPxDH.label: Georgian
http://lmss.sali.org/RqBFVRMcncXt4WhPxDH.definition: Georgian (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the country of Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqBMS8HFJwbfAcW0aEK.definition: A Due Diligence Clause is a provision in a contract that requires a party to exercise a certain level of care and investigation before entering into the agreement, often including a period of time for the investigation to take place.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqGvHTwtA1UtIembx0E.label: New York City Court - Rochester
http://lmss.sali.org/RqGvHTwtA1UtIembx0E.definition: New York City Court - Rochester is a specific court located in Rochester, New York that falls under the jurisdiction of the broader New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqGxSnAp9vX42GRKHqw.label: Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RqGxSnAp9vX42GRKHqw.definition: Fraud is the intentional act of deceiving someone in order to gain an unfair advantage or cause harm.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqH4BWxdKaLgUWMsoSw.label: Emergency Room Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RqH4BWxdKaLgUWMsoSw.definition: Negligent actions or omissions by medical professionals in an emergency room setting, resulting in harm or injury to a patient.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqHAb2VknPwsPQ4GYxT.label: Owner Exclusion for Discriminatory Reasons
http://lmss.sali.org/RqHAb2VknPwsPQ4GYxT.definition: The concept of "Owner Exclusion for Discriminatory Reasons" refers to the act of removing a property owner from their property based on discriminatory reasons such as race, gender, religion, or national origin, and is a subcategory of the legal action of ejectment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqHLQbqYW16CtZ6TSKO.label: Admiralty and Maritime Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RqHLQbqYW16CtZ6TSKO.definition: Admiralty and Maritime Claims refer to legal claims arising from incidents that occur on navigable waters, including injuries to seamen, damage to vessels, and cargo disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqItoKI3H03BkiGTjwR.label: Appointment
http://lmss.sali.org/RqItoKI3H03BkiGTjwR.definition: An appointment is a specific type of litigation event where a person is designated to fulfill a particular role or duty, such as a receiver or trustee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqLTf7YnPRDUOTT48Sv.label: AI Technical System Attributes
http://lmss.sali.org/RqLTf7YnPRDUOTT48Sv.definition: AI Technical System Attributes refer to the specific characteristics, functionalities, and methodologies that define the operation and capabilities of artificial intelligence systems. These attributes encompass various elements such as adaptiveness, learning paradigms, human-centered considerations, and technical architectures that collectively determine the system's performance and alignment with human values

http://lmss.sali.org/RqMjkNJ0fgxLg2NEgI3.label: Criminal Citation
http://lmss.sali.org/RqMjkNJ0fgxLg2NEgI3.definition: In the context of criminal law, a citation is a formal notice or document issued by law enforcement officers to an individual, alleging a minor violation or offense, such as a traffic infraction. Rather than arresting the individual, the citation instructs them to appear in court on a specified date to address the violation, or in some cases, to pay a fine or take corrective action. Failure to comply with the terms of a citation can lead to additional penalties or warrants for arrest.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqNYDJtQ1pAsGPKZNEU.label: Commercial and Trade Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RqNYDJtQ1pAsGPKZNEU.definition: Law that applies to the rights, relations, and conduct of persons and businesses engaged in commerce, merchandising, trade, and sales.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqOdgfH9Z27rUXzaKDI.label: Consolidated Bill

http://lmss.sali.org/RqWYmNLhfvzysGhC75y.definition: Immigration Claims refer to legal actions brought by individuals seeking to obtain or protect their rights related to immigration, including violations of immigration laws, applications for naturalization, and illegal re-entry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqiDHswc43JoKvLEHWM.label: Prevailing Wage Violation Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RqiDHswc43JoKvLEHWM.definition: A prevailing wage violation claim is a legal action initiated by an employee against their employer for not paying the required prevailing wage for work performed on a government-funded construction project or a project subject to prevailing wage laws. Prevailing wage laws require contractors and subcontractors to pay workers on public works projects the prevailing wage rate for their job classification in the local area where the work is performed. The claim typically arises when an employer pays workers less than the applicable prevailing wage rate or does not properly classify workers for the purposes of determining their prevailing wage rate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqnIBMd1vm5P2qkKrRw.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Miller County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Miller County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rqv9abaiR5BJYIonRSv.definition: The concept of Larceny by Trick refers to the act of stealing property through deceit or fraud, such as obtaining possession of the property by lying or making false promises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RqvvHQUa3gfya33UyLl.definition: The concept of False Imprisonment refers to a tort claim where a person is unlawfully restrained or confined against their will, without any legal justification or authority.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rr5uuLGspjpJZoB9AYY.definition: A language that was spoken by the Goths, a Germanic people who played a significant role in the fall of the Western Roman Empire.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rr7STYfOraRV76S02ZL.definition: Retirement benefits refer to financial perks or plans offered to employees to support their financial well-being after they retire, including vehicles like 401(k) plans, pensions, and other related financial arrangements.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rr7oz8XcZCBEq0V1LIL.label: Autonomous AI System
http://lmss.sali.org/Rr7oz8XcZCBEq0V1LIL.definition: An Autonomous AI System is an artificial intelligence system capable of performing tasks with minimal human intervention, relying on its ability to analyze data and make decisions independently. These systems are designed to learn and adapt to new situations without explicit programming, enabling them to function in dynamic environments

http://lmss.sali.org/Rr7unN3nXmcbbkDTbDW.label: Article 3 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rr7unN3nXmcbbkDTbDW.definition: An Article III claim pertains to a legal argument based on Article III of the U.S. Constitution, which establishes the judicial branch of the federal government. Such a claim may arise in disputes over federal court jurisdiction, the interpretation of federal laws, or the constitutionality of legislation or executive actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rr9w7wCl8wpJfmdqqOJ.label: Temporary Receiver
http://lmss.sali.org/Rr9w7wCl8wpJfmdqqOJ.definition: A Temporary Receiver is a person appointed by a court to take control of and manage a business or property for a limited period of time, typically to preserve assets or prevent harm until a permanent receiver can be appointed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrAADvsP4nimMFuvYiE.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bryan County
http://lmss.sali.org/RrAADvsP4nimMFuvYiE.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Bryan County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Bryan County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrCF5zcrzh4jFvAQn6e.label: Sex Worker
http://lmss.sali.org/RrCF5zcrzh4jFvAQn6e.definition: A "Sex Worker" refers to an individual who engages in commercial sexual activities in exchange for money, goods, or other forms of compensation. This profession encompasses various roles and services within the adult industry, and the term aims to humanize and destigmatize those involved in such work.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrCRpfvUZ00ERcru31p.label: Gwich'in
http://lmss.sali.org/RrCRpfvUZ00ERcru31p.definition: Gwich'in (Language) is a structured system of communication spoken by the Gwich'in people, primarily in Alaska and Canada.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrCvoYNlr1F0f671Kdq.label: Negligent Handling of Animals
http://lmss.sali.org/RrCvoYNlr1F0f671Kdq.definition: Negligent Handling of Animals refers to a legal claim that arises when an individual fails to exercise reasonable care in handling animals, resulting in harm or injury to another person or property.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrECTdM9f5ml4sac9MF.label: Regulations
http://lmss.sali.org/RrECTdM9f5ml4sac9MF.definition: Rules or orders issued by a governmental regulatory agency and having the force of law.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrEXfbB4FY5W2xzSd4e.definition: A court located in Cowley County, Winfield, Kansas that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrFaPW7zcU84bBDLKpB.label: Indemnifying Party Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RrFaPW7zcU84bBDLKpB.definition: A clause in a contract that specifies the party responsible for providing compensation or reimbursement for any losses or damages incurred by the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrIBhhABVtr5vSCZFL7.label: Financial Management Course
http://lmss.sali.org/RrIBhhABVtr5vSCZFL7.definition: A Financial Management Course is a structured program designed to educate individuals on managing finances, specifically in the context of bankruptcy and restructuring events.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrMIIsCEqxpHSyyLrup.label: Pension Benefit
http://lmss.sali.org/RrMIIsCEqxpHSyyLrup.definition: A pension benefit is a periodic payment made to an employee who has retired from work, based on the employee's years of service and salary history. It is typically provided as part of a retirement plan, ensuring financial security for the retiree.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrOXR1s27xRM6aQWD8q.label: Driving Without a License
http://lmss.sali.org/RrOXR1s27xRM6aQWD8q.definition: Driving Without a License refers to the criminal offense of operating a motor vehicle on public roads without a valid driver's license.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrOlEPl4Uzef7bEh1Up.label: Limited License Legal Technician
http://lmss.sali.org/RrOlEPl4Uzef7bEh1Up.definition: A Limited License Legal Technician (LLLT) is a legal professional who is authorized to provide certain legal services under the supervision of a licensed attorney, but is not a full-fledged lawyer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrPgamntGVCkirompZu.label: oasis:TemporalCharacteristics
http://lmss.sali.org/RrPgamntGVCkirompZu.definition: The concept of oasis:TemporalCharacteristics refers to a type of information that describes the time-related attributes of an object or event, and is a subcategory of the broader concepts of oasis:Associable and oasis:Collection.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrTw7gZ2F0N6WBdARbU.label: In Forma Pauperis
http://lmss.sali.org/RrTw7gZ2F0N6WBdARbU.definition: In forma pauperis (also known as "Fee Waiver") is a legal status granted to individuals who cannot afford the costs associated with legal proceedings, allowing them to proceed without paying fees. Courts typically require proof of indigency, and if granted, this status may cover court costs and other associated expenses

http://lmss.sali.org/RrUujWsbn4EF5HyLOud.label: Domestic Partner
http://lmss.sali.org/RrUujWsbn4EF5HyLOud.definition: A Domestic Partner is an individual who lives with another person in a committed, intimate relationship akin to marriage but without legal recognition as a spouse. This status often provides certain legal benefits and responsibilities, such as healthcare decision-making rights and inheritance, similar to those available to married couples.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrVGQBVLYqjSaNx4RPg.label: Air Force
http://lmss.sali.org/RrVGQBVLYqjSaNx4RPg.definition: An Air Force is the aerial warfare branch of a nation's armed forces, primarily responsible for military operations in the air and space domains. This organization maintains, trains, and equips air and space forces to defend national airspace, provide air support, and conduct strategic air operations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrYc14SDMHyXfplFhiI.label: Unsecured Creditor
http://lmss.sali.org/RrYc14SDMHyXfplFhiI.definition: An unsecured creditor is an individual or institution that lends money without obtaining specified assets as collateral. If a borrower fails to make payment on debt that is unsecured, the creditor cannot take any of the borrower's assets without winning a lawsuit first.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrZ8GeZZWg1PSJ3c7Sq.label: Rights Offering Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RrZ8GeZZWg1PSJ3c7Sq.definition: Rights Offering Practice is a method of equity financing in which a company offers its existing shareholders the right to purchase additional shares of stock, typically at a discounted price, before the shares are offered to the general public. This practice allows companies to raise capital while giving current shareholders the opportunity to maintain their proportional ownership.

http://lmss.sali.org/RraVbXQhP74EFbW54D6.label: School Disciplinary Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RraVbXQhP74EFbW54D6.definition: School disciplinary events, such as suspension and expulsion, are actions taken by educational institutions in response to student misconduct or rule violations. Suspension typically involves a temporary removal of a student from school for a specific period, while expulsion is a more severe action resulting in the student's permanent removal from the school. These measures are intended to maintain a safe and conducive learning environment but must adhere to legal and due process requirements.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrcCXlGpVB5y2DhQaor.label: French
http://lmss.sali.org/RrcCXlGpVB5y2DhQaor.definition: French (Language) is a structured system of communication consisting of grammar and vocabulary, used in legal matters as a means of document, artifact, evidence, testimony, proceeding, or any other legal aspect, and is a subcategory of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RreSXkk2lBT5QOHsP8U.label: Waiver of Damages Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RreSXkk2lBT5QOHsP8U.definition: A Waiver of Damages Clause is a provision in a contract where one party agrees to waive their right to seek damages from the other party in the event of a breach of contract or other specified circumstances.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rrg4cyS943amEafmkgc.label: General Welfare Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/Rrg4cyS943amEafmkgc.definition: A General Welfare Clause claim refers to a legal argument challenging the constitutionality of a law or government action based on the interpretation and application of the General Welfare Clause found in the United States Constitution. This claim asserts that the law or action exceeds the scope of the federal government's authority by not promoting the general welfare of the people, as mandated by the Clause, and therefore may be unconstitutional.

http://lmss.sali.org/RriGmZKwv4jK5icHz7p.label: Failure To Use a Seatbelt
http://lmss.sali.org/RriGmZKwv4jK5icHz7p.definition: The failure to use a seatbelt refers to the act of not wearing a safety belt while driving or riding in a vehicle, which can be used as a defense in civil litigation cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrjGTPu6JzbBZWhk4na.label: Burmese
http://lmss.sali.org/RrjGTPu6JzbBZWhk4na.definition: Burmese (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Burmese language, which is used in legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrkYyPTU4YGup1XdAJH.label: Palming Off
http://lmss.sali.org/RrkYyPTU4YGup1XdAJH.definition: The concept of Palming Off refers to a type of unfair competition claim or intellectual property claim where one party misrepresents their goods or services as those of another party in order to deceive consumers and gain an unfair advantage.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrmWOnsTC9bQsFGeWOD.label: Crewmember Visa - Different Vessels
http://lmss.sali.org/RrmWOnsTC9bQsFGeWOD.definition: Non-immigrant visa for crew members who work on a marine vessel or aircraft and will depart on a different vessel than the one they arrived on.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrnF8rdL9TEXzRcDJGA.label: Florida County Court - Columbia County
http://lmss.sali.org/RrnF8rdL9TEXzRcDJGA.definition: A court located in Columbia County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rrrz5tEefPjrslo4z8d.label: Failure to Prevent Harassment
http://lmss.sali.org/Rrrz5tEefPjrslo4z8d.definition: Failure to prevent harassment refers to a situation in which an employer, organization, or entity does not take appropriate measures to address and discourage harassment within their environment. This can include not having clear policies against harassment, failing to provide training or education on harassment prevention, or neglecting to investigate and resolve complaints of harassment in a timely and effective manner.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rrt9KJEwo6Yz8wbXcaZ.label: Debit Card Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/Rrt9KJEwo6Yz8wbXcaZ.definition: Debit Card Payment is a transaction that transfers funds electronically from the cardholder's bank account to a merchant’s account, facilitated through a debit card network. Unlike credit cards, this form of payment is funded by existing money in the cardholder’s account.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrtcH5tpTa0fn1ESUcS.label: Arizona Superior Court - Navajo Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RrtcH5tpTa0fn1ESUcS.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Navajo Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Navajo County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RruZqndu4LsKmDkgSlS.label: Search
http://lmss.sali.org/RruZqndu4LsKmDkgSlS.definition: Search, in a legal context, refers to the systematic examination and investigation of a person, place, or entity to discover evidence, information, or assets relevant to a legal matter or proceeding. This encompasses activities ranging from physical searches by law enforcement to electronic searches for discoverable information in litigation or due diligence processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrwKWn7PQLCSscgstTN.label: Evidentiary Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/RrwKWn7PQLCSscgstTN.definition: Evidentiary Objectives refer to the goals or purposes of presenting and challenging evidence in a legal proceeding. These objectives include ensuring the relevance, reliability, and fairness of the evidence, as well as preventing undue prejudice or confusion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RrwhSTWvgKB461Y72fW.label: Probate Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RrwhSTWvgKB461Y72fW.definition: Probate Law is the area of law that deals with the legal process of administering the estate of a deceased person, including resolving claims and distributing assets to beneficiaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RryGzhjGLCn21XyIwFX.label: Physician-Patient Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RryGzhjGLCn21XyIwFX.definition: A legal protection that allows a patient to keep confidential any communications made between themselves and their physician.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rs2T4JXRBzxyj3hNAMR.label: Event Status
http://lmss.sali.org/Rs2T4JXRBzxyj3hNAMR.definition: Status of an event (e.g., scheduled, postponed, held, cancelled).

http://lmss.sali.org/Rs6VT1NPT0twQELhnpA.label: Unauthorized Practice of Law
http://lmss.sali.org/Rs6VT1NPT0twQELhnpA.definition: The Unauthorized Practice of Law occurs when an individual or entity engages in legal activities without being licensed or authorized to practice law in a specific jurisdiction. This typically includes offering legal advice, representing clients in legal proceedings, or preparing legal documents for others without the requisite legal qualifications or accreditation.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rs8klnT0vntAbsg0p8r.label: Georgia District Court - Coffee County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rs8klnT0vntAbsg0p8r.definition: Georgia District Court - Coffee County: A specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Coffee County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rs9t8ypW3DzT0VtG9RI.label: Riparian Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/Rs9t8ypW3DzT0VtG9RI.definition: A Riparian Real Estate Asset refers to property that is situated along the banks of a natural watercourse, such as a river, stream, or lake. These assets often come with specific water rights and obligations related to the use, conservation, and management of the adjoining water body.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsAMZy74rL2SqcTNjPK.label: Debtor's Election of Small Business Designation
http://lmss.sali.org/RsAMZy74rL2SqcTNjPK.definition: The Debtor's Election of Small Business Designation is a legal document filed in bankruptcy and restructuring cases by a debtor who qualifies as a small business under the Bankruptcy Code, allowing them to take advantage of certain provisions and procedures specific to small businesses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsCH1D7vkrpOjAD7zyS.label: 899 Administrative Procedure Act/Review or Appeal of Agency Decision (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RsCH1D7vkrpOjAD7zyS.definition: Action filed under the Administrative Procedures Act, 5 U.S.C. § 701, or civil actions to review or appeal a federal agency decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsCr2ffuxk4pqU5CQ8S.label: Foreclosure
http://lmss.sali.org/RsCr2ffuxk4pqU5CQ8S.definition: Foreclosure is the legal process by which a lender takes possession of a property, generally after the borrower fails to meet the financial obligations outlined in the mortgage agreement. The process usually culminates in the sale of the property, with the proceeds used to pay off the outstanding debt and any associated costs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsDNLN3OFdVxc9ZIMb6.label: Personal Identity Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/RsDNLN3OFdVxc9ZIMb6.definition: A personal identity objective refers to an individual's pursuit to legally alter or affirm aspects of their personal identity, such as their name or gender marker, in official records. This process often involves navigating legal procedures and requirements to obtain necessary documentation or court orders to reflect the desired change or affirmation on official identification documents

http://lmss.sali.org/RsDXW4XOplruZcWE3sK.label: National Governmental Leader
http://lmss.sali.org/RsDXW4XOplruZcWE3sK.definition: A national leader is the head of state and/or head of government of a country, responsible for guiding its policies and representing its interests on the global stage. Examples include presidents, who often serve as both head of state and government, and prime ministers, who typically are the head of government in parliamentary systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsERG4YzHQBiWpxhF9l.label: PA630 Official Communication - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RsERG4YzHQBiWpxhF9l.definition: All action associated with processing an Official Communication from a Patent Office outside the home country of the applicant in connection with an application filed under PA500, including initial review and calendaring of any response deadline, report to client with any proposed response, review of applicant's instructions and inventor's comments, preparation of amendments and/or responsive arguments, examiner interviews, and report of actions to the client. Includes activities associated with Official Communications not affecting the merits of the application, such as filing receipts, restriction/election requirements, and annuity/maintenance fee payments. Also includes "Petitions" and other requests for supervisory action that are not decided by a quasi-judicial appellate tribunal within the Patent Office, such as petitions to reinstate an abandoned application in the U.S.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsHGfMOikKPb9YZpGIV.label: Weight Loss Due to Any Digestive Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RsHGfMOikKPb9YZpGIV.definition: Weight loss due to any digestive disorder refers to the significant reduction in body weight resulting from conditions affecting the gastrointestinal tract's ability to properly digest and absorb nutrients. This can be caused by disorders such as Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or chronic pancreatitis, leading to symptoms like malnutrition, decreased appetite, and malabsorption.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsHKmukY8RoJdJO1gsT.label: Constructive Discharge
http://lmss.sali.org/RsHKmukY8RoJdJO1gsT.definition: Constructive Discharge: A legal claim that arises when an employer makes working conditions intolerable for an employee, forcing them to resign, as a result of discrimination or retaliation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsHsEgklvRVFN2pwycg.label: Client Terms Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RsHsEgklvRVFN2pwycg.definition: Client Terms Management refers to the process of managing the terms and conditions of a client's engagement with a law firm, including billing arrangements, scope of work, and other contractual obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsHuW5MLfrGGruc6e9r.label: Material Adverse Effect Definition
http://lmss.sali.org/RsHuW5MLfrGGruc6e9r.definition: Material Adverse Effect (MAE) is a legal term that refers to a significant negative change or event that affects the financial condition, business operations, or assets of a company, and is used in legal agreements to define the circumstances under which a party can terminate or modify the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsIk086IXyTKYbjN680.label: International Carrier Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RsIk086IXyTKYbjN680.definition: The International Carrier Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the carrier responsible for transporting goods or people across international borders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsJ6DupkWKlUlCHH0Yc.label: Litigation Remedies, Relief, and Penalties
http://lmss.sali.org/RsJ6DupkWKlUlCHH0Yc.definition: Litigation Remedies, Relief, and Penalties refer to the legal actions or measures sought by a party in a lawsuit to obtain compensation, restitution, or other forms of relief for harm suffered, as well as the penalties imposed on the opposing party for their wrongdoing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsJmLXZCMyfSkJ6A2x4.label: Return of Company Property Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RsJmLXZCMyfSkJ6A2x4.definition: A Return of Company Property Clause is a provision in a contract that requires the return of any property belonging to the company upon termination of the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsKAdFizNZ9p4EIf28s.label: New York Supreme Court - Putnam County
http://lmss.sali.org/RsKAdFizNZ9p4EIf28s.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Putnam County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Putnam County, New York, which is a subordinate court of the New York Supreme Court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsKDUbw0wJYWl8RVC0O.label: Chamorro
http://lmss.sali.org/RsKDUbw0wJYWl8RVC0O.definition: Chamorro (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Chamorro people of the Mariana Islands.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsMFBq7uyno1UllIoTn.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Dent County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Dent County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsMZCIpNr75CMlyiRfV.definition:
"An indicator of whether the discount or credit applies to fees (""Fee"") or expenses (""Exp"").
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RsMfhxTVe2SIdylrtbI.label: Endometrial Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RsMfhxTVe2SIdylrtbI.definition: Endometrial cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the endometrium, the lining of the uterus. It often presents with abnormal vaginal bleeding and typically requires treatments such as surgery, radiation therapy, and chemotherapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsMwYoqVE3O2RRmXEOZ.label: Contact Mobile Phone
http://lmss.sali.org/RsMwYoqVE3O2RRmXEOZ.definition: Contact Mobile Phone Number refers to the mobile telephone number associated with an individual serving as a point of contact for a business or organization. This information is commonly used for direct communication and may be stored in databases or directories for easy access.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsN5jMsiqL57uIZtgve.label: Withdrawal of Union Shop Authority Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RsN5jMsiqL57uIZtgve.definition: A Withdrawal of Union Shop Authority (UD) Claim is a legal action initiated by an employer or labor organization to terminate or modify a union shop arrangement, which requires all employees in a bargaining unit to become union members as a condition of employment. This claim often arises in the context of changes in labor relations or challenges to the legality of union security clauses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsN9x9sbDJ1uoxxhxVC.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Cumberland County
http://lmss.sali.org/RsN9x9sbDJ1uoxxhxVC.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Cumberland County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that handles minor criminal offenses, traffic violations, and civil cases involving amounts up to $12,000.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsNCuDHhcBOYuucDj6o.label: Clergy-Penitent Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/RsNCuDHhcBOYuucDj6o.definition: A legal concept that protects communications made in confidence between a member of the clergy and a penitent from being disclosed in court proceedings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsP7ipDzVCxegnqVSCg.label: Georgia District Court - Screven County
http://lmss.sali.org/RsP7ipDzVCxegnqVSCg.definition: Georgia District Court - Screven County: A court of law in the state of Georgia that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Screven County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsPz5V4eHK4ktNBSAAf.label: Asset Valuation
http://lmss.sali.org/RsPz5V4eHK4ktNBSAAf.definition: Asset Valuation refers to the process and set of methods used to determine the fair market value of an individual asset, such as real estate, stocks, or machinery. This valuation serves as a foundational element in various financial activities, including transactions, balance sheet reporting, and strategic planning

http://lmss.sali.org/RsR6Vfqf2C5jngqoCJQ.label: Visa for Family Reunification of Permanent Resident
http://lmss.sali.org/RsR6Vfqf2C5jngqoCJQ.definition: The Family Reunification Visa is a nonimmigrant visa that allows the spouses and minor children of U.S. lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders) to enter and remain in the U.S. while their immigrant visa petitions are being processed. The visa is designed to reduce the wait time and keep families together during the lengthy visa processing period.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsR7E09nMYFtvkbfkCY.label: Case Status Update Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/RsR7E09nMYFtvkbfkCY.definition: A Case Status Update Letter is a type of correspondence that provides information on the current status of a legal case, typically sent by an appellate court to the parties involved in the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsRtyiHal5LpCp4JZhZ.label: Bankruptcy Discharge Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RsRtyiHal5LpCp4JZhZ.definition: A bankruptcy discharge order is a court-issued order that releases a debtor from personal liability for certain debts, preventing creditors from taking further collection actions. It signifies the conclusion of a bankruptcy case and provides the debtor with a fresh financial start, although certain debts may not be discharged, such as certain taxes, student loans, or child support obligations

http://lmss.sali.org/RsS68wXy1ay0iCR3UTE.label: Motor Vehicle Theft
http://lmss.sali.org/RsS68wXy1ay0iCR3UTE.definition: The theft of a motor vehicle.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsTF0Cdv5lCbzB7P0L9.label: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RsTF0Cdv5lCbzB7P0L9.definition: An EAR Claim arises when an individual or entity violates the Export Administration Regulations, which govern the export and re-export of dual-use items, software, and technology from the United States. This claim involves allegations of unauthorized export, re-export, or transfer of items subject to EAR to prohibited destinations, entities, or individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsTnyZoBckeYgjbwks7.label: California Superior Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RsTnyZoBckeYgjbwks7.definition: The California Superior Court is a court of general jurisdiction in the California State Courts system, responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdictional boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsV5QMwDFnmWcL8RT5i.label: Private Investigators Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RsV5QMwDFnmWcL8RT5i.definition: Expenses incurred by a party for the purpose of hiring a private investigator to gather information or evidence related to a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsV9iqJSb9nvczqBNpC.label: B.A. (Bachelor of Arts)
http://lmss.sali.org/RsV9iqJSb9nvczqBNpC.definition: The suffix "B.A." stands for "Bachelor of Arts" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an undergraduate degree in a field typically related to the humanities, social sciences, or fine arts. This designation signifies the individual's foundational knowledge and skills in their chosen field of study and is commonly used in academic, professional, and formal settings

http://lmss.sali.org/RsVgTKeIHd94BUU2goO.label: Motion for Certification to State Supreme Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RsVgTKeIHd94BUU2goO.definition: A Motion for Certification to State Supreme Court is a formal request to transfer a case from a lower court to the highest court in the state for review and decision.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsVqLEy1Ul1x1LAG2Ai.label: No Review
http://lmss.sali.org/RsVqLEy1Ul1x1LAG2Ai.definition: No Review: A legal concept referring to a situation where a court or tribunal has no authority to review a decision made by a lower court or administrative agency.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsYpnraUs1U88jsurZg.label: Facsimile Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RsYpnraUs1U88jsurZg.definition: A facsimile expense is a type of expense that refers specifically to the cost of sending or receiving documents via fax, and is considered a subcategory of general expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsZTk6D1WWksAXb2fqc.label: Contact Job Title
http://lmss.sali.org/RsZTk6D1WWksAXb2fqc.definition: Contact Job Title refers to the official designation or position held by an individual who serves as a point of contact for a business or organization. This title provides context for the individual's role and responsibilities, and is often included in professional communications and documentation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsZqYmFpa29ujUnSiVi.label: Organizational Chart
http://lmss.sali.org/RsZqYmFpa29ujUnSiVi.definition: An Organizational Chart is a visual diagram that outlines the structure of the operational functions of an organization. For example, it can show the roles, responsibilities, and relationships between employees, divisions, and other stakeholders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsZxhuNFK33sHecLQ7W.label: Employer
http://lmss.sali.org/RsZxhuNFK33sHecLQ7W.definition: An employer is a person or entity who hires another to performs service under an express or implied agreement and has control, or the right to control, over the manner and means of performing the services. An employer has the right to control an employee.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsaC1DeVmdIpw8YKXA9.label: Divestiture
http://lmss.sali.org/RsaC1DeVmdIpw8YKXA9.definition: Divestiture is the process of selling, liquidating, or otherwise disposing of a company's assets, subsidiaries, or business units, often as a strategic decision or in response to regulatory requirements. Divestitures can be executed for various reasons, such as to streamline operations, raise capital, reduce debt, or comply with antitrust regulations, and typically involve the transfer of ownership and control of the divested assets to another entity.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsakFU5c8t7trv10CiW.label: Ancillary Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RsakFU5c8t7trv10CiW.definition: Ancillary Documents are written or recorded materials that support or supplement Mergers & Acquisitions Documents.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rsd5DlkpsVyqos0zrO3.label: Debt Security Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rsd5DlkpsVyqos0zrO3.definition: A Debt Security Agreement is a legal contract that outlines the terms under which a company or government entity issues debt securities, such as bonds or notes, to investors. The agreement specifies the interest rate, maturity date, and other covenants that govern the relationship between the issuer and the holders of the debt securities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsdDEmJbxIZliJRCdd2.label: Florida Circuit Court - Clay County - 4th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RsdDEmJbxIZliJRCdd2.definition: Florida Circuit Court - Clay County (4th Circuit Court) is a specific court within the Florida Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Clay County, Florida.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsdwEwu7LYvKqhaVWlH.label: Right to Fair Wages
http://lmss.sali.org/RsdwEwu7LYvKqhaVWlH.definition: The right to fair wages refers to the human right that ensures workers receive just and favorable remuneration for their labor, sufficient for a decent standard of living. This right is often protected by international instruments like the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights and national labor laws, which may set minimum wage standards and regulate working conditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsgoER7MK25rNPtQDWo.label: Creoles and pidgins, English based
http://lmss.sali.org/RsgoER7MK25rNPtQDWo.definition: A type of language that is based on English but has developed from a mixture of different languages and is used as a means of communication between people who do not share a common language.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsjSvqTnsUpWdxFUO18.label: Invoice Total Net Due
http://lmss.sali.org/RsjSvqTnsUpWdxFUO18.definition: The "Invoice Total Net Due" is a specific type of fee invoice detail that represents the total amount owed by the client after all deductions and adjustments have been made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RskHhsuhWsZ8Bjxgt5n.label: Confusing Language in Written Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/RskHhsuhWsZ8Bjxgt5n.definition: The concept of "Confusing Language in Written Contract" refers to the use of unclear or ambiguous terms in a written agreement, which may lead to disputes or misunderstandings between the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rslx2R4OEGw6tfdMiFv.label: Public Defender
http://lmss.sali.org/Rslx2R4OEGw6tfdMiFv.definition: A public defender is a lawyer appointed by the court to represent individuals who cannot afford to hire their own legal counsel.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsmQzMZ9Tr9YLeyZNPj.label: Drafting Tools and Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RsmQzMZ9Tr9YLeyZNPj.definition: Drafting Tools and Management refers to the process of creating and organizing legal documents using various tools and techniques, and falls under the broader category of Document Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsnkbLwEhxYv1iqoF4n.label: Transfer Agent Services Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RsnkbLwEhxYv1iqoF4n.definition: A Transfer Agent Services Agreement is a contract between a company and a transfer agent who manages the record-keeping of investor information, processes security transactions, and distributes dividends. The agreement outlines the services provided and compensation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RsqADS9ugQ9yZzYwshy.label: X141 Special Purpose Moving and Storage Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RsqADS9ugQ9yZzYwshy.definition: Any costs for moving and storage of physical objects; typically associated with a trial. Excludes internal data storage fees (X405).
http://lmss.sali.org/RsqADS9ugQ9yZzYwshy.pref_label: X141 Special Purpose Moving and Storage Fees

http://lmss.sali.org/Rss8FJTgnn6V9FuSLxl.label: Insanity Defense
http://lmss.sali.org/Rss8FJTgnn6V9FuSLxl.definition: The insanity defense is a legal strategy in which a defendant claims that they were not criminally responsible for their actions at the time of the alleged crime due to a severe mental disorder or illness. If successful, this defense can result in the defendant being found not guilty by reason of insanity or being committed to a psychiatric institution rather than being subject to criminal penalties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RssAZbpAdTvtzgbHYQt.label: Lack of Authentication Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RssAZbpAdTvtzgbHYQt.definition: A Lack of Authentication Objection is raised when a party attempts to introduce evidence without providing sufficient proof that the evidence is genuine and authentic. This objection asserts that the party offering the evidence has not met the necessary burden to establish that the evidence is what it purports to be.

http://lmss.sali.org/RstHLneVramGuHShP5s.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Juniata County
http://lmss.sali.org/RstHLneVramGuHShP5s.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Juniata County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in the state of Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RswiEHbSw1XSnrr7x9a.label: 380 Other Personal Property Damage (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RswiEHbSw1XSnrr7x9a.definition: Action primarily based on damage to personal property caused by harmful conduct such as negligence, misrepresentation, interference with business relationships or unfair trade practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rsz1ZKYTNGjBNHN0a1u.label: Cherokee
http://lmss.sali.org/Rsz1ZKYTNGjBNHN0a1u.definition: A Native American language spoken primarily in the southeastern United States, particularly in the Cherokee Nation and among members of the Cherokee diaspora.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rsz9106mJVMacoVbGe0.label: Application to Designate Responsible Individual
http://lmss.sali.org/Rsz9106mJVMacoVbGe0.definition: An Application to Designate Responsible Individual is a legal document filed in the context of bankruptcy proceedings, which allows for the appointment of an individual to oversee the administration of the debtor's estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RszUiYFgocCPkuHr4Iz.label: Payment Advices
http://lmss.sali.org/RszUiYFgocCPkuHr4Iz.definition: Payment Advices (Employment Pay Stubs) are written or electronic documents provided by an employer to an employee that show the details of their pay, including deductions and taxes.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt0JqQ9ENDi6hglqbWB.label: Treaty Investor Visa
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt0JqQ9ENDi6hglqbWB.definition: The Treaty Investor Visa is a type of visa offered by various countries to foreign nationals who intend to invest a significant amount of capital in the host country's economy. The visa is usually part of bilateral treaties between the host country and the investor's home country, aimed at encouraging economic cooperation and foreign investment.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt1IQ6Xz3xIuCqfEanq.label: Motion to Enforce Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt1IQ6Xz3xIuCqfEanq.definition: A Motion to Enforce Agreement is a legal request made by one party to a court to compel the other party to comply with the terms of a previously agreed upon settlement.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt2AOEEvMbhpF3f4Nlu.label: Subsidiary
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt2AOEEvMbhpF3f4Nlu.definition: A Subsidiary is a company that is owned or controlled by another company, known as the parent company or holding company. The parent company holds a controlling interest in the subsidiary, typically through ownership of more than 50% of its voting stock, allowing it to influence the subsidiary's management and operations.
examples: Audi AG: A subsidiary of Volkswagen Group, specializing in luxury automobiles.
Instagram, LLC: A subsidiary of Meta Platforms, Inc., focusing on photo and video sharing.
Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc.: A subsidiary of Warner Bros. Discovery, engaged in the film and entertainment industry.
YouTube, LLC: A subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., operating as a video-sharing platform.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt4K0sTb3lb3Y8vIZb8.label: Designation
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt4K0sTb3lb3Y8vIZb8.definition: A designation refers to a specific identification or name given to a legal document or filing, and is a subcategory of Appellate Filings - Correspondence and Forms.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt4T1FlyWPLKcpZDSAs.label: Comparative Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt4T1FlyWPLKcpZDSAs.definition: A legal theory that allows for the apportionment of damages between parties based on their respective degrees of fault or negligence in causing harm or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt5Dk1xAKpjjBXy2m3w.label: Motion to Reject Lease or Executory Contract
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt5Dk1xAKpjjBXy2m3w.definition: A Motion to Reject Lease or Executory Contract is a request made in a bankruptcy case to terminate a lease or contract that is burdensome to the debtor's estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt5FGmbxxPsHHTTCAtF.label: Office of Compliance
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt5FGmbxxPsHHTTCAtF.definition: The Office of Compliance (OOC) is a specific administrative proceeding venue responsible for ensuring compliance with workplace laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt6KOkTvSIlSs53prEh.label: Failure to State a Cause of Action
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt6KOkTvSIlSs53prEh.definition: The failure to state a cause of action is a defense in civil litigation where the plaintiff's complaint does not contain sufficient facts to support a legal claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt7TTPXJ7WX1Jrjufs0.label: Beneficiary
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt7TTPXJ7WX1Jrjufs0.definition: A beneficiary is an individual or entity designated to receive benefits, assets, or proceeds from a legal matter, including those of an estate, trust, insurance policy, or other financial or legal instruments. The term is commonly used in legal and financial contexts to specify who will benefit from a particular financial arrangement or legal structure.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt7y5QJoXmShB4OEPQ8.label: Nutrition Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt7y5QJoXmShB4OEPQ8.definition: The nutrition market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in dietary and nutritional health. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek to maintain or improve their health through balanced and healthy eating habits, dietary supplements, and nutrition-focused products.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rt9cgsg6l3EtGbkJ5yF.label: Patent Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Rt9cgsg6l3EtGbkJ5yF.definition: The management of patents, including their acquisition, maintenance, and enforcement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtCuPfaGyAVDDMDhAaq.label: Marwari
http://lmss.sali.org/RtCuPfaGyAVDDMDhAaq.definition: Marwari is a language spoken in the Indian state of Rajasthan and surrounding areas.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtGO7nVUVQhovRrhewz.label: International Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RtGO7nVUVQhovRrhewz.definition: The international segment refers to a market that spans across multiple countries or regions. It targets a global audience and is characterized by marketing strategies and product offerings that cater to diverse international preferences and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtGb1AJX4FTKl0QftEc.label: Shoalwater Bay Indian Tribe of the Shoalwater Bay Indian Reservation

http://lmss.sali.org/RtGnfdvsy9I8AL3n0Oz.label: Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RtHkyQ5lSxRaJ9oaSOW.label: Vital Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RtHkyQ5lSxRaJ9oaSOW.definition: Vital Status refers to the current state of being either alive or deceased for an individual person.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtJUihV1Pfh2kMyuacR.label: Proceeding Reactivated
http://lmss.sali.org/RtJUihV1Pfh2kMyuacR.definition: The concept of "Case Reactivated" refers to a legal matter that was previously closed or pending, but has now been reopened or resumed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtKp87QjUjjsubajYvW.label: Analysis of KEIPs and KERPs
http://lmss.sali.org/RtKp87QjUjjsubajYvW.definition: Analysis of KEIPs and KERPs refers to the examination and evaluation of key employee incentive plans and key employee retention plans in order to determine their effectiveness and impact on employee retention within an organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtLCzYWZfRT3o7tzhya.label: Peripheral Neuropathy
http://lmss.sali.org/RtLCzYWZfRT3o7tzhya.definition: Peripheral neuropathy refers to a range of disorders caused by damage to the peripheral nerves, which are the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord. This condition often results in symptoms such as pain, numbness, tingling, and weakness, typically affecting the extremities like the hands and feet.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtNdCOiqmpVOXZef1Di.label: Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker
http://lmss.sali.org/RtNdCOiqmpVOXZef1Di.definition: The Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker (in the U.S., I-140 Petition), is a form filed with to initiate the employment-based Permanent Resident (in the U.S., green card) process for a foreign worker. In the United States, this petition is typically filed by the employer to demonstrate that there is a valid job offer and that the foreign worker meets the qualifications for the specific employment-based preference category. For PERM-based I-140 petitions, the employer must first obtain a Labor Certification (PERM) from the U.S. Department of Labor to demonstrate that there are no qualified U.S. workers available for the job position. Once the I-140 is approved, the foreign worker can move forward with the final steps of the green card process, including waiting for a visa number to become available in the relevant preference category

http://lmss.sali.org/RtOq2czQgfEjteQJAux.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Huntingdon County
http://lmss.sali.org/RtOq2czQgfEjteQJAux.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Huntingdon County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Huntingdon County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtQPFGzyCrviDEdzt0a.label: Dzongkha
http://lmss.sali.org/RtQPFGzyCrviDEdzt0a.definition: Dzongkha is a written or spoken structured system of communication that is the official language of Bhutan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtQgohkpDAYX2dOBE8I.label: Appraiser
http://lmss.sali.org/RtQgohkpDAYX2dOBE8I.definition: An expert who conducts an appraisal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtSJkLiGzcKx8PVlCAB.label: Bankruptcy Applications
http://lmss.sali.org/RtSJkLiGzcKx8PVlCAB.definition: Bankruptcy Applications are written requests submitted to a court by individuals or entities seeking relief from their debts and financial obligations under the Bankruptcy and Restructuring Document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtSews3LsWL6xdoibt5.label: Current Legal Efficacy
http://lmss.sali.org/RtSews3LsWL6xdoibt5.definition: Property of a Legal Authority, annotating whether that authority (e.g., caselaw, statute, rule, regulation) is currently effective, or whether it is obsolete (e.g., overruled judicial opinion, superseded statute).

http://lmss.sali.org/RtSnrf1URIhJNP0fCJ6.label: Mammals
http://lmss.sali.org/RtSnrf1URIhJNP0fCJ6.definition: Mammals are a class of vertebrate animals characterized by the presence of mammary glands which produce milk for feeding their young, hair or fur, and a neocortex region in the brain. Mammals are warm-blooded and include a wide range of species from terrestrial to aquatic environments, such as humans, elephants, and whales.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtUC1tvBcYyMrybhdzV.label: MAE-Based Antitrust Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RtUC1tvBcYyMrybhdzV.definition: A MAE-Based Antitrust Standard is a legal concept that sets limitations on antitrust efforts based on the occurrence of a material adverse effect, which is a significant negative change in the financial condition or business operations of a company.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtVEoiPl048ZfSUppj1.label: Bonded Labor Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RtVEoiPl048ZfSUppj1.definition: A bonded labor claim alleges that an individual is forced to work under a debt or other obligation that they cannot repay and that limits their freedom. This practice is a form of modern-day slavery and is illegal under international law and in many national jurisdictions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtYoJXrPiwPxepfYK3g.label: Sjögren’s Syndrome
http://lmss.sali.org/RtYoJXrPiwPxepfYK3g.definition: Sjögren's syndrome is an immune-mediated disorder of the exocrine glands. Involvement of the lacrimal and salivary glands is the hallmark feature, resulting in symptoms of dry eyes and dry mouth, and possible complications, such as corneal damage, blepharitis (eyelid inflammation), dysphagia (difficulty in swallowing), dental caries, and the inability to speak for extended periods of time. Involvement of the exocrine glands of the upper airways may result in persistent dry cough.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtZOQKmbQWbN4HmZscn.label: CLIENT_ADDRESS_1
http://lmss.sali.org/RtZOQKmbQWbN4HmZscn.definition: The concept CLIENT_ADDRESS_1 refers to the first line of the address of a client in the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for legal electronic data exchange.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtZa3Q4Jhg09Lsy7Tlr.label: Court Fees Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/RtZa3Q4Jhg09Lsy7Tlr.definition: Court Fees Expense refers to the costs incurred by a party in a legal matter for filing documents, motions, or other court-related activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtZlndNKDWDIe2rRtUS.label: 152 Recovery of Defaulted Student Loans (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RtZlndNKDWDIe2rRtUS.definition: Action to recover debt owed to the United States from defaulted student loan.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtcZ2CKpIshtXjBITHb.label: Pedi; Sepedi; Northern Sotho
http://lmss.sali.org/RtcZ2CKpIshtXjBITHb.definition: African language spoken in South Africa, belonging to the Bantu language family and specifically to the Sotho-Tswana group.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtdKpTDpiZa6z0RYYz0.label: Chappaquiddick Tribe of the Wampanoag Indian Nation

http://lmss.sali.org/Rte2A8gY3vh8lVIpY5m.label: Pretrial Release
http://lmss.sali.org/Rte2A8gY3vh8lVIpY5m.definition: Pretrial Release refers to the legal process of releasing a defendant from custody before their trial, subject to certain conditions such as bail or supervision, as a means of ensuring their appearance in court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RthkEiKYxt3o1thUAdb.label: Reserved Power Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RthkEiKYxt3o1thUAdb.definition: A Reserved Power Clause claim is a legal assertion related to the Tenth Amendment of the United States Constitution, which reserves to the states or the people any powers not specifically delegated to the federal government or prohibited to the states by the Constitution. This clause forms the basis of federalism, the division of power between the federal government and the states. A claim involving this clause typically arises when there is a dispute over whether a power exercised by the federal government infringes on powers reserved to the states or the people.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rtk1I9my9XunVh1G3oh.label: Revenue Share Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rtk1I9my9XunVh1G3oh.definition: A Revenue Share Agreement is a contractual arrangement where the parties agree to share a portion of the generated revenue from a specific project, product, or business venture. This type of agreement is often used in collaborative business models, joint ventures, or licensing deals to align the interests of the parties and distribute earnings based on their respective contributions or agreed-upon terms.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rtlb0g8ixWZV3HQygRl.label: County Governmental Representative
http://lmss.sali.org/Rtlb0g8ixWZV3HQygRl.definition: A County Governmental Representative is an elected or appointed official who serves in a governmental body overseeing an area larger than a municipality but smaller than a state or province. This individual is responsible for policy-making, budget allocation, and administration of services for a specific region, such as a county, district, or prefecture.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtmRdqzdG4lddVrtCTo.label: Breach of Fiduciary Duty
http://lmss.sali.org/RtmRdqzdG4lddVrtCTo.definition: Breach of Fiduciary Duty refers to a situation where a person in a position of trust and confidence, such as a trustee, agent, or business partner, fails to act in the best interests of the other party and instead acts in their own self-interest, resulting in harm or loss to the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtoqwGhjnspOeVmvIXf.label: Parathyroid Gland Disorders
http://lmss.sali.org/RtoqwGhjnspOeVmvIXf.definition: Parathyroid gland disorders affect the regulation of calcium levels in the body, influencing bone health, blood calcium levels, and nerve and muscle function. These disorders can lead to osteoporosis, fractures, hypercalcemia, kidney failure, and hypocalcemia with associated symptoms such as tetany and muscle spasms.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtowQ7kj1Qwrif8iyWx.label: Material Adverse Effect Definition - "Relating to" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RtowQ7kj1Qwrif8iyWx.definition: A Material Adverse Effect (MAE) Definition - "Relating to" Language refers to a clause in a contract that outlines the specific circumstances under which a party can terminate the agreement if there is a significant negative change in the other party's financial or business condition that affects the overall value of the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtpiPhG6h0b7sUIDKft.label: Term Extension Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RtpiPhG6h0b7sUIDKft.definition: A Term Extension Clause is a provision in a contract that allows for the extension of the agreement beyond its original expiration date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtqoovduMlRE7DMilvl.label: Mental Health Services
http://lmss.sali.org/RtqoovduMlRE7DMilvl.definition: Mental Health Services refer to the treatment and care provided to individuals with mental health conditions as a condition of their criminal disposition.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtrxZGwgTL594abOAwp.label: Discovery Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RtrxZGwgTL594abOAwp.definition: Discovery Documents are written or recorded evidence presented during a legal case, including responses to requests for admission, production, and interrogatories, witness statements, privilege logs, FOIA requests, subpoenas, requests for physical or mental examination, and deposition exhibits.

http://lmss.sali.org/RtvgI7BbCSUGxptjAam.label: X136 Appraiser/Appraisal Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RtvgI7BbCSUGxptjAam.definition: Any Appraiser's fees, appraisal costs or cost of an appraiser's report

http://lmss.sali.org/Rtyq22ozVXJsU1wS8jD.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Adams County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rtyq22ozVXJsU1wS8jD.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Adams County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ru0PT4Forlea4Iv8qAV.label: Motion to Withdraw Document
http://lmss.sali.org/Ru0PT4Forlea4Iv8qAV.definition: A Motion to Withdraw Document is a formal request made to a court or other legal authority to remove a written or recorded representation of thought or expression from consideration in a legal proceeding.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ru41sI42cmsEoPZNzlC.label: Peppers
http://lmss.sali.org/Ru41sI42cmsEoPZNzlC.definition: Peppers are fruit vegetables from the Capsicum genus, known for their diverse flavors ranging from sweet to spicy. They are used in a wide array of culinary applications, valued for their vibrant colors, unique flavors, and nutritional benefits, including vitamins A and C and antioxidants.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ru4JWcuxmRIKjPMhZxp.label: L629 Quality assurance and control
http://lmss.sali.org/Ru4JWcuxmRIKjPMhZxp.definition: Activities and actions related to ensuring that the process and practices used to perform analysis meet an acceptable level of defensibility.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ru4xTEglN22D9fpGWBZ.label: General Partnership
