http://lmss.sali.org/Ru4xTEglN22D9fpGWBZ.definition: A general partnership, the basic form of partnership under common law, is in most countries an association of persons or an unincorporated company with the following major features: must be created by agreement, proof of existence and estoppel; formed by two or more persons; the owners are jointly and severally liable for any legal actions and debts the company may face, unless otherwise provided by law or in the agreement. It is a partnership in which partners share equally in both responsibility and liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ru8IZ0c4FPR4BSj4MyR.label: Risk Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Ru8IZ0c4FPR4BSj4MyR.definition: The concept of Risk Management refers to the process of identifying, assessing, and prioritizing potential risks that may affect a business or organization, and implementing strategies to mitigate or avoid those risks.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuBd7UIXBNWTIC6Dr67.label: Minnesota District Court - Blue Earth County
http://lmss.sali.org/RuBd7UIXBNWTIC6Dr67.definition: Minnesota District Court - Blue Earth County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system located in Blue Earth County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuDAbRiNW105SQoqb1X.label: Injury
http://lmss.sali.org/RuDAbRiNW105SQoqb1X.definition: An injury refers to damage or harm caused to the structure or function of the body, either due to external forces or internal causes. Injuries can be physical or emotional and can result from accidents, falls, hits, weapons, and other causes, leading to pain, discomfort, or disability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuFYyZorYWUSsV5u02J.label: Motion to Avoid Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/RuFYyZorYWUSsV5u02J.definition: A Motion to Avoid Lien is a legal request made in a bankruptcy case to remove a creditor's lien on a debtor's property, allowing the debtor to keep the property free and clear of the creditor's claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuFa1wrcj6X39EQTjEV.label: Cerebral Palsy
http://lmss.sali.org/RuFa1wrcj6X39EQTjEV.definition: Cerebral Palsy (CP) is a group of neurological disorders that affect movement, muscle tone, and posture, caused by damage to the developing brain either during pregnancy, childbirth, or shortly after birth. This condition leads to varying degrees of motor impairment and may also impact speech, vision, and cognitive abilities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuGCUgu3KSRqVu9XKcP.label: X122 Late Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RuGCUgu3KSRqVu9XKcP.definition: Any late fee imposed by a governmental or quasi-governmental agency in any type of matter in order to have a document entered into record past the initial deadline. For IP matters, includes including Petition for Extension of Time and Information Disclosure Statement fees in the US. Excludes any late fee or finance charge on overdue legal bills.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuGrZGUFfiswzSZww3V.label: Intestate Status
http://lmss.sali.org/RuGrZGUFfiswzSZww3V.definition: The state of having died without a valid will or testamentary disposition of property, resulting in the distribution of the deceased's assets according to the laws of intestacy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuIG2rEI5t49RfIVJsH.label: Demand Futility
http://lmss.sali.org/RuIG2rEI5t49RfIVJsH.definition: Demand futility is a legal concept within corporate and partnership liability claims that allows shareholders to bring a lawsuit on behalf of the company without first making a demand on the board of directors if doing so would be futile.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuJballS0a7fp0UeRUT.label: Animal Authorship
http://lmss.sali.org/RuJballS0a7fp0UeRUT.definition: Animal Authorship in copyright law addresses the concept of works created by animals, questioning whether such creations can qualify for copyright protection. It challenges traditional notions of authorship by considering the legal status and intellectual property rights of works produced by non-human beings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuJhYldf073jSBRO6lP.label: 371 Truth in Lending (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RuJhYldf073jSBRO6lP.definition: Action alleging violation of the federal Truth in Lending Act arising from consumer loan transactions involving personal property including automobile loans and revolving credit accounts. Actions relating to fraud or misrepresentation in the transfer of real property should be classified under nature of suit 290, “All Other Real Property,” or, if foreclosure is involved, under nature of suit 220, “Foreclosure.”

http://lmss.sali.org/RuJmpYq6CWT98g9HENe.label: LAW_FIRM_MATTER_ID
http://lmss.sali.org/RuJmpYq6CWT98g9HENe.definition: A LAW_FIRM_MATTER_ID is a unique identifier assigned by a law firm to a specific matter, and is defined within the context of the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard for electronic billing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuKmOKRLQQDzqibBjh1.label: Economic Experts
http://lmss.sali.org/RuKmOKRLQQDzqibBjh1.definition: An expert in a monetary areas, including accounting, appraisal, damages, securities, and other areas of finance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuL0ZmnpwPStrmbowJs.label: cl_tax_id
http://lmss.sali.org/RuL0ZmnpwPStrmbowJs.definition: The client's tax id number to which law firm taxes are charged.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuNRzptxqnjdnI9WDZm.label: Subornation of Perjury
http://lmss.sali.org/RuNRzptxqnjdnI9WDZm.definition: The act of persuading someone to commit perjury, which is giving false testimony under oath, with the intention of obstructing justice or misleading the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuOr8jHRko3SoUEV95z.label: Claim Construction Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RuOr8jHRko3SoUEV95z.definition: Claim Construction Practice refers to the process of analyzing and interpreting the language used in patent claims to determine the scope of the invention, and is a subset of Fact Investigation and Development.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuQrjxxvpOmozofPFu0.label: Non-Main Proceeding (Foreign Insolvency)
http://lmss.sali.org/RuQrjxxvpOmozofPFu0.definition: A non-main proceeding in foreign insolvency is an ancillary insolvency case initiated in a jurisdiction other than where the debtor's center of main interests (COMI) is located. This proceeding handles local assets and operations, complementing the main proceeding by addressing regional concerns and facilitating cooperation in cross-border insolvency cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuRxGOKd3SAaEl1onp3.label: X300 Discovery/eDiscovery Collection-Forensic
http://lmss.sali.org/RuRxGOKd3SAaEl1onp3.definition: Any costs associated with the retrieval of collection materials for forensic purposes when billed as an expense instead of a service

http://lmss.sali.org/RuTiqSJ76kL8qUWS8ca.label: Noncompete Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RuTiqSJ76kL8qUWS8ca.definition: A Noncompete Agreement is a legal contract between an employer and an employee that restricts the employee from working for a competitor or starting a competing business for a certain period of time after leaving the employer.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuUeDwicdR6OBqs9C9v.label: Duration of the Contract Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RuUeDwicdR6OBqs9C9v.definition: The Duration of the Contract Clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the length of time that the agreement will remain in effect.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuVkF69YWfl7oG9MBkj.label: Sheriff
http://lmss.sali.org/RuVkF69YWfl7oG9MBkj.definition: Official of a political subdivision who is charged with judicial duties, such as executing a court's processes and orders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuWy2Mln0IfiDNDCvyT.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Worth County
http://lmss.sali.org/RuWy2Mln0IfiDNDCvyT.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Worth County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Worth County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuXAgB2Spljjm6XAvTw.label: Case Assessment, Development, Administration Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RuXAgB2Spljjm6XAvTw.definition: Documents related to the evaluation, creation, and management of legal cases, including but not limited to pleadings, motions, and discovery requests.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuXnK6ekIOAF6EA1wVt.label: Lung Cancer
http://lmss.sali.org/RuXnK6ekIOAF6EA1wVt.definition: Lung cancer is a type of cancer that begins in the lungs, often in the cells lining the air passages. It can be classified into different types, primarily non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC), each requiring specific treatments such as surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuYMUlbVtOYREJfX9HG.label: Target Stockholder Proceedings Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RuYMUlbVtOYREJfX9HG.definition: Language used in legal proceedings related to disputes between target companies and their stockholders regarding Material Adverse Effect (MAE) definitions and carveouts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuYatR0GQCBDUpS0Wtb.label: Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RuYatR0GQCBDUpS0Wtb.definition: The Commercially Reasonable Efforts Standard is a legal concept that refers to the level of effort that a party must exert in order to fulfill their obligations under a contract or agreement. This standard requires the party to act in a manner that is reasonable and consistent with industry practices and standards.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuZhvzjemQZ4MkRHbBb.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Lasalle County (13th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RuaUxFaB6LghEf6v3QN.label: Application for Trademark Registration
http://lmss.sali.org/RuaUxFaB6LghEf6v3QN.definition: An Application for Trademark Registration is a formal request filed with a trademark office to secure legal protection for a specific logo, name, or symbol used in commerce. The application usually includes the name of the applicant, a representation of the trademark, the goods or services it will be used on, and a specimen showing the trademark as used in commerce.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rub2xErcJ0t8GToQfoa.label: Vegetable Crops
http://lmss.sali.org/Rub2xErcJ0t8GToQfoa.definition: Vegetable Crops are cultivated plants grown primarily for their edible parts, such as leaves, roots, stems, and fruits. They are a vital component of human diets, providing essential vitamins, minerals, and fiber, and are cultivated in a variety of environments worldwide.

http://lmss.sali.org/RudVpL8vC628MXN0Aly.label: Supporting
http://lmss.sali.org/RudVpL8vC628MXN0Aly.definition: Actor who is supporting the Lead.

http://lmss.sali.org/RueR3rhuHgLRlPI7BKS.label: French, Middle
http://lmss.sali.org/RueR3rhuHgLRlPI7BKS.definition: Middle French is a language that was spoken in France between the 14th and 17th centuries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RufYamRr2NVHvQecvks.label: Prepayment Penalty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RufYamRr2NVHvQecvks.definition: A prepayment penalty clause is a provision in a contract that requires a borrower to pay a fee or penalty if they pay off a loan before the end of its term.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuidEWPhqdnezHnYG0X.label: Claim for Falling on Grease
http://lmss.sali.org/RuidEWPhqdnezHnYG0X.definition: A claim for falling on grease is a legal assertion made by a plaintiff who has suffered injury due to slipping on a surface contaminated with grease, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of slip-and-fall negligence.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuihYLprF6BAYRiY7f0.label: Joint and Several Obligations Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RuihYLprF6BAYRiY7f0.definition: A joint and several obligations clause is a provision in a contract where two or more parties are jointly and individually responsible for fulfilling the obligations outlined in the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ruiy0zsIf3NYCzYWb5t.label: Voter
http://lmss.sali.org/Ruiy0zsIf3NYCzYWb5t.definition: A voter, also known as an Elector, is an individual who is eligible to vote in an election. This term can also refer to a member of an electoral college, who has the formal responsibility to cast votes for the selection of certain public officials, such as the President of the United States.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rul3ZQ6VDAEkNdMR0aj.label: "'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/Rul3ZQ6VDAEkNdMR0aj.definition: "'Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent' with fiduciary duties" Language refers to a specific phrase used in legal documents that indicates actions or decisions that may go against the responsibilities and obligations of a fiduciary, such as a trustee or agent, and may result in legal consequences.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuliWeVDE8CQi4AATMN.label: Abstention Doctrines
http://lmss.sali.org/RuliWeVDE8CQi4AATMN.definition: Abstention Doctrines refer to legal theories that allow federal courts to abstain from exercising jurisdiction over a case in deference to state court proceedings, including Pullman Abstention, Brillhart-Wilton Abstention, Younger Abstention, Burford Abstention, and Colorado River Abstention.

http://lmss.sali.org/RumDhEGZaR4LvYIQUoJ.label: Attachment
http://lmss.sali.org/RumDhEGZaR4LvYIQUoJ.definition: Attachment refers to a legal remedy that allows a creditor to seize a debtor's property before a judgment is made, in order to secure payment of a debt.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuoTLodWI8r1M7hg3sl.label: JK10 Preparation of trial bundles (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RuoTLodWI8r1M7hg3sl.definition: Time spent identifying documents for inclusion in the trial bundles, working with the other parties to agree the trial bundles, preparing and updating the trial bundles.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuoUsMPWNHUFq304ESv.label: Monetary Outflow
http://lmss.sali.org/RuoUsMPWNHUFq304ESv.definition: Legal Services Buyer pays external Actor. Money flowing out of the Legal Services Buyer. E.g., Legal Services Buyer pays Legal Services Provider. In Accounts Payable systems (e.g., Oracle), this is labeled "Cost Center."

http://lmss.sali.org/Rur2GcVfhwGRdEjyt84.label: Eviction of Tenant for Illegal Occupancy
http://lmss.sali.org/Rur2GcVfhwGRdEjyt84.definition: The eviction of a tenant for occupying a property illegally, which involves the removal of the tenant from the property due to a violation of the terms of the lease or rental agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RusVTgN5XKjS4qJaIYI.label: Banking Law Documents
http://lmss.sali.org/RusVTgN5XKjS4qJaIYI.definition: "Banking Law Documents" refer to the collection of legal texts, forms, contracts, and regulatory materials that govern the operations, transactions, and compliance of financial institutions. These documents encompass a wide range of topics, including but not limited to, customer interactions, financial transactions, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rut-9YyvT3OL__I9r1Z.label: Nuclear Electric Power Generation
http://lmss.sali.org/Rut-9YyvT3OL__I9r1Z.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating nuclear electric power generation facilities. These facilities use nuclear power to produce electric energy. The electric energy produced in these establishments is provided to electric power transmission systems or to electric power distribution systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/RutXSExAWlagMSiMY90.label: Pricing Grid Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RutXSExAWlagMSiMY90.definition: A Pricing Grid Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the pricing structure for goods or services, typically presented in a grid format.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuuyvVIox6mEdUaIi6r.label: No Compensation Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RuuyvVIox6mEdUaIi6r.definition: A No Compensation Clause is a provision in a contract that prohibits one party from receiving any form of payment or reimbursement for their services or actions related to the contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuwRSRjBqTUCrx9P-wI.label: X119 Foreclosure Costs
http://lmss.sali.org/RuwRSRjBqTUCrx9P-wI.definition: Any other costs specifically associated with a foreclosure action not already provided for within the expense codes

http://lmss.sali.org/RuxpPEnx5gPVvb3GolF.label: Motion to Set Hearing
http://lmss.sali.org/RuxpPEnx5gPVvb3GolF.definition: A Motion to Set Hearing is a formal request made to a court or tribunal to schedule a hearing for a specific matter, often used to expedite the legal process.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuyZNixKnG2371yxDSw.label: Georgia District Court - Colquitt County
http://lmss.sali.org/RuyZNixKnG2371yxDSw.definition: A court located in Colquitt County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RuzenPJ5TXCwXPQoVD2.label: Motion for New Trial - Evidentiary Error
http://lmss.sali.org/RuzenPJ5TXCwXPQoVD2.definition: A Motion for New Trial - Evidentiary Error is a legal request made by a party to a case asking the court to grant a new trial due to a mistake made during the presentation of evidence that affected the outcome of the trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv1W9XAEwmBhuHZ7qNH.label: Motion to Continue
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv1W9XAEwmBhuHZ7qNH.definition: A Motion to Continue is a request made to a court to postpone a scheduled hearing or trial to a later date.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv279y8wg9Lh0P6PqXP.label: Pahlavi
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv279y8wg9Lh0P6PqXP.definition: A language that was used in ancient Persia and is now extinct, characterized by its use of an Aramaic script and its influence on modern Persian.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv2BH4j7XbwE7RJbqFk.label: Risk Benefit Test
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv2BH4j7XbwE7RJbqFk.definition: A Risk Benefit Test is a defense used in product liability cases where the defendant argues that the benefits of the product outweigh the risks associated with it.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv2q2GbIs1ciD5N7uf4.label: Internal Medicine Malpractice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv2q2GbIs1ciD5N7uf4.definition: Negligent or wrongful actions or omissions committed by a healthcare provider who specializes in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of adult diseases, and who has breached the standard of care expected in the field of internal medicine.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv3E9nq0JvIPTd5My1y.label: Transportation Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv3E9nq0JvIPTd5My1y.definition: A Transportation Agreement is a legally binding contract between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the transportation of goods or people from one place to another.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv3swANBomz5la6o0Se.label: Pro Se Party
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv3swANBomz5la6o0Se.definition: A Pro Se Party is an individual who represents themselves in a legal matter without the assistance of an attorney. Another name for pro se is "unrepresented party."

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv4ABt24oeDVQUXuwWg.label: Brief Drafting Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv4ABt24oeDVQUXuwWg.definition: Brief Drafting Management refers to the process of managing and organizing the creation of legal documents that are concise and to the point. It is a subcategory of Litigation Management, which involves the overall management of legal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rv6S9nLU92wbJMJHTQR.label: ADR Private Judging Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/Rv6S9nLU92wbJMJHTQR.definition: A private forum for alternative dispute resolution (ADR) where a neutral third party acts as a judge to resolve disputes outside of the court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvAPD1VTRvO1JjOaCGx.label: Analysis of Environmental Considerations
http://lmss.sali.org/RvAPD1VTRvO1JjOaCGx.definition: Analysis of Environmental Considerations refers to the process of evaluating and assessing the potential environmental impacts and consequences of a legal obligation or action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvBPzbdQdgSMJrZtfAx.label: Geez
http://lmss.sali.org/RvBPzbdQdgSMJrZtfAx.definition: A language originating in Ethiopia and Eritrea, characterized by a script that dates back to the 5th century and is still used in religious contexts.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvBgYD1PbK9WZrkMwuB.label: Upper Sorbian
http://lmss.sali.org/RvBgYD1PbK9WZrkMwuB.definition: Upper Sorbian is a Slavic language spoken in eastern Germany, primarily in the region of Lusatia, and is a subcategory of the Language top-level class.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvCyXheApiOSz6osTb8.label: Recitals Incorporated Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RvCyXheApiOSz6osTb8.definition: A Recitals Incorporated Clause is a type of contractual clause that includes a section outlining the background and context of the agreement being made.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvFOoGYP10Qkd86ugVy.label: Consumer Protection Act Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RvFOoGYP10Qkd86ugVy.definition: Claims made under the Consumer Protection Act, which provide legal recourse for consumers who have been harmed by defective products or unfair business practices.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvG8Z4RwqjGEGd8i1qS.label: Georgia District Court - Catoosa County
http://lmss.sali.org/RvG8Z4RwqjGEGd8i1qS.definition: A court located in Catoosa County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvHK3kJKRvG6dboS1cP.label: Withdrawal of Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RvHK3kJKRvG6dboS1cP.definition: Withdrawal of Claim refers to the act of retracting a previously filed claim in a bankruptcy or restructuring document.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvHOPp8VdeUP69FBWd2.label: Fanti
http://lmss.sali.org/RvHOPp8VdeUP69FBWd2.definition: Fanti is a language that belongs to the Language top-level class and is spoken in Ghana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvITJ74ynBH2zCNG0vf.label: Employment Training
http://lmss.sali.org/RvITJ74ynBH2zCNG0vf.definition: "Employment Training" refers to the process of acquiring or enhancing the skills, knowledge, and competencies necessary for a specific job or career. It often involves formal or informal education, on-the-job training, workshops, or courses designed to prepare individuals for employment or improve their performance in a current job.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvIX5LiqKdGfF4rcmou.label: Tax ID - Firm
http://lmss.sali.org/RvIX5LiqKdGfF4rcmou.definition: A Tax ID - Firm is a specific identifier assigned to a legal services provider organization for tax purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvJsM8w7P50e9uwf6Yz.label: Petition for Skilled Workers - Master's Cap
http://lmss.sali.org/RvJsM8w7P50e9uwf6Yz.definition: In the United States, the "Petition for Skilled Workers - Master's Cap" involves employers filing Form I-129 for H-1B visas on behalf of prospective employees with a master's degree or higher, subject to the annual H-1B master's cap, and potentially requiring a lottery for selection

http://lmss.sali.org/RvKP6GwVs7lzIl3Uhnv.label: Funeral
http://lmss.sali.org/RvKP6GwVs7lzIl3Uhnv.definition: A funeral is a ceremony or service held in honor of a deceased person, often involving rituals, customs, or religious practices. The event can include various elements such as eulogies, the burial or cremation of the body, and gatherings for mourning and remembrance.
sources: From LIST: Legal Issues Taxonomy — https://taxonomy.legal/

http://lmss.sali.org/RvKWzeabmYGNsPTgpV0.label: Description of Asset Recovery
http://lmss.sali.org/RvKWzeabmYGNsPTgpV0.definition: For a given dispute, a description of the assets that are potentially recoverable.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvMbV7PbNx2ccGZF1PE.label: Notice of Action
http://lmss.sali.org/RvMbV7PbNx2ccGZF1PE.definition: A Notice of Action (in the U.S., Form I-797), is a document issued by the government agency (e.g., United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS)) to communicate specific actions taken on an immigration application or petition. It serves as an official receipt or approval notice for various immigration-related applications, including visa petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvOCpmr98FwBq1EZ2L8.label: Single Transferable Vote System
http://lmss.sali.org/RvOCpmr98FwBq1EZ2L8.definition: The Single Transferable Vote (STV) system is a proportional voting method where voters rank candidates in order of preference. Votes are initially allocated to each voter's first preference, and if a candidate reaches a specified quota, they are elected; any surplus votes are transferred to remaining candidates based on the voters' next preferences, and this process continues until all seats are filled.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvOk9UP5lfNJm6UJBzG.label: Uncontentious
http://lmss.sali.org/RvOk9UP5lfNJm6UJBzG.definition: Uncontentious negotiation refers to a negotiation process where parties have aligned interests and work cooperatively to reach an agreement without conflict or adversarial tactics. This approach emphasizes mutual understanding, amicable discussions, and efficient resolution of terms, often resulting in agreements that are satisfactory to all parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvSlOEolBu8mN8qzVuu.label: Missouri Circuit Court - City of St. Louis
http://lmss.sali.org/RvSlOEolBu8mN8qzVuu.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court located in the City of St. Louis, which is a court of general jurisdiction in Missouri responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvUasCI1Y704vIh3IaI.label: Connecticut Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RvUasCI1Y704vIh3IaI.definition: The Connecticut Circuit Court is a lower court within the Connecticut State Courts system that has jurisdiction over certain civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvUd14Lw1TxYJEBX6IF.label: Wellness Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RvUd14Lw1TxYJEBX6IF.definition: The wellness market segment refers to a division of the market that is specifically targeted towards consumers who are interested in maintaining or enhancing their overall well-being. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are designed to cater to the needs, preferences, and interests of individuals who seek holistic health solutions, including physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual wellness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvXeh0ZAtQc2cpH9Gmy.label: B170 Fee/Employment Objections
http://lmss.sali.org/RvXeh0ZAtQc2cpH9Gmy.definition: Review of and objections to the employment and fee applications of others

http://lmss.sali.org/RvYm9rfykaYAU0n4v49.label: New York Supreme Court - Saratoga County
http://lmss.sali.org/RvYm9rfykaYAU0n4v49.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Saratoga County is a court of general jurisdiction in the state of New York that has the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvYuKVxSvhODjfxzqHd.label: "Constructive Knowledge - Express Investigation" Language
http://lmss.sali.org/RvYuKVxSvhODjfxzqHd.definition: A negative change or event that has a significant impact on a company's financial condition or operations, and which a reasonable person would not have known about without conducting an express investigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvYz3orfLlfDkyq7oyL.label: Improper Impeachment Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RvYz3orfLlfDkyq7oyL.definition: An Improper Impeachment Objection is raised when a party in a legal proceeding believes that the opposing counsel is attempting to discredit a witness in a manner that is not allowed by the rules of evidence. This objection aims to protect the integrity of the witness's testimony and ensure that any challenge to their credibility is conducted appropriately.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvZDroDaAPsXaMsTgTS.label: Florida County Court - Hendry County
http://lmss.sali.org/RvZDroDaAPsXaMsTgTS.definition: A court located in Hendry County, Florida that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within the county.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvZL9hXii6Ka5fXySxv.label: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder
http://lmss.sali.org/RvZL9hXii6Ka5fXySxv.definition: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is a mental health condition triggered by experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event, such as a natural disaster, serious accident, terrorist act, war/combat, rape, or other violent personal assault. Individuals with PTSD may experience intense, disturbing thoughts and feelings related to their experience long after the traumatic event has ended.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvaALQLFU83UkZaEMOL.label: Slavic languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RvaALQLFU83UkZaEMOL.definition: Slavic languages are a group of related languages spoken in Eastern Europe, characterized by their use of the Cyrillic alphabet and shared grammatical features.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvarcjDMtvkjKFA7vTQ.label: Late Payment Penalty Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RvarcjDMtvkjKFA7vTQ.definition: A Late Payment Penalty Clause is a provision in a contract that imposes a financial penalty on a party who fails to make a payment by the agreed-upon due date.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvbyX8vNJ1kNZBC1pcm.label: Metallic Mineral Rights
http://lmss.sali.org/RvbyX8vNJ1kNZBC1pcm.definition: These rights concern the ownership and extraction of metallic minerals, like gold, silver, copper, and iron, from a particular area of land. These rights can be leased, sold, or transferred, allowing either the owner or the lessee to profit from the extraction of these minerals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvdWikoK944iZtZ4cu5.label: Exceptions Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RvdWikoK944iZtZ4cu5.definition: An Exceptions Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or action violates the Exceptions Clause of the United States Constitution by exceeding the constitutional limitations on the President's veto power, as the Clause outlines specific circumstances where a veto can be overridden by a two-thirds majority vote in both houses of Congress. The claim challenges the validity of the law or action based on an alleged violation of the constitutional procedures outlined in the Exceptions Clause

http://lmss.sali.org/RvfWrROj8zJrtO8P9B5.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Douglas County (6th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RvgSllm1V4c8HFGjBKE.label: Verdict
http://lmss.sali.org/RvgSllm1V4c8HFGjBKE.definition: A verdict is a decision made by a trial court that determines the guilt or innocence of a defendant.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rvh4toXuvsKHyb8iiH8.label: AAA Construction Industry Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures
http://lmss.sali.org/Rvh4toXuvsKHyb8iiH8.definition: The AAA Construction Industry Arbitration Rules and Mediation Procedures are a set of guidelines and procedures established by the American Arbitration Association for resolving disputes in the construction industry through arbitration and mediation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvnRVMO2BRVEyUKVlBt.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Nodaway County
http://lmss.sali.org/RvnRVMO2BRVEyUKVlBt.definition: A Missouri Circuit Court in Nodaway County is a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Nodaway County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvpVqC4Gt7SDHOy4JCO.label: Business Formation Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RvpVqC4Gt7SDHOy4JCO.definition: Business formation practice refers to the legal service in which lawyers assist individuals in establishing a new business, covering aspects like selecting the appropriate business structure, filing necessary paperwork, and ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Lawyers in this field guide clients through legal complexities to mitigate risk and create a sound legal foundation for the business

http://lmss.sali.org/RvpY1fp6IX31yViO9GQ.label: Azerbaijani
http://lmss.sali.org/RvpY1fp6IX31yViO9GQ.definition: Azerbaijani (Language) refers to the written or spoken structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary specific to the Azerbaijani language, which is a member of the Turkic language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvpYaZqbCEq7HyOJQvs.label: German, Middle High
http://lmss.sali.org/RvpYaZqbCEq7HyOJQvs.definition: Middle High German is a structured system of communication used between 1050 and 1500, and is considered a language in the context of legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rvqabl3zKCe9914xjp4.label: M&A F4 Environmental Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/Rvqabl3zKCe9914xjp4.definition: M&A F4 Environmental Practice refers to the legal work performed by a Legal Services Provider in the course of a merger or acquisition transaction that involves regulatory and specialty matters related to environmental issues.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rvr8AdbITF9NopKBs88.label: Motion to Extend Time to File Appendix
http://lmss.sali.org/Rvr8AdbITF9NopKBs88.definition: A Motion to Extend Time to File Appendix is a request made to a court to allow additional time beyond the original deadline for a party to submit a document containing the record of a case on appeal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvtAG5ZxdY8mteP8zvI.label: Bankruptcy Schedule - Codebtors
http://lmss.sali.org/RvtAG5ZxdY8mteP8zvI.definition: Bankruptcy Schedule - Codebtors, also known as Schedule H, requires the debtor to list all individuals or entities who are also liable on any of the debtor's debts. This schedule includes the names and addresses of codebtors, along with the corresponding debts for which they share liability, providing transparency about shared financial obligations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvtKtmtbtUkG15r7cuH.label: Return on Investment
http://lmss.sali.org/RvtKtmtbtUkG15r7cuH.definition: Return on Investment (ROI) is a financial metric used to evaluate the profitability of an investment or to compare the profitability of multiple investments. It is calculated by dividing the net profit from the investment by the initial cost, usually multiplied by 100 to express it as a percentage. ROI is commonly used to evaluate investment effectiveness.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvthpGbzF5vsoC8eT3r.label: Papuan languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RvthpGbzF5vsoC8eT3r.definition: A group of languages spoken in Papua New Guinea and surrounding areas, characterized by their unique grammar and vocabulary.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rvv1eQgS5npqL7Oq4au.label: Term of Agreement and Termination Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rvv1eQgS5npqL7Oq4au.definition: A Term of Agreement and Termination Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which the agreement can be ended by either party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvvvSrhxhsCCUkfpr6e.label: Laryngitis
http://lmss.sali.org/RvvvSrhxhsCCUkfpr6e.definition: Laryngitis is an inflammation of the larynx (voice box), often causing hoarseness or loss of voice, and may be accompanied by throat pain and coughing. This condition can be acute, typically resulting from viral infections or vocal strain, or chronic, caused by persistent irritation from factors such as smoking, GERD, or prolonged vocal overuse.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvwiNpzsydr7gKcGS9i.label: Remote Deposition Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RvwiNpzsydr7gKcGS9i.definition: Remote Deposition Management refers to the process of managing and conducting depositions remotely, typically through video conferencing technology. This concept falls under the broader category of Litigation Management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvxWl1GyQyoCflTi4Et.label: Indian Commerce Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RvxWl1GyQyoCflTi4Et.definition: An Indian Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a state law or regulation infringes upon the exclusive authority of the federal government to regulate commerce with Native American tribes. This claim is based on the interpretation that the Indian Commerce Clause grants Congress the power to regulate trade and commerce involving tribal nations, thereby limiting state interference in this sphere.

http://lmss.sali.org/RvyyiqOv1WWXcWSX9JV.label: Contact Phone
http://lmss.sali.org/RvyyiqOv1WWXcWSX9JV.definition: A contact phone is a type of contact information used to communicate with a person or entity involved in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw-stB2cwRMGrEmbJLN.label: A120 Processing
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw-stB2cwRMGrEmbJLN.definition: For discovery and eDiscovery, services associated with the processing of documents, images, files, etc. in a document collection. Includes OCR, importing/ingestion/overlay, exporting, file conversion and/or extraction when billed as a service. Excludes scanning (A117).

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw0vHmAxPQA6gaaufqW.label: Stipulation to Compromise Controversy
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw0vHmAxPQA6gaaufqW.definition: A Stipulation to Compromise Controversy is a legal agreement between parties to settle a dispute by making concessions and coming to a mutual agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw11rpQqnQyaJiNFECV.label: P220 Tax
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw11rpQqnQyaJiNFECV.definition: This task includes all steps involved in conducting fact investigation/due diligence from a tax perspective.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw514WrvQbSAQN7bZyT.label: Espionage
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw514WrvQbSAQN7bZyT.definition: The act of spying or gathering confidential information for a foreign government or entity, considered a crime against the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw5OH1xJGJ68bljWGn5.label: Impact Investor
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw5OH1xJGJ68bljWGn5.definition: Investors who aim to generate a measurable, beneficial social or environmental impact alongside a financial return.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw7Dq022luyqZ98hcMb.label: Motion for Exemption from Credit Counseling
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw7Dq022luyqZ98hcMb.definition: A Motion for Exemption from Credit Counseling is a request made in a bankruptcy case to be excused from the requirement of completing credit counseling before filing for bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw8TISGrIXU7Q2wMpVE.label: Radishes
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw8TISGrIXU7Q2wMpVE.definition: Radishes are edible root vegetables belonging to the Raphanus sativus species, characterized by their crisp texture and pungent flavor. They are typically small, round or elongated in shape, with colors ranging from white to red to black, and are consumed raw in salads, as garnishes, or cooked in various culinary applications.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw8qpqnhIJYzvDbHTch.label: M.B.A. (Master of Business Administration)
http://lmss.sali.org/Rw8qpqnhIJYzvDbHTch.definition: The suffix "M.B.A." stands for "Master of Business Administration" and is used after a person's name to indicate that they have earned an advanced degree in business management. This designation signifies the individual's expertise in various aspects of business, such as finance, marketing, and operations, and is commonly used in professional, academic, and formal settings

http://lmss.sali.org/Rw9VrMyvwlIMtlLMfsK.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Vermilion County (5th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RwAhEspfh5POkWeAGBq.label: Pushto; Pashto
http://lmss.sali.org/RwAhEspfh5POkWeAGBq.definition: A language spoken primarily in Afghanistan and Pakistan, belonging to the Indo-European family and written in Arabic script.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwBKJaiDnBsAeybx19P.label: Past Medical Expenses
http://lmss.sali.org/RwBKJaiDnBsAeybx19P.definition: Expenses incurred for medical treatment or services that have already been provided to an individual.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwBvYhPgZD3E9q63hRq.label: Job Application
http://lmss.sali.org/RwBvYhPgZD3E9q63hRq.definition: A "Job Application" is a formal document or form that individuals submit to potential employers when expressing interest in a specific job or position. It typically includes personal information, work history, education, qualifications, and may require applicants to answer specific questions related to the job. Job applications serve as the initial step in the hiring process, allowing employers to assess candidates' suitability for a particular role.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwD7QSyU5m2So0AXqiv.label: JJ00 Interim Applications and Hearings (UK J-CODE)
http://lmss.sali.org/RwD7QSyU5m2So0AXqiv.definition: Work covering all proposed and actual interim applications and hearings.  Includes taking instructions,  making inquiries, research, preparing and filing applications, supporting evidence and skeleton arguments including reviewing those of other parties whether or not a responsive document is served, preparing for and attending hearings and all meetings and communications for the purpose of such applications or hearings.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwDaHIBVHWxyiPeB3k0.label: Income Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RwDaHIBVHWxyiPeB3k0.definition: An Income Tax Payment Event refers to the specific instance when an individual or entity makes a payment to satisfy their income tax obligations. This includes periodic payments such as quarterly estimated tax payments or annual tax settlements, made to the relevant tax authorities.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwEJQCNxcN2xpsZ1I2Y.label: Beyond the Scope Objection
http://lmss.sali.org/RwEJQCNxcN2xpsZ1I2Y.definition: A Beyond the Scope Objection is raised when questions during cross-examination or redirect examination address matters not covered in the previous direct examination, exceeding the permissible scope as defined by rules of evidence (e.g., Federal Rule of Evidence 611(b)). While cross-examination is generally limited to the subject matter of the direct examination and matters relating to credibility, decision-makers often permit wide-ranging examinations as long as the questions are relevant, with the option to call the witness as an adverse witness for further questioning.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwILvBLesNEwVlbhquS.label: Male
http://lmss.sali.org/RwILvBLesNEwVlbhquS.definition: A male is a person who identifies as or is biologically characterized as male, and is a member of the gender class of self-identified gender.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwJIQy6QbfofSLqbRRp.label: Insurance Claim Wrongfully Delayed or Denied
http://lmss.sali.org/RwJIQy6QbfofSLqbRRp.definition: An Insurance Claim Wrongfully Delayed or Denied refers to a situation where an insurance company unjustly postpones or denies payment to a policyholder for a claim that is covered under the policy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwKsT7WL4MtmNei35Zl.label: Disability / Loss of a Normal Life
http://lmss.sali.org/RwKsT7WL4MtmNei35Zl.definition: The concept of Disability/Loss of a Normal Life refers to the physical or mental impairment that results in a diminished ability to enjoy life's activities and experiences, and the resulting non-economic damages that may be awarded in a legal matter.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwOMSIjx2yx6LoJwtVc.label: Local Governmental Body
http://lmss.sali.org/RwOMSIjx2yx6LoJwtVc.definition: A local governmental body, such as a city or municipality, is responsible for governance at the community or city level, addressing issues and services that directly affect residents within a specific locality. These bodies typically have authority over matters like zoning, local law enforcement, public works, sanitation, and local ordinances. Their structure can include a mayor or city manager, a city council or board, and various departments or agencies dedicated to specific community services. The specific powers and responsibilities of local governments can vary widely based on regional laws and traditions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwQes3NHkD7wb1ZquhH.label: Florida Circuit Court - Baker County - 8th Circuit Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RwQes3NHkD7wb1ZquhH.definition: A court located in Baker County, Florida that is part of the 8th Circuit Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwRiaZ3qMvbpCjHHBjh.label: 791 Employee Retirement Income Security Act (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RwRiaZ3qMvbpCjHHBjh.definition: Action filed under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act, 29 U.S.C. § 1132 by individuals and labor organizations.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwTy8429IDRUYEjuukV.label: Statement of Work
http://lmss.sali.org/RwTy8429IDRUYEjuukV.definition: A Statement of Work is a document accompanying a contract that provides detailed descriptions of specific tasks, deliverables, timelines, and resources associated with a project or service contract. It serves as a guideline for the work to be performed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwU3GRvqoQYs6Q6rnbA.label: Local Market Segment
http://lmss.sali.org/RwU3GRvqoQYs6Q6rnbA.definition: The local segment refers to a portion of the market that is focused on consumers and businesses within a specific, limited geographical area, such as a city, town, or neighborhood. This segment encompasses products, services, and marketing strategies that are tailored to meet the needs and preferences of the local population, often considering hyper-local culture, traditions, and consumer behavior.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwXxSdk18FzyEqLFPGv.label: L510 Appellate Motions and Submissions
http://lmss.sali.org/RwXxSdk18FzyEqLFPGv.definition: A legal document filed with an appellate court requesting a ruling or decision on a specific issue or matter, falling under the broader category of appeals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwY92ea1zSievXKUPWV.label: Landlord's Failure to Protect Tenant from Crime
http://lmss.sali.org/RwY92ea1zSievXKUPWV.definition: The failure of a landlord to provide adequate protection to a tenant from criminal activity, resulting in harm or injury to the tenant.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwYkmlESAOTkMApIUWq.label: Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court - Armstrong County
http://lmss.sali.org/RwYkmlESAOTkMApIUWq.definition: A Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court in Armstrong County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Magisterial District Court system that has jurisdiction over minor criminal offenses and civil cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwa1952GPPo0L5Mrit2.label: Notice of Motion
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwa1952GPPo0L5Mrit2.definition: A Notice of Motion is a formal written request submitted to a court or tribunal by a party in a legal proceeding, seeking a specific order or direction from the court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwadSStLIBnmEe8euTp.label: Employment Harassment Claims
http://lmss.sali.org/RwadSStLIBnmEe8euTp.definition: Employment Harassment Claims: Legal claims made by an employee against an employer for harassment in the workplace, including sexual harassment, harassment based on protected characteristics, and harassment related to the work environment.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwb69BL1DbTISxyVYJJ.label: oasis:figure collection
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwb69BL1DbTISxyVYJJ.definition: A collection of figures within the OASIS standard framework.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwdhuuPLbMNn3T9mxGZ.label: Nominal Damages
http://lmss.sali.org/RwdhuuPLbMNn3T9mxGZ.definition: Nominal Damages are a small amount of money awarded to a plaintiff in a lawsuit to recognize a legal wrong, without compensating for any actual loss or injury.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwgJby1wc2ct10CJbrP.label: Import-Export Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RwgJby1wc2ct10CJbrP.definition: An Import-Export Clause claim is a legal argument asserting that a law or government action violates the Import-Export Clause of the United States Constitution, which prohibits states from imposing taxes or regulations that discriminate against imports or exports, thus protecting the free flow of goods across state and national borders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwiYr04MwuGhJnwApa5.label: Quasi-Public Governmental Body
http://lmss.sali.org/RwiYr04MwuGhJnwApa5.definition: A Quasi-Public Governmental Body is an organization that has governmental functions but operates with some degree of independence from direct government control. These bodies often provide public services and may have regulatory authority, yet they typically function more like private enterprises.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwipRpN2mP7u4u1N74M.label: Commerce Clause Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RwipRpN2mP7u4u1N74M.definition: A Commerce Clause claim is a legal argument centered on the interpretation of the Commerce Clause in the United States Constitution, which grants Congress the power to regulate interstate commerce. These claims often involve disputes over the scope of federal authority to regulate economic activities or address issues that may impact multiple states, and can have implications for the balance of power between the federal government and state governments.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwjUss6QZVzUsfsKBJ0.label: Antitrust Efforts Provisions
http://lmss.sali.org/RwjUss6QZVzUsfsKBJ0.definition: Antitrust Efforts Provisions refer to the specific provisions in a legal agreement that outline the standards and limitations for the parties' efforts to comply with antitrust laws and regulations.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwlacj5u1wGL6ZMuJlm.label: Infraction
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwlacj5u1wGL6ZMuJlm.definition: An infraction is a violation of a rule or law that is typically considered less serious than a misdemeanor or felony. Infractions are generally punishable by fines, citations, or other minor penalties, rather than imprisonment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwonL1GtFsGBAquUbIP.label: Georgia Superior Court - Bulloch County
http://lmss.sali.org/RwonL1GtFsGBAquUbIP.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Bulloch County and responsible for hearing civil and criminal cases within its jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwp7fcwpje8NEhX8IOC.label: Judicial Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwp7fcwpje8NEhX8IOC.definition: The concept of Judicial Privilege refers to the legal immunity granted to judges and other court officials from being compelled to testify in court about their official duties or decision-making processes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwpgIJhG7Y7k5E5J0tJ.label: Sotho, Southern
http://lmss.sali.org/RwpgIJhG7Y7k5E5J0tJ.definition: African language spoken primarily in Lesotho and South Africa, belonging to the Bantu language family.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwphanDTZRSP5yAQyZq.label: Translation Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RwphanDTZRSP5yAQyZq.definition: Translation Management refers to the process of managing the translation of legal documents and materials from one language to another within the context of Legal Point Solutions.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwqd8jdYrbaXvkdbEGo.label: Statutory Lien
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwqd8jdYrbaXvkdbEGo.definition: A statutory lien is a legal claim or encumbrance on property that arises by operation of law, typically created by a statute, and provides security for the payment of a debt or obligation.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwrb6VkKC1COoSANsW1.label: Minnesota District Court - Crow Wing County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwrb6VkKC1COoSANsW1.definition: Minnesota District Court - Crow Wing County: A specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Crow Wing County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwrvvLJKf3R5aeBucwV.label: Default Judgment
http://lmss.sali.org/RwrvvLJKf3R5aeBucwV.definition: A default judgment is a legal decision made by a court when one party fails to appear or respond to a lawsuit.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwvY8XJvIEvQJbUOBLJ.label: Outsourcing Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RwvY8XJvIEvQJbUOBLJ.definition: An Outsourcing Agreement is a legal contract between two parties where one party hires another to perform a specific task or service on their behalf, typically involving the transfer of certain responsibilities or functions outside of the organization.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwx570qxTQ5CBkQ6Rjf.label: TR199 Other Assessment, Development, or Administration
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwx570qxTQ5CBkQ6Rjf.definition: Use only for assessment, development, administration and other activities that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwx570qxTQ5CBkQ6Rjf.pref_label: TR199 Other Assessment, Development, or Administration

http://lmss.sali.org/RwxL1z0C8tiJRzH9j7g.label: Location-Based Event
http://lmss.sali.org/RwxL1z0C8tiJRzH9j7g.definition: A Location-Based Event refers to an occurrence tied to a specific geographic location, often marking a change in status or condition for a person or object. Examples include events like a person beginning or ending residency in a particular place, or an item entering or leaving a specified location, which may have legal, social, or logistical implications.
examples: After a killing, person left the state.
While in a country, person signed a contract

http://lmss.sali.org/RwxMCBJyGR2qfGM3Lsy.label: TR730 Assignments and Security Interests
http://lmss.sali.org/RwxMCBJyGR2qfGM3Lsy.definition: All actions associated with negotiating and preparing assignment (i.e. previously registered or filed application) or security interest, including review of file history, checking status and meeting with client. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rwxtf5xtE5Qo5l1iMAt.label: Cybersecurity Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/Rwxtf5xtE5Qo5l1iMAt.definition: The potential of loss or damage from a cyber event such as a data breach, cyber attack, or system failure.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwzWFQNfytyhuu1FXiT.label: Approved During Tail Period
http://lmss.sali.org/RwzWFQNfytyhuu1FXiT.definition: A legal term referring to the approval of an acquisition proposal during the final period of the transaction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RwzrT6MJec4vePgte9i.label: Fee Discount or Credit Percent
http://lmss.sali.org/RwzrT6MJec4vePgte9i.definition: A Fee Discount or Credit Percent is a type of discount or credit applied to legal services fees, which reduces the overall cost by a certain percentage.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx0vlvEGjaMK9xj6r7M.label: Massachusetts Superior Court - Dukes County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx0vlvEGjaMK9xj6r7M.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Massachusetts that has authority over civil and criminal cases in Dukes County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx1vavFiVPoynp4F3SB.label: Appellate Court Forum
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx1vavFiVPoynp4F3SB.definition: An Appellate Court Forum is a level of court forum that hears appeals from lower courts and has the authority to review and modify decisions made by those courts.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx3SBlp4M2pvcRjgBxR.label: Human Resources Form
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx3SBlp4M2pvcRjgBxR.definition: A Human Resources Form is a standardized document used within an organization to capture specific information related to personnel management. Forms may be used for various HR functions, such as hiring, performance evaluations, or benefits enrollment.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx69EnEj3H3TpcgTfUS.label: Status
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx69EnEj3H3TpcgTfUS.definition: The state or condition of a proceeding, legal element, or legal matter (e.g., open, closed, canceled, expired).

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx6Ffao6QnUtj1EJkeW.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Clinton County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx6Ffao6QnUtj1EJkeW.definition: Indiana Circuit Court - Clinton County refers to a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Clinton County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx73OtOSnOdjzb248cq.label: Change in Control Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx73OtOSnOdjzb248cq.definition: A Change in Control Clause is a provision in a contract that outlines the conditions under which a change in ownership or control of a company would trigger certain rights or obligations for the parties involved.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7CkM9fjahTS5lZtG2.label: Occupancy
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7CkM9fjahTS5lZtG2.definition: Occupancy refers to the act of residing in or using a property or space. This includes the possession and control of the property, typically under a lease or ownership agreement, and entails responsibilities such as maintenance and adherence to property regulations. Occupancy refers to the physical act of living in or using a property, which can be temporary or intermittent, in contrast to "residence," which refers to a person's fixed, permanent, and principal home, often with legal implications and the intention to remain for an extended period.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7fzqdw9MzJU6axuDZ.label: New York City Court - North Tonawanda
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7fzqdw9MzJU6axuDZ.definition: A court located in North Tonawanda, New York, which is a part of the larger New York City Court system.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7jxAO2t5Y7jNBaMGT.label: NAFTA Market Region
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx7jxAO2t5Y7jNBaMGT.definition: The NAFTA Market Region encompasses the countries that were part of the North American Free Trade Agreement—Canada, the United States, and Mexico—characterized by integrated supply chains, significant trade flows, and economic collaboration. This region is known for its extensive cross-border trade and investment, driven by the harmonization of regulations and the reduction of trade barriers.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx8Fia3ENKxMwr8Us4e.label: INVOICE_DESCRIPTION
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx8Fia3ENKxMwr8Us4e.definition: A description of the goods or services provided on an invoice, as defined within the LEDES98BI V5 Format Rev 1-2020 standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx8yW0InHTrovCSXHzF.label: D.C. Office of Bar Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx8yW0InHTrovCSXHzF.definition: The D.C. Office of Bar Counsel is an entity within the District of Columbia Courts that is responsible for administering proceedings related to attorney discipline and ethics.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxCcQihOcq7Y3RmJqZ8.label: Motion for Intra-District Transfer
http://lmss.sali.org/RxCcQihOcq7Y3RmJqZ8.definition: A Motion for Intra-District Transfer is a request made in a bankruptcy case to transfer the case from one district to another within the same state.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxCgiN0rMMrc7x1xhW0.label: 245 Tort Product Liability (PACER NoS)
http://lmss.sali.org/RxCgiN0rMMrc7x1xhW0.definition: Action alleging harm by an unsafe product based on negligence, breach of warranty, misrepresentation, and strict tort liability.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxEOWl1tQm6lA3cA2Ds.label: Remote Employment
http://lmss.sali.org/RxEOWl1tQm6lA3cA2Ds.definition: Remote Employment refers to a work arrangement where the employee performs job tasks from a location outside the employer's physical facilities, often from home or another suitable environment. This setup provides greater flexibility but may require specific technologies and self-discipline to maintain productivity and communication with the team.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxFJJ2HOrihyVsEGc2l.label: Involuntary Bankruptcy Petition
http://lmss.sali.org/RxFJJ2HOrihyVsEGc2l.definition: An Involuntary Bankruptcy Petition is a legal request filed by creditors against a debtor who has not paid their debts, seeking to force the debtor into bankruptcy.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxH7lIaJncEJ3TCqMq2.label: Neutral Fact Witness Interview
http://lmss.sali.org/RxH7lIaJncEJ3TCqMq2.definition: A Neutral Fact Witness Interview is an interview conducted by an unbiased party with a person who has knowledge of a situation, without taking any side or expressing any opinion.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxIAXZIbLd8oSF4ZgqZ.label: DEPRECATED: Litigation Deliverables
http://lmss.sali.org/RxIAXZIbLd8oSF4ZgqZ.definition: Deprecated: Litigation Deliverables refers to the specific documents or items that are produced or provided as part of a litigation engagement, which are no longer in use or recommended.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxIL9PBLEFkKKk6X8GL.label: Rules of Criminal Procedure
http://lmss.sali.org/RxIL9PBLEFkKKk6X8GL.definition: A court's body of procedural rules governing criminal actions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxJhP6upqvHlawarYye.label: Termination Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RxJhP6upqvHlawarYye.definition: A Termination Agreement is a legal document that formally concludes a previously established contract before the original terms of the contract are fulfilled. It outlines the conditions, responsibilities, and any obligations or entitlements of the parties involved in ending the agreement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxKLJQ0Ujh1mPxpn5yJ.label: Provider Last Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RxKLJQ0Ujh1mPxpn5yJ.definition: The concept of "Provider Last Name" refers to the surname or family name of an individual who provides legal services as a person, within the broader category of Legal Services Provider.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxKOdwRHKP32r4F1sT7.label: Nondischargeable Debt
http://lmss.sali.org/RxKOdwRHKP32r4F1sT7.definition: Debt that cannot be eliminated through bankruptcy proceedings, typically including taxes, student loans, and debts incurred through fraud or willful misconduct.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxKmsLiD1KciMucmHXX.label: Bankruptcy Means Test
http://lmss.sali.org/RxKmsLiD1KciMucmHXX.definition: The Bankruptcy Means Test is a document used in bankruptcy and restructuring proceedings to determine whether an individual or business is eligible for bankruptcy relief based on their income and expenses.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxLV9XEaDWbDIA8N1fl.label: Minnesota District Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RxLV9XEaDWbDIA8N1fl.definition: The Minnesota District Court is a trial court in the state of Minnesota that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxMGpB33xjOdBX3hTCQ.label: Parking - Real Estate Asset
http://lmss.sali.org/RxMGpB33xjOdBX3hTCQ.definition: Parking, in the context of real estate assets, refers to designated areas or structures designed for the temporary storage of vehicles. This type of real estate asset can include surface lots, multi-story garages, or underground facilities, often generating revenue through hourly, daily, or monthly fees.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxMOaT78rtx8cK3CsgG.label: Texas District Court - Harris County
http://lmss.sali.org/RxMOaT78rtx8cK3CsgG.definition: A Texas District Court - Harris County is a specific court within the Texas District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Harris County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxNwDQ5PLYnwvIGnKx1.label: Corporate Campaigns Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RxNwDQ5PLYnwvIGnKx1.definition: Corporate Campaigns Practice involves the development and execution of strategy and strategic communication efforts aimed at influencing corporate policies and practices. This practice includes managing campaigns that address issues such as employee rights, environmental sustainability, and corporate social responsibility to achieve specific advocacy goals.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxO4gDDB74UeHhXhIYe.label: Reinstatement Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RxO4gDDB74UeHhXhIYe.definition: A reinstatement claim is a legal action initiated by a party, often a borrower or homeowner, to reinstate a contract or agreement that has been terminated or suspended due to noncompliance with its terms. This can apply to various contracts, including mortgage agreements, insurance policies, or service contracts. The claim typically seeks to rectify the breach or default by fulfilling the outstanding obligations, such as making overdue payments or meeting specified conditions, with the goal of resuming the original contractual relationship.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxPxADB12qeAIDAFEgW.label: Private Equity, Hedge Funds and Venture Capital Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RxPxADB12qeAIDAFEgW.definition: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, and Venture Capital Law encompasses the legal frameworks governing private equity investments, hedge funds, and venture capital financing. It involves regulations related to fund formation, management, investment, compliance, investor rights, and financial transactions within these sectors.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxQ9amGYNaNNyjzrOzx.label: Indecent Exposure
http://lmss.sali.org/RxQ9amGYNaNNyjzrOzx.definition: The act of exposing one's private parts in public or in the presence of others in a lewd or offensive manner, which is considered a criminal offense of a less serious nature.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxR08KRoco6awkWidJ3.label: Georgia District Court - Turner County
http://lmss.sali.org/RxR08KRoco6awkWidJ3.definition: Georgia District Court - Turner County refers to a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Turner County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxRuGOnGdQ4YM4eSQH2.label: North Dakota Office of the Attorney General
http://lmss.sali.org/RxRuGOnGdQ4YM4eSQH2.definition: The North Dakota Office of the Attorney General is a government entity responsible for providing legal advice and representation to the state of North Dakota, and is a part of the North Dakota State Courts system.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxSFQ66UBxYZh0laDXj.label: Rule of 60 Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RxSFQ66UBxYZh0laDXj.definition: A Rule of 60 Clause is a specific type of contractual clause that sets a time limit of 60 days for a party to take certain actions or make certain decisions.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxTxaN981tLTsN82qPB.label: Business Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RxTxaN981tLTsN82qPB.definition: Distinct from legal risks, those risks to the business's operations (e.g., capital, reputation, financial management, programs)

http://lmss.sali.org/RxWrCyEH6sVtwYoR6el.label: Oil Crops
http://lmss.sali.org/RxWrCyEH6sVtwYoR6el.definition: Oil crops are plants grown specifically for the oil extracted from their seeds, fruits, or nuts, which is used for culinary, industrial, and medicinal purposes. These crops provide essential fatty acids, vitamins, and nutrients and are a significant source of vegetable oils globally.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxZ8LKWXrlP1GouFHZz.label: Dutch; Flemish
http://lmss.sali.org/RxZ8LKWXrlP1GouFHZz.definition: A language spoken in the Netherlands and Belgium, characterized by its use of Dutch and Flemish vocabulary, grammar, and syntax.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rx_TAoMl5RWi8lDcVsC.label: PA499 Other Patent Prosecution - Domestic
http://lmss.sali.org/Rx_TAoMl5RWi8lDcVsC.definition: Use only for patent prosecution activities for applications that are to be initially filed in the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, and that can not be included under a previous code, or as instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxaGsmVtyRbNrlVyALu.label: California Superior Court - Stanislaus Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RxaGsmVtyRbNrlVyALu.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in Stanislaus County, California, with the power to hear and decide a wide range of legal cases within its geographical jurisdiction.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxcJvTz1yS02bACVrtJ.label: PA520 Non-Provisional Application Preparation - International
http://lmss.sali.org/RxcJvTz1yS02bACVrtJ.definition: All actions associated with completing a non-provisional, utility or utility model (but not design or provisional) patent application that is to be filed outside the ('domestic') home country or region of the applicant, including translations, review of any invention disclosure materials or parent applications, drafting of application including pre-filing revision of a parent applications, preparation and execution of formal documents (such as assignments, declarations, information disclosure statements, transmittals, and biological deposits) filing of application, and reporting to the client. Includes PCT International Applications when filed outside the home country of the applicant. Note that government fees and other external expenses are included under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxczZoUvaShK0P_N56_.label: TR230 Clearance Investigation
http://lmss.sali.org/RxczZoUvaShK0P_N56_.definition: All actions associated with determining the final availability and registerability of a particular trademark, including definition of the scope of protection, searching, analyzing the search results, and reporting the results to the client. Also known as a "full" search, a clearance search is the broadest type of trademark search which includes review of pending trademark applications, active trademark registrations, abandoned trademark applications and registrations, public and corporate records, government publications and various databases. Any formal opinion should be prepared under TR710. Work of outside vendors in conducting searches or otherwise assisting investigation should be an expense under E100.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxjbdbQtN2WZA0R6u2n.label: Acquitted
http://lmss.sali.org/RxjbdbQtN2WZA0R6u2n.definition: "Acquitted" is a legal term used to describe the outcome of a criminal trial in which the defendant is found not guilty of the charges brought against them. It signifies that the court has determined that there is insufficient evidence to prove the defendant's guilt beyond a reasonable doubt, and as a result, they are exonerated and not subject to criminal punishment or convictions for the alleged offense. "Acquitted" typically refers to a formal legal judgment of innocence, often issued by a judge or jury, while "Not Guilty" can denote the absence of sufficient evidence to establish guilt but may not necessarily imply a formal acquittal.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxkTKgYqWS0WBHnJgrn.label: Financial Assets
http://lmss.sali.org/RxkTKgYqWS0WBHnJgrn.definition: Financial Assets are economic resources that have value and can be owned or controlled with the expectation of generating future income or financial benefits. They can exist in various forms such as cash, stocks, bonds, and real estate.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxklOdHbkgGvOsTdoKE.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Boone County
http://lmss.sali.org/RxklOdHbkgGvOsTdoKE.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Boone County: A court of law in Missouri that has jurisdiction over cases within Boone County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxkyjui3De88JNN2ZCq.label: Privilege
http://lmss.sali.org/Rxkyjui3De88JNN2ZCq.definition: Privilege refers to a legal protection that allows certain communications or information to be kept confidential between specific parties, such as attorney-client privilege or physician-patient privilege.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxl1pfdU0O2bRl3PxA9.label: Grand River Band of Ottawa Indians

http://lmss.sali.org/RxmH5k05WCzYwuamED9.label: Yacht
http://lmss.sali.org/RxmH5k05WCzYwuamED9.definition: A Yacht is a luxury watercraft used primarily for private leisure, recreation, or sports, often equipped with sophisticated amenities and accommodations. Yachts vary in size from small sailing yachts to large motor yachts and are typically associated with opulent lifestyles and maritime enjoyment.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxmjoCAyfDHKhwXHlwi.label: Insurance Agreements
http://lmss.sali.org/RxmjoCAyfDHKhwXHlwi.definition: An Insurance Related Agreement is a general term for contracts related to the insurance sector, covering a variety of relationships, obligations, and terms. These agreements set the foundation for how insurance operations and transactions are handled.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxmkfUCAsbv7pENuBxq.label: Wildlife and Plants Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RxmkfUCAsbv7pENuBxq.definition: Laws governing the potential impact of human activity on wild animals or plants, whether directly on individuals or populations, or indirectly via habitat degradation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxnnHg6PDCqDuN8hlIR.label: Platelet Deficiency
http://lmss.sali.org/RxnnHg6PDCqDuN8hlIR.definition: Thrombocytopenia is a medical condition characterized by a low platelet count in the blood, which can lead to increased bleeding and bruising. It results from either decreased production of platelets, increased destruction of platelets, or sequestration of platelets in the spleen.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxoCHQEPnZBgMfEs0ST.label: Invoice Date Received
http://lmss.sali.org/RxoCHQEPnZBgMfEs0ST.definition: The "Invoice Date Received" concept refers to the specific date on which an invoice was received by the recipient, and is a subcategory of the broader concept of "Invoice Date".

http://lmss.sali.org/RxoNw5zBCTjk6cahJCS.label: Human Values For AI
http://lmss.sali.org/RxoNw5zBCTjk6cahJCS.definition: Human Values for AI recognize that AI systems are not value-neutral and that their design must incorporate idealized qualities or conditions deemed good by society. Designing AI with human values involves negotiating different value systems, making ethical decisions, and considering governance, policies, and incentives while respecting cultural diversity and social and economic interests

http://lmss.sali.org/RxoOeykNtshNcQUBvf3.label: Motion to Reopen Chapter 13 Case
http://lmss.sali.org/RxoOeykNtshNcQUBvf3.definition: A Motion to Reopen Chapter 13 Case is a request made to the court to reopen a previously closed Chapter 13 bankruptcy case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxpK2dx1WmUsBneZFCQ.label: L520 Appellate Briefs
http://lmss.sali.org/RxpK2dx1WmUsBneZFCQ.definition: A written legal argument submitted to an appellate court, typically in response to a lower court's decision, falling under the broader category of legal appeals.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxpa6slGHQ2Fw06qkFT.label: Living Will
http://lmss.sali.org/Rxpa6slGHQ2Fw06qkFT.definition: A Living Will is a legal document that allows an individual to express their wishes regarding medical treatment in the event they become incapacitated and unable to communicate those wishes themselves.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxq2qQYpdo9stHOBIQh.label: Real Estate Regulatory Services
http://lmss.sali.org/Rxq2qQYpdo9stHOBIQh.definition: Real Estate Regulatory Services refers to legal services related to working with governmental or authorized entities and procedures regarding the monitoring, licensing, and regulating real estate activities within a jurisdiction. These services relate to changes and compliance with laws, rules, and standards related to property transactions, development, and management.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxq9H83mWAaaXKD76cA.label: Telephone Expense
http://lmss.sali.org/Rxq9H83mWAaaXKD76cA.definition: Telephone Expense refers to the cost incurred by an individual or organization for using telephone services, which is categorized as an expense in accounting and financial management.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxqIcTNrdb7PdqIlGao.label: Sign Languages
http://lmss.sali.org/RxqIcTNrdb7PdqIlGao.definition: A system of communication that uses visual gestures and signs instead of spoken words, used by individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxqbetYhPzqR3tJ4vtT.label: Objection Document
http://lmss.sali.org/RxqbetYhPzqR3tJ4vtT.definition: An objection is a formal statement made in a trial court or bankruptcy case challenging the validity or legality of a specific action or request, such as a confirmation of a plan, application for professional employment, professional fees, claim, debtor's claim of exemptions, or transfer of claim.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxrGN3iaASbuakvNl0L.label: X139 Translation
http://lmss.sali.org/RxrGN3iaASbuakvNl0L.definition: Any translation fees including the preparation and keyboarding (typing) of documentation. Excludes general word processing charges (X105).

http://lmss.sali.org/RxtPqy6N4ozU2pq7p4J.label: "Material Adverse Effect" Definition - Exceptions - Economic Conditions

http://lmss.sali.org/Rxtm6yCTUcImGngCzkP.label: Unavailable Declarant Objective
http://lmss.sali.org/Rxtm6yCTUcImGngCzkP.definition: The Unavailable Declarant Objective is a hearsay exception that allows the admission of certain statements made by a declarant who is unavailable to testify at a trial or hearing. This exception is based on the principle that the hearsay rule should not exclude reliable evidence when the declarant cannot be present to testify, and the statements fall under specific categories outlined in the Federal Rules of Evidence.
examples: Declarant is absent from the hearing or trial and the proponent of the statement is unable to secure attendance by a subpoena or other process.
Declarant is exempted from testifying by a ruling on the ground of privilege.
Declarant is unable to be present because of an existing physical or mental illness or death.
Declarant persists in refusing to testify despite a court order.
Declarant testifies to a lack of memory of the subject matter of the statement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxvDJ1zl0ikIMMjfefc.label: Distributor Agreement
http://lmss.sali.org/RxvDJ1zl0ikIMMjfefc.definition: A Distribution Agreement is a contractual arrangement between a supplier or manufacturer and a distributor that outlines the terms and conditions for the distribution of goods or services. The agreement typically covers issues like pricing, delivery, and geographic territory, as well as the responsibilities and obligations of both parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxwN6gyZ70Qc5T5GFzp.label: Dyula
http://lmss.sali.org/RxwN6gyZ70Qc5T5GFzp.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, including in Mali, Ivory Coast, and Burkina Faso.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxwfbvWrxjdHqJhrBu3.label: Elder Abuse
http://lmss.sali.org/RxwfbvWrxjdHqJhrBu3.definition: The mistreatment or harm inflicted upon an elderly person, which can take the form of financial exploitation or physical abuse.

http://lmss.sali.org/RxzkuoDN8SYKMaXYgMA.label: P230 Environmental
http://lmss.sali.org/RxzkuoDN8SYKMaXYgMA.definition: This task includes all fact investigation/due diligence from an environmental perspective.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry2NMIMK6RbgkvBMKND.label: New York Supreme Court - Ulster County
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry2NMIMK6RbgkvBMKND.definition: The New York Supreme Court - Ulster County is a court of general jurisdiction located in Ulster County, New York, with authority to hear and decide a wide range of civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry2zpiHIeLctXWkmz2C.label: New Business Intake Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry2zpiHIeLctXWkmz2C.definition: New Business Intake Management refers to the process of evaluating and accepting new clients or matters in a law firm, including conflicts checks, risk assessments, and client/matter intake procedures.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry383Dr4tq480SlKuhS.label: Venture Capital Investor
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry383Dr4tq480SlKuhS.definition: Individuals or firms that invest in startups and early-stage companies that have strong growth potential.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry7QetgRhR5fe5tz2gt.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Decatur County
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry7QetgRhR5fe5tz2gt.definition: A court located in Decatur County, Indiana that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographic area.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry8OCwL7qVOEQeDZo1t.label: Minnesota District Court - Pope County
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry8OCwL7qVOEQeDZo1t.definition: Minnesota District Court - Pope County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Pope County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9hX7PSumXkvA5dFwO.label: Commissions (Pay)
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9hX7PSumXkvA5dFwO.definition: Commissions refers to a percentage-based payment earned by individuals, often salespeople, for each sale or transaction they facilitate. It serves as a motivation to generate business and is directly linked to the volume or value of sales achieved

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9v6X10eRtWGHFoEbq.label: X129 Trial Exhibits
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9v6X10eRtWGHFoEbq.definition: Costs for materials associated with the creation of or obtaining a copy of a Trial Exhibit

http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9w4kczmQDyNhmCiE1.label: TR130 Document/File Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Ry9w4kczmQDyNhmCiE1.definition: A narrowly defined task that includes creating and populating document and other databases or filing systems, that does not fit under other task codes below. Includes the planning, design, and overall management of this process. Work of outside vendors in building litigation support databases should be an expense under E100. Calendaring (or "docketing" in the U.S.) should be included under the appropriate task codes below for each matter unless, otherwise instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyAuMYI25ZCqSnGXSHl.label: New York City Court - Salamanca
http://lmss.sali.org/RyAuMYI25ZCqSnGXSHl.definition: A court located in New York City that handles legal disputes and cases, specifically the Salamanca case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyB6BmQegfw67XAMe9j.label: Debtor's Request for Separate Notice
http://lmss.sali.org/RyB6BmQegfw67XAMe9j.definition: A Debtor's Request for Separate Notice is a document filed in a bankruptcy case by a debtor requesting that certain parties receive separate notice of important events in the case, such as a hearing or a deadline.
