http://lmss.sali.org/RyBjWTOgp5a7MIuqM3K.label: M&A F2 Data Security / Privacy / Data Protection / Cybersecurity Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RyBjWTOgp5a7MIuqM3K.definition: A specialized legal practice area within Mergers and Acquisitions law that focuses on advising clients on data security, privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyCrJHt79MBeEqEqBZx.label: Georgia Superior Court - Oconee County
http://lmss.sali.org/RyCrJHt79MBeEqEqBZx.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia, located in Oconee County and presided over by a judge.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyEzP1KUrLaS4mGjIh4.label: Estate and Inheritance Tax Payment
http://lmss.sali.org/RyEzP1KUrLaS4mGjIh4.definition: Estate and Inheritance Tax Payment refers to the settlement of taxes levied on the transfer of assets from a deceased person's estate to their beneficiaries. Estate tax is usually paid by the estate itself before distribution, while inheritance tax is usually paid by the recipients of the estate assets based on the value they receive.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyIEPYgZF2tC6Qlxiw8.label: Damages Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RyIEPYgZF2tC6Qlxiw8.definition: A damages clause is a provision in a contract that specifies the amount of money that one party must pay to the other in the event of a breach of contract.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyIdeOkyfdo43m9aVr2.label: Upfront Payment Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/RyIdeOkyfdo43m9aVr2.definition: An upfront payment clause is a provision in a contract that requires a specified amount of money to be paid in advance of the delivery of goods or services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyItksdT5vInqyBuoGg.label: U.S. Territory Courts
http://lmss.sali.org/RyItksdT5vInqyBuoGg.definition: U.S. Territory Courts are courts established in U.S. territories, such as the Virgin Islands and Guam, that have jurisdiction over cases within their respective territories.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyJcUQ1hGi2IoaMo7cP.label: Mediator
http://lmss.sali.org/RyJcUQ1hGi2IoaMo7cP.definition: A mediator is an independent person or body appointed to mediate a dispute.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyK2xv8wLMx4QuCV2gD.label: Billing Application Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RyK2xv8wLMx4QuCV2gD.definition: A Billing Application Name is a specific identifier used to track and manage the fees associated with a legal engagement.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyKcIn62llXcjUfXlSs.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
http://lmss.sali.org/RyKcIn62llXcjUfXlSs.definition: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic inflammatory disease that can affect any organ or body system. It is frequently, but not always, accompanied by constitutional symptoms such as severe fatigue, fever, malaise, and involuntary weight loss, and involves major organ or body system manifestations including respiratory, cardiovascular, renal, hematologic, skin, neurologic, mental, and immune system disorders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyLDI18A6mP37n4Fj9U.label: Entity Characteristic
http://lmss.sali.org/RyLDI18A6mP37n4Fj9U.definition: Entity Characteristic refers to a distinguishing feature or attribute of a Legal Entity, such as whether it is a Private Company (Not Publicly Traded) or a Public Company (Publicly Traded).

http://lmss.sali.org/RyNiu4sHJoI3Rc5VGod.label: Port of Entry
http://lmss.sali.org/RyNiu4sHJoI3Rc5VGod.definition: "Port of Entry" (POE) is the official location where an individual enters a country, subject to immigration inspection and clearance by authorities, determining their eligibility to enter and stay within the country's borders.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyP4THD1q0s9GhYijVh.label: New York Civil Court
http://lmss.sali.org/RyP4THD1q0s9GhYijVh.definition: A court in New York State that handles civil legal matters.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyPfcqNtXu4Jvza25X2.label: Ménière's Disease
http://lmss.sali.org/RyPfcqNtXu4Jvza25X2.definition: Ménière's disease is a chronic disorder of the inner ear characterized by recurrent episodes of vertigo (spinning sensation), tinnitus (ringing or buzzing in the ears), and fluctuating hearing loss. It is associated with an abnormal buildup of fluid in the inner ear, and diagnosis often involves confirming vestibular dysfunction through caloric or other vestibular tests and verifying hearing loss via audiometry.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyQPsG5Zb7Powzf9UUQ.label: Washington Superior Court - Grays Harbor County
http://lmss.sali.org/RyQPsG5Zb7Powzf9UUQ.definition: Washington Superior Court - Grays Harbor County refers to a specific court within the Washington Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters in Grays Harbor County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyRNSAO6hNYvTsE8rvb.label: Contains Line Items
http://lmss.sali.org/RyRNSAO6hNYvTsE8rvb.definition: Contains Line Items refers to a subclass of Fee Invoice Detail in the context of Engagement Terms, indicating that it includes specific items or charges within a legal services invoice.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyVgKi7IeI9T0o7E91y.label: New York City Court - Gloversville
http://lmss.sali.org/RyVgKi7IeI9T0o7E91y.definition: A court located in Gloversville, New York City that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical area.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyW1lu17I5btTBhWZHj.label: Citation to Treaties
http://lmss.sali.org/RyW1lu17I5btTBhWZHj.definition: A document's citations to treaties (e.g., international treaties, aboriginal treaties)

http://lmss.sali.org/RyWPa5HrSLiNq6S3FCF.label: Other Construction Material Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/RyWPa5HrSLiNq6S3FCF.definition: This industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of manufactured homes (i.e., mobile homes) and/or prefabricated buildings and (2) establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of construction materials (except lumber, plywood, millwork, wood panels, brick, stone, roofing, siding, electrical and wiring supplies, and insulation materials).
examples: Fencing and fencing accessories (except wood) merchant wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/RyXFkz3behDLKJusiUF.label: Attributes of Real Estate
http://lmss.sali.org/RyXFkz3behDLKJusiUF.definition: Attributes of Real Estate refer to specific designations or classifications that a parcel of land or property can possess, influencing its usage, regulations, and value. These attributes, like being a Historical Landmark or Nature Reserve, often come with particular legal frameworks and can be used for zoning or development purposes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyYdOW1LC5osZQkcbS9.label: Motion to Stay Removal
http://lmss.sali.org/RyYdOW1LC5osZQkcbS9.definition: A Motion to Stay Removal is a legal request made to temporarily halt the deportation or removal of an individual from a country.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyZQ00ZvhQjy6DdTFLH.label: L631 ESI stage, preparation and process
http://lmss.sali.org/RyZQ00ZvhQjy6DdTFLH.definition: Activities and actions related to staging, preparing and processing ESI. Includes culling, date filtering, key word application, ECA and other related.
http://lmss.sali.org/RyZQ00ZvhQjy6DdTFLH.pref_label: L631 ESI stage, preparation and process

http://lmss.sali.org/RyatIlpeh3k3JCJQNlH.label: Reasonable Best Efforts Standard
http://lmss.sali.org/RyatIlpeh3k3JCJQNlH.definition: A Reasonable Best Efforts Standard is a legal concept that requires a party to make a good faith effort to achieve a specific goal or outcome, taking into account the circumstances and resources available to them.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyazUr0HwLdeSIiJjws.label: Educational Diplomas and Degrees
http://lmss.sali.org/RyazUr0HwLdeSIiJjws.definition: Educational Diplomas and Degrees are credentials awarded by educational institutions to signify the completion of a course of study or training in a particular subject. These degrees vary in level, such as associate's, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees, and in field, such as arts, sciences, law, medicine, and engineering. They serve as a qualification for various professions and are commonly used in academic, professional, and formal settings to denote expertise

http://lmss.sali.org/RybmPQiRqfCkemZ2x04.label: Uninsured Driving
http://lmss.sali.org/RybmPQiRqfCkemZ2x04.definition: "Driving Without Insurance" refers to the act of operating a motor vehicle without having the necessary insurance coverage as required by law. This is considered a legal offense in many jurisdictions and may result in penalties, fines, and even suspension of the driver's license.

http://lmss.sali.org/RybnrpASs8eHZx9fnR7.label: Georgia District Court - Spalding County
http://lmss.sali.org/RybnrpASs8eHZx9fnR7.definition: A court located in Spalding County, Georgia that has jurisdiction over certain legal matters within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyeqviATd4YRSAiT6TX.label: Buddhist Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RyeqviATd4YRSAiT6TX.definition: Buddhist Law, while not codified as a formal legal system in most regions, refers to the ethical and moral teachings derived from the teachings of the Buddha, especially the Vinaya, which governs the conduct of Buddhist monastics.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ryhh8i1lqTtulJHvTT4.label: TR720 Portfolio Analysis and Management
http://lmss.sali.org/Ryhh8i1lqTtulJHvTT4.definition: All action associated with reviewing, analyzing, documenting, and managing a portfolio of trademarks. Includes trademark "due diligence" during transactional analysis.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyicQwNULWIxvuuxsG4.label: Settlement Offer
http://lmss.sali.org/RyicQwNULWIxvuuxsG4.definition: A settlement offer is a written proposal made by one party to another in an attempt to resolve a legal dispute outside of court.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyjHxikhTMidy1kqlwo.label: Practical Guidance Management
http://lmss.sali.org/RyjHxikhTMidy1kqlwo.definition: Practical Guidance Management is a subcategory of Legal Research that involves the organization and utilization of practical guidance materials to assist in legal decision-making and problem-solving.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyjKJM2JsGHAo8PMXkZ.label: Equitable Fraud
http://lmss.sali.org/RyjKJM2JsGHAo8PMXkZ.definition: Equitable Fraud is a type of claim in which a party seeks relief from a court based on the defendant's fraudulent conduct, even if the conduct does not meet the legal definition of fraud.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyjwJDmJoeRdPwVIpoZ.label: Intervenor-Defendant
http://lmss.sali.org/RyjwJDmJoeRdPwVIpoZ.definition: A person who intervenes or seeks to intervene as a defendant in a civil action.

http://lmss.sali.org/RykN1YjePTomsFXpxlX.label: TR140 Budgeting
http://lmss.sali.org/RykN1YjePTomsFXpxlX.definition: Covers developing, negotiating, and revising the budget for a matter that does not fit under other task codes below. Cost estimates which are included as part of other activities, such as reporting an Official Communication from a Trademark Office, should be included under the appropriate task codes below, unless otherwise instructed by the client.

http://lmss.sali.org/RykWUHX4Jw5mqQCl2kL.label: Georgia Superior Court - Chattahoochee County
http://lmss.sali.org/RykWUHX4Jw5mqQCl2kL.definition: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over legal matters within Chattahoochee County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RylyViN7f9W76RQFbZj.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Intellectual Impairment
http://lmss.sali.org/RylyViN7f9W76RQFbZj.definition: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Intellectual Impairment is characterized by the core symptoms of autism, including deficits in social communication and interaction, and restricted, repetitive behaviors or interests. This condition is accompanied by significant limitations in intellectual functioning, affecting cognitive abilities and adaptive functioning.
http://lmss.sali.org/RylyViN7f9W76RQFbZj.pref_label: Autism Spectrum Disorder with Cognitive Impairment

http://lmss.sali.org/RymGzG1GhTx-1QVSxlr.label: X135 Local Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/RymGzG1GhTx-1QVSxlr.definition: Any local counsel fees paid directly by the law firm or legal vendor

http://lmss.sali.org/RyncEmApuR_CUbLDrJS.label: X107 Telephone-Local
http://lmss.sali.org/RyncEmApuR_CUbLDrJS.definition: Any local telephone charges; if VOIP expense bill as a single line item as opposed to a per call charge

http://lmss.sali.org/RypEVGNYSEgH2GgA4sY.label: Litigation Hold Letter
http://lmss.sali.org/RypEVGNYSEgH2GgA4sY.definition: A litigation hold letter is a written communication sent to potential custodians of electronically stored information (ESI) advising them of their obligation to preserve relevant ESI in anticipation of or during litigation.

http://lmss.sali.org/RysulJVLLFPkPX8Y2gH.label: oasis:actor
http://lmss.sali.org/RysulJVLLFPkPX8Y2gH.definition: A person or organization that plays a role in the creation, management, or dissemination of metadata, as defined within the OASIS standard.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ryu5LoAUzP13SyODG4j.label: Waiver Clause
http://lmss.sali.org/Ryu5LoAUzP13SyODG4j.definition: A waiver clause is a provision in a contract that relinquishes a party's right to assert a particular legal claim or defense.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyuQMoucBJAPSzKoFdN.label: Motions on Remedies and Relief
http://lmss.sali.org/RyuQMoucBJAPSzKoFdN.definition: Motions on Remedies and Relief refer to requests made in trial courts seeking a specific remedy or relief, such as an increase or reduction in award, equitable relief, or recovery of fees, interest, and costs.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyvCJFycaJQat8ZZ4zb.label: Fraud in the Inducement
http://lmss.sali.org/RyvCJFycaJQat8ZZ4zb.definition: Fraud in the Inducement is a type of fraud claim where a party is deceived into entering a contract or agreement based on false information provided by the other party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RyvMfSKehTHKvegyc5H.label: X143 Bank Fees
http://lmss.sali.org/RyvMfSKehTHKvegyc5H.definition: Any reimbursable bank fees associated with the matter. This type of expense is more typically reimbursed outside the US.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ryz3VWLysfUWxexbNfV.label: Disapproved Law
http://lmss.sali.org/Ryz3VWLysfUWxexbNfV.definition: The previously effective law has been disapproved by some authority (e.g., appellate court, judge).

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz1snHHYQEdmTLNTziM.label: Lesbian
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz1snHHYQEdmTLNTziM.definition: Lesbian refers to a woman who is attracted to other women. It is a sexual orientation that is part of the LGBTQIA+ spectrum, and like other orientations, the experience of being lesbian can vary among individuals.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz1yyhKFaBoVC4ilqxU.label: Georgia Superior Court - Carroll County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz1yyhKFaBoVC4ilqxU.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Carroll County: A court of general jurisdiction in the state of Georgia that has authority over civil and criminal cases within Carroll County.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz2ybU7wWlYn2cuIZdI.label: Georgia Superior Court - Pike County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz2ybU7wWlYn2cuIZdI.definition: Georgia Superior Court - Pike County is a specific court within the Georgia Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases in Pike County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz5Xvn6ft5lW75KJfkO.label: Georgia District Court - Jefferson County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz5Xvn6ft5lW75KJfkO.definition: Georgia District Court - Jefferson County is a specific court within the Georgia District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Jefferson County, Georgia.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz7E5XRKUxna0t7bBus.label: Texas District Court - Bexar County
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz7E5XRKUxna0t7bBus.definition: A court located in Bexar County, Texas that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases within its geographical boundaries.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz8Qdup_2TmWJ1JDSYw.label: P500 Negotiation/Revision/Responses
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz8Qdup_2TmWJ1JDSYw.definition: This phase includes conducting negotiations, revising the initial (P400) transaction documentation as a result of such negotiations, attendance at meetings, and responses thereto (including communications with clients with respect thereto). The review of documents received from non-client third parties should also be coded here.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rz9N1etzkn69qEZxXM9.label: Copyright Registration Document
http://lmss.sali.org/Rz9N1etzkn69qEZxXM9.definition: A Copyright Registration Document is the official certificate issued by a copyright office, such as the U.S. Copyright Office, confirming the registration of a specific work. The document serves as public record of the copyright claim and provides prima facie evidence of copyright ownership, facilitating the enforcement of rights in legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzBukPsKWTommbx5e6_.label: L621 Collection/Recovery
http://lmss.sali.org/RzBukPsKWTommbx5e6_.definition: Activities and actions related to the collection and/or recovery of a) custodial email residing on the network, server, home share or enterprise archive or journal, hard-drives and removable media, as well as paper files, b) collection and/or recovery of non-custodial data the network, server, group shares, removable media and paper files, and c) decrypting files, cracking passwords, files restoration and other forensic analysis activity. Includes selective collection, searches and source imaging.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzEkNCsULREmeLI3Zvl.label: Physician
http://lmss.sali.org/RzEkNCsULREmeLI3Zvl.definition: A physician or doctor is a person who is licensed to practice medicine and provide medical treatment to patients.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzGXWT98X1MCqqF7qmU.label: Indiana Circuit Court - Montgomery County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzGXWT98X1MCqqF7qmU.definition: The Indiana Circuit Court - Montgomery County is a specific court within the Indiana Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal proceedings in Montgomery County, Indiana.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzIJZXc6tTGicYzJN2D.label: Protected Timberland
http://lmss.sali.org/RzIJZXc6tTGicYzJN2D.definition: Protected Timberland refers to forested land that is designated for conservation and protection from logging and other forms of exploitation. This designation is often made to preserve biodiversity, protect wildlife habitats, and maintain ecological balance.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzLNZvmvjHqtxVfg3yh.label: Reputational Risk
http://lmss.sali.org/RzLNZvmvjHqtxVfg3yh.definition: The threats and opportunities associated with an organization's reputation and credibility with its partners, stakeholders, and the public — that might damage an organization's public image, credibility, or brand value. These risks can stem from various sources, such as operational failures, unethical behavior, or public controversies, potentially leading to diminished customer loyalty, reduced investor confidence, or decreased market opportunities, ultimately impacting the organization's overall performance and growth prospects.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzN0lEecajkj9LkgP3L.label: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/RzN0lEecajkj9LkgP3L.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in advertising, public relations, and related services, such as media buying, independent media representation, indoor and outdoor display advertising, direct mail advertising, advertising material distribution services, and other services related to advertising.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzPFpJps5y0LYrU19fP.label: Missouri Circuit Court - Holt County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzPFpJps5y0LYrU19fP.definition: Missouri Circuit Court - Holt County refers to a specific court within the Missouri Circuit Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Holt County, Missouri.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzPjBFXOANWEOTITOwQ.label: Litigation Case Name
http://lmss.sali.org/RzPjBFXOANWEOTITOwQ.definition: A Litigation Case Name is a specific identifier used to refer to a legal case in the context of litigation, which may include a short or long name for the case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzQ5gwUabt1mu60F6ps.label: Tiv
http://lmss.sali.org/RzQ5gwUabt1mu60F6ps.definition: Tiv (Language) is a structured system of communication that consists of grammar and vocabulary, and is spoken in Nigeria by the Tiv people.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzQmY3E958fA9POPoG0.label: Fraud and Economic Torts Law
http://lmss.sali.org/RzQmY3E958fA9POPoG0.definition: Law governing civil wrongs committed through deceptive, dishonest, or manipulative conduct that causes financial harm to individuals or businesses, including fraudulent misrepresentation, deceit, conspiracy, unlawful interference with business relations, and passing off, providing remedies such as damages and injunctions to affected parties.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzRevQI04QCGyTSdEEC.label: L656 Redaction
http://lmss.sali.org/RzRevQI04QCGyTSdEEC.definition: Activities and actions related to the development and implementation of a redaction protocol and the actual redaction of data and documents consistent with such a protocol.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzRvQLXgcqPkW5S6dyN.label: Creoles and pidgins, French-based
http://lmss.sali.org/RzRvQLXgcqPkW5S6dyN.definition: A French-based Creole or Pidgin language, which is a simplified language that develops as a means of communication between groups who do not share a common language, but have frequent contact with each other, and which has evolved from French.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzS5kQCctIh5w09UGh8.label: Administrative Negligence
http://lmss.sali.org/RzS5kQCctIh5w09UGh8.definition: Administrative Negligence is a legal concept that refers to the failure of a government agency or official to perform their duties with reasonable care, resulting in harm or injury to individuals or the public.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzVoqLdVqqvDchT3Qcs.label: Joint Venture Formation Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RzVoqLdVqqvDchT3Qcs.definition: The creation of a new business entity by two or more parties working together, typically performed by a legal services provider as part of their entity formation services.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzWHx3gJWwaAVC6eqJE.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Forest County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzWHx3gJWwaAVC6eqJE.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Forest County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings in Forest County, Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzXEQztwCXDC6aEDCdT.label: Nevada Court of Appeals
http://lmss.sali.org/RzXEQztwCXDC6aEDCdT.definition: The Nevada Court of Appeals is a court within the Nevada State Courts system that hears appeals from lower courts and makes decisions on legal disputes.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzZsWnimVMfomNyig7S.label: Bankruptcy Chapter 7 Claim
http://lmss.sali.org/RzZsWnimVMfomNyig7S.definition: A Bankruptcy Chapter 7 Claim is a type of claim made by a creditor in a bankruptcy case under Chapter 7 of the Bankruptcy Code, seeking to recover a debt owed by the debtor.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzajD2KuPBjHSugvdBJ.label: Right to Effective Assistance of Counsel
http://lmss.sali.org/RzajD2KuPBjHSugvdBJ.definition: The "Right to Effective Assistance of Counsel" refers to an individual's entitlement not only to legal representation but to representation that is competent and effective. It means that a lawyer must perform adequately and any significant failure in this duty can lead to a violation of a defendant's rights, potentially resulting in reversals of convictions or other legal remedies.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzbRrublchPvUBEyEBe.label: Negligent Performance of An Undertaking
http://lmss.sali.org/RzbRrublchPvUBEyEBe.definition: The Negligent Performance of An Undertaking refers to a legal claim of negligence where a party fails to fulfill their obligation or duty, resulting in harm or damage to another party.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzbzW8gDXSPAygq6nTe.label: Arizona Superior Court - Gila Cty.
http://lmss.sali.org/RzbzW8gDXSPAygq6nTe.definition: Arizona Superior Court - Gila Cty. is a specific court within the Arizona Superior Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Gila County.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzfFH8JWSdPtXHz4cLc.label: Motions on Timing
http://lmss.sali.org/RzfFH8JWSdPtXHz4cLc.definition: A Motion on Timing is a type of procedural motion in a trial court or bankruptcy case that seeks to modify or extend the time frame for a particular action or event, such as setting a hearing or continuing a case.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzfXHc1RhlPptij1fLJ.label: Abandonment Practice
http://lmss.sali.org/RzfXHc1RhlPptij1fLJ.definition: Abandonment Practice refers to the legal process of relinquishing ownership or control of an asset, typically in the context of Asset Disposition Practice.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rzg8mCIjXsMzEVnQwCT.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas
http://lmss.sali.org/Rzg8mCIjXsMzEVnQwCT.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas is a trial court within the Pennsylvania State Courts system that has jurisdiction over civil and criminal cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzgyVNiCOeush4yockp.label: Mobile Home
http://lmss.sali.org/RzgyVNiCOeush4yockp.definition: A Mobile Home is a prefabricated residential structure built in a factory and transported to its site, designed for permanent or semi-permanent habitation. These homes are typically placed in mobile home parks or on private land and can be moved to different locations as needed.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzhJrcuWPt2Cw7ZBOei.label: Bankruptcy Procedural Filings
http://lmss.sali.org/RzhJrcuWPt2Cw7ZBOei.definition: Bankruptcy Procedural Filings are written or recorded documents related to the legal process of bankruptcy, including petitions, motions, and other court filings.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rzj0jUmJiicKtCX5lhH.label: Status - Received
http://lmss.sali.org/Rzj0jUmJiicKtCX5lhH.definition: Status of "Received" indicates that the relevant authority or agency has successfully received the submitted application or document. This status marks the initial step in the processing journey, with further steps to follow for assessment, review, and decision-making

http://lmss.sali.org/RzkJWacKFdqYKXz4kLN.label: L460 Post-Trial Motions and Submissions
http://lmss.sali.org/RzkJWacKFdqYKXz4kLN.definition: A post-trial motion or submission is a legal request made by a party after a trial has concluded, typically seeking relief or a change in the outcome of the trial.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rzkc596nCuFi7zaE5CS.label: Soybeans
http://lmss.sali.org/Rzkc596nCuFi7zaE5CS.definition: Soybeans are legumes from the Glycine max species, known for their high protein content and versatility in food, feed, and industrial applications. They are cultivated for their seeds, which are processed into products like soy oil, tofu, and soy milk, and used as a key ingredient in animal feed and biodiesel production.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzoLFQE0iuqIQJlexIG.label: Illinois Circuit Court - Coles County (5th Circuit Court)

http://lmss.sali.org/RzormhSTmyKZqt1HuiS.label: New Mexico Magistrate Court - Union County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzormhSTmyKZqt1HuiS.definition: A court located in Union County, New Mexico that has limited jurisdiction over certain types of cases.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzphmBTlNRBpDxluLQL.label: file_item_nbr
http://lmss.sali.org/RzphmBTlNRBpDxluLQL.definition:
"The item count of this data element in the invoice file submission.  
"

http://lmss.sali.org/RzqZHFcPdOltkkfOpuk.label: Real Estate Broker's Liability to Prospective Purchaser for Failure to Inspect and Disclose
http://lmss.sali.org/RzqZHFcPdOltkkfOpuk.definition: The legal responsibility of a real estate broker to a potential buyer for not inspecting and revealing information about a property.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rzqx5UOno00GCvPYpSd.label: Contact Short Name
http://lmss.sali.org/Rzqx5UOno00GCvPYpSd.definition: Contact Short Name refers to an abbreviated or simplified name used to easily identify a person or entity. This shortened name may be used in databases, communications, or reports, and is usually derived from the client's full legal or DBA name for ease of reference.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzrvyhxM3e9TKFbTTL2.label: Respiratory Failure
http://lmss.sali.org/RzrvyhxM3e9TKFbTTL2.definition: Respiratory failure is a serious condition in which the respiratory system fails to adequately exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide, leading to insufficient oxygenation of the blood or inadequate removal of carbon dioxide. This condition, resulting from chronic respiratory disorders, requires invasive mechanical ventilation, noninvasive ventilation with bilevel positive airway pressure (BiPAP), or a combination of both treatments for a continuous period of at least 48 hours, or at least 72 hours if postoperative.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzujIHyLZLQTcyZMUFL.label: Minnesota District Court - Dodge County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzujIHyLZLQTcyZMUFL.definition: Minnesota District Court - Dodge County is a specific court within the Minnesota District Court system that has jurisdiction over legal matters within Dodge County, Minnesota.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzvrxtR6CPkYd2N1FZ4.label: Stay Execution of Judgment or Order
http://lmss.sali.org/RzvrxtR6CPkYd2N1FZ4.definition: A Stay Execution of Judgment or Order is a legal concept that refers to a request made by a party to temporarily suspend the enforcement of a court's decision or order, typically while an appeal or other legal action is pending.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzwEONnxUELw6N9WvbC.label: Fulah
http://lmss.sali.org/RzwEONnxUELw6N9WvbC.definition: A language spoken primarily in West Africa, including countries such as Senegal, Gambia, and Guinea, among others.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzwSxGmgnDgdQqnzra5.label: Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas -  Crawford County
http://lmss.sali.org/RzwSxGmgnDgdQqnzra5.definition: The Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas - Crawford County is a specific court within the Pennsylvania Court of Common Pleas system, which is responsible for administering legal proceedings at the county level in Pennsylvania.

http://lmss.sali.org/Rzy5rvrKtuL8AwKrBTF.label: Patent Regulatory Objectives
http://lmss.sali.org/Rzy5rvrKtuL8AwKrBTF.definition: Patent Regulatory Objectives refer to the specific aims, goals, and plans related to the legal framework governing the registration of patents, including plant, design, and utility patents.

http://lmss.sali.org/RzyeWKhoAOFwQhI2R5P.label: Drug / Alcohol Treatment
http://lmss.sali.org/RzyeWKhoAOFwQhI2R5P.definition: A program or facility designed to help individuals overcome addiction to drugs or alcohol, which is a condition imposed as part of a criminal sentence.

http://lmss.sali.org/S0aqiIi5Q4WHMwEpiXD.label: Other General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/S0aqiIi5Q4WHMwEpiXD.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing pumps and compressors, material handling equipment, and all other general purpose machinery (except ventilation, heating, air-conditioning, and commercial refrigeration equipment; metalworking machinery; and engines, turbines, and power transmission equipment).

http://lmss.sali.org/S12-VZg9R06JW6Mqb9p.label: Advertising, Public Relations, and Related Services
http://lmss.sali.org/S12-VZg9R06JW6Mqb9p.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in advertising, public relations, and related services, such as media buying, independent media representation, indoor and outdoor display advertising, direct mail advertising, advertising material distribution services, and other services related to advertising.

http://lmss.sali.org/S1DzIgwxSme60dIu3gy.label: Video Tape and Disc Rental
http://lmss.sali.org/S1DzIgwxSme60dIu3gy.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting prerecorded video tapes and discs for home electronic equipment, including renting through vending machines.

http://lmss.sali.org/S1TYJxyeSVKL_9xm68k.label: Funeral Homes and Funeral Services
http://lmss.sali.org/S1TYJxyeSVKL_9xm68k.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in preparing the dead for burial or interment and conducting funerals (i.e., providing facilities for wakes, arranging transportation for the dead, selling caskets and related merchandise). Funeral homes combined with crematories are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/S1mUDAfmRD2u_7JeEnf.label: Paper Mills
http://lmss.sali.org/S1mUDAfmRD2u_7JeEnf.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing paper from pulp. These establishments may manufacture or purchase pulp. In addition, the establishments may convert the paper they make. The activity of making paper classifies an establishment into this industry regardless of the output.

http://lmss.sali.org/S2M-cTTtR8qfVV2DQIu.label: Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing

http://lmss.sali.org/S9-hz-TeTO2A2BhGF9v.label: Health and Welfare Funds
http://lmss.sali.org/S9-hz-TeTO2A2BhGF9v.definition: This industry comprises legal entities (i.e., funds, plans, and/or programs) organized to provide medical, surgical, hospital, vacation, training, and other health- and welfare-related employee benefits exclusively for the sponsor's employees or members.

http://lmss.sali.org/S9FlAMSDQrmcMUbQ-uR.label: Historical Sites
http://lmss.sali.org/S9FlAMSDQrmcMUbQ-uR.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the preservation and exhibition of sites, buildings, forts, or communities that describe events or persons of particular historical interest. Archeological sites, battlefields, historical ships, and pioneer villages are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/SA8cNIMITkqIl5OAGhe.label: Taxi and Ridesharing Services
http://lmss.sali.org/SA8cNIMITkqIl5OAGhe.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing passenger transportation by automobile or van, not operated over regular routes and on regular schedules. Establishments of taxicab owner/operators, taxicab fleet operators, taxicab organizations, ridesharing services (including arrangement services), and ride hailing services (including arrangement services) are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/SAo8Dp5qQvWsNsNR-tG.label: Other Transit and Ground Passenger Transportation
http://lmss.sali.org/SAo8Dp5qQvWsNsNR-tG.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing other transit and ground passenger transportation (except urban transit systems, interurban and rural bus transportation, taxi and ridesharing services, school and employee bus transportation, charter bus services, and limousine services (except shuttle services)).  Shuttle services (except school and employee bus) and special needs transportation services are included in this industry.  Shuttle services establishments generally travel within a metropolitan area and its adjacent nonurban areas on regular routes, on regular schedules and provide services between hotels, airports, or other destination points.  Establishments in the Special Needs Transportation industry provide passenger transportation for the disabled or elderly.  These establishments may use specially equipped vehicles to provide passenger transportation.

http://lmss.sali.org/SGXQgcwnQya4ZEyToBb.label: Artificial and Synthetic Fibers and Filaments Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/SGXQgcwnQya4ZEyToBb.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing cellulosic (e.g., rayon, acetate) and noncellulosic (e.g., nylon, polyolefin, polyester) fibers and filaments in the form of monofilament, filament yarn, staple, or tow or (2) manufacturing and texturizing cellulosic and noncellulosic fibers and filaments.

http://lmss.sali.org/SGahJEz_Tfqwxxi7eSp.label: Electric Power Generation
http://lmss.sali.org/SGahJEz_Tfqwxxi7eSp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating electric power generation facilities.  These facilities convert other forms of energy, such as water power (i.e., hydroelectric), fossil fuels, nuclear power, and solar power, into electrical energy.  The establishments in this industry produce electric energy and provide electricity to transmission systems or to electric power distribution systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/SKBPGNtcSvyEtH-dWvF.label: Plumbing and Heating Equipment and Supplies (Hydronics) Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/SMxNxWmNRdaY3reO9Yl.label: Noncitrus Fruit and Tree Nut Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/SMxNxWmNRdaY3reO9Yl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) growing noncitrus fruits (e.g., apples, grapes, berries, peaches); (2) growing tree nuts (e.g., pecans, almonds, pistachios); or (3) growing a combination of fruit(s) and tree nut(s) with no one fruit (or family of fruit) or family of tree nuts accounting for one-half of the establishment's agricultural production (i.e., value of crops for market).

http://lmss.sali.org/SPXILEu-TGOrd-H31WS.label: Automobile Dealers
http://lmss.sali.org/SPXILEu-TGOrd-H31WS.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new and used automobiles and light trucks, such as sport utility vehicles, and passenger and cargo vans.

http://lmss.sali.org/SXtNTeFbQKe_zs0skS2.label: Parking Lots and Garages
http://lmss.sali.org/SXtNTeFbQKe_zs0skS2.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing parking space for motor vehicles, usually on an hourly, daily, or monthly basis and/or valet parking services.

http://lmss.sali.org/Scu_E6EhRxyAGv21PaE.label: Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance
http://lmss.sali.org/Scu_E6EhRxyAGv21PaE.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the repair and maintenance of commercial and industrial machinery and equipment. Establishments in this industry either sharpen/install commercial and industrial machinery blades and saws or provide welding (e.g., automotive, general) repair services; or repair agricultural and other heavy and industrial machinery and equipment (e.g., forklifts and other material handling equipment, machine tools, commercial refrigeration equipment, construction equipment, and mining machinery).

http://lmss.sali.org/Se4mNLZQQZ69BfRWbSx.label: Drilling Oil and Gas Wells
http://lmss.sali.org/Se4mNLZQQZ69BfRWbSx.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in drilling oil and gas wells for others on a contract or fee basis. This industry includes contractors that specialize in spudding in, drilling in, redrilling, and directional drilling.

http://lmss.sali.org/ShaHrE3JSuSw8d_CotF.label: Administration of Conservation Programs
http://lmss.sali.org/ShaHrE3JSuSw8d_CotF.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in the administration, regulation, supervision, and control of land use, including recreational areas; conservation and preservation of natural resources; erosion control; geological survey program administration; weather forecasting program administration; and the administration and protection of publicly and privately owned forest lands. Government establishments responsible for planning, management, regulation, and conservation of game, fish, and wildlife populations, including wildlife management areas and field stations; and other administrative matters relating to the protection of fish, game, and wildlife are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/SkwHXBa5S8ONIcORTlm.label: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers
http://lmss.sali.org/SkwHXBa5S8ONIcORTlm.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily providing media streaming distribution services, operating social network sites, operating media broadcasting and cable television networks, and supplying information, such as news reports, articles, pictures, and features, to the news media. These establishments distribute textual, audio, and/or video content of general or specific interest.

http://lmss.sali.org/SquZDxmJQbKVzsQQG7g.label: RV (Recreational Vehicle) Parks and Campgrounds
http://lmss.sali.org/SquZDxmJQbKVzsQQG7g.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating sites to accommodate campers and their equipment, including tents, tent trailers, travel trailers, and RVs (recreational vehicles). These establishments may provide access to facilities, such as washrooms, laundry rooms, recreation halls, playgrounds, stores, and snack bars.

http://lmss.sali.org/StKB20avSAGLkRjtTXn.label: Metal Kitchen Cookware, Utensil, Cutlery, and Flatware (except Precious) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/StKB20avSAGLkRjtTXn.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metal kitchen cookware (except by casting (e.g., cast iron skillets) or stamped without further fabrication), utensils, and/or nonprecious and precious plated metal cutlery and flatware.

http://lmss.sali.org/SumCSM-FQg6S-yVb7s6.label: Tax Preparation Services
http://lmss.sali.org/SumCSM-FQg6S-yVb7s6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments (except offices of CPAs) engaged in providing tax return preparation services without also providing accounting, bookkeeping, billing, or payroll processing services. Basic knowledge of tax law and filing requirements is required.

http://lmss.sali.org/T0X_ivhHQkCaPnNevOI.label: Lawn and Garden Tractor and Home Lawn and Garden Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/T0X_ivhHQkCaPnNevOI.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing powered lawnmowers, lawn and garden tractors, and other home lawn and garden equipment, such as tillers, shredders, yard vacuums, and leaf blowers.

http://lmss.sali.org/T25EgplyTE-bGCTqpq3.label: Sawmills
http://lmss.sali.org/T25EgplyTE-bGCTqpq3.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in sawing dimension lumber, boards, beams, timbers, poles, ties, shingles, shakes, siding, and wood chips from logs or bolts. Sawmills may plane the rough lumber that they make with a planing machine to achieve smoothness and uniformity of size.

http://lmss.sali.org/T2VBR8SASwKmJFvtAuk.label: Grain and Field Bean Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/T3L_rvXVTVqvaXB0P70.label: Sports and Recreation Instruction
http://lmss.sali.org/T3L_rvXVTVqvaXB0P70.definition: This industry comprises establishments, such as camps and schools, primarily engaged in offering instruction in athletic activities. Overnight and day sports instruction camps are included in this industry.
examples: Martial arts instruction, camps or schools
Professional sports instructors (i.e., not participating in sporting events)
Sports (e.g., baseball, basketball, football, golf) instruction

http://lmss.sali.org/T52Au1AsTrOHXnAZgVk.label: Orange Groves
http://lmss.sali.org/T52Au1AsTrOHXnAZgVk.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing oranges.

http://lmss.sali.org/T9ZFMFADSVG3dMO9tIA.label: Truck, Utility Trailer, and RV (Recreational Vehicle) Rental and Leasing

http://lmss.sali.org/TBzExOxgQ7u7L-yhkoB.label: Business and Secretarial Schools
http://lmss.sali.org/TBzExOxgQ7u7L-yhkoB.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering courses in office procedures and secretarial and stenographic skills and may offer courses in basic office skills, such as word processing. In addition, these establishments may offer such classes as office machine operation, reception, communications, and other skills designed for individuals pursuing a clerical or secretarial career. Instruction may be provided in diverse settings, such as the establishment's or client's training facilities, educational institutions, the workplace, or the home, and through diverse means, such as correspondence, television, the Internet, or other electronic and distance-learning methods. The training provided by these establishments may include the use of simulators and simulation methods.

http://lmss.sali.org/TDBuFLztTWeKrc2FmCd.label: Legal Counsel and Prosecution
http://lmss.sali.org/TDBuFLztTWeKrc2FmCd.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in providing legal counsel or prosecution services for the government.

http://lmss.sali.org/TDwUlpEZSGuDW41xcTU.label: Port and Harbor Operations
http://lmss.sali.org/TDwUlpEZSGuDW41xcTU.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating ports, harbors (including docking and pier facilities), or canals.

http://lmss.sali.org/TF0aslPDR-GSrJMddkb.label: Motor and Generator Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/TF0aslPDR-GSrJMddkb.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric motors (except internal combustion engine starting motors), power generators (except battery charging alternators for internal combustion engines), and motor generator sets (except turbine generator set units). This industry includes establishments rewinding armatures on a factory basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/TFrZ6Lh_RUuqOGnuHZb.label: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)

http://lmss.sali.org/TIqRyosqTd-D921xWs8.label: Support Activities for Agriculture and Forestry Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/TIqRyosqTd-D921xWs8.definition: Industries in the Support Activities for Agriculture and Forestry subsector provide support services that are an essential part of agricultural and forestry production.  These support activities may be performed by the agriculture or forestry producing establishment or conducted independently as an alternative source of inputs required for the production process for a given crop, animal, or forestry industry.  Establishments that primarily perform these activities independent of the agriculture or forestry producing establishment are in this subsector.

http://lmss.sali.org/TP8bYWTvRPqldPGnbXz.label: Security Guards and Patrol Services
http://lmss.sali.org/TP8bYWTvRPqldPGnbXz.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing guard and patrol services, such as bodyguard, guard dog, and parking security services.

http://lmss.sali.org/TS52cRC3TUmuhQW8iVa.label: All Other Miscellaneous Crop Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/TS52cRC3TUmuhQW8iVa.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one of the following: (1) growing crops (except oilseeds and/or grains; vegetables and/or melons; fruits and/or tree nuts; greenhouse, nursery, and/or floriculture products; tobacco; cotton; sugarcane; hay; sugar beets; or peanuts); (2) growing a combination of crops (except a combination of oilseed(s) and grain(s); and a combination of fruit(s) and tree nut(s)) with no one crop or family of crops accounting for one-half of the establishment's agricultural production (i.e., value of crops for market); or (3) gathering tea or maple sap.
examples: General combination crop farming (except oilseed and grain; vegetables and melons; fruit and tree nut combinations)

http://lmss.sali.org/TX1kJhHwTh29xTsgcvC.label: Automotive Glass Replacement Shops
http://lmss.sali.org/TX1kJhHwTh29xTsgcvC.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in replacing, repairing, and/or tinting automotive vehicle glass, such as passenger car, truck, and van glass.

http://lmss.sali.org/T_N2rUqJRaenqgqG2m-.label: Materials Recovery Facilities
http://lmss.sali.org/T_N2rUqJRaenqgqG2m-.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) operating facilities for separating and sorting recyclable materials from nonhazardous waste streams (i.e., garbage) and/or (2) operating facilities where commingled recyclable materials, such as paper, plastics, used beverage cans, and metals, are sorted into distinct categories.

http://lmss.sali.org/TbJ_AhFTTRSiN3iu04W.label: Motor Vehicle Seating and Interior Trim Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/TbJ_AhFTTRSiN3iu04W.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing motor vehicle seating, seats, seat frames, seat belts, and interior trimmings.

http://lmss.sali.org/TdWXsCbdSU-RjXqVb9N.label: Other Chemical and Allied Products Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/TdWXsCbdSU-RjXqVb9N.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of chemicals and allied products (except agricultural and medicinal chemicals, paints and varnishes, fireworks, and plastics materials and basic forms and shapes).
examples: Automotive chemicals (except lubricating oils and greases) merchant wholesalers
Explosives (except ammunition and fireworks) merchant wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/Tf97x9FEQNW6HgpfnRY.label: Air and Gas Compressor Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/Tf97x9FEQNW6HgpfnRY.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose air and gas compressors, such as reciprocating compressors, centrifugal compressors, vacuum pumps (except laboratory), and nonagricultural spraying and dusting compressors and spray gun units.

http://lmss.sali.org/TfrCYTtGTaCrbhjnoTI.label: Social Advocacy Organizations
http://lmss.sali.org/TfrCYTtGTaCrbhjnoTI.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in promoting a particular cause or working for the realization of a specific social or political goal to benefit a broad or specific constituency.  These organizations may solicit contributions and offer memberships to support these goals.

http://lmss.sali.org/TgbaL9DdR8OTUZgsNnE.label: Offices of All Other Health Practitioners
http://lmss.sali.org/TgbaL9DdR8OTUZgsNnE.definition: This industry comprises establishments of independent health practitioners (except physicians; dentists; chiropractors; optometrists; mental health specialists; physical, occupational, and speech therapists; and audiologists).  These practitioners operate private or group practices in their own offices (e.g., centers, clinics) or in the facilities of others, such as hospitals or HMO medical centers.
examples: Registered or licensed practical nurses' offices

http://lmss.sali.org/Ttp4GbyJQRiufXdqBE3.label: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities

http://lmss.sali.org/TvZnOSDNRIO4OJgosz_.label: Paint, Coating, and Adhesive Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/TvZnOSDNRIO4OJgosz_.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) mixing pigments, solvents, and binders into paints and other coatings; (2) manufacturing allied paint products; and (3) manufacturing adhesives, glues, and caulking compounds.

http://lmss.sali.org/TvwWH-LhTdWKOOiYZkZ.label: Local Messengers and Local Delivery
http://lmss.sali.org/TvwWH-LhTdWKOOiYZkZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing local messenger and delivery services of small items within a single metropolitan area or within an urban center. These establishments generally provide point-to-point pick-up and delivery and do not operate as part of an intercity courier network.
examples: Grocery delivery services (i.e., independent service from grocery store)
Letters, documents, or small parcels local delivery services
Restaurant meals order and delivery services (i.e., independent order and delivery services)

http://lmss.sali.org/U3L3UG1LQhe2QTqofGA.label: Other Building Finishing Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/U3L3UG1LQhe2QTqofGA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building finishing trade work (except drywall, plaster, and insulation work; painting and wall covering work; flooring work; tile and terrazzo work; and finish carpentry work). The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Countertop and cabinet, metal (except residential-type), installation
Drapery fixture (e.g., hardware, rods, tracks) installation
Fabricating metal cabinets or countertops on site
Modular furniture system attachment and installation
Trade show exhibit installation and dismantling

http://lmss.sali.org/UDUCrCXqR4CCpcNe2xl.label: Portfolio Management and Investment Advice
http://lmss.sali.org/UDUCrCXqR4CCpcNe2xl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in managing the portfolio assets (i.e., funds) of others on a fee or commission basis and/or providing customized investment advice to clients on a fee basis. Establishments providing portfolio management have the authority to make investment decisions, and they derive fees based on the size and/or overall performance of the portfolio. Establishments providing investment advice provide financial planning advice and investment counseling to meet the goals and needs of specific clients, but do not have the authority to execute trades.
examples: Financial planning services, customized, fees paid by client
Investment advisory services, customized, fees paid by client

http://lmss.sali.org/UDhuJNauT0qJZdjxeEv.label: Industrial Launderers
http://lmss.sali.org/UDhuJNauT0qJZdjxeEv.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in supplying, on a rental or contract basis, laundered industrial work uniforms and related work clothing, such as protective apparel (flame and heat resistant) and clean room apparel; dust control items, such as treated mops, rugs, mats, dust tool covers, cloths, and shop or wiping towels.

http://lmss.sali.org/UEzpzaG5Tk22PIRw0kr.label: Wood Window and Door Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UEzpzaG5Tk22PIRw0kr.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing window and door units, sash, window and door frames, and doors from wood or wood clad with metal or plastics.

http://lmss.sali.org/UHySd-JETVCP2QupoNZ.label: All Other Automotive Repair and Maintenance
http://lmss.sali.org/UHySd-JETVCP2QupoNZ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing automotive repair and maintenance services (except mechanical and electrical repair and maintenance; body, paint, interior, and glass repair; motor oil change and lubrication; and car washing) for automotive vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, and vans, and all trailers.

http://lmss.sali.org/UIlwNs7nSDqESFgwSum.label: Pharmacies and Drug Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/UIlwNs7nSDqESFgwSum.definition: This industry comprises establishments generally known as pharmacies and drug retailers engaged in retailing prescription or nonprescription drugs and medicines.

http://lmss.sali.org/UIsrIt8uQ5Sca4Pm80Y.label: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UIsrIt8uQ5Sca4Pm80Y.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing complete guided missiles and space vehicles and/or (2) developing and making prototypes of guided missiles or space vehicles.

http://lmss.sali.org/UMqcn0wCQiKchFW4xdy.label: Utility System Construction
http://lmss.sali.org/UMqcn0wCQiKchFW4xdy.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of distribution lines and related buildings and structures for utilities (i.e., water, sewer, petroleum, gas, power, and communication). All structures (including buildings) that are integral parts of utility systems (e.g., storage tanks, pumping stations, power plants, and refineries) are included in this industry group.

http://lmss.sali.org/UR_lRSJmQCmidXs7FXJ.label: Petroleum and Petroleum Products Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/UR_lRSJmQCmidXs7FXJ.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of petroleum and petroleum products, including liquefied petroleum gas.

http://lmss.sali.org/UUbVZ4-4RN2ytfsuyfT.label: Motion Picture Theaters (except Drive-Ins)
http://lmss.sali.org/UUbVZ4-4RN2ytfsuyfT.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating motion picture theaters (except drive-ins) and/or exhibiting motion pictures or videos at film festivals, and so forth.

http://lmss.sali.org/UUlsN65-Sju87tNKMbk.label: Sewing, Needlework, and Piece Goods Retailers

http://lmss.sali.org/UZHAh81eQVWc-8XUbZa.label: Cookie and Cracker Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UZHAh81eQVWc-8XUbZa.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing cookies, crackers, and other products, such as ice cream cones.

http://lmss.sali.org/Ue8QtJxWSyu3VbO3sPK.label: General Line Grocery Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/Ue8QtJxWSyu3VbO3sPK.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of a general line (wide range) of groceries.

http://lmss.sali.org/UlA02PR-R3man_0KO_n.label: Motion Picture and Video Industries
http://lmss.sali.org/UlA02PR-R3man_0KO_n.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the production and/or distribution of motion pictures, videos, television programs, or commercials; in the exhibition of motion pictures; or in the provision of postproduction and related services.

http://lmss.sali.org/UmtThKRlSUegdS0VuXO.label: Metal Can, Box, and Other Metal Container (Light Gauge) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UmtThKRlSUegdS0VuXO.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in forming light gauge metal containers.

http://lmss.sali.org/Uo4w8-vaTXe50UVioBC.label: Other Building Equipment Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/Uo4w8-vaTXe50UVioBC.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing or servicing building equipment (except electrical, plumbing, heating, cooling, or ventilation equipment). The repair and maintenance of miscellaneous building equipment is included in this industry. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Lightning protection equipment (e.g., lightning rod) installation
Overhead door, commercial- or industrial-type, installation

http://lmss.sali.org/UrGyvt2fSYCnoBa8-dd.label: Paint, Varnish, and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/UsuwArHqTi6W7A5ulsZ.label: Spring and Wire Product Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UsuwArHqTi6W7A5ulsZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing steel springs by forming, such as cutting, bending, and heat winding, metal rod or strip stock and/or (2) manufacturing wire springs and fabricated wire products from wire drawn elsewhere (except watch and clock springs).

http://lmss.sali.org/UyDvcUP5RMeHsfUdpVz.label: Other Metal Container Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/UyDvcUP5RMeHsfUdpVz.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metal (light gauge) containers (except cans).
examples: Light gauge metal garbage cans manufacturing
Light gauge metal lunch boxes manufacturing
Light gauge metal tool boxes manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/UyhuRO16TPuwZqArhxS.label: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction
http://lmss.sali.org/UyhuRO16TPuwZqArhxS.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of highways (including elevated), streets, roads, airport runways, public sidewalks, or bridges. The work performed may include new work, reconstruction, rehabilitation, and repairs. Specialty trade contractors are included in this industry if they are engaged in activities primarily related to highway, street, and bridge construction (e.g., installing guardrails on highways).
examples: Culverts, highway, road, and street, construction
Painting traffic lanes or parking lot lines
Pothole filling, highway, road, street, or bridge
Resurfacing, highway, road, street, or bridge
Sign erection, highway, road, street, or bridge

http://lmss.sali.org/UzPdho2sQeOTADiJMpp.label: Jewelry, Watch, Precious Stone, and Precious Metal Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/UzPdho2sQeOTADiJMpp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of jewelry, precious and semiprecious stones, precious metals and metal flatware, costume jewelry, watches, clocks, silverware, and/or jewelers' findings.

http://lmss.sali.org/V08LPAsVSCyyK7FP8pQ.label: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/V08LPAsVSCyyK7FP8pQ.definition:
Industries in the Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services subsector group establishments engaged in processes where human capital is the major input.  These establishments make available the knowledge and skills of their employees, often on an assignment basis, where an individual or team is responsible for the delivery of services to the client.  The individual industries of this subsector are defined on the basis of the particular expertise and training of the services provider.

The distinguishing feature of the Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services subsector is the fact that most of the industries grouped in it have production processes that are almost wholly dependent on worker skills.  Thus, the establishments classified in this subsector sell expertise.  Much of the expertise requires degrees, though not in every case.

http://lmss.sali.org/V5nDoBfZSPqS3e42Ixt.label: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events with Facilities

http://lmss.sali.org/VCGR6P2jR0q9L_lX5h7.label: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability, Mental Health, and Substance Abuse Facilities
http://lmss.sali.org/VCGR6P2jR0q9L_lX5h7.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing residential care (but not licensed hospital care) to people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental illness, or substance abuse problems.

http://lmss.sali.org/VCR9hyfXRGWw0OTw1xQ.label: Truck Trailer Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/VCR9hyfXRGWw0OTw1xQ.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing truck trailers, truck trailer chassis, cargo container chassis, detachable trailer bodies, and detachable trailer chassis for sale separately.

http://lmss.sali.org/VGLJUk4pSieAONjp47k.label: Used Household and Office Goods Moving

http://lmss.sali.org/VHkgxnxGT4qaxn1JLx1.label: Electronic Connector Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/VHkgxnxGT4qaxn1JLx1.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electronic connectors, such as coaxial, cylindrical, rack and panel, pin and sleeve, printed circuit, and fiber optic.

http://lmss.sali.org/VKr05y7lSEm6Nz0tBRX.label: Broadwoven Fabric Mills
http://lmss.sali.org/VKr05y7lSEm6Nz0tBRX.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in weaving broadwoven fabrics and felts (except tire fabrics and rugs). Establishments in this industry may weave only, weave and finish, or weave, finish, and further fabricate fabric products.

http://lmss.sali.org/VLN3qLhtQCSfxIexmyu.label: Natural Gas Distribution
http://lmss.sali.org/VLN3qLhtQCSfxIexmyu.definition: This industry comprises: (1) establishments primarily engaged in operating gas distribution systems (e.g., mains, meters); (2) establishments known as gas marketers that buy gas from the well and sell it to a distribution system; (3) establishments known as gas brokers or agents that arrange the sale of gas over gas distribution systems operated by others; and (4) establishments primarily engaged in transmitting and distributing gas to final consumers.

http://lmss.sali.org/VNQQBcIdQ2ODJfMfPri.label: Navigational Services to Shipping
http://lmss.sali.org/VNQQBcIdQ2ODJfMfPri.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing navigational services to shipping. Marine salvage establishments are included in this industry.
examples: Docking and undocking marine vessel services

http://lmss.sali.org/VO3xEqPPRw6R4VHVWk0.label: Nature Parks and Other Similar Institutions

http://lmss.sali.org/VOQk8E3iRPaJ7ty0sc9.label: Pump and Compressor Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/VOQk8E3iRPaJ7ty0sc9.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing pumps and compressors, such as general purpose air and gas compressors, nonagricultural spraying and dusting equipment, general purpose pumps and pumping equipment (except fluid power pumps and motors), and measuring and dispensing pumps.

http://lmss.sali.org/VW9dGXK1TAOprr8MMoa.label: Shellfish Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/VW9dGXK1TAOprr8MMoa.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in farm raising shellfish (e.g., crayfish, shrimp, oysters, clams, mollusks).

http://lmss.sali.org/VXKNsrvGR0i5JPT-qmu.label: All Other Miscellaneous Nonmetallic Mineral Product Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/VXKNsrvGR0i5JPT-qmu.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonmetallic mineral products (except pottery, ceramics, and plumbing fixtures; clay building materials and refractories; glass and glass products; cement; ready-mix concrete; concrete products; lime; gypsum products; abrasive products; cut stone and stone products; ground and treated minerals and earth; and mineral wool).
examples: Manmade and engineered proppants (e.g., resin-coated sand, ceramic materials) manufacturing
Synthetic stones, for gem stones and industrial use, manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/Vbg_AW0iQnqmEwYY23z.label: Postharvest Crop Activities (except Cotton Ginning)
http://lmss.sali.org/Vbg_AW0iQnqmEwYY23z.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in performing services on crops, subsequent to their harvest, with the intent of preparing them for market or further processing. These establishments provide postharvest activities, such as crop cleaning, sun drying, shelling, fumigating, curing, sorting, grading, packing, and cooling.

http://lmss.sali.org/VdmGZkpoTdaApzEi7pu.label: Residential Remodelers
http://lmss.sali.org/VdmGZkpoTdaApzEi7pu.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily responsible for the remodeling construction (including additions, alterations, reconstruction, maintenance, and repairs) of houses and other residential buildings, single-family and multifamily. Included in this industry are remodeling general contractors, for-sale remodelers, remodeling design-build firms, and remodeling project construction management firms.

http://lmss.sali.org/VdrHhNRRTQqo4fbFAVe.label: Farm Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/VdrHhNRRTQqo4fbFAVe.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of farm supplies, such as animal feeds, fertilizers, agricultural chemicals, pesticides, plant seeds, and plant bulbs.

http://lmss.sali.org/Vg3C3l_KRV6EVmmF2fd.label: Floor Covering Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/Vg3C3l_KRV6EVmmF2fd.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new floor coverings, such as rugs and carpets, laminate and vinyl floor coverings, linoleum flooring, and floor tile (except ceramic tile or hardwood floor coverings only); or retailing new floor coverings in combination with installation and repair services.

http://lmss.sali.org/VgA6rX00RRemI1dqDNJ.label: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures

http://lmss.sali.org/Vh_0VPk6TBSZaKwlDwb.label: Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs)

http://lmss.sali.org/VppQhq4XQsq9cx8oNsh.label: Electric Lamp Bulb and Other Lighting Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/VppQhq4XQsq9cx8oNsh.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing electric light bulbs, tubes, and parts (except glass blanks for electric light bulbs and light emitting diodes (LEDs)), electric lighting fixtures (except residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and vehicular electric lighting fixtures), and nonelectric lighting equipment.
examples: Christmas tree lighting sets, electric, manufacturing
LED (light emitting diode) light bulbs manufacturing
Lanterns (e.g., carbide, electric, gas, gasoline, kerosene) manufacturing
Street lighting fixtures (except traffic signals) manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/VtvaT5V-TRukXG3kI9M.label: Record Production and Distribution
http://lmss.sali.org/VtvaT5V-TRukXG3kI9M.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in record production and/or releasing, promoting, and distributing sound recordings to wholesalers, retailers, or directly to the public. These establishments contract with artists, arrange and finance the production of original master recordings, and/or produce master recordings themselves, such as digital music and compact discs. Establishments in this industry hold the copyright to the master recording, or obtain reproduction and distribution rights to master recordings produced by others, and derive most of their revenues from the sales, leasing, licensing, or distribution of master recordings.

http://lmss.sali.org/Vym_IBb2Rcaj-SG67zi.label: Other Food Crops Grown Under Cover
http://lmss.sali.org/Vym_IBb2Rcaj-SG67zi.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing food crops (except mushrooms) under glass or protective cover.
examples: Alfalfa sprout farming, grown under cover

http://lmss.sali.org/W-jGRNvOSFaPZxQMA84.label: Other Management Consulting Services
http://lmss.sali.org/W-jGRNvOSFaPZxQMA84.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing management consulting services (except administrative and general management consulting; human resources consulting; marketing consulting; or process, physical distribution, and logistics consulting). Establishments providing telecommunications or utilities management consulting services are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/W1kQtC8lQ0qF-vXog2V.label: Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/W2f3zFf7TqGjiIp6K4I.label: Other Legal Services
http://lmss.sali.org/W2f3zFf7TqGjiIp6K4I.definition: This industry comprises establishments of legal practitioners (except lawyers and attorneys) primarily engaged in providing specialized legal or paralegal services.
examples: Patent agent services (i.e., patent filing and searching services)

http://lmss.sali.org/W6CYSklXTSCa4nUTnIN.label: Television Broadcasting Stations
http://lmss.sali.org/W6CYSklXTSCa4nUTnIN.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in broadcasting images together with sound. These establishments operate television broadcasting studios and facilities for the programming and transmission of programs to the public. Programming may originate in their own studio, from an affiliated network, or from external sources.

http://lmss.sali.org/WBLLpndJRPGdl5m0HLi.label: Architectural and Structural Metals Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WBLLpndJRPGdl5m0HLi.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing one or more of the following: (1) prefabricated metal buildings, panels, and sections; (2) structural metal products; (3) metal plate work products; (4) metal framed windows (i.e., typically using purchased glass) and metal doors; (5) sheet metal work; and (6) ornamental and architectural metal products.

http://lmss.sali.org/WDWAOXFMTCWRuv7rkuv.label: Piece Goods, Notions, and Other Dry Goods Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/WE8R2zm6TZ6Et7qfPN-.label: Veneer, Plywood, and Engineered Wood Product Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WE8R2zm6TZ6Et7qfPN-.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing veneer and/or plywood; (2) manufacturing engineered wood members; and (3) manufacturing reconstituted wood products.  This industry includes manufacturing plywood from veneer made in the same establishment or from veneer made in other establishments, and manufacturing plywood faced with nonwood materials, such as plastics or metal.
examples: Reconstituted wood sheets and boards manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/WEmfMdZSRJye75jPt8n.label: Metal Ore Mining
http://lmss.sali.org/WEmfMdZSRJye75jPt8n.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in developing mine sites or mining metallic minerals, and establishments primarily engaged in ore dressing and beneficiating (i.e., preparing) operations, such as crushing, grinding, washing, drying, sintering, concentrating, calcining, and leaching. Beneficiating may be performed at mills operated in conjunction with the mines served or at mills, such as custom mills, operated separately.

http://lmss.sali.org/WGReUk8QTC-rSzzk_jp.label: National Security
http://lmss.sali.org/WGReUk8QTC-rSzzk_jp.definition: This industry comprises government establishments of the Armed Forces, including the National Guard, primarily engaged in national security and related activities.
examples: Military training schools (except military service academies)

http://lmss.sali.org/WKdlevc0TBSMKSzQN1Q.label: Fine Arts Schools
http://lmss.sali.org/WKdlevc0TBSMKSzQN1Q.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in offering instruction in the arts, including dance, art, drama, and music.

http://lmss.sali.org/WKeb91iVSJGeZb9ZldD.label: Underground Coal Mining
http://lmss.sali.org/WKeb91iVSJGeZb9ZldD.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) underground mining of bituminous and anthracite coal; (2) developing bituminous and anthracite coal underground mine sites; and (3) underground mining and beneficiating (e.g., cleaning, washing, screening, and sizing) of bituminous and anthracite coal.

http://lmss.sali.org/WOxD63u1Tz6qwJzXUey.label: Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/WOxD63u1Tz6qwJzXUey.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing and servicing plumbing, heating, and air-conditioning equipment. Contractors in this industry may provide both parts and labor when performing work. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Duct work (e.g., cooling, dust collection, exhaust, heating, ventilation) installation
Refrigeration system (e.g., commercial, industrial, scientific) installation

http://lmss.sali.org/WQBL4QKmTFa8tTM_gtp.label: Elementary and Secondary Schools
http://lmss.sali.org/WQBL4QKmTFa8tTM_gtp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in furnishing academic courses and associated course work that comprise a basic preparatory education. A basic preparatory education ordinarily constitutes kindergarten through 12th grade. This industry includes school boards and school districts.
examples: Schools for the physically disabled, elementary or secondary

http://lmss.sali.org/WVjbLimvS3OOpJKjhHW.label: Motor Vehicle Steering and Suspension Components (except Spring) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WVjbLimvS3OOpJKjhHW.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and/or rebuilding motor vehicle steering mechanisms and suspension components (except springs).
examples: Rack and pinion steering assemblies manufacturing
Shock absorbers, automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing
Steering columns, automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing
Steering wheels, automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing
Struts, automotive, truck, and bus, manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/WX2_Mh1PS_iHcPXYt4I.label: Dried and Dehydrated Food Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WX2_Mh1PS_iHcPXYt4I.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) drying (including freeze-dried) and/or dehydrating fruits, vegetables, and soup mixes and bouillon and/or (2) drying and/or dehydrating ingredients and packaging them with other purchased ingredients, such as rice and dry pasta.

http://lmss.sali.org/WXW-twbGQ9istckX90b.label: Finfish Fishing
http://lmss.sali.org/WXW-twbGQ9istckX90b.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the commercial catching or taking of finfish (e.g., bluefish, salmon, trout, tuna) from their natural habitat.

http://lmss.sali.org/WYzUtG0pSuelE1J60ab.label: Rolling Mill and Other Metalworking Machinery Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WYzUtG0pSuelE1J60ab.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing rolling mill machinery and equipment and/or other metalworking machinery (except industrial molds; special dies and tools, die sets, jigs, and fixtures; cutting tools and machine tool accessories; and machine tools).
examples: Assembly machines (i.e., wire making equipment) manufacturing
Cradle assembly machinery (i.e., wire making equipment) manufacturing
Metalworking coil winding and cutting machinery manufacturing
Rolling mill roll machines, metalworking, manufacturing
Wire drawing and fabricating machinery and equipment (except dies) manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/WZm9fu6RTKmXKnDw_qV.label: Boat Building
http://lmss.sali.org/WZm9fu6RTKmXKnDw_qV.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building boats. Boats are defined as watercraft not built in shipyards and typically of the type suitable or intended for personal use. Included in this industry are establishments that manufacture heavy-duty inflatable rubber or inflatable plastic boats (RIBs).
examples: Boats (e.g., motorboats, rowboats, canoes, kayaks) manufacturing
Sailboat building, not done in shipyards
Yacht building, not done in shipyards

http://lmss.sali.org/WgeKWAPDTuekZB6ixx6.label: Corporate, Subsidiary, and Regional Managing Offices
http://lmss.sali.org/WgeKWAPDTuekZB6ixx6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments (except government establishments) primarily engaged in administering, overseeing, and managing other establishments of the company or enterprise. These establishments normally undertake the strategic or organizational planning and decision-making role of the company or enterprise. Establishments in this industry may hold the securities of the company or enterprise.

http://lmss.sali.org/WleJ0cFlQD63EzNxick.label: Ethyl Alcohol Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/WleJ0cFlQD63EzNxick.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing nonpotable ethyl alcohol.

http://lmss.sali.org/WmIEPfNTSMiLM5RHR6M.label: Office Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing
http://lmss.sali.org/WmIEPfNTSMiLM5RHR6M.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting or leasing office machinery and equipment, such as computers, office furniture, duplicating machines (i.e., copiers), or facsimile machines.

http://lmss.sali.org/Wnb0B4vNR66_Oszwz0y.label: Computer and Peripheral Equipment Manufacturing
