http://lmss.sali.org/uTCc8NHvTfCtiYBs9IT.definition: This industry comprises legal entities, trusts, estates, or agency accounts, administered on behalf of the beneficiaries under the terms of a trust agreement, will, or agency agreement.
examples: Private estates (i.e., administering on behalf of beneficiaries)

http://lmss.sali.org/uTD31fktRc2OkJ_qgkn.label: Mobile Food Services
http://lmss.sali.org/uTD31fktRc2OkJ_qgkn.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in preparing and serving meals and snacks for immediate consumption from motorized vehicles or nonmotorized carts. The establishment is the central location from which the caterer route is serviced, not each vehicle or cart. Included in this industry are establishments primarily engaged in providing food services from vehicles, such as hot dog carts and ice cream trucks.

http://lmss.sali.org/uUK2KwffQ6q8HQtrrAe.label: Ice Cream and Frozen Dessert Manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/uWOA_M6CQQaGGo4Y88C.label: Other Consumer Goods Rental
http://lmss.sali.org/uWOA_M6CQQaGGo4Y88C.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in renting consumer goods (except consumer electronics and appliances).
examples: Hospital bed rental and leasing (i.e., home use)
Video disc rental for home electronic equipment (e.g., DVD)

http://lmss.sali.org/uWp0yA0fQRiilbdyyuh.label: Other Activities Related to Real Estate
http://lmss.sali.org/uWp0yA0fQRiilbdyyuh.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in performing real estate related services (except lessors of real estate, offices of real estate agents and brokers, real estate property managers, and offices of real estate appraisers).

http://lmss.sali.org/uWsJEyDhQ3K5WR8utga.label: Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/uWsJEyDhQ3K5WR8utga.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing communications equipment (except telephone apparatus, radio and television broadcast equipment, and wireless communications equipment).
examples: Fire detection and alarm systems manufacturing
Signals (e.g., highway, pedestrian, railway, traffic) manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/ueoh3Lk7TFOreKKJMRQ.label: General Freight Trucking
http://lmss.sali.org/ueoh3Lk7TFOreKKJMRQ.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing general freight trucking. General freight trucking establishments handle a wide variety of commodities, generally palletized, and transported in a container or van trailer. The establishments of this industry group provide a combination of the following network activities: local pick-up, local sorting and terminal operations, line-haul, destination sorting and terminal operations, and local delivery.

http://lmss.sali.org/ulsY3y_tT4uEwDx1G5n.label: Narrow Fabric Mills and Schiffli Machine Embroidery
http://lmss.sali.org/ulsY3y_tT4uEwDx1G5n.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) weaving or braiding narrow fabrics in their final form or initially made in wider widths that are specially constructed for narrower widths; (2) making fabric-covered elastic yarn and thread; and (3) manufacturing Schiffli machine embroideries. Establishments in this industry may weave only; weave and finish; or weave, finish, and further fabricate fabric products.

http://lmss.sali.org/um-TAjR7R9SPY2LzFBM.label: Continuing Care Retirement Communities and Assisted Living Facilities for the Elderly

http://lmss.sali.org/umUcpM-8TXWKmeKjdR_.label: Furniture and Home Furnishings Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/umUcpM-8TXWKmeKjdR_.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new furniture and home furnishings. Establishments in this industry group with fixed point-of-sale locations may operate from showrooms and have substantial areas for the presentation of their products. Establishments in this industry group may provide incidental services, including interior decorating, product assembly, installation, or repair services.

http://lmss.sali.org/uvuQmp65S4a_MkaUra8.label: Cattle Ranching and Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/uvuQmp65S4a_MkaUra8.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising cattle, milking dairy cattle, or feeding cattle for fattening.

http://lmss.sali.org/uwLptFtuSJKZqEgh9R3.label: Dairy Product (except Dried or Canned) Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/uxuU-zKyRD2HCM3Xa_r.label: Hotels (except Casino Hotels) and Motels
http://lmss.sali.org/uxuU-zKyRD2HCM3Xa_r.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing short-term lodging in facilities known as hotels, motor hotels, resort hotels, and motels. The establishments in this industry may offer food and beverage services, recreational services, conference rooms, convention services, laundry services, parking, and other services.

http://lmss.sali.org/v1yPGscFRR-sQIWeXAk.label: Jewelry and Silverware Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/v1yPGscFRR-sQIWeXAk.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching fine and costume jewelry; (2) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching metal personal goods (i.e., small articles carried on or about the person, such as compacts or cigarette cases); (3) manufacturing, engraving, chasing, or etching precious metal solid, precious metal clad, or pewter flatware and other hollowware; (4) stamping coins; (5) manufacturing unassembled jewelry parts and stock shop products, such as sheet, wire, and tubing; (6) cutting, slabbing, tumbling, carving, engraving, polishing, or faceting precious or semiprecious stones and gems; (7) recutting, repolishing, and setting gem stones; and (8) drilling, sawing, and peeling cultured and costume pearls. This industry includes establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing precious solid, precious clad, and precious plated jewelry and personal goods.

http://lmss.sali.org/v9vYgkKAQKi18G9-iRx.label: Polish and Other Sanitation Good Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/v9vYgkKAQKi18G9-iRx.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and packaging polishes and specialty cleaning preparations.

http://lmss.sali.org/vBLsP_p9T0ChTbDgyR8.label: Drugs and Druggists' Sundries Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/vC_ktnWvR4ST75CIMUA.label: Warehouse Clubs, Supercenters, and Other General Merchandise Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/vC_ktnWvR4ST75CIMUA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new general merchandise (except department stores).  These establishments retail a general line of new merchandise, such as apparel, automotive parts, dry goods, hardware, groceries, housewares, and home furnishings, with no one merchandise line predominating.  Establishments generally known as warehouse clubs, superstores, or supercenters, and retailing a general line of merchandise in combination with a significant amount and variety of perishable groceries, are included in this industry.  This industry also includes establishments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of new and used merchandise on an auction basis.
examples: General merchandise (new and used) auction houses
Warehouse clubs (i.e., food and general merchandise)

http://lmss.sali.org/vGIs4nPgQmyF5RTAWOB.label: Other Leather and Allied Product Manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/vGLzHe62TEKDZYaCar2.label: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)

http://lmss.sali.org/vIw-IeRTQw2hgsPE-MG.label: Diet and Weight Reducing Centers
http://lmss.sali.org/vIw-IeRTQw2hgsPE-MG.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing non-medical services to assist clients in attaining or maintaining a desired weight. The sale of weight reduction products, such as food supplements, may be an integral component of the program. These services typically include individual or group counseling, menu and exercise planning, and weight and body measurement monitoring.

http://lmss.sali.org/vLdfPPyyStWY6_B3x2r.label: Saw Blade and Handtool Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/vLdfPPyyStWY6_B3x2r.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing saw blades, all types (including those for power sawing machines) and/or (2) manufacturing nonpowered handtools and edge tools.

http://lmss.sali.org/vQlZTEAqT5erD0ws7Bb.label: Sporting and Recreational Goods and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/vVDXhbuGTD25X9_z6Su.label: Residential Intellectual and Developmental Disability Facilities
http://lmss.sali.org/vVDXhbuGTD25X9_z6Su.definition: This industry comprises establishments (e.g., group homes, hospitals, intermediate care facilities) primarily engaged in providing residential care services for persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities. These facilities may provide some health care, though the focus is room, board, protective supervision, and counseling.

http://lmss.sali.org/vVPTZWM9TquOobPy0Y4.label: Greenhouse, Nursery, and Floriculture Production
http://lmss.sali.org/vVPTZWM9TquOobPy0Y4.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing crops of any kind under cover and/or growing nursery stock and flowers. "Under cover" is generally defined as greenhouses, cold frames, cloth houses, and lath houses. The crops grown are removed at various stages of maturity and have annual and perennial life cycles. The nursery stock includes short rotation woody crops that have growth cycles of 10 years or less.

http://lmss.sali.org/vYKfaxlqRdyXZxEjWlQ.label: Power Boiler and Heat Exchanger Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/vYKfaxlqRdyXZxEjWlQ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing power boilers and heat exchangers. Establishments in this industry may perform installation in addition to manufacturing power boilers and heat exchangers.

http://lmss.sali.org/vYX7JSuNRDSzce-lpVw.label: Soap and Cleaning Compound Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/vYX7JSuNRDSzce-lpVw.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing and packaging soaps and other cleaning compounds, surface active agents, and textile and leather finishing agents used to reduce tension or speed the drying process.

http://lmss.sali.org/vYl5tm7YTduEPX3h-92.label: Building Equipment Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/vYl5tm7YTduEPX3h-92.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing or servicing equipment that forms part of a building mechanical system (e.g., electricity, water, heating, and cooling). The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs. Contractors installing specialized building equipment, such as elevators, escalators, service station equipment, and central vacuum cleaning systems, are also included.

http://lmss.sali.org/v_2q9_rZTwe-ZUOp0fI.label: Textile Furnishings Mills
http://lmss.sali.org/v_2q9_rZTwe-ZUOp0fI.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing woven, tufted, and other carpets and rugs and (2) manufacturing household textile products from purchased materials. The household textile products may be made on a stock or custom basis for sale to individual retail customers.

http://lmss.sali.org/vfgqAHTKQsidCGObF6U.label: Rubber Product Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/vfgqAHTKQsidCGObF6U.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in processing natural, synthetic, or reclaimed rubber materials into intermediate or final products using processes, such as vulcanizing, cementing, molding, extruding, and lathe-cutting.

http://lmss.sali.org/viDFUCC5QLSs8Vplm2Q.label: Ground or Treated Mineral and Earth Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/viDFUCC5QLSs8Vplm2Q.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in calcining, dead burning, or otherwise processing beyond beneficiation, clays, ceramic and refractory minerals, barite, and miscellaneous nonmetallic minerals.

http://lmss.sali.org/voGue_OlSK2-rhVnTqI.label: Refrigerated Warehousing and Storage
http://lmss.sali.org/voGue_OlSK2-rhVnTqI.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating refrigerated warehousing and storage facilities. Establishments primarily engaged in the storage of furs for the trade are included in this industry. The services provided by these establishments include blast freezing, tempering, and modified atmosphere storage services.

http://lmss.sali.org/vp7kR0nBQcW_5ylXi5_.label: Remediation Services
http://lmss.sali.org/vp7kR0nBQcW_5ylXi5_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) remediation and cleanup of contaminated buildings, mine sites, soil, or ground water; (2) integrated mine reclamation activities, including demolition, soil remediation, waste water treatment, hazardous material removal, contouring land, and revegetation; and (3) asbestos, lead paint, and other toxic material abatement.

http://lmss.sali.org/vqSWMMSFSheZALehwOc.label: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
http://lmss.sali.org/vqSWMMSFSheZALehwOc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing computing infrastructure, data processing services, Web hosting services (except software publishing), and related services, including streaming support services (except streaming distribution services). Data processing establishments provide complete processing and specialized reports from data supplied by clients or provide automated data processing and data entry services.
examples: Video and audio technical streaming support services

http://lmss.sali.org/vugUuFNNSgaslZCbqxD.label: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/vugUuFNNSgaslZCbqxD.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing semiconductors and related solid-state devices. Examples of products made by these establishments are integrated circuits, memory chips, microprocessors, diodes, transistors, solar cells, and other optoelectronic devices.

http://lmss.sali.org/vwGnu2UEQs-Eg4pQmy6.label: Metal Heat Treating
http://lmss.sali.org/vwGnu2UEQs-Eg4pQmy6.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in heat treating, such as annealing, tempering, and brazing, and cryogenically treating metals and metal products for the trade.

http://lmss.sali.org/vxo-fcGbSwqaAfpsZUs.label: Food Crops Grown Under Cover
http://lmss.sali.org/vxo-fcGbSwqaAfpsZUs.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing food crops (e.g., fruits, melons, tomatoes) under glass or protective cover.

http://lmss.sali.org/w0UoGediRO6QtrYoz9r.label: Labor Unions and Similar Labor Organizations

http://lmss.sali.org/w4DOnajkSfC-XzLtKxt.label: Wired and Wireless Telecommunications Carriers (except Satellite)
http://lmss.sali.org/w4DOnajkSfC-XzLtKxt.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating, maintaining, and/or providing access to switching and transmission facilities and infrastructure that they own and/or lease for the transmission of voice, data, text, sound, and video using wired and wireless telecommunications networks (except satellite).  Transmission facilities may be based on a single technology or a combination of technologies.  By exception, establishments providing satellite television distribution services using facilities and infrastructure that they operate are included in this industry.
examples: Broadband Internet service providers, wired (e.g., cable, DSL)
VoIP service providers, using own operated wired telecommunications infrastructure
Wireless Internet service providers, except satellite
Wireless telephone communications carriers, except satellite

http://lmss.sali.org/w4Fos4oGS5ypTviWwbb.label: Clay Building Material and Refractories Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/w4Fos4oGS5ypTviWwbb.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in shaping, molding, baking, burning, or hardening clay refractories, nonclay refractories, ceramic tile, structural clay tile, brick, and other structural clay building materials. A refractory is a material that will retain its shape and chemical identity when subjected to high temperatures and is used in applications that require extreme resistance to heat, such as furnace linings.

http://lmss.sali.org/w6qA3TFqStG724FyU_J.label: Small Electrical Appliance Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/w6qA3TFqStG724FyU_J.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing small electric appliances and electric housewares, household-type fans (except attic fans), household-type vacuum cleaners, and other electric household-type floor care machines.
examples: Carpet and floor cleaning equipment, household-type electric, manufacturing
Portable cooking appliances (except microwave, convection ovens), household-type electric, manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/wBIoHMrdSV6P1fFji8d.label: New Single-Family Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders)
http://lmss.sali.org/wBIoHMrdSV6P1fFji8d.definition: This U.S. industry comprises general contractor establishments primarily responsible for the entire construction of new single-family housing, such as single-family detached houses and town houses or row houses where each housing unit (1) is separated from its neighbors by a ground-to-roof wall and (2) has no housing units constructed above or below. This industry includes general contractors responsible for the on-site assembly of modular and prefabricated houses. Single-family housing design-build firms and single-family construction management firms acting as general contractors are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/wBNINp-dT1em13Ek4Ml.label: Agents and Managers for Artists, Athletes, Entertainers, and Other Public Figures
http://lmss.sali.org/wBNINp-dT1em13Ek4Ml.definition: This industry comprises establishments of agents and managers primarily engaged in representing and/or managing creative and performing artists, sports figures, entertainers, and other public figures. The representation and management includes activities, such as representing clients in contract negotiations; managing or organizing clients' financial affairs; and generally promoting the careers of their clients.

http://lmss.sali.org/wBpX5rAKRBenq8OgtEB.label: Computer Systems Design and Related Services
http://lmss.sali.org/wBpX5rAKRBenq8OgtEB.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing expertise in the field of information technologies through one or more of the following activities: (1) writing, modifying, testing, and supporting software to meet the needs of a particular customer; (2) planning and designing computer systems that integrate computer hardware, software, and communication technologies; (3) on-site management and operation of clients' computer systems and/or data processing facilities; and (4) other professional and technical computer related advice and services.
examples: Computer hardware or software consulting services

http://lmss.sali.org/wEQe5b-RTNmQrY1pAG9.label: Oil and Gas Pipeline and Related Structures Construction
http://lmss.sali.org/wEQe5b-RTNmQrY1pAG9.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the construction of oil and gas lines, mains, refineries, and storage tanks. The work performed may include new work, reconstruction, rehabilitation, and repairs. Specialty trade contractors are included in this industry if they are engaged in activities primarily related to oil and gas pipeline and related structures construction. All structures (including buildings) that are integral parts of oil and gas networks (e.g., storage tanks, pumping stations, and refineries) are included in this industry.
examples: Distribution line, gas and oil, construction
Gathering line, gas and oil field, construction
Pumping station, gas and oil transmission, construction
Storage tank, natural gas or oil, tank farm or field, construction

http://lmss.sali.org/wIDc9KRZRzy4V6FnP7e.label: Siding Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/wIDc9KRZRzy4V6FnP7e.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in installing siding of wood, aluminum, vinyl, or other exterior finish material (except brick, stone, stucco, or curtain wall). This industry also includes establishments installing gutters and downspouts. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Downspout, gutter, and gutter guard installation

http://lmss.sali.org/wIEtyAdCTKydfrgBFhH.label: Promoters of Performing Arts, Sports, and Similar Events without Facilities
http://lmss.sali.org/wIEtyAdCTKydfrgBFhH.definition: This industry comprises promoters primarily engaged in organizing, promoting, and/or managing live performing arts productions, sports events, and similar events, such as state fairs, county fairs, agricultural fairs, concerts, and festivals, in facilities that are managed and operated by others. Theatrical (except motion picture) booking agencies are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/wJSrD34wT_i5cwB0Hte.label: Administration of Housing Programs, Urban Planning, and Community Development

http://lmss.sali.org/wKJTHPpGQNKwQxyKhlx.label: Unlaminated Plastics Film and Sheet (except Packaging) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wKJTHPpGQNKwQxyKhlx.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in converting plastics resins into plastics film and unlaminated sheet (except packaging).

http://lmss.sali.org/wLPY4QkERcWafkpqOnV.label: Marinas
http://lmss.sali.org/wLPY4QkERcWafkpqOnV.definition: This industry comprises establishments, commonly known as marinas, engaged in operating docking and/or storage facilities for pleasure craft owners, with or without one or more related activities, such as retailing fuel and marine supplies; and repairing, maintaining, or renting pleasure boats.

http://lmss.sali.org/wOdsGZCWSs-YeT7rQkA.label: Soybean Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/wOdsGZCWSs-YeT7rQkA.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing soybeans and/or producing soybean seeds.

http://lmss.sali.org/wXo7lKUuTRGwCgeG1tJ.label: Paper Bag and Coated and Treated Paper Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wXo7lKUuTRGwCgeG1tJ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) cutting and coating paper and paperboard; (2) cutting and laminating paper, paperboard, and other flexible materials (except plastics film to plastics film); (3) manufacturing bags, multiwall bags, sacks of paper, metal foil, coated paper, laminates, or coated combinations of paper and foil with plastics film; (4) manufacturing laminated aluminum and other converted metal foils from purchased foils; and (5) surface coating paper or paperboard.

http://lmss.sali.org/waSyqIlaQ2KJrUnMcfn.label: Specialized Automotive Repair
http://lmss.sali.org/waSyqIlaQ2KJrUnMcfn.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing specialized mechanical or electrical repair and maintenance services (except engine repair and replacement) for automotive vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, and vans, and all trailers.
examples: Automotive exhaust system replacement and repair shops

http://lmss.sali.org/waxajmBPR9ie788Qkax.label: Amusement and Theme Parks
http://lmss.sali.org/waxajmBPR9ie788Qkax.definition: This industry comprises establishments, known as amusement or theme parks, primarily engaged in operating a variety of attractions, such as mechanical rides, water rides, games, shows, theme exhibits, refreshment stands, and picnic grounds. These establishments may lease space to others on a concession basis.

http://lmss.sali.org/wb3iJxm2RdaGrof9D_s.label: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wb3iJxm2RdaGrof9D_s.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) manufacturing measuring and dispensing pumps, such as gasoline pumps and lubricating oil measuring and dispensing pumps and/or (2) manufacturing general purpose pumps and pumping equipment (except fluid power pumps and motors), such as reciprocating pumps, turbine pumps, centrifugal pumps, rotary pumps, diaphragm pumps, domestic water system pumps, oil well and oil field pumps, and sump pumps.

http://lmss.sali.org/wdv7Os4xQBWb9SYDVMc.label: Environmental Consulting Services
http://lmss.sali.org/wdv7Os4xQBWb9SYDVMc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on environmental issues, such as the control of environmental contamination from pollutants, toxic substances, and hazardous materials. These establishments identify problems (e.g., inspect buildings for hazardous materials), measure and evaluate risks, and recommend solutions. They employ a multidisciplined staff of scientists, engineers, and other technicians with expertise in areas, such as air and water quality, asbestos contamination, remediation, ecological restoration, and environmental law. Establishments providing sanitation or site remediation consulting services are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/wfbQ4xuyTzmgN0f_t9I.label: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wfbQ4xuyTzmgN0f_t9I.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing search, detection, navigation, guidance, aeronautical, and nautical systems and instruments. Examples of products made by these establishments are aircraft instruments (except engine), flight recorders, navigational instruments and systems, radar systems and equipment, and sonar systems and equipment.

http://lmss.sali.org/wiaGuQemQkyR1qSRh9u.label: Fabricated Structural Metal Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wiaGuQemQkyR1qSRh9u.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in fabricating structural metal products, such as assemblies of concrete reinforcing bars and fabricated bar joists.

http://lmss.sali.org/wmQ5m7Q6RPKn6lAaRBm.label: Lessors of Other Real Estate Property

http://lmss.sali.org/wnwNWgAqSmOBe59tCIH.label: Executive and Legislative Offices, Combined
http://lmss.sali.org/wnwNWgAqSmOBe59tCIH.definition: This industry comprises government establishments serving as councils and boards of commissioners or supervisors and such bodies where the chief executive (e.g., county executive or city mayor) is a member of the legislative body (e.g., county or city council) itself.

http://lmss.sali.org/wvz7V1NcSBKrlafZPC0.label: Cane Sugar Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wvz7V1NcSBKrlafZPC0.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) processing sugarcane and/or (2) refining cane sugar from raw cane sugar.

http://lmss.sali.org/wwL7y7fcTXS5VOmVT61.label: Aircraft Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/wwL7y7fcTXS5VOmVT61.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) manufacturing or assembling complete aircraft; (2) developing and making aircraft prototypes; (3) aircraft conversion (i.e., major modifications to systems); and (4) complete aircraft overhaul and rebuilding (i.e., periodic restoration of aircraft to original design specifications).

http://lmss.sali.org/wxCs9O6GT7a0wqZCRWD.label: Sugar Beet Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/wxCs9O6GT7a0wqZCRWD.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing sugar beets.

http://lmss.sali.org/x3cnl5kORAOBfJgR37P.label: Poured Concrete Foundation and Structure Contractors

http://lmss.sali.org/x4_-bJB3TzmuIGNEuuB.label: Tobacco Product and Electronic Cigarette Merchant Wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/x8qscR7XQVOkFI-Gyhl.label: Printing Ink Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/x8qscR7XQVOkFI-Gyhl.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing printing and inkjet inks and inkjet cartridges.

http://lmss.sali.org/xAuasYIeRWGIjXmpncP.label: Fabricated Pipe and Pipe Fitting Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/xAuasYIeRWGIjXmpncP.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in fabricating, such as cutting, threading, and bending, metal pipes and pipe fittings made from purchased metal pipe.

http://lmss.sali.org/xC-eByosSr-Ha5l9zMZ.label: Exterminating and Pest Control Services
http://lmss.sali.org/xC-eByosSr-Ha5l9zMZ.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in exterminating and controlling birds, mosquitoes, rodents, termites, and other insects and pests (except for crop production and forestry production). Establishments providing fumigation services are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/xE0MHQ92QBOhBSI_eqv.label: Crushed and Broken Granite Mining and Quarrying
http://lmss.sali.org/xE0MHQ92QBOhBSI_eqv.definition: This U.S. industry comprises (1) establishments primarily engaged in developing the mine site, and/or mining or quarrying crushed and broken granite (including related rocks, such as gneiss, syenite (except nepheline), and diorite) and (2) preparation plants primarily engaged in beneficiating granite (e.g., grinding or pulverizing).

http://lmss.sali.org/xHYpQehTSCuxJCSwbZ2.label: Depository Credit Intermediation Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/xHYpQehTSCuxJCSwbZ2.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in accepting deposits (or share deposits) and in lending funds from these deposits. Within this group, industries are defined on the basis of differences in the types of deposit liabilities assumed and in the nature of the credit extended.

http://lmss.sali.org/xLHw6gf6RjugSp9uLEX.label: Remediation and Other Waste Management Services
http://lmss.sali.org/xLHw6gf6RjugSp9uLEX.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in remediation and other waste management services (except waste collection, waste treatment and disposal, and waste management consulting services).

http://lmss.sali.org/xM-VFVJHRwmgLXYW3KL.label: Casinos (except Casino Hotels)
http://lmss.sali.org/xM-VFVJHRwmgLXYW3KL.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating gambling facilities that offer table wagering games along with other gambling activities, such as slot machines and sports betting. These establishments often provide food and beverage services. Included in this industry are floating casinos (i.e., gambling cruises, riverboat casinos) and casinos with racetracks.

http://lmss.sali.org/xMQKjPstSu-pwmHEbJh.label: Cafeterias, Grill Buffets, and Buffets
http://lmss.sali.org/xMQKjPstSu-pwmHEbJh.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments, known as cafeterias, grill buffets, or buffets, primarily engaged in preparing and serving meals for immediate consumption using cafeteria-style or buffet serving equipment, such as steam tables, refrigerated areas, display grills, and self-service nonalcoholic beverage dispensing equipment. Patrons select from food and drink items on display in a continuous cafeteria line or from buffet stations.

http://lmss.sali.org/xMkLKyB6TeSKfZuEd_m.label: Iron and Steel Pipe and Tube Manufacturing from Purchased Steel
http://lmss.sali.org/xMkLKyB6TeSKfZuEd_m.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing welded, riveted, or seamless pipe and tube from purchased iron or steel.

http://lmss.sali.org/xMuZ1gX8RYq9cWUBiGj.label: Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance
http://lmss.sali.org/xMuZ1gX8RYq9cWUBiGj.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in repairing and maintaining one or more of the following: (1) consumer electronic equipment; (2) computers; (3) office machines; (4) communication equipment; and (5) other electronic and precision equipment and instruments, without retailing these products as new. Establishments in this industry repair items, such as microscopes, radar and sonar equipment, televisions, stereos, video recorders, computers, fax machines, photocopying machines, two-way radios, cellular telephones, and other communications equipment, scientific instruments, and medical equipment.

http://lmss.sali.org/xPELArJHQ7aoZqqbcbh.label: Lessors of Residential Buildings and Dwellings
http://lmss.sali.org/xPELArJHQ7aoZqqbcbh.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in acting as lessors of buildings used as residences or dwellings, such as single-family homes, apartment buildings, and town homes. Included in this industry are owner-lessors and establishments renting real estate and then acting as lessors in subleasing it to others. The establishments in this industry may manage the property themselves or have another establishment manage it for them.

http://lmss.sali.org/xTRxLt_cQi-34FkDvM_.label: Telephone Answering Services
http://lmss.sali.org/xTRxLt_cQi-34FkDvM_.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in answering telephone calls and relaying messages on behalf of clients or for other establishments of the same enterprise.

http://lmss.sali.org/xXwVm2IwRQCJF8K-W4Q.label: Management of Companies and Enterprises Industry

http://lmss.sali.org/xaeK0Z3TSbKSBwNNkf8.label: Nonscheduled Air Transportation
http://lmss.sali.org/xaeK0Z3TSbKSBwNNkf8.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) providing air transportation of passengers and/or cargo with no regular routes and regular schedules or (2) providing specialty flying services with no regular routes and regular schedules using general purpose aircraft.  These establishments have more flexibility with respect to choice of airports, hours of operation, load factors, and similar operational characteristics.

http://lmss.sali.org/xbCV3jLeQCuUfyvr5Os.label: Locksmiths
http://lmss.sali.org/xbCV3jLeQCuUfyvr5Os.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) selling mechanical or electronic locking devices, safes, and security vaults, along with installation, repair, rebuilding, or adjusting services or (2) installing, repairing, rebuilding, and adjusting mechanical or electronic locking devices, safes, and security vaults.

http://lmss.sali.org/xcK989Y3QB6kHwRG4uD.label: Wind Electric Power Generation
http://lmss.sali.org/xcK989Y3QB6kHwRG4uD.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating wind electric power generation facilities. These facilities use wind power to drive a turbine and produce electric energy. The electric energy produced in these establishments is provided to electric power transmission systems or to electric power distribution systems.

http://lmss.sali.org/xetp3Y4fRFmL7GChfae.label: Tile and Terrazzo Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/xetp3Y4fRFmL7GChfae.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in setting and installing ceramic tile, stone (interior only), and mosaic and/or mixing marble particles and cement to make terrazzo at the job site. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Marble, granite, and slate, interior installation contractors

http://lmss.sali.org/xpxCh3WdTMuIsk5Gcbe.label: Paperboard Mills
http://lmss.sali.org/xpxCh3WdTMuIsk5Gcbe.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing paperboard (e.g., can/drum stock, container board, corrugating medium, folding carton stock, linerboard, tube) from pulp. These establishments may manufacture or purchase pulp. In addition, the establishments may also convert the paperboard they make.

http://lmss.sali.org/xtVJlR7gSsa74DvdMrI.label: Paper Bag and Coated and Treated Paper Manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/xuwgH_9JStK5sueegeL.label: Wood Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/xvDRByR5QHO6zxQ2iC5.label: All Other General Merchandise Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/xvDRByR5QHO6zxQ2iC5.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing new and used general merchandise (except department stores, warehouse clubs, superstores, and supercenters). These establishments retail a general line of new and used merchandise, such as apparel, automotive parts, dry goods, groceries, hardware, housewares or home furnishings, and other lines in limited amounts, with none of the lines predominating. This industry also includes establishments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of new and used merchandise on an auction basis.
examples: General merchandise (new and used) auction houses

http://lmss.sali.org/xvGcowzRSYaFvQ83iwT.label: All Other Food Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/xvGcowzRSYaFvQ83iwT.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing food (except animal food; grain and oilseed milling; sugar and confectionery products; preserved fruits, vegetables, and specialty foods; dairy products; meat products; seafood products; baked goods and tortillas; snack foods; coffee and tea; flavoring syrups and concentrates; seasonings; and dressings).  Included in this industry are establishments primarily engaged in mixing purchased dried and/or dehydrated ingredients, including those mixing purchased dried and/or dehydrated ingredients for soup mixes and bouillon.
examples: Cut or peeled fresh vegetables manufacturing
Powdered drink mixes (except chocolate, coffee, tea, or milk based) manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/xy8Zy-zeT5K2BnkljKN.label: Fastener, Button, Needle, and Pin Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/xy8Zy-zeT5K2BnkljKN.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing fasteners, buttons, needles, pins, and buckles (except made of precious metals or precious and semiprecious stones and gems).

http://lmss.sali.org/y2pq44pLQya708NbGTo.label: Dental Laboratories
http://lmss.sali.org/y2pq44pLQya708NbGTo.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing dentures, crowns, bridges, and orthodontic appliances customized for individual application.

http://lmss.sali.org/y4E9W51STceu11dcEEq.label: Gasoline Stations with Convenience Stores
http://lmss.sali.org/y4E9W51STceu11dcEEq.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing automotive fuels (e.g., gasoline, diesel fuel, gasohol, alternative fuels) in combination with a limited line of groceries. These establishments can either be in a convenience store (i.e., food mart) setting or a gasoline station setting. These establishments may also provide automotive repair services.

http://lmss.sali.org/y6jqdOKdSDGOVWJ8EPe.label: Pet Care (except Veterinary) Services
http://lmss.sali.org/y6jqdOKdSDGOVWJ8EPe.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing pet care services (except veterinary), such as boarding, grooming, sitting, walking, and training pets.

http://lmss.sali.org/y6nQRE4HQ_K6Ijx-5uF.label: Offices of Other Health Practitioners
http://lmss.sali.org/y6nQRE4HQ_K6Ijx-5uF.definition: This industry group comprises establishments of independent health practitioners (except physicians and dentists).

http://lmss.sali.org/yCwJYkutSP-NQ7C3KEY.label: Commercial Printing (except Screen and Books)
http://lmss.sali.org/yCwJYkutSP-NQ7C3KEY.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in commercial printing (except screen printing, books printing) without publishing (except fabric grey goods printing). The printing processes used in this industry include, but are not limited to, lithographic, gravure, flexographic, letterpress, engraving, and various digital printing technologies. This industry includes establishments engaged in commercial printing on purchased stock materials, such as stationery, invitations, labels, and similar items, on a job-order basis. Establishments primarily engaged in traditional printing activities combined with document photocopying services (i.e., quick printers) or primarily engaged in printing graphical materials using digital printing equipment are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/yEaA-SRFR7iZTNpcMDC.label: Spring Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/yEaA-SRFR7iZTNpcMDC.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing springs from purchased wire, strip, or rod.

http://lmss.sali.org/yItUS00QRmee_d_m5cp.label: Financial Transactions Processing, Reserve, and Clearinghouse Activities Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/yItUS00QRmee_d_m5cp.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing one or more of the following: (1) financial transaction processing (except central bank); (2) reserve and liquidity services (except central bank); and/or (3) check or other financial instrument clearinghouse services (except central bank).
examples: Automated clearinghouses, bank or check (except central bank)
Electronic funds transfer services, including peer-to-peer payment services

http://lmss.sali.org/yMwh-VDxQ9S8zN6Jc9t.label: Clay Product and Refractory Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/yMwh-VDxQ9S8zN6Jc9t.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) shaping, molding, glazing, and firing pottery, ceramics, and plumbing fixtures, and electrical supplies made entirely or partly of clay or other ceramic materials or (2) shaping, molding, baking, burning, or hardening clay refractories, nonclay refractories, ceramic tile, structural clay tile, brick, and other structural clay building materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/yOKqXQQ4Slmg_mO_t3y.label: Painting and Wall Covering Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/yOKqXQQ4Slmg_mO_t3y.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in interior or exterior painting or interior wall covering. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.

http://lmss.sali.org/yPIW4uCrQPmTqbzwxIf.label: Solid Waste Combustors and Incinerators
http://lmss.sali.org/yPIW4uCrQPmTqbzwxIf.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating combustors and incinerators for the disposal of nonhazardous solid waste. These establishments may produce byproducts, such as electricity and steam.

http://lmss.sali.org/yUiU8D7sT0uIwx0oXS-.label: Turkey Production
http://lmss.sali.org/yUiU8D7sT0uIwx0oXS-.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in raising turkeys for meat or egg production.

http://lmss.sali.org/yXZV1bOZQRCL9w1Jd2A.label: Flooring Contractors
http://lmss.sali.org/yXZV1bOZQRCL9w1Jd2A.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the installation of resilient floor tile, carpeting, linoleum, and hardwood flooring. The work performed may include new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs.
examples: Floor laying, scraping, finishing, and refinishing
Resilient floor tile or sheet (e.g., linoleum, rubber, vinyl), installation only

http://lmss.sali.org/ygWbbXgnQPS-sRtx2hC.label: Military Armored Vehicle, Tank, and Tank Component Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/ygWbbXgnQPS-sRtx2hC.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing complete military armored vehicles, combat tanks, specialized components for combat tanks, and self-propelled weapons.

http://lmss.sali.org/yhsp_9s9QNm9UB4VUcc.label: Other Business Support Services
http://lmss.sali.org/yhsp_9s9QNm9UB4VUcc.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing business support services (except secretarial and other document preparation services; telephone answering or telemarketing services; private mail services or document copying services conducted as separate activities or in conjunction with other office support services; monetary debt collection services; and credit reporting services).
examples: Charitable fundraising campaign organization services on a contract or fee basis
Real-time (i.e., simultaneous) closed captioning of live television performances, meetings, conferences

http://lmss.sali.org/yjRiY46cQFumWNnGef2.label: Specialized Freight (except Used Goods) Trucking, Local
http://lmss.sali.org/yjRiY46cQFumWNnGef2.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing local, specialized trucking. Local trucking establishments provide trucking within a metropolitan area that may cross state lines. Generally the trips are same-day return.
examples: Local dump trucking (e.g., gravel, sand, top-soil)

http://lmss.sali.org/ypM3HwsfTkaEskWo-b5.label: Specialty (except Psychiatric and Substance Abuse) Hospitals
http://lmss.sali.org/ypM3HwsfTkaEskWo-b5.definition: This industry comprises establishments known and licensed as specialty hospitals primarily engaged in providing diagnostic and medical treatment to inpatients with a specific type of disease or medical condition (except psychiatric or substance abuse). Hospitals providing long-term care for the chronically ill and hospitals providing rehabilitation, restorative, and adjustive services to physically challenged or disabled people are included in this industry. These establishments maintain inpatient beds and provide patients with food services that meet their nutritional requirements. They have an organized staff of physicians and other medical staff to provide patient care services. These hospitals may provide other services, such as outpatient services, diagnostic X-ray services, clinical laboratory services, operating room services, physical therapy services, educational and vocational services, and psychological and social work services.

http://lmss.sali.org/ysMBv9gdQQmKbY9Q9z1.label: Printing and Writing Paper Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/ysMBv9gdQQmKbY9Q9z1.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of bulk printing and/or writing paper generally on rolls for further processing.
examples: Bulk paper (e.g., fine, printing, writing) merchant wholesalers

http://lmss.sali.org/yv_CmYZ_SqOc0shKIhx.label: Coastal and Great Lakes Freight Transportation
http://lmss.sali.org/yv_CmYZ_SqOc0shKIhx.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing water transportation of cargo in coastal waters, on the Great Lakes System, or deep seas between ports of the United States, Puerto Rico, and United States island possessions or protectorates. Marine transportation establishments using the facilities of the St. Lawrence Seaway Authority Commission are considered to be using the Great Lakes Water Transportation System. Establishments primarily engaged in providing coastal and/or Great Lakes barge transportation services are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/yxGBugvDSQ2aTK6cRyU.label: Asphalt Paving Mixture and Block Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/yxGBugvDSQ2aTK6cRyU.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing asphalt and tar paving mixtures and blocks from purchased asphaltic materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/yymIiytuSQGEbfIG6Ll.label: Other Individual and Family Services
http://lmss.sali.org/yymIiytuSQGEbfIG6Ll.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing nonresidential individual and family social assistance services (except those specifically directed toward children, the elderly, or persons with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities).
examples: Marriage counseling services (except by offices of mental health practitioners)
Self-help organizations (except for disabled persons, the elderly)

http://lmss.sali.org/z3AvSAowQJekaj9P5gj.label: All Other Miscellaneous Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/z3AvSAowQJekaj9P5gj.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing fabricated metal products (except forgings and stampings, cutlery and handtools, architectural and structural metals, boilers, tanks, shipping containers, hardware, spring and wire products, machine shop products, turned products, screws, nuts and bolts, metal valves, ball and roller bearings, ammunition, small arms and other ordnances and accessories, and fabricated pipes and pipe fittings).
examples: Metal pipe hangers and supports manufacturing
Sanitary ware (e.g., bathtubs, lavatories, sinks), metal and enameled metal, manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/z3eGBnnvTVCJueg7ceH.label: Radio and Television Broadcasting Stations
http://lmss.sali.org/z3eGBnnvTVCJueg7ceH.definition: This industry group comprises establishments operating radio or television broadcasting stations for the programming and transmission of programs to the public. Programming may originate in their own studio, from an affiliated network, or from external sources.

http://lmss.sali.org/z8c5DL99SOCh-FEIdYL.label: Tree Nut Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/z8c5DL99SOCh-FEIdYL.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing tree nuts.

http://lmss.sali.org/z92pj9hTTd2-Vgl3rH8.label: All Other General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/z92pj9hTTd2-Vgl3rH8.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing general purpose machinery (except ventilation, heating, air-conditioning, and commercial refrigeration equipment; metalworking machinery; engines, turbines, and power transmission equipment; pumps and compressors; and material handling equipment).
examples: Bridge and gate lifting machinery manufacturing

http://lmss.sali.org/zDdwEeZvTte4D_SkfmM.label: Hardware Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zDdwEeZvTte4D_SkfmM.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing metal hardware, such as metal hinges, metal handles, keys, and locks (except coin- or card-operated, time locks).

http://lmss.sali.org/zFZjz8Q_RcOV7VZt_mi.label: Printed Circuit Assembly (Electronic Assembly) Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zFZjz8Q_RcOV7VZt_mi.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in loading components onto printed circuit boards or who manufacture and ship loaded printed circuit boards. Also known as printed circuit assemblies, electronics assemblies, or modules, these products are printed circuit boards that have some or all of the semiconductor and electronic components inserted or mounted and are inputs to a wide variety of electronic systems and devices.

http://lmss.sali.org/zITr6CzeSv6Yhyw4pdM.label: Automobile and Other Motor Vehicle Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/zITr6CzeSv6Yhyw4pdM.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of new and used passenger automobiles, trucks, trailers, and other motor vehicles, such as motorcycles, motor homes, and snowmobiles.

http://lmss.sali.org/zJI_Ck8XSUmLNoUHj6d.label: Hardware Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/zJI_Ck8XSUmLNoUHj6d.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing a general line of new hardware items, such as tools and builders' hardware.

http://lmss.sali.org/zJvwU05_RG-wP9_DO5p.label: Regulation and Administration of Communications, Electric, Gas, and Other Utilities

http://lmss.sali.org/zLn0ZdveSx21N9LUjvY.label: Other Foundation, Structure, and Building Exterior Contractors

http://lmss.sali.org/zVyFRMyvS12UvtDZANE.label: Asphalt Shingle and Coating Materials Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zVyFRMyvS12UvtDZANE.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in (1) saturating purchased mats and felts with asphalt or tar from purchased asphaltic materials and (2) manufacturing asphalt and tar and roofing cements and coatings from purchased asphaltic materials.

http://lmss.sali.org/zXJlF4ZJQQGraxIjgIt.label: Iron and Steel Mills and Ferroalloy Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zXJlF4ZJQQGraxIjgIt.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in one or more of the following: (1) direct reduction of iron ore; (2) manufacturing pig iron in molten or solid form; (3) converting pig iron into steel; (4) making steel; (5) making steel and manufacturing shapes (e.g., bar, plate, rod, sheet, strip, wire); (6) making steel and forming pipe and tube; and (7) manufacturing electrometallurgical ferroalloys. Ferroalloys add critical elements, such as silicon and manganese for carbon steel and chromium, vanadium, tungsten, titanium, and molybdenum for low- and high-alloy metals. Ferroalloys include iron-rich alloys and more pure forms of elements added during the steel manufacturing process that alter or improve the characteristics of the metal.

http://lmss.sali.org/zZrNgdPqRCyQxuIj0b5.label: Communication and Energy Wire and Cable Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zZrNgdPqRCyQxuIj0b5.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in insulating fiber optic cable, and manufacturing insulated nonferrous wire and cable from nonferrous wire drawn in other establishments.

http://lmss.sali.org/zaaTiX8NTY6F1gMr-mj.label: Automotive Body, Paint, and Interior Repair and Maintenance
http://lmss.sali.org/zaaTiX8NTY6F1gMr-mj.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in repairing or customizing automotive vehicle and trailer bodies and interiors; and/or painting automotive vehicles and trailer bodies.
examples: Restoration shops, antique and classic automotive

http://lmss.sali.org/zcX2fp2ISZWcyQQcbR_.label: Concrete Pipe, Brick, and Block Manufacturing
http://lmss.sali.org/zcX2fp2ISZWcyQQcbR_.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in manufacturing concrete pipe, brick, and block.

http://lmss.sali.org/zcy3IZbQQZ69UqNYGPN.label: Monetary Authorities-Central Bank Industry
http://lmss.sali.org/zcy3IZbQQZ69UqNYGPN.definition: The Monetary Authorities-Central Bank subsector groups establishments that engage in performing central banking functions, such as issuing currency, managing the Nation's money supply and international reserves, holding deposits that represent the reserves of other banks and other central banks, and acting as a fiscal agent for the central government.

http://lmss.sali.org/zf8A0WzpS_6VzPbNP87.label: Rice Farming
http://lmss.sali.org/zf8A0WzpS_6VzPbNP87.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in growing rice (except wild rice) and/or producing rice seeds.

http://lmss.sali.org/zfz344mpSe-jWrPApg2.label: Flower, Nursery Stock, and Florists' Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/zfz344mpSe-jWrPApg2.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of flowers, florists' supplies, and/or nursery stock (except plant seeds and plant bulbs).

http://lmss.sali.org/zjmuqYJpQXWHi19NVPn.label: Dairy Cattle and Milk Production
http://lmss.sali.org/zjmuqYJpQXWHi19NVPn.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in milking dairy cattle.

http://lmss.sali.org/zrLrYn1dQ_CWBpr2SLR.label: Farm Management Services
http://lmss.sali.org/zrLrYn1dQ_CWBpr2SLR.definition: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing farm management services on a contract or fee basis usually to citrus groves, orchards, or vineyards. These establishments always provide management and may arrange or contract for the partial or the complete operations of the farm establishment(s) they manage. Operational activities may include cultivating, harvesting, and/or other specialized agricultural support activities.

http://lmss.sali.org/zsRJsDRFRTWise5EO9W.label: Grocery and Related Product Merchant Wholesalers
http://lmss.sali.org/zsRJsDRFRTWise5EO9W.definition: This industry group comprises establishments primarily engaged in the merchant wholesale distribution of (1) a general line of groceries; (2) packaged frozen food; (3) dairy products; (4) poultry and poultry products; (5) confectioneries; (6) fish and seafood; (7) meats and meat products; (8) fresh fruits and vegetables; and (9) other grocery and related products.

http://lmss.sali.org/ztob7F-SRvuxFBfyAgs.label: Meat Retailers
http://lmss.sali.org/ztob7F-SRvuxFBfyAgs.definition: This industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in retailing fresh, frozen, or cured meats and poultry not for immediate consumption. Delicatessen-type establishments primarily engaged in retailing fresh meat are included in this industry.

http://lmss.sali.org/zxyXToiXS6aVbnljcU_.label: Correctional Institutions
http://lmss.sali.org/zxyXToiXS6aVbnljcU_.definition: This industry comprises government establishments primarily engaged in managing and operating correctional institutions. The facility is generally designed for the confinement, correction, and rehabilitation of adult and/or juvenile offenders sentenced by a court.

http://purl.org/dc/terms/agent.label: oasis:agent
http://purl.org/dc/terms/agent.definition: An "oasis:agent" is a type of agent or actor within the context of the OASIS standard, which is used to represent individuals or organizations that are involved in some way in a particular activity or process.

http://lmss.sali.org/1I7FDiM6OkrUyokmq3h.label: Individual
http://lmss.sali.org/1I7FDiM6OkrUyokmq3h.definition: An industry classification for matters where the primary client is a natural person rather than an incorporated entity, partnership, or other formal business structure. Used for personal legal matters including estate planning, high-net-worth advisory, family law, and work involving influencers, athletes, or other individuals whose economic activity does not fit a single corporate sector code.

http://lmss.sali.org/5K7eOa4PXk56Vad6Pc6.label: Family Office
http://lmss.sali.org/5K7eOa4PXk56Vad6Pc6.definition: A privately held entity established to manage investment, financial, and administrative services for a single ultra-high-net-worth family or a small number of related wealthy families. Services typically include investment portfolio management, estate and succession planning, tax structuring, philanthropy coordination, and intergenerational wealth transfer.

http://lmss.sali.org/2GL3wPPyBNPcAdt7zIO.label: Crypto Brokerage / Digital Asset Exchange
http://lmss.sali.org/2GL3wPPyBNPcAdt7zIO.definition: An operator of platforms that facilitate the buying, selling, and trading of cryptocurrencies, digital tokens, stablecoins, and other digital assets between counterparties. Includes centralised exchanges (CEX) such as Coinbase and Kraken, decentralised exchange (DEX) protocol operators, and hybrid platforms providing custody and brokerage services for digital assets.

http://lmss.sali.org/3RwsEOFAKImzAfPqj1l.label: Crypto Mining & Blockchain Infrastructure
http://lmss.sali.org/3RwsEOFAKImzAfPqj1l.definition: Companies engaged in the computational validation of transactions and creation of new blocks on proof-of-work blockchain networks, or in providing the specialised hardware, hosting facilities, and software infrastructure that supports such operations. Includes ASIC and GPU hardware manufacturers, mining pool operators, and dedicated crypto data centre providers such as Bitmain and Riot Platforms.

http://lmss.sali.org/6bN0Lg2OT8yiqpb4vSa.label: Cannabis Cultivation
http://lmss.sali.org/6bN0Lg2OT8yiqpb4vSa.definition: Cultivation, on-site processing, and extraction of cannabis (Cannabis sativa L.) for commercial purposes, covering medical cannabis, recreational cannabis, and industrial hemp. Encompasses the full point-of-production cycle: growing from seed or clone through harvest (indoor, greenhouse, and outdoor operations); post-harvest processing including drying, curing, and trimming; and primary extraction of cannabinoids and other plant-derived compounds. Also includes nurseries supplying genetics and clones to other cultivators. Excludes wholesale distribution, retail dispensary operations, and the manufacture of finished consumer products incorporating cannabis-derived inputs.

http://lmss.sali.org/e18b221c-01c6-4a32-.label: Business Management Software
http://lmss.sali.org/e18b221c-01c6-4a32-.definition: Software that automates general business functions used across most industries — including finance and accounting, enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management, human capital management, sales, marketing, advertising, e-commerce, customer service, productivity, and collaboration. Examples include SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, HubSpot, Workday, and ServiceNow.

http://lmss.sali.org/60472104-b771-4a38-.label: Industry-Specific Application Software
http://lmss.sali.org/60472104-b771-4a38-.definition: Software whose primary product is built for the operations, regulatory profile, or workflows of a specific industry rather than for cross-industry use. Covers verticals such as healthcare, legal, financial services, insurance, real estate, government, education, hospitality, construction, manufacturing, logistics, retail, and energy. Examples include Epic (healthcare), Veeva (life sciences), Toast (restaurants), Clio (legal), and Procore (construction).

http://lmss.sali.org/aaa35b92-6f9b-4844-.label: Infrastructure & Platform Software
http://lmss.sali.org/aaa35b92-6f9b-4844-.definition: Software that supports the development, deployment, operation, and integration of other software, including operating systems, databases, application development platforms, developer tools, DevOps and site-reliability software, observability and monitoring, and integration middleware. Examples include Linux distributions, PostgreSQL, GitHub, GitLab, Datadog, and MuleSoft. Excludes underlying compute, storage, and network services, which are classified under Computing Infrastructure Providers (NAICS 5182).

http://lmss.sali.org/11134090-2a7e-4778-.label: Security Software
http://lmss.sali.org/11134090-2a7e-4778-.definition: Software whose primary function is to protect computer systems, networks, applications, identities, and data from unauthorized access, misuse, or attack. Includes endpoint and network security, cloud and application security, identity and access management, security operations (SIEM/SOAR), encryption and data protection, and fraud, anti-money-laundering, and compliance software. Examples include CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Okta, SentinelOne, and Splunk.

http://lmss.sali.org/4008e077-83c8-4f12-.label: Data, Analytics & AI Software
http://lmss.sali.org/4008e077-83c8-4f12-.definition: Software for storing, processing, analyzing, and modeling data — including business intelligence and analytics, data warehousing and data lakes, data integration and ETL, machine learning platforms (MLOps), foundation model providers, and applied AI and AI agent platforms. Examples include Snowflake, Databricks, Tableau, Hugging Face, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

http://lmss.sali.org/a767e24f-77e5-4b41-.label: Engineering & Design Software
http://lmss.sali.org/a767e24f-77e5-4b41-.definition: Software used to design, simulate, model, and document physical products, structures, systems, and spatial environments — including computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided manufacturing and engineering (CAM/CAE), electronic design automation (EDA), simulation, and geographic information systems (GIS). Examples include Autodesk, Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, Ansys, and Esri.

http://lmss.sali.org/b1b249b3-b04a-43e0-.label: Consumer Software
http://lmss.sali.org/b1b249b3-b04a-43e0-.definition: Software whose primary buyers are individual consumers rather than businesses or institutions, including mobile applications, social and communication apps, dating and lifestyle apps, and personal productivity tools. Examples include Spotify, Duolingo, WhatsApp, and Strava. Excludes consumer video games, which are classified under NAICS 5132.

http://lmss.sali.org/1eBnOl7E5JvXM95Kp0B.label: Telecommunications, Media and Entertainment Regulatory Practice

http://lmss.sali.org/0IVTryiHDaoc8QtK0Db.label: Contract or Agreement Scope and Subject Matter
